title: REALM: A Unified Red-Teaming Benchmark for Physical-World VLMs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as perception-reasoning backbones for embodied intelligence in safety-critical physical systems, where perception or reasoning errors can lead to unsafe decisions or actions. Although many red-teaming methods have been developed to probe VLM vulnerabilities, their evaluation remains fragmented across datasets, metrics, and threat models, making direct comparison difficult and obscuring whether observed differences arise from stronger attacks, more vulnerable models, or incompatible evaluation settings. Existing chatbot-centric red-teaming benchmarks mainly standardize jailbreak and content-safety evaluation, but they do not systematically capture physically grounded functional failures or cover red-teaming methods that target physical-world VLMs. This raises the key challenge of comparing diverse attack methods under a unified protocol while targeting the same scenario-specific failures. We introduce REALM, to our knowledge the first unified red-teaming benchmark for physical-world VLMs. REALM integrates 12 red-teaming methods, 3 model-agnostic defenses, and 13 VLMs under a practical black-box threat model with shared datasets and metrics. To align adversarial objectives across attack families, REALM introduces an agentic target-generation pipeline that constructs shared, scenario-specific, and physically grounded attack objectives for each scene, enabling fair comparison of diverse red-teaming methods under aligned adversarial goals. Our evaluation shows that text and typographic injection attacks induce the most failures, multimodal co-optimization yields the strongest visual-perturbation transfer, single-pass attacks approach iterative methods at much lower cost, and model scale alone does not confer adversarial robustness. Code is available at https://github.com/UCF-ML-Research/REALM.

title: The Professor: Multi-Teacher Unsupervised Prompt Distillation for Vision-Language Models
summary: Prompt distillation compresses large vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP into lightweight student models by matching teacher predictions on unlabeled domain images. PromptKD (CVPR 2024) established this paradigm with a single PromptSRC-finetuned ViT-L/14 teacher and a ViT-B/16 student. We propose TheProfessor, a multi-teacher extension that distills from a fixed two-teacher ensemble: a domain-finetuned PromptSRC ViT-L/14 teacher and a zero-shot EVA-CLIP-L/14 teacher whose logits are pre-computed per dataset. We evaluate single-teacher PromptKD, equal-probability ensembling, and confidence-weighted ensembling on four base-to-novel datasets: Caltech-101, DTD, UCF101, and EuroSAT. In a 12-run single-seed sweep, confidence-weighted ensembling improves average HM from 87.52 to 89.28 (+1.77 points), while equal averaging improves average HM to 88.88 (+1.37 points). Gains are dataset dependent: they are negligible on Caltech-101 (+0.16 HM for confidence weighting), modest on UCF101 (+0.62), and largest on domain-shifted EuroSAT (+5.78). These results update our earlier Caltech-only analysis and show that multi-teacher prompt distillation is most useful when the second teacher contributes complementary supervision under domain shift.

AI.title_translation: The Professor：面向视觉语言模型的多教师无监督提示蒸馏
AI.tldr: 通过结合领域微调与零样本两种教师模型，TheProfessor 显著提升了轻量级视觉语言模型的蒸馏效果，尤其在应对领域偏移时表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有的单教师提示蒸馏（如 PromptKD）在处理复杂领域时可能受限于单一知识源，需要探索多教师集成是否能为轻量级学生模型提供更丰富的监督信息。
AI.method: 提出了 TheProfessor 框架，采用双教师集成策略：一个是领域微调的 PromptSRC ViT-L/14 模型，另一个是预计算 Logits 的零样本 EVA-CLIP-L/14 模型，并对比了等概率集成和置信度加权集成两种方法。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上的实验表明，置信度加权集成将平均调和平均数（HM）从 87.52 提升至 89.28，特别是在领域偏移显著的 EuroSAT 数据集上提升高达 5.78 个点。
AI.conclusion: 多教师提示蒸馏（如 TheProfessor）在处理领域偏移时具有显著优势，通过结合不同特性的教师模型，能有效提升轻量级学生模型的泛化性能。
AI.translation: 提示蒸馏将 CLIP 等大型视觉语言模型（VLM）压缩为轻量级学生模型，通过匹配教师在无标签领域图像上的预测来实现。PromptKD（CVPR 2024）利用单一的 PromptSRC 微调 ViT-L/14 教师和 ViT-B/16 学生建立了这一范式。我们提出了 TheProfessor，这是一种多教师扩展方案，从固定的双教师集成中进行蒸馏：一个是领域微调的 PromptSRC ViT-L/14 教师，另一个是针对每个数据集预计算 Logits 的零样本 EVA-CLIP-L/14 教师。我们在 Caltech-101、DTD、UCF101 和 EuroSAT 四个基础到新颖（base-to-novel）数据集上评估了单教师 PromptKD、等概率集成和置信度加权集成。在 12 次单种子运行中，置信度加权集成将平均 HM 从 87.52 提高到 89.28（+1.77 点），而等概率平均将平均 HM 提高到 88.88（+1.37 点）。增益取决于数据集：在 Caltech-101 上几乎可以忽略不计（置信度加权为 +0.16 HM），在 UCF101 上表现适中（+0.62），而在存在领域偏移的 EuroSAT 上增益最大（+5.78）。这些结果更新了我们早期的 Caltech 专项分析，并表明当第二个教师在领域偏移下提供互补监督时，多教师提示蒸馏最为有效。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了 TheProfessor，一种针对视觉语言模型的提示蒸馏方法，通过集成领域微调教师和零样本教师，显著提升了轻量级学生模型在跨数据集任务中的泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 提示蒸馏, 多教师蒸馏, 领域偏移, 模型压缩
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地引入了多教师蒸馏范式，通过结合领域微调教师和零样本教师，利用两者的互补性显著提升了提示蒸馏的效果。其局限性在于性能提升在不同数据集上表现出明显的差异，在领域偏移较大的数据集上效果显著，而在领域相似度较高的数据集上提升较小。

title: ARIA: Adaptive Region-Based Importance Allocation for Conditional Diffusion Distillation
summary: Distilling conditional diffusion models aims to transfer the behavior of a large teacher to a smaller student while preserving alignment across conditioning inputs. Unlike recognition tasks, knowledge distillation in conditional diffusion often struggles to transfer knowledge beyond the training distribution, since the predicted noise strongly depends on the conditioning signal. As a result, effective distillation requires exploring a large conditioning space. In practical settings, this creates a major bottleneck. Paired image-condition data may be limited, and generating synthetic images for every available condition is often computationally infeasible, while the pool of conditions, such as text prompts, can be extremely large. Recent work addresses this issue by switching conditions during training, exposing the student to a broader conditioning space without changing the distillation objective. Yet this raises a complementary question: once a large conditioning corpus is available, how should the training effort be allocated? In this work, we introduce ARIA, a framework that adaptively allocates training effort across coarse regions of the conditioning space. By maintaining online estimates of teacher-student discrepancy at the region level, ARIA focuses updates where misalignment persists while preserving the original distillation objective. Empirically, ARIA improves over RC across most architectures and settings, with the clearest gains observed in unseen and underrepresented regimes. We also provide a theoretical analysis showing that the proposed tracking mechanism follows the evolving discrepancy during training under bounded variance and drift assumptions.

AI.title_translation: ARIA：用于条件扩散蒸馏的自适应区域重要性分配算法
AI.tldr: ARIA通过实时动态调整训练重点，优化了条件扩散模型的蒸馏过程，显著提升了模型在未见条件下的表现。
AI.motivation: 条件扩散模型在知识蒸馏时，由于条件空间巨大且数据配对有限，难以有效覆盖所有条件，导致学生模型在训练分布之外的表现不佳。现有的随机条件采样方法无法高效利用大规模条件语料库。
AI.method: 提出ARIA框架，通过在线维护条件空间各区域的教师-学生差异估计，从而自适应地分配训练权重，专注于处理那些失准较严重的区域，同时保持原始的蒸馏目标。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，ARIA在多种架构和设置下均优于现有的随机条件（RC）方法，特别是在未见过的和样本不足的条件下，效果提升最为明显。理论分析也支持了其追踪差异机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ARIA框架通过自适应地将训练重点分配到条件空间的薄弱区域，有效解决了条件扩散模型蒸馏中的知识迁移难题，并在多个基准测试中优于现有的随机条件采样方法。
AI.translation: 条件扩散模型的蒸馏旨在将大型教师模型的行为转移给较小的学生模型，同时保持与条件输入的一致性。与识别任务不同，条件扩散中的知识蒸馏往往难以将知识转移到训练分布之外，因为预测的噪声强烈依赖于条件信号。因此，有效的蒸馏需要探索巨大的条件空间。在实际应用中，这造成了一个主要的瓶颈。配对的图像-条件数据可能有限，为每个可用条件生成合成图像在计算上往往不可行，而诸如文本提示之类的条件池可能非常庞大。最近的研究通过在训练期间切换条件来解决这个问题，使学生接触到更广泛的条件空间，而不改变蒸馏目标。然而，这提出了一个补充问题：一旦有了大量的条件语料库，应该如何分配训练工作？在这项工作中，我们引入了ARIA，这是一个在条件空间的粗略区域之间自适应分配训练工作的框架。通过在区域级别维护教师-学生差异的在线估计，ARIA将更新重点放在失准仍然存在的地方，同时保留了原始的蒸馏目标。从经验上看，ARIA在大多数架构和设置中都优于RC（随机条件），在未见和代表性不足的方案中观察到了最明显的收益。我们还提供了理论分析，表明所提出的跟踪机制遵循了在有界方差和漂移假设下训练期间不断演变的差异。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ARIA框架，旨在解决条件扩散模型知识蒸馏中训练资源分配不均的问题。通过实时监控条件空间不同区域的蒸馏误差，ARIA能够动态地将训练重点引导至模型表现较差的区域，从而在不改变蒸馏目标的前提下，显著提升模型在广泛条件下的泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 条件扩散模型, 知识蒸馏, 自适应训练分配, 训练效率, 泛化能力
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的策略，通过在线监测教师-学生模型在条件空间区域上的差异，动态调整训练权重。这种方法在处理大规模条件空间时非常有效，尤其是在提升模型对未见或数据稀缺区域的泛化能力方面具有显著优势。其局限性在于可能增加了训练过程的复杂性，且对区域划分的策略依赖性较高。

title: Topological Online Learning for Displacement-based Formation Control
summary: This paper addresses the problem of robust formation control by introducing Topological Online Learning for Displacement-based (TOLD) formation control, a real-time edge-level adaptation framework. Unlike conventional node-level robust controllers that regulate individual robot inputs without modifying the interaction topology, TOLD updates the interaction topology weights online to directly minimize formation distortion. Two strategies are proposed under the TOLD formation control framework: Online Gradient Flow (OGF) with unconstrained weights and Online Exponential Gradient Flow (OExpGF) with non-negative convex weights. Theoretical analysis establishes that, for single-integrator agents over directed graphs, OExpGF guarantees asymptotic consensus, while OGF ensures bounded formation distortion. Simulations with twelve robots under intermittent disturbances show 1.2%-33.14% median cumulative Root Mean Distortion Error reduction when augmenting TOLD with node-level controllers. Hardware experiments with Crazyflie 2.0 quadrotors demonstrate over 62% (OGF) and 31.4% (OExpGF) reduction in median formation distortion compared to fixed-weight consensus.

AI.title_translation: 基于位移编队控制的拓扑在线学习
AI.tldr: 提出了一种在线动态调整多智能体编队拓扑权重的新方法，显著降低了外部干扰下的编队畸变。
AI.motivation: 传统的鲁棒控制器通常只调节节点输入而不改变交互拓扑，在面临干扰时难以有效维持编队结构，因此需要一种能实时适应环境的拓扑调整机制。
AI.method: 提出了TOLD（基于位移的拓扑在线学习）框架，包含两种策略：在线梯度流（OGF，无约束权重）和在线指数梯度流（OExpGF，非负凸权重），旨在通过在线更新交互拓扑权重来最小化编队畸变。
AI.result: 仿真显示畸变误差降低了1.2%-33.14%；Crazyflie 2.0实机实验表明，相比固定权重，OGF和OExpGF分别减少了超过62%和31.4%的编队畸变。
AI.conclusion: TOLD框架通过实时调整交互拓扑权重，能有效降低编队畸变，显著优于传统的固定权重控制方法。
AI.translation: 本文解决了鲁棒编队控制问题，引入了基于位移的拓扑在线学习（TOLD）——一种实时边级自适应框架。与不修改交互拓扑的传统节点级鲁棒控制器不同，TOLD在线更新交互拓扑权重以直接最小化编队畸变。TOLD框架下提出了两种策略：无约束权重的在线梯度流（OGF）和非负凸权重的在线指数梯度流（OExpGF）。理论分析表明，对于有向图上的单积分智能体，OExpGF保证了渐近一致性，而OGF确保了有界编队畸变。在十二个机器人的间歇性干扰仿真中，TOLD与节点级控制器结合后，中位累积均方根畸变误差降低了1.2%-33.14%。Crazyflie 2.0四旋翼硬件实验表明，与固定权重一致性相比，中位编队畸变分别降低了超过62%（OGF）和31.4%（OExpGF）。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于基于位移的编队控制的拓扑在线学习（TOLD）框架，通过实时更新交互拓扑权重来直接最小化编队畸变。该方法包含OGF和OExpGF两种策略，在理论上保证了收敛性和稳定性，并在仿真与实机实验中验证了其在抗干扰场景下显著优于传统固定拓扑控制的性能。
AI.keywords: 在线学习, 编队控制, 拓扑优化, 鲁棒控制, 多智能体系统
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将“在线学习”引入到多智能体编队控制的拓扑结构调整中，从传统的仅调节节点输入转向动态调整边权重，为解决抗干扰编队问题提供了新思路。其实验结果在仿真和实机上均表现出显著的性能提升，具有很高的实用价值。

title: AutoPRAC: Automating Attack Discovery for PRAC-Based Rowhammer Defenses using Model Checkers
summary: Per-Row Activation Counting (PRAC) in DDR5 is a specification to mitigate Rowhammer attacks by tracking activations per row and triggering mitigative refreshes when needed. However, the security of PRAC designs is currently evaluated using human-crafted attack patterns and we lack formal verification of their security properties, or automated techniques to detect implementation flaws. In this work, we present AutoPRAC, the first automated technique to test the security of PRAC-based defenses using model checkers. AutoPRAC models PRAC implementations as bounded state machines and checks security-critical safety properties against a worst-case oracle attacker. If a property is violated, the framework produces a concrete counterexample trace corresponding to a successful attack. Using AutoPRAC, we uncover a previously unreported flaw in MOAT, a state-of-the-art PRAC defense, in its counter-reset policy that allows up to 34 activations to go undetected above the Rowhammer threshold. Our results demonstrate that AutoPRAC can automatically discover subtle security flaws in Rowhammer mitigations and serves as an early-stage design aid for attack discovery on PRAC designs.

title: Scaling Dense Retrieval with LLM-Annotated Training Data: Structured Mining and Progressive Curriculum for E-Commerce Sponsored Search
summary: How can we generate high-quality training data for dense retrieval models at production scale, without relying on click signals or manual annotation? This question is critical for e-commerce sponsored search, where click-based training suffers from position bias and tail-query sparsity, and manual labeling at the scale of hundreds of millions of query-item pairs is economically infeasible. Our work is driven by the following insight: heterogeneous retrieval systems disagree on most items they retrieve, and this disagreement creates a natural source of structured training signal -- easy positives where all systems agree, hard positives that only lexical systems find, and hard negatives that fool exactly one system. As our key novelty, we combine three ideas into an end-to-end pipeline: (a) multi-channel retrieval mining with rank metadata from three production systems, (b) graded-relevance annotation by a calibrated three-model cascade ) that reaches 89.1% agreement with trained human annotators, and (c) three-stage progressive curriculum training that organizes 240M+ training examples across five difficulty levels. We deploy the trained two-tower BERT model on Walmart's sponsored search and evaluate it against 30K queries labeled by trained third-party human annotators. First, we show that the system achieves +5.1% NDCG@10 over the click-trained production baseline, with the largest gain on tail queries . Second, we show that embarrassing retrievals (rating 0) drop from 8.7% to 3.5%. Third, a two-week online A/B test with tens of millions of ad requests per arm confirms +2.80% ad spend, +1.4% CTR, +2.8% eCPM, and +2.9% click conversion rate. Overall, our work provides a practical and scalable blueprint for replacing click-based training with structured LLM-annotated supervision in production retrieval systems.

AI.title_translation: 利用大模型标注数据扩展密集检索：电商赞助搜索中的结构化挖掘与渐进式课程学习
AI.tldr: 通过利用异构检索系统的分歧并结合大模型进行自动化分级标注与课程学习，在电商搜索中显著提升了检索效果，成功替代了传统的点击反馈训练。
AI.motivation: 电商搜索中，基于点击的训练存在严重的位置偏差和长尾查询稀疏问题，而手动标注数亿对数据成本过高，亟需一种无需点击信号或人工标注的高质量大规模数据生成方案。
AI.method: 1. 多通道检索挖掘：利用三个生产系统获取检索结果及排名元数据；2. 大模型标注：使用校准后的三模型级联进行分级相关性标注；3. 渐进式课程学习：将2.4亿+训练数据按难度分为五个等级，进行三阶段训练。
AI.result: 在沃尔玛赞助搜索中，相比基准线，NDCG@10提升5.1%，严重错误检索下降至3.5%；在线A/B测试显示广告支出增加2.80%，CTR提升1.4%，eCPM提升2.8%，转化率提升2.9%。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一套可扩展的、基于大模型注释的检索模型训练框架，证明了在电商场景下，利用结构化挖掘和课程学习替代点击反馈训练是高效且可行的。
AI.translation: 我们如何能够在不依赖点击信号或人工标注的情况下，以生产规模为密集检索模型生成高质量的训练数据？这个问题对于电商赞助搜索至关重要，因为基于点击的训练受到位置偏差和长尾查询稀疏性的困扰，而对数以亿计的查询-商品对进行人工标注在经济上是不可行的。我们的工作受到以下洞察的驱动：异构检索系统在它们检索到的大多数商品上存在分歧，这种分歧产生了一个自然的结构化训练信号来源——所有系统都同意的“简单正样本”、只有词法系统才能找到的“困难正样本”，以及恰好能误导一个系统的“困难负样本”。作为核心创新，我们将三个理念结合到一个端到端流水线中：(a) 利用三个生产系统的排名元数据进行多通道检索挖掘；(b) 通过校准后的三模型级联进行分级相关性标注，该标注与受过训练的人工标注者的一致性达到89.1%；(c) 三阶段渐进式课程训练，将2.4亿多个训练样本组织为五个难度级别。我们将训练好的双塔BERT模型部署在沃尔玛的赞助搜索中，并针对由受过训练的第三方人工标注者标记的3万个查询进行了评估。首先，我们证明该系统比基于点击训练的生产基线在NDCG@10上提升了5.1%，在长尾查询上的提升最为显著。其次，我们证明令人尴尬的检索结果（评级为0）从8.7%下降到3.5%。第三，为期两周、涉及数千万广告请求的在线A/B测试确认了广告支出增加2.80%、点击率（CTR）提升1.4%、每千次展示收益（eCPM）提升2.8%以及点击转化率提升2.9%。总的来说，我们的工作为在生产检索系统中用结构化的大模型标注监督取代基于点击的训练提供了一个实用且可扩展的蓝图。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用大模型生成高质量训练数据以优化电商密集检索模型的方法。通过挖掘异构检索系统的分歧，结合大模型级联进行分级标注，并实施三阶段渐进式课程训练，成功在大规模生产环境中替代了传统的点击反馈训练，显著提升了搜索质量和商业指标。
AI.keywords: 密集检索, 电商搜索, 大模型标注, 课程学习, 生产环境部署
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地利用异构检索系统的分歧点作为训练信号，结合大模型作为标注器，有效解决了电商搜索中点击数据偏差和稀疏性问题。其实用性极强，通过三阶段课程学习成功将大规模合成数据转化为生产力，是工业界利用LLM改进检索系统的典范。

title: Closing the Loop: Formally Verified Law as a Reward Signal for Self-Improving Legal AI
summary: This article develops an architecture that creates a formally verifiable reward signal to train legal AI, adapting the LLM proposes, verifier disposes paradigm from mathematical AI to the distinctive demands of law. We present an architecture comprising LLM-driven autoformalization into a formal legal calculus extending Catala, a verification kernel, and explanation generation grounded in formal proof traces. For the computational components of law, the architecture provides provable correctness. For open-textured legal analysis, it provides structural guarantees: every required stage of the legal argument is addressed, argumentation is exercised at the correct stages and not omitted, and the deductive links between steps are valid. We demonstrate the architecture on procedural deadline calculations in German law, Commerce Clause analysis in U.S. constitutional law, and cross-jurisdictional sanction proportionality. We further show that the same architecture has a structural advantage for legal AI training: a deterministic external verifier supplies verifiable outcomes for legal problems and thereby closes the traditional reinforcement-learning loop gap in law.

title: Do LLM Attribution Metrics Transfer? Auditing Retrieval-Augmented Generation Evaluation Across Datasets and Constructs
authors: Juan Pablo De la Cruz Weinstein
summary: Practice often treats automatic metrics for attribution in LLM retrieval-augmented generation as interchangeable. We audit eight automatic scorers -- lexical, embedding, and BERTScore baselines alongside entailment/grounding-trained models (clean and FEVER NLI, the checker MiniCheck) -- across three evaluation constructs (provenance/topicality, generated-answer attribution, and fact-check entailment), asking whether any scorer transfers: stays within the 95% confidence interval of the best audited scorer on every dataset of a multi-dataset construct. In the construct with the most multi-dataset human-labeled coverage -- generated-answer attribution (AttributionBench's four source datasets, n = 1,610, with independent HAGRID, n = 2,150) -- none does: the per-dataset metric rankings invert (Kendall tau = -0.64, p = 0.031 on AttributedQA vs. LFQA), and an off-the-shelf NLI scorer that is best on short-claim AttributedQA (AUROC 0.90) collapses to AUROC 0.53 (chance) on long-form LFQA, where BERTScore wins (0.91); the flip is not a length or truncation artifact. This instability has a concrete decision cost: a naive "best-on-average" rule for choosing an evaluator fails leave-one-dataset-out (mean held-out regret 0.172 AUROC, worse than fixing one scorer), so metric choice must be validated on the target dataset rather than learned from others. A prompt-based LLM judge avoids the chance-level collapses the automatic scorers suffer (no LFQA collapse) but is not uniformly best, ~100x costlier, and non-deterministic -- relocating, not removing, the validation burden.

AI.title_translation: LLM归因指标能迁移吗？跨数据集与结构的检索增强生成评估审计
AI.tldr: RAG的自动评估指标在不同数据集间表现极不稳定，不存在通用最优指标，因此必须在目标数据集上进行单独验证。
AI.motivation: 实践中常错误地将LLM检索增强生成（RAG）的自动归因指标视为可互换的，作者旨在探究这些指标在不同数据集和评估结构下是否具有跨数据集的泛化能力。
AI.method: 研究审计了8种自动评分器（包括词法、嵌入、BERTScore及NLI模型），跨越三种评估结构，对比了它们在多个数据集上的表现，并计算了Kendall tau相关系数和AUROC，同时对比了基于Prompt的LLM judge。
AI.result: 没有指标能跨所有数据集保持最优。指标排名在不同数据集上甚至出现倒置（Kendall tau = -0.64），且某些在短文本上表现极佳的指标在长文本上会跌至随机水平（AUROC 0.90降至0.53）。“平均最优”指标策略在留一法验证中表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: RAG的自动归因指标在不同数据集间表现不稳定且无法泛化，不存在通用的“最优指标”。研究建议必须在目标数据集上对评估指标进行特定验证，而基于LLM的评估器虽然避免了某些崩塌，但存在成本高和不确定性等问题。
AI.translation: 实践中通常将LLM检索增强生成（RAG）中用于归因的自动指标视为可互换的。我们审计了八种自动评分器——包括词法、嵌入和BERTScore基线，以及经过蕴含/基础训练的模型（clean和FEVER NLI，检查器MiniCheck）——涵盖三种评估结构（来源/主题相关性、生成答案归因和事实核查蕴含），探究是否有任何评分器能够迁移：即在多数据集结构的每个数据集上，其表现是否始终处于最佳审计评分器的95%置信区间内。在具有最多多数据集人工标注覆盖的结构中——生成答案归因（AttributionBench的四个源数据集，n=1,610，及独立的HAGRID，n=2,150）——没有任何评分器能做到这一点：各数据集的指标排名发生倒置（AttributedQA与LFQA上的Kendall tau = -0.64, p = 0.031），并且在短声明AttributedQA上表现最好的现成NLI评分器（AUROC 0.90）在长篇LFQA上会崩溃至AUROC 0.53（随机水平），而此时BERTScore胜出（0.91）；这种翻转并非长度或截断伪影。这种不稳定性具有具体的决策成本：选择评估器的朴素“平均最优”规则在留一法验证中失败（平均留出遗憾为0.172 AUROC，比固定选择一个评分器更差），因此指标选择必须在目标数据集上进行验证，而不是从其他数据集中学习。基于Prompt的LLM judge避免了自动评分器所遭受的随机水平崩溃（LFQA无崩溃），但并非在所有情况下都是最好的，且成本高出约100倍且具有非确定性——这只是转移而非消除了验证负担。
AI.summary: 本文系统性地评估了RAG归因指标的泛化性能。研究发现，现有的自动评分器在不同数据集上表现极不稳定，无法跨数据集通用。实验表明，指标的选择必须针对具体数据集进行验证，而不能简单依赖平均表现。LLM judge虽能缓解部分崩塌问题，但伴随着高昂的成本和非确定性。
AI.keywords: 检索增强生成 (RAG), 归因评估, 指标泛化性, LLM评估器, 评估不稳定性
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了RAG评估指标在不同数据集之间缺乏泛化能力的严重问题，打破了指标可互换的假设。这对开发可靠的RAG评估系统具有重要启示，强调了在目标数据集上进行指标验证的必要性，而非盲目依赖“平均表现最好”的指标。

title: Trustworthy Image Authentication using Forensic Knowledge Graphs
summary: Advances in generative AI have made image falsification highly realistic, demanding trustworthy authentication systems. Existing forensic detectors can target certain forgery types but lack interpretability, while vision-language models (VLMs) provide explanations but cannot exploit forensic traces for reliable detection. We propose Forensic Knowledge Graphs (FKGs), a unified framework that integrates forensic evidence extraction, structured reasoning, and human-interpretable explanation. Our FKG structure encodes forensic traces along with their causal dependencies and links to scene content. To generate accurate FKGs, we introduce a novel forensic authentication network and an Iterative Context Refinement strategy that guides VLMs to produce faithful, grounded explanations. We also present FKG-50K, a dataset of 50,000 realistic forgeries with ground-truth FKGs. Experiments demonstrate that FKG outperforms both forensic detectors and VLMs in detection, forgery identification and localization, and forensic justification.

AI.title_translation: 基于取证知识图谱的可信图像认证
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于取证知识图谱的统一框架，通过结合证据提取、结构化推理与人类可读解释，在图像篡改检测与可解释性方面显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI导致图像篡改愈发逼真，现有的取证检测器缺乏可解释性，而视觉语言模型（VLM）虽然具有解释能力但在取证可靠性上存在缺陷，需要一种既能可靠检测又能提供可解释性证据的方法。
AI.method: 提出了取证知识图谱（FKG）框架，包含取证证据提取、结构化推理和人类可解释的解释；引入了新的取证认证网络和迭代上下文细化策略（Iterative Context Refinement）以增强VLM的生成能力；并构建了FKG-50K数据集。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，FKG在图像篡改检测、识别、定位以及取证解释方面均优于现有的取证检测器和视觉语言模型。
AI.conclusion: Forensic Knowledge Graphs (FKG) 提供了一个统一的框架，通过结合取证证据、结构化推理和人类可读的解释，显著提升了图像真实性鉴定的准确性和可解释性。
AI.translation: 生成式人工智能的进步使得图像伪造变得高度逼真，这迫切需要可信的认证系统。现有的取证检测器可以针对某些类型的伪造，但缺乏可解释性；而视觉语言模型（VLM）虽然能够提供解释，却无法利用取证痕迹进行可靠的检测。我们提出了取证知识图谱（FKG），这是一个集取证证据提取、结构化推理和人类可解释性于一体的统一框架。FKG结构对取证痕迹及其因果依赖关系以及与场景内容的联系进行了编码。为了生成准确的FKG，我们引入了一种新颖的取证认证网络和一种迭代上下文细化策略，引导VLM生成忠实且有据可查的解释。我们还提出了FKG-50K，这是一个包含50,000个具有真实FKG标注的逼真伪造数据集。实验表明，FKG在检测、伪造识别与定位以及取证论证方面均优于现有的取证检测器和VLM。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为取证知识图谱（FKG）的统一框架，通过整合取证证据、结构化推理和人类可读的解释，有效应对了生成式AI带来的图像伪造挑战。该框架通过创新的认证网络和迭代上下文细化策略，实现了对图像篡改的可靠检测与解释，并配套发布了FKG-50K数据集。
AI.keywords: 图像取证, 知识图谱, 可解释性, 生成式AI, 视觉语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将取证技术与知识图谱相结合，解决了传统取证模型缺乏可解释性以及视觉语言模型在取证可靠性上的不足。FKG-50K数据集的构建为该领域的研究提供了宝贵的基准。其局限性可能在于构建高质量知识图谱的计算成本以及对复杂伪造场景的泛化能力。

title: Unified Multi-Task Relevance Modeling for E-Commerce: Comparing Task Routing Architectures Across LLMs and Cross-Encoders
summary: How can we build a single relevance model that handles six different entity pair relationship types in e commerce from query product matching to product type similarity when each task has different data volumes, different semantic requirements, and potentially conflicting learning signals? This question is important because current industry practice relies on separate models for each task, preventing knowledge transfer and producing inconsistent relevance signals. Our work is driven by the following insight: encoder based and decoder only models encode task identity through different mechanisms, so the choice of task routing architecture how task identity is communicated to the shared model affects these two families in asymmetric ways. As our key novelty, we combine three ideas: (a) a unified multi task framework that jointly trains on six entity pair tasks under a shared three point relevance scale, (b) a systematic comparison of three task routing architectures (text prefix routing, multi head classification, and multihead with private transformer layers) across both LoRA adapted LLMs and fully finetuned cross encoders, and (c) a majority vote ensemble that exploits the diversity induced by private layer routing. First, we show that the MHP Ensemble (multi head with private layers) achieves 89.96% accuracy on 453K test examples the highest across all configurations . Second, we show that removing text prefixes without private layers causes severe degradation for decoder only LLMs while cross encoders remain robust , suggesting an encoder decoder asymmetry in task identity encoding. Third, we show that multi task training yields up to 14% improvement on low resource tasks over single task baselines.

title: Catastrophic Compositional Generation: Why Vanilla Diffusion Models Fail to Extrapolate
summary: The task of compositional generation involves using a conditional generative model, trained only on a subset of the possible conditions, to produce samples from compositionally-defined target distributions such as a geometric combination of the source distributions. In this work, we argue that this task is often infeasible for vanilla conditional diffusion models: we conjecture that no inference-time technique can efficiently produce samples from the target distribution in certain well-motivated settings. This idea is supported by theory-guided generalization arguments and carefully-designed experiments on both synthetic and realistic data. In particular, while recent methods such as Feynman-Kac correction reduce inference-time approximation error, our results show that score estimation error has a more catastrophic effect on performance when the target distribution is out-of-distribution with respect to the sources, highlighting the need for a different approach to this task.

title: RIFT-Bench: Dynamic Red-teaming For Agentic AI Systems
summary: Agentic AI systems powered by large language models (LLMs) are rapidly evolving into autonomous decision-making systems, exposing attack vectors beyond those of traditional LLM vulnerabilities. Existing security evaluations are often tied to specific implementations or domains, limiting unified comparison across heterogeneous systems. To address this gap, we introduce RIFT-Bench, a graph representation-driven methodology for dynamic red-teaming that enables unified evaluations across diverse agentic architectures. Building on a novel hierarchical representation, RIFT-Bench operates in two automated phases: Discovery, which extracts system structure, and Scanning, which deploys adaptive adversarial attacks and produces a comprehensive evaluation report. It evaluates the examined system itself, leveraging a broad set of dynamically adaptable adversarial probes across diverse attack vectors and objectives. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed evaluation pipeline across 45 agentic systems spanning a diverse range of implementations, showing that the approach generalizes effectively to heterogeneous agentic architectures. Beyond systems and attacks, RIFT-Bench also supports direct evaluation of mitigation strategies. These key capabilities make RIFT-Bench a scalable foundation for security evaluation of agentic AI systems.

title: Welfarist Control Design -- How to fulfill the societal mandate in multi-agent control?
summary: At the core of most socio-technical systems lies a scarce resource that is allocated among agents: highway lanes, public transit, road space, water rights, energy access, grid capacity, user attention, pollution rights, etc. With further automation of the underlying allocation processes, control engineers are increasingly tasked to make decisive assumptions regarding what society wants. In practice to date, design choices are largely driven by industry norms and conventions rather than a result of conscientiously responsible and ethical design. In this paper, we look at tools available to control engineers to design systems in a more principled manner in order to match the societal mandate. We consider three control design paradigms: online feedback optimization, control of Markov decision processes, and model predictive control. Beginning with aggregating individual agents' preferences into control design objectives, subsequently ensuring and certifying the fulfillment of those specifications, we argue that the feedback nature of control systems enables appropriate allocation of the shared resources in ways hitherto unparalleled.

title: KLip-PPO: A per-sample KL perspective on PPO-Clip
summary: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is the standard policy-gradient algorithm for on-policy reinforcement learning. The literature presents it in two forms, a clipped surrogate that bounds the importance ratio between successive policies and a Kullback-Leibler penalty between them. These forms are treated as separate algorithms with their own gradients, their own hyperparameters, and their own reference implementations, and a sizeable body of empirical work compares them. We show that the gradient of the clipped surrogate is reproduced exactly by a Kullback-Leibler surrogate whose coefficient varies per sample, with closed-form dependence on the importance ratio and the advantage. The identity holds at every minibatch step and across the entire inner loop, and on five MuJoCo continuous-control benchmarks the two losses produce indistinguishable training curves. The reformulation exposes a structural feature of the clipped surrogate that the min notation hides. PPO-Clip's implicit per-sample penalty is a step function at the boundary of the trust region, and the shape of this coefficient is the natural design axis for generalising the algorithm. We sketch the resulting follow-up directions in the discussion.

title: Flow-Corrected Thompson Sampling for Non-Stationary Contextual Bandits
summary: We study non-stationary linear contextual bandits where the reward model drifts over time, rendering classical contextual bandit algorithms brittle because historical data becomes systematically biased. We propose Flow-Corrected Thompson Sampling (fcTS), a Bayesian method that reuses experience by transporting past rewards to the present using an explicit drift model and incorporating each transported observation with a confidence weight that reflects transport reliability. This yields a unified template that specializes in (i) linear parameter drift via online slope estimation and reward correction, (ii) periodic variation via phase-aware reuse across cycles, and (iii) recurring regime switches via changepoint detection and regime-specific posterior memory. The resulting posterior updates remain closed-form under a linear Gaussian model and can be implemented efficiently with truncated, incrementally updated sufficient statistics. Across five controlled case studies and a semi-synthetic portfolio-selection benchmark with multiple overlapping non-stationarities, fcTS outperforms standard forgetting-based baselines (discounting, sliding windows, and periodic restarts), with the largest gains in settings exhibiting recurring temporal structure. These results demonstrate that when non-stationarity is structured, correcting and reweighting historical observations can be substantially more sample-efficient than uniformly discarding them.

AI.title_translation: 面向非平稳上下文赌博机的流修正汤普森采样
AI.tldr: 提出了一种通过修正和重用历史数据（而非丢弃）来处理非平稳上下文赌博机问题的新方法，显著提升了样本效率。
AI.motivation: 在非平稳线性上下文赌博机中，传统的算法因历史数据存在系统性偏差而变得脆弱，简单的遗忘策略（如折扣或滑动窗口）往往会导致样本效率低下。作者旨在通过修正历史数据而非直接丢弃，来提升算法在非平稳环境下的表现。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“流修正汤普森采样”（fcTS）的算法，通过显式的漂移模型将历史奖励数据转换到当前，并根据转换的可靠性赋予置信权重。该方法针对线性参数漂移、周期性变化和循环制度切换提供了统一的修正模板，并利用截断的、增量更新的充分统计量实现了高效的闭式后验更新。
AI.result: 在五个受控案例研究和一个半合成投资组合选择基准测试中，fcTS 在处理多种重叠非平稳性的场景下，表现均优于传统的基于遗忘的基线算法，特别是在具有循环时间结构的环境中优势最为明显。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式的 drift 模型对历史数据进行修正和加权，fcTS 在处理具有结构化非平稳性的上下文赌博机问题时，比传统的遗忘机制（如折扣或滑动窗口）具有更高的样本效率。
AI.translation: 我们研究了奖励模型随时间漂移的非平稳线性上下文赌博机问题，这使得经典的上下文赌博机算法因历史数据产生系统性偏差而变得脆弱。我们提出了流修正汤普森采样（fcTS），这是一种贝叶斯方法，它通过显式的漂移模型将过去的奖励运输到当前，并结合反映运输可靠性的置信权重来重用经验。这产生了一个统一的模板，专门用于（i）通过在线斜率估计和奖励修正处理线性参数漂移，（ii）通过跨周期的相位感知重用处理周期性变化，以及（iii）通过变点检测和特定制度的后验记忆处理循环制度切换。在线性高斯模型下，所得的后验更新保持闭式，并可通过截断的、增量更新的充分统计量高效实现。在五个受控案例研究和一个具有多个重叠非平稳性的半合成投资组合选择基准中，fcTS 的表现优于标准的基于遗忘的基线（折扣、滑动窗口和周期性重启），在表现出循环时间结构的设置中增益最大。这些结果表明，当非平稳性具有结构时，修正和重新加权历史观测值比统一丢弃它们在样本效率上要高得多。
AI.summary: 本文针对非平稳线性上下文赌博机问题，提出了一种名为“流修正汤普森采样”（fcTS）的新型贝叶斯方法。该方法通过引入显式漂移模型，将过去的数据修正并加权后重新利用，从而有效地处理了线性漂移、周期性变化和制度切换等多种非平稳结构，显著提升了算法的样本效率。
AI.keywords: 非平稳上下文赌博机, 汤普森采样, 数据运输, 漂移模型, 样本效率
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于引入了“流修正”（Flow-Corrected）机制，通过显式的漂移模型将过去的数据“运输”到当前，而非简单地丢弃旧数据，从而在处理结构化非平稳性问题上取得了显著的样本效率提升。这为解决非平稳环境下的强化学习问题提供了一种优雅且通用的贝叶斯框架。

title: An Efficient Construction of Completely Independent Spanning Trees in Dense Gaussian Networks
summary: Fault tolerance in routing and broadcasting is a critical aspect in ensuring the reliability and robustness of communication networks, particularly in environments prone to failures. This work presents an efficient method for constructing Completely Independent Spanning Trees (CISTs) within dense Gaussian networks, providing improved fault tolerance, reliability, and communication efficiency in large-scale interconnection systems. To construct the CISTs in the Gaussian network, we partition the network into sets, and accordingly the nodes are connected properly to form the first CIST and then rotated to get the second CIST with less depth than the existing state-of-art. To evaluate the performance of the proposed construction, we calculated the average maximum number of steps required to deliver a message from the root node to all other nodes in the network. A comparison with existing approaches shows that our construction outperforms them, achieving an improvement of at least 33%

title: When Retrieval Metrics Mislead: Measuring Policy Signal in Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
authors: Juan Pablo De la Cruz Weinstein
summary: Exact-match retrieval recall is often used as a proxy for whether a retriever supplies useful policy context to a downstream decision model. We test this proxy for pre-action policy classification in tau-bench using Qwen2.5-3B/7B classifiers. Under gold-policy conditioning, a compact structured state improves macro-F1 over raw trajectories by 0.13-0.17 after tuning. We then replace the benchmark-designated policy clause with the top-ranked clause retrieved from decision-time context. Although the exact governing clause is retrieved at rank 1 for only 7% of airline states, the primary 3B classifier obtains macro-F1 0.58 with retrieved clauses versus 0.60 with gold clauses (Delta=-0.02, task-cluster 95% CI [-0.23,+0.21]); mismatched-policy and no-policy controls score 0.32 and 0.21. We do not detect a macro-F1 difference between retrieved and gold clauses in this configuration, although the interval remains too wide to establish non-inferiority. The same qualitative pattern appears with a second retriever and at 7B, while varying across fine-tuning configurations. These results indicate that exact-match clause recall can underestimate downstream policy utility in this benchmark setting, motivating evaluation with retrieved policies in the classification loop rather than recall alone.

AI.title_translation: 当检索指标误导：在长视野工具使用智能体中衡量策略信号
AI.tldr: 精确匹配检索召回率会低估下游策略的实用性，建议在下游分类循环中直接评估检索到的策略，而非仅依赖召回率指标。
AI.motivation: 精确匹配检索召回率常被用作衡量检索器是否为下游决策模型提供有用策略上下文的代理指标，但该指标可能会误导，因此需要测试其在实际长视野工具使用智能体任务中的有效性。
AI.method: 在tau-bench基准上使用Qwen2.5-3B/7B分类器进行动作前策略分类。首先测试黄金策略调节下结构化状态对性能的提升；然后将基准指定的策略条款替换为从决策时上下文中检索到的排名第一的条款，并对比使用检索条款、黄金条款、不匹配策略和无策略控制组的宏F1（macro-F1）得分。
AI.result: 尽管在航空状态下精确控制条款在排名第一处的检索率仅为7%，但使用检索条款的3B分类器宏F1得分达到0.58，与使用黄金条款的0.60极其接近（差距仅为-0.02），而未匹配和无策略控制组得分仅为0.32和0.21。在7B模型和第二种检索器上也观察到了相同的定性模式。
AI.conclusion: 精确匹配条款召回率在基准设置中会低估下游策略的实用性。因此，评估检索质量时，应当在分类循环中直接使用检索到的策略进行端到端评估，而不是仅仅依赖召回率指标。
AI.translation: 精确匹配检索召回率通常被用作评估检索器是否为下游决策模型提供有用策略上下文的替代指标。我们在tau-bench中使用Qwen2.5-3B/7B分类器对这种替代指标在动作前策略分类中的表现进行了测试。在黄金策略调节下，经过微调后，紧凑的结构化状态相比于原始轨迹将宏观F1（macro-F1）提高了0.13-0.17。然后，我们将基准指定的策略条款替换为从决策时上下文中检索到的排名第一的条款。尽管对于航空公司状态，精确的控制条款在排名第一处的检索率仅为7%，但主要的3B分类器在使用检索条款时获得了0.58的宏观F1值，而使用黄金条款时为0.60（差异为-0.02，任务集群95%置信区间为[-0.23, +0.21]）；相比之下，不匹配策略和无策略的对照组得分分别为0.32和0.21。在此配置中，我们没有检测到检索条款和黄金条款之间的宏观F1差异，尽管置信区间仍然太宽，无法确立非劣效性。在使用第二种检索器和7B模型时，也出现了相同的定性模式，但在不同的微调配置下会有所变化。这些结果表明，在这一基准设置中，精确匹配条款召回率可能会低估下游策略的实用性，从而促使在分类循环中使用检索到的策略进行评估，而不是仅仅依赖召回率。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了长视野工具使用智能体中检索指标（如精确匹配召回率）的局限性。作者在tau-bench基准上使用Qwen2.5-3B/7B模型，对比了使用检索到的策略条款与黄金策略条款在动作前策略分类任务中的表现。实验表明，尽管精确条款的检索召回率极低（仅7%），但下游分类器使用检索条款的性能（宏F1为0.58）与使用黄金条款（0.60）几乎没有检测到差异，远优于对照组。这表明精确匹配召回率低估了检索内容的实际下游效用，建议在评估中直接将检索策略纳入分类循环中进行测试。
AI.keywords: 检索指标, 策略信号, 工具使用智能体, 召回率, tau-bench
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了信息检索评估指标（如精确匹配召回率）与下游实际任务表现之间的脱节，指出低召回率并不一定代表低实用性，这对大模型智能体（Agent）系统的评估设计具有重要启发意义。不过，研究中置信区间较宽，尚未能完全确立检索策略与黄金策略的非劣效性。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Drive: Rule-Grounded Faithful Reasoning for Driving VLAs
summary: Driving VLA models incorporating Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning are attractive because they leverage pretrained VLM representations and expose intermediate decisions in natural language, yet current rationales often lack the step-by-step decision semantics needed to keep the rationale causally connected to the planned motion. We introduce Neuro-Symbolic Drive, a neuro-symbolic driving framework that supervises a driving VLA with rule-grounded reasoning traces extracted directly from classical rule-based planners. Our key observation is that rule-based planners are symbolic AI systems that already function as executable reasoning engines: they reason about active safety constraints, search over candidate maneuvers, and select a final trajectory. We instrument these planners in simulation to capture both the executed trajectory and the internal decision trace at each rule-evaluation step. Each trace is serialized into structured rule-grounded reasoning and paired with the trajectory to fine-tune Qwen3.5-4B as a driving VLA. Because these traces are derived directly from the planner states that determine the action, they ensure reasoning is structurally coupled to motion generation by construction, rather than by post-hoc alignment. On our simulator-generated benchmark, detailed rule-grounded reasoning reduces ADE@3s from 0.47 to 0.26 and miss rate from 8.30% to 6.40% under three-camera perception, and from 0.54 to 0.26 and 10.13% to 5.99% under eight-camera perception. Neuro-Symbolic Drive thus converts neuro-symbolic planning logic into structured supervision. Code base: https://github.com/XiangboGaoBarry/Neural-Symbolic-Drive.

AI.title_translation: 神经符号驾驶：面向驾驶VLA的规则基础忠实推理
AI.tldr: Neuro-Symbolic Drive是一个神经符号驾驶框架，它通过将基于规则的规划器中的内部决策轨迹作为结构化监督，来微调驾驶VLA，从而解决现有驾驶VLA中推理与运动之间因果连接不足的问题，并显著提升了驾驶性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的驾驶VLA模型虽然利用思维链（CoT）推理，但其理由通常缺乏逐步决策语义，导致推理与规划的运动之间缺乏因果连接，影响了其忠实性。
AI.method: 本文提出了Neuro-Symbolic Drive框架。该框架通过在模拟中检测经典的基于规则的规划器，提取其在每个规则评估步骤的执行轨迹和内部决策轨迹。这些轨迹被序列化为结构化的规则基础推理，并与轨迹配对，用于微调Qwen3.5-4B等驾驶VLA。这种方法确保了推理与运动生成在结构上的耦合，而非事后对齐。
AI.result: 在模拟器生成的基准上，Neuro-Symbolic Drive显著提升了性能。在三摄像头感知下，ADE@3s从0.47降低到0.26，漏报率从8.30%降低到6.40%。在八摄像头感知下，ADE@3s从0.54降低到0.26，漏报率从10.13%降低到5.99%。该方法成功地将神经符号规划逻辑转换为结构化监督。
AI.conclusion: Neuro-Symbolic Drive通过利用基于规则的规划器中的内部决策轨迹作为结构化监督，有效地解决了驾驶VLA中推理与运动之间因果连接不足的问题，显著提升了模型的性能和推理的忠实性。
AI.translation: 驾驶VLA模型结合思维链（CoT）推理具有吸引力，因为它们利用了预训练的VLM表示并在自然语言中暴露中间决策，但当前的理由通常缺乏将理由与计划运动因果连接所需的逐步决策语义。我们引入了神经符号驾驶（Neuro-Symbolic Drive），这是一个神经符号驾驶框架，它使用直接从经典基于规则的规划器中提取的规则基础推理轨迹来监督驾驶VLA。我们的关键观察是，基于规则的规划器是符号AI系统，它们已经作为可执行的推理引擎运行：它们推理主动安全约束，搜索候选机动，并选择最终轨迹。我们在模拟中对这些规划器进行检测，以捕获每个规则评估步骤的执行轨迹和内部决策轨迹。每个轨迹都被序列化为结构化的规则基础推理，并与轨迹配对以微调Qwen3.5-4B作为驾驶VLA。由于这些轨迹直接来源于决定动作的规划器状态，它们通过结构而非事后对齐，确保推理与运动生成在结构上耦合。在我们模拟器生成的基准上，详细的规则基础推理在三摄像头感知下将ADE@3s从0.47降低到0.26，漏报率从8.30%降低到6.40%；在八摄像头感知下从0.54降低到0.26，从10.13%降低到5.99%。因此，神经符号驾驶将神经符号规划逻辑转换为结构化监督。代码库：https://github.com/XiangboGaoBarry/Neural-Symbolic-Drive。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Neuro-Symbolic Drive框架，旨在解决现有驾驶VLA模型中思维链推理与实际运动之间因果连接不足的问题。该框架通过从经典规则规划器中提取规则基础的内部决策轨迹，将其作为结构化监督来微调驾驶VLA（如Qwen3.5-4B）。这些轨迹直接反映了规划器决定动作的状态，从而确保了推理与运动生成之间的结构化耦合。实验结果表明，在模拟器生成的基准上，Neuro-Symbolic Drive显著降低了ADE@3s和漏报率，证明了其将神经符号规划逻辑转化为有效结构化监督的能力，从而提升了驾驶VLA的性能。
AI.keywords: 神经符号驾驶, 规则基础推理, 驾驶VLA, 结构化监督, 自动驾驶
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将传统规则规划器内部的决策逻辑（符号AI）转化为结构化监督信号，用于训练现代VLA模型（神经AI），从而弥合了神经与符号AI之间的鸿沟，并确保了推理的忠实性和与动作的因果连接。这种方法提供了一种提升自动驾驶系统可解释性和安全性的新途径。

title: BipBipCache: Pipeline-Aware Integration of Low-Latency Tweakable Encryption in an Embedded Cache Controller
summary:
Consumer and embedded processors store sensitive data in on-chip SRAM caches that remain readable after power loss or physical probing unless ciphertext is maintained in the memory array itself. This paper presents BipBipCache, a direct-mapped cache controller that integrates the BipBip tweakable block cipher (TBC) to encrypt cache data and tags in real time using a C$^3$-style 24+40 bit decomposition of each 64-bit word. We reconstruct the first pipelined hardware BipBip encryptor from a decryptor-centric specification and coordinate it with a 3-cycle decryptor inside the cache datapath.
  Our threat model targets confidentiality of cache-resident contents against cold-boot, bus, and SRAM readout attacks. A key architectural result is that 6-cycle encryption latency does not fully translate into 6-cycle write penalty: the first three encryptor stages overlap with tag decryption and hit detection, leaving an effective 3-cycle write commitment after hit verification. We verify encryptor and decryptor correctness against the official BipBip C++ reference (five vectors each), report FPGA resource utilization on Xilinx Artix-7 (3,356 LUTs, 16.1% of device; crypto logic ~79% of LUTs), and confirm end-to-end operation on hardware.

AI.title_translation: BipBipCache：嵌入式缓存控制器中低延迟可调加密的流水线感知集成
AI.tldr: BipBipCache是一种直接映射缓存控制器，它集成BipBip可调块密码以实时加密缓存数据和标签，并通过流水线设计将6周期加密延迟的写惩罚有效降低到3周期，从而保护缓存内容的机密性。
AI.motivation: 保护片上SRAM缓存中的敏感数据，防止断电或物理探测导致数据泄露（如冷启动、总线和SRAM读出攻击）。
AI.method: 提出BipBipCache，一个直接映射缓存控制器，它将BipBip可调块密码（TBC）集成到缓存数据路径中，用于实时加密缓存数据和标签。采用C$^3$风格的24+40位分解64位字，并重建了第一个流水线硬件BipBip加密器，与3周期解密器协调工作。
AI.result: 6周期加密延迟通过流水线设计，有效写提交时间降至3周期（前三阶段与标签解密和命中检测重叠）。加密器和解密器通过官方BipBip C++参考（各五个向量）验证了正确性。报告了Xilinx Artix-7上FPGA资源利用率（3,356个LUTs，占设备的16.1%；加密逻辑约占LUT的79%）。确认了硬件上的端到端操作。
AI.conclusion: BipBipCache成功地在嵌入式缓存控制器中集成了低延迟可调加密，有效保护了缓存数据的机密性，并通过流水线优化显著降低了写惩罚。
AI.translation: 消费者和嵌入式处理器将敏感数据存储在片上SRAM缓存中，除非在内存阵列本身中维护密文，否则在断电或物理探测后这些数据仍然可读。本文提出了BipBipCache，一个直接映射缓存控制器，它集成了BipBip可调块密码（TBC），以使用每个64位字的C$^3$风格24+40位分解实时加密缓存数据和标签。我们从以解密器为中心的规范中重建了第一个流水线硬件BipBip加密器，并将其与缓存数据路径内的3周期解密器协调。我们的威胁模型针对缓存驻留内容针对冷启动、总线和SRAM读出攻击的机密性。一个关键的架构结果是，6周期加密延迟并未完全转化为6周期写惩罚：前三个加密器阶段与标签解密和命中检测重叠，在命中验证后留下了有效的3周期写提交。我们根据官方BipBip C++参考（各五个向量）验证了加密器和解密器的正确性，报告了Xilinx Artix-7上的FPGA资源利用率（3,356个LUT，占设备的16.1%；加密逻辑约占LUT的79%），并确认了硬件上的端到端操作。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了BipBipCache，一个直接映射缓存控制器，它将BipBip可调块密码集成到片上SRAM缓存中，以实时加密数据和标签，从而保护敏感数据免受冷启动、总线和SRAM读出攻击。通过创新的流水线设计，尽管加密操作需要6个周期，但有效写入惩罚仅为3个周期。该系统在FPGA上进行了验证，展示了其正确性、资源效率和硬件上的端到端功能。
AI.keywords: 嵌入式缓存, 可调加密, BipBipCache, 流水线, SRAM安全
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过在嵌入式缓存控制器中集成可调块密码，提出了一种新颖的方法来解决片上SRAM缓存中的数据机密性问题。其创新之处在于通过流水线优化将加密延迟对写入性能的影响降至最低，这对于实时系统至关重要。展示了在资源受限环境中实现安全性和性能平衡的潜力。

title: DREG: A Layer-Wise Jacobian Regularization as a General-Purpose Penalty
summary: We present a large-scale empirical study isolating the contributions of the Derivative Regularization penalty (DREG). Across a fully-crossed factorial sweep of 960 experiments spanning 4 activations, 6 regularizers, 8 datasets, and 5 random seeds, we ask: when, where, and why does DREG work? Our results establish three principal findings. First, DREG achieves the highest overall and clean-regime accuracy among all regularizers evaluated (significantly so against the unregularized baseline, Weight Decay, and IGPen; Wilcoxon $p \leq 0.031$). It ranks second in noise robustness behind Spectral Normalization (SN) - the only two layer-wise regularizers in the study. Second, DREG is globally the best-performing regularizer under GELU, the default activation in modern transformer architectures, particularly on both messy vision and messy NLP benchmarks, suggesting direct applicability to frontier deep learning settings. Third, DREG's advantage over competing regularizers is most pronounced under data scarcity, consistent with its role as a geometric inductive bias that substitutes for the regularizing effect of data volume. Throughout, DREG is applied with a single fixed hyperparameter $λ= 10^{-2.5}$ and no per-dataset tuning, supporting its characterization as a plug-and-play regularizer for neural networks with nontrivial Jacobian structure. These findings are consistent with DREG's design: concentrating regularization pressure on layers where the activation derivative is largest, rather than constraining the network uniformly.

AI.title_translation: DREG：一种作为通用惩罚的层状雅可比正则化
AI.tldr: DREG是一种层状雅可比正则化方法，在各种激活函数、数据集和噪声条件下，其整体和清洁精度优于其他正则化器，尤其在GELU激活函数和数据稀疏时表现突出，可作为即插即用的正则化器。
AI.motivation: 研究DREG（一种层状雅可比正则化方法）在不同条件下的有效性，特别是它何时、何地以及为何有效，旨在将其作为一种通用的深度学习正则化器。
AI.method: 在4种激活函数、6种正则化器、8个数据集和5个随机种子下进行了960项实验，以评估DREG的性能。
AI.result: DREG在整体和清洁精度方面表现最佳，仅次于谱归一化（SN）在噪声鲁棒性方面。在GELU激活函数下，DREG在视觉和自然语言处理任务中表现尤为出色，尤其在数据稀缺的情况下，其优势更为明显。DREG使用固定的超参数λ=10^-2.5，无需进行数据集调优。
AI.conclusion: DREG是一种有效的、即插即用的正则化器，尤其适用于GELU激活函数和数据稀缺的场景，其优势在于将正则化压力集中在激活导数较大的层上。
AI.translation: 我们进行了大规模的实证研究，分离了导数正则化惩罚（DREG）的贡献。通过对960项实验进行完全交叉的因子析因扫描，涵盖4种激活函数、6种正则化器、8个数据集和5个随机种子，我们提出了问题：DREG何时、何地以及为何有效？我们的结果确立了三个主要发现。第一，在所有评估的正则化器中，DREG实现了最高的整体精度和清洁状态精度（与未正则化的基线、权重衰减和IGPen相比显著；Wilcoxon p≤0.031）。在噪声鲁棒性方面，它仅次于谱归一化（SN），是研究中仅有的两个层状正则化器。第二，DREG在现代Transformer架构中作为默认激活函数的GELU下，是整体表现最佳的正则化器，尤其是在混乱的视觉和混乱的自然语言处理基准测试中，表明其直接适用于前沿的深度学习环境。第三，DREG相对于竞争性正则化器的优势在数据稀缺的情况下最为明显，这与其作为一种替代数据量正则化作用的几何归纳偏差的作用一致。在整个过程中，DREG使用单一固定超参数λ=10^-2.5进行应用，并且没有进行每数据集调优，支持其作为具有非平凡雅可比结构的神经网络的即插即用正则化器的特性。这些发现与DREG的设计一致：将正则化压力集中在激活导数最大的层上，而不是统一约束网络。
AI.summary: 本研究通过大规模实验评估了DREG（层状雅可比正则化）的性能。结果表明，DREG在整体精度和清洁精度方面表现优于多种正则化器，在GELU激活函数和数据稀缺场景下尤为突出，可作为一种即插即用的正则化器应用于深度学习。
AI.keywords: DREG,层状雅可比正则化,深度学习,GELU激活函数,数据稀缺
AI.comments: 该研究通过大规模、系统性的实验，清晰地阐述了DREG作为一种正则化方法的优势和适用场景。特别是在现代深度学习模型常用的GELU激活函数以及数据稀缺这一普遍存在的问题上，DREG展现了其独特的价值。将正则化压力集中于关键层而非全局约束的设计理念，也为正则化器的发展提供了新的思路。然而，研究中提到的“非平凡雅可比结构”可能限制了其普适性，未来可进一步探索其在不同网络结构上的表现。

title: QuechuaTok: Morphological Boundary Accuracy as a Necessary Metric for Tokenizer Evaluation in Agglutinative Low-Resource Languages
comments: 4 pages, 3 tables, 1 figure. Code available at kaggle.com/code/macmaky/quechuatok
summary: Tokenization is a foundational step in NLP pipelines, yet standard evaluation metrics such as fertility rate fail to capture morphological correctness for agglutinative languages. We present QuechuaTok, a systematic benchmark comparing four tokenization strategies - BPE, Unigram LM, WordPiece, and a morphology-aware PRPE tokenizer - for Southern Quechua (quz), a low-resource agglutinative language spoken by 8-10 million people in South America. Using a 200k-sentence corpus and the SQUOIA finite-state morphological analyzer (Rios, 2016) as silver standard, we evaluate three metrics: fertility rate, OOV rate, and morphological boundary accuracy (MorphAcc). Our results show that BPE achieves the lowest fertility rate (1.636 at 16k vocab) by memorizing surface word forms, while achieving only 6.67% MorphAcc. PRPE achieves 83.33% MorphAcc - the highest of all systems - demonstrating that fertility rate alone is insufficient to evaluate tokenizers for agglutinative languages. All code and models are publicly available at kaggle.com/code/macmaky/quechuatok

AI.title_translation: 盖丘亚语分词器：形态边界准确性作为粘着性低资源语言分词器评估的必要指标
AI.tldr: 现有分词器评估指标（如生育率）不适用于粘着语。QuechuaTok基准测试表明，形态边界准确性（MorphAcc）对于评估盖丘亚语等粘着语分词器至关重要，形态感知的PRPE在MorphAcc方面表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 标准的分词器评估指标（如生育率）未能捕捉粘着语的形态正确性，导致对这些语言的分词器评估不准确。
AI.method: 本文提出了QuechuaTok，一个系统性基准测试，比较了BPE、Unigram LM、WordPiece和形态感知PRPE四种分词策略在南盖丘亚语上的表现。研究使用了包含20万句子的语料库和SQUOIA有限状态形态分析器作为银标准，并评估了生育率、OOV率和形态边界准确性（MorphAcc）三个指标。
AI.result: BPE实现了最低的生育率（1.636，16k词汇量），但形态边界准确性仅为6.67%。形态感知的PRPE实现了最高的形态边界准确性（83.33%）。
AI.conclusion: 生育率 alone不足以评估粘着语的分词器；形态边界准确性（MorphAcc）是一个必要的指标，形态感知的PRPE等分词器在这方面表现更优。
AI.translation: 分词是自然语言处理（NLP）流程中的基础步骤，但标准的评估指标（如生育率）未能捕捉粘着语的形态正确性。我们提出了QuechuaTok，这是一个系统性基准测试，比较了四种分词策略——BPE、Unigram LM、WordPiece和一种形态感知的PRPE分词器——在南盖丘亚语（quz）上的表现。南盖丘亚语是一种低资源粘着语，在南美洲有8-10百万人使用。我们使用一个包含20万句子的语料库和SQUOIA有限状态形态分析器（Rios, 2016）作为银标准，评估了三个指标：生育率、OOV率和形态边界准确性（MorphAcc）。我们的结果显示，BPE通过记忆表面词形实现了最低的生育率（16k词汇量时为1.636），但形态边界准确性仅为6.67%。PRPE实现了83.33%的形态边界准确性——所有系统中最高的——这表明单独使用生育率不足以评估粘着语的分词器。所有代码和模型均在kaggle.com/code/macmaky/quechuatok上公开可用。
AI.summary: 本文提出了QuechuaTok基准测试，旨在解决标准分词器评估指标（如生育率）在粘着性低资源语言（如南盖丘亚语）中无法准确评估形态正确性的问题。通过比较BPE、Unigram LM、WordPiece和形态感知PRPE四种分词策略，并引入形态边界准确性（MorphAcc）作为关键评估指标，研究发现BPE虽然生育率低，但MorphAcc极差，而PRPE在MorphAcc上表现最佳。这证明了对于粘着语，形态边界准确性是评估分词器的必要指标。
AI.keywords: 分词, 粘着语, 形态边界准确性, 盖丘亚语, 低资源语言
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于强调了形态边界准确性对于粘着语分词器评估的重要性，并提出了一个针对低资源粘着语的系统性基准测试。它挑战了传统上仅依赖生育率等指标的评估方法，为处理复杂形态语言的NLP任务提供了更合适的评估框架。其局限性可能在于MorphAcc的银标准依赖于特定的形态分析器，其准确性会影响基准测试的可靠性。

title: LMS-AR: LMS Prediction-based Adaptive Regulator for Memory Bandwidth in Multicore Systems
summary: Memory bandwidth contention in multi-core systems severely impacts application performance and quality-of-service (QoS) guarantees. Regulating the shared memory bandwidth mitigates the memory performance uncertainty thereby making it a manageable resource and improving trustworthiness of multi-core systems. In this work we propose a memory bandwidth regulation mechanism LMS-AR, i.e., LMS Prediction-based Adaptive Regulator within a Linux kernel module to distribute the memory bandwidth as a resource among the CPU cores. We describe a design in which both monitoring and regulation is enforced from outside by a master core - which is not a dedicated controller for regulation. This allows for plugging in computationally heavy prediction and regulation algorithms without interfering with the regulated core. An adaptive filtering technique was employed for prediction of per-core bandwidth requirement. We conducted several experiments with SPEC CPU 2017 benchmarks distributed across multiple cores. Our proposed approach demonstrated significant improvement over Memguard with respect to slowdown ratios caused due to memory contention. Our solution is hosted publicly at $\href{https://github.com/ss22ongithub/LMSAdaptiveRegulator}{https://github.com/ss22ongithub/LMSAdaptiveRegulator}$.

AI.title_translation: LMS-AR：多核系统中基于LMS预测的内存带宽自适应调节器
AI.tldr: LMS-AR是一个在Linux内核模块中实现的基于LMS预测的自适应调节器，用于管理多核系统中的内存带宽，通过外部主核进行监控和调节，并使用自适应滤波预测带宽需求，在SPEC CPU 2017基准测试中显著优于Memguard。
AI.motivation: 多核系统中的内存带宽争用严重影响应用程序性能和QoS保证。调节共享内存带宽可以减轻内存性能的不确定性，使其成为可管理的资源，并提高多核系统的可信度。
AI.method: 本文提出了LMS-AR，一个基于LMS预测的自适应调节器，作为一个Linux内核模块来在CPU核心之间分配内存带宽。该设计通过一个非专用控制器的主核从外部进行监控和调节，从而允许在不干扰受调节核心的情况下插入计算密集型预测和调节算法。采用自适应滤波技术来预测每个核心的带宽需求。
AI.result: 所提出的方法在SPEC CPU 2017基准测试中，相对于Memguard，显著改善了由内存争用引起的减速比。
AI.conclusion: LMS-AR通过其基于LMS预测的自适应调节机制，有效缓解了多核系统中的内存带宽争用问题，提高了系统性能和可信度。
AI.translation: 多核系统中的内存带宽争用严重影响应用程序性能和服务质量（QoS）保证。调节共享内存带宽可以减轻内存性能的不确定性，使其成为可管理的资源，并提高多核系统的可信度。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个内存带宽调节机制LMS-AR，即在Linux内核模块中实现的基于LMS预测的自适应调节器，用于在CPU核心之间分配内存带宽。我们描述了一种设计，其中监控和调节都由一个主核从外部执行——这个主核并非专用于调节的控制器。这允许插入计算量大的预测和调节算法，而不会干扰受调节的核心。我们采用了一种自适应滤波技术来预测每个核心的带宽需求。我们使用分布在多个核心上的SPEC CPU 2017基准测试进行了多项实验。我们提出的方法在由内存争用引起的减速比方面，相对于Memguard表现出显著的改进。我们的解决方案已公开托管在 $\href{https://github.com/ss22ongithub/LMSAdaptiveRegulator}{https://github.com/ss22ongithub/LMSAdaptiveRegulator}$。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为LMS-AR的内存带宽自适应调节器，它作为一个Linux内核模块运行，旨在解决多核系统中的内存带宽争用问题。LMS-AR利用基于LMS预测的自适应滤波技术来预测每个核心的带宽需求，并通过一个外部主核进行监控和调节，以避免干扰被调节的核心。实验结果表明，与现有方案Memguard相比，LMS-AR在降低内存争用导致的性能下降方面取得了显著改善。
AI.keywords: 内存带宽, 多核系统, 自适应调节器, LMS预测, Linux内核
AI.comments: LMS-AR的创新之处在于其“外部”主核监控和调节设计，这使得更复杂的预测和调节算法能够被集成而不会影响核心性能。结合自适应滤波进行带宽预测，使其成为解决多核内存带宽争用问题的实用方案。

title: Layer-wise Probing of wav2vec 2.0 and Whisper for Consonant Cluster Reduction in African American English
comments: This paper has been accepted for presentation at Interspeech 2026
summary: Self-supervised and supervised speech models are increasingly used to investigate which linguistic information their internal representations encode, and at what level of abstraction they encode it. One underexplored phenomenon is consonant cluster reduction (CCR) in African American English (AAE), a widespread phonological process and a source of automatic speech recognition (ASR) disparity. To examine how CCR is represented, we conduct speaker-independent layer-wise probing of wav2vec2-base and Whisper-small using two tasks: segmental reduction detection and segmental restoration of underlying cluster identity. Both models distinguish reduced and canonical forms with high accuracy. Crucially, reduced segments retain cues to their underlying stops, indicating that CCR is encoded as structured gradient phonological variation rather than simple segmental deletion. These results demonstrate structured phonological encoding of AAE CCR patterns in modern speech models.
comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at Interspeech 2026

AI.title_translation: 逐层探测wav2vec 2.0和Whisper在非洲裔美国英语辅音群简化中的应用
AI.tldr: 研究通过逐层探测wav2vec 2.0和Whisper模型，发现它们能高精度区分非洲裔美国英语(AAE)中的辅音群简化(CCR)形式，并保留底层辅音线索，表明CCR被编码为结构化的渐变音韵变异。
AI.motivation: 调查现代语音模型（如wav2vec 2.0和Whisper）如何编码非洲裔美国英语（AAE）中的辅音群简化（CCR）现象，因为CCR是一个普遍的音韵过程，也是自动语音识别（ASR）差异的来源，但此前研究不足。
AI.method: 对wav2vec2-base和Whisper-small模型进行说话人独立的逐层探测。使用两个任务：片段简化检测和底层群身份的片段恢复。
AI.result: 两个模型都能高精度区分简化形式和规范形式。关键是，简化片段保留了其底层塞音的线索，表明CCR被编码为结构化的渐变音韵变异，而非简单的片段删除。
AI.conclusion: 现代语音模型能结构化地编码非洲裔美国英语辅音群简化模式。
AI.translation: 自我监督和监督语音模型正越来越多地被用于研究其内部表示编码了哪些语言信息，以及它们以何种抽象级别编码这些信息。一个尚未充分探索的现象是非洲裔美国英语（AAE）中的辅音群简化（CCR），这是一个普遍的音韵过程，也是自动语音识别（ASR）差异的来源。为了检查CCR是如何被表示的，我们对wav2vec2-base和Whisper-small进行了说话人独立的逐层探测，使用了两个任务：片段简化检测和底层群身份的片段恢复。这两个模型都能高精度地区分简化形式和规范形式。关键的是，简化片段保留了其底层塞音的线索，这表明CCR被编码为结构化的渐变音韵变异，而不是简单的片段删除。这些结果表明现代语音模型中非洲裔美国英语CCR模式的结构化音韵编码。
AI.summary: 本文通过逐层探测wav2vec2-base和Whisper-small模型，研究非洲裔美国英语（AAE）中辅音群简化（CCR）的编码方式。研究发现，这些模型能高精度地区分CCR的简化和规范形式，并且简化片段仍保留了底层辅音的线索。这表明CCR在现代语音模型中被编码为结构化的渐变音韵变异，而非简单的删除。
AI.keywords: 辅音群简化, 非洲裔美国英语, wav2vec 2.0, Whisper, 逐层探测, 语音模型
AI.comments: 这项研究通过深入探测流行的语音模型，揭示了它们如何处理复杂的语言变体，特别是对于自动语音识别（ASR）准确性至关重要的音韵现象。其创新之处在于证明模型不仅识别简化，还能保留底层信息，这对于理解模型内部表征和改进多方言ASR系统具有重要意义。

title: Variational inference and density estimation with non-negative tensor of hierarchical tucker format
summary: In this work, we present an efficient method to compress a high-dimensional discrete probability function, i.e., a probability tensor, into a non-negative hierarchical Tucker format. The methodology is a two-stage procedure. In the first stage, we take an existing interpolation method to compress the target tensor into a hierarchical Tucker (HT) in a manner similar to the CUR decomposition for low-rank matrix reconstruction. In the second stage, we fit the first-stage output against a non-negative hierarchical Tucker ansatz using a second-order method tailored specifically for this setting. When the tensor is of order \(d\), both stages admit an \(\mathcal{O}(d)\) computational complexity, and therefore the proposed methodology readily extends into high-dimensional settings. Numerical experiments show success in compressing various high-dimensional probability tensors.

AI.title_translation: 具有分层tucker格式的非负张量的变分推断和密度估计
AI.tldr: 提出一种将高维离散概率函数（概率张量）压缩为非负分层tucker格式的高效方法。
AI.motivation: 高维离散概率函数（概率张量）的压缩和表示。
AI.method: 采用两阶段方法：第一阶段使用插值法将目标张量压缩为分层tucker（HT）格式，类似于CUR分解；第二阶段使用二阶方法将第一阶段的输出与非负分层tucker模型进行拟合。
AI.result: 成功压缩了各种高维概率张量。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法计算复杂度为O(d)，易于扩展到高维设置，并在数值实验中证明了其压缩高维概率张量的有效性。
AI.translation: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一种将高维离散概率函数，即概率张量，压缩为非负分层Tucker格式的高效方法。该方法是一个两阶段过程。在第一阶段，我们采用现有的插值方法将目标张量以类似于CUR分解的低秩矩阵重构的方式压缩为分层Tucker（HT）格式。在第二阶段，我们使用一种专门为此场景量身定制的二阶方法，将第一阶段的输出与非负分层Tucker模型进行拟合。当张量的阶数为d时，两个阶段都具有O(d)的计算复杂度，因此所提出的方法易于扩展到高维设置。数值实验表明，该方法在压缩各种高维概率张量方面取得了成功。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种高效的两阶段方法，用于将高维离散概率函数（概率张量）压缩成非负分层Tucker（HT）格式。该方法首先通过类似CUR分解的插值技术压缩张量，然后使用专门的二阶方法拟合非负HT模型。该方法具有O(d)的计算复杂度，易于扩展到高维问题，并在压缩高维概率张量的数值实验中表现出色。
AI.keywords: 概率张量, 分层Tucker格式, 非负张量, 密度估计, 变分推断
AI.comments: 该方法在处理高维概率张量方面具有潜力，尤其是在计算复杂度方面表现出色。然而，其在实际应用中的鲁棒性和与其他压缩技术的比较有待进一步研究。

title: DivRL: Disentangled Self-Similarity Rewards for Diverse Subject-Driven Generation
comments: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://qianwangx.github.io/DivRL/
summary: Subject-driven image generation faces an "Identity-Diversity Paradox", where strong identity preservation often leads to rigid and low-diversity outputs. We propose a post-training framework called DivRL that jointly optimizes identity consistency and structural diversity simultaneously by leveraging disentangled visual features from a robust similarity model. Specifically, we introduce a Negative Self-Similarity Measure (nSSM) to quantify structural diversity, and Visual Semantic Matching (VSM) to evaluate identity consistency. We propose an "Explore-and-Suppress" strategy that treats VSM as a gated constraint: the model freely explores structurally diverse configurations, and only samples that violate the identity threshold are penalized via a quadratic hinge loss. This converts identity preservation from a competing objective into a feasibility constraint, allowing nSSM and VSM to improve jointly. Experiments demonstrate that our method effectively pushes the model to generate both consistent and diverse images and improves structural diversity while maintaining comparable identity consistency through a gated optimization formulation.
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://qianwangx.github.io/DivRL/

AI.title_translation: DivRL：用于多样化主体驱动生成的解耦自相似奖励
AI.tldr: DivRL框架通过解耦视觉特征和“探索-抑制”策略，同时优化主体驱动图像生成中的身份一致性和结构多样性，解决了“身份-多样性悖论”。
AI.motivation: 主体驱动图像生成面临“身份-多样性悖论”，即强身份保留往往导致僵化和低多样性的输出。
AI.method: 提出DivRL后训练框架，利用鲁棒相似性模型中的解耦视觉特征，共同优化身份一致性和结构多样性。引入负自相似性度量（nSSM）量化结构多样性，以及视觉语义匹配（VSM）评估身份一致性。提出“探索-抑制”策略，将VSM作为门控约束：模型自由探索结构多样配置，只有违反身份阈值的样本才通过二次铰链损失进行惩罚。这使得身份保留从竞争目标转变为可行性约束。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法有效地促使模型生成一致且多样化的图像，并通过门控优化公式在保持可比身份一致性的同时提高了结构多样性。
AI.conclusion: DivRL框架通过将身份保留转化为可行性约束，成功解决了主体驱动图像生成中的“身份-多样性悖论”，实现了身份一致性和结构多样性的共同提升。
AI.translation: 主体驱动的图像生成面临“身份-多样性悖论”，即强身份保留往往导致僵化和低多样性的输出。我们提出了一个名为DivRL的后训练框架，该框架通过利用鲁棒相似性模型中的解耦视觉特征，同时优化身份一致性和结构多样性。具体来说，我们引入了负自相似性度量（nSSM）来量化结构多样性，并使用视觉语义匹配（VSM）来评估身份一致性。我们提出了一种“探索-抑制”策略，将VSM视为一个门控约束：模型自由探索结构多样化的配置，只有违反身份阈值的样本才通过二次铰链损失进行惩罚。这使得身份保留从一个竞争目标转变为一个可行性约束，从而允许nSSM和VSM共同改进。实验表明，我们的方法有效地促使模型生成一致且多样化的图像，并通过门控优化公式在保持可比身份一致性的同时提高了结构多样性。
AI.summary: DivRL是一个后训练框架，旨在解决主体驱动图像生成中的“身份-多样性悖论”。它通过解耦视觉特征，引入负自相似性度量（nSSM）和视觉语义匹配（VSM），并采用“探索-抑制”策略。该策略将身份一致性（VSM）作为门控约束，允许模型在探索多样性（nSSM）的同时，仅对不符合身份阈值的样本进行惩罚，从而实现身份一致性和结构多样性的共同优化。实验证明DivRL能生成一致且多样化的图像，并在保持身份一致性的前提下提高多样性。
AI.keywords: 主体驱动生成, 身份多样性悖论, 解耦特征, 自相似奖励, 探索-抑制策略
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了“探索-抑制”策略，将身份保留从一个竞争目标转化为一个可行性约束，巧妙地解决了主体驱动生成中的“身份-多样性悖论”。这种方法使得模型能够同时兼顾生成图像的身份一致性和结构多样性，对于提升生成模型的实用性具有重要意义。通过解耦视觉特征和引入特定的度量标准（nSSM和VSM），DivRL提供了一个有效且可解释的优化途径。

title: Is competitive online paging an artifact?
summary:
In any real system a newly computed datum begins its existence in the processor rather than in external memory, and thus does not inevitably incur a cold miss. This was captured by early I/O models, but not by the Sleator-Tarjan one that has come to underpin competitive analysis of paging. If one corrects the Sleator-Tarjan model by charging no cost for the first access to newly computed data, optimal offline algorithms such as LFD remain optimal, but no online paging algorithm can be competitive, even if randomized, even with arbitrary resource augmentation, even against request sequences that are not tailored against it but are instead representative of widely used computational techniques. The proofs are simple, and appear robust against any reasonable assumption/model adjustment, including virtually all tools developed to make competitive analysis less pessimistic.
  In other words, while competitive analysis does predict the good performance exhibited in practice by online paging algorithms such as LRU, these predictions seem just a fortuitous artifact of an incorrect assumption that has crept into the underlying model several decades ago. And there are implications beyond paging, too: for example, the same issue undermines the Ideal Cache model on which the popular Cache-Oblivious and Cache-Adaptive algorithmic frameworks are based.

AI.title_translation: 在线分页的竞争性分析是一个人为假象吗？
AI.tldr: 现有的分页竞争性分析模型因错误地对新生成数据的访问计费，导致其理论预测可能只是模型偏差带来的偶然结果。
AI.motivation: 现有的竞争性分析模型（Sleator-Tarjan模型）未能反映真实系统中“新计算出的数据直接存在于处理器中，无需冷启动缺失”的客观事实，导致理论模型与实际系统行为存在偏差。
AI.method: 通过修正Sleator-Tarjan模型，规定“首次访问新计算出的数据不计费”，在这一改进模型下重新评估在线分页算法的竞争性，并对比分析了该模型对Cache-Oblivious和Cache-Adaptive框架的影响。
AI.result: 在修正后的模型中，任何在线分页算法（包括随机化算法和具备资源增强的算法）均无法实现竞争性，证明了现有的竞争性分析结果可能是基于错误假设的偶然产物。
AI.conclusion: 分页算法的竞争性分析在很大程度上是基于一个错误的模型假设，即忽视了新生成数据无需从外部存储读取这一事实，这导致了现有理论与实践之间可能存在的误导性联系。
AI.translation: 在任何真实系统中，新计算出的数据最初存在于处理器中而非外部存储器中，因此并不必然导致冷启动缺失。早期的I/O模型捕捉到了这一点，但Sleator-Tarjan模型（目前支撑分页竞争性分析的基础）却忽略了这一点。如果修正Sleator-Tarjan模型，规定对新计算数据的首次访问不计费，那么像LFD这样的最优离线算法依然保持最优，但没有任何在线分页算法能够实现竞争性，即使是随机化算法、具备任意资源增强的算法，甚至在面对非针对性的代表性请求序列时也是如此。这些证明非常简单，且对任何合理的假设/模型调整（包括旨在减轻竞争性分析悲观性的工具）都表现出鲁棒性。换句话说，虽然竞争性分析确实预测了LRU等在线分页算法在实践中的良好性能，但这些预测似乎只是几十年前潜入底层模型的一个错误假设所带来的偶然产物。此外，这一问题的影响远不止于分页：例如，同样的问题也破坏了流行的Cache-Oblivious和Cache-Adaptive算法框架所基于的理想缓存模型。
AI.summary: 本文指出Sleator-Tarjan分页模型因错误地对所有数据访问收费而导致偏差。修正模型后发现，在线分页算法无法实现竞争性，这不仅质疑了现有分页理论的有效性，还指出缓存无关算法框架同样受到该假设错误的影响。
AI.keywords: 在线分页, 竞争性分析, Sleator-Tarjan模型, 缓存模型, 算法效率
AI.comments: 该论文对经典的竞争性分析模型提出了深刻的质疑，揭示了其核心假设（即所有数据访问都需计费）在现代计算环境中的局限性。这一发现不仅挑战了分页算法的理论基础，还波及了缓存无关（Cache-Oblivious）等算法框架的有效性，具有极高的理论价值。

title: Learning the Koopman Operator using Attention Free Transformers
summary: Learning Koopman operators with autoencoders enables linear prediction in a latent space, but long-horizon rollouts often drift off the learned manifold, leading to phase and amplitude errors on systems with switching, continuous spectra, or strong transients. We introduce two complementary components that make Koopman predictors more robust. First, we add an attention-free latent memory (AFT) block that aggregates a short window of past latents to produce a corrected latent before each Koopman update. Unlike multi-head attention, AFT operates in linear time and adds only $\approx$30k parameters ($3d^2 + T^2$, fewer than matched multi-head attention), yet captures the local temporal context needed to suppress error divergence. Second, we propose dynamic re-encoding: lightweight, online change-point triggers (EWMA, CUSUM, and sequential two-sample tests) that detect latent drift and project predictions back onto the autoencoder manifold. Across three benchmark systems -- Duffing oscillator, Repressilator, IRMA -- our model consistently reduces error accumulation compared to a Koopman autoencoder and matched-capacity multi-head attention. We also compare against GRU and Transformer autoencoders, evaluated both from initial conditions and with a 50-step context, and find that Koopman+AFT (with optional re-encoding) attains markedly lower long-horizon error while maintaining lower inference latency. We report improvements over horizons up to 1000 steps, together with ablations over trigger policies. The result is a fast, compact predictor that stays on the learned manifold over long horizons.

AI.title_translation: 使用无注意力Transformer学习Koopman算子
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合无注意力潜在记忆（AFT）块和动态重编码的Koopman预测器，显著减少了长期预测误差并保持低延迟。
AI.motivation: Koopman算子与自编码器结合进行学习时，在长期预测中常出现漂移，导致相误差和幅值误差，尤其在具有切换、连续谱或强瞬态的系统中。
AI.method: 引入了两个互补组件：1) 无注意力潜在记忆（AFT）块，它聚合短期历史潜在状态以在每次Koopman更新前生成校正后的潜在状态，以线性时间操作且参数较少。2) 动态重编码，利用轻量级在线变点触发器（如EWMA、CUSUM）检测潜在漂移并将预测重新投影回自编码器流形。
AI.result: 在Duffing振子、Repressilator和IRMA三个基准系统上，与Koopman自编码器和相同容量的多头注意力模型相比，模型持续减少了误差累积。与GRU和Transformer自编码器相比，Koopman+AFT（可选重编码）在保持较低推理延迟的同时，实现了显著更低的长期误差（高达1000步）。
AI.conclusion: 提出的方法产生了一个快速、紧凑的预测器，能够在长期预测中保持在学习到的流形上，显著降低了误差积累。
AI.translation: 使用自编码器学习Koopman算子可以在潜在空间中实现线性预测，但长期推演常会偏离所学习的流形，导致具有切换、连续谱或强瞬态的系统出现相误差和幅值误差。我们引入了两个互补组件，使Koopman预测器更加鲁棒。首先，我们添加了一个无注意力潜在记忆（AFT）块，该块聚合短期历史潜在状态窗口，以在每次Koopman更新前生成校正后的潜在状态。与多头注意力不同，AFT以线性时间操作，并且仅增加了约3万个参数（$3d^2 + T^2$，少于匹配的多头注意力），但却捕获了抑制误差发散所需的局部时间上下文。其次，我们提出了动态重编码：轻量级、在线变点触发器（EWMA、CUSUM和序贯两样本检验），它们检测潜在漂移并将预测重新投影回自编码器流形。在Duffing振子、Repressilator、IRMA三个基准系统上，与Koopman自编码器和相同容量的多头注意力模型相比，我们的模型持续减少了误差累积。我们还与GRU和Transformer自编码器进行了比较，这些模型从初始条件和50步上下文进行评估，发现Koopman+AFT（可选重编码）在保持较低推理延迟的同时，实现了显著更低的长期误差。我们报告了在长达1000步的预测范围内的改进，以及对触发策略的消融研究。结果是一个快速、紧凑的预测器，能够在长期预测中保持在学习到的流形上。
AI.summary: 本文针对Koopman自编码器在长期预测中存在的漂移和误差累积问题，提出了一种名为Koopman+AFT的新型预测器。该方法通过引入无注意力潜在记忆（AFT）块来捕获局部时间上下文并校正潜在状态，以及通过动态重编码机制检测并纠正潜在漂移。实验结果表明，Koopman+AFT在多个基准系统上显著降低了长期预测误差，并保持了较低的推理延迟，生成了一个快速、紧凑且能长期保持在学习流形上的预测模型。
AI.keywords: Koopman算子, 无注意力Transformer, 动态系统预测, 误差校正, 潜在空间学习
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入无注意力潜在记忆块和动态重编码机制，有效地解决了Koopman自编码器在长期预测中面临的漂移和误差累积问题。AFT块以线性时间复杂度提供了高效的局部时间上下文捕获能力，同时参数量较少，这在实际应用中具有重要意义。动态重编码则提供了一种实用的在线校正机制，确保预测保持在学习流形上。这种结合创新性地提升了Koopman算子学习方法的鲁棒性和预测精度。

title: Does My Embedding Reflect That $A = B$? Evaluating Mathematical Equivalence in Embedding Models
summary: Because mathematics is highly abstract, a single statement can take very different forms depending on what subfield it is framed in. There are many examples where breakthroughs occurred after researchers discovered that a question had already been answered in a different field. At the same time, the growth of new resources related to formalization has increased the need for tools that enable efficient and reliable navigation between mathematical 'languages' (e.g., from Lean to natural language). In this paper, we investigate whether current embedding models capture mathematical equivalence. To do this, we introduce the Mathematically Equivalent but Lexically Different Pairs (MELD) Dataset, a collection of mathematically equivalent statements that are expressed in very different language. We show that current state-of-the-art embedding models tend to group statements by the terminology used to make them instead of the underlying math. Motivated by this, we propose a contrastive approach to learning embeddings of mathematical text that focuses on aligning informal statements with different formalizations. Our experiments demonstrate that this leads to improvements not only on informal-formal retrieval tasks but also on MELD, which only contains natural language statements.

AI.title_translation: $A = B$是否反映在我的嵌入中？评估嵌入模型中的数学等价性
AI.tldr: 嵌入模型倾向于根据术语而非底层数学来对齐数学语句，但一种新的对比学习方法可以改善这一点。
AI.motivation: 需要工具来有效地在不同的数学“语言”（例如，从Lean到自然语言）之间导航，并且需要了解当前的嵌入模型是否捕获数学等价性。
AI.method: 引入了“数学上等价但词汇不同对”（MELD）数据集，一个包含数学上等价但语言上截然不同的陈述的集合。提出了一种对比学习方法来学习数学文本的嵌入，重点是将非正式陈述与不同的形式化对齐。
AI.result: 当前最先进的嵌入模型倾向于根据术语而不是底层数学来对齐语句。提出的对比学习方法在非正式-正式检索任务和MELD数据集上都取得了改进。
AI.conclusion: 当前最先进的嵌入模型未能有效捕获数学等价性，但提出的对比学习方法可以改善这一点，并能更好地处理不同语言表述的数学语句。
AI.translation: 由于数学的高度抽象性，一个陈述可以根据其所属的子领域以非常不同的形式出现。当研究人员发现一个问题已经在不同的领域得到解答后，就会出现许多突破。与此同时，与形式化相关的新资源的增长增加了对能够实现数学“语言”（例如，从Lean到自然语言）之间高效可靠的导航的工具的需求。在本研究中，我们研究了当前的嵌入模型是否捕获数学等价性。为此，我们引入了数学上等价但词汇不同对（MELD）数据集，这是一个由语言上非常不同的数学等价陈述组成的集合。我们证明了当前最先进的嵌入模型倾向于根据其使用的术语而不是底层数学来对齐陈述。受此启发，我们提出了一种对比学习方法来学习数学文本的嵌入，重点是将非正式陈述与不同的形式化对齐。我们的实验表明，这不仅在非正式-正式检索任务上有所改进，而且在仅包含自然语言陈述的MELD数据集上也有所改进。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了当前的嵌入模型是否能捕捉数学等价性。研究人员引入了MELD数据集，该数据集包含语言上不同但数学上等价的陈述。实验表明，现有的嵌入模型倾向于根据词汇而不是数学含义对陈述进行分组。为了解决这个问题，提出了一种新的对比学习方法，通过将非正式陈述与其不同的形式化对齐来学习嵌入。这种方法在检索任务和MELD数据集上都取得了改进。
AI.keywords: 数学等价性, 嵌入模型, 对比学习, MELD数据集, 数学形式化
AI.comments: 该研究解决了在形式化日益增长的背景下，理解和处理不同数学表述的数学文本的重要问题。MELD数据集的引入是一个有价值的贡献，为评估嵌入模型捕捉数学等价性的能力提供了一个基准。提出的对比学习方法显示出前景，但需要进一步的研究来探索其在更广泛的数学推理任务中的可扩展性和有效性。

title: Forget Without Compromise: Nexus Sampling for Streaming KV-Cache Eviction Under Fixed Budgets
summary: Long-context and agentic LLM workloads push the KV cache past any fixed memory budget, forcing the inference stack to permanently evict tokens at every step of a continuous-inference stream. Existing methods all share the same template, a per-step direct-attention score followed by deterministic top-$K$ selection, which converts a single below-cutoff step into an irreversible verdict and permanently erases any subtly important token that direct attention cannot single out from noise. To address this challenge, we propose Nexus Sampling, a training-free eviction method that pairs Nexus scoring, an iterative walk over direct attention that surfaces bridge tokens, with weighted reservoir sampling, which retains tokens with inclusion probability in place of deterministic top-$K$. Theoretically, we show that Nexus Sampling dominates deterministic top-$K$ in long-run survival of subtly important tokens. Empirically, at 80% KV cache eviction, Nexus Sampling matches dense attention within 1% on LongBench while outperforming top-$K$ baselines on retrieval-heavy tasks, with up to 10x smaller per-sequence cache memory.

AI.title_translation: 不妥协的遗忘：固定预算下流式KV缓存逐出中的Nexus采样
AI.tldr: Nexus Sampling是一种新的、无训练的KV缓存逐出方法，它结合了迭代注意力得分和加权水库采样，以在固定内存预算下更好地保留重要token，尤其是在长上下文LLM中，性能优于现有确定性方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的KV缓存逐出方法在长上下文和代理LLM工作负载中表现不佳，因为它们使用每步直接注意力得分和确定性top-K选择，这可能导致重要但微妙的token被永久删除。
AI.method: Nexus Sampling提出了一种无训练的逐出方法，它结合了两种机制：1) Nexus评分，通过迭代遍历直接注意力来发现桥接token；2) 加权水库采样，以包含概率而非确定性top-K来保留token。
AI.result: 在80%的KV缓存逐出率下，Nexus Sampling在LongBench上与密集注意力匹配度在1%以内，同时在检索密集型任务上优于top-K基线，并且每序列缓存内存减少了10倍。理论上，Nexus Sampling在微妙重要token的长期存活方面优于确定性top-K。
AI.conclusion: Nexus Sampling通过结合Nexus评分和加权水库采样，在固定内存预算下，有效解决了长上下文LLM中KV缓存逐出导致重要token丢失的问题，并在性能和内存效率上超越了现有方法。
AI.translation: 长上下文和代理LLM工作负载使得KV缓存超出了任何固定的内存预算，迫使推理栈在连续推理流的每一步都永久逐出token。现有方法都采用相同的模板：每步直接注意力得分，然后是确定性top-K选择，这会将低于截止值的单个步骤转化为不可逆转的判决，并永久擦除任何直接注意力无法从噪声中区分出来的微妙重要token。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了Nexus Sampling，一种无训练的逐出方法，它将Nexus评分（一种迭代遍历直接注意力以发现桥接token的方法）与加权水库采样（以包含概率而非确定性top-K来保留token）相结合。理论上，我们表明Nexus Sampling在微妙重要token的长期存活方面优于确定性top-K。经验上，在80%的KV缓存逐出率下，Nexus Sampling在LongBench上与密集注意力的匹配度在1%以内，同时在检索密集型任务上优于top-K基线，并且每序列缓存内存减少了10倍。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了Nexus Sampling，一种用于长上下文和代理LLM中KV缓存逐出的无训练方法。针对现有确定性top-K方法可能永久删除重要token的问题，Nexus Sampling结合了迭代Nexus评分（用于识别桥接token）和加权水库采样（根据包含概率保留token）。理论和实验结果表明，Nexus Sampling在保留重要token方面优于确定性top-K，并在高逐出率下实现了与密集注意力相当的性能，同时显著降低了缓存内存消耗。
AI.keywords: KV缓存逐出, Nexus Sampling, 长上下文LLM, 注意力机制, 加权水库采样
AI.comments: Nexus Sampling的创新之处在于它引入了一种非确定性的、基于迭代注意力评分的逐出策略，有效解决了传统确定性top-K方法在处理长上下文LLM时容易丢失重要但微妙的token的问题。通过理论证明和实证结果，该方法在保持性能的同时，显著提高了KV缓存的内存效率，对于推动长上下文LLM的实际应用具有重要意义。

title: 3D Masked Autoencoders are Robust Learners of Volumetric and Multimodal Cellular Representations for Microscopy
comments: Accepted at MICCAI 2026. Code available at: https://github.com/marrlab/mae3d-opencell
summary: Self-supervised learning in fluorescence microscopy often relies on 2D projections, despite the inherently three-dimensional nature of cells. We present a systematic comparison of 2D and 3D masked autoencoders (MAE-2D vs. MAE-3D) on volumetric microscopy data. Under matched architectures and training protocols, MAE-3D consistently outperforms 2D max-projection and slice-based variants on downstream single-cell tasks. We further align visual representations with a pretrained protein language model (ESM2) and show that cross-modal supervision yields larger gains for volumetric models. Channel cross-attention and frequency-domain regularization are critical for leveraging 3D spatial context. On a protein--protein interaction task, MAE-3D achieves a ROC--AUC of 0.865, outperforming prior methods by up to +0.025. For protein localization, our best 3D model attains state-of-the-art AUC$_{\text{micro}}$ (0.952) and F1$_{\text{micro}}$ (0.742), improving over previous approaches by +0.003 and +0.010 absolute, respectively. Overall, these results demonstrate the advantages of native 3D modeling and multimodal alignment for representation learning in single-cell microscopy.

AI.title_translation: 3D掩码自编码器是显微镜下体积和多模态细胞表征的鲁棒学习器
AI.tldr: 3D掩码自编码器在荧光显微镜数据中学习细胞表征优于2D方法，并通过多模态对齐进一步提升性能，达到SOTA表现。
AI.motivation: 荧光显微镜中的自监督学习常依赖2D投影，忽略了细胞固有的三维特性，限制了表征学习的潜力。
AI.method: 本文系统比较了2D和3D掩码自编码器（MAE-2D vs. MAE-3D）在体积显微镜数据上的表现。在匹配的架构和训练协议下，将视觉表征与预训练的蛋白质语言模型ESM2对齐，并利用通道交叉注意力（channel cross-attention）和频域正则化（frequency-domain regularization）来利用3D空间上下文。
AI.result: MAE-3D在下游单细胞任务中始终优于2D最大投影和基于切片的方法。跨模态监督为体积模型带来了更大的增益。在蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用任务中，MAE-3D的ROC-AUC达到0.865，比现有方法高出0.025。在蛋白质定位任务中，最佳3D模型达到了SOTA的AUC_micro（0.952）和F1_micro（0.742），分别比之前的方法绝对提高了0.003和0.010。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果证明了原生3D建模和多模态对齐在单细胞显微镜表征学习中的优势。
AI.translation: 荧光显微镜中的自监督学习通常依赖于二维投影，尽管细胞本质上是三维的。我们对体积显微镜数据上的二维和三维掩码自编码器（MAE-2D vs. MAE-3D）进行了系统比较。在匹配的架构和训练协议下，MAE-3D在下游单细胞任务中始终优于二维最大投影和基于切片的方法。我们进一步将视觉表征与预训练的蛋白质语言模型（ESM2）对齐，结果表明跨模态监督为体积模型带来了更大的增益。通道交叉注意力和频域正则化对于利用三维空间上下文至关重要。在蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用任务中，MAE-3D的ROC-AUC达到0.865，比现有方法高出0.025。对于蛋白质定位，我们最好的三维模型达到了最先进的AUC_micro（0.952）和F1_micro（0.742），分别比之前的方法绝对提高了0.003和0.010。总的来说，这些结果证明了原生三维建模和多模态对齐在单细胞显微镜表征学习中的优势。
AI.summary: 本文系统比较了3D和2D掩码自编码器在体积荧光显微镜数据上的性能，发现3D模型在单细胞任务上表现更优。通过与预训练蛋白质语言模型ESM2进行跨模态对齐，进一步提升了体积模型的性能。研究强调了通道交叉注意力和频域正则化在利用3D空间上下文中的重要性，并在蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用和蛋白质定位任务中取得了显著的SOTA结果，证明了原生3D建模和多模态对齐在单细胞显微镜表征学习中的优势。
AI.keywords: 3D掩码自编码器, 自监督学习, 单细胞显微镜, 多模态表征, 蛋白质语言模型
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过系统比较3D与2D掩码自编码器，并引入多模态对齐，有效地解决了荧光显微镜数据中3D信息利用不足的问题。其创新点在于强调了原生3D建模的重要性以及通过与蛋白质语言模型结合实现跨模态学习，显著提升了单细胞表征学习的性能，为未来生物图像分析提供了新的思路。

title: The Serialized Bridge: Understanding and Recovering LLM Serving Performance under Blackwell GPU Confidential Computing
summary:
GPU Confidential Computing (GPU-CC) now preserves GPU-local performance: on NVIDIA B300, BF16 matmul runs at 0.998x of non-confidential performance. Yet LLM serving under Intel TDX plus GPU-CC still loses 13-27% of throughput, and KV-cache restore latency can more than double. This paper studies that gap on two Blackwell platforms, RTX Pro 6000 and B300 HGX, and identifies its dominant cause: the confidential VM-GPU bridge, not GPU compute.
  We find that GPU-CC turns host/device movement into a serialized, high-setup-cost channel. Secure copies do not gain CUDA-stream concurrency within a context, asynchronous transfers block at the runtime boundary, and small crossings pay a fixed toll. This violates the assumptions of modern inference runtimes, where DMA is expected to be cheap, concurrent, and asynchronous. In vLLM dense decode, the gap closes around 44x-slower small alloc-and-copy operations; targeted patches reject alternative explanations. A scheduling flag recovers 57% of the gap, while a worker-thread drain recovers up to 92% in qualified high-concurrency runs. The same bridge model explains a +131% KV-restore penalty and a 34x model-load slowdown.
  Blackwell also changes the confidential tenancy unit. We qualify confidential multi-GPU NVSwitch tenants on B300, including 510 GB/s NVLink P2P inside a CVM and concurrent isolated tenants, and identify the remaining fabric-attestation gap for production confidential AI platforms.

AI.title_translation: 序列化桥接：理解并恢复Blackwell GPU机密计算下的LLM服务性能
AI.tldr: GPU机密计算中的LLM性能瓶颈不在计算，而在于主机与GPU间通信桥接的串行化开销；通过优化调度策略可恢复大部分性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管NVIDIA Blackwell架构在GPU计算层面实现了近乎零开销的机密计算，但在实际的大语言模型（LLM）推理场景中，结合Intel TDX使用时，仍存在显著的吞吐量下降和KV缓存恢复延迟问题。研究旨在识别并解决这一性能鸿沟。
AI.method: 在RTX Pro 6000和B300 HGX Blackwell平台上进行了深入的性能分析。通过对比研究，发现GPU-CC导致主机到设备的数据传输变为串行化、高开销的通道。作者通过实施针对性的调度标志（scheduling flag）和工作线程清理（worker-thread drain）机制来验证瓶颈来源并恢复性能。
AI.result: 研究发现GPU-CC使主机与设备间的通信丧失了并发性和异步性。通过优化，成功恢复了57%的吞吐量损失，在高并发场景下恢复率高达92%。此外，模型加载速度提升了34倍，KV缓存恢复延迟显著降低。同时验证了B300上多GPU机密租用的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: GPU机密计算中的性能损失主要源于主机与GPU之间的“桥接”通信机制，而非计算本身。通过优化调度策略和内存管理，可以有效恢复大部分性能损失。此外，论文还验证了Blackwell架构下多GPU机密租用的可行性。
AI.translation:
GPU机密计算（GPU-CC）如今能够保持GPU本地的计算性能：在NVIDIA B300上，BF16矩阵乘法的运行速度达到非机密环境下的0.998倍。然而，在Intel TDX结合GPU-CC的环境下，LLM服务仍有13-27%的吞吐量损失，且KV缓存恢复延迟增加了一倍以上。本文在RTX Pro 6000和B300 HGX两个Blackwell平台上研究了这一差距，并确定了其主要原因：是机密VM-GPU桥接的问题，而非GPU计算本身。

我们发现，GPU-CC将主机与设备间的数据移动变成了串行化、高初始化开销的通道。安全复制无法在同一上下文中实现CUDA流并发，异步传输在运行时边界处发生阻塞，且小规模数据传输需支付固定开销。这违背了现代推理运行时的假设，即DMA操作应该是廉价、并发且异步的。在vLLM密集解码中，性能差距在44倍减慢的小型分配与复制操作中体现，针对性补丁排除了其他解释。调度标志可以恢复57%的性能差距，而在合格的高并发运行中，工作线程清理可以恢复高达92%的性能。同样的桥接模型解释了+131%的KV恢复惩罚和34倍的模型加载减速。

Blackwell还改变了机密租用单元。我们验证了B300上机密多GPU NVSwitch租户的情况，包括CVM内部510 GB/s的NVLink P2P和并发隔离租户，并确定了生产级机密AI平台尚存的架构认证差距。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了Blackwell架构下GPU机密计算对LLM推理性能的影响。研究指出，性能损失并非源于GPU计算，而是由于机密VM与GPU之间的通信桥接机制导致数据传输串行化且开销巨大。作者通过改进调度与线程管理策略，有效缓解了这一瓶颈，并评估了多GPU机密租用环境下的性能。
AI.keywords: GPU机密计算, 大语言模型推理, Blackwell架构, 性能优化, 通信延迟
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了在GPU机密计算（GPU-CC）环境下，虽然GPU自身计算性能几乎无损，但主机与GPU之间的通信桥接（Bridge）成为了严重的性能瓶颈。作者通过深入的实证分析，挑战了现代推理运行时关于DMA操作高效、并发的假设，并提出了切实可行的优化方案，对于大规模机密AI部署具有重要的工程指导价值。

title: A Topological Framework for Finite Behavioural Observations and Verification
summary: Formal verification and monitorability are based on finite observations, which allow properties to be verified from finite information about system behaviour. We study such observations through the topologies they generate on spaces of processes. We first consider trace-based topologies and show that finite trace observations on $Σ^ω$ induce the Cantor topology, while the topology corresponding to full trace inclusion is the discrete one. We then move to arbitrary process spaces, where finite trace observations define the topology $τ_O$, and show that simulation observations generate a strictly finer topology $τ_{\mathrm{sim}}$. Next, we prove a general verification theorem showing that, for any topology generated by finite observations, open sets are exactly the properties verifiable by those observations. We instantiate this result for $τ_O$ and $τ_{\mathrm{sim}}$, obtaining multi-trace and simulation monitorability as concrete cases. Finally, we examine the effect of replacing simulation with stronger relations, showing that finite-depth bisimulation yields a genuinely different topology.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于有限行为观测与验证的拓扑框架
AI.tldr: 本文通过拓扑学方法统一了形式化验证中的有限观测理论，证明了可验证属性本质上就是观测诱导拓扑中的开集。
AI.motivation: 现有的形式化验证和监控理论依赖于有限观测，但缺乏一个统一的数学框架来系统地描述这些观测如何影响属性的可验证性。
AI.method: 通过在进程空间上定义由有限观测生成的拓扑（如迹拓扑、模拟拓扑），分析不同观测机制诱导的拓扑结构，并利用拓扑开集的性质来刻画可验证属性。
AI.result: 证明了有限迹观测诱导Cantor拓扑；证明了模拟观测生成的拓扑比迹观测拓扑更精细；得出了一个通用定理：由有限观测生成的拓扑中，开集即为可验证属性；发现有限深度双模拟会产生完全不同的拓扑结构。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功建立了一个通用的拓扑框架，证明了由有限观测生成的拓扑中的开集恰好是这些观测下可验证的属性，为形式化验证提供了深刻的数学基础。
AI.translation: 形式化验证和可监控性基于有限观测，这使得属性可以根据关于系统行为的有限信息进行验证。我们通过这些观测在进程空间上生成的拓扑来研究它们。我们首先考虑基于迹的拓扑，并证明在Σ^ω上的有限迹观测诱导了康托尔拓扑，而对应于全迹包含的拓扑是离散拓扑。接着，我们转向任意进程空间，其中有限迹观测定义了拓扑τ_O，并表明模拟观测生成了一个更精细的拓扑τ_sim。随后，我们证明了一个通用的验证定理，表明对于由有限观测生成的任何拓扑，开集正是那些可以通过这些观测验证的属性。我们将此结果应用于τ_O和τ_sim，得到了多迹和模拟可监控性作为具体案例。最后，我们研究了用更强关系替代模拟的效果，表明有限深度双模拟产生了一个本质上不同的拓扑。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于拓扑学的框架来研究形式化验证中的有限观测。通过将迹、模拟和双模拟等观测机制转化为进程空间上的拓扑，作者证明了这些观测下的“可验证属性”与拓扑中的“开集”是一一对应的，从而为有限观测下的系统验证提供了统一的数学刻画。
AI.keywords: 形式化验证, 有限观测, 拓扑框架, 可监控性, 模拟关系
AI.comments: 该论文通过拓扑学的视角对形式化验证中的有限观测进行了系统化研究，创新性地将“可监控性”与拓扑中的“开集”建立了等价关系。这种方法论为理解不同验证机制（如迹、模拟、双模拟）的表达能力提供了一个统一的数学框架。局限性在于其主要侧重于理论框架的构建，对于大规模实际系统中的计算复杂性讨论较少。

title: A Comparative Study of Bayesian Contextual Bandits for Real-Time Warehouse Sorter Optimization
comments: Accepted at 2026 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (IEEE ICMA 2026)
summary: Efficient sorter diversion control of automated material handling systems (MHS) is critical for optimizing operational efficiency in large-scale warehouse environments. In this study, we use an inbound receiving sorter at a high-volume e-commerce warehouse as our primary use case, where the sorter diversion system relies on cost functions with static weight configurations that fail to adapt to highly dynamic system contexts, such as volume mode, congestion level, equipment physical status, and upstream/downstream dependencies. To address this real-time sorter diversion optimization challenge, we conducted a comparative study of three candidate hybrid machine learning frameworks: Linear Regression with Gradient Descent Optimization (LR+GDO), XGBoost with Bayesian Optimization (XGB+BO), and Bayesian Contextual Bandits (BCB). Model training and evaluation were enabled by leveraging a high-fidelity physics-aware emulator to overcome the cold-start problem and allow a safe transition from offline to online learning. We performed comprehensive evaluations including reward model predictive accuracy, contextual sensitivity, action distribution, and projected reward uplift. Our results demonstrate that while tree-based reward models offer slightly better predictive power, the BCB framework achieved overall higher performance with 2.03% reward uplift over the heuristic baseline. Furthermore, BCB exhibits several superior characteristics, such as its decisive time-optimal policy backed by Bang-Bang control theory, continuous online learning capability, strategic balance between exploration and exploitation, and significantly shorter inference latency. These results demonstrate the potential of the BCB framework for real-time control optimization in large-scale warehouse environments, motivating further investigation toward operational deployment.
