AI.title_translation: SP-Mind：一种用于空间蛋白质组学分析的自主推理智能体
AI.tldr: SP-Mind是一款能够将自然语言指令转化为空间蛋白质组学分析工作流的自主智能体，显著提升了分析的自动化程度与性能。
AI.motivation: 当前空间蛋白质组学分析工作流极其碎片化，依赖人工手动操作多种异构工具，限制了研究的可扩展性和可重复性。
AI.method: 开发了自主AI智能体SP-Mind，利用专家策划的生物分析技能和计算工具，将自然语言查询自动转化为端到端的分析工作流；同时构建了包含102个任务的SP-Bench基准进行评估。
AI.result: SP-Mind在SP-Bench和各类下游任务中均表现出优于现有开源生物医学智能体基准的性能，实现了端到端的自动化分析。
AI.conclusion: SP-Mind证明了自主智能体在处理复杂空间蛋白质组学分析任务中的有效性，能够实现从原始数据到表型发现的自动化，并优于现有的生物医学智能体基准。
AI.translation: 空间蛋白质组学能够在组织架构内实现单细胞分辨率的蛋白质表达表征，在理解肿瘤微环境和指导精准医疗方面发挥着关键作用。然而，目前的分析工作流仍然是碎片化的，需要专家对异构工具进行手动编排，这限制了研究的可扩展性和可重复性。我们提出了SP-Mind，这是第一个旨在统一空间蛋白质组学分析流水线的自主AI智能体，涵盖了从原始多路组织成像到下游表型发现的全过程。SP-Mind配备了专家策划的生物分析技能和专门的计算工具，无需针对特定任务进行微调，即可将自然语言查询转化为端到端的分析工作流。为了严格评估其能力，我们引入了SP-Bench，这是一个涵盖多种组织类型、包含18个不同类别共102项任务的综合基准。通过在SP-Bench和既定下游任务上的广泛评估，SP-Mind与现有的开源生物医学智能体基准相比，实现了最先进的性能。
AI.summary: SP-Mind是一款旨在统一空间蛋白质组学分析流水线的自主AI智能体，通过将自然语言查询转化为端到端的分析工作流，简化了从图像处理到表型发现的复杂过程，并配合SP-Bench基准测试验证了其卓越性能。
AI.keywords: 空间蛋白质组学, 自主智能体, 自动化分析, SP-Bench, 肿瘤微环境
AI.comments: SP-Mind通过引入自主智能体概念，解决了空间蛋白质组学分析中工具碎片化和人工依赖过高的问题，其核心创新在于将自然语言处理与生物信息学流程自动化相结合。SP-Bench的引入为评估AI在生物医学领域的推理能力提供了重要的标准化工具。

title: Towards Federated Long-Tailed Graph Learning: An Energy-Guided Dual Decoupling Approach
summary: Federated Graph Learning facilitates collaborative graph modeling across distributed clients while preserving data privacy. However, real-world data categories frequently exhibit long-tailed distributions. Such statistical scarcity severely degrades performance in two ways: it biases the global model toward majority classes, and it structurally isolates minority nodes by submerging them in heterophilic, head-dominated neighborhoods. While existing methods attempt topology-agnostic statistical compensations, they often fail under data scarcity. Instead of recovering tail nodes, they overfit the structural noise from adjacent dominant classes, leading to representation degradation. To address these limitations, we propose FedEPD, a framework built on a dual decoupling paradigm that separates topological purification from semantic recalibration. Specifically, FedEPD utilizes distribution-aware Dirichlet energy pruning to filter spatial heterophilic edges. It then overcomes Non-IID distribution shifts by extracting robust global prototypes from topologically central nodes, which are incorporated into local representations via a spatial low-pass prototype injection. Furthermore, a two stage alternating optimization strategy strictly protects majority decision boundaries while improving minority accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedEPD achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse long-tailed benchmarks, yielding absolute improvements of up to 4.97% in Accuracy and 5.48% in Macro-F1.

AI.title_translation: 面向联邦长尾图学习：一种能量引导的双重解耦方法
AI.tldr: 针对联邦长尾图学习中少数类节点被多数类噪声淹没的问题，本文提出了FedEPD框架，通过能量引导的拓扑净化与原型注入实现语义解耦，显著提升了模型在长尾分布下的鲁棒性和准确性。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的图数据常呈现长尾分布，导致联邦图学习模型偏向多数类，且少数类节点在异质邻域中被噪声淹没，现有方法难以在数据稀缺情况下有效恢复少数类表示。
AI.method: 提出FedEPD框架：采用双重解耦范式，利用分布感知的狄利克雷能量剪枝进行拓扑净化，并通过空间低通原型注入将鲁棒的全局原型融合到局部表示中，同时配合两阶段交替优化策略。
AI.result: FedEPD在多个长尾基准测试中达到了最优性能，准确率提升最高达4.97%，Macro-F1提升最高达5.48%。
AI.conclusion: FedEPD通过双重解耦策略有效缓解了联邦长尾图学习中的偏差问题，在多项基准测试中均表现出优于现有方法的性能。
AI.translation: 联邦图学习在保护数据隐私的同时，促进了跨分布式客户端的协作图建模。然而，现实世界中的数据类别往往呈现长尾分布。这种统计上的稀缺性在两个方面严重降低了性能：它使全局模型偏向多数类，并通过将少数类节点淹没在异质的、以头部类为主导的邻域中，从结构上孤立了它们。虽然现有方法尝试进行与拓扑无关的统计补偿，但它们往往在数据稀缺的情况下失效。它们不仅没有恢复尾部节点，反而过拟合了来自相邻主导类别的结构噪声，导致表示退化。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了FedEPD，这是一个建立在双重解耦范式上的框架，将拓扑净化与语义重新校准分离开来。具体而言，FedEPD利用分布感知的狄利克雷能量剪枝来过滤空间异质边。然后，它通过从拓扑中心节点提取鲁棒的全局原型，并通过空间低通原型注入将其整合到局部表示中，从而克服了非独立同分布（Non-IID）的分布偏移。此外，两阶段交替优化策略在严格保护多数类决策边界的同时，提高了少数类的准确性。大量实验表明，FedEPD在多种长尾基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，准确率提升高达4.97%，Macro-F1提升高达5.48%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了FedEPD框架以应对联邦长尾图学习挑战。该方法通过双重解耦策略，利用狄利克雷能量剪枝净化拓扑，并结合全局原型注入和交替优化策略，有效解决了模型对多数类的偏差及少数类节点表示退化的问题。
AI.keywords: 联邦图学习, 长尾分布, 拓扑净化, 语义解耦, 能量引导
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地结合了联邦学习、长尾分布和图学习三个复杂领域。通过引入能量导向的拓扑净化和语义解耦，有效地解决了长尾分布下少数类节点被多数类噪声淹没的问题，具有很高的实际应用价值。

title: AutoSpec: Safety Rule Evolution for LLM Agents via Inductive Logic Programming
summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly automate complex tasks by integrating language models with external tools and environments. However, their autonomy poses significant safety risks: agents may execute destructive commands, leak sensitive data, or violate domain constraints. Existing safety approaches face a fundamental tradeoff: hand-crafted rules are interpretable but brittle, with overly conservative rules blocking safe operations (high false positives) while permissive rules miss unsafe behaviors (high false negatives). Neural classifiers lack the interpretability required for safety-critical deployments.
  We present AutoSpec, a framework that automatically evolves deployed expert-designed safety rules from user safe/unsafe annotations through counterexample-guided inductive synthesis (CEGIS) guided by inductive logic programming (ILP). Starting from the expert rules and a stream of annotated traces, AutoSpec iteratively evaluates rules, mines false-positive and false-negative counterexamples, uses ILP to learn which predicates discriminate them, generates candidate rule edits, and verifies candidates to select the best revision. The key insight is that ILP efficiently identifies predicates that appear frequently in false negatives but rarely in false positives (or vice versa), dramatically pruning the exponential search space of rule edits. This continues until convergence, producing interpretable rules that balance precision and recall.
  We evaluate AutoSpec on 291 execution traces spanning code execution and embodied agent domains. AutoSpec raises rule F1 to 0.98 and 0.93 across the two domains, achieving up to 94% false positive reduction while maintaining high recall, and converges within 4-5 iterations. The ILP-guided approach achieves up to 4.8x higher F1 than heuristic CEGIS. The learned rules are human-readable, auditable, and generalize to unseen scenarios.

AI.title_translation: AutoSpec：通过归纳逻辑编程实现LLM代理的安全规则进化
AI.tldr: AutoSpec利用归纳逻辑编程自动化优化LLM代理的安全规则，在保持高可解释性的前提下，显著降低了误报率并提升了安全防护性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理的安全防护手段存在缺陷：手动规则难以平衡精确率与召回率，且过于僵化；神经分类器则缺乏关键的安全可解释性。因此，需要一种能够自动演进、既可解释又能保持高安全性能的规则管理方法。
AI.method: AutoSpec框架采用基于归纳逻辑编程（ILP）的计数器示例引导归纳合成（CEGIS）。系统从专家规则出发，通过分析用户标注的轨迹，挖掘假阳性和假阴性示例，利用ILP识别判别性谓词，迭代生成并验证候选规则编辑，直至收敛。
AI.result: 在代码执行和具身智能两个领域的实验表明，AutoSpec将规则F1分数提升至0.98和0.93，误报率降低高达94%，并在4-5次迭代内收敛，其表现优于传统的启发式CEGIS方法。
AI.conclusion: AutoSpec提供了一种高效、可解释的LLM代理安全规则迭代进化框架。通过将人类专家知识与ILP引导的自动合成相结合，该系统能够在保证高安全性的同时显著降低误报率，是构建鲁棒AI代理的关键技术。
AI.translation:
大型语言模型（LLM）代理通过集成语言模型与外部工具和环境，日益自动化地处理复杂任务。然而，其自主性带来了重大的安全风险：代理可能执行破坏性指令、泄露敏感数据或违反领域约束。现有的安全方法面临根本性的权衡：手工制作的规则虽然具有可解释性但过于僵化，过于保守的规则会阻止安全操作（高误报率），而过于宽松的规则会遗漏不安全行为（高漏报率）。神经分类器则缺乏安全关键部署所需的可解释性。
我们提出了AutoSpec，这是一个通过归纳逻辑编程（ILP）引导的计数器示例引导归纳合成（CEGIS），从用户安全/不安全标注中自动演进专家设计安全规则的框架。从专家规则和标注轨迹流开始，AutoSpec迭代评估规则，挖掘假阳性和假阴性计数器示例，使用ILP学习区分它们的谓词，生成候选规则编辑，并验证候选者以选择最佳修订。关键洞察在于ILP能高效识别在假阴性中频繁出现但在假阳性中罕见（反之亦然）的谓词，从而显著剪枝规则编辑的指数级搜索空间。这一过程持续到收敛，产生平衡精确率与召回率的可解释规则。
我们在涵盖代码执行和具身智能领域的291条执行轨迹上评估了AutoSpec。AutoSpec在两个领域中将规则F1分数分别提高到0.98和0.93，在保持高召回率的同时实现了高达94%的误报率降低，并在4-5次迭代内收敛。该ILP引导的方法达到了比启发式CEGIS高出4.8倍的F1分数。所学习的规则是人类可读的、可审计的，并能泛化到未见过的场景中。
AI.summary: AutoSpec是一个自动演进LLM代理安全规则的框架，旨在解决手动规则的局限性。它通过结合归纳逻辑编程与计数器示例引导的归纳合成，从标注数据中学习并优化规则。该方法不仅生成了高度可解释且可审计的规则，还显著提升了安全防护的准确性与召回率。
AI.keywords: LLM代理, 安全规则进化, 归纳逻辑编程, CEGIS, 可解释性
AI.comments: AutoSpec通过归纳逻辑编程（ILP）自动化优化LLM代理的安全规则，巧妙地解决了手动规则维护成本高和神经分类器缺乏可解释性的矛盾。其创新点在于利用ILP有效缩减规则编辑的搜索空间，实现了安全性能与可解释性的双重提升。该方法在实际应用中展现了卓越的收敛速度和泛化能力，为安全关键领域的AI部署提供了重要参考。

title: M^2C-EvDet: Multi-Domain Multi-Order Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Event-based Object Detection
summary: Event-based object Detection (EvDet), as a biologically inspired visual perception paradigm, demonstrates superior performance in scenarios demanding high temporal resolution and a wide dynamic range. Nevertheless, the inherent sparse representations and inadequate visual semantics of event data result in a considerable performance disparity between EvDet and frame-based object detection. Previous works attempt to alleviate this cross-modal discrepancy through knowledge distillation, yet they only focus on spatial visual semantics or pair-wise relational information, thus limiting performance in more complex scenarios. To address this challenge, this paper proposes M^2C-EvDet, a Multi-domain and Multi-order Cross-modal knowledge distillation framework for EvDet. Built upon frequency learning and hypergraph computation, M^2C-EvDet integrates two specialized modules: Adaptive Frequency-Decoupled Feature Distillation (AF^2D^2) and Multi-Order Relational Distillation (MORD).

AI.title_translation: M^2C-EvDet：用于事件驱动目标检测的多领域多阶跨模态知识蒸馏
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合频率解耦和多阶关系蒸馏的M^2C-EvDet框架，通过从多维度迁移知识，显著提升了事件驱动目标检测的性能。
AI.motivation: 针对事件数据稀疏和视觉语义不足导致事件驱动目标检测（EvDet）性能落后于帧基目标检测的问题，以及现有知识蒸馏方法仅关注空间语义或成对关系导致的局限性。
AI.method: 提出M^2C-EvDet框架，包含两个核心模块：自适应频率解耦特征蒸馏（AF^2D^2）和多阶关系蒸馏（MORD）。
AI.result: 有效地弥补了事件数据与帧数据之间的模态差异，在复杂场景下提升了事件驱动目标检测的性能。
AI.conclusion: M^2C-EvDet框架通过结合频率解耦和多阶关系蒸馏，显著提升了事件驱动目标检测的性能，为跨模态知识迁移提供了新的思路。
AI.translation: 事件驱动目标检测（EvDet）作为一种受生物启发的视觉感知范式，在高时间分辨率和宽动态范围场景中表现出卓越的性能。然而，事件数据固有的稀疏表示和不足的视觉语义导致了EvDet与基于帧的目标检测之间的巨大性能差距。以前的工作试图通过知识蒸馏来缓解这种跨模态差异，但它们仅关注空间视觉语义或成对关系信息，从而限制了在更复杂场景中的性能。为了解决这一挑战，本文提出了M^2C-EvDet，一个用于EvDet的多领域和多阶跨模态知识蒸馏框架。基于频率学习和超图计算，M^2C-EvDet集成了两个专门的模块：自适应频率解耦特征蒸馏（AF^2D^2）和多阶关系蒸馏（MORD）。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为M^2C-EvDet的知识蒸馏框架，旨在通过频率学习和超图计算来缩小事件数据与帧数据之间的语义差距，提升事件驱动目标检测的效果。
AI.keywords: 事件驱动目标检测, 知识蒸馏, 频率学习, 超图计算, 跨模态学习
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入频率学习和超图计算，从多领域和多阶关系的视角优化了事件相机与传统视觉模态之间的知识蒸馏，有效解决了事件数据语义稀疏的问题，具有较强的创新性。

title: Semantic Lock: Synchronization Based on the Analysis of the Operation Conflict Graph
summary: This paper presents a new lock, SemanticLock, based on the conflict graph between operations. We can consider it a generalization of a read-write lock where conflicts exist between write operations and all other operations. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our lock in two applications. In the first, we design a toy data structure: an array supporting point queries and different range queries. In the second, potentially of greater interest, we augment an existing concurrent data structure, ConcurrentHashMap, with additional long-running operations.

AI.title_translation: 语义锁：基于操作冲突图分析的同步机制
AI.tldr: SemanticLock通过利用操作间的冲突图关系，提供了一种比传统读写锁更高效、更灵活的并发同步方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的同步机制（如读写锁）在处理具有复杂操作集的数据结构时往往不够灵活，无法充分利用操作间的语义特性来提升并发度。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于操作冲突图的SemanticLock机制，该机制将传统的读写锁泛化，根据不同操作间是否存在冲突来决定同步策略。
AI.result: 通过在数组查询（点查询与范围查询）和ConcurrentHashMap中添加长运行操作的应用验证，证明了SemanticLock的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SemanticLock是一种通用的同步机制，通过分析操作间的冲突图，能有效提升复杂并发数据结构的性能。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种新的锁机制SemanticLock，其基于操作间的冲突图。我们可以将其视为读写锁的一种泛化，其中冲突存在于写操作与其他所有操作之间。我们通过两个应用展示了该锁的有效性。第一个是设计了一个支持点查询和不同范围查询的简单数据结构；第二个，也是可能更具吸引力的，是使用额外的长运行操作增强了现有的并发数据结构ConcurrentHashMap。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为SemanticLock的新型锁机制，通过分析操作之间的冲突图来实现更细粒度的同步。作为读写锁的泛化版本，它允许根据具体操作的冲突关系进行并发控制，并在数组数据结构和ConcurrentHashMap的性能优化中得到了验证。
AI.keywords: 语义锁, 并发控制, 冲突图, 数据结构, 读写锁泛化
AI.comments: SemanticLock通过操作冲突图实现同步，是对读写锁概念的有效泛化。其创新在于将同步粒度从简单的读/写提升到了基于具体操作语义的冲突分析，这在处理复杂并发数据结构时具有很高的实用价值和性能潜力。

title: Probing the Misaligned Thinking Process of Language Models
summary: Large language models exhibit a growing range of misaligned behaviors such as strategic deception, sandbagging, and self-preservation. As they are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, it is critical to reliably detect such behaviors to ensure safe and responsible use. In this work, we propose to monitor misalignment by decomposing it into fine-grained cognitive processes -- misalignment indicators -- and detecting their presence in a model's internal activations via linear probes. We develop a taxonomy of 18 indicators spanning different misaligned behaviors, paired with an automated, meta-plan-guided pipeline that generates multi-turn training conversations. To rigorously evaluate generalization, we construct an out-of-distribution suite combining automated behavioral elicitation, established misalignment benchmarks, and natural benign conversations. Across 5 misaligned behaviors, our probes match a strong LLM judge with 0.935 AUROC on out-of-distribution benchmarks while keeping a low false positive rate on benign traffic. We further perform in-depth analysis to understand the probes and the model's internal representations of misalignment indicators.

title: TuringViT: Making SOTA Vision Transformers Accessible to All
summary: Modern VLMs and VLA systems commonly adopt off-the-shelf ViTs such as SigLIP2 as visual encoders, but diverse downstream requirements in latency, temporal modeling, and VLM integration often call for customized SOTA-level ViTs. Training such encoders remains beyond the reach of much of the community, as it requires massive image-text data, while standard softmax attention makes high-resolution or dynamic-resolution pretraining prohibitively costly and often forces low-resolution pretraining followed by post-hoc adaptation. TuringViT addresses these challenges with three key designs: Turing Linear Attention (TLA) for efficient sequence modeling, VISTA-Curation to construct supervision-rich image-video training data, and native dynamic-resolution pretraining that supports flexible inputs from the start and transfers seamlessly to downstream VLMs. As a result, TuringViT outperforms leading open-source ViT baselines with only 10% of the data, achieves stronger downstream VLM performance, and delivers substantially better latency scaling on high-resolution inputs. Our scaling-law analysis further shows that TuringViT continues to improve predictably with curated data scale, far from saturation. Its fast adaptation, hardware-friendly design, and efficient deployment have made it a unified visual foundation across XPeng's AI systems. More broadly, TuringViT provides a reproducible pipeline that dramatically lowers the cost for the community to train, customize, and deploy SOTA-level ViTs, moving toward making such Vision Transformers accessible to all.

AI.title_translation: TuringViT：让所有人都能使用 SOTA 视觉 Transformer
AI.tldr: TuringViT 通过线性注意力和高效数据策略，降低了 SOTA 视觉 Transformer 的训练门槛，实现了更低成本、更高性能的视觉编码器开发。
AI.motivation: 现有的 SOTA 视觉 Transformer 训练成本过高（依赖海量数据和 softmax 注意力），且难以应对多样化的下游任务（如延迟要求、动态分辨率等），限制了社区对定制化编码器的开发与使用。
AI.method: 1. 引入 Turing Linear Attention (TLA) 实现高效序列建模；2. 使用 VISTA-Curation 构建高质量图文训练数据；3. 采用原生动态分辨率预训练以支持灵活输入。
AI.result: TuringViT 仅用 10% 的数据就超越了主流开源 ViT 基准，在高分辨率输入下具有更好的延迟扩展性，并在下游 VLM 任务中表现出更强的性能。
AI.conclusion: TuringViT 通过创新的架构设计和数据处理策略，成功实现了高性能视觉编码器的高效训练与部署，为视觉 Transformer 的普及提供了可复制的范式。
AI.translation: 现代视觉语言模型（VLM）和视觉语言动作（VLA）系统通常采用现成的 ViT（如 SigLIP2）作为视觉编码器，但对延迟、时间建模和 VLM 集成的多样化下游需求往往需要定制化的 SOTA 级 ViT。训练此类编码器对大多数社区成员而言仍然遥不可及，因为它需要海量的图文数据，而标准的 Softmax 注意力使得高分辨率或动态分辨率预训练成本极高，通常迫使研究者进行低分辨率预训练后再进行事后适配。TuringViT 通过三项关键设计解决了这些挑战：用于高效序列建模的 Turing 线性注意力（TLA）、用于构建监督丰富的图文视频训练数据的 VISTA-Curation，以及支持灵活输入并能无缝迁移到下游 VLM 的原生动态分辨率预训练。结果表明，TuringViT 仅用 10% 的数据就超越了领先的开源 ViT 基准，在下游 VLM 中实现了更强的性能，并为高分辨率输入提供了显著更好的延迟扩展性。我们的缩放定律分析进一步表明，TuringViT 随着数据规模的扩大持续可预测地改进，远未饱和。其快速的适配性、硬件友好型设计和高效的部署能力，使其成为小鹏汽车 AI 系统的统一视觉基础。更广泛地说，TuringViT 提供了一个可复制的流水线，极大地降低了社区训练、定制和部署 SOTA 级 ViT 的成本，推动了视觉 Transformer 的普及。
AI.summary: TuringViT 提出了一种高效的视觉编码器训练框架，通过线性注意力、优化数据管理和原生动态分辨率预训练，在显著降低计算成本和数据需求的同时，实现了优于现有基准的性能，并具备更好的灵活性和扩展性。
AI.keywords: TuringViT, 线性注意力, 动态分辨率, 视觉 Transformer, 高效训练
AI.comments: TuringViT 的创新之处在于结合了线性注意力机制与高质量数据管理，解决了视觉 Transformer 在高分辨率和动态输入下的高昂训练成本问题。它通过降低训练门槛，使高性能视觉编码器对社区更具可及性，同时在工业落地方面展示了卓越的实用价值。

title: Social Structure Matters in 3D Human-Human Interaction Generation
summary: Although text-to-motion generation has achieved strong progress in synthesizing realistic single-person motions from language, extending it to text-driven 3D human-human interaction (HHI) remains non-trivial, as HHI requires modeling the underlying \textbf{social structure} that governs phase progression, actor roles, and inter-actor coordination. In this paper, we formulate HHI generation as a social structure modeling and grounding problem: the model must first infer how an interaction unfolds and how the two actors coordinate their roles, and then realize this structure as continuous, physically plausible, and partner-aware 3D motion. To study how such structure should be modeled, we first examine the capability boundary of large language models (LLMs) for HHI generation. Our analysis shows that LLMs can \textit{think} by recovering phase decompositions and partner-aware roles, but cannot directly \textit{move}, as they fail to generate dynamic, physically plausible, and interaction-aware motion. This motivates our planner-executor paradigm, \textbf{Think with LLM, Move with Motion Skill}. The LLM planner converts implicit interaction semantics into motion-aligned social supervision by decomposing interactions into phases, assigning partner-aware actor roles, and aligning them with motion sequence. The motion executor then grounds the planned social structure into coordinated two-person motion by adapting a pretrained solo motion model with LoRA, previous-phase self-conditioning, and ego-relative partner conditioning. Together, our Solo-to-Social framework bridges social organization and motion realization, producing 3D HHI with improved phase consistency, role alignment, and partner-aware coordination.

title: Trimming the Long-Tail of Visual World Modeling Evaluation
summary: Physical interactions follow a long-tailed distribution: a set of common and regular interactions dominates human experience and visual data, while a broad spectrum of rare and irregular interactions remains underrepresented. Although recent visual world models, including image and video generation models, achieve impressive realism on existing benchmarks, they primarily focus on simulating common physical interactions. This raises a central question: Do current visual world models internalize and generalize physical principles? In this work, we introduce Tailor-Bench, a benchmark that challenges world models to simulate irregular physical interactions. To enable systematic evaluation, we design three scenario modes that progressively challenge model reasoning: Regular scenarios reflect common tool-task pairs, Unconventional scenarios replace conventional tools with attribute-compatible substitutes to test affordance generalization, and Impossible scenarios introduce attribute-violating tools to probe constraint awareness. Additionally, we design two complementary settings under a unified evaluation protocol: predictive generation requires inferring outcomes without guidance, while descriptive generation specifies the target outcome for faithful realization. Our experimental results reveal a clear long-tail gap in physical world modeling: performance degrades from Regular to Unconventional and Impossible scenarios, indicating limited generalization beyond common interactions. Failure analysis further shows that models rely on superficial visual patterns: image models fail to realize correct state changes, while video models further suffer from temporal inconsistencies.

title: 3DCarGen: Scalable 3D Car Generation via 3D-consistent Multi-view Synthesis
summary: High-quality 3D vehicle assets are essential for autonomous driving simulation. Although multi-view diffusion-based paradigms enable controllable single-image reconstruction, they typically produce limited viewpoints and exhibit cross-view geometric inconsistencies, thereby reducing reconstruction fidelity in real-world scenarios. In this work, we introduce 3DCarGen, a scalable single-view 3D car generation framework designed for real-world images by synthesizing an arbitrary number of 3D-consistent multi-view images. Specifically, given a single image as input, we first synthesize a set of images from fixed viewpoints. These images are then fed into a feed-forward reconstruction model, resulting in a coarse 3D representation based on 3D Gaussian Splatting. Conditioned on this explicit 3D prior, our multi-view diffusion model generates 3D-consistent images from arbitrary camera viewpoints. We further extend a fast mesh reconstruction algorithm by incorporating color-normal joint optimization to recover detailed and coherent 3D vehicle models from the synthesized dense views. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves robust geometric consistency and reconstruction fidelity compared to existing methods. Code and models will be released.

AI.title_translation: 3DCarGen：通过 3D 一致多视图合成实现可扩展的 3D 车辆生成
AI.tldr: 3DCarGen 是一款能从单张照片生成高质量、几何一致的 3D 车辆模型的新框架，解决了现有方法在自动驾驶模拟中重建不稳定的难题。
AI.motivation: 现有的多视图扩散模型在从单图重建 3D 资产时，通常受限于视点数量，且存在严重的跨视角几何不一致问题，导致真实场景下的重建质量不佳。
AI.method: 提出 3DCarGen 框架：首先通过输入单图生成固定视角的图像，利用 3D 高斯溅射得到粗略 3D 表示；以此显式 3D 先验为条件，驱动多视图扩散模型生成任意视角的 3D 一致图像；最后结合颜色-法线联合优化算法从密集视图中重建精细网格模型。
AI.result: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，3DCarGen 在几何一致性和重建保真度方面均优于现有方法，能够生成高质量的 3D 车辆模型。
AI.conclusion: 3DCarGen 提供了一种高效且鲁棒的方案，能够从单张真实世界图像生成高质量、几何一致的3D车辆模型，推动了自动驾驶模拟资产的自动化构建。
AI.translation: 高质量的 3D 车辆资产对于自动驾驶模拟至关重要。尽管基于多视图扩散的范式实现了可控的单图像重建，但它们通常产生有限的视点，并表现出跨视图的几何不一致性，从而降低了现实场景中的重建保真度。在这项工作中，我们引入了 3DCarGen，这是一种可扩展的单视图 3D 车辆生成框架，旨在通过合成任意数量的 3D 一致多视图图像来处理真实世界图像。具体而言，给定单张图像作为输入，我们首先合成一组固定视点的图像。然后将这些图像输入到前馈重建模型中，得到基于 3D 高斯溅射的粗略 3D 表示。以这种显式 3D 先验为条件，我们的多视图扩散模型从任意摄像机视点生成 3D 一致的图像。我们进一步通过结合颜色-法线联合优化来扩展快速网格重建算法，以从合成的密集视图中恢复详细且连贯的 3D 车辆模型。在合成和真实数据集上的大量实验表明，与现有方法相比，我们的方法实现了稳健的几何一致性和重建保真度。代码和模型即将发布。
AI.summary: 3DCarGen 是一种用于真实世界图像的单图 3D 车辆生成框架。它通过多视图扩散模型与 3D 高斯溅射技术的融合，实现了从任意视角生成具有 3D 一致性的图像，并进一步通过颜色-法线联合优化重建出高精度的 3D 网格模型，解决了现有技术在几何一致性与重建质量上的瓶颈。
AI.keywords: 3D车辆生成, 多视图合成, 3D高斯溅射, 自动驾驶模拟, 几何一致性
AI.comments: 该研究通过结合多视图扩散模型与3D高斯溅射技术，有效解决了单图生成3D资产时常见的几何不一致性问题，在自动驾驶模拟领域具有重要的应用价值。其创新点在于引入了显式的3D先验来指导多视图生成，并提出了基于颜色-法线联合优化的快速网格重建方法。

title: SURGELLM: Rethinking Multi-Task Evaluation through Task-Aware Feature Gating with Class-Balanced Normalization
comments: Proceedings of the 6th Workshop on Trustworthy NLP (TrustNLP 2026), ACL 2026, San Diego, California, USA. Available at https://openreview.net/forum?id=WJCalficPT
summary: Fine-tuned encoders deployed across heterogeneous NLP tasks face three compounding problems: mismatched inductive biases, class-imbalance corruption of feature statistics, and no mechanism to condition attention on external lexical knowledge. We introduce \textbf{\surgellm}, a unified transformer framework that addresses each with a dedicated lightweight module: a \emph{surgical feature gate} (learned per-dimension sigmoid over curated lexical indicators and \texttt{[CLS]}; provably degenerates to identity when features are uninformative), \emph{task-conditioned prefix tokens} (quantized feature values and task identity prepended to every input), and \emph{Instance-Weighted Normalization} (IWN; removes class-prior bias from gate statistics). We prove an excess-risk bound linking gate benefit to \emph{surgical feature alignment}. Across four tasks, SST-2, multi-hop retrieval, LLM-prompt attribution, and authorship detection, covering 17,830 examples and eleven model variants over three seeds, the IWN variant achieves macro-F1 \textbf{0.940} ($+0.036$ over the strongest non-IWN baseline; $+0.130$ on authorship detection). A random-vocabulary control ($-0.028$ avg.\ F1) confirms gains are lexical, not parametric. Code, vocabularies, and a $99.5\%$-recovery auto-extraction recipe are released.

AI.title_translation: SURGELLM：通过任务感知特征门控与类平衡归一化重新思考多任务评估
AI.tldr: SURGELLM通过引入特征门控、任务前缀和实例加权归一化，有效解决了NLP多任务学习中的偏差与不平衡问题，性能显著提升。
AI.motivation: 微调编码器在异构NLP任务中面临归纳偏差不匹配、类别不平衡导致的特征统计偏移，以及缺乏利用外部词汇知识机制的问题。
AI.method: 提出了SURGELLM框架，包含三个模块：1. 外科手术式特征门控（Surgical feature gate），利用词汇指标进行逐维筛选；2. 任务条件前缀标记（Task-conditioned prefix tokens），通过量化特征和任务ID引导注意力；3. 实例加权归一化（IWN），消除门控统计中的类别先验偏差。
AI.result: 在SST-2、多跳检索、LLM提示归因和作者检测四个任务（17,830个样本）中，IWN变体实现了0.940的Macro-F1，比最强基线提升0.036，且在作者检测任务上提升了0.130。
AI.conclusion: SURGELLM通过结构化的特征门控和归一化策略，有效解决了微调编码器在处理异构NLP任务时的核心痛点，证明了在模型微调中引入任务感知特征对齐的巨大潜力。
AI.translation: 部署在异构NLP任务上的微调编码器面临三个复合问题：归纳偏差不匹配、类别不平衡导致的特征统计损坏，以及缺乏根据外部词汇知识调节注意力的机制。我们引入了SURGELLM，这是一个统一的Transformer框架，通过三个专用轻量级模块解决了这些问题：手术式特征门控（在策划的词汇指标和[CLS]上学习逐维sigmoid；当特征无信息时可证明退化为恒等映射）、任务条件前缀标记（在每个输入前添加量化特征值和任务标识）以及实例加权归一化（IWN；从门控统计中消除类别先验偏差）。我们证明了一个连接门控收益与手术式特征对齐的超额风险界。在涵盖17,830个样本和11个模型变体的四个任务（SST-2、多跳检索、LLM提示归因和作者检测）中，IWN变体实现了0.940的Macro-F1（比最强非IWN基线高出0.036；在作者检测任务上高出0.130）。随机词汇对照实验（平均F1下降0.028）证实了收益源于词汇，而非参数。我们发布了代码、词汇表和99.5%恢复率的自动提取配方。
AI.summary: SURGELLM是一个统一的Transformer框架，通过引入手术式特征门控、任务条件前缀和实例加权归一化，解决了多任务微调中的偏差、不平衡和知识整合挑战，显著提升了模型在异构任务上的表现。
AI.keywords: SURGELLM, 多任务学习, 特征门控, 类别不平衡, Transformer
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的轻量级模块化方法（SURGELLM），通过针对性地解决多任务学习中的归纳偏差、类别不平衡和外部知识整合问题，在多个NLP任务上实现了显著的性能提升。其最大的亮点在于通过理论证明了特征对齐的有效性，并提供了可解释的门控机制。

title: Architecting Hybrid Quantum-Classical Software Systems: Exploration of the Design Trade-off Space with Quantitative Guarantees
summary: Addressing problems beyond classical computing limits is sparking an increasing interest in Quantum Computing. However, despite their adequacy to address specific problems, quantum algorithms cover a limited subset of the functionality required in real-world computing systems. Additionally, they require expensive specialized hardware. To overcome this issue, hybrid (quantum-classical) software systems are emerging as a promising way to integrate both computing paradigms by applying the principles of Service-Oriented Architectures (SOA). Still, the design and deployment of hybrid service-based systems faces unique challenges like the idiosyncrasies and constraints of NISQ computers (e.g., algorithms that can only run in specific machines, disparate quality attribute metrics), and the management of structural and behavioural properties of service-based applications. From the SOA perspective, architectural decisions need to be made by performing a trade-off analysis and providing quantitative guarantees of system configurations under prescribed levels of uncertainty. In this paper, a method to explore the design space of quantum-classical applications is provided by a formalization of an architectural style of hybrid applications. The obtained results demonstrate that the proposed method successfully identifies decision boundaries. It enables the dynamic selection of the most suitable hybrid or classical configuration based on the user's QoS criteria.

AI.title_translation: 架构混合量子-经典软件系统：基于定量保障的设计权衡空间探索
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过形式化架构风格和量化权衡分析来优化混合量子-经典软件系统配置的方法，能够根据QoS需求动态选择最优方案。
AI.motivation: 量子算法仅能解决部分特定问题且硬件昂贵，现有的混合软件系统在设计和部署上面临NISQ设备约束、异构质量属性度量以及结构与行为属性管理等挑战，缺乏有效的架构决策权衡分析手段。
AI.method: 提出了一种混合应用架构的形式化方法，通过架构风格建模，执行设计空间权衡分析，并结合QoS指标在不确定性下提供系统配置的定量保障。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提方法能够成功识别决策边界，并支持根据用户设定的QoS标准，在混合架构与经典架构之间进行动态选择。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功提出了一种形式化的混合应用架构风格，通过量化分析方法，能够有效识别设计决策边界，并根据用户QoS需求动态优化量子-经典系统的配置。
AI.translation: 解决超越经典计算极限的问题正引发对量子计算的日益关注。然而，尽管量子算法足以解决特定问题，但它们仅涵盖了现实世界计算系统所需功能的一个有限子集。此外，它们需要昂贵的专业硬件。为了克服这个问题，混合（量子-经典）软件系统作为一种通过应用面向服务架构（SOA）原则整合两种计算范式的有前途的方法正在兴起。尽管如此，基于服务的混合系统的设计和部署仍面临独特的挑战，如NISQ计算机的特性和约束（例如，只能在特定机器上运行的算法、不同的质量属性指标），以及服务型应用结构和行为属性的管理。从SOA的角度来看，架构决策需要通过执行权衡分析，并在规定的不确定性水平下为系统配置提供定量保证。在本文中，通过对混合应用架构风格的形式化，提供了一种探索量子-经典应用设计空间的方法。获得的结果表明，所提方法成功识别了决策边界，并能够根据用户的QoS标准动态选择最合适的混合或经典配置。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了混合量子-经典软件系统的架构设计，针对NISQ设备的硬件限制，引入面向服务架构（SOA）原则。通过形式化混合应用架构风格，提出了一种量化权衡分析方法，旨在解决系统配置中的不确定性，并根据QoS指标实现最优配置的动态选择。
AI.keywords: 量子计算, 混合软件系统, 面向服务架构, 权衡分析, QoS保障
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将面向服务架构（SOA）引入量子-经典混合计算领域，通过形式化建模解决NISQ设备的硬件约束问题。其核心贡献在于提供了一种量化的权衡分析方法，填补了现有量子软件架构设计中缺乏定量保障的空白，具有重要的工程参考价值。

title: Minimal additive codes and additive strong blocking sets
summary: Additive codes over $\mathbb{F}_{q^h}$ generalize linear codes by relaxing linearity over the alphabet while retaining linearity over the subfield $\mathbb{F}_q$. In this paper, we introduce minimal additive codes and we initiate their study from a geometric perspective. We define the concept of additive strong blocking sets, a class of $h$-projective systems whose union forms a strong blocking set. We establish a one-to-one correspondence between equivalence classes of nondegenerate minimal additive codes and equivalence classes of additive strong blocking sets. We also compare this framework with the theory of outer strong blocking sets, showing that the latter arises as a special case. Finally, we provide constructions and existence results for minimal additive codes, and derive upper, lower, and asymptotic bounds on their minimum length.

title: MotifGen: Spatiotemporal interpolation of misaligned satellite images via multi-source generative modeling, in an application to tropical cyclones
summary: Microwave satellite imagery plays a crucial role in monitoring tropical cyclone precipitation and intensity worldwide, but suffers from long revisit times, potentially missing rapid storm evolution phases. While this raises the need for an interpolation method, it is made challenging by the high level of heterogeneity of microwave data coming from different instruments. In this work, we introduce the first generative model that can be applied to multiple geospatial sources that change across samples, occur at irregular time intervals, are misaligned geographically, and come from instruments with varying characteristics. We apply this model to the case of spatio-temporal interpolation of tropical cyclone microwave images from other microwave and infrared instruments. We train using a self-supervised task in which a random source is masked and reconstructed, and show that it leads to a significant decrease in Continuous Ranked Probability Score over supervised training. We show a further improvement by combining infrared and microwave data compared to microwave only. Using these improvements, the generative model produces an ensemble mean on par with that of a deterministic model, while generating a power spectrum significantly closer to that of true observations. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first generative model that interpolates microwave images of cyclones by combining multiple microwave instruments and infrared observations at irregular time intervals.

AI.title_translation: MotifGen：通过多源生成建模对非对齐卫星图像进行时空插值——在热带气旋中的应用
AI.tldr: MotifGen 是一款首创的生成模型，通过融合多源、非对齐的卫星数据，实现了热带气旋微波影像的高质量时空插值，有效弥补了观测重访周期的不足。
AI.motivation: 微波卫星影像在监测热带气旋时存在重访周期长的问题，难以捕捉风暴的快速演变，且不同来源的数据存在异构性、地理错位和时间不规则等挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于生成建模的框架，通过自监督学习任务（掩码重建）对来自不同仪器、具有异构特性且地理位置非对齐的卫星影像进行时空插值；同时融合了红外与微波多模态数据。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该模型显著降低了连续排名概率分数（CRPS），生成的图像在功率谱方面比传统确定性模型更接近真实观测，且多模态融合（红外+微波）的效果优于单一微波源。
AI.conclusion: MotifGen 模型成功实现了多源、非对齐卫星影像的时空插值，在生成图像的功率谱逼真度上优于传统确定性模型，为热带气旋的实时监测提供了强有力的工具。
AI.translation: 微波卫星影像在监测全球热带气旋降水和强度方面起着至关重要的作用，但其重访时间长，可能错过风暴的快速演变阶段。虽然这提出了对插值方法的迫切需求，但由于来自不同仪器的微波数据具有高度异构性，这构成了巨大的挑战。在这项工作中，我们引入了第一个可以应用于多种地理空间源的生成模型，这些数据源在样本间发生变化、出现时间不规则、地理上不对齐，且来自具有不同特征的仪器。我们将该模型应用于热带气旋微波图像的时空插值案例，并结合了其他微波和红外仪器的数据。我们使用自监督任务进行训练，其中随机源被掩蔽并重建，结果表明，与监督学习相比，该方法显著降低了连续排名概率分数（CRPS）。我们证明，与仅使用微波数据相比，结合红外和微波数据可以进一步提高性能。利用这些改进，该生成模型产生的系综平均值与确定性模型相当，同时生成的功率谱显著更接近真实观测。据我们所知，这是第一个通过在不规则时间间隔内结合多种微波仪器和红外观测来插值气旋微波图像的生成模型。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 MotifGen，这是一种创新的生成模型，旨在解决热带气旋监测中多源微波卫星影像的时空插值难题。该模型能有效处理不同卫星仪器间存在的异构性、地理错位及不规则采样问题，通过自监督学习融合红外与微波数据，实现了高质量的图像重建。
AI.keywords: MotifGen, 时空插值, 热带气旋, 多源生成模型, 卫星遥感
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种能够处理异构、非对齐、不规则时间间隔多源卫星数据的生成模型。其重要性在于解决了微波卫星影像重访周期长导致无法捕捉热带气旋快速演变的问题，通过自监督学习和多模态融合（微波+红外），显著提升了气象观测的时空分辨率和数据质量。

title: Discovery of connectivity-trainability trade-off of IQP Circuits for Hamiltonian Optimization
summary: Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial-time (IQP) circuits are promising candidates for near-term quantum advantage due to the conjectured classical hardness of their sampling task. However, their capabilities for optimization remain largely unexplored. We present a systematic investigation of the performance and trainability of IQP circuits for Hamiltonian optimization. Our results reveal a trade-off between optimization performance and circuit connectivity, demonstrating that the circuit structure plays a key role in determining the ability of IQP circuits to reach low-energy states.

AI.title_translation: 用于哈密顿量优化的IQP电路的连通性-可训练性权衡的发现
AI.tldr: 研究发现IQP电路在哈密顿量优化中存在性能与连通性的权衡，电路结构决定了其达到低能态的能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管IQP电路因其采样任务的经典难解性在近邻量子优势中具有潜力，但其在优化问题上的具体能力尚不明确，需要系统评估。
AI.method: 对IQP电路在哈密顿量优化任务中的性能和可训练性进行了系统性的调查与分析。
AI.result: 研究发现优化性能与电路连通性之间存在权衡，电路结构是决定IQP电路能否达到低能态的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: IQP电路的优化能力受到电路连通性的显著制约，存在明确的性能与连通性权衡关系。
AI.translation: 瞬时量子多项式时间（IQP）电路因其采样任务的经典难解性，被认为是实现近邻量子优势的有希望的候选者。然而，它们在优化方面的能力在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们对IQP电路在哈密顿量优化中的性能和可训练性进行了系统性调查。我们的结果揭示了优化性能与电路连通性之间的权衡，表明电路结构在决定IQP电路达到低能态的能力方面起着关键作用。
AI.summary: 本文系统研究了IQP电路在哈密顿量优化中的表现，发现电路的连通性与优化性能之间存在明显的权衡，揭示了电路结构对量子算法效能的核心影响。
AI.keywords: IQP电路, 哈密顿量优化, 量子优势, 电路连通性, 可训练性
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了量子计算中一个基础性的权衡关系，即电路连通性与可训练性/优化性能之间的矛盾。这一发现对于设计高效的近邻量子算法具有重要的指导意义，特别是在利用IQP电路进行哈密顿量优化时，如何在复杂度和性能之间取得平衡是未来的研究重点。

title: Neural Network-Based Parametric Model Reduction for Predicting Turbulent Flow for Different Vehicle Geometries
summary: Numerical simulations in industrial applications often require performing numerous high-precision computations parameterized by specific experimental conditions. For instance, in vehicle body design, aerodynamic simulations are essential for evaluating the aerodynamic characteristics of various proposed body geometries. However, computational resource constraints often become a bottleneck. Therefore, achieving the desired accuracy while minimizing computational cost is crucial. To address this challenge, model reduction methods have been developed to decrease the degrees of freedom by constraining the possible states of a physical system to a lower-dimensional subspace. In particular, reduction techniques that project the system onto a nonlinear subspace using neural networks have been actively studied. Our previous research developed a reduced-order model that integrates neural-network-based model reduction with a time-evolution method, implemented as a distributed parallel training framework to process high-resolution flow field data efficiently. In this study, we extend this reduction approach by incorporating a variational autoencoder to assess its robustness in high-Reynolds-number flows around multiple vehicle bodies with varying geometries. Specifically, we evaluate the reconstruction accuracy of vortex generation across different spatial and temporal scales using a compact latent representation, with a particular focus on the flow behavior near the rear end of the vehicle body.

title: Pigeonholing: Bad prompts hurt models to collapse and make mistakes
summary: While in-context learning is generally shown to be effective in Large Language Models (LLMs), bad contexts can cause performance degradation and mode collapse, a phenomenon we call "pigeonholing." **Unintentionally bad** contexts can happen without malicious jailbreaking intents: For example, a user asks the model to justify an incorrect math theorem or fails to correct the model's buggy code. Specifically, we investigate ``pigeonholing" in two scenarios: (1) when the user suggests a solution, and (2) when the conversation context includes the assistant's previous (incorrect) responses. Our experiments across 10 verifiable and open-ended tasks with 10 different models show that pigeonholing manifests in several ways: (1) repeating the incorrect answers from context (leading to 38-40% performance drop), (2) converging on a narrow set of answers in coding and text generation without exploring alternatives, and (3) flipping stance on controversial topics to align with the user or the assistant's previous claims. We find that pigeonholing worsens almost monotonically with the number of conversation turns (performance drops by additional 14+% as repeated mistakes increase from 1 to 5), and pigeonholing-induced mode collapse can happen even when the provided example is correct. As a step toward mitigation, we propose RLVR with synthetic errors which improves models by 43-60% under bad contexts compared to vanilla RLVR baselines.

title: Deep numerical schemes for systems of Ergodic BSDEs with applications to regime-switching forward utilities
summary: In this paper, we introduce two neural-network-based numerical schemes for solving systems of coupled ergodic Backward Stochastic Differential Equations (eBSDEs), motivated by the approximation of optimal strategies within the framework of forward utilities in a regime-switching stochastic factor model. Our approach builds on the representation of such models through systems of eBSDEs introduced in [HLT20]. We first establish a link between the solution of the system of ergodic BSDEs and that of an associated multidimensional BSDE with random terminal time, given by the hitting time of the positive recurrent stochastic factor. Building on this representation, we introduce a locally additive deep learning scheme obtained by minimizing aggregated local error terms. We then present a new Deep Galerkin Method (DGM) inspired algorithm that minimizes the residual of the associated ergodic PDE system, relying on a representation of the ergodic cost. Finally, we apply this framework to regime-switching forward utilities in a stochastic factor model. We first derive a general consistency SPDE that characterizes regime-switching forward utilities and retrieve their representation with systems of ergodic BSDEs in the homothetic case. Numerical experiments demonstrate the performance of the proposed methods, with a particular focus on the impact on forward preferences of taking into account regime switches.

title: How to~Peel Fully Convex Digital Sets
summary: Full convexity is an interesting alternative to classical digital convexity since it guarantees connectedness and even simple connectedness in digital spaces Z d , for any dimension d. This paper aims at giving a better understanding of the monotonicity properties of fully convex digital sets, since earlier works showed that the question was difficult for thin fully convex sets. To decipher the hierarchy of fully convex sets ordered by inclusion, we study how we can peel a fully convex set progressively while keeping its full convexity. We provide a characterization of peelable points and fast algorithms to identify them. Furthermore we show that fully convex set can be peeled one point at a time till reduced to the empty set, similarly to digitally convex sets in the classical sense. The peeling of a fully convex set can be seen as an analog to homotopic thinning processes, but with an additional geometric property.

AI.title_translation: 如何剥离完全凸数字集
AI.tldr: 本文提出了完全凸数字集的逐点剥离方法，通过定义可剥离点及开发高效算法，证明了完全凸集可以像经典凸集一样被逐层剥离。
AI.motivation: 完全凸性是经典数字凸性的重要替代方案，能保证数字空间的连通性。然而，现有研究在处理薄型完全凸集的单调性问题时存在困难，因此需要进一步探索其包含关系层次和剥离特性。
AI.method: 通过研究完全凸数字集的包含关系层次，定义并表征了“可剥离点”（peelable points），并设计了用于识别这些点的快速算法，证明了完全凸集可以逐点剥离至空集。
AI.result: 论文成功表征了完全凸集中的可剥离点，提供了识别这些点的快速算法，并证明了任何完全凸集均可通过逐点剥离直至清空，同时在整个过程中维持完全凸性。
AI.conclusion: 完全凸数字集可以像经典数字凸集一样，通过逐点剥离的方式最终缩减为空集，且这一过程保持了完全凸性，类似于具有特定几何约束的同伦细化过程。
AI.translation: 完全凸性是经典数字凸性的一种有趣替代方案，因为它能保证数字空间 Z^d（任意维度 d）中的连通性，甚至是简单连通性。由于早期的研究表明薄型完全凸集的单调性问题较为困难，本文旨在深入理解完全凸数字集的单调性。为了解读按包含关系排序的完全凸集层次，我们研究了如何在保持完全凸性的前提下逐步剥离一个完全凸集。我们提供了可剥离点的表征以及识别它们的快速算法。此外，我们证明了完全凸集可以像经典意义上的数字凸集一样，逐点剥离直至缩减为空集。完全凸集的剥离可以看作是同伦细化过程的模拟，但具有额外的几何属性。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了完全凸数字集的剥离过程，旨在揭示其基于包含关系的层次结构。作者表征了可剥离点并开发了高效识别算法，证明了完全凸集可逐点剥离至空集，这一过程与带几何约束的同伦细化相似。
AI.keywords: 完全凸性, 数字几何, 剥离过程, 层次结构, 算法
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入“剥离”（peeling）概念，为理解完全凸数字集的单调性和层次结构提供了新的几何视角，填补了该领域在处理薄型完全凸集时的研究空白。其提出的高效算法具有实际应用潜力。

title: Tractable Reasoning and Conjunctive Query Answering for Defeasible DL-Lite under Rational Closure
summary: In Description Logics (DLs), reasoning under Rational Closure (RC) is a well-known and widely accepted non-monotonic formalism to handle defeasible knowledge. In this paper, we study the application of RC to the core and horn variants of the DL-Lite family of lightweight description logics. We analyze both entitlement (instance checking) and Conjunctive Query (CQ) answering under RC. Our main contribution is providing a plug-in architecture that builds upon existing standard classical reasoners, establishing that reasoning and CQ answering under RC for DL-Lite can be done efficiently with minimal computational overhead.

AI.title_translation: 理性闭包下可废止DL-Lite的易处理推理与合取查询回答
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在DL-Lite中实现理性闭包的高效架构，使得在处理可废止知识时，推理和合取查询回答能够保持低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决描述逻辑中处理可废止知识的需求，特别是在DL-Lite这一轻量级框架下，实现高效的理性闭包推理与合取查询。
AI.method: 提出了一种插件式架构，该架构构建在现有的标准经典推理器之上，通过该框架实现DL-Lite下的理性闭包推理与合取查询。
AI.result: 研究表明，在DL-Lite的core和Horn变体中，基于理性闭包的推理和合取查询回答可以以极小的计算开销高效完成。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了在DL-Lite（核心和Horn变体）下进行理性闭包的推理和合取查询回答是高效可行的，且无需复杂的额外计算开销。
AI.translation: 在描述逻辑（DLs）中，理性闭包（RC）下的推理是一种众所周知且被广泛接受的、处理可废止知识的非单调形式体系。在本文中，我们研究了RC在DL-Lite轻量级描述逻辑家族的核心和Horn变体中的应用。我们分析了RC下的权利（实例检查）和合取查询（CQ）回答。我们的主要贡献是提供了一种构建在现有标准经典推理器之上的插件式架构，确立了DL-Lite在RC下的推理和CQ回答可以以极小的计算开销高效完成。
AI.summary: 本文研究了描述逻辑DL-Lite家族（core和Horn变体）在理性闭包（RC）下的推理与合取查询问题。作者提出了一种基于现有经典推理器的插件式架构，证明了在RC下进行DL-Lite推理和查询是高效且低开销的。
AI.keywords: 描述逻辑, 理性闭包, DL-Lite, 合取查询, 非单调推理
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种基于现有经典推理器的插件式架构，成功将理性闭包（RC）扩展到DL-Lite家族，并证明了其在计算上的高效性，这对于处理现实世界中不确定和可废止的知识具有重要的工程价值。

title: CALIBER: Calibrating Confidence Before and After Reasoning in Language Models
summary: Reasoning language models are increasingly asked not only to answer difficult questions, but also to estimate their likelihood of success. Existing methods typically elicit confidence only once: either before thinking or after answering. We argue that confidence in reasoning models is state-dependent: before thinking, confidence should estimate the chance of the model correctly solving the prompt, while after thinking it should predict whether the realized answer is likely to be correct. This distinction determines the appropriate supervision target: prompt-level success should supervise confidence estimates made after seeing the prompt, while individual answer-level correctness should supervise confidence estimates made after answering. We introduce CALIBER (Calibration Before and After Reasoning), which elicits both estimates and supervises each with the target matched to its information state. Under this unified protocol, CALIBER reduces Expected Calibration Error (ECE) by 52.5% over the strongest single-confidence baseline on BigMathDigits for the 7B model, while achieving the best Brier score and AUROC, and remains within 2.1 points of the best accuracy. Further, on a larger 30B model, CALIBER achieves the best ECE on BigMathDigits while remaining competitive in Brier score and AUROC. Out of distribution, it achieves the best ECE and Brier score on GPQA and TriviaQA, and remains competitive on SimpleQA. Ablations further show that this position-target alignment is most beneficial under distribution shift where it consistently reduces calibration error across all out-of-distribution benchmarks.

AI.title_translation: CALIBER：校准语言模型推理前后的置信度
AI.tldr: CALIBER通过在推理前和推理后分别进行针对性的置信度监督，显著提升了大模型的校准能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常只在推理前或推理后单一阶段评估模型置信度，忽略了模型在推理不同阶段对置信度预测的信息需求差异。
AI.method: 提出CALIBER框架，通过在推理过程前后分别进行置信度评估，并对不同阶段的置信度使用匹配的监督目标（推理前为Prompt级成功率，推理后为具体答案正确性）。
AI.result: 在7B模型上，CALIBER将预期校准误差（ECE）降低了52.5%，并在多种任务（如BigMathDigits, GPQA, TriviaQA）中取得了最佳的校准性能，同时保持了高预测准确度。
AI.conclusion: CALIBER通过在推理的前后阶段分别应用针对性的监督目标，成功提升了语言模型的校准准确性，在多种基准测试中均优于现有的单一置信度方法。
AI.translation: 推理语言模型不仅被要求回答难题，还被要求估计其成功的可能性。现有方法通常只在思考前或回答后进行一次置信度评估。我们认为推理模型的置信度是状态相关的：在思考前，置信度应估计模型成功解决提示词的机会；而在思考后，它应预测已得出的答案是否正确。这种区别决定了合适的监督目标：提示词级别的成功应监督在看到提示词后做出的置信度估计，而个体答案级别的正确性应监督在回答后做出的置信度估计。我们引入了CALIBER（推理前后的校准），它同时引出这两种估计，并用与信息状态匹配的目标对每个估计进行监督。在这种统一协议下，CALIBER在7B模型的BigMathDigits数据集上将预期校准误差（ECE）较最强的单一置信度基准降低了52.5%，同时达到了最佳的Brier分数和AUROC，并且准确率保持在最佳水平的2.1个百分点以内。此外，在更大的30B模型上，CALIBER在BigMathDigits上实现了最佳的ECE，同时在Brier分数和AUROC方面保持竞争力。在分布外（OOD）测试中，它在GPQA和TriviaQA上实现了最佳的ECE和Brier分数，并在SimpleQA上保持竞争力。消融实验进一步表明，这种位置-目标对齐在分布偏移下最有利，它持续降低了所有分布外基准测试的校准误差。
AI.summary: 本文提出了CALIBER，一种针对推理语言模型的置信度校准框架。它通过区分推理前后的信息状态，分别采用不同的监督目标来训练模型进行置信度预测，有效解决了单一置信度估计在推理任务中的不足。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 推理, 置信度校准, 位置-目标对齐, 预期校准误差
AI.comments: 该论文通过区分推理前后的不同置信度需求，创新性地提出了位置-目标对齐方法，这在处理复杂推理任务的校准问题上具有重要意义，尤其在分布偏移（OOD）场景下表现出显著的鲁棒性。

title: UniRED: Unified RGB-D Video Frame Interpolation with Event Guidance
summary: High frame-rate RGB-D videos are crucial for a variety of downstream tasks, including motion analysis, dynamic scene understanding, and 3D reconstruction. However, due to hardware and sensing constraints, practical RGB-D cameras are typically limited to low frame rates, making it difficult to capture rapid scene dynamics. Existing video interpolation methods have achieved strong performance on RGB data, but they are not readily applicable to RGB-D scenarios, where they often yield blurry boundaries, visible artifacts, and degraded geometric consistency. Furthermore, motion estimation from only two boundary frames is inherently under-constrained in complex dynamic scenes. Event cameras, by contrast, provide asynchronous measurements with ultra-high temporal resolution, offering dense motion cues. In this paper, we propose a unified multimodal framework for RGB-D video interpolation that jointly exploits RGB appearance, depth geometry, and event-based temporal cues. Specifically, it first extracts and fuses RGB, depth and event cues, then estimates bidirectional flow with motion basis refinement for RGB and Z-axial refinement for depth, and finally synthesizes the target RGB-D frame via bidirectional warping and soft blending. In addition, we construct a new RGB-D-Event dataset to alleviate the scarcity of tri-modal training data. Extensive experiments on a public benchmark and the proposed dataset demonstrate that our method achieves superior photometric fidelity for RGB interpolation and stronger geometric accuracy for depth interpolation than existing approaches.

AI.title_translation: UniRED：基于事件引导的统一RGB-D视频帧插值
AI.tldr: UniRED利用RGB、深度和事件数据，通过多模态融合技术实现了高质量的RGB-D视频插值，显著提升了插值结果的几何与光度质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的RGB视频插值方法难以直接应用于RGB-D场景，常导致边界模糊、伪影和几何一致性下降；此外，仅从两帧边界帧进行运动估计在复杂动态场景中是不充分的。
AI.method: 提出了一种统一的多模态框架，首先提取并融合RGB、深度和事件线索，随后通过运动基细化进行双向光流估计（RGB）和Z轴细化（深度），最后通过双向扭曲和软混合合成目标RGB-D帧。并构建了一个新的RGB-D-Event数据集。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在RGB插值的光度保真度和深度插值的几何精度方面均显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: UniRED框架通过多模态融合（RGB、深度、事件）有效地实现了高质量的RGB-D视频帧插值，在光度保真度和几何精度方面均优于现有方法。
AI.translation: 高帧率RGB-D视频对于运动分析、动态场景理解和3D重建等下游任务至关重要。然而，受限于硬件和传感约束，实际的RGB-D相机通常只能以低帧率运行，难以捕捉快速的场景动态。现有的视频插值方法在RGB数据上表现良好，但无法直接应用于RGB-D场景，往往会导致边界模糊、可见伪影和几何一致性下降。此外，仅从两帧边界帧进行运动估计在复杂动态场景中本质上是欠约束的。相比之下，事件相机提供具有超高时间分辨率的异步测量，提供密集的运动线索。在本文中，我们提出了一个统一的多模态RGB-D视频插值框架，联合利用RGB外观、深度几何和基于事件的时间线索。具体而言，它首先提取并融合RGB、深度和事件线索，然后通过用于RGB的运动基细化和用于深度的Z轴细化来估计双向流，最后通过双向扭曲和软混合合成目标RGB-D帧。此外，我们构建了一个新的RGB-D-Event数据集，以缓解三模态训练数据的稀缺。在公共基准和所提数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在RGB插值的光度保真度和深度插值的几何精度方面均优于现有方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了UniRED，一种统一的RGB-D视频插值框架，通过融合RGB外观、深度几何和事件相机的动态线索，解决了传统方法在复杂场景中插值效果不佳和几何不一致的问题，并提供了新的数据集支持。
AI.keywords: RGB-D视频插值, 事件相机, 多模态融合, 运动估计, 几何一致性
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于成功地整合了RGB、深度和事件数据，解决了传统RGB-D插值方法中常见的几何一致性差和运动模糊问题。通过引入事件相机提供的超高时间分辨率运动线索，有效地克服了仅依赖边界帧进行运动估计的局限性。此外，构建的新数据集对推动该领域的研究具有重要意义。

title: Control Based Enhanced Regenerative Modes for Hydraulic Multi-Actuator Systems
summary: This paper focuses on a control-based approach for enhancing the regenerative capabilities of hydraulic multi-actuator systems using individual metering valves. Thanks to this architecture, pressure and displacement of each actuator can be controlled nearly independently. By determining online, the right pressure to be driven, it enables the optimization of regenerative control strategies for resistive or driving forces. Globally, this control strategy behaves such as a load sensing approach but each metering valve is piloted in order to activate regenerative mode when it is allowable. The main contribution relies on optimizing the pressure to be controlled in each actuator and the main pump in order to maximize the regenerative capacity of a hydraulic machine while following a displacement. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is proved in simulation. Only a single pump line regeneration is explored here but extensions to multi-pump or direct regeneration are also possible.

title: AVOC: Enhancing Hour-Level Audio-Video Understanding in Omni-Modal LLMs via Retrieval-Inspired Token Compression
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models have achieved remarkable progress in short-form audio-video understanding, yet long-form audio-video comprehension remains challenged by limited context windows and severe information redundancy. To address these bottlenecks, we propose AVOC, a framework for long-form audio-video understanding in Omni-modal Large Language Models. AVOC introduces a learnable token compression module between the modality encoders and the LLM backbone. We reframe multimodal token compression as a top-$K$ retrieval problem: given a fixed context budget, the module must retrieve a compact subset of tokens that best supports answering the user query. We draw inspiration from three classical Information Retrieval criteria for selecting informative units from a large candidate pool: relevance, importance, and diversity. AVOC instantiates each criterion as a tailored mechanism for audio-video understanding, and integrates them into a unified retrieval-style compression pipeline. Experiments show that AVOC achieves state-of-the-art performance on long-form audio-video benchmarks, surpassing the second-best model by 4.9 and 5.5 points in average accuracy on OmniVideoBench and LVOmniBench, respectively. Moreover, AVOC maintains robust performance on Audio-Video Needle-in-a-Haystack task at durations up to one hour.

AI.title_translation: AVOC：通过检索启发式 Token 压缩增强全模态大模型的小时级音视频理解能力
AI.tldr: AVOC 将长视频 token 压缩视为信息检索问题，通过筛选关键信息，显著提升了多模态大模型处理小时级视频的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型在处理长视频时受限于有限的上下文窗口，且存在严重的视觉和音频信息冗余，导致长视频理解能力不足。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 AVOC 的框架，在模态编码器与 LLM 之间引入可学习的 token 压缩模块。该模块将 token 压缩重构为 top-K 检索问题，并融合了相关性、重要性和多样性三种信息检索准则，从候选池中筛选出最能支持用户查询的紧凑 token 子集。
AI.result: 在 OmniVideoBench 和 LVOmniBench 基准测试中达到了 SOTA 性能，平均准确率分别领先第二名 4.9 和 5.5 个百分点；在长达一小时的“大海捞针”任务中表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: AVOC通过将 token 压缩建模为检索问题，有效提升了全模态大模型在小时级长视频理解任务中的性能，显著缓解了长序列带来的计算压力和信息冗余。
AI.translation: 多模态大模型在短视频理解方面取得了显著进展，但长视频理解仍因上下文窗口限制和严重的信息冗余而面临挑战。为了解决这些瓶颈，我们提出了 AVOC，这是一个用于全模态大模型中长视频理解的框架。AVOC 在模态编码器和 LLM 主干之间引入了一个可学习的 token 压缩模块。我们将多模态 token 压缩重构为一个 top-K 检索问题：在固定的上下文预算下，该模块必须检索出一个最能支持回答用户查询的紧凑 token 子集。我们借鉴了三种经典的信息检索准则来从大量候选池中选择信息单元：相关性、重要性和多样性。AVOC 将每种准则实例化为针对音视频理解定制的机制，并将它们整合到一个统一的检索式压缩流水线中。实验表明，AVOC 在长视频基准测试中达到了最先进的性能，在 OmniVideoBench 和 LVOmniBench 上的平均准确率分别超过第二名 4.9 和 5.5 个百分点。此外，AVOC 在长达一小时的音视频“大海捞针”任务中保持了稳健的性能。
AI.summary: AVOC 是一种针对长视频理解的检索式 token 压缩框架，通过整合相关性、重要性和多样性准则，将冗长的多模态序列压缩为紧凑的 token 子集，有效提升了全模态大模型在小时级视频处理中的性能与效率。
AI.keywords: 长视频理解, 多模态大模型, Token压缩, 信息检索, AVOC
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入信息检索领域的经典准则（相关性、重要性、多样性）来解决长视频理解中信息冗余的问题，这种跨领域的方法论创新非常具有启发意义。其局限性在于依赖于检索式压缩的准确性，对于极其复杂或需要全局细粒度推理的任务，可能存在信息丢失风险。

title: ActiveScope: Actively Seeking and Correcting Perception for MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive vision-language understanding, yet still struggle with fine-grained perception in high-resolution images. While existing training-free methods typically rely on attention-based localization or coarse-to-fine search, they are often misled by distractors and fail to locate multiple targets. Our investigation attributes these failures to Contextual Dominance, where salient distractors overwhelm target attention and cause inaccurate localization, and Semantic Bias, where global semantics cause the model to fixate on the most salient concept, resulting in incomplete localization in multi-object scenarios. Built on these insights, we propose ActiveScope, a training-free framework that enhances MLLMs by actively seeking and correcting perception. ActiveScope features two modules. The Semantic Anchor Localization (SAL) utilizes fine-grained semantic anchors to independently localize key targets, thereby mitigating semantic bias. The Interference-Suppressed Refinement (ISR) refines localization by suppressing attention on salient distractions to overcome contextual dominance. Extensive experiments on high-resolution image understanding benchmarks demonstrate that ActiveScope outperforms existing training-free methods (e.g., 96.34 percent accuracy on $V^{*}$ Bench), validating the superiority of the active search and self-correction paradigm. Our code is available at https://github.com/jasmine-ww/ActiveScope.

title: Hierarchical Spatial and Channel Aggregation for Cross-domain Few-shot Segmentation
summary: Cross-domain Few-shot Segmentation (CD-FSS) aims to learn generalizable segmentation capability from abundant annotated samples in the source domain, enabling accurate segmentation of novel classes in the target domain with only a few annotated samples. Existing CD-FSS methods mainly focus on mitigating feature distribution shifts caused by style gaps while ignoring significant differences in class semantic granularity and discriminative attributes across domains, leading to two key degradations in support-query matching: semantic over-alignment and attribute over-alignment. To this end, we propose the Dual Hierarchical Aggregation Network (DHANet), which comprises three key modules. First, the Hierarchical Spatial Aggregation (HSA) module performs multi-scale region aggregation of pixel features along the spatial dimension, generating hierarchical semantic-enhanced features to alleviate semantic over-alignment. Additionally, the HCA module conducts multi-scale attribute aggregation along the channel dimension, generating hierarchical attribute-enhanced features to mitigate attribute over-alignment. Finally, we propose the Online Probabilistic Semantic Bank (OPSB), which progressively constructs and updates class probability distributions from query predictions during inference, and samples multiple pseudo-prototypes as additional support information to mitigate insufficient support. Extensive experiments on four target-domain datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance.

title: Training-free Cross-domain Few-shot Segmentation via Robust Semantic Representation and Matching
summary: Cross-domain Few-shot Segmentation (CD-FSS) aims to transfer knowledge learned from source domain to distinct target domains, segmenting unseen target classes with only a few annotated samples. Although existing methods have made significant progress, they still rely on training or fine-tuning processes, which incur high computational costs and risk overfitting. We observe that when powerful and general-purpose vision foundation models are incorporated into these methods, their performance shows only marginal improvement or even degrades due to overfitting. To address this, we eliminate trainable parameters and propose a training-free framework to avoid both training overhead and overfitting. Built upon the self-supervised vision encoder DINOv3, our framework addresses cross-domain challenges through three core modules. First, the Semantic-aware Feature Re-fusion (SAFR) module identifies and re-fuses features that emphasize semantic patterns, generating representations with enhanced semantic discriminability. Additionally, the Adaptive Support Enhancement (ASE) module narrows semantic gaps between support and query through robust query information aggregation. Finally, the Hybrid Prototype Matching (HPM) module integrates matching results from diverse prototypes to adapt to varying semantic complexity across domains. Extensive experiments on four target domain datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in CD-FSS without any training.

AI.title_translation: 通过鲁棒语义表示与匹配实现无训练的跨域少样本分割
AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的跨域少样本分割框架，通过利用DINOv3基础模型及三个创新模块，在避免过拟合的同时实现了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有跨域少样本分割方法高度依赖训练或微调，不仅计算成本高，且在使用强力视觉基础模型时容易出现过拟合，导致性能提升有限甚至下降。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于DINOv3的训练免费框架，包含三个核心模块：1. 语义感知特征重融合（SAFR）模块，提升语义判别力；2. 自适应支持增强（ASE）模块，通过查询信息聚合缩小语义差距；3. 混合原型匹配（HPM）模块，适应不同语义复杂度的跨域匹配。
AI.result: 在四个目标域数据集上进行了广泛实验，结果表明该方法在无需任何训练的前提下，实现了跨域少样本分割的最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出的训练免费框架在不需要任何训练的情况下，通过SAFR、ASE和HPM三个核心模块，在四个跨域少样本分割数据集上达到了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 跨域少样本分割（CD-FSS）旨在将源域学到的知识迁移到不同的目标域，仅利用少量标注样本即可对目标域中未见的类别进行分割。尽管现有方法已取得显著进展，但它们仍依赖于训练或微调过程，这不仅带来了高昂的计算成本，还存在过拟合的风险。我们观察到，当将强大的通用视觉基础模型引入这些方法时，由于过拟合，其性能仅有微小的提升甚至出现下降。为了解决这一问题，我们消除了可训练参数，并提出了一个无需训练的框架，以规避训练开销和过拟合。该框架基于自监督视觉编码器DINOv3，通过三个核心模块应对跨域挑战。首先，语义感知特征重融合（SAFR）模块识别并重融合强调语义模式的特征，生成具有增强语义判别力的表示。此外，自适应支持增强（ASE）模块通过鲁棒的查询信息聚合，缩小了支持集与查询集之间的语义鸿沟。最后，混合原型匹配（HPM）模块整合了来自不同原型的匹配结果，以适应跨域中多变的语义复杂度。在四个目标域数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在无需任何训练的情况下，在CD-FSS任务上达到了最先进的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种无需训练的跨域少样本分割框架，旨在解决现有方法中因训练带来的高昂计算成本及过拟合问题。该方法以DINOv3为基础，通过语义感知特征重融合、自适应支持增强和混合原型匹配三个模块，有效增强了跨域场景下的语义判别力与匹配精度，在多个基准测试中表现出色。
AI.keywords: 跨域少样本分割, 训练免费, 视觉基础模型, 特征匹配, 语义增强
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于完全摒弃了传统的训练或微调过程，通过利用通用视觉基础模型（DINOv3）并设计专门的特征增强与匹配机制，成功解决了跨域少样本分割中的过拟合与计算开销问题，为训练免费（Training-free）方法在复杂视觉任务中的应用提供了新思路。

title: MM-TRELLIS: Point-Cloud Guided Multi-Modal 3D Vehicle Generation in Autonomous Driving
summary: Recovering realistic 3D vehicle models from autonomous driving scenes is crucial for synthesizing training data and building simulation environment. However, most existing vehicle generation methods fail to fully exploit multimodal sensors i.e. multi-view images and LiDAR point clouds) and rely on neural rendering based reconstruction, leading to low-quality mesh. Recently, native 3D generative models have made significant progress, yet they are not built for arbitrary multi-view inputs and often struggle with in-the-wild driving images. In this work, we present MM-TRELLIS, a multi-modal version of TRELLIS for in-the-wild 3D vehicle generation that integrates LiDAR and image sensors from autonomous driving datasets into native 3D generative models. Specifically, multi-view images are cycled as conditioning inputs, while LiDAR point clouds provide test-time guidance to ensure geometric accuracy and cross-view consistency. During denoising, we first align the guidance point cloud with the model priors, then enforce consistency between the generated geometry and the guidance point cloud. Finally, we introduce a voxel filtering strategy based on the opacity of 3D Gaussian Splatting to suppress floaters and produce clean meshes. Comprehensive experiments on Waymo dataset demonstrate our method outperforms existing methods in high-fidelity 3D vehicle generation. Code is available at https://github.com/HongliXiao/MM-TRELLIS.

title: TrOCR for Medieval HTR: A Systematic Ablation Study with Cross-Dataset Validation
comments: Accepted at Document Analysis Systems Workshop 2026 (ICDAR Satellite event)
summary: Fine-tuning transformer-based handwritten text recognition (HTR) models on medieval manuscripts is challenging because these models are pre-trained on modern text and must adapt to a very different visual domain. This paper studies how three controllable fine-tuning choices (contrast normalization, data augmentation, and layer freezing) affect recognition accuracy when adapting TrOCR to small historical datasets. We run controlled experiments on a 13th-century Italian manuscript (I-CT 91 "Cortonese") and replicate the same experimental grid on the public READ-16 benchmark as robustness evidence. On Cortonese, our best configuration achieves 8.03% character error rate (CER). Statistical comparisons across 13 configurations show that freezing up to three encoder layers or six decoder layers does not significantly harm accuracy, while deeper freezing becomes progressively detrimental. Removing contrast normalization (CLAHE) yields 7.84% CER, comparable to a domain-specialized baseline, suggesting strong optimization can reduce reliance on image preprocessing. Cross-dataset validation on READ-16 shows that decoder freezing thresholds transfer more robustly than encoder thresholds, and combined freezing strategies require dataset-specific re-validation. Finally, we use Grad-CAM gradient attributions and decoder cross-attention maps to diagnose error patterns and failure modes revealed by the ablations. Source code is available at https://github.com/LaudareProject/TrOCR-analysis

AI.title_translation: 用于中世纪HTR的TrOCR：基于跨数据集验证的系统性消融研究
AI.tldr: 本文通过消融实验探讨了如何通过调整预处理和层冻结策略，使TrOCR模型高效适配中世纪手稿的识别任务。
AI.motivation: Transformer架构的手写文本识别（HTR）模型在现代文本上表现优异，但在视觉特征差异巨大的中世纪手稿上应用时面临巨大挑战，需要研究如何通过微调策略有效适配。
AI.method: 针对三种微调变量（对比度归一化、数据增强和层冻结）进行系统性消融实验；在13世纪意大利手稿（Cortonese）和READ-16数据集上进行验证；利用Grad-CAM和交叉注意力图进行误差分析。
AI.result: 在Cortonese数据集上实现了8.03%的字符错误率（CER）；发现移除对比度归一化可获得7.84%的CER；证实了在一定限度内（编码器前三层或解码器前六层）冻结层数不会显著降低精度。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过合理的微调策略（如适当的层冻结和减少对图像预处理的依赖），TrOCR可以在中世纪手稿识别任务中取得优异性能。跨数据集验证证实了解码器冻结策略比编码器冻结更具鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 在手写文本识别（HTR）中，将基于Transformer的模型微调至中世纪手稿是一项挑战，因为这些模型是在现代文本上预训练的，必须适应截然不同的视觉领域。本文研究了三种可控的微调选择（对比度归一化、数据增强和层冻结）在将TrOCR适配到小型历史数据集时如何影响识别准确率。我们在13世纪的意大利手稿（I-CT 91“Cortonese”）上进行了对照实验，并在公开的READ-16基准测试上复制了相同的实验网格以作为稳健性证据。在Cortonese上，我们的最佳配置实现了8.03%的字符错误率（CER）。对13种配置的统计比较显示，冻结多达三个编码器层或六个解码器层不会显著损害准确性，而更深层的冻结会逐渐产生不利影响。去除对比度归一化（CLAHE）可获得7.84%的CER，与特定领域的基线相当，这表明强大的优化可以减少对图像预处理的依赖。对READ-16的跨数据集验证表明，解码器冻结阈值的转移比编码器阈值更稳健，并且组合冻结策略需要针对特定数据集进行重新验证。最后，我们使用Grad-CAM梯度归因和解码器交叉注意力图来诊断消融实验中揭示的错误模式和失效模式。源代码可在https://github.com/LaudareProject/TrOCR-analysis获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对TrOCR模型在处理中世纪手稿时的微调策略进行了系统性消融研究。通过对比实验，分析了对比度归一化、数据增强和层冻结对识别准确率的影响，并验证了这些策略在不同数据集上的迁移效果，为历史文献的自动转录提供了优化方案。
AI.keywords: TrOCR, 中世纪手稿, 手写文本识别 (HTR), 消融研究, 迁移学习
AI.comments: 该研究通过系统性的消融实验，为将预训练模型（TrOCR）迁移至极具挑战性的中世纪手稿领域提供了实证指导。其价值在于揭示了预处理（CLAHE）并非总是必需的，并量化了层冻结策略对识别准确率的影响。局限性在于主要基于特定的小型数据集，通用性仍需进一步验证。

title: The 3D Nonconforming Virtual Element Method with enhanced spaces: numerical investigation and implementation guide
summary: In this paper, we describe the 3D Nonconforming Virtual Element Method, where the local spaces are enhanced in order to build an $L^2$ projection of virtual functions onto polynomials of degree $k$. This higher order projection provides a more accurate representation of the load term and, more importantly, it enables the construction of the reaction term. We conduct a convergence analysis of the $L^2$ norm and $H^1$ seminorm errors with respect to mesh size and approximation degree. We also compare our results with those obtained using the conforming Virtual Element Method.

AI.title_translation: 具有增强空间的3D非协调虚元法：数值研究与实现指南
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种增强3D非协调虚元法，通过高阶L2投影改进了载荷项表示及反应项构建，并验证了其收敛性。
AI.motivation: 为了实现更精确的载荷项表示，并解决传统非协调虚元法中反应项构建困难的问题。
AI.method: 通过增强局部空间，构建虚函数到k次多项式的L2投影，并进行网格尺寸和近似阶数的收敛性分析。
AI.result: 数值实验和收敛性分析表明，该方法在L2范数和H1半范数下具有良好的收敛特性，并与协调虚元法进行了性能对比。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，增强空间的3D非协调虚元法在提高载荷项表示精度和构建反应项方面表现优异，并通过理论分析验证了其收敛性。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们描述了3D非协调虚元法，其中局部空间被增强以构建虚函数到k次多项式的L2投影。这种高阶投影提供了载荷项更精确的表示，更重要的是，它使得反应项的构建成为可能。我们针对网格尺寸和近似阶数进行了L2范数和H1半范数误差的收敛性分析。我们还将其结果与使用协调虚元法获得的结果进行了对比。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种增强空间的3D非协调虚元法，通过改进局部空间以实现虚函数到高阶多项式的高精度L2投影，从而优化了载荷项表示与反应项构建，并验证了其数值收敛性。
AI.keywords: 3D非协调虚元法, 增强空间, L2投影, 收敛性分析, 数值模拟
AI.comments: 该论文通过增强局部空间改进了3D非协调虚元法（VEM），填补了在处理高阶投影和反应项构建方面的空白。其创新点在于提升了投影精度，为解决复杂物理场问题提供了更强大的数值工具。

title: Real-Time Interactive Music Generation via Data-Free Streaming Consistency Distillation
summary: Interactive music and live performance relies on real-time human expression, but modern generative music AI remains largely absent from this domain due to its prohibitive inference latency and offline rendering paradigm. To provide pioneer musicians with a novel medium for interactive composition, we should fundamentally change these static models into dynamic, playable instruments. In this paper, we propose a framework that bridges this gap. To achieve the low latency required for live interaction without sacrificing structural coherence, we formulate distillation within a streaming autoregressive latent space. Our approach gets rid of the need for expensive paired audio-latent datasets by utilizing prompt-only inputs to synthesize teacher-guided, chunk-wise trajectories on the fly. Because live instruments require high acoustic fidelity, we introduce music-aware consistency objectives, which combine latent, spectral, and temporal-difference losses, to preserve crucial qualities like timbre, transients, and rhythmic stability during accelerated single-step streaming generation. Implemented via parameter-efficient adaptation, our distillation reduces generation steps to achieve a low real-time factor. Crucially, by operating as a continuous autoregressive stream, the system can seamlessly assimilate dynamic human inputs on the fly, allowing users to instantly steer the musical trajectory without interrupting the audio flow. Ultimately, this work recontextualizes generative text-to-music models not as passive prompt-and-wait systems, but as responsive instruments, opening new frontiers for live human-AI musical co-creation.

AI.title_translation: 通过无数据流式一致性蒸馏实现实时交互式音乐生成
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种实时交互式音乐生成框架，通过流式一致性蒸馏技术，在无需配对数据的情况下，将静态AI音乐模型转化为可实时演奏、支持用户动态干预的乐器。
AI.motivation: 当前生成式音乐AI存在推理延迟高和离线渲染的局限性，无法满足现场表演中实时人类交互的需求，因此需要将静态模型转变为动态、可演奏的乐器。
AI.method: 提出了一种流式自回归潜在空间蒸馏框架，利用无需配对数据的提示输入合成教师引导的块状轨迹，并引入包含潜在、频谱和时序差分损失的音乐感知一致性目标，结合参数高效适配技术减少生成步骤。
AI.result: 实现了低延迟的实时音乐生成，在保证音色、瞬态和节奏稳定性的同时，允许用户在不中断音频流的情况下动态干预音乐轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功将生成式音乐模型转化为可实时交互的乐器，通过流式一致性蒸馏实现了低延迟与高音质的平衡，推动了人机音乐协同创作的发展。
AI.translation: 交互式音乐和现场表演依赖于人类的实时表达，但现代生成式音乐AI由于其过高的推理延迟和离线渲染模式，在这一领域几乎处于空白状态。为了给先锋音乐家提供一种全新的交互式创作媒介，我们需要从根本上将这些静态模型转变为动态的、可演奏的乐器。在本文中，我们提出了一个弥合这一差距的框架。为了在不牺牲结构连贯性的前提下实现现场交互所需的低延迟，我们在流式自回归潜在空间内制定了蒸馏策略。我们的方法通过利用仅含提示（prompt-only）的输入来实时合成教师引导的块状（chunk-wise）轨迹，从而消除了对昂贵的成对音频-潜在数据集的需求。由于现场乐器需要高保真度，我们引入了音乐感知一致性目标（结合了潜在、频谱和时序差分损失），以在加速的单步流式生成过程中保持音色、瞬态和节奏稳定性等关键品质。通过参数高效适配实现，我们的蒸馏技术减少了生成步骤，从而实现了低实时因子。至关重要的是，作为一种连续的自回归流，该系统可以无缝吸收动态的人类输入，允许用户在不中断音频流的情况下即时引导音乐轨迹。最终，这项工作将生成式文本转音乐模型重新定义为响应式乐器，而非被动的“提示-等待”系统，为人类与AI的现场音乐协同创作开辟了新前沿。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种实时交互式音乐生成框架，通过流式一致性蒸馏技术，将静态的生成式音乐模型转化为可实时演奏的乐器。该方法无需配对数据集，通过优化生成步骤和引入音乐感知损失，实现了低延迟、高保真的实时音乐流生成，支持用户实时动态干预，从而促进了人机协同的现场音乐创作。
AI.keywords: 实时音乐生成, 流式一致性蒸馏, 交互式AI, 音乐生成模型, 低延迟推理
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将传统的离线生成式音乐模型转化为实时交互式乐器。通过无需配对数据的流式一致性蒸馏方法，解决了生成延迟与结构一致性之间的矛盾。其意义在于为AI音乐创作开辟了实时表演的新领域，但对于复杂音乐语境下的长期连贯性表现仍有待进一步观察。

title: LemonHarness Technical Report
summary: As large language model (LLM) agents are applied to longer tasks, they increasingly modify workspace state across multiple rounds of iteration. However, agents typically observe only tool outputs and log fragments, while the actual state changes occur in the file system. Without explicit workspace boundaries, state-changing operations such as file writes and temporary artifact generation may scatter changes across paths. Over time, these weakly constrained changes accumulate, making states such as modified files difficult to track. This paper presents LemonHarness, an integrated execution framework for long-horizon agents. LemonHarness establishes an explicit execution boundary by constraining state-changing operations within a clearly defined workspace and bringing model invocation, tool execution, and rule knowledge within a single controlled boundary. State-changing operations, including file writes, dependency installation, and temporary artifact creation, are executed through structured tool interfaces, with execution feedback recorded as observations available to subsequent model decisions. The system also introduces a reusable rule knowledge base, which turns recurring execution rules and acceptance criteria into runtime knowledge. LemonHarness further adds a time-aware execution mechanism that exposes elapsed and remaining budget to the model, so it can rebalance exploration, implementation, and validation effort as time pressure shifts and avoid timeouts from long waits or excessive verification. On Terminal-Bench 2.0, LemonHarness_GPT-5.3-CodeX reached 84.49% accuracy over 445 trials; pairing the same framework with the stronger GPT-5.5 backbone raised the average accuracy to 86.52% across five jobs. The results suggest that a unified runtime boundary, callable rule knowledge, and time-aware execution can improve the stability of long-horizon agent execution.

AI.title_translation: LemonHarness 技术报告
AI.tldr: LemonHarness 是一套长周期智能体执行框架，通过统一工作空间边界、整合规则知识库并引入时间感知机制，有效解决了智能体在复杂任务中状态管理混乱的问题，提升了执行准确率。
AI.motivation: 长周期任务中，智能体对文件系统等工作空间状态的无序修改导致状态难以追踪，且缺乏对执行时间和资源的有效管理，从而影响任务成功率。
AI.method: LemonHarness 框架：1. 建立明确的执行边界以约束状态变更操作；2. 通过结构化工具接口执行文件写入、依赖安装等操作并记录反馈；3. 引入可复用的规则知识库；4. 实施时间感知执行机制，使模型能根据剩余预算调整策略。
AI.result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上，LemonHarness_GPT-5.3-CodeX 达到 84.49% 的准确率；使用 GPT-5.5 作为底座时，准确率提升至 86.52%。
AI.conclusion: LemonHarness 通过构建统一的执行边界、可调用的规则库及时间感知机制，有效提升了长周期智能体在复杂任务中的执行稳定性与准确性。
AI.translation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）代理被应用于更长的任务，它们在多轮迭代中频繁修改工作空间状态。然而，代理通常只能观察到工具输出和日志片段，而实际的状态变化发生在文件系统中。在缺乏明确工作空间边界的情况下，文件写入和临时工件生成等状态变更操作可能会散落在不同路径中。随着时间推移，这些弱约束的变更不断累积，使得修改文件等状态难以追踪。本文提出了 LemonHarness，一个针对长周期代理的集成执行框架。LemonHarness 通过将状态变更操作约束在明确定义的工作空间内，并将模型调用、工具执行和规则知识整合在单一受控边界内，从而建立了明确的执行边界。包括文件写入、依赖安装和临时工件创建在内的状态变更操作均通过结构化工具接口执行，并将执行反馈记录为后续模型决策可用的观察结果。该系统还引入了一个可复用的规则知识库，将重复出现的执行规则和验收标准转化为运行时知识。LemonHarness 进一步添加了时间感知执行机制，向模型展示已用时间和剩余预算，使其能够随着时间压力的变化重新平衡探索、实施和验证工作，并避免因长时间等待或过度验证而超时。在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上，LemonHarness_GPT-5.3-CodeX 在 445 次试验中达到了 84.49% 的准确率；将同一框架与更强的 GPT-5.5 主干模型配对后，五个作业的平均准确率提高到了 86.52%。结果表明，统一的运行时边界、可调用的规则知识和时间感知执行可以提高长周期代理执行的稳定性。
AI.summary: LemonHarness 是一款专为长周期智能体设计的集成执行框架。它通过强制执行边界、结构化工具调用、规则知识库集成以及时间感知调度，解决了代理在复杂环境下的状态管理难题，显著提升了任务执行的稳定性和成功率。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型代理, 长周期任务, 执行框架, 状态管理, 时间感知
AI.comments: LemonHarness 解决了长周期 LLM 代理在处理复杂任务时因状态管理混乱导致的性能下降问题。其创新之处在于通过强制性的工作空间边界和结构化工具接口，将原本离散的文件系统操作纳入受控环境，并引入时间感知机制，这对提升代理在实际部署中的鲁棒性具有重要参考价值。

title: Prob-BBDM: a Probabilistic Brownian Bridge Diffusion Model for MRI sequence image-to-image translation
summary: AI-driven image-to-image synthesis is rapidly advancing, with growing applications in medical imaging. Multi-modal image analysis plays a crucial role in optimizing examination quality, yet acquiring multiple imaging modalities in clinical settings remains resource-intensive and time-consuming, especially for 3D imaging. To address this challenge, we propose a novel image-to-image translation model based on Brownian Bridge Diffusion Models (BBDM), which synthesizes magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) sequences from 2D axial slices. Our approach integrates a variational encoder-guided diffusion mechanism, leveraging probabilistic image distributions to enhance synthesis quality. Evaluated on the BraTS 2021 dataset, our Probabilistic-BBDM (Prob-BBDM) achieves superior performance across multiple translation tasks, reaching up to 88.46% SSIM and 26.09 dB PSNR, with consistent improvements over baselines. Notably, our diffusion process requires only 4 steps, making it computationally efficient while maintaining high-quality synthesis. To further validate generalizability, we test Prob-BBDM on an external third-party dataset, demonstrating consistent performance across domains. Additionally, we assess the clinical utility of the synthesized slices by using them as input to a pre-trained segmentation model. Tumor segmentation yields a Dice score of 88.71% and an HD95 of 3.49 mm, confirming that the synthesized slices preserve critical diagnostic information. These results highlight the potential of Prob-BBDM for high-quality, efficient, and generalizable MRI synthesis, offering a promising step toward improved medical image translation.

AI.title_translation: Prob-BBDM：一种用于MRI序列图像转换的概率布朗桥扩散模型
AI.tldr: Prob-BBDM利用布朗桥扩散模型实现高效且高质量的MRI序列转换，仅需4步采样，在图像质量及临床分割任务中均表现出色。
AI.motivation: 解决医学影像中多模态获取资源密集且耗时的问题，旨在实现高效、高质量的MRI序列间图像转换。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于布朗桥扩散模型（BBDM）的图像转换框架，集成了变分编码器引导的扩散机制，利用概率图像分布来优化合成质量，并实现了仅需4步的高效采样过程。
AI.result: 在BraTS 2021数据集上，SSIM达到88.46%，PSNR达到26.09 dB；在下游肿瘤分割任务中，Dice分数为88.71%，HD95为3.49 mm，并在外部数据集上验证了良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: Prob-BBDM通过高效的扩散过程实现了高质量的MRI序列转换，不仅在标准指标上表现优异，且在临床下游任务（如肿瘤分割）中保留了关键诊断信息，证明了其临床应用潜力。
AI.translation: 人工智能驱动的图像到图像合成技术正在迅速发展，并在医学影像领域得到了越来越多的应用。多模态图像分析在优化检查质量方面起着至关重要的作用，然而在临床环境中获取多种成像模态既耗资源又耗时，特别是在3D成像方面。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种基于布朗桥扩散模型（BBDM）的新型图像到图像转换模型，用于从2D轴向切片合成磁共振成像（MRI）序列。我们的方法集成了一种变分编码器引导的扩散机制，利用概率图像分布来提高合成质量。在BraTS 2021数据集上的评估显示，我们的Prob-BBDM在多个转换任务中表现优异，SSIM高达88.46%，PSNR达到26.09 dB，且在各项指标上均优于基线模型。值得注意的是，我们的扩散过程仅需4步，在保持高质量合成的同时实现了计算高效。为了进一步验证泛化能力，我们在第三方外部数据集上测试了Prob-BBDM，结果显示其在不同领域间表现一致。此外，我们通过将合成切片输入预训练的分割模型来评估其临床效用。肿瘤分割任务达到了88.71%的Dice得分和3.49 mm的HD95，证实了合成切片保留了关键的诊断信息。这些结果突显了Prob-BBDM在高质量、高效且可泛化的MRI合成方面的潜力，为改善医学图像转换提供了有希望的一步。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Prob-BBDM的新型医学图像转换模型，通过结合布朗桥扩散模型与变分编码器引导机制，实现了从2D轴向MRI切片到多模态序列的高质量、高效合成，仅需4步采样即可在保持临床诊断信息的同时达到优异的转换性能。
AI.keywords: MRI序列转换, 布朗桥扩散模型, 图像合成, 医学影像, 变分编码器
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将布朗桥扩散模型（BBDM）应用于MRI序列转换，并引入变分编码器引导机制，在保证高质量合成的同时实现了仅需4步的高效采样，这对计算资源受限的临床应用具有重要意义。局限性方面，论文未提及在极端病理情况下的鲁棒性表现。

title: Data-Driven Robust MPC for Unknown Nonlinear Systems via Set-Membership Learning
summary: Data-driven model predictive control (MPC) has become an attractive approach for controlling unknown systems, especially when data are corrupted by noise. However, most existing data-driven MPC methods focus on linear systems, and little attention has been given to nonlinear dynamics under disturbances. To fill this gap, we propose a robust data-driven min-max MPC scheme for unknown nonlinear systems with process disturbances. We represent the unknown nonlinear dynamics using vector fields built from a dictionary of basis functions, yielding an equivalent linear form with unknown matrices. These unknown matrices are characterized by a set-membership representation derived from noisy input-state data. Using this uncertainty description, we formulate a min-max MPC problem. Two online scenarios are studied: i) when state measurements are noise-free, and, ii) when they are corrupted by process disturbance. For each case, we derive a Lyapunov-based semidefinite program (SDP) to compute a stabilizing state-feedback controller. The resulting schemes are shown to guarantee recursive feasibility and either exponential or robust stability of the closed-loop system depending on whether there is process disturbance. Simulation studies on benchmark examples illustrate the effectiveness and competitive performance of the proposed approach compared to existing data-driven and model-based controllers.

title: ZONOS2 Technical Report
comments: 15 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Technical report. Model weights, inference code, and the ZTTS1-Eval benchmark released under Apache 2.0. Code: https://github.com/Zyphra/ZONOS2 ; weights: https://huggingface.co/Zyphra/ZONOS2 ; benchmark: https://github.com/Zyphra/ZTTS1-Eval
summary: We present ZONOS2 8B, our latest TTS model, which achieves state-of-the-art naturalness, prosody, and voice cloning fidelity. We improve upon Zonos-v0.1 across scale, data, and training recipe. We scale the model from 1.6B to 8B total parameters (900M active) with a novel mixture-of-experts (MoE) backbone, improving inference latency and throughput. We expand our training corpus from 200K to over 6M hours using a new data processing pipeline, and we simplify our post-training and conditioning recipes to improve naturalness and voice cloning fidelity. We evaluate ZONOS2 8B on quality, speaker similarity, WER, and ZTTS1-Eval, our novel TTS benchmark, where it performs competitively with state-of-the-art systems while maintaining good streaming latency. We release our model weights and example inference code under an Apache 2.0 license on GitHub and Hugging Face.

title: Securing LLM-Agent Long-Term Memory Against Poisoning: Non-Malleable, Origin-Bound Authority with Machine-Checked Guarantees
comments: Index Terms: LLM agents, long-term memory, memory poisoning, information-flow control, capability security, prompt injection, formal verification, benchmark
summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent long-term memory, which creates a critical vulnerability that we study here: memory poisoning. An adversary can store untrusted content in one session that later steers a consequential action, such as a payment, a setting change, or data exfiltration, in a future session. Existing defenses base a memory item's authority to act on either its content (detection or trust-scoring) or its derivation history (lineage). We show that both signals are malleable. An attacker can launder an untrusted origin through three channels specific to LLM agents: the agent's own summarization, a trusted-tool echo, and manufactured corroboration. Each makes the content look benign and breaks or flips its derivation edge to ``trusted.'' We formalize malleability for the memory write-retrieve-act pipeline and prove a machine-checked separation theorem. No content- or lineage-based defense is sound under laundering (T1), write-time origin binding is necessary (T2), and non-malleable origin-bound authority with Sybil-resistant corroboration-gated elevation is sufficient (T3). Our construction, TMA-NM (Tamper-evident Memory Authority, Non-Malleable), instantiates non-malleable information-flow control (IFC) for LLM-agent memory. A cross-defense, cross-attack, and cross-model benchmark over eight frontier models shows that existing defenses fail exactly where the theory predicts (up to 68% laundering attack-success), while TMA-NM reaches 0% attack success on both direct and laundering attacks across all models and channels, at full legitimate utility. We release the benchmark, harness, and machine-checked TLA+ models to support reproducibility.

title: Prague Dependency Treebank -- Consolidated 2.0: Enriching a Complex Annotation Scheme
summary: The Prague Dependency Treebank framework is unique in its attempt to systematically include and link different layers of language, including a meaning representation with several types of inter-sentential phenomena, especially coreference and discourse relations. We present its second consolidated version (PDT-C 2.0), which concludes almost 30-years long project of sustained development of the resource to a uniformly and coherently annotated, genre-diversified, almost 4 million token language resource of Czech language, with accompanying fully compatible lexicons. In addition to continuous linguistic research, the richly linguistically annotated corpus is also widely used in international comparisons of the development of traditional and novel NLP tools as well as in conversions into other formalisms. The corpus and the trained parsers are available under the CC BY-NC-SA licence.
