title: Random coloured digraphs defined by a Markov logic network
summary: A Markov Logic Network (MLN) is a probabilistic relational model used in Statistical Relational Artificial Intelligence for defining a probability distribution on the set of possible worlds with domain $D$ for an arbitrary finite domain $D$. An MLN consists of soft constraints with associated weights which are nonnegative real numbers. In this study we consider a language speaking about a property $P(x)$ and a relation $R(x, y)$. We consider an MLN for which every Boolean combination of $P(x)$ and $R(x, y)$ is a soft constraint (with associated weight). Let $n$ denote the size (cardinality) of the domain. We show that, for every choice of weights, if the weights are scaled by $1/n$ then, for every first-order sentence $\varphi$, the probability that $\varphi$ holds tends to either 0 or 1 as $n \to \infty$; that is, a 0-1 law for first-order logic holds. Morover, the limit probability does {\em not} depend on the weights. If we instead use the standard semantics of MLNs, in the case of which the weights are {\em not} scaled, then the limit behaviour is more complicated and {\em depends} on the weights. With unscaled weights we get 7 qualitatively different cases which depend on the weights. In some cases we have a 0-1 law for first-order logic, in some cases not, but we may still have a convergence law. The influence of the weights on the asymptotic probability of a first-order sentence may be in the form of a sudden ``phase transition'' from one of the 7 cases to another. The presence of a convergence law has positive implications for inference on large domains.

AI.title_translation: 由马尔可夫逻辑网络定义的随机彩色有向图
AI.tldr: 研究发现，马尔可夫逻辑网络（MLN）在权重缩放时服从一阶逻辑0-1律，而未缩放权重时则表现出复杂的相变行为。
AI.motivation: 探索马尔可夫逻辑网络（MLN）在处理大规模领域时，一阶逻辑句子的概率分布如何随领域规模 $n$ 的增大而演变，以及权重设置对这种渐近行为的影响。
AI.method: 通过数学分析和概率论方法，研究了在给定属性 $P(x)$ 和关系 $R(x, y)$ 的语言下，当领域规模 $n \to \infty$ 时，MLN中一阶逻辑句子的渐近概率行为，对比了权重缩放（$1/n$）与未缩放两种情形。
AI.result: 在权重缩放为 $1/n$ 的情况下，MLN满足与权重无关的一阶逻辑0-1律；在未缩放权重的情况下，系统存在7种受权重影响的定性不同情形，并可能发生相变。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，对权重进行 $1/n$ 缩放时，MLN满足一阶逻辑0-1律且与权重无关；而在未缩放权重时，系统表现出复杂的依赖权重的行为，存在7种不同的渐近情形及相变现象。
AI.translation: 马尔可夫逻辑网络（MLN）是一种统计关系人工智能中的概率关系模型，用于定义具有任意有限域 $D$ 的可能世界集上的概率分布。MLN 由具有非负实数权重的软约束组成。在本研究中，我们考虑一种描述属性 $P(x)$ 和关系 $R(x, y)$ 的语言。我们考虑一个 MLN，其中 $P(x)$ 和 $R(x, y)$ 的每个布尔组合都是一个软约束（具有相关权重）。设 $n$ 表示域的大小（基数）。我们证明，对于每一组权重选择，如果权重按 $1/n$ 缩放，则对于每个一阶句子 $\varphi$，$\varphi$ 成立的概率随着 $n \to \infty$ 趋于 0 或 1；也就是说，一阶逻辑的 0-1 律成立。此外，极限概率不依赖于权重。如果我们改为使用 MLN 的标准语义，即权重未缩放，则极限行为更复杂，且依赖于权重。在未缩放权重的情况下，我们得到了7种定性上不同的情况，这些情况取决于权重。在某些情况下，我们有一阶逻辑的 0-1 律，在某些情况下则不然，但我们可能仍然有收敛律。权重对一阶句子渐近概率的影响可能表现为从7种情况之一到另一种的突然“相变”。收敛律的存在对大规模域上的推理具有积极意义。
AI.summary: 本文研究了马尔可夫逻辑网络在定义随机彩色有向图时的渐近行为。分析表明，当权重缩放为 $1/n$ 时，系统服从与权重无关的一阶逻辑0-1律；若权重不缩放，则会出现7种复杂的渐近情形，且可能发生相变。这一结论对于大规模领域的概率推理具有重要意义。
AI.keywords: 马尔可夫逻辑网络, 一阶逻辑, 0-1律, 渐近概率, 相变
AI.comments: 该研究通过数学逻辑证明了马尔可夫逻辑网络（MLN）在特定约束下的渐近行为。其创新点在于揭示了权重缩放对一阶逻辑0-1律的影响，特别是在未缩放权重时出现的7种相变现象，这为大规模关系学习中的推理稳定性提供了重要的理论基础。

title: Dimensionality Reduction of QAOA Parameter Space with Kernel PCA for Max-Cut
comments: 10 pages, 3 figures, submitted to IEEE Quantum Week Conference
summary: The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) is a leading variational algorithm for combinatorial optimization on near term quantum devices. As circuit depth increases, the number of optimization parameters grows, making the search landscape increasingly nonlinear and difficult to optimize. Previous studies have shown that optimal QAOA parameters often lie on a low dimensional manifold that can be approximated using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) at shallow circuit depths. However, the effectiveness of PCA decreases at higher depths because the underlying parameter manifold becomes increasingly nonlinear. In this work, we investigate Kernel Principal Component Analysis (KPCA) with a radial basis function kernel as a nonlinear dimensionality reduction technique for QAOA parameter optimization. The model is trained using 200 graphs from each of 3 graph families, namely Erdos-Renyi, Barabasi-Albert, and Watts-Strogatz, with graph sizes ranging from 7 to 10 nodes. Performance is evaluated on 30 test graphs containing 12 nodes at circuit depths 1, 2, 4, and 8. Experimental results demonstrate that KPCA consistently outperforms PCA at deeper circuit depths across all graph families. At depth 8, KPCA achieves approximation ratios above 0.86, while PCA declines to approximately 0.81 to 0.83. Both methods reduce the number of quantum circuit evaluations by more than 93 percent relative to unrestricted QAOA optimization. These findings suggest that nonlinear kernel methods more effectively capture the structure of the QAOA parameter manifold and provide a practical approach for scaling variational quantum optimization to deeper circuits.
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, submitted to IEEE Quantum Week Conference

AI.title_translation: 基于核主成分分析的Max-Cut问题QAOA参数空间降维研究
AI.tldr: 通过使用核主成分分析（KPCA），本文成功降低了QAOA在高深度电路下的参数优化难度，在大幅减少计算开销的同时，实现了比传统PCA更好的近似性能。
AI.motivation: 随着QAOA电路深度的增加，参数数量显著增长，搜索空间变得高度非线性，导致传统的PCA降维方法在深层电路中效果下降。因此，需要更先进的非线性降维技术来优化参数空间。
AI.method: 使用具有径向基函数（RBF）核的核主成分分析（KPCA）对QAOA参数空间进行非线性降维，通过在不同图族（Erdos-Renyi, Barabasi-Albert, Watts-Strogatz）上的训练和测试，评估其在不同电路深度下的性能。
AI.result: 在电路深度为8时，KPCA的近似比超过0.86，优于PCA的0.81-0.83；同时，两种方法均能减少超过93%的量子电路评估次数。
AI.conclusion: 核主成分分析（KPCA）能够有效捕捉高深度下QAOA参数空间的非线性结构，在保持高压缩率的同时，显著优于传统的PCA方法，是扩展变分量子优化算法的有效手段。
AI.translation: 量子近似优化算法（QAOA）是近邻量子设备上用于组合优化的领先变分算法。随着电路深度的增加，优化参数的数量随之增长，使得搜索空间变得越来越非线性且难以优化。之前的研究表明，最优QAOA参数通常位于一个低维流形上，该流形可以在浅层电路深度下使用主成分分析（PCA）进行近似。然而，由于底层的参数流形变得越来越非线性，PCA在高深度下的有效性会降低。在这项工作中，我们研究了使用带有径向基函数核的核主成分分析（KPCA）作为QAOA参数优化的非线性降维技术。该模型使用了来自Erdos-Renyi、Barabasi-Albert和Watts-Strogatz这三个图族的各200个图进行训练，图规模从7到10个节点不等。性能评估是在包含12个节点的30个测试图上，分别在电路深度1、2、4和8下进行的。实验结果表明，在所有图族中，KPCA在更深的电路深度下始终优于PCA。在深度8时，KPCA实现了超过0.86的近似比，而PCA则下降到大约0.81至0.83。与不受限的QAOA优化相比，这两种方法都将量子电路评估次数减少了93%以上。这些发现表明，非线性核方法能更有效地捕捉QAOA参数流形的结构，并为将变分量子优化扩展到更深电路提供了一种实用的方法。
AI.summary: 本文研究了利用核主成分分析（KPCA）优化QAOA参数空间的方法。针对高深度电路中参数空间非线性增强的问题，通过在多种图结构上的实验验证，证明了KPCA在捕捉参数流形结构方面优于传统PCA，能在大幅减少计算开销的同时提升优化效果。
AI.keywords: QAOA, 降维, 核主成分分析 (KPCA), 最大割问题, 变分量子算法
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入核主成分分析（KPCA）有效解决了QAOA在高深度电路下参数空间非线性增强导致的优化难题，相比传统PCA具有更好的扩展性和性能，为变分量子算法的实际应用提供了新的优化思路。

title: A Hybrid Quantum-Classical Approach for Melt Pool Prediction in Laser Powder Bed Fusion
comments: 10 pages, 7 figures, to be presented at the ASME IDETC/CIE 2026 Conference
summary: Laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) is a promising additive manufacturing technique that suffers from quality assurance concerns. Predicting melt pools from process parameters is crucial for assessing quality prior to manufacturing but remains a difficult problem because of the complex physical processes underlying LPBF. Quantum computers present a new computing paradigm, providing a new approach to information processing using quantum entanglement and superposition. This paper presents a practical demonstration of a hybrid quantum-classical model that leverages quantum computing to improve process parameter feature extraction with a quantum feature encoder. To make the quantum approach computationally feasible for large datasets, we first employ a clustering algorithm to reduce the number of expensive quantum computations. These quantum features are then processed by a classical neural network to predict the melt pool morphology, allowing for more accurate predictions of melt pools. We demonstrate the method using a quantum simulator, analyze the effect of measurement shot noise on the predictive performance of the network, and verify the results using quantum hardware. Finally, by examining which quantum features are most important, we provide insights that can inform the future design of more effective quantum encoding circuits. Ultimately, the performance improvement over purely classical networks validates the hybrid approach, demonstrating an engineering application of quantum computing using noisy and intermediate scale quantum (NISQ) devices.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于激光粉末床熔融中熔池预测的混合量子-经典方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种混合量子-经典模型，通过量子特征编码优化LPBF熔池预测，在NISQ设备上实现了比纯经典网络更优的性能。
AI.motivation: 激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）过程复杂，导致质量评估困难；而量子计算的独特特性有望提升复杂制造过程中参数特征提取的精度。
AI.method: 提出了一种混合量子-经典模型：首先利用聚类算法减少量子计算量，接着通过量子特征编码器提取过程参数特征，最后输入经典神经网络进行熔池形态预测，并在量子模拟器与量子硬件上进行了验证。
AI.result: 该混合方法在预测熔池形态方面表现优于纯经典神经网络，并分析了测量射击噪声对性能的影响，同时通过特征重要性分析为量子电路设计提供了见解。
AI.conclusion: 该混合量子-经典模型在预测LPBF熔池形态方面优于纯经典网络，验证了利用NISQ设备进行工程应用的可行性与有效性。
AI.translation: 激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）是一种极具前景的增材制造技术，但其质量保证问题令人担忧。根据工艺参数预测熔池对于在制造前评估质量至关重要，但由于LPBF底层复杂的物理过程，这仍然是一个难题。量子计算机提供了一种新的计算范式，利用量子纠缠和叠加提供了一种新的信息处理方法。本文展示了一种混合量子-经典模型的实际演示，该模型利用量子计算通过量子特征编码器改进工艺参数特征提取。为了使量子方法对大数据集具有计算可行性，我们首先采用聚类算法来减少昂贵的量子计算数量。然后，这些量子特征由经典神经网络处理以预测熔池形态，从而实现更准确的熔池预测。我们使用量子模拟器演示了该方法，分析了测量射击噪声对网络预测性能的影响，并使用量子硬件验证了结果。最后，通过检查哪些量子特征最重要，我们提供了可以为未来设计更有效的量子编码电路提供信息见解。最终，相对于纯经典网络的性能提升验证了这种混合方法，展示了使用噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）设备的量子计算工程应用。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种结合量子计算与经典神经网络的混合模型，用于激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）过程中的熔池形态预测。通过聚类算法优化计算资源，利用量子编码器提取特征，该方法在NISQ设备上实现了比传统方法更优的预测性能。
AI.keywords: 激光粉末床熔融, 熔池预测, 混合量子-经典计算, 量子特征编码, 增材制造
AI.comments: 该研究成功地将量子计算应用于复杂的工业制造领域（LPBF），展示了NISQ设备在处理工程数据方面的潜力。通过聚类算法降低计算成本并结合经典神经网络，该方法在实际工程应用中具有很高的参考价值，尤其是在处理高维数据特征提取方面展现了优势。

title: Computational references are not experiments: pre-registered validation of machine-learned sodium-cathode voltages
summary: Machine-learning screens for battery materials are trained and judged almost entirely against computed reference voltages, and those references carry their own systematic errors. We report a case in which this matters quantitatively: our own screening stack (a graph-network voltage screen, a prior-art triage layer, and a local PBE+U bench) fails pre-registered validation against experiment-anchored literature values. Verdict thresholds, failure modes, and the primary metric were committed before analysis. On an operator-audited set of known Na-ion cathodes (n = 6 after one documented exclusion; verdict unchanged at n = 7), the raw held-out mean absolute error was 0.67 V, the pre-registered conservative metric, the upper 95% confidence bound of the cross-validated bias-corrected error, was 1.09 V, and the residual was strongly voltage-dependent (r = -0.94), so no additive calibration is valid. On the two compounds where prediction, database reference, and experiment could all be compared, the Materials Project PBE+U reference sat about 0.54 V below measurement: the reference, not the model, dominated the error. A prior-art screen found at least 70% of the targeted Na substitution space already published. We retire the screen, bound what "verified" means for our DFT ledger, and pre-register a calibration audit of it against four benchmark Li couples.

AI.title_translation: 计算参考值不是实验：机器学习钠离子阴极电压的预注册验证
AI.tldr: 通过预注册验证发现，机器学习电池材料筛选模型的失败主要归咎于计算参考数据库的系统误差，而非模型本身。
AI.motivation: 当前机器学习筛选电池材料主要依赖计算参考电压，但这些参考值本身存在系统误差，其对筛选准确性的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用图神经网络电压筛选、预筛选层及PBE+U基准计算，并对已知钠离子阴极数据集进行预注册验证，通过与实验锚定文献值对比来评估模型性能。
AI.result: 模型在实验数据上的平均绝对误差为0.67V，且存在强电压依赖性，无法简单校准。实验发现Materials Project的PBE+U参考值比实验值低约0.54V，证实了误差主要源于参考数据而非模型本身。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明计算参考值存在显著的系统性偏差，导致机器学习筛选模型失效，强调了在电池材料研究中必须将实验数据作为验证基准。
AI.translation: 机器学习电池材料筛选主要基于计算参考电压进行训练和评估，而这些参考值本身带有系统误差。我们报告了一个定量证实这一问题的案例：我们的筛选模型（包含图神经网络电压筛选、预筛选层和局部PBE+U基准）在针对实验锚定文献值的预注册验证中失败。我们在分析前预先确定了判定阈值、失效模式和主要指标。在经人工审核的已知钠离子阴极集（n=6）上，原始留出平均绝对误差为0.67V，预注册的保守指标（交叉验证偏差校正误差的95%置信上限）为1.09V，且残差具有强电压依赖性（r=-0.94），因此任何加性校准均无效。在可同时比较预测值、数据库参考值和实验值的两种化合物上，Materials Project的PBE+U参考值比测量值低约0.54V：参考值而非模型主导了误差。此外，一项现有技术筛选发现至少70%的目标钠取代空间已被发表。我们决定废弃该筛选模型，界定DFT分类账中“已验证”的含义，并预注册针对四种基准锂电偶的校准审计。
AI.summary: 本文通过对钠离子电池阴极电压预测模型进行预注册验证，发现基于计算参考值训练的模型在真实实验数据面前表现不佳。研究指出计算参考值的系统性偏差是导致模型失效的主要原因，并据此决定停止使用现有筛选模型，转向更严谨的实验基准校准。
AI.keywords: 机器学习, 钠离子电池, 阴极电压, 计算误差, 预注册验证
AI.comments: 本文通过预注册验证揭示了机器学习电池筛选中一个关键问题：计算参考值本身存在的系统误差往往被误认为是模型误差。这种实证研究对于提高计算材料科学的严谨性具有重要意义，提醒研究者在依赖数据库标签时需保持审慎。

title: Ultra-Low-Rate Information Reconciliation: Repetition Coding or Dedicated Codes?
comments: Accepted and to be presented at the Optica Advanced Photonics Congress: Signal Processing in Photonic Communications (SPPCom), pp. p. SpTh1F.3, Long Beach, CA, USA, Jul. 2026
summary: We compare repetition-based ultra-low-rate information reconciliation with dedicated ultra-low-rate codes for CV-QKD. Repetition coding offers a favorable performance-complexity trade-off, incurring only a moderate error-rate penalty while reducing decoding complexity by $2\times$, making it attractive for implementation-constrained systems.

AI.title_translation: 超低码率信息协调：重复编码还是专用编码？
AI.tldr: 对于CV-QKD系统，重复编码在性能略有下降的情况下，能将解码复杂度降低一半，是实现受限环境下的更优选择。
AI.motivation: 在CV-QKD系统中，针对超低码率信息协调，旨在寻找性能与解码复杂度之间的最佳平衡点。
AI.method: 通过对比研究，评估了基于重复编码的超低码率信息协调与专用超低码率编码在CV-QKD中的表现。
AI.result: 重复编码在仅带来适度误码率代价的同时，将解码复杂度降低了2倍。
AI.conclusion: 对于受限于实现复杂性的CV-QKD系统，重复码是一种比专用低码率码更具吸引力的选择。
AI.translation: 我们对比了CV-QKD中基于重复编码的超低码率信息协调与专用超低码率编码的表现。重复编码提供了一个有利的性能-复杂度权衡，在仅产生适度误码率惩罚的同时将解码复杂度降低了2倍，使其对受限于实现的系统具有吸引力。
AI.summary: 本文对比了CV-QKD中重复编码与专用超低码率码在信息协调方面的表现，发现重复编码在牺牲少量性能的前提下显著降低了解码复杂度。
AI.keywords: 量子密钥分发, 信息协调, 重复编码, 低码率, 复杂度分析
AI.comments: 该论文通过对比分析，指出了在资源受限的CV-QKD系统中，重复码（Repetition Coding）在性能与复杂性之间取得了良好的平衡，这为实际系统设计提供了一个务实的工程选择。

title: Certifying Quantum Optimization and Circuit Cutting by Using Quantum-Classical Moment Duality
comments: submitted; feedback welcome! simulation code is available at https://github.com/adaskin/quantum-moment-certification
summary: We establish a direct quantum-classical duality based on the degree-$2$ Sum-of-Squares (SoS) semidefinite programming cone: the matrix of two-qubit Pauli-$Z$ correlation functions obtained from \emph{any} quantum state $ρ$ is automatically a feasible point of the classical Goemans-Williamson (GW) relaxation. This observation provides a universal ``safety net'' for quantum optimization algorithms: applying GW random hyperplane rounding to the quantum-driven moment matrix yields a certified expected cut value $\mathbb{E}[\mathrm{Cut}] \ge α_{\mathrm{GW}}\langle\mathcal{H}\rangle_ρ$, valid for every state produced by variational algorithms such as QAOA or the Variational Quantum Power Method (VQPM), regardless of convergence quality. We further show that the same moment matrix reveals the tensor-product structure of the underlying unitary circuit, enabling a polynomial-time, correlation-based circuit cutting procedure with rigorous error bounds. The framework is validated numerically on Max-Cut instances for variational quantum algorithms and on random states for circuit cutting, demonstrating that the cheap two-point correlation data are sufficient to locate near-optimal bipartitions and that the theoretical error bounds hold in practice.

title: Performance and Interpretability of Convolutional, Transformer, and Hybrid Deep Learning Models in Colorectal Histology Classification
summary: Deep learning has become an important tool in computational pathology, enabling automated analysis of histopathological images. While convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have traditionally dominated this field, transformer-based and hybrid architectures have recently demonstrated promising performance. However, comprehensive comparisons of these approaches for colorectal histopathology remain limited. This study evaluated twelve ImageNet-pretrained CNN, transformer, and hybrid architectures using the Kather colorectal histopathology dataset containing 5,000 image tiles from eight tissue classes. All models were trained using a standardized transfer-learning and fine-tuning protocol and assessed using multiple performance metrics, including accuracy, precision, sensitivity, specificity, F1-score, ROC-AUC, Cohen's kappa, and Matthews correlation coefficient. All evaluated models achieved high classification performance, with accuracies ranging from 93.2% to 97.1%. EVA-02 achieved the highest overall performance (97.1% accuracy, 97.0% F1-score), closely followed by ViT-B/16. Among CNNs, ResNet34 and ConvNeXt-Tiny demonstrated highly competitive performance, achieving accuracies of 96.4% and 96.3%, respectively. Transformer architectures generally produced the strongest results across evaluation metrics, although the performance gap between the best transformer and CNN models was relatively small. Per-class analysis showed consistently strong classification performance across all tissue categories, with Complex Stroma representing the most challenging class. Overall, transformer-based architectures achieved the highest predictive performance, whereas modern CNNs provided a favorable balance between accuracy and model complexity. These findings provide a comprehensive benchmark of major deep learning paradigms for colorectal histopathology classification.

AI.title_translation: 卷积、Transformer及混合深度学习模型在结直肠组织病理学分类中的性能与可解释性研究
AI.tldr: 通过对比12种模型，研究发现Transformer在结直肠组织病理学分类中性能领先，但CNN在保持高精度的同时具有更好的复杂度平衡。
AI.motivation: 尽管深度学习在计算病理学中应用广泛，但目前缺乏针对结直肠组织病理学分类中卷积神经网络、Transformer及混合架构的全面性能与可解释性对比研究。
AI.method: 研究评估了12种ImageNet预训练模型（包含CNN、Transformer和混合架构），在Kather结直肠组织病理学数据集上使用了统一的迁移学习和微调协议，并通过多种指标（准确率、F1分数、ROC-AUC等）进行性能评估。
AI.result: 所有模型均表现优异，准确率在93.2%至97.1%之间。EVA-02表现最佳（97.1%准确率），ViT-B/16紧随其后。现代CNN（如ResNet34和ConvNeXt-Tiny）表现出极强的竞争力，Transformer整体性能略优但与CNN差距较小。复杂基质（Complex Stroma）被识别为最难分类的类别。
AI.conclusion: Transformer架构在结直肠组织病理学分类中表现最佳，但现代CNN在精度与模型复杂性之间提供了更优的平衡，研究结果为该领域的模型选型提供了重要参考。
AI.translation: 深度学习已成为计算病理学的重要工具，能够实现组织病理学图像的自动化分析。虽然卷积神经网络（CNN）在这一领域长期占据主导地位，但基于Transformer和混合架构的模型近期展现出良好的性能。然而，针对结直肠组织病理学中这些方法的全面比较仍然有限。本研究使用包含来自八个组织类别的5,000个图像块的Kather结直肠组织病理学数据集，评估了12种ImageNet预训练的CNN、Transformer和混合架构。所有模型均使用标准化的迁移学习和微调协议进行训练，并使用包括准确率、精确率、敏感性、特异性、F1分数、ROC-AUC、Cohen's kappa和Matthews相关系数在内的多种性能指标进行了评估。所有评估模型均实现了高分类性能，准确率范围为93.2%至97.1%。EVA-02实现了最高的整体性能（97.1%准确率，97.0% F1分数），ViT-B/16紧随其后。在CNN中，ResNet34和ConvNeXt-Tiny表现出极强的竞争力，准确率分别为96.4%和96.3%。Transformer架构在各项评估指标中通常产生最强结果，尽管最佳Transformer模型与CNN模型之间的性能差距相对较小。分类别分析显示所有组织类别的分类性能均保持强劲，其中“复杂基质”是最具挑战性的类别。总体而言，基于Transformer的架构实现了最高的预测性能，而现代CNN在准确性和模型复杂性之间提供了良好的平衡。这些发现为结直肠组织病理学分类的主要深度学习范式提供了全面的基准。
AI.summary: 本文对比了12种卷积、Transformer及混合深度学习模型在结直肠组织病理学图像分类任务中的表现。结果显示Transformer模型在预测性能上略胜一筹，而现代CNN则在精度与模型复杂度之间取得了良好的平衡。
AI.keywords: 深度学习, 结直肠组织病理学, 卷积神经网络, Transformer, 迁移学习
AI.comments: 该研究通过大规模基准测试，明确了不同深度学习范式在结直肠组织病理学分类中的表现与权衡。其创新之处在于对比了CNN、Transformer及混合架构，为临床决策支持系统的模型选择提供了实证依据。局限性在于仅使用了单一数据集（Kather），且未深入探讨不同架构在计算资源与推理速度上的具体差异。

title: JEDEL: Zero-Shot DNA-Encoded Library Design for Early-Stage Drug Discovery
summary: We present JEDEL, a framework for generating synthesis-ready DNA-encoded libraries (DELs) directly from three-dimensional pharmacophore representations of active ligands. JEDEL is the first model to map pharmacophore interaction patterns to actionable, scalable synthesis instructions, enabling the design of targeted libraries comprising potentially millions of molecules. Unlike existing generative approaches that produce virtual compounds requiring downstream synthesis planning, JEDEL operates within the space of purchasable building blocks and validated reactions, ensuring that every output is experimentally realizable by construction. JEDEL learns a predictive alignment between pharmacophore geometry and molecular structure and decodes this into combinatorial synthesis routes at scale. Across 18 protein targets, it generates focused libraries that outperform random and diversity-based baselines in predicted binding affinity, pharmacophore recovery, and sample efficiency, without target-specific retraining. JEDEL enables a shift from virtual molecule generation to experimentally deployable library design.

title: An Empirical Study of Entropy-Conserving Binarization in H.264/AVC CABAC
comments: 9 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code, benchmarks, and raw data: https://github.com/vinamras19/cabac-binarization-study
summary: CABAC, the entropy coder of H.264/AVC and the basis for HEVC and VVC, decomposes multi-symbol values into bins via a binarization scheme before a binary arithmetic coder. H.264 uses Truncated Unary plus k-th order Exp-Golomb (UEG); alternatives include canonical Huffman and the entropy-conserving binarization (ECB), which provably preserves entropy mapping m-ary data to m-1 binary strings but has not been evaluated inside a production binary arithmetic coder. We integrate ECB into a from-scratch CABAC implementation alongside UEG, single-context Huffman, and a Huffman variant with per-bin-position contexts (HuffmanPos), all sharing one M-coder backend. We benchmark all four on synthetic sources, DCT residuals from a procedural image, and the full 24-image Kodak suite (2,480 round-trip trials, bit-exact verified). On the procedural image, a sparsity-driven crossover at Q=8 lets ECB overtake single-context Huffman, reaching 27 percentage points below at Q=32. On Kodak the crossover shifts below the tested range and ECB beats single-context Huffman at every Q, the gap growing from 0.031 to 0.113 bits per symbol. HuffmanPos, sharing Huffman's codewords but allocating one context per bin position, beats ECB on 12 of 15 source cells and loses by at most 0.56 percentage points on the other three, despite the same per-symbol bin count as single-context Huffman. This isolates the dominant mechanism: at low source entropy the rate gap is driven primarily by context allocation over the bin stream, not the binarization's per-symbol bin count. ECB's rate efficiency costs 7 to 10x in decoder latency on large alphabets, traced to an O(N*m) decoder; we sketch an interleaved single-pass variant that would close this gap. Code, benchmarks, and raw data are open source.

title: Machine Learning and Deep Learning for Exoplanet Detection and Atmospheric Characterization with JWST and the Upcoming Ariel Mission
summary: The detection and atmospheric characterization of exoplanets have entered a new data-intensive era driven by the James Webb Space Telescope and the upcoming Ariel mission. Modern surveys produce millions of light curves and high-resolution spectra that overwhelm traditional pipelines, motivating the rapid integration of Machine Learning and Deep Learning methods into the exoplanet workflow. This review synthesizes the latest progress in applying ML/DL techniques to exoplanet detection (transit identification, candidate vetting, false-positive rejection) and atmospheric characterization (retrieval, detrending, cross-correlation, surrogate modelling) in the context of JWST and Ariel. We start with classical algorithms such as Random Forests and Convolutional Neural Networks, move through Transformers and Recurrent architectures, then survey modern simulation-based inference using Neural Posterior Estimation and Flow Matching Posterior Estimation with normalizing or continuous normalizing flows. We discuss benchmark efforts, including the Ariel Machine Learning Data Challenges (2019 to 2025) hosted with NeurIPS, and key JWST case studies such as the WASP-39b Early Release Science programme. Results indicate that DL approaches consistently match or exceed traditional pipelines in both speed and accuracy, while ML-driven retrievals reduce inference time from CPU-hours to seconds and can accelerate nested-sampling retrievals by factors of 3-8 without compromising Bayesian evidence. We identify outstanding challenges interpretability, calibration of uncertainties under noisy data, hybrid modelling, and the generalization of models across instruments and planet populations and outline a research roadmap spanning the JWST era and beyond into Ariel's launch in 2029.

AI.title_translation: 机器学习与深度学习在JWST和即将到来的Ariel任务中进行系外行星探测与大气表征的应用
AI.tldr: 本文综述了ML/DL在处理JWST与Ariel任务海量数据中的应用，证明了其在提升探测速度与大气检索效率方面的显著优势，并指出了模型可解释性与泛化等未来挑战。
AI.motivation: 詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）和即将发射的Ariel任务产生的数据量巨大，传统分析流程难以应对，迫切需要引入机器学习和深度学习技术。
AI.method: 综述了从经典算法（随机森林、CNN）到前沿架构（Transformer、RNN）的应用，以及基于模拟的推理方法（如神经后验估计、流匹配后验估计）。
AI.result: 深度学习方法在速度和精度上均能达到或超过传统流程；基于机器学习的检索技术将推理时间从CPU小时级缩短至秒级，并使嵌套采样检索速度提升3-8倍，且不损害贝叶斯证据。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习和深度学习已成为现代系外行星科学的核心工具，能有效提升数据处理的规模与效率，未来研究应聚焦于提升模型的鲁棒性、可解释性及泛化能力。
AI.translation: 系外行星的探测与大气表征已进入由詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）和即将到来的Ariel任务推动的数据密集型新时代。现代观测产生了数百万条光变曲线和高分辨率光谱，这些数据使传统分析管道不堪重负，促使机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）方法快速融入系外行星的研究流程。本综述综合了在JWST和Ariel背景下，将ML/DL技术应用于系外行星探测（凌星识别、候选体审核、假阳性剔除）和大气表征（反演、去趋势、互相关、代理建模）的最新进展。我们从随机森林和卷积神经网络等经典算法入手，探讨了Transformer和循环神经网络架构，随后调查了使用神经后验估计和流匹配后验估计（具有归一化或连续归一化流）的现代仿真推理方法。我们讨论了基准测试工作，包括与NeurIPS共同举办的Ariel机器学习数据挑战（2019至2025年），以及WASP-39b早期发布科学计划等关键JWST案例研究。结果表明，深度学习方法在速度和精度上始终能匹配或超过传统流程，而机器学习驱动的反演将推理时间从CPU小时缩短至秒级，并在不影响贝叶斯证据的前提下，将嵌套采样反演速度提高了3-8倍。我们识别了诸如可解释性、噪声数据下的不确定性校准、混合建模以及模型在不同仪器和行星种群间的泛化等亟待解决的挑战，并规划了跨越JWST时代直至2029年Ariel发射后的研究路线图。
AI.summary: 本文综述了机器学习与深度学习在JWST和Ariel任务中关于系外行星探测与大气表征的应用，总结了从经典模型到现代仿真推理技术的发展，并指出了当前面临的挑战及未来研究方向。
AI.keywords: 系外行星, 机器学习, 深度学习, JWST, Ariel任务
AI.comments: 该论文对机器学习在系外行星研究中的应用进行了全面的综述，强调了其在处理海量观测数据方面的关键作用，特别是在提高效率和降低计算成本方面的显著优势。其局限性在于模型的可解释性、不确定性校准以及跨任务/跨仪器泛化能力仍面临挑战。

title: Integrated Sensing and Communications for Real-time Avatar Control in XR over 5G
summary: Extended Reality (XR) presents a challenging use case for 5G and 6G networks, requiring high data-rates and lowlatency communication to deliver a truly immersive experience. Moreover, in order to seamlessly translate physical actions to the virtual world, accurate gesture recognition and pose estimation are required. Current XR interaction solutions based on handheld controllers and cameras cannot easily capture full-body poses, inhibit the free use of hands, and require good visibility and a clear line of sight. In this work, we propose a multimodal sensing architecture for XR that combines 5G MillimeterWave (mmWave) Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) and surface electromyography (sEMG) signals. 5G mmWave ISAC cannot only be used to deliver content wirelessly to the Head-mounted display (HMD), but also the same communication signals can be used to derive coarse body-level gestures and poses of the user, to support real-time avatar control. For fine-grained finger-level gestures, our architecture leverages lightweight sEMG sensors that capture forearm muscle activity. To illustrate the need of both modalities, we present evaluations of both sensing technologies. At the body level (5G), our architecture relies on power-per-beam-pair (PPBP), which can be computed from standard beam management or beam sweeping procedures of the 5G NR standard. PPBP-based sensing achieves 82.2$\pm$5.9% average accuracy when evaluated on users not seen during training. For fine-grained finger-level interactions, we show that surface electromyography (sEMG) carries strong discriminative information achieving consistent promising performance across different movement settings. Thus, combining the two modalities enables multi-scale gesture recognition, at the body level via existing 5G signals and finger level via lightweight sEMG sensors, forming a complete XR framework.

title: Hessian-augmented Supervised Learning for Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman PDEs
summary: A data-driven method is developed for approximating value functions in deterministic optimal control problems with nonlinear control-affine dynamics. The Pontryagin Maximum Principle optimality system is solved from multiple initial conditions to generate training data consisting of values, gradients, and Hessians of the value function, where Hessian information is obtained from a matrix Riccati equation along optimal trajectories. These quantities augment a weighted least-squares regression over sparse polynomial bases on hyperbolic cross index sets, with gradients and Hessians contributing additional linear equations per sample and substantially reducing sample complexity compared to value-only regression. Feedback laws are recovered analytically from the learned value function. In high dimensions, a partial Hessian strategy controls the cost of data generation. The approach is validated on problems of increasing state dimension, where second-order data augmentation is shown to improve approximation accuracy and closed-loop performance, with up to an order-of-magnitude reduction in the number of training samples required relative to lower-order methods.

AI.title_translation: 用于Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman偏微分方程的Hessian增强监督学习
AI.tldr: 通过在监督学习中引入Hessian信息，该方法显著提升了求解高维最优控制问题（HJB方程）的样本效率和近似精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于价值函数的近似方法在求解高维最优控制问题时往往面临样本效率低下和计算成本过高的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于数据驱动的Hessian增强监督学习方法。利用Pontryagin极大值原理生成包含价值函数值、梯度和Hessian矩阵的训练数据（通过矩阵Riccati方程获取），并将其整合到基于稀疏多项式基的加权最小二乘回归中，同时针对高维问题采用了部分Hessian策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，二阶数据增强能显著提高价值函数近似精度和闭环控制性能，与仅使用价值信息的低阶方法相比，训练样本需求量减少了高达一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过利用Hessian信息增强监督学习，显著提高了价值函数近似的精度和样本效率，为高维确定性最优控制提供了一种有效的数值求解方案。
AI.translation: 本文为具有非线性控制仿射动力学的确定性最优控制问题中的价值函数近似开发了一种数据驱动方法。通过从多个初始条件求解Pontryagin极大值原理最优性系统，生成包含价值函数值、梯度和Hessian矩阵的训练数据，其中Hessian信息通过最优轨迹上的矩阵Riccati方程获得。这些量增强了对双曲交叉索引集上稀疏多项式基的加权最小二乘回归，梯度和Hessian为每个样本贡献了额外的线性方程，与仅使用价值的回归相比，显著降低了样本复杂度。反馈律从学习到的价值函数中解析恢复。在高维情况下，部分Hessian策略控制了数据生成的成本。该方法在状态维度不断增加的问题上得到了验证，结果表明二阶数据增强提高了近似精度和闭环性能，与低阶方法相比，训练样本需求量减少了一个数量级。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于近似Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程价值函数的Hessian增强监督学习方法。通过利用Pontryagin极大值原理和矩阵Riccati方程生成包含二阶导数信息的训练样本，结合稀疏多项式回归，显著降低了样本复杂度，并有效提升了高维最优控制问题的求解精度。
AI.keywords: 最优控制, Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程, 监督学习, Hessian增强, 样本效率
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入Hessian信息有效解决了高维最优控制问题中价值函数近似的“维度灾难”和样本效率问题。其创新之处在于利用Pontryagin极大值原理和矩阵Riccati方程获取二阶导数信息，从而显著降低了回归所需的样本量，为解决Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman偏微分方程提供了一种高效的监督学习范式。

title: The Measurable Majority
summary: This paper studies strict majority reasoning in finite electorates using so-called $\textit{social decision frames}$: finite sets of voters equipped with distinguished families of coalitions interpreted as those voting blocs evaluated to form a strict majority. A coherence criterion for qualitative majority judgments is identified and shown to give an exact characterization for representability of strict majorities by finitely additive measures. In addition, a minimal natural logic for reasoning about strict majorities is shown to be sound and complete. These developments motivate examination of associated combinatorial questions concerning incoherence in finite families of sets; partial results and a conjecture are given. Finally, the results of this paper are applied to correct a classical representation theorem for weak qualitative probability structures due to Patrick Suppes and to establish a May-type characterization for ordinary strict majority rule for social decision frames.

AI.title_translation: 可测量的多数派
AI.tldr: 本文通过引入社会决策框架，为有限选民中的严格多数推理提供了数学表示、逻辑完备性证明，并修正了经典的概率表示定理。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决有限选民中严格多数推理的数学基础问题，特别是寻找定性多数判断的一致性准则，以及为严格多数规则建立形式化逻辑和表示定理。
AI.method: 使用了社会决策框架（social decision frames）作为模型，结合有限可加测度理论、命题逻辑推理以及组合数学方法进行分析和证明。
AI.result: 确定了定性多数判断的一致性准则，证明了严格多数规则可用有限可加测度表示；建立了一个完备的最小自然逻辑；修正了Suppes的弱定性概率表示定理，并为社会决策框架推导出了May型特征刻画。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了严格多数判断的一致性准则，建立了相应的逻辑系统，并成功将其应用于修正经典表示定理及扩展May定理，为理解多数规则提供了坚实的数学基础。
AI.translation: 本文研究了有限选民中使用所谓“社会决策框架”的严格多数推理：即一组有限的选民，配备了被解释为形成严格多数的投票集团家族。文章确定了定性多数判断的一致性准则，并证明了该准则为严格多数通过有限可加测度进行表示提供了精确刻画。此外，证明了一个关于严格多数推理的最小自然逻辑是可靠且完备的。这些发展推动了对有限集合族中不一致性相关的组合问题的研究；文中给出了部分结果及一个猜想。最后，本文的结果被应用于修正Patrick Suppes关于弱定性概率结构的经典表示定理，并为社会决策框架中的普通严格多数规则建立了May型特征刻画。
AI.summary: 本文研究了有限选民中的严格多数推理，提出了“社会决策框架”模型。通过定义一致性准则，实现了严格多数判断与有限可加测度的联系，并构建了相应的完备逻辑系统。研究还探讨了相关的组合问题，并修正了Suppes的经典表示定理，同时为普通严格多数规则建立了May型特征刻画。
AI.keywords: 社会决策框架, 严格多数推理, 有限可加测度, 逻辑完备性, 多数规则
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入“社会决策框架”这一数学结构，为研究有限选民中的多数派推理提供了一个严谨的形式化框架。其核心贡献在于将定性多数判断与有限可加测度联系起来，并解决了经典概率表示定理中的潜在问题，体现了社会选择理论与组合数学、逻辑学的交叉创新。

title: Identifying structural design principles shaping the computational abilities of recurrent neural networks
summary: Understanding how the architecture of neural networks shapes the computations they carry is a central challenge in neuroscience and machine learning. While specific circuit architectures have been linked to particular network computations and theoretical bounds on expressivity of broad classes of networks have been found, we are still missing general principles connecting the structure of finite networks to their computational capabilities. Here, we characterize the computational abilities of recurrent neural networks as a function of their connectivity by training a large collection of different networks to compute a large set of Boolean functions. For small networks, we constructed the complete ``catalogs'' of network-function performance, which revealed that computational capacity varies widely across architectures and that most networks show poor performance, and most functions are hard to compute. However, we show that having local 2- and 3-cycles in a network strongly enhances its computational ability, and networks with such cycles are often the minimal architectures that can solve particular functions. We further show that a small set of structural statistics accurately predict networks' performance. Extending our analysis to large networks showed that typical networks fail even to approximate a randomly selected function. Surprisingly, adding a small number of sparsely connected biologically-inspired interneurons to the network dramatically increases computational capacity. As in small networks, adding short cycles improved networks' capacity, outperforming acyclic or reachability-matched controls. Thus, our results identify local cycles as design principles linking neural connectivity to computational power, and offer a general framework to explore structure-function relations in computing networks.

AI.title_translation: 识别塑造循环神经网络计算能力的结构设计原则
AI.tldr: 研究发现循环神经网络中的局部2-和3-循环是提升计算能力的关键结构设计原则，且引入生物启发神经元可进一步增强网络性能。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏连接有限网络结构与其计算能力的一般性原理，需要理解神经架构如何塑造计算过程。
AI.method: 通过训练大量不同连接架构的循环神经网络来完成多种布尔函数计算，构建“网络-功能”性能目录，统计分析结构特征与性能的相关性，并探究生物启发中间神经元的影响。
AI.result: 发现局部2-和3-循环能显著提升网络计算能力，且这些结构往往是求解特定函数的最小架构；结构统计量可预测性能；添加少量稀疏连接的生物启发中间神经元能大幅提升大网络的计算能力。
AI.conclusion: 局部循环结构（特别是2-和3-循环）是决定循环神经网络计算能力的核心设计原则，能显著增强网络的计算效能，甚至在引入生物启发的中间神经元时效果更佳。
AI.translation: 理解神经网络的架构如何塑造其执行的计算是神经科学和机器学习领域的核心挑战。虽然特定的电路架构已被证实与特定的网络计算相关，且已发现了广泛类别网络的表达能力理论边界，但我们仍然缺乏将有限网络结构与其计算能力联系起来的一般原则。在此，我们通过训练大量不同的网络来计算大量的布尔函数，将循环神经网络的计算能力表征为连接性的函数。对于小型网络，我们构建了网络-功能性能的完整“目录”，揭示了计算能力在不同架构间差异巨大，且大多数网络表现不佳，大多数函数也很难计算。然而，我们表明，网络中存在局部2-和3-循环能显著增强其计算能力，并且具有此类循环的网络通常是能够解决特定函数的最小架构。我们进一步表明，一小部分结构统计量可以准确预测网络的性能。将我们的分析扩展到大型网络表明，典型的网络甚至无法近似随机选择的函数。令人惊讶的是，在网络中添加少量稀疏连接的生物启发中间神经元会显著增加计算能力。与小型网络一样，添加短循环提高了网络的容量，优于无环或可达性匹配的对照组。因此，我们的结果确定了局部循环是连接神经连接与计算能力的结构设计原则，并提供了一个探索计算网络中结构-功能关系的通用框架。
AI.summary: 本文旨在探索循环神经网络的结构与其计算能力之间的关系。通过对不同架构网络进行大规模布尔函数计算测试，研究发现大多数随机架构性能较差，但具有局部2-和3-循环的结构能显著增强计算能力。此外，研究还发现生物启发的中间神经元能有效提升大规模网络的计算效能，揭示了局部循环作为连接结构与功能的关键设计原则。
AI.keywords: 循环神经网络, 计算能力, 结构设计原则, 局部循环, 网络架构
AI.comments: 该研究通过大规模的计算实验，揭示了局部循环结构（local cycles）在提升循环神经网络计算能力方面的关键作用。这不仅为理解生物神经网络的结构提供了理论依据，也为人工神经网络的架构搜索提供了结构化原则。研究的局限性在于主要针对布尔函数，且在大规模网络上的普适性仍需进一步验证。

title: Promise and challenges of heart chamber segmentation from non-contrast CT scans using contrastive unpaired image translation: a feasibility study
summary: Purpose: To evaluate the feasibility and challenges of heart chamber segmentation from non-contrast CT scans using contrastive unpaired image translation and deep learning-based segmentation. Approach: We developed ChameleonNet, a framework utilizing the Contrastive Unpaired Translation (CUT) network with decoupled contrastive learning (DCL) loss to synthesize non-contrast CT from contrast CT scans. Using annotations of four heart chambers (left atrium (LA), left ventricle (LV), right atrium (RA), and right ventricle (RV)) from contrast scans, we trained a Hausdorff distance loss-enhanced nnU-Net on synthesized non-contrast images. The translation model was trained with 35,538 contrast-enhanced and 37,197 non-contrast CT slices. The segmentation model was trained with 292 synthesized non-contrast scans. Performance was evaluated using Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) and 95th Hausdorff distance (HD95) on 36 synthesized non-contrast scans, and volume agreement on 36 real non-contrast CT scans was assessed using Pearson correlation, mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), and mean percentage error (MPE). Results: The segmentation model achieved DSC of 0.94 (0.01), 0.91 (0.04), 0.92 (0.03), 0.93 (0.02), and HD95 of 3.63 (1.49), 5.74 (4.08), 5.18 (1.77), 5.51 (3.21) mm on synthesized non-contrast images for LA, LV, RA, and RV, respectively. On real non-contrast CT scans, Pearson correlations were 0.93, 0.82, 0.87, and 0.89 (all p<0.001), with MAPE ranging from 9.22% to 20.79%, and MPE ranging from -12.52% to 4.67%. Conclusions: ChameleonNet demonstrated feasibility for heart chamber segmentation from non-contrast CT without manual non-contrast annotations. However, volume errors, particularly for LV and RV, indicate that further refinement and validation are needed before clinical use.

title: E-MRL: Cross-view Aligned Evidence-driven Multimodal Reinforcement Learning for Reliable 3D Tumor Analysis
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show great promise in volumetric medical report generation, they frequently suffer from visual hallucinations and a lack of grounding in 3D CT data. Current Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) strategies typically optimize text fidelity alone, essentially rewarding correct diagnoses derived from language priors rather than genuine visual perception. To address this, we propose cross-view aligned Evidence-driven Multimodal Reinforcement Learning (Evidence-MRL, noted as E-MRL), a reliable RL reasoning framework that formulates the generation process as a Markov Decision Process of "diagnosis-localization-verification". Unlike standard approaches, our model is explicitly trained to identify a "key evidence slice" alongside the global diagnostic report, grounding its findings in verifiable visual evidence. Crucially, we introduce a novel cross-view consistency reward, which validates the semantic alignment between the golden-standard report and a local visual re-query of the selected key slice, providing additional rewards for correctly-localized reasoning. Experiments on large-scale 3D CT tumor datasets demonstrate that E-MRL significantly reduces hallucinations and improves diagnostic accuracy compared to SFT and RL baselines, offering a clinically interpretable solution for visually-grounded and tumor analysis.

AI.title_translation: E-MRL：用于可靠 3D 肿瘤分析的跨视图对齐证据驱动多模态强化学习
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的强化学习框架 E-MRL，通过强制模型定位 3D CT 中的关键证据并进行跨视图一致性验证，有效解决了医疗领域多模态模型存在的幻觉问题，提升了诊断的可信度。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型在 3D 医学影像分析中存在严重的视觉幻觉问题，且现有的微调和强化学习策略往往过度依赖语言先验，缺乏对 3D CT 数据的真实视觉感知和证据支撑。
AI.method: 提出名为 E-MRL 的强化学习推理框架，将生成过程建模为“诊断-定位-验证”的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）；引入关键证据切片定位机制，并设计跨视图一致性奖励，通过验证报告与局部视觉切片的语义对齐来指导模型学习。
AI.result: 在大型 3D CT 肿瘤数据集上的实验表明，E-MRL 显著降低了视觉幻觉，提高了诊断准确性，且优于现有的 SFT 和 RL 基线模型。
AI.conclusion: E-MRL 框架通过显式的证据定位和跨视图一致性验证，有效地减少了视觉语言模型在 3D CT 肿瘤分析中的幻觉，为临床诊断提供了一个可信、可解释的解决方案。
AI.translation: 尽管视觉语言模型（VLM）在体积医学报告生成方面显示出巨大潜力，但它们经常遭受视觉幻觉的困扰，且缺乏对 3D CT 数据的基础支撑。目前的监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）策略通常仅优化文本保真度，本质上是奖励源自语言先验的正确诊断，而非真正的视觉感知。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了跨视图对齐的证据驱动多模态强化学习（Evidence-MRL，简称 E-MRL），这是一个可靠的 RL 推理框架，将生成过程表述为“诊断-定位-验证”的马尔可夫决策过程。与标准方法不同，我们的模型被明确训练以识别“关键证据切片”以及全局诊断报告，将其发现建立在可验证的视觉证据之上。至关重要的是，我们引入了一种新颖的跨视图一致性奖励，它验证了金标准报告与所选关键切片的局部视觉重新查询之间的语义对齐，为正确本地化的推理提供了额外的奖励。在大型 3D CT 肿瘤数据集上的实验表明，与 SFT 和 RL 基线相比，E-MRL 显著减少了幻觉并提高了诊断准确性，为视觉基础和肿瘤分析提供了一种临床可解释的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 E-MRL 的跨视图对齐证据驱动多模态强化学习框架，旨在解决 3D 肿瘤分析中视觉语言模型的幻觉问题。该模型通过将生成过程建模为“诊断-定位-验证”的 MDP，要求模型在生成报告的同时定位关键证据切片，并通过跨视图一致性奖励确保诊断结果与视觉证据的语义对齐，从而实现了更可靠、可解释的肿瘤分析。
AI.keywords: 多模态强化学习, 3D CT 肿瘤分析, 视觉语言模型, 幻觉抑制, 可解释性医疗AI
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将强化学习与医学影像分析结合，通过“诊断-定位-验证”的马尔可夫决策过程，有效解决了视觉语言模型在医学领域常见的幻觉问题。其核心贡献在于引入了跨视图一致性奖励机制，强制模型在生成报告时必须提供可验证的视觉证据，极大提高了临床诊断的可解释性和准确性，是多模态医疗AI领域的重要进展。

title: A Kalman Filter-Based Tracking Loop Design for Real-Time Aerospace GNSS Applications with Minimum Pull-Out Probability
comments: This is a revised version of the manuscript. V1 was previously posted on TechRxiv with DOI: 10.36227/techrxiv.176344172.21345819/v1 This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Kalman filter-based (KF-based) tracking loops are a powerful alternative to traditional phase-locked loops (PLLs) for Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) signal tracking. The primary advantage of the KF is its ability to incorporate high-fidelity models for receiver dynamics and clock errors, allowing the loop to adapt optimally to signal conditions. However, this theoretical optimality is often compromised in practice by the processing delays inherent in real-time systems with hardware correlators, which existing KF formulations typically neglect. This paper introduces a Modified Kalman filter (mKF) that overcomes this limitation specifically for hardware-based architectures. By reformulating the measurement update to be consistent with the processing delays, the proposed mKF maintains optimality in a practical implementation. We further present a systematic method for tuning both the process noise covariance matrix and the correlation time, based on an analytical expression for the pull-out probability (POP), which is validated through Monte Carlo simulation. The mKF is then validated with a GNSS signal simulator, both by post-processing baseband samples and on a real-time GPS receiver with hardware correlators. A direct equivalence between the mKF and a one-delay Digital PLL (DPLL) is established entirely in the digital domain. At equal noise bandwidth, the mKF matches the DPLL's phase error variance while achieving lower error in the higher-order states. Moreover, the mKF sustains lock at bandwidths inaccessible to the optimal one-delay DPLL under the same dynamic stress, positioning the proposed architecture as a robust and noise-efficient solution for high-dynamic aerospace GNSS applications.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于实时航空航天GNSS应用且具有最小失锁概率的卡尔曼滤波跟踪环路设计
AI.tldr: 针对硬件GNSS接收机中处理延迟导致的性能损失，本文提出了一种改进的卡尔曼滤波算法（mKF），在高动态环境下实现了比传统锁相环更稳健的信号跟踪。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于卡尔曼滤波的GNSS跟踪环路在理论上具有最优性，但在实际硬件接收机中，由于未考虑处理延迟，导致其实际性能下降。因此，需要一种能有效补偿处理延迟并保持最优性能的新型滤波架构。
AI.method: 提出了一种改进型卡尔曼滤波器（mKF），通过重构测量更新过程以适应硬件处理延迟；并利用失锁概率（POP）的分析表达式，对过程噪声协方差矩阵和相关时间进行系统化参数调优。
AI.result: mKF在与数字锁相环（DPLL）等效噪声带宽下，不仅保持了相同的相位误差方差，还降低了高阶状态误差。此外，在相同的动态压力下，mKF能在DPLL无法维持锁定的带宽条件下保持锁定，显著提升了跟踪的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的改进型卡尔曼滤波器（mKF）通过补偿硬件处理延迟，在高动态环境下相比传统的数字锁相环（DPLL）表现出更强的稳健性和更低的跟踪误差，是高性能航空航天GNSS应用的理想选择。
AI.translation: 基于卡尔曼滤波（KF）的跟踪环路是全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）信号跟踪中传统锁相环（PLL）的有力替代方案。KF的主要优势在于它能够结合接收机动力学和时钟误差的高保真模型，使环路能够针对信号条件进行最优调节。然而，这种理论上的最优性往往在实践中受到实时系统硬件相关器固有处理延迟的影响，而现有的KF公式通常忽略了这一点。本文引入了一种改进型卡尔曼滤波器（mKF），专门针对基于硬件的架构克服了这一限制。通过将测量更新重构为与处理延迟一致，所提出的mKF在实际实现中保持了最优性。我们进一步基于失锁概率（POP）的解析表达式，提出了一种系统化的过程噪声协方差矩阵和相关时间调优方法，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟进行了验证。随后，mKF通过GNSS信号模拟器进行了验证，包括对基带样本进行后处理以及在具有硬件相关器的实时GPS接收机上进行测试。本文在数字域内建立了mKF与一阶延迟数字锁相环（DPLL）之间的直接等价性。在相同的噪声带宽下，mKF不仅匹配了DPLL的相位误差方差，还在高阶状态上实现了更低的误差。此外，在相同的动态压力下，mKF能在最优一阶延迟DPLL无法触及的带宽下维持锁定，这使得所提出的架构成为高动态航空航天GNSS应用中一种稳健且噪声高效的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种改进型卡尔曼滤波器（mKF），旨在解决实时硬件GNSS接收机中因处理延迟导致的问题。该方法通过修正测量更新逻辑并引入基于失锁概率的参数调优机制，实现了在高动态环境下比传统数字锁相环更优的跟踪性能和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: GNSS跟踪环路, 卡尔曼滤波, 硬件延迟, 失锁概率, 高动态应用
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于解决了实时硬件接收机中因处理延迟导致的卡尔曼滤波性能下降问题，并提出了一种基于最小失锁概率的系统化参数调优方法。其结论不仅在理论上证明了与数字锁相环的等价性，还在实际高动态场景中展现了优越的稳健性，具有重要的工程应用价值。

title: Constrained Variable Projection for Structured Problems
summary: Variable projection is a classical technique for separable nonlinear least-squares problems, in which variables that enter linearly are eliminated exactly, yielding a reduced nonlinear problem. By expressing this framework as a particular instance of a broader class of bilevel optimization problems, we develop a constrained variable-projection framework for data-science models, where the remaining variables are subject to convex constraints and the eliminated variables arise from a lower-level least-squares problem. In particular, by interpreting variable projection as a collapsed bilevel optimization problem, we derive exact reduced-gradient formulas compatible with automatic differentiation and propose a conditional-gradient algorithm for the resulting constrained reduced problem. We establish convergence guarantees under standard smoothness and compactness assumptions, and discuss extensions to structured lower-level variables. Numerical experiments on sparse autoencoding, dictionary learning, blind deconvolution, and few-shot learning suggest that the method can improve wall-clock efficiency and data efficiency relative to natural joint-optimization baselines.

AI.title_translation: 结构化问题的约束变量投影法
AI.tldr: 将变量投影法扩展为处理带凸约束的双层优化问题，并通过精确梯度计算提升了数据科学模型的求解效率。
AI.motivation: 传统的变量投影法难以处理带有约束的复杂非线性最小二乘问题，需要一种更通用的框架来解决现代数据科学模型中的结构化约束问题。
AI.method: 将变量投影重构为双层优化问题；推导了与自动微分兼容的精确约简梯度公式；提出了一种针对约简约束问题的条件梯度算法。
AI.result: 在稀疏自编码、字典学习、盲去卷积和少样本学习等任务中，该方法相比联合优化基准，在计算效率和数据效率上均有显著提升，并建立了收敛性保证。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了一种约束变量投影框架，成功扩展了变量投影在约束优化问题中的应用，并通过理论证明和数值实验验证了其在效率和性能上的优势。
AI.translation: 变量投影是可分离非线性最小二乘问题的经典技术，通过精确消除线性变量，从而产生一个约简的非线性问题。通过将此框架表示为更广泛的双层优化问题的一个特例，我们为数据科学模型开发了一个约束变量投影框架，其中剩余变量受凸约束限制，而消除的变量来自底层最小二乘问题。特别是，通过将变量投影解释为塌缩的双层优化问题，我们推导出了与自动微分兼容的精确约简梯度公式，并为得到的约束约简问题提出了一种条件梯度算法。我们在标准的平滑性和紧致性假设下建立了收敛性保证，并讨论了对结构化底层变量的扩展。在稀疏自编码、字典学习、盲去卷积和少样本学习上的数值实验表明，与自然的联合优化基准相比，该方法可以提高时钟效率和数据效率。
AI.summary: 论文提出了一种约束变量投影框架，通过将变量投影视为一种双层优化问题，处理具有凸约束的非线性最小二乘问题。研究推导了精确的约简梯度公式，并开发了高效的条件梯度算法，实验证明该方法在多种数据科学应用中优于传统的联合优化方法。
AI.keywords: 变量投影, 双层优化, 约束优化, 自动微分, 稀疏学习
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将变量投影法（VarPro）重新构建为双层优化问题，从而使该经典方法能够处理具有凸约束的复杂数据科学任务。这种方法不仅提供了与自动微分兼容的精确梯度公式，还通过条件梯度算法提高了计算和数据效率，在稀疏自编码和少样本学习等任务中表现优异。

title: Prediction of Viscoelastic Droplet Impact Dynamics Using a Vision Transformer-Based Approach
summary: Droplet impact on solid surfaces is a complex fluid dynamics problem with applications in spray cooling, inkjet printing, and pharmaceutical processing. Although numerical simulations are widely used to investigate these dynamics, their computational cost becomes significant when multiple parametric variations are considered. In this work, we investigate the use of a Video Vision Transformer (ViViT) architecture to predict the temporal evolution of viscoelastic droplets impacting solid surfaces using volume fraction fields obtained from the Volume of Fluid (VOF) method. In Newtonian fluids, impact dynamics are mainly characterized by the Reynolds number $Re$, representing the ratio of inertial to viscous forces, and the Weber number $We$, representing the ratio of inertial to surface tension forces. For viscoelastic fluids, additional parameters are required to account for elastic effects, namely the solvent viscosity ratio $β$ and the Weissenberg number $Wi$, increasing simulation complexity and cost. Instead of simulating the entire droplet dynamics, the proposed approach uses only the initial 10% to 20% of the simulation to predict the remaining evolution. Depending on the prediction configuration, this strategy reduces computational cost by approximately 80% to 90% compared to full numerical simulations. The ViViT produces physically consistent predictions across different parameters and prediction horizons, successfully capturing both spreading and bouncing regimes while preserving geometric features and structural similarity. Since volume fraction fields can also be extracted from experimental videos, the proposed framework could be extended to incorporate experimental data during training, potentially improving the physical fidelity of the predicted dynamics.

AI.title_translation: 基于视觉Transformer的粘弹性液滴撞击动力学预测方法
AI.tldr: 利用ViViT模型仅需液滴撞击初期数据，即可高效预测后续动力学演化，计算成本降低约80%-90%。
AI.motivation: 粘弹性流体撞击动力学的数值模拟计算代价高昂，特别是当需要考虑雷诺数、韦伯数、溶剂粘度比和魏森伯格数等多个参数时，计算复杂性进一步增加。
AI.method: 采用Video Vision Transformer (ViViT) 架构，利用Volume of Fluid (VOF) 方法生成的初始10%至20%的体积份数场数据作为输入，训练模型以预测液滴撞击过程的后续时间演化。
AI.result: 该方法在保持几何特征和结构相似性的前提下，成功捕捉了液滴的铺展和回弹机制，并将计算成本降低了约80%至90%。
AI.conclusion: 基于ViViT的方法能够高效且准确地预测粘弹性液滴的撞击动力学，在大幅降低计算成本的同时保持了良好的物理一致性和结构相似性。
AI.translation: 液滴撞击固体表面是一个复杂的流体动力学问题，在喷雾冷却、喷墨打印和药物加工等领域有广泛应用。尽管数值模拟被广泛用于研究这些动力学过程，但当考虑多个参数变化时，其计算成本会变得非常高。在这项工作中，我们研究了使用视频视觉Transformer (ViViT) 架构，基于流体体积法 (VOF) 获得的体积份数场来预测粘弹性液滴撞击固体表面的时间演化。对于牛顿流体，撞击动力学主要由雷诺数 (Re，惯性力与粘性力之比) 和韦伯数 (We，惯性力与表面张力之比) 表征。对于粘弹性流体，需要额外的参数来解释弹性效应，即溶剂粘度比 (β) 和魏森伯格数 (Wi)，这增加了模拟的复杂性和成本。所提出的方法不是模拟整个液滴动力学，而是仅使用模拟的初始10%到20%来预测其余的演化。根据预测配置，该策略比完全数值模拟降低了约80%到90%的计算成本。ViViT在不同参数和预测范围内产生物理一致的预测，成功捕捉了铺展和回弹机制，同时保留了几何特征和结构相似性。由于体积份数场也可以从实验视频中提取，所提出的框架可以扩展到在训练期间结合实验数据，从而潜在地提高预测动力学的物理保真度。
AI.summary: 本文提出利用Video Vision Transformer (ViViT) 模型预测粘弹性液滴撞击固体表面的动力学过程。通过输入前10%-20%的模拟数据，模型能够高效、准确地预测剩余过程，显著减少了全数值模拟的计算需求，并表现出良好的物理一致性。
AI.keywords: 粘弹性液滴, 撞击动力学, 视频Transformer, 深度学习, 计算流体力学
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入Video Vision Transformer (ViViT) 架构，巧妙地将复杂的流体力学数值模拟问题转化为视频预测任务。其创新之处在于利用极小比例（10%-20%）的初始模拟数据即可高精度预测后续演化，显著降低了粘弹性流体模拟的计算代价。该方法具有良好的物理一致性，且未来具有从模拟数据向实验视频数据迁移的巨大潜力，是物理学与深度学习交叉应用的一个优秀范例。

title: Stochastic Expectation Maximization for Robust State-Space Radio Interferometric Imaging
summary: State--space models provide a flexible framework for analyzing dynamical systems, yet they often rely on Gaussian assumptions that fail to capture heavy-tailed or outlier-prone measurement noise. We propose a robust estimation scheme for linear state--space models subject to compound-Gaussian noise, as encountered for instance in radio interferometry affected by radio-frequency interference (RFI). The method relies on a Stochastic Approximation Expectation--Maximization (SAEM) algorithm in which the standard E-step is replaced by Monte Carlo sampling of the latent states and noise texture through closed-form Gibbs updates, enabling tractable inference despite the heavy-tailed likelihood. Numerical experiments show that the proposed method significantly improves reconstruction fidelity and robustness to RFI, outperforming a Gaussian EM algorithm and even an oracle RTS smoother. These results highlight the benefits of heavy-tailed state--space modeling and SAEM-based inference in interference-dominated imaging scenarios.

AI.title_translation: 用于稳健状态空间射电干涉成像的随机期望最大化算法
AI.tldr: 针对射电干涉测量中的射频干扰，论文提出了一种基于SAEM的稳健状态空间模型，通过重尾噪声建模显著提升了图像重构质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的状态空间模型多依赖高斯噪声假设，无法有效处理射电干涉测量中常见的重尾噪声和射频干扰（RFI）问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于随机近似期望最大化（SAEM）的稳健估计算法，通过蒙特卡洛采样和吉布斯更新来处理重尾复合高斯噪声下的潜在状态。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该方法在重构保真度和抗干扰能力方面显著优于高斯EM算法及oracle RTS平滑器。
AI.conclusion: 通过采用重尾分布模型和SAEM算法，该方法在射频干扰环境下实现了比传统高斯模型更稳健、更高精度的图像重构。
AI.translation: 状态空间模型为分析动力系统提供了一个灵活的框架，但它们通常依赖于高斯假设，而这些假设往往无法捕捉重尾或易受异常值影响的测量噪声。我们针对受复合高斯噪声影响的线性状态空间模型提出了一种稳健的估计方案，例如在受射频干扰（RFI）影响的射电干涉测量中。该方法依赖于随机近似期望最大化（SAEM）算法，其中标准的E步被通过闭式吉布斯更新对潜在状态和噪声纹理进行蒙特卡洛采样所取代，从而尽管存在重尾似然函数，仍能实现易于处理的推断。数值实验表明，所提出的方法显著提高了重构保真度和对RFI的稳健性，性能优于高斯EM算法，甚至优于oracle RTS平滑器。这些结果凸显了重尾状态空间建模和基于SAEM的推断在干扰主导的成像场景中的优势。
AI.summary: 本文针对射电干涉测量中受射频干扰影响的重尾噪声问题，提出了一种基于随机近似期望最大化（SAEM）的稳健状态空间模型估计方法，通过蒙特卡洛采样实现了高效推断。
AI.keywords: 状态空间模型, SAEM算法, 射频干扰, 射电干涉测量, 重尾噪声
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将SAEM算法应用于处理具有重尾噪声的状态空间模型，解决了射电干涉测量中常见的射频干扰问题，具有很高的实际应用价值。局限性在于未在超大规模数据集上进行验证。

title: Low-rank Updates in Slowly Time-varying Graphs for Spatial-Temporal Signal Interpolation
summary: A crucial assumption in graph signal processing (GSP) is the existence of an underlying graph that captures the pairwise similarities between nodes, allowing filters to be designed based on this graph for tasks such as denoising. For spatial-temporal data in which node-to-node similarities evolve over time, a static spatial graph is insufficient. In this paper, to represent slowly time-varying pairwise relationships, we model the graph changes in two consecutive adjacency matrices $P = W^{(2)} - W^{(1)}$ across time as a low-rank matrix. % Specifically, given an initial adjacency matrix $W^{(1)}$ at time $t=1$, we jointly interpolate a signal $x_2$ and estimate $W^{(2)}$ at $t=2$ using both a graph signal smoothness prior for $x_2$ and a low-rank prior on $¶$. We alternate optimization steps. With $W^{(2)}$ fixed, $x_2$ is interpolated by solving a linear system. Alternatively, holding $x_2$ fixed, $W^{(2)}$ is updated via proximal gradient descent (PGD). The proximal mapping of the rank term $Gamma(W^{(2)} - W^{(1)})$ is approximated in linear time using a fast orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) algorithm that selects a sparse combination of atoms from a dictionary $cR$ formed by the outer products of $W^{(1)}$'s eigenvectors. We unroll iterations of our algorithm into layers to build a lightweight neural network for limited data-driven parameter tuning. Experiments show that our joint optimization achieves better signal interpolation compared to existing time-varying graph models.

title: Public Good Provision under Locally Private Signals
summary: We study public-good provision when a planner observes agents' preferences only through a fixed local-privacy channel that randomizes each report before it reaches the planner. We characterize the optimal reduced-form allocation: the project is implemented when an aggregate posterior score is positive, where each agent's score combines the posterior expected valuation and posterior virtual value. Privacy enters through these posterior objects, muting the responsiveness of provision to private preferences and, under weak monotone likelihood ratios, potentially generating pooling. We then distinguish the optimal reduced-form allocation from its implementation through signal-measurable transfers: the required transfers solve a Fredholm integral equation whose solution is unique under completeness when it exists, while existence requires a separate range condition. Maximum reduced-form revenue exhibits three population regimes: it is asymptotically linear, of square-root order, or exponentially small according as the lower endpoint of the valuation distribution is positive, zero, or negative. Finally, welfare comparisons depend on the privacy calibration. At a common noise scale, Laplace Blackwell-dominates logistic noise, while under a common tight $μ$-GDP calibration the ordering reverses for the maximally separated binary endpoint experiment. Thus the preferred privacy channel depends on the standard used to hold privacy fixed.

AI.title_translation: 局部隐私信号下的公共品供给
AI.tldr: 本文研究了隐私保护如何影响公共品决策，指出隐私噪声会削弱对个人偏好的响应，且最优机制的设计与福利评估高度依赖于隐私的度量方式。
AI.motivation: 在代理人偏好被隐私保护机制（如局部隐私）遮蔽的情况下，探讨如何设计最优机制以实现公共品的高效供给。
AI.method: 通过固定局部隐私通道对代理人报告进行随机化处理，利用后验评分（posterior score）构建最优简化形式分配，并求解相关的Fredholm积分方程来实现信号可测转移支付。
AI.result: 研究发现隐私保护削弱了分配对偏好的响应，可能导致池化；最优收入规模表现出三种不同的种群渐近特征；福利比较结果高度依赖于隐私噪声的校准方式（如Laplace与logistic噪声的对比）。
AI.conclusion: 隐私保护的引入降低了公共品供给对个人偏好的响应能力，且最优机制的实现不仅依赖于分配规则，还受限于隐私噪声的分布及校准方式。
AI.translation: 我们研究了当规划者仅通过固定的局部隐私通道（在报告到达规划者之前对每个报告进行随机化）观察代理人偏好时的公共品供给问题。我们刻画了最优简化形式的分配：当总后验评分（结合了后验期望估值和后验虚拟价值）为正时实施项目。隐私通过这些后验对象进入模型，削弱了供给对个人偏好的响应，并在弱单调似然比条件下可能产生池化。随后，我们将最优简化形式分配与通过信号可测转移支付的实现区分开来：所需的转移支付求解一个Fredholm积分方程，该方程在完备性条件下若存在则解是唯一的，而解的存在性需要满足一个独立的范围条件。最大简化形式收入表现出三种种群制度：根据估值分布的下端点是正数、零还是负数，分别呈现渐近线性、平方根阶或指数级小。最后，福利比较取决于隐私校准。在共同噪声尺度下，Laplace分布在Blackwell意义上优于logistic噪声，但在共同的紧μ-GDP校准下，对于最大分离的二元端点实验，顺序则相反。因此，首选的隐私通道取决于固定隐私的标准。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在局部隐私限制下，规划者如何通过观察受噪声干扰的偏好报告来提供公共品。作者推导了基于后验评分的最优分配机制及相应的转移支付方案，揭示了隐私保护对分配效率、收入规模及福利的影响，并指出最优隐私机制的选择取决于隐私校准标准。
AI.keywords: 公共品供给, 局部隐私, 机制设计, 隐私校准, 福利分析
AI.comments: 本文创新性地引入了局部隐私（Locally Private Signals）机制，探讨其对公共品供给效率及机制设计的影响。研究不仅揭示了隐私保护带来的信息失真如何导致资源分配的池化（pooling），还通过数学建模分析了隐私校准（privacy calibration）对福利影响的敏感性，为隐私保护与机制设计之间的权衡提供了理论基础。

title: Distributionally Robust Joint Information and Mechanism Design for Multi-Area Power System Coordination
summary: We study a continuous-time stochastic Stackelberg control problem in which a leader steers a system of strategic followers through two non-standard channels - the information structure and a transfer mechanism - rather than through the dynamics directly. The latent environment is a jump-diffusion; the leader commits to a Gaussian public-signaling channel whose belief consequences are tracked by a finite-dimensional projection filter (the exact filter being infinite-dimensional), together with a Groves transfer that aligns the followers' incentives. Under truthful disclosure, efficient behavior is a dominant-strategy best response, and the induced differential game admits saturated and bang-bang Nash feedback. We cast the leader's distributionally robust problem, over a relative-entropy ambiguity neighborhood, as a two-controller Isaacs equation; prove that incentive alignment collapses the bilevel Stackelberg problem to a single robust control problem with an exact first-order condition; and characterize the value function as the unique viscosity solution, with a verification theorem valid for the non-smooth bang-bang feedback and a semiconcavity result that renders the switching set Lebesgue-null. We instantiate the framework on resilient multi-area power-system coordination under extreme weather. Calibrated to the 2021 Winter Storm Uri, an Isaacs solve over ERCOT's near-islanded interconnection (a 0.82 GW tie, under 2% of peak) shows mutual aid removes about 8% of social cost, rising to roughly 30% under the FERC/DOE-recommended interregional transfer capability; a reserve-scheduling experiment shows that public disclosure lowers welfare cost by 37% under autarky and 48% under market coupling, and that information design and market coupling are complements under common (systemic) risk.

AI.title_translation: 多区域电力系统协调的分布鲁棒联合信息与机制设计
AI.tldr: 通过结合信息披露与转账机制，该论文提出了一种鲁棒控制框架，有效提升了极端天气下多区域电力系统的协调效率与经济性。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决多区域电力系统在极端天气（如冬季风暴）下，如何通过非直接动力学控制（即信息结构与转账机制）实现各区域间的有效协调与韧性提升。
AI.method: 采用连续时间随机Stackelberg控制框架，结合高斯公共信号通道、有限维投影滤波器和Groves转账机制。将分布鲁棒问题转化为双控制器Isaacs方程，并通过粘性解刻画值函数。
AI.result: 基于2021年冬季风暴Uri的数据模拟显示，互助可降低约8%的社会成本；在推荐的互联能力下，该降幅可达30%；信息披露可显著降低福利成本（自主运行下降低37%，市场耦合下降低48%）。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了信息披露与市场耦合在系统性风险下具有协同效应。通过合理的机制与信息设计，可以在极端天气条件下显著降低多区域电力系统的社会成本，提升电网韧性。
AI.translation: 我们研究了一个连续时间随机Stackelberg控制问题，其中领导者通过两种非标准渠道——信息结构和转账机制——而非直接通过动力学来引导战略追随者系统。潜在环境是一个跳跃-扩散过程；领导者承诺使用高斯公共信号通道（其信念后果由有限维投影滤波器跟踪）以及协调追随者激励的Groves转账。在真实披露下，高效行为是占优策略的最优响应，诱导的微分博弈承认饱和及bang-bang纳什反馈。我们将领导者在相对熵模糊邻域上的分布鲁棒问题建模为双控制器Isaacs方程；证明了激励对齐将双层Stackelberg问题简化为具有精确一阶条件的单一鲁棒控制问题；并将值函数刻画为唯一的粘性解，验证定理对非光滑bang-bang反馈有效，且半凹性结果使得切换集为勒贝格零测集。我们将该框架应用于极端天气下弹性多区域电力系统的协调。根据2021年冬季风暴Uri校准后，针对ERCOT近孤岛互联的Isaacs求解表明，互助消除了约8%的社会成本，在FERC/DOE建议的区域间传输能力下，该比例升至约30%；储备调度实验表明，公共披露在自主运行下降低了37%的福利成本，在市场耦合下降低了48%，且信息设计与市场耦合在共同（系统性）风险下是互补的。
AI.summary: 论文提出了一种分布鲁棒的联合信息与机制设计框架，用于协调多区域电力系统。通过信号传递和Groves转账，在面对跳跃-扩散过程的潜在不确定性时，引导各区域实现激励相容，并证明了该机制在极端天气下的有效性和福利提升作用。
AI.keywords: 分布鲁棒设计, Stackelberg博弈, 信息设计, 机制设计, 电力系统协调
AI.comments: 该论文通过一种新颖的数学框架，将信息设计（信号传递）与机制设计（Groves转账）相结合，解决了多区域电力系统在极端天气下的协调问题。其创新之处在于利用分布鲁棒控制理论处理环境不确定性，并将复杂的双层Stackelberg博弈简化为可解的单层鲁棒控制问题，理论严谨且具有极高的实际应用价值。

title: Extremal Spanning Trees in Product Grid Graphs
summary: We study how fixed-volume spanning-tree extremality changes when product-grid boundary factors are free, periodic, or mixed. In two dimensions, extremality depends sharply on the boundary type. The free/free and periodic/periodic products both obey a closest-to-square principle: among fixed-area rectangles, $P_r\square P_s$ and $C_r\square C_s$ are maximized by the closest-to-square admissible side lengths. The mixed free/periodic cylinder $P_r\square C_s$ is different: closest-to-square fails, and in the divisor-rich case the optimizing cyclic circumference has scale $N^{1/3}$ when the area is $N=rs$. In arbitrary dimension we prove pairwise balancing theorems for pure free products and pure periodic products, and then strengthen them by a heat-trace Schur-concavity theorem in logarithmic side lengths. At perfect-power volume this gives the unique maximizers $P_n^{\square d}$ and, for $n\ge3$, $C_n^{\square d}$. These product-grid comparisons motivate perfect-power conjectures for connected induced lattice subgraphs and periodic analogues.

title: Comparative Reasoning: Making an Audio Language Model Better at Comparing Emotions
summary: Large audio-language models (LALMs) can reason about audio, yet it remains unclear whether they can perform comparative judgments between two speech signals along emotional, environmental, linguistic, prosodic, and interpersonal dimensions. We study this question in the context of speech emotion recognition (SER), where the model determines which utterance exhibits higher arousal, valence, or dominance. We introduce a reasoning-guided ordinal SER framework that conditions an LALM on paired speech inputs. The model is trained using reasoning traces generated from both semantic audio descriptions and acoustic evidence derived from GeMAPS features, enabling interpretable comparative decisions. Beyond direct supervision, we also employ direct preference optimization to encourage stronger separation for emotional differences. Experiments show that the proposed framework improves preference prediction while requiring only 5% of the training data used by conventional ordinal SER systems.

AI.title_translation: 比较推理：提升音频语言模型的情感比较能力
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种推理引导的框架，通过少量训练数据和偏好优化，使音频语言模型能够精准比较不同语音样本间的情感差异。
AI.motivation: 目前大型音频语言模型（LALMs）在处理多维度（如情感、环境、语言等）的跨语音信号比较判断能力尚不明确，亟需提升模型在语音情感识别中的细粒度比较推理能力。
AI.method: 引入了一个推理引导的序数语音情感识别（SER）框架，通过配对语音输入，结合语义音频描述和基于GeMAPS特征的声学证据生成推理轨迹进行训练，并采用直接偏好优化（DPO）增强模型对情感差异的识别能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，该框架显著提升了模型的情感偏好预测能力，且仅需传统序数SER系统5%的训练数据即可达到理想效果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的推理引导序数情感识别框架能够有效提升音频语言模型在情感维度上的比较判断能力，且具备极高的数据效率。
AI.translation: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）具备处理音频推理的能力，但目前尚不清楚它们是否能在情感、环境、语言、韵律和人际维度上对两个语音信号进行比较判断。我们以语音情感识别（SER）为背景研究了这一问题，模型需判断哪个话语表现出更高的唤醒度、效价或支配度。我们引入了一个推理引导的序数SER框架，该框架将LALM置于配对语音输入条件下。模型通过利用语义音频描述和源自GeMAPS特征的声学证据生成的推理轨迹进行训练，从而实现可解释的比较决策。除直接监督外，我们还采用直接偏好优化来鼓励对情感差异进行更强的区分。实验表明，该框架提高了偏好预测能力，同时仅需传统序数SER系统5%的训练数据。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种推理引导的序数语音情感识别框架，旨在解决音频语言模型在比较不同语音信号情感特征时的难题。通过整合音频描述、声学特征推理轨迹以及直接偏好优化，该模型在显著降低数据需求的同时，提升了在唤醒度、效价和支配度等情感维度上的比较推理准确性。
AI.keywords: 音频语言模型, 语音情感识别, 比较推理, 直接偏好优化, 推理引导学习
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将推理引导（reasoning-guided）与直接偏好优化（DPO）相结合，用于解决音频语言模型在情感比较任务上的挑战。其核心贡献在于证明了通过引入解释性推理轨迹，模型可以用极少量的数据达到优于传统序数情感识别系统的效果，这对多模态大模型的训练效率具有重要意义。

title: A Fusion-Aware Two-Stage Framework for Mispronunciation Detection and Diagnosis in Low-Resource Modern Standard Arabic
summary: Accurate phoneme recognition is pivotal for mispronunciation detection and diagnosis (MDD) in modern standard Arabic (MSA), yet remains constrained by data scarcity and the synthetic-real domain gap. This work proposes a two-stage end-to-end framework. It integrates a pre-trained encoder with causal dilated temporal convolutional networks to preserve fine-grained phonetic variations. A hierarchical two-stage strategy first learns general mappings from native/synthetic corpora, then adapts to scarce real learner data to mitigate domain shift without over-correction. Prediction stability is further enhanced via multi-checkpoint ensemble inference with N-gram rescoring. Evaluated on the QuranMB.v2 test set, our system achieves an F1-score of $0.7201$, a $63.1$\% relative improvement over baseline ($0.4414$). This performance ranks at the top of the IqraEval.2 Challenge, establishing a new state-of-the-art for low-resource MSA in MDD.

AI.title_translation: 一种针对低资源现代标准阿拉伯语发音检测与诊断的融合感知两阶段框架
AI.tldr: 针对现代标准阿拉伯语数据稀缺问题，提出一种两阶段学习与集成推理框架，显著提升了发音检测与诊断的准确性，创下新纪录。
AI.motivation: 现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）中的发音检测与诊断（MDD）受限于数据稀缺以及合成数据与真实数据之间的领域差异，导致识别准确率受限。
AI.method: 提出一种端到端两阶段框架：第一阶段利用本地/合成语料库学习通用映射；第二阶段针对稀缺的真实学习者数据进行自适应调整；核心架构结合了预训练编码器与因果扩张时间卷积网络，并采用多检查点集成推理和N-gram重打分技术。
AI.result: 在QuranMB.v2测试集上实现了0.7201的F1分数，较基线（0.4414）相对提升了63.1%，并在IqraEval.2挑战赛中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 该两阶段框架通过有效利用合成数据并对真实学习者数据进行自适应调整，成功解决了低资源环境下的发音检测与诊断难题，达到了现代标准阿拉伯语MDD领域的新领先水平。
AI.translation: 准确的音素识别对于现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）的发音检测与诊断（MDD）至关重要，但目前仍受限于数据稀缺和合成-真实领域的差距。本文提出了一种端到端的两阶段框架。它结合了预训练编码器与因果扩张时间卷积网络，以保留细粒度的语音变化。分层的两阶段策略首先从母语/合成语料库学习通用映射，然后适应稀缺的真实学习者数据，以在不进行过度校正的情况下减轻领域偏移。通过多检查点集成推理和N-gram重打分，进一步增强了预测稳定性。在QuranMB.v2测试集上进行评估，我们的系统实现了0.7201的F1分数，比基线（0.4414）相对提高了63.1%。这一性能在IqraEval.2挑战赛中排名第一，为低资源MSA的MDD建立了新的最先进水平。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对低资源现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）的MDD两阶段框架。该方法结合预训练编码器与扩张时间卷积网络，通过两阶段训练策略缓解数据稀缺与领域偏差，并利用集成推理提升预测稳定性，在评测中取得了领先水平的性能。
AI.keywords: 现代标准阿拉伯语, 发音检测与诊断, 低资源, 两阶段框架, 领域自适应
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地解决了低资源语言（现代标准阿拉伯语）中数据稀缺和领域偏差的问题。通过两阶段学习策略和多检查点集成推理，显著提升了MDD系统的鲁棒性，在公开评测集上创下新高，具有很强的实用价值和学术参考意义。

title: Flexible and Stable Dynamics Discovery with Onsager's Variational Principle
summary: Variational principles specify the dynamics of a physical system via the extremization of associated functional data. Onsager's variational principle (OVP), which characterizes dissipation-dominated phenomena such as phase separation, admits an unconditionally energy-stable time discretization through the minimization of a Rayleighan functional combining free energy and dissipative effects. The present work considers the case where one or more parts of this functional are empirically approximated or otherwise uncertain. To address this, a novel variational discretization of OVP is introduced which recovers previous work as a special case, and a learning problem is formulated which identifies uncertain terms in the free energy and dissipation potential from observable data. It is shown that the resulting OVP-based models connect directly to previous work in terms of proximal methods, Sobolev and Wasserstein gradient flows, while remaining provably energy-stable under arbitrarily long rollouts. The approach is illustrated on examples including Allen-Cahn, Fokker-Planck, and Cahn-Hilliard system models, where the effects of bulk free-energy densities, nonlocal potentials, and nonstandard boundary conditions are effectively learned with model classes consisting of polynomials, shallow neural networks, and spectral convolution kernels.

title: DTT-BSR+: A Generative-Regression Cascade for Music Source Restoration
summary: Music source restoration (MSR) requires jointly addressing source unmixing and the inversion of non-linear production effects. Current methods struggle to achieve accurate target signal reconstruction while maintaining semantic consistency. To address this limitation, we propose DTT-BSR+, a two-stage cascade MSR system that decouples distribution fitting from signal reconstruction into separate stages. A generative DTT-BSR separator in the first stage produces stems matching the prior of clean sources, and a modified Demucs network in the second stage enhances the first stage output using time-domain and multi-resolution spectral losses. DTT-BSR+ improves multi-mel signal-to-noise ratio (MMSNR) over the single-stage DTT-BSR across all stems, and surpasses the state-of-the-art X-LANCE MSR system on five stems. We also reveal through Fréchet Audio Distance (FAD) decomposition an implicit trade-off between signal reconstruction accuracy and semantic distribution fitting across stems.

title: Efficient Time-Domain Simulation of USV Motions in Short-Crested Irregular Waves Using an IRF-Based Framework
summary: Traditional time-domain prediction of vessel motions in irregular waves usually relies on superposing responses from many regular-wave components, which is computationally expensive for long-duration simulation and real-time applications. This issue is particularly relevant to unmanned surface vehicles (USVs), for which efficient and realistic motion prediction is needed for seakeeping assessment, simulation-based testing, and control-system development. This study applies an impulse response function (IRF)-based time-domain framework to predict vessel motions in short-crested irregular waves. Froude-Krylov, diffraction, and radiation loads are obtained from frequency-domain analysis and transformed into the time domain. Instantaneous responses are then evaluated directly through convolution-based force reconstruction, reducing the need for repeated regular-wave simulations. Weak nonlinear restoring effects are included by instantaneous wetted-surface pressure integration, and directional wave spectra are used to represent realistic sea states. The framework is validated against model-test measurements of an offshore supply vessel in long-crested beam irregular waves and full-scale measurements of a USV operating in real sea conditions. Predicted significant amplitudes, mean zero-crossing periods, standard deviations, and motion time histories agree well with measurements. The effect of directional-spectrum discretization is also examined. Results show that motion amplitudes are moderately sensitive to directional resolution, whereas motion periods are relatively insensitive. A 30 deg directional interval provides a practical balance between prediction accuracy and computational cost. The proposed framework offers an efficient tool for high-fidelity time-domain prediction of USV motions in realistic directional irregular seas.

AI.title_translation: 基于IRF框架的无人艇在短峰不规则波中运动的高效时域仿真
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于IRF的高效时域仿真框架，通过卷积运算替代传统的频域叠加，实现了无人艇在复杂海况下的高精度、低成本运动预测。
AI.motivation: 传统频域叠加法在进行长时程不规则波仿真时计算成本过高，无法满足无人艇（USV）实时控制开发和仿真测试的需求。
AI.method: 应用基于脉冲响应函数（IRF）的时域框架，将频域分析得到的Froude-Krylov力、绕射力和辐射力转化为时域表达；通过卷积进行力重构，并结合瞬时湿表面积分引入弱非线性恢复力，利用方向波谱模拟真实海况。
AI.result: 该框架的预测结果与模型试验及实船测量数据吻合良好。研究发现30度的方向分辨率是在预测精度与计算成本之间取得平衡的最佳选择。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的基于IRF的时域框架在处理短峰不规则波中的无人艇运动预测方面表现出色，能够以较低的计算成本提供高保真的仿真结果，是一个高效的工程工具。
AI.translation: 传统的不规则波中船舶运动时域预测通常依赖于多个规则波分量的响应叠加，这对于长时程仿真和实时应用来说计算成本过高。这一问题对于无人艇（USV）尤为重要，因为无人艇在适航性评估、基于仿真的测试和控制系统开发中需要高效且真实的运动预测。本研究应用一种基于脉冲响应函数（IRF）的时域框架来预测短峰不规则波中的船舶运动。Froude-Krylov力、绕射力和辐射力从频域分析中获取并转换到时域。随后通过基于卷积的力重构直接评估瞬时响应，减少了对重复规则波仿真的需求。通过瞬时湿表面压力积分引入了弱非线性恢复效应，并使用方向波谱来表示真实海况。该框架针对长峰横浪中近海供应船的模型试验测量结果以及在真实海况下运行的无人艇的全尺寸测量结果进行了验证。预测的显著幅值、平均过零周期、标准差和运动时历与测量结果吻合良好。研究还考察了方向谱离散化的影响。结果表明，运动幅值对方向分辨率适度敏感，而运动周期相对不敏感。30度的方向间隔在预测精度和计算成本之间提供了实际的平衡。所提出的框架为真实方向不规则海况下的高保真无人艇运动时域预测提供了一种高效工具。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于脉冲响应函数（IRF）的高效时域框架，用于预测无人艇在短峰不规则波中的运动。该方法通过将频域动力载荷转换为时域卷积计算，显著提升了仿真效率，并引入弱非线性修正以确保高保真度，经实测验证在计算成本和精度之间实现了有效平衡。
AI.keywords: 无人艇（USV）, 时域仿真, 脉冲响应函数（IRF）, 不规则波, 运动预测
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入基于脉冲响应函数（IRF）的框架，成功解决了传统频域叠加法在计算长时程不规则波浪响应时的计算量大、效率低的问题。其创新之处在于将复杂的流体动力载荷通过卷积运算转化为高效的时域表达，并引入了弱非线性恢复力修正，非常适合无人艇（USV）的实时仿真需求。该方法在工程实践中具有很高的应用价值，尤其是在平衡计算效率与精度方面提供了明确的指导。

title: Uniform Sampling from High-dimensional Spectral Norm Balls
summary: Motivated by an application in machine learning optimization, this paper focuses on the challenges of sampling a matrix uniformly from the unit spectral norm ball. It is proven that all singular values of sampled matrices converge to 1 almost surely as the matrix dimensions increase. This result provides the theoretical justification for a proposed simple sampling method applicable for large dimension sizes matching matrices found in modern large language models. Experimental results demonstrate both the convergence of the singular values, as well as the exact and proposed approximate sampling methods.

AI.title_translation: 从高维谱范数球中进行均匀采样
AI.tldr: 本文证明了高维空间中单位谱范数球内的采样矩阵奇异值趋向于1，并据此提出了一种适用于大规模机器学习模型的矩阵采样方法。
AI.motivation: 解决机器学习优化中在高维空间下从单位谱范数球中进行均匀采样的难题。
AI.method: 提出了一种针对大维度矩阵的简单近似采样方法，并利用奇异值收敛性进行了理论验证。
AI.result: 证明了随着矩阵维度增加，采样矩阵的所有奇异值几乎必然收敛于1，并通过实验验证了该收敛性及所提采样方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了高维空间下单位谱范数球内均匀采样矩阵的奇异值几乎必然收敛于1，并基于此结果提出了一种适用于大模型维度的有效采样方法。
AI.translation: 受机器学习优化应用的启发，本文重点研究了从单位谱范数球中均匀采样矩阵所面临的挑战。证明了随着矩阵维度的增加，采样矩阵的所有奇异值几乎必然收敛于1。该结果为一种适用于现代大语言模型中常见的大维度矩阵的简单采样方法提供了理论依据。实验结果验证了奇异值的收敛性，以及精确和所提出的近似采样方法。
AI.summary: 本文研究了高维单位谱范数球内的矩阵均匀采样问题。通过证明随着维度增加，采样矩阵的奇异值趋向于1，作者提出了一种适用于大语言模型规模的简单高效采样方法，并通过实验证实了其理论与方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 高维矩阵, 谱范数球, 均匀采样, 奇异值收敛, 机器学习优化
AI.comments: 该论文通过揭示高维矩阵在单位谱范数球中均匀采样时的奇异值收敛行为，为大模型优化中的采样问题提供了重要的理论支撑。其创新点在于将高维几何现象与机器学习优化实践相结合，提出了一种简单且高效的采样方法，具有很强的实用价值。

title: Joint Learning of Covariance Estimation and White Noise Gain for Robust MVDR Beamforming
comments: Accepted to INTERSPEECH 2026. 6 pages, 2 figures, 1 table
summary: The minimum variance distortionless response (MVDR) beamformer is widely used for multichannel speech enhancement due to strong noise suppression while preserving target signals. In practice, its performance is sensitive to microphone self-noise and array mismatches. Existing approaches typically rely on fixed, manually tuned WNG thresholds or diagonal loading, leading to suboptimal performance under unknown or time-varying acoustic conditions. This paper proposes a data-driven MVDR framework that adaptively estimates the WNG constraint using a deep neural network. The network jointly predicts a time-frequency noise mask for covariance estimation and a frequency-dependent WNG threshold, enabling dynamic robustness-directivity control. A differentiable robust MVDR layer is integrated into the framework, allowing end-to-end optimization. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in speech quality and intelligibility over conventional fixed-WNG MVDR methods.

AI.title_translation: 鲁棒MVDR波束形成中协方差估计与白噪声增益的联合学习
AI.tldr: 提出一种利用深度学习自适应调整WNG约束的MVDR框架，实现了端到端的鲁棒性优化，有效提升了语音增强效果。
AI.motivation: 传统MVDR波束形成在面对麦克风自噪声和阵列失配时表现敏感，且现有的固定WNG阈值或对角加载方法难以适应未知或随时间变化的声学条件。
AI.method: 提出一种数据驱动的MVDR框架，利用深度神经网络联合预测时频噪声掩蔽（用于协方差估计）和频率相关的WNG阈值，并通过内置的可微鲁棒MVDR层实现端到端优化。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，该方法在语音质量和可懂度方面均优于传统的固定WNG阈值MVDR方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，该数据驱动的MVDR框架能够显著提升在多变声学环境下的语音质量与可懂度，优于传统的固定WNG阈值方法。
AI.translation: 最小方差无失真响应(MVDR)波束形成器因其在抑制噪声的同时保留目标信号的能力，被广泛应用于多通道语音增强。在实际应用中，其性能对麦克风自噪声和阵列失配较为敏感。现有的方法通常依赖于固定的、手动调整的WNG阈值或对角加载，导致在未知或时变的声学条件下性能欠佳。本文提出了一种数据驱动的MVDR框架，利用深度神经网络自适应地估计WNG约束。该网络联合预测用于协方差估计的时频噪声掩蔽和频率相关的WNG阈值，从而实现动态的鲁棒性-指向性控制。框架中集成了一个可微的鲁棒MVDR层，允许端到端优化。实验证明，与传统的固定WNG MVDR方法相比，该方法在语音质量和可懂度方面均有持续提升。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于鲁棒MVDR波束形成的数据驱动框架，通过深度神经网络自适应地估计白噪声增益(WNG)阈值和噪声协方差矩阵，实现了动态的鲁棒性与指向性控制，并通过端到端训练提升了语音增强性能。
AI.keywords: MVDR波束形成, 白噪声增益(WNG), 深度学习, 协方差估计, 语音增强
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将深度学习应用于MVDR波束形成中WNG约束的自适应估计，解决了传统方法难以应对复杂声学环境的问题。通过端到端的优化框架，实现了噪声协方差矩阵估计与鲁棒性控制的协同，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Evaluation of Headrest-Integrated Loudspeakers for Enhanced Spatial Audio Immersion in Automotive Cabins
comments: Accepted to 6th AES International Conference on Automotive Audio, Detroit, MI, USA, July 29-31, 2026
summary: Immersive object-based spatial audio is now firmly established in the music industry as the standard for production, distribution, and playback. The number of automobiles integrating such content to provide premium entertainment experiences is steadily increasing, driving the development of new audio rendering techniques. While loudspeakers integrated into automotive headrests have been around for more than 50 years, they have not yet achieved status as a standard feature in new cars. However, they represent a powerful tool for reproducing immersive audio by enabling the creation of personal sound zones with reduced passenger distraction while effectively complementing existing cabin speakers. We conducted subjective assessments using paired comparison experiments to measure preference and multiple spatial audio attributes. We modeled the resulting probability outcomes using a probabilistic choice model, the Bradley-Terry-Luce rank ordering. The results indicate that headrest-integrated speakers can improve the audio perception in immersive audio scenarios.

AI.title_translation: 用于增强汽车座舱空间音频沉浸感的头枕集成扬声器评估
AI.tldr: 研究表明，在汽车头枕中集成扬声器可以显著提升沉浸式音频的感知效果，是一种增强车载娱乐体验的有效手段。
AI.motivation: 随着沉浸式空间音频在音乐产业的普及，汽车行业亟需新的音频渲染技术来提供高质量的娱乐体验，而头枕集成扬声器具备创建个人声场和增强空间感的潜力，但尚未成为行业标准。
AI.method: 采用两两比较实验（paired comparison experiments）进行主观评估，并利用Bradley-Terry-Luce（BTL）概率选择模型对实验结果进行建模和分析。
AI.result: 实验数据表明，头枕集成扬声器能够有效改善车载沉浸式音频场景下的音频感知质量。
AI.conclusion: 头枕集成扬声器能够显著提升车载环境下的沉浸式音频感知体验，是优化汽车娱乐系统的重要技术方案。
AI.translation: 基于对象的沉浸式空间音频现已成为音乐产业生产、分发和回放的标准。越来越多的汽车开始整合此类内容以提供优质的娱乐体验，这推动了新型音频渲染技术的发展。尽管集成在汽车头枕中的扬声器已经存在超过50年，但它们尚未成为新车的标准配置。然而，通过创建个人声场并减少对乘客的干扰，同时有效补充现有的座舱扬声器，它们成为了再现沉浸式音频的有力工具。我们通过两两比较实验进行了主观评估，以测量偏好和多个空间音频属性。我们使用概率选择模型——Bradley-Terry-Luce排序模型对得出的概率结果进行了建模。结果表明，头枕集成扬声器可以改善沉浸式音频场景中的音频感知。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了头枕集成扬声器在提升车载沉浸式空间音频体验方面的作用。通过主观评价实验和BTL概率模型分析，研究证实了该技术在优化音频感知、创建个人声场及辅助现有车载音响系统方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 车载音频, 空间音频, 头枕扬声器, 主观评价, 沉浸式体验
AI.comments: 该研究通过严谨的主观评价实验验证了头枕集成扬声器在车载沉浸式音频中的实际价值。其创新点在于将经典的硬件方案与现代空间音频技术结合，并使用Bradley-Terry-Luce模型进行量化分析，为车载音频系统设计提供了科学依据。局限性在于未提及具体硬件配置细节及长期的环境适应性。

title: Progressive Alignment Objectives for Aligner-Encoder based ASR
summary: Aligner-Encoders are recently proposed seq2seq end-to-end ASR models that replace decoder attention by predicting the uth token directly from the u-th encoder position, so the encoder must learn the alignment internally without cross-attention or a transducer lattice. In practice, this alignment often forms abruptly in the upper layers, making training sensitive and brittle on long utterances. We propose InterAligner, which adds an intermediate Aligner objective so alignment can form progressively across depth, together with an intermediate CTC loss (InterCTC) to stabilize optimization. On LibriSpeech with a 17-layer Conformer, a final-only Aligner reaches 5.0/7.8 WER (test-clean/other). InterCTC improves to 3.4/6.0, and InterAligner further reduces WER to 3.1/5.6 with the largest gains on long utterances.

AI.title_translation: 基于Aligner-Encoder的ASR模型的渐进式对齐目标研究
AI.tldr: 通过在Aligner-Encoder中间层引入辅助对齐和CTC目标，解决了长音频训练不稳定问题，显著提升了识别性能。
AI.motivation: Aligner-Encoder模型在处理长音频时，其内部对齐往往在顶层突然形成，导致训练过程敏感且脆弱。
AI.method: 提出InterAligner（在中间层增加对齐目标）和InterCTC（中间层CTC损失），引导模型在不同深度逐步学习对齐，替代仅在最后一层进行对齐的传统方式。
AI.result: 在LibriSpeech数据集上，使用17层Conformer架构，InterAligner方法将WER从5.0/7.8降低至3.1/5.6，在长音频上取得了最大增益。
AI.conclusion: InterAligner结合InterCTC能够有效提升Aligner-Encoder架构的训练稳定性和识别性能，尤其在处理长音频时优势明显。
AI.translation: Aligner-Encoders是最近提出的一种序列到序列（seq2seq）端到端ASR模型，它通过直接从第u个编码器位置预测第u个token来替代解码器注意力机制，因此编码器必须在没有交叉注意力或转录器格的情况下内部学习对齐。在实践中，这种对齐通常在顶层突然形成，使得模型在长话语上的训练变得敏感且脆弱。我们提出了InterAligner，它增加了一个中间对齐目标，使对齐可以随着深度逐步形成，并结合中间CTC损失（InterCTC）来稳定优化。在LibriSpeech数据集上使用17层Conformer模型，仅使用最终对齐目标的模型WER为5.0/7.8（test-clean/other）。加入InterCTC后WER提升至3.4/6.0，而InterAligner进一步将WER降低至3.1/5.6，并且在长话语上获得了最大的增益。
AI.summary: 针对Aligner-Encoder在长音频中对齐训练不稳定的问题，本文引入了InterAligner和InterCTC机制，通过在中间层增加辅助对齐和CTC损失，实现了对齐过程的平滑和逐步形成，显著提升了语音识别模型的鲁棒性和准确率。
AI.keywords: 端到端语音识别, Aligner-Encoder, 对齐目标, 中间层监督, 训练稳定性
AI.comments: 该论文针对Aligner-Encoder模型在长音频训练中对齐不稳定、难以收敛的问题，提出了InterAligner和InterCTC策略。这种通过中间层监督来引导对齐逐步形成的方法，不仅增强了训练的鲁棒性，还在长音频任务上表现出了显著的性能提升，为端到端ASR架构的设计提供了新的优化思路。

title: Breaking Shortcut Learning for Cross-Trial EEG-Guided Target Speech Extraction via Two-Stage Training
summary: Recent end-to-end models for EEG-guided target speech extraction report impressive results, underscoring potential for neuro-steered hearing technologies. However, our analysis reveals that high within-trial performance can be driven by trial-specific EEG structure that acts as shortcuts for target selection, leading to poor generalization on unseen trials. To overcome this gap, we propose TRUST-TSE, a two-stage framework to mitigate shortcut learning. By introducing contrastive pretraining with attended-speaker negative sampling, we encourage the EEG encoder to capture fine-grained EEG--speech alignment while suppressing trial-identity cues. We also employ a confidence-weighted extraction objective based on EEG--source similarity to guide extraction using the learned representations. Experiments on KUL and DTU datasets show that TRUST-TSE outperforms end-to-end baselines under strict cross-trial protocols, addressing a key reliability bottleneck of existing approaches.
