title: A Dual Edge Spatial Jacobian Image Graph for Interpretable Diabetic Retinopathy Grading
summary: Automated diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading from colour fundus photographs can achieve strong predictive performance, but clinical interpretation requires more than an image-level label. It requires understanding how lesion evidence is distributed around retinal vessels and how this evidence relates to quantitative vascular biomarkers. We present a dual-edge spatial-Jacobian image graph for interpretable DR grading. Each fundus image is represented as a graph node with four aligned evidence streams: AutoMorph vessel information ($X_1$), DR-XAI-style lesion evidence maps ($X_2$), a 128-dimensional lesion-based contrastive image embedding ($X_3$), and AutoMorph morphometric biomarkers ($X_4$). The spatial edge branch ($X_{12}$) encodes vessel-lesion geometry, while the Jacobian branch ($X_{34}$) models embedding-biomarker sensitivity. Lightweight two-token attention fuses both edge families into a final image graph. On 2,910 matched non-augmented APTOS images, the full graph achieves 0.8076 accuracy, 0.8312 quadratic weighted kappa, 0.5915 macro-F1, and 0.9330 adjacent-grade accuracy; referable DR reaches 0.9055 accuracy and 0.9711 AUROC. The framework is positioned as an explainable representation-learning tool for lesion-biomarker hypothesis generation, rather than as a deployment-ready clinical classifier. The code is available at https://github.com/Inamullah-Colab/dual-edge-dr-graph-xai.

AI.title_translation: 用于糖尿病视网膜病变可解释分级的双边空间雅可比图像图
AI.tldr: 该研究通过构建一种融合血管几何与病变敏感性的双边空间图模型，实现了糖尿病视网膜病变的精准分级，并提供了比传统分类器更具临床洞察力的可解释分析。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动化糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）分级模型虽然预测准确，但缺乏临床可解释性，无法揭示病变分布与血管生物标志物之间的定量关系。
AI.method: 提出一种双边空间雅可比图像图（Dual Edge Spatial-Jacobian Image Graph），通过四个对齐的证据流（血管信息、病变图谱、对比图像嵌入、形态学指标）构建节点，利用空间边分支编码血管-病变几何关系，利用雅可比分支建模嵌入-生物标志物敏感性，最后通过轻量级双标记注意力机制融合各分支进行分级。
AI.result: 在2,910张APTOS图像上，该模型在DR分级中达到了0.8076的准确率、0.8312的二次加权Kappa值及0.5915的宏观F1值，在可转诊DR检测中达到了0.9055的准确率和0.9711的AUROC。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的双边空间雅可比图像图框架能够有效整合多源视网膜数据，在保持较高预测精度的同时，提供了对DR分级的可解释性，为医学影像分析中的可解释表示学习提供了新思路。
AI.translation: 通过彩色眼底照片进行自动化糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）分级可以实现强大的预测性能，但临床解释不仅仅需要图像级的标签。它需要理解病变证据如何在视网膜血管周围分布，以及这些证据如何与定量血管生物标志物相关联。我们提出了一种用于可解释DR分级的双边空间雅可比图像图。每张眼底图像被表示为一个具有四个对齐证据流的图节点：AutoMorph血管信息（X1）、DR-XAI风格的病变证据图（X2）、128维基于病变的对比图像嵌入（X3）以及AutoMorph形态学生物标志物（X4）。空间边缘分支（X12）对血管-病变几何结构进行编码，而雅可比分支（X34）对嵌入-生物标志物敏感性进行建模。轻量级的双标记注意力机制将两个边缘族融合到一个最终的图像图中。在2,910张匹配的未增强APTOS图像上，该完整图模型实现了0.8076的准确率、0.8312的二次加权Kappa值、0.5915的宏观F1值以及0.9330的相邻等级准确率；可转诊DR达到了0.9055的准确率和0.9711的AUROC。该框架被定位为一种用于病变-生物标志物假设生成的、可解释的表示学习工具，而非部署就绪的临床分类器。代码可在https://github.com/Inamullah-Colab/dual-edge-dr-graph-xai获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）分级的双边空间雅可比图像图模型。该方法将视网膜图像表示为包含血管、病变、嵌入向量和生物标志物四种证据流的图结构，通过空间和雅可比分支捕捉几何与敏感性特征，实现了兼具高预测性能与临床可解释性的DR分级。
AI.keywords: 糖尿病视网膜病变, 可解释人工智能, 图神经网络, 图像分析, 生物标志物
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种双边空间雅可比图模型，通过整合血管信息、病变图谱、对比嵌入和形态学指标，实现了对糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）分级的可解释性。其重要性在于将诊断从单纯的分类任务转向了病变与生物标志物关系的机制理解，为临床假设生成提供了有力工具，而非仅仅作为黑盒分类器使用。

title: A Conditional Timing Protection Level: Holdover-Limited Undetected Time Error Under GNSS Spoofing
comments: 8 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Calibrated on the public JammerTest 2024 dataset (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15911589). TPL primitives, CUSUM detector, and calibration example open source in the Kshana simulator (AGPL-3.0)
summary: A GNSS timing receiver under spoofing has no nominal-geometry fault for position-domain RAIM to bound: the threat is a slow, common-mode pull of served clock time that the receiver's own time-accuracy flag need not reveal. We make three graded contributions. First, a field measurement: solving the receiver clock trajectory from raw L1 pseudoranges and broadcast ephemeris, we show a recorded over-the-air spoof from the public JammerTest 2024 campaign pulled a u-blox ZED-F9P by about 1.01 ms of served time while it reported at most 51 ns, a gap near 20,000x. Second, an impossibility: against an adversary free to choose the ramp rate, no finite unconditional bound on undetected time error exists under a single self-referential clock-aided monitor, because a ramp slow enough to keep the disciplined reference in lock-step is never alarmed while the error grows without limit, so any finite guarantee is conditional. Third, the conditional bound: the Timing Protection Level (TPL), a model-free monitor's static detectability floor plus the oscillator's coast over the detection latency, holds given detection by an independent cross-satellite consistency check a coherent spoofer does not drive in lock-step. Each term is a closed form over a primitive verified in the open Kshana simulator, so the sum is reproducible by hand. Calibrated on the recorded attack, the budget is 114 ns at one-second recovery and 458 ns at a 60-second coast, thousands of times below the 1.01 ms accepted; a clock-aided sequential test alone gives essentially no protection on this slow ramp (it alarms only near the ~1 ms capture), while the model-free monitor alarms during the ramp. We are explicit: the bound is calibrated, not field-validated; carries no integrity-risk budget; and is reported as a band at long coast. The simulator, bound, and calibration example are open source under AGPL-3.0.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Calibrated on the public JammerTest 2024 dataset (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15911589). TPL primitives, CUSUM detector, and calibration example open source in the Kshana simulator (AGPL-3.0)

AI.title_translation: 一种条件定时保护水平：GNSS欺骗下的保持受限未检测时间误差
AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种量化GNSS欺骗攻击下定时误差的新方法（TPL），解决了单一监测器无法识别缓慢共模时间攻击的问题，将误差界限从毫秒级降低至纳秒级。
AI.motivation: GNSS接收机在面对欺骗攻击时，现有的基于位置域的RAIM无法有效检测到缓慢的共模时间拉动，导致接收机报告的时间精度标记失效，造成严重的未检测时间误差。
AI.method: 1. 实测分析：利用JammerTest 2024数据量化分析了u-blox ZED-F9P在欺骗攻击下的时钟轨迹；2. 理论论证：证明了在单一自引用时钟监测下，不存在有限的无条件时间误差界限；3. 模型构建：提出了基于模型无关监测器检测下限与振荡器保持特性的“定时保护水平（TPL）”计算公式。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提出的TPL在欺骗攻击下可将误差界限控制在数百纳秒级别（如1s恢复时为114ns），相比于原始攻击造成的1.01ms误差，保护效果提升了数千倍。该方法在Kshana模拟器中得到了验证，并开源了相关代码。
AI.conclusion: 在GNSS欺骗环境下，单一时钟辅助监测器无法提供无条件的误差界限。本文提出的TPL模型通过结合独立的一致性检查和振荡器保持特性，能够有效量化并约束隐蔽的定时误差，显著提升了抗欺骗能力。
AI.translation: 在GNSS欺骗攻击下，GNSS定时接收机缺乏位置域RAIM可约束的名义几何故障：其威胁在于对服务时钟时间的缓慢、共模拉动，而接收机自身的时间精度标志并不一定能揭示这一点。我们做出了三项分级贡献。首先，实测：通过从原始L1伪距和广播星历解算接收机时钟轨迹，我们展示了来自公开JammerTest 2024活动的记录空口欺骗攻击，使u-blox ZED-F9P的服务时间被拉动了约1.01毫秒，而其报告的误差最多仅51纳秒，差距接近20,000倍。第二，不可能性：对于自由选择斜坡速率的对手，在单一自引用时钟辅助监测器下，不存在关于未检测时间误差的有限无条件界限，因为足够缓慢以保持受控参考处于锁定步长的斜坡永远不会触发警报，同时误差会无限增长，因此任何有限的保证都是有条件的。第三，条件界限：定时保护水平（TPL），即模型无关监测器的静态可检测性底限加上振荡器在检测延迟期间的保持量，在通过独立跨卫星一致性检查（相干欺骗者无法驱动其进入锁定步长）检测到的前提下成立。每一项都是在开源Kshana模拟器中验证过的原语上的闭式解，因此总和可以通过手工重现。根据记录的攻击进行了校准，预算在1秒恢复时为114纳秒，在60秒保持时为458纳秒，比公认的1.01毫秒低数千倍；单独的时钟辅助顺序测试在这个慢速斜坡上几乎没有提供保护（它仅在接近~1毫秒捕获时才报警），而模型无关的监测器在斜坡期间就会报警。我们明确：该界限是经过校准的，未经现场验证；不携带完整性风险预算；并以长保持状态下的波段形式报告。模拟器、界限和校准示例在AGPL-3.0下开源。
AI.summary: 本文针对GNSS接收机在欺骗攻击下遭受缓慢共模时间拉动的问题，分析了现有监测机制的缺陷。研究证明了单一时钟辅助监测器无法提供有限的无条件定时误差界限，为此提出了一种新的“定时保护水平（TPL）”，通过结合独立的一致性检查与振荡器保持特性，实现了对隐蔽定时误差的有效约束与量化。
AI.keywords: GNSS欺骗, 定时保护水平, 时间同步, 接收机自主完好性监测, 时钟漂移
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了GNSS欺骗攻击中一个极具隐蔽性的威胁：攻击者可以通过缓慢的“共模拉动”使接收机时钟产生巨大的未检测时间误差。论文的创新在于提出了“定时保护水平（TPL）”的概念，并通过理论证明了单一时钟辅助监测器的局限性，为高精度时间同步安全提供了重要的理论框架和可验证的计算模型。

title: Metric entropy of Fourier ratio classes on ${\mathbb Z}_N$
summary:
We study metric entropy and uniform sampling for classes of signals on ${\mathbb Z}_N$ with prescribed Fourier ratio. The Fourier ratio measures how spread out the Fourier transform of a signal is, interpolating between sparse spectral support and nearly uniform spectral distribution.
  Our main result gives upper and lower bounds for the metric entropy of a Fourier-ratio layer of size $r.$ At any sufficiently small fixed covering scale, these bounds match in their dependence on $r$ and $N$ and show that $FR(f)^2$ acts as an effective dimension parameter governing the size of the class. We use the entropy estimate to obtain uniform bounds for empirical approximation over Fourier-ratio classes.
  We also establish a phase-orbit packing result. If a single signal has a flat spectral block of size $k,$ then phase perturbations of that signal generate an exponentially large family with the same Fourier ratio and positive $\ell^2$ separation.
  Together, these results show that the Fourier ratio governs not only approximation properties of individual signals, but also the geometric size and uniform sampling behavior of entire signal classes.

AI.title_translation: $\mathbb{Z}_N$ 上傅里叶比类的度量熵
AI.tldr: 本文证明了傅里叶比是衡量 $\mathbb{Z}_N$ 上信号类复杂度和采样特性的关键参数，并给出了度量熵的精确界限。
AI.motivation: 研究在 $\mathbb{Z}_N$ 上具有特定傅里叶比的信号类的度量熵和均匀采样问题，以探讨傅里叶比如何作为一种有效维度参数来度量信号的稀疏性与分布均匀性。
AI.method: 利用傅里叶比层（Fourier-ratio layer）进行度量熵上下界分析；应用熵估计推导经验近似的均匀界；构造相位扰动下的平坦谱块以实现相轨填充（phase-orbit packing）。
AI.result: 给出了傅里叶比层度量熵的匹配上下界，证明了 $FR(f)^2$ 是决定信号类大小的有效维度参数；获得了经验近似的均匀界；并证明了通过相位扰动可生成具有相同傅里叶比的大规模分离信号族。
AI.conclusion: 傅里叶比是衡量傅里叶变换分布特征的关键参数，它决定了信号类的度量熵、几何尺寸以及均匀采样性能，并能有效刻画信号空间的复杂性。
AI.translation: 我们研究了 $\mathbb{Z}_N$ 上具有指定傅里叶比的信号类的度量熵和均匀采样问题。傅里叶比衡量信号傅里叶变换的分布情况，在稀疏谱支撑和近乎均匀谱分布之间进行插值。我们的主要结果给出了大小为 $r$ 的傅里叶比层的度量熵的上下界。在任何足够小的固定覆盖尺度下，这些界限在对 $r$ 和 $N$ 的依赖性上相匹配，并表明 $FR(f)^2$ 作为控制该类大小的有效维度参数。我们利用熵估计获得了傅里叶比类上经验近似的均匀界。我们还建立了一个相轨填充结果。如果单个信号具有大小为 $k$ 的平坦谱块，则该信号的相位扰动会产生一个具有相同傅里叶比且具有正 $\ell^2$ 分离的指数级大的信号族。总之，这些结果表明，傅里叶比不仅决定了单个信号的近似属性，还决定了整个信号类的几何尺寸和均匀采样行为。
AI.summary: 本文研究了 $\mathbb{Z}_N$ 上傅里叶比受限的信号类。通过分析度量熵，证明了傅里叶比平方是刻画这些信号类几何尺寸的有效维度。研究结果不仅涵盖了经验近似的均匀界，还通过相位扰动展示了信号族的几何结构，确立了傅里叶比在度量信号类复杂度和采样行为中的核心作用。
AI.keywords: 傅里叶比, 度量熵, 均匀采样, 信号类, 有效维度
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了傅里叶比（Fourier ratio）作为刻画信号类几何复杂度和采样行为的核心参数的内在联系，为理解信号处理中的稀疏性与均匀性之间的平滑过渡提供了重要的理论基础。其局限性在于主要聚焦于理论界限，未详细讨论在具体实际应用场景中的计算复杂度。

title: Automated Residual Plot Assessment With the R Package autovi and the Shiny Application autovi.web
comments: Published in Australian & New Zealand Journal of Statistics
summary: Visual assessment of residual plots is a common approach for diagnosing linear models, but it relies on manual evaluation, which does not scale well and can lead to inconsistent decisions across analysts. The lineup protocol, which embeds the observed plot among null plots, can reduce subjectivity but requires even more human effort. In today's data-driven world, such tasks are well suited for automation. We present a new R package that uses a computer vision model to automate the evaluation of residual plots. An accompanying Shiny application is provided for ease of use. Given a sample of residuals, the model predicts a visual signal strength (VSS) and offers supporting information to help analysts assess model fit.
comment: Published in Australian & New Zealand Journal of Statistics

AI.title_translation: 使用R包autovi和Shiny应用autovi.web进行自动化残差图评估
AI.tldr: autovi利用计算机视觉自动化残差图评估，提升了统计模型诊断的客观性与效率。
AI.motivation: 传统残差图的人工评估方法存在扩展性差、分析师之间判断不一致以及“排队协议（lineup protocol）”人力成本过高等问题。
AI.method: 开发了一个R包（autovi）和一个配套的Shiny应用（autovi.web），利用计算机视觉模型对残差图进行分析，计算视觉信号强度（VSS）并提供评估辅助信息。
AI.result: 该工具能够自动化评估残差图，通过预测视觉信号强度（VSS）协助分析师判断模型拟合质量，减少了人工评估的主观性。
AI.conclusion: autovi通过计算机视觉自动化残差图评估，为统计模型诊断提供了一种客观且可扩展的解决方案。
AI.translation: 视觉评估残差图是诊断线性模型的常用方法，但它依赖于人工评估，这不仅难以扩展，还可能导致不同分析师之间的判断不一致。将观测图嵌入到空值图中的“排队协议”虽然可以降低主观性，但需要更多的人工投入。在当今数据驱动的世界中，此类任务非常适合自动化。我们提出了一个新的R包，利用计算机视觉模型来实现残差图评估的自动化，并提供了一个配套的Shiny应用以方便使用。给定一组残差，该模型会预测视觉信号强度（VSS）并提供支持信息，以帮助分析师评估模型拟合情况。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一个名为autovi的R包及配套的Shiny应用，旨在通过计算机视觉模型自动化残差图的评估过程，以解决传统人工检查方法效率低下和主观性强的问题。
AI.keywords: 残差图诊断, 计算机视觉, 线性模型, R语言包, 自动化评估
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将计算机视觉应用于统计模型诊断，解决了传统残差图人工评估效率低、主观性强的问题。其局限性在于未提及模型在复杂非线性或异常数据下的鲁棒性表现。

title: When Surveys Become Conversations: Adaptive Matrix Validation for AI-Assisted Interviews
summary: AI-assisted interviews promise to reduce respondent burden in surveys by allowing respondents to describe experiences naturally while an AI system noisily maps those accounts into structured survey variables. That mapping is a measurement process that is fallible, versioned, adaptive, and potentially behaves differently across subgroups. This paper proposes Adaptive Matrix Validation (AMV), a design in which each respondent completes an AI-assisted interview, which is then mapped into tabular data by the AI. Respondents are also asked a small, randomized set of structured questions, which are used for statistical adjustment. The estimator first calibrates the mapped values using validation answers from other respondents, then corrects the remaining error with the validation answers observed for the target respondent. The paper develops estimators for item means, subgroup estimates, and regression coefficients when outcomes, predictors, or both are mapped from interviews. It also gives planning formulas the number of validation questions required and the sample size. A design-calibration simulation, an American Time Use Survey emulation, and a CHAMPS verbal-autopsy narrative study show when sparse validation can improve precision and when it cannot

AI.title_translation: 当调查成为对话：AI辅助访谈的自适应矩阵验证
AI.tldr: 提出了一种通过少量结构化验证问题来校准AI辅助访谈数据误差的统计框架，以提升调查数据的准确性。
AI.motivation: AI辅助访谈虽然能减轻受访者负担，但AI将自然语言映射为结构化变量的过程存在不可靠、不一致及潜在的偏差问题，需要一种有效的统计校准机制来保证数据质量。
AI.method: 提出自适应矩阵验证（AMV）框架。该方法首先利用部分受访者的验证性问题答案对AI映射的数据进行校准，随后利用目标受访者自身的验证数据进一步纠正剩余误差，并开发了针对均值、子群估计及回归系数的估计量及相应的样本量规划公式。
AI.result: 通过设计校准模拟、美国时间利用调查仿真以及CHAMPS口头尸检叙事研究，验证了该方法在稀疏验证条件下能够有效改善估计精度，并明确了该方法的适用条件与局限性。
AI.conclusion: AMV方法通过结合AI映射数据与少量验证性问题，能够有效校准测量误差，在不同场景下均能通过统计调整显著提高估计的准确性和精度。
AI.translation: AI辅助访谈有望通过允许受访者自然地描述经历，同时由AI系统将这些描述映射为结构化调查变量，从而减轻受访者的负担。这种映射是一个易错的、版本化的、自适应的且可能在不同子群体中表现不同的测量过程。本文提出了自适应矩阵验证（AMV）设计，每个受访者完成AI辅助访谈，随后由AI映射为表格数据。受访者同时被要求回答一小部分随机化的结构化问题，用于统计调整。该估计器首先利用其他受访者的验证答案校准映射值，然后利用目标受访者的验证答案纠正剩余误差。本文开发了当结果、预测变量或两者均从访谈中映射时，针对项目均值、子群估计和回归系数的估计量，并给出了所需的验证问题数量和样本量的规划公式。通过设计校准模拟、美国时间利用调查仿真以及CHAMPS口头尸检叙事研究，展示了稀疏验证在何时能提高精度以及何时不能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“自适应矩阵验证”（AMV）的框架，旨在通过结合AI辅助访谈生成的非结构化数据与少量随机化结构化验证问题，解决AI映射过程中的测量误差问题，并通过统计方法对结果进行校准和纠偏。
AI.keywords: AI辅助访谈, 自适应矩阵验证, 测量误差校准, 调查方法论, 统计调整
AI.comments: 该研究针对AI辅助访谈中数据映射的不可靠性问题，提出了一种统计学上的校准方法。其创新之处在于将AI生成的非结构化数据与少量结构化验证问题结合，通过统计纠偏提高数据质量，为AI在调查研究中的应用提供了实用的方法论支撑和样本量规划依据。

title: PROTECT-90: A Fault Dataset for Power System Protection
comments: 6 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for publication at IEEE PES ISGT Europe 2026. Author accepted manuscript. Final published version will be available via IEEE Xplore
summary: The increasing interest in data-driven methods for power system protection is accompanied by a lack of standardized, publicly available high-voltage waveform datasets that enable transparent and reproducible evaluation. To address this gap, this paper introduces the PROTECT-90 dataset, an open electromagnetic transient (EMT)-simulated reference benchmark for high-voltage fault studies with consistent digital-fault-recorder-like measurements, publicly released with this work. The dataset comprises 9,022 physically consistent short-circuit simulation episodes generated on a standardized 90 kV double-line topology with systematically documented domain randomization of grid operating points, line parameters, and fault conditions. For each episode, synchronized three-phase voltage and current waveforms are recorded at eight measurement locations and released together with structured, machine-readable metadata describing fault type, fault location, inception time, and operating conditions. All modeling assumptions, parameter ranges, and data-generation procedures are explicitly documented to ensure transparency and cross-study comparability. By combining physically grounded EMT simulation, balanced scenario coverage, and open accessibility, PROTECT-90 establishes a standardized foundation for reproducible benchmarking of protection-oriented signal processing and learning-based methods.

title: Conditioning of incoherent sub-dictionaries sampled from a coherent dictionary
summary: Motivated by the desire to find a realistic and stable random model for $d$-dimensional signals, that are sparse in a transform-based and thus often coherent frame, such as a wavelet or a Gabor frame, we study the conditioning of incoherent sub-dictionaries sampled from a coherent dictionary, such as a unit norm frame. In particular, we show that if the sub-dictionary is selected via a coherence rejective Poisson sampling model, it is well-conditioned with high probability, as long as its expected size scales as $d/\log (K)$, where $K$ is the number of dictionary elements. The result is proved for the more general case of sampling quadratic sub-matrices from a real but not necessarily symmetric $K\times K$ matrix with zero diagonal, where coherence rejective sampling is defined via a symmetric mask, that acts as coherence substitute.

AI.title_translation: 从相干字典中采样非相干子字典的条件数研究
AI.tldr: 本文证明了通过特定的相干拒绝采样策略，可以从高相干字典中提取出条件数良好的子字典，为稀疏信号处理提供了稳定的模型基础。
AI.motivation: 为了解决在小波或Gabor帧等具有相干性的框架下，如何为稀疏信号寻找一种既现实又稳定的随机模型的问题。
AI.method: 提出了相干拒绝泊松采样模型，并将其推广至从一般的K×K实矩阵中采样二次子矩阵，利用对称掩码作为相干替代物进行理论证明。
AI.result: 证明了若采用相干拒绝泊松采样模型，当期望子字典大小为d/log(K)时，采样得到的子字典以高概率保持良好的条件数。
AI.conclusion: 通过相干拒绝泊松采样模型，研究证明了可以从高相干字典中提取出具有良好条件数的子字典，且其规模与信号维度及字典大小满足特定的缩放关系。
AI.translation: 出于寻找一种现实且稳定的d维信号随机模型的愿望，这些信号在变换域（如小波或Gabor帧）中往往是稀疏且相干的，我们研究了从相干字典（如单位范数帧）中采样的非相干子字典的条件数。特别地，我们证明了如果子字典是通过相干拒绝泊松采样模型选择的，那么只要其期望大小按d/log(K)缩放（其中K是字典元素的数量），它就以高概率保持良好的条件数。该结果在从具有零对角的实（但不一定对称）K×K矩阵中采样二次子矩阵的更一般情况下得到了证明，其中相干拒绝采样是通过作为相干替代物的对称掩码来定义的。
AI.summary: 本文研究了从相干字典（如小波或Gabor帧）中采样非相干子字典的条件数问题。作者提出了一种相干拒绝泊松采样模型，证明了在该模型下，当子字典规模达到d/log(K)时，其具有良好的条件数，并将其推广至一般的矩阵采样情形。
AI.keywords: 稀疏信号, 相干字典, 子字典采样, 泊松采样, 条件数
AI.comments: 该研究为从相干字典中采样非相干子字典提供了一个严谨的理论框架，对于稀疏信号处理及压缩感知领域具有重要意义。其创新点在于引入了“相干拒绝泊松采样模型”，有效地克服了直接从高相干字典中采样导致的条件数恶化问题。局限性在于该模型主要针对特定类型的矩阵结构，在复杂实际应用中的推广尚需进一步验证。

title: Obstructions for Minor-Closed Classes of limiting Densities Below 3/2
comments: An extended abstract has been presented at WG 2026
summary: Given a graph class $\mathcal{G}$, the limiting density of $\mathcal{G}$ is defined as $δ(\mathcal{G})=\lim_{n\to\infty} \mathsf{ex}(\mathcal{G},n)/n$ where $\mathsf{ex}(\mathcal{G},n)$ is the maximum number of edges of a graph in $\mathcal{G}$ on $n$ vertices. The limiting density $δ(\mathcal{G})$ is known to be a rational number when $\mathcal{G}$ is a minor-closed graph class. For every $δ\in[0,\frac{3}{2})$, we prove that the set of $\subseteq$-minimal minor-closed graph classes with densities $>δ$ is finite and we identify it completely. A consequence of our results is an algorithm that, given a finite set of graphs $\mathcal{Z}$, of total size $n$, either outputs the value of $δ(\mathsf{excl}(\mathcal{Z}))$ or reports that $δ(\mathsf{excl}(\mathcal{Z}))\geq \frac{3}{2}$, where $\mathsf{excl}(\mathcal{Z})$ is the class of graphs excluding the graphs in $\mathcal{Z}$ as minors. The algorithm runs in $2^{\mathsf{poly}(n)}$ time.
comment: An extended abstract has been presented at WG 2026

AI.title_translation: 限制密度小于3/2的次图封闭类的障碍研究
AI.tldr: 本文完全刻画了限制密度小于3/2的次图封闭类，并提供了一种在指数时间内计算禁图集合限制密度的算法。
AI.motivation: 旨在研究和刻画次图封闭类中限制密度小于3/2时的结构特征，并寻找判定给定禁图集合限制密度的方法。
AI.method: 利用结构图论方法，分析次图封闭类的限制密度性质，证明了密度小于3/2的极小类集合的有限性，并构建了相应的计算算法。
AI.result: 证明了对于任意密度δ < 3/2，密度大于δ的极小次图封闭类集合是有限的且已被完全识别；给出了一个能在2^poly(n)时间内计算禁图集合限制密度（或判定其是否≥ 3/2）的算法。
AI.conclusion: 对于所有小于3/2的密度值，确定了所有极小的次图封闭类，并证明了其集合的有限性，同时提出了一个计算给定禁图集合限制密度的算法。
AI.translation: 对于一个图类 $\mathcal{G}$，其限制密度定义为 $δ(\mathcal{G})=\lim_{n\to\infty} \mathsf{ex}(\mathcal{G},n)/n$，其中 $\mathsf{ex}(\mathcal{G},n)$ 是 $\mathcal{G}$ 中 $n$ 个顶点的图所能拥有的最大边数。已知当 $\mathcal{G}$ 为次图封闭类时，$δ(\mathcal{G})$ 为有理数。对于每个 $δ\in[0,\frac{3}{2})$，我们证明了密度 $>δ$ 的 $\subseteq$-极小次图封闭类集合是有限的，并对其进行了完全识别。我们结果的一个推论是一个算法：给定一个总大小为 $n$ 的有限图集合 $\mathcal{Z}$，该算法要么输出 $δ(\mathsf{excl}(\mathcal{Z}))$ 的值，要么报告 $δ(\mathsf{excl}(\mathcal{Z}))\geq \frac{3}{2}$，其中 $\mathsf{excl}(\mathcal{Z})$ 是排除 $\mathcal{Z}$ 中图作为次图的图类。该算法的运行时间为 $2^{\mathsf{poly}(n)}$。
AI.summary: 本文研究了次图封闭类在密度小于3/2时的性质，证明了密度大于任意给定δ < 3/2的极小次图封闭类集合是有限的，并给出了完全刻画。基于此，提出了一种在指数时间内计算禁图集合限制密度的算法。
AI.keywords: 次图封闭类, 限制密度, 极小障碍, 极值图论, 算法复杂度
AI.comments: 该研究在图论领域具有重要意义，通过刻画限制密度小于3/2的次图封闭类的极小障碍集，建立了图类密度与禁图集合之间的深刻联系，并提供了一个有效的算法，为理解图类的极端性质提供了理论工具。

title: OpenMP GPU Acceleration and Portability of TRIMEG-C1 for Electromagnetic Gyrokinetic Simulations in Tokamak Plasmas
comments: 19 pages, 11 figures, to tables, 6th Fusion HPC Workshop
summary: The Triangular mesh-based gyrokinetic code TRIMEG-C1 solves the gyrokinetic equations using the particle-in-cell scheme to simulate electromagnetic instabilities in tokamak plasmas. TRIMEG-C1 utilizes a high-order C1 finite element method, which captures the accurate physics with lower grid resolution than the C0 method. In this work, we focus on achieving a portable implementation on multiple graphics processing unit (GPU) architectures to accelerate the TRIMEG-C1 code for future physics studies. The OpenMP framework is chosen as the acceleration framework for GPU offloading on different hardware platforms, specifically, NVIDIA and AMD GPUs. The particle pushing procedure, as well as particle-to-grid operations have been adapted for GPU execution. A speedup of $\approx9$ for the particle pusher kernel is achieved on 2 AMD MI300A APUs (Accelerated Processing Unit) compared with 2 AMD 9754 CPUs. In addition, the efficiency of hybrid MPI-OpenMP offloading parallelization was assessed by oversubscribing GPU resources. The Ion Temperature Gradient (ITG) mode was simulated using the GPU implementation, and its correctness was verified by comparing the physics results in terms of the energy growth rate and the two-dimensional mode structures.

title: The effect of micro-changes in the pluck trajectory on the sound of an acoustic guitar
comments: Published in Vibrations of Physical Systems
summary: This study explores how micro-changes in the plucking trajectory of a guitar pick influence the sound of an acoustic guitar. Using a state-of-the-art robotic plucker, a series of measurements has been performed, where the plectrum was moved towards the instrument by a step of 192 micrometers, resulting in an increased attack depth. It has been analysed how the effect of these changes is reflected in loudness, timbre, harmonic content and how the sound progresses during decay. This methodology has been repeated for guitar plectra made from six different materials to investigate how the pick itself influences the effect of a change in the plucking trajectory. The results of the study show that at a low depth the string is not fully excited resulting in weak and markedly altered sound. title: Female-RHINO: A Real-Time Scanner-Integrated Framework for Automated Quantitative Uterine MRI Analysis and Structured Reporting
summary: Standardized assessment of uterine MRI remains challenging due to anatomical variability, observer dependence, and the lack of workflow-integrated automated analysis tools. This work presents Female-RHINO: (R)eproductive (H)ealth (I)maging A(N)alysis T(O)ol, a real-time AI-assisted framework for automated quantitative uterine MRI analysis and structured reporting during image acquisition. We present an end-to-end system that integrates inline communication with the MRI scanner and deep learning-based analysis to derive quantitative uterine biomarkers from sagittal T2-weighted pelvic MRI. The framework combines segmentation and anatomical landmark detection models trained and evaluated on more than 500 multi-center datasets spanning diverse protocols, vendors, and patient populations. It performs volumetry, detects and quantifies common incidental findings such as fibroids and Nabothian cysts, and extracts six anatomical landmarks for biometric assessment. Results are compiled into a structured clinician-oriented report with integrated visualizations, without manual interaction. Evaluation on independent retrospective and prospective cohorts demonstrated robust performance across varying acquisition settings. Mean Dice similarity coefficients were 0.82 for the uterus and 0.80 for fibroids, with lower but consistent agreement for Nabothian cysts. Landmark detection achieved a mean radial error of 3.7 mm. End-to-end processing was completed in under 70 seconds, enabling availability of results during the ongoing scan. Prospective deployment yielded immediate, standardized, and reproducible analyses supported by inter-observer agreement. The proposed system enables real-time scanner-integrated AI for automated uterine MRI analysis and reporting, with potential to improve standardization, efficiency, and clinical workflow in pelvic imaging.

AI.title_translation: Female-RHINO：一种用于自动化定量子宫MRI分析和结构化报告的实时扫描仪集成框架
AI.tldr: Female-RHINO是一款直接集成在MRI扫描仪中的AI系统，可在扫描过程中实时自动完成子宫MRI的定量分析与结构化报告生成，显著提升了临床影像工作流的效率和标准化水平。
AI.motivation: 子宫MRI评估目前面临解剖变异性大、依赖观察者经验以及缺乏与工作流集成的自动化分析工具等挑战。
AI.method: 开发了一个端到端的深度学习框架，集成在MRI扫描仪中；利用超过500个多中心数据集训练了子宫分割和解剖标志检测模型；系统能够自动计算体积、识别纤维瘤和Nabothian囊肿，并生成结构化报告。
AI.result: 该系统在70秒内完成处理；子宫和纤维瘤的Dice系数分别为0.82和0.80；解剖标志检测平均径向误差为3.7毫米；临床部署显示出良好的可重复性和观察者间一致性。
AI.conclusion: Female-RHINO框架成功实现了子宫MRI的实时自动化定量分析与结构化报告生成，证明了其在临床工作流中提高效率、标准化评估的潜力。
AI.translation: 子宫MRI的标准化评估由于解剖结构的变异性、观察者依赖性以及缺乏集成在工作流中的自动化分析工具而极具挑战。本研究提出了Female-RHINO（生殖健康影像分析工具），这是一个实时AI辅助框架，用于在图像采集过程中进行自动化的定量子宫MRI分析和结构化报告。我们提出了一个端到端系统，该系统集成了与MRI扫描仪的在线通信和基于深度学习的分析，从矢状面T2加权盆腔MRI中提取定量子宫生物标志物。该框架结合了在超过500个跨越不同协议、供应商和患者群体的多中心数据集上训练和评估的分割及解剖标志检测模型。它执行体积测量，检测并量化常见的偶然发现（如纤维瘤和Nabothian囊肿），并提取六个解剖标志进行生物特征评估。结果被编译成面向临床医生的结构化报告，并集成了可视化功能，无需人工交互。在独立的回顾性和前瞻性队列上的评估表明，该系统在不同的采集设置下表现稳健。子宫和纤维瘤的平均Dice相似系数分别为0.82和0.80，Nabothian囊肿的一致性较低但表现一致。标志检测的平均径向误差为3.7毫米。端到端处理在70秒内完成，使结果在扫描过程中即可获得。前瞻性部署产生了即时、标准化和可重复的分析，并得到了观察者间一致性的支持。所提出的系统实现了实时扫描仪集成的AI，用于自动化的子宫MRI分析和报告，具有提高盆腔成像标准化、效率和临床工作流的潜力。
AI.summary: Female-RHINO是一个集成于MRI扫描仪的实时AI框架，通过深度学习实现子宫MRI的自动化定量分析、病变检测及结构化报告生成，旨在提升临床评估的标准化与效率。
AI.keywords: 子宫MRI, 人工智能, 实时扫描, 定量分析, 结构化报告
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将AI分析工具直接集成到MRI扫描流程中，实现了端到端的自动化分析与结构化报告生成。其优势在于显著提高了临床工作效率和报告的标准化程度，但对于较小或形态复杂的病变（如Nabothian囊肿）的识别准确性仍有提升空间。

title: An Agnostic Machine Learning Model of Photosynthetic Habitability
comments: 17 pages main body, 5 figures. Submitted to MNRAS
summary: The search for exoplanet biosignatures is guided by whether planetary environments can sustain photosynthesis. As such, the Photosynthetic Habitable Zone (PHZ) was recently proposed, as the overlap between the canonical habitable zone and the orbital range where stellar irradiance is sufficient to drive photosynthesis. Existing PHZ estimates rely on empirical light-response curves from Earth phytoplankton, and thus include implicit Earth-centric biases. We introduce an agnostic PHZ derived from a generalized model of photosynthesis grounded in thermodynamics and redox chemistry, without reference to model organisms. The model is built on a generic photochemical reaction in which photon capture couples oxidation of a donor molecule to the reduction of CO2. The optical properties and CO2 reduction rate are optimized against irradiance spectra for exoplanets orbiting main-sequence stars, using a genetic algorithm that mimics evolution by natural selection. Our simulations predict that photosynthetic organisms compensate for reduced flux by evolving larger light-harvesting structures. As a result, photosynthetic viability declines only linearly with orbital distance, despite stellar flux falling off quadratically. As such, the agnostic PHZ expands well beyond previous Earth-based estimates. Earth-like (visible light) oxygenic photosynthesis is flux-limited at the outer habitable zone for cool M-dwarf stars; however, both anoxygenic photosynthesis and a hypothetical, NIR-driven oxygenic photosynthesis are viable across the entire habitable zone for M, K, and G stars. This implies that M-dwarf exoplanets could sustain robust oxygenic photosynthesis, though it would be different to that found on Earth, presenting reflectance biosignatures in the NIR band rather than the visible.

AI.title_translation: 一种光合作用宜居性的不可知机器学习模型
AI.tldr: 通过摆脱地球生物的限制，研究发现光合作用在宇宙中比预想的更普遍，尤其是在M型矮星的近红外波段，这为寻找系外生命提供了新的线索。
AI.motivation: 现有的光合作用宜居带（PHZ）估算主要依赖于地球浮游生物的经验数据，存在严重的地球中心偏见，无法准确评估不同环境下的光合作用潜力。
AI.method: 基于热力学和氧化还原化学构建通用光合作用模型；利用遗传算法模拟自然选择，优化光捕获和CO2还原速率；针对不同主序星的光谱进行模拟仿真。
AI.result: 模型显示光合作用活力随轨道距离的增加呈线性而非二次方下降；M、K、G型恒星的宜居带内普遍存在光合作用的可能性，尤其是M型矮星的近红外波段具有显著的生物特征潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，光合作用的宜居范围远比基于地球生物估算的更广，特别是对于M型矮星系，NIR（近红外）驱动的光合作用可能使其整个宜居带都具备光合作用潜力，这为未来的系外行星搜寻提供了新的生物特征搜索方向。
AI.translation: 搜寻系外行星生物特征的指导原则是行星环境能否维持光合作用。因此，近期提出了“光合作用宜居带”（PHZ）的概念，即经典宜居带与足以驱动光合作用的恒星辐照度轨道范围之间的重叠区域。现有的PHZ估算依赖于地球浮游生物的经验光响应曲线，因此包含了隐含的地球中心偏见。我们引入了一种不可知的PHZ，它源于一个基于热力学和氧化还原化学的广义光合作用模型，而不参考任何模型生物。该模型建立在一个通用的光化学反应之上，即光子捕获将供体分子的氧化与CO2的还原耦合起来。利用模拟自然选择的遗传算法，针对主序星轨道上的系外行星的辐照光谱，对光学性质和CO2还原速率进行了优化。我们的模拟预测，光合作用生物通过进化出更大的光捕获结构来补偿光通量的减少。因此，尽管恒星通量呈二次方下降，但光合作用的活力随轨道距离的增加仅呈线性下降。因此，不可知的PHZ远远超出了以往基于地球的估算。类地（可见光）产氧光合作用在冷M型矮星的宜居带外缘受到通量限制；然而，非产氧光合作用和假设的NIR（近红外）驱动的产氧光合作用在M、K和G型恒星的整个宜居带内都是可行的。这意味着M型矮星系外行星可以维持强大的产氧光合作用，尽管它与地球上的不同，其反射生物特征将出现在NIR波段而非可见光波段。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种不依赖特定生物模型的通用光合作用宜居带（PHZ）评估方法。通过结合热力学、氧化还原化学和遗传算法，研究发现光合作用对恒星光通量的适应性比预想更强。结果表明，光合作用的宜居范围远超传统估算，且M型矮星系的行星在近红外波段可能存在独特的生物特征。
AI.keywords: 光合作用宜居带, 系外行星, 生物特征, 热力学, M型矮星
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于打破了以地球生物为中心的偏见，通过热力学和氧化还原化学构建了一个通用的光合作用模型。这一研究对于扩大系外行星生命搜索范围具有重要意义，特别是为M型矮星系外行星的宜居性提供了新的理论视角。局限性在于该模型基于理想化的假设，且目前缺乏实验观测验证。

title: Adaptive Machine Learning Framework for UAV Trajectory Optimization in O-RAN
comments: 16 pages, 12 figures, IEEE Transactions on Vehicular Technology
summary: The deployment of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) as open radio units (O-RUs) in 6G cellular systems presents a promising opportunity to achieve scalable and adaptive network coverage. However, optimizing UAV trajectories in dynamic and unfamiliar environments remains a critical challenge, particularly due to the need for extensive retraining in each new scenario. In this paper, we introduce a novel UAV trajectory optimization framework that integrates enhanced continual transfer learning within the O-RAN architecture. The proposed system maintains a library of pre-trained models and employs a model selection mechanism to identify and transfer knowledge from the most relevant environments, minimizing adaptation time and improving efficiency. When no sufficiently similar model is available, a fallback model empowered by continuous refinements ensures baseline performance. The framework leverages real-world city maps and ray tracing techniques to enhance learning reliability and improve trajectory planning. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed model selection-based transfer learning approach reduces convergence time by 44% to 56% compared to retraining from scratch, and up to 40% compared to traditional transfer learning without model selection.
comment: 16 pages, 12 figures, IEEE Transactions on Vehicular Technology

title: Trade-off invariance for weighted scalarizations in multi-objective optimization
summary: We consider weighted-sum scalarizations for an abstract multi-objective minimization problem defined by the vector-valued map $U\ni u\mapsto ( f_1(u),\ldots, f_N(u))$, where $U$ is an arbitrary nonempty set and no topology, convexity, compactness, or lower semicontinuity assumption is imposed. Using the open simplex as parameter space for positive weights, we show that the Trade-off Invariance Principle for scalarizations yields a generic uniqueness property in the objective space. Namely, for almost every weight vector, all minimizers of the corresponding weighted-sum scalarization have the same objective vector. Moreover, excluding again a null-measure subset, all minimizing sequences determine the same limiting objective vector, independently of the chosen sequence. We also give a geometric interpretation of these results in the attainable objective set: for almost every positive weight vector, the scalarization exposes at most one nondominated point. Moreover, minimizing sequences determine at most one asymptotically exposed objective vector in the closure of the attainable set.

title: An Erdős Matching Conjecture for Vector Spaces
summary: We study a vector-space analogue of the Erdős Matching Conjecture. Let $m_q(n,k,s)$ denote the maximum cardinality of a family of $k$-dimensional subspaces of an $n$-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb F_q$ with no $s+1$ members whose sum is direct. Two natural constructions provide lower bounds. The first consists of all $k$-subspaces contained in a fixed $((s+1)k-1)$-dimensional subspace; the second consists of all $k$-subspaces that intersect a fixed $s$-dimensional subspace nontrivially. These constructions motivate the following vector-space analogue of the Erdős Matching Conjecture: for all $n\ge (s+1)k$, $$m_q(n,k,s)=\max\left\{\genfrac{[}{]}{0pt}{}{(s+1)k-1}{k}_q,~\genfrac{[}{]}{0pt}{}{n}{k}_q-q^{ks}\genfrac{[}{]}{0pt}{}{n-s}{k}_q\right\}.$$ We prove this conjecture when $k=2$, when $n=(s+1)k$, and when $n$ is sufficiently large. In particular, the case $k=2$ may be viewed as a vector-space analogue of the Erdős--Gallai theorem. In the large-$n$ range, we also prove a Hilton--Milner-type stability theorem, determining the largest nontrivial families with this property. Finally, we connect this problem with $t$-cover-free families in vector spaces and determine their extremal number up to a lower-order term, extending a recent result of Shan and Zhou for the special case $t=2$. The proofs combine Lovász's minimax theorem for matroid matchings, a high-dimensional Hoffman bound for uniform hypergraphs, and packing-design arguments in vector spaces.

title: Infinitesimal Causality
summary: This paper introduces a categorical account of infinitesimal causality in Frobenius Markov categories equipped with tangent-bundle semantics. IDC captures the infinitesimal layer in which interventions act as tangent deformations of copy/discard structure. Two distinct Frobenius structures interact: (1) the categorical Frobenius algebra on classical variables encoding copying, comparing, and discarding; and (2) the geometric Frobenius integrability condition, namely involutive closure of the intervention distribution, distinct from the algebraic Frobenius structure. Categorical causal sufficiency is defined as the compatibility of these two notions. A key observation is that, for structural causal models, infinitesimal causality is most naturally formulated in the slice of deterministic mechanisms over exogenous variables, with visible stochastic kernels obtained only after pushforward. Interventions are tangent vectors that deform the Frobenius copy/discard operations; their Lie brackets measure whether this deformation preserves classical information-flow structure. Pearl's do-calculus is used as a guiding example of intervention identities: ignoring irrelevant interventions corresponds to counit invariance, action/observation exchange to coproduct compatibility with pushforward, and independence to involutive bracket closure of the visible intervention distribution.

title: An eigenvalue proof of Hegedüs's bound for codes with a single Hamming distance
summary: We give a short, self-contained linear-algebra proof of a bound of Hegedüs [Australasian Journal of Combinatorics, 2026; arXiv:2409.07877]: if all pairwise Hamming distances in a family of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ equal a fixed value $λ\ne(n+1)/2$, then the family has at most $n$ members. Our proof uses the same Gram matrix as in Hegedüs's argument, but reads its eigenvalues in place of its determinant, and keys off of a single fact about vectors of equal norm and equal pairwise inner product. That fact applies verbatim over an alphabet of size $q$, where it yields the bound $n(q-1)$ for $λ\ne\bigl((q-1)n+1\bigr)/q$ -- the corrected form of a conjecture of Hegedüs, recently established by Hu, Huang, and Yu [arXiv:2504.07036].

title: Parallel Dynamic Programming for Conic Linear Quadratic Control
comments: This paper was accepted for presentation at the IFAC World Congress 2026 (IFAC WC 2026)
summary: Linear Quadratic (LQ) control problems are at the heart of linear control theory and Model Predictive Control (MPC). While performant, standard approaches to solving such problems are inherently serial, limiting real-time scalability despite the parallel computing power available on modern multi-core CPUs. Contributing to addressing this challenge and motivated by ``divide and conquer'' strategies, we present a parallel-in-time approach that solves computationally demanding conic optimal control problems through the use of the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM). In particular, we formulate the inner primal update of ADMM as an LQ problem and split the reformulated problem along the time horizon. This enables us to derive a variant of the Riccati recursion using dynamic programming to solve each subproblem in parallel. Numerical benchmarks on two real-world applications demonstrate as much as a 5x speedup compared to existing related approaches on multi-core CPU hardware.

AI.title_translation: 用于圆锥线性二次型控制的并行动态规划
AI.tldr: 通过将线性二次型控制问题分解为并行子问题，利用ADMM算法在多核CPU上实现了5倍的计算提速。
AI.motivation: 传统的线性二次型控制问题求解方法本质上是串行的，无法充分利用现代多核CPU的并行计算能力，限制了其在实时控制场景下的扩展性。
AI.method: 采用“分而治之”策略，通过交替方向乘子法（ADMM）将圆锥最优控制问题转化为内层原始更新问题，并沿时间维度对问题进行分割，利用动态规划推导出的Riccati递归变体实现各子问题的并行求解。
AI.result: 在真实世界的应用基准测试中，该方法在多核CPU硬件上实现了最高5倍的加速效果。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的并行动态规划方法通过时间域分解，成功实现了圆锥线性二次型控制问题的并行化求解，显著提升了计算效率。
AI.translation: 线性二次型（LQ）控制问题是线性控制理论和模型预测控制（MPC）的核心。尽管性能良好，但解决此类问题的标准方法本质上是串行的，这限制了其实时可扩展性，尽管现代多核CPU提供了强大的并行计算能力。为了应对这一挑战，并受“分而治之”策略的启发，我们提出了一种时间并行方法，通过交替方向乘子法（ADMM）解决计算需求高的圆锥最优控制问题。特别是，我们将ADMM的内层原始更新公式化为一个LQ问题，并沿时间维度分割重构后的问题。这使我们能够推导出一个使用动态规划的Riccati递归变体，从而并行解决每个子问题。在两个实际应用上的数值基准测试表明，与现有的相关方法相比，在多核CPU硬件上实现了高达5倍的加速。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对圆锥线性二次型控制问题的并行时间域求解方法。通过将ADMM算法与动态规划相结合，将复杂的控制问题分解为多个可并行处理的子问题，从而在多核处理器上大幅提升了求解速度。
AI.keywords: 线性二次型控制, 模型预测控制, 并行计算, ADMM, 动态规划
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将传统串行的线性二次型控制问题通过ADMM算法转化为可并行计算的子问题，有效利用了现代多核CPU的计算能力。其局限性在于该方法主要针对圆锥优化控制问题，且未在极大规模或非线性更强的场景下进行验证。

title: Suboptimal and Reduced-Order MPC via Timescale Separation
summary: In this paper, we propose a generalized framework for the design and analysis of suboptimal and reduced-order nonlinear Model Predictive Control (MPC) architectures. The proposed framework manages real-time operation of MPC schemes by (i) computing the control action suboptimally, i.e., by running a generic optimal control algorithm for a finite number of iterations, and (ii) relying on a reduced-order model that neglects part of the plant dynamics (accounting for, e.g., unmodeled dynamics or a low-level compensator). To rigorously handle the interplay between optimization error and model mismatch, we treat the sampling time as a tunable design parameter. We analyze the resulting closed-loop system, comprising the full-order physical plant interconnected with the iterative optimization algorithm (treated as a dynamical system), by leveraging tools from timescale separation. We prove that operating at a sufficiently fast sampling rate ensures that the closed-loop system maintains recursive feasibility and achieves an exponentially stable equilibrium point. The effectiveness of the proposed framework is validated on an underactuated two-link robotic arm through virtual experiments in the high-fidelity MuJoCo physics engine.

AI.title_translation: 基于时间尺度分离的次优与降阶模型预测控制
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于设计和分析次优和降阶非线性模型预测控制（MPC）架构的通用框架。该框架通过次优计算控制动作和依赖降阶模型来管理MPC方案的实时操作。通过将采样时间视为可调设计参数，并利用时间尺度分离工具，证明了足够快的采样率可以确保闭环系统保持递归可行性并实现指数稳定的平衡点。该框架在欠驱动两连杆机械臂上得到了验证。
AI.motivation: 该论文的动机是管理模型预测控制（MPC）方案的实时操作，通过解决计算控制动作的次优性问题和依赖于忽略部分系统动力学的降阶模型，以应对优化误差和模型不匹配之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种通用的次优和降阶非线性模型预测控制（MPC）架构设计与分析框架。该方法通过以下方式管理MPC的实时操作：(i) 次优计算控制动作，即运行通用最优控制算法有限次迭代；(ii) 依赖于忽略部分系统动力学（例如，未建模动力学或低级补偿器）的降阶模型。为了严格处理优化误差和模型不匹配之间的相互作用，将采样时间视为可调设计参数。通过利用时间尺度分离工具，分析了由全阶物理设备与迭代优化算法（视为动力系统）组成的闭环系统。
AI.result: 结果表明，在足够快的采样率下运行可以确保闭环系统保持递归可行性并实现指数稳定的平衡点。所提出框架的有效性在欠驱动两连杆机械臂上通过高保真MuJoCo物理引擎中的虚拟实验得到了验证。
AI.conclusion: 本文的结论是，所提出的次优和降阶非线性模型预测控制框架，通过结合次优计算和降阶模型，并在足够快的采样率下运行，能够确保闭环系统保持递归可行性并实现指数稳定的平衡点。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们提出了一种用于设计和分析次优和降阶非线性模型预测控制（MPC）架构的通用框架。所提出的框架通过以下方式管理MPC方案的实时操作：(i) 次优计算控制动作，即运行通用最优控制算法有限次迭代；(ii) 依赖于忽略部分系统动力学（例如，未建模动力学或低级补偿器）的降阶模型。为了严格处理优化误差和模型不匹配之间的相互作用，我们将采样时间视为可调设计参数。我们通过利用时间尺度分离工具，分析了由此产生的闭环系统，该系统包括与迭代优化算法（被视为一个动力系统）互连的全阶物理设备。我们证明了在足够快的采样率下运行可以确保闭环系统保持递归可行性并实现指数稳定的平衡点。所提出框架的有效性在欠驱动两连杆机械臂上通过高保真MuJoCo物理引擎中的虚拟实验得到了验证。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种通用的次优和降阶非线性模型预测控制（MPC）框架。该框架通过有限次迭代的次优控制动作计算和使用降阶模型来处理MPC的实时操作，以应对优化误差和模型失配。通过将采样时间作为可调参数并应用时间尺度分离工具，研究证明了足够快的采样率能使闭环系统保持递归可行性并达到指数稳定平衡点。该方法已在两连杆机械臂的虚拟实验中得到验证。
AI.keywords: 模型预测控制, 次优控制, 降阶模型, 时间尺度分离, 实时控制
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入时间尺度分离来系统地处理MPC中的次优性和模型降阶问题，这在理论上具有创新性。它提供了一种严谨的方法来分析优化误差和模型不匹配对闭环系统稳定性和可行性的影响，并通过采样时间作为设计参数来调控，为实时MPC的实现提供了坚实的理论基础和实用指导。

title: Extended pseudo-spectral physics-informed neural networks for phase-field models
summary: Phase-field models play a central role in the continuum description of phase separation, in which the bulk free-energy density and the interfacial thickness parameter determine pattern formation and microstructural evolution. In practice, these constitutive quantities are rarely known a priori and must be inferred from limited dynamical observations. In this work, an extended pseudo-spectral physics-informed neural network (ESPINN) framework is developed for the inverse identification of phase-field models from transient snapshot data. It enables the simultaneous recovery of both the bulk chemical potential and unknown gradient coefficients. Numerical experiments on the one-dimensional Cahn-Hilliard equation demonstrate accurate and statistically stable reconstruction in the noiseless regime, with substantial constitutive information recoverable from even a single snapshot pair. In the presence of noise, reconstruction accuracy degrades gracefully, and increasing the number of snapshots improves robustness by reducing variance across runs. These results establish ESPINN as a data-efficient and physically consistent approach for learning free-energy structure in continuum models of phase separation.

AI.title_translation: 用于相场模型的扩展伪谱物理信息神经网络
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种ESPINN框架，能利用少量观测数据准确反演相场模型中的未知本构参数，具有高数据效率和物理一致性。
AI.motivation: 相场模型中的体自由能密度和界面厚度参数通常难以预先确定，需要从有限的动力学观测数据中进行反演，传统的参数识别方法在处理复杂微观结构演化时存在局限。
AI.method: 开发了扩展伪谱物理信息神经网络（ESPINN）框架，通过整合伪谱方法与物理约束神经网络，利用瞬态快照数据同时反演体化学势和梯度系数。
AI.result: 在Cahn-Hilliard方程的数值实验中，ESPINN在无噪声环境下实现了高精度的参数重构，且仅需单对快照即可恢复关键信息；在噪声环境下表现出良好的鲁棒性，增加快照数量可有效降低重构方差。
AI.conclusion: ESPINN框架为从瞬态观测数据中反演相场模型提供了一种高效且鲁棒的方法，能够准确重构自由能结构和梯度系数。
AI.translation: 相场模型在相分离的连续介质描述中起着核心作用，其中体自由能密度和界面厚度参数决定了图案形成和微观结构演化。在实践中，这些本构量很少能先验已知，必须从有限的动力学观测中推断出来。在这项工作中，开发了一种扩展伪谱物理信息神经网络（ESPINN）框架，用于从瞬态快照数据中反演识别相场模型。它能够同时恢复体化学势和未知的梯度系数。对一维Cahn-Hilliard方程的数值实验表明，在无噪声情况下，该方法实现了准确且统计稳定的重构，甚至仅从单个快照对中就能恢复大量的本构信息。在存在噪声的情况下，重构精度会适度下降，而增加快照数量通过减少运行间的方差提高了鲁棒性。这些结果确立了ESPINN作为一种用于学习相分离连续介质模型中自由能结构的数据高效且物理一致的方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种扩展伪谱物理信息神经网络（ESPINN），旨在从有限的瞬态快照数据中反演相场模型的关键参数，包括体化学势和梯度系数，并验证了该方法在Cahn-Hilliard方程中的准确性和抗噪能力。
AI.keywords: 物理信息神经网络, 相场模型, 反演问题, Cahn-Hilliard方程, 数据驱动建模
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的ESPINN框架，有效地解决了相场模型中本构参数的反演问题。其优势在于数据效率高且物理一致性强，能够仅利用少量快照数据恢复复杂的自由能结构，是物理信息神经网络（PINN）在材料科学领域应用的一个重要进展。

title: A Physics-Informed Fourier-Wavelet Transformer for Multiscale Computational Fluid Dynamics Surrogate Modeling
summary: Physics-informed surrogate models can accelerate computational fluid dynamics simulations. However, many existing methods reproduce global flow patterns more reliably than localized multiscale structures. This study presents a physics-informed Fourier-wavelet transformer for next-step velocity-field reconstruction in real-world flow benchmarks. The proposed formulation combines hybrid Fourier-wavelet spectral encoding with physics-biased self-attention based on partial differential equation residual diagnostics. It also uses self-supervised pretraining through Masked Physics Prediction and Equation Consistency Prediction. The experiments are conducted on two real benchmark cases: cylinder-wake flow and fluid-structure interaction. All approaches are evaluated under a shared local protocol and compared with spectral, transformer-based, operator-learning, and physics-informed neural-network baselines. On the cylinder-wake benchmark, the proposed model achieves the best aggregate accuracy, with an all-channel normalized mean-squared error of 0.05875 and an all-channel Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.97019. On the fluid-structure-interaction benchmark, it gives the lowest all-channel normalized mean-squared error of $2.70 \times 10^{-4}$, compared with $4.02 \times 10^{-4}$ for the strongest baseline. Component-wise field comparisons and scale-separated diagnostics further show stronger recovery of localized wake structures, including near-body, wake-core, and far-wake features. The results demonstrate improved real-world flow reconstruction while maintaining a practical accuracy-cost tradeoff.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于多尺度计算流体动力学替代建模的物理信息傅里叶-小波变换器
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合傅里叶和小波变换的物理信息Transformer模型，有效提升了计算流体动力学中局部多尺度流场结构的重构精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的物理信息替代模型虽然能较好地重构全局流场，但在捕捉局部多尺度流体结构方面存在不足，难以满足高精度计算流体动力学模拟的需求。
AI.method: 提出了一个物理信息傅里叶-小波变换器，结合了混合傅里叶-小波谱编码、基于偏微分方程残差诊断的物理偏置自注意力机制，以及通过掩码物理预测和方程一致性预测进行的自监督预训练。
AI.result: 在圆柱绕流和流固耦合两个基准测试中，该模型均取得了最佳的聚合精度。在圆柱绕流中，归一化均方误差达到0.05875；在流固耦合中，误差降至2.70 × 10^-4，显著优于现有的对比模型，并能更准确地恢复局部尾迹结构。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的物理信息傅里叶-小波变换器在处理多尺度流体动力学问题上表现优异，在保证计算效率的同时，显著提升了对复杂局部流场结构的重构精度，为计算流体动力学的替代模型构建提供了强有力的新框架。
AI.translation: 物理信息替代模型可以加速计算流体动力学模拟。然而，许多现有方法在重现全局流动模式方面比重现局部多尺度结构更为可靠。本研究提出了一种用于现实流动基准测试中下一时刻速度场重构的物理信息傅里叶-小波变换器。所提出的公式结合了混合傅里叶-小波谱编码与基于偏微分方程残差诊断的物理偏置自注意力机制。它还通过掩码物理预测和方程一致性预测使用了自监督预训练。实验在圆柱绕流和流固耦合两个现实基准案例上进行。所有方法都在共享的本地协议下进行评估，并与谱方法、基于Transformer的方法、算子学习和物理信息神经网络基线进行了比较。在圆柱绕流基准测试中，该模型实现了最佳的聚合精度，全通道归一化均方误差为0.05875，全通道皮尔逊相关系数为0.97019。在流固耦合基准测试中，其全通道归一化均方误差为2.70 × 10^-4，而最强基线为4.02 × 10^-4。组件级场比较和尺度分离诊断进一步表明，该模型对局部尾迹结构（包括近体、尾流核心和远尾流特征）的恢复能力更强。结果证明，该方法在保持实际精度-成本权衡的同时，改进了现实世界的流动重构。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于计算流体动力学替代建模的物理信息傅里叶-小波变换器。该模型通过融合小波分析的局部特征捕获能力与傅里叶变换的全局建模优势，并结合物理约束的自注意力机制和自监督预训练，显著提高了对复杂多尺度流场（如圆柱绕流和流固耦合）的重构精度。
AI.keywords: 物理信息神经网络, 傅里叶-小波变换, 计算流体动力学, 多尺度建模, 替代模型
AI.comments: 该研究通过结合傅里叶变换（处理全局特征）和小波变换（处理局部多尺度结构）的优势，成功解决了传统物理信息神经网络在捕捉流体动力学局部细节方面的不足。其引入的物理偏置自注意力机制和自监督预训练策略是显著的创新点，具有很高的实际应用价值。

title: Scheduling jobs with unknown size distribution in a M/G/1 queue: the shifted empirical Gittins
summary: In this paper we consider a M/G/1 queue for which we want to minimize the expected response time. We show how to compute indices from $n$ samples of the job size distribution such that the corresponding index policy is asymptotically optimal as $n$ grows. This construction is based on a discretization of the bounded support of the job size distribution and a shift of the samples to their nearest discrete point to the right. We show that the Gittins index of the empirical distribution of these shifted samples is close to the Gittins index of the original distribution. This translates to the asymptotic optimality of the corresponding index policy for minimizing the expected response time. Numerical comparison with other approaches further confirm the efficiency of our approach.

AI.title_translation: M/G/1队列中未知大小分布作业的调度：移位经验Gittins索引
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用有限样本估计Gittins索引的方法，实现了在作业大小分布未知的情况下，M/G/1队列调度响应时间最小化的渐近最优。
AI.motivation: 在M/G/1队列中，当作业大小分布未知时，如何通过有限的样本信息设计出能够最小化期望响应时间的调度策略。
AI.method: 基于作业大小分布的有界支持进行离散化，将样本点向右移位至最近的离散点，并计算这些移位后样本的经验Gittins索引，以此作为调度依据。
AI.result: 证明了该策略产生的Gittins索引与真实分布的索引接近，且随着样本量n的增加，该策略在最小化期望响应时间方面具有渐近最优性，数值实验也验证了其高效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过移位经验Gittins索引策略，可以在作业大小分布未知的情况下，有效实现M/G/1队列响应时间最小化的渐近最优调度。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们考虑了一个旨在最小化期望响应时间的M/G/1队列。我们展示了如何从n个作业大小分布的样本中计算索引，使得相应的索引策略随着n的增长而趋于渐近最优。这种构造基于对作业大小分布有界支持的离散化，并将样本移位到其右侧最近的离散点。我们证明了这些移位样本的经验分布的Gittins索引接近原始分布的Gittins索引。这转化为相应的索引策略在最小化期望响应时间方面的渐近最优性。与其它方法的数值比较进一步证实了我们方法的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了M/G/1队列中作业大小分布未知时的调度问题。作者提出了一种基于样本移位处理的经验Gittins索引策略，通过离散化和向右移位样本，使经验分布的索引逼近真实分布的索引，从而实现了响应时间最小化的渐近最优调度。
AI.keywords: M/G/1队列, Gittins索引, 调度策略, 渐近最优, 经验分布
AI.comments: 该论文针对M/G/1队列中作业大小分布未知的情况，提出了一种创新的“移位经验Gittins索引”策略。其核心贡献在于通过样本的离散化和移位处理，巧妙地克服了分布信息缺失的难题，并在理论上证明了其渐近最优性，为实际调度问题提供了高效且稳健的解决方案。

title: Convex geometries and directed paths on three vertices
summary:
A convexity space is an ordered pair $(V,\mathcal{C})$, where $V$ is an arbitrary set and $\mathcal{C}$ is a family of subsets of $V$, called convex, which contains $\{\emptyset,V\}$ and is closed under intersections and nested unions of its elements. For any $S\subseteq V$, the convex hull of $S$ is the inclusion-wise minimum convex set $C\in \mathcal{C}$ such that $S\subseteq C$. For a convex set $C\in \mathcal{C}$, an element $p\in C$ is an extreme of $C$ if $p$ does not belong to the convex hull of $C\setminus\{p\}$. A convexity $\mathcal{C}$ defined over $V$ is a convex geometry if any convex set $C\in \mathcal{C}$ is the convex hull of its extreme elements.
  Given an oriented graph $D = (V,A)$, the family $\mathcal{C}$ of subsets of $V$ is the $\overrightarrow{P_3}$-convexity defined over $D$ if $\mathcal{C}$ is formed by all (convex) sets $C\subseteq V$ such that no vertex $v\in V\setminus C$ is the central vertex of a directed path $P=(u,v,w)$ with $\{u,w\} \subseteq C$, while in the $\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-convexity defined over $D$, we have that no vertex $v\in V\setminus C$ is the central vertex of a directed path $P=(u,v,w)$ such that $\{u,w\} \subseteq C$ and $(u,w)\notin A$.
  In this work, we present necessary and sufficient conditions over an oriented graph $D$ so that the $\overrightarrow{P_3}$-convexity over $D$ is geometric, or the $\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-convexity over $D$ is geometric. While the first case implies a polynomial-time algorithm to decide whether the $\overrightarrow{P_3}$-convexity over $D$ is a geometric, we show that it is coNP-complete to decide whether the $\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-convexity over $D$ is a convex geometry. We also present a family termed acyclic indifference oriented graphs and demonstrate that deciding whether the $\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-convexity in this class is geometric can be solved in polynomial-time.

AI.title_translation: 凸几何与三顶点的有向路径
AI.tldr: 本文研究了有向图上的两种特定凸性（$\overrightarrow{P_3}$-凸性和$\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-凸性）何时构成凸几何。研究发现，判断$\overrightarrow{P_3}$-凸性是否为几何是多项式时间可解的，而判断$\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-凸性是否为几何是coNP-完全问题，但在无环无差异有向图中是多项式时间可解的。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在确定有向图D上的$\overrightarrow{P_3}$-凸性和$\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-凸性何时是几何的，并分析相关决策问题的计算复杂性。
AI.method: 本文通过给出有向图上的必要和充分条件来判断$\overrightarrow{P_3}$-凸性和$\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-凸性是否为几何。此外，还分析了这些决策问题的算法复杂性，并引入了一类特殊的有向图（无环无差异有向图）进行研究。
AI.result:
1. 提出了有向图D上的必要和充分条件，以使$\overrightarrow{P_3}$-凸性或$\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-凸性是几何的。
2. 判断$\overrightarrow{P_3}$-凸性是否为几何是多项式时间可解的。
3. 判断$\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-凸性是否为几何是coNP-完全问题。
4. 对于无环无差异有向图，判断$\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-凸性是否为几何是多项式时间可解的。
AI.conclusion: 本文为有向图上的$\overrightarrow{P_3}$-凸性和$\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-凸性何时构成凸几何提供了明确的条件和计算复杂性分析。研究揭示了这两种密切相关的凸性在计算难度上的显著差异，并为特殊图类提供了可行的解决方案。
AI.translation:
一个凸性空间是一个有序对$(V,\mathcal{C})$，其中$V$是一个任意集合，$\mathcal{C}$是$V$子集的一个族，称为凸集，它包含$\{\emptyset,V\}$，并且在元素的交集和嵌套并集下是封闭的。对于任何$S\subseteq V$，S的凸包是包含关系上最小的凸集$C\in \mathcal{C}$，使得$S\subseteq C$。对于一个凸集$C\in \mathcal{C}$，如果$p$不属于$C\setminus\{p\}$的凸包，则元素$p\in C$是$C$的一个极值。
定义在$V$上的凸性$\mathcal{C}$是一个凸几何，如果任何凸集$C\in \mathcal{C}$是其极值元素的凸包。
给定一个有向图$D = (V,A)$，如果$\mathcal{C}$由$V$的所有子集$C\subseteq V$组成，使得没有$v\in V\setminus C$是具有$\{u,w\} \subseteq C$的有向路径$P=(u,v,w)$的中心顶点，则$\mathcal{C}$是定义在$D$上的$\overrightarrow{P_3}$-凸性；而在定义在$D$上的$\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-凸性中，没有$v\in V\setminus C$是具有$\{u,w\} \subseteq C$且$(u,w)\notin A$的有向路径$P=(u,v,w)$的中心顶点。
在这项工作中，我们提出了有向图$D$上的必要和充分条件，以使$D$上的$\overrightarrow{P_3}$-凸性是几何的，或者$D$上的$\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-凸性是几何的。虽然第一种情况意味着一个多项式时间算法来决定$D$上的$\overrightarrow{P_3}$-凸性是否为几何，但我们表明，决定$D$上的$\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-凸性是否为凸几何是coNP-完全问题。我们还提出了一类称为无环无差异有向图的族，并证明了决定这类图中$\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-凸性是否为几何可以在多项式时间内解决。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了有向图上两种基于三顶点有向路径定义的凸性：$\overrightarrow{P_3}$-凸性和$\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-凸性，并研究了它们何时构成凸几何。研究给出了使这两种凸性成为几何的必要和充分条件。在计算复杂性方面，本文证明了判断$\overrightarrow{P_3}$-凸性是否为几何是多项式时间可解的，而判断$\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-凸性是否为几何是coNP-完全问题。此外，对于一类特殊的无环无差异有向图，判断$\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-凸性是否为几何可在多项式时间内解决。
AI.keywords: 凸几何, 有向路径, P3-凸性, P3*-凸性, 计算复杂性
AI.comments: 本文在凸性理论和图论的交叉领域做出了重要贡献，特别是引入了基于有向路径的两种新颖凸性概念。其创新之处在于不仅给出了使这些凸性成为几何的条件，还深入分析了相关决策问题的计算复杂性，揭示了两种相似概念在计算难度上的巨大差异。对于$\overrightarrow{P_3^*}$-凸性在一般情况下是coNP-完全问题，但在特殊图类（无环无差异有向图）中可多项式时间解决，这一发现具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: Model selection with proper scoring rules on data sets of time series
summary:
We consider the problem of model selection between probabilistic models on data sets of time series. Chosen a proper scoring rule, we denote by the term \textit{score} the average value of the scoring rule on the test of an individual time series. For model selection, we need aggregating the values of the scores across multiple time series. Three summary statistics are commonly used for model selection: mean score, median score, and mean rank. Results in previous papers show that these statistics can yield conflicting decisions; we show how the conflicting conclusions are due to the skewness of the distribution of scores. We also show that as the test set of each time series of the data set increases, the different model selection criteria progressively converge to the same conclusion. However, for short tests sets, only the mean score identifies the true model as the best.
  We illustrate these phenomena with an analysis on intermittent time series, including the data set of the M5 competition, where we underline the importance of having a large test set. In such experiments, we further notice that model selection based on mean ranks remains unchanged using different scaling factors.

AI.title_translation: 基于适当评分规则的时间序列数据集模型选择
AI.tldr: 针对时间序列模型选择中不同指标结论冲突的问题，本文证明了评分分布的偏度是主因，并指出平均分在短测试集下比中位数和平均秩更准确。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明，常用的模型选择统计量（平均分、中位数、平均秩）在实际应用中常导致冲突的决策，需要从统计学角度探究其背后的原因及适用条件。
AI.method: 研究了三种模型选择统计量（平均分、中位数、平均秩），分析了它们在不同测试集长度下的表现，并通过间歇性时间序列（包括M5竞赛数据集）进行了实证分析。
AI.result: 模型选择指标的冲突源于评分分布的偏度；随着测试集长度的增加，不同指标会趋向于相同的结论；在测试集较短时，仅平均分能有效识别出真实模型。此外，基于平均秩的选择对缩放因子具有不变性。
AI.conclusion: 在时间序列模型选择中，当测试集较短时，平均分是比中位数和平均秩更可靠的指标；随着测试集长度增加，不同指标的选择倾向会趋于一致。
AI.translation: 我们考虑了时间序列数据集上概率模型之间的模型选择问题。选择一种适当的评分规则，我们将“分数”定义为评分规则在单个时间序列测试集上的平均值。对于模型选择，我们需要汇总跨多个时间序列的分数。三种汇总统计量常用于模型选择：平均分、中位数和平均秩。先前论文的结果表明，这些统计量可能会导致冲突的决策；我们展示了这些冲突的结论是如何由分数分布的偏度引起的。我们还展示了随着每个时间序列测试集的增加，不同的模型选择标准会逐渐收敛到相同的结论。然而，对于短测试集，只有平均分能识别出真实模型作为最佳模型。我们通过对间歇性时间序列的分析（包括M5竞赛数据集）说明了这些现象，并强调了拥有大测试集的重要性。在此类实验中，我们进一步注意到，基于平均秩的模型选择在使用不同缩放因子时保持不变。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了时间序列概率模型选择中常用统计量（平均分、中位数、平均秩）产生冲突的原因，指出评分分布的偏度是关键因素。研究发现，测试集长度是影响模型选择一致性的核心变量，且在短测试集场景下，平均分指标表现最优。
AI.keywords: 时间序列, 模型选择, 适当评分规则, 统计量, 偏度
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了在模型选择中常用的三种统计量（平均分、中位数、平均秩）产生冲突的根本原因在于评分分布的偏度。研究强调了测试集长度对模型选择一致性的影响，并指出在测试集较短的情况下，平均分指标具有更优的识别准确性。这对时间序列预测中的模型评估具有重要的实践指导意义。

title: On the Limits of Stretching Quantum Pseudorandomness
summary:
Pseudorandom states, introduced by Ji, Liu, and Song (CRYPTO '18), are quantum analogues of classical pseudorandom generators. A fundamental property of classical pseudorandom generators is that their output can be stretched to arbitrary polynomial length. Whether an analogous stretching property holds for quantum pseudorandom states remains unclear.
  In this work, we prove the first black-box separation between single-copy secure pseudorandom states ($\mathsf{1PRS}$) with different output lengths. Specifically, we construct a quantum oracle relative to which $\mathsf{1PRS}$ with output length $m(n)=1.1n$ exist, but $\mathsf{1PRS}$ with output length $m(n)=Ω(n^{2+ε})$ do not, for any $ε>0$. Our proof leverages the Common Haar Random State (CHRS) model introduced by Chen, Coladangelo, and Sattath (EUROCRYPT '25), and introduces a technique to bound the effective number of resource CHRS states utilized by any $\mathsf{1PRS}$ generator in this model.

title: Asymptotic Compression of Interactive Quantum Communication using Type-Constrained de Finetti Reduction
summary: For many information processing tasks, de Finetti-style theorems can often simplify the analysis in worst-case input scenarios for which the task exhibits some permutation-invariance symmetry, as they can allow for a reduction from an analysis on worst-case inputs to that of i.i.d. inputs. If further information is available on the inputs, it might be advantageous to reflect this information in the de Finetti reduction. In our work, we focus on a form of such constraint, based on the type of the input. This allows us to obtain a conceptually simple proof of a new de Finetti reduction for classical probability distributions, derived from elementary properties from the method of types. We apply our constrained de Finetti reduction to the compression of quantum interactive communication protocols with classical inputs, and prove that the prior-free quantum information cost equals the worst-case input amortized quantum communication cost.

AI.title_translation: 利用类型约束de Finetti归约实现交互式量子通信的渐近压缩
AI.tldr: 本文引入了一种新的类型约束de Finetti归约方法，证明了在特定条件下，交互式量子通信的先验无关信息成本与其最坏情况下的摊销通信成本相等。
AI.motivation: 现有的de Finetti定理在处理具有特定输入信息的场景时不够精确，作者旨在通过引入“类型约束”这一额外信息，实现更有效的输入归约，从而简化对复杂通信任务的分析。
AI.method: 利用经典概率分布的“类型方法”（method of types）推导出一套新的类型约束de Finetti归约方法，并将其应用于分析量子交互式通信协议的压缩。
AI.result: 成功推导出一种基于类型约束的de Finetti归约方法，并证明了对于具有经典输入的量子交互式通信，其先验无关的量子信息成本等于最坏情况下的摊销量子通信成本。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过类型约束的de Finetti归约，可以证明在具有经典输入的量子交互式通信中，先验无关的量子信息成本与最坏情况下的摊销量子通信成本是相等的，从而在理论上简化了此类协议的分析。
AI.translation: 对于许多信息处理任务，de Finetti风格的定理通常可以简化对任务表现出某种置换不变对称性的最坏情况输入场景的分析，因为它们允许将对最坏情况输入的分析简化为对独立同分布（i.i.d.）输入的分析。如果关于输入有进一步的信息可用，那么在de Finetti归约中反映这些信息可能是有利的。在我们的工作中，我们专注于一种基于输入类型的约束形式。这使我们能够从类型方法的初等性质出发，获得一种新的经典概率分布de Finetti归约的简单证明。我们将这种约束de Finetti归约应用于具有经典输入的量子交互式通信协议的压缩，并证明了先验无关的量子信息成本等于最坏情况下的摊销量子通信成本。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用输入类型约束来改进de Finetti归约的方法。该方法通过类型方法简化了经典概率分布的分析，并将其成功应用于量子交互式通信协议的压缩，证明了先验无关量子信息成本与最坏情况摊销量子通信成本的等价性。
AI.keywords: 量子通信, de Finetti归约, 类型方法, 协议压缩, 信息成本
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入类型约束（type-constrained）的de Finetti归约，为处理对称性输入提供了一种更精细的方法。其创新之处在于利用经典信息论中“类型方法”的简单性质，成功将这一经典结果推广并应用于量子交互式通信协议的压缩问题，弥合了先验无关信息成本与最坏情况摊销通信成本之间的理论鸿沟。

title: Strong duality for the GROW criterion
summary: This paper presents general strong duality results when testing hypotheses by betting against them. A bet is an e-variable for a composite null hypothesis $\mathcal{P}$: a nonnegative random variable $X$ whose expected value is at most one under every $¶\in \Pcal$. Following Kelly, Breiman, Cover, Shafer, Grünwald and others, we study a natural minimax \emph{log-optimality} criterion: given a composite alternative $\Qcal$, we characterize the ``GROW value'' $\sup_{X} \inf_{\Q} \E_{\Q}[\log X]$. This paper generalizes the results of \cite{larsson2025numeraire} from (arbitrary $\Pcal$ and) simple $\Qcal$ to arbitrary $\Qcal$. We identify a weak-$*$ joint information projection pair between arbitrary $\Pcal$ and $\Qcal$ that always exists and show that the GROW value for \emph{bounded} e-variables always equals the relative entropy of this pair, without any restrictions on $\Pcal$ or $\Qcal$. We also prove a similarly general strong duality for the REGROW criterion with bounded e-variables and arbitrary bounded offsets. Under various assumptions our results extend to unbounded e-variables, and examples show that without any assumptions such extensions fail. Our results are analogous to those in~\cite{larsson2026complete}, swapping tests for bounded e-variables, minimax risk for the GROW criterion, and total variation for relative entropy.

AI.title_translation: GROW准则的强对偶性
AI.tldr: 论文证明了在处理任意复合假设检验时，有界e-变量的GROW值等于其联合信息投影对之间的相对熵，确立了该准则下的强对偶性。
AI.motivation: 为了推广现有的GROW（Log-optimality）准则研究，使其能够处理更一般的复合替代假设（composite alternative），并建立起基于e-变量的假设检验中强对偶性的通用理论框架。
AI.method: 通过引入弱-*联合信息投影对，将GROW值表征为两个假设集合之间的相对熵，并利用该投影分析有界e-变量下的强对偶性，同时探讨了向无界e-变量扩展的条件。
AI.result: 对于任意复合零假设和替代假设，有界e-变量的GROW值始终等于其弱-*联合信息投影对之间的相对熵；同时证明了REGROW准则在类似条件下的强对偶性，并指出无界e-变量下该结论通常不成立。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了在有界e-变量条件下，GROW值始终等于两假设集合之间的相对熵，并给出了REGROW准则的类似强对偶结果，同时指出了在无界情况下该结论可能失效的边界条件。
AI.translation: 本文提出了在通过对赌进行假设检验时的一般强对偶性结果。赌注（bet）是针对复合零假设 $\mathcal{P}$ 的e-变量：即在每个 $\mathbb{P} \in \mathcal{P}$ 下期望值至多为1的非负随机变量。追随 Kelly、Breiman、Cover、Shafer、Grünwald 等人的工作，我们研究了一个自然的极大极小“对数最优”准则：给定一个复合替代假设 $\mathcal{Q}$，我们刻画了“GROW值” $\sup_{X} \inf_{\mathbb{Q}} \mathbb{E}_{\mathbb{Q}}[\log X]$。本文将 Larsson 等人（2025）的结果从（任意 $\mathcal{P}$ 和）简单 $\mathcal{Q}$ 推广到了任意 $\mathcal{Q}$。我们确定了一对始终存在的任意 $\mathcal{P}$ 和 $\mathcal{Q}$ 之间的弱-* 联合信息投影，并证明了对于有界e-变量，GROW值始终等于该投影对的相对熵，且对 $\mathcal{P}$ 或 $\mathcal{Q}$ 没有任何限制。我们还证明了对于有界e-变量和任意有界偏移量的 REGROW 准则具有类似的通用强对偶性。在各种假设下，我们的结果扩展到了无界e-变量，且例子表明，没有任何假设时这种扩展会失败。我们的结果与 Larsson 等人（2026）的结果类似，将检验替换为有界e-变量，将极大极小风险替换为 GROW 准则，将总变差替换为相对熵。
AI.summary: 本文研究了基于e-变量的假设检验中的强对偶性问题，重点分析了GROW（对数最优性）准则。论文将先前的研究成果推广至任意复合替代假设，证明了在有界e-变量条件下，GROW值始终等于相关假设集合的相对熵，并建立了相应的强对偶性理论，同时讨论了向无界情况扩展的局限性。
AI.keywords: GROW准则, 强对偶性, e-变量, 相对熵, 假设检验
AI.comments: 该论文通过推广现有的GROW准则研究，利用弱-*联合信息投影对，在无需对假设空间做严格限制的情况下，成功建立了有界e-变量的强对偶性，为统计假设检验中的对数最优性提供了更一般的理论框架。其创新点在于将结果推广至任意复合替代假设，并明确了有界性条件的必要性。

title: DeepBD: A Grounded Agentic Workflow for Variant Prioritization and Diagnosis of Genetic Birth Defects
summary: Birth defects are a major cause of fetal loss, neonatal morbidity and long-term disability. In the subset with suspected genetic etiologies, exome and genome sequencing have moved many cases from variant detection to post-sequencing interpretation: clinicians must rank patient-specific candidate variants under incomplete fetal or infant phenotypes and heterogeneous evidence from population genetics, variant-effect prediction, gene-disease validity, phenotype ontologies, cellular and pathway context, protein structure and clinical literature. We present DeepBD, a grounded agentic workflow for variant prioritization and diagnostic interpretation of genetic birth defects. DeepBD organizes the workflow into LLM-assisted case structuring, a pretrained evidence engine, specialist evidence modules and a grounded diagnostic review layer. The evidence engine learns patient-specific variant scores from structured rule evidence, sequence and variant-effect representations and phenotype-conditioned biological context, whereas specialist modules and the agentic layer provide tool-based refinement, candidate-pool review and diagnosis-oriented synthesis from ranked candidates. Developed using an in-house fetal and infant cohort comprising 18,622 cases, DeepBD achieved Recall@1/3/5/10 of 0.658/0.882/0.912/0.929 on an internal held-out solved-case benchmark, outperforming standalone Exomiser, DeepRare and prompted LLM reranking baselines evaluated on Exomiser-derived top-20 candidate variants. Ablation and overlap analyses show that rule evidence, mechanistic context, and specialist refinement provide complementary signals. These findings support a grounded agentic workflow that separates evidence integration, tool-based refinement, and LLM-assisted diagnostic review for retrospective variant prioritization in genetic birth defects.

AI.title_translation: DeepBD：一种用于遗传性出生缺陷变异优先排序与诊断的有根据代理工作流
AI.tldr: DeepBD 是一款利用代理工作流和 LLM 技术，自动整合多维证据进行遗传病变异分析的系统，显著提升了出生缺陷的诊断效率和准确性。
AI.motivation: 针对遗传性出生缺陷诊断中，临床医生在处理不完整表型和海量异构遗传证据时，变异优先级排序困难且耗时的问题，亟需一种更高效的自动化诊断工具。
AI.method: 提出了 DeepBD 框架，包含四个核心组件：LLM 辅助的病例结构化、预训练证据引擎、专家证据模块和有根据的诊断审查层。该系统整合了序列信息、变异效应预测、基因-疾病关联及表型本体等多维数据。
AI.result: 在包含 18,622 例病例的队列中，DeepBD 在内部测试集上实现了 0.658/0.882/0.912/0.929 的 Recall@1/3/5/10，性能优于 Exomiser、DeepRare 及基于 LLM 的重排序基线。
AI.conclusion: DeepBD 证明了代理工作流在处理复杂临床遗传诊断任务中的有效性，为遗传病的自动化诊断提供了一种鲁棒且可解释的框架。
AI.translation: 出生缺陷是胎儿丢失、新生儿发病和长期残疾的主要原因。在疑似遗传病因的亚群中，外显子组和基因组测序已将许多病例从变异检测转向测序后解读：临床医生必须在不完整的胎儿或婴儿表型，以及来自群体遗传学、变异效应预测、基因-疾病有效性、表型本体、细胞和通路背景、蛋白质结构和临床文献的异构证据下，对患者特定的候选变异进行排序。我们提出了 DeepBD，这是一种用于遗传性出生缺陷变异优先排序和诊断解读的有根据代理工作流。DeepBD 将工作流组织为 LLM 辅助的病例结构化、预训练证据引擎、专家证据模块和有根据的诊断审查层。证据引擎从结构化规则证据、序列和变异效应表示以及表型条件下的生物学背景中学习患者特定的变异评分，而专家模块和代理层提供基于工具的细化、候选池审查以及从排序后的候选变异中进行诊断导向的合成。DeepBD 使用包含 18,622 例病例的内部胎儿和婴儿队列开发，在内部留出的已解决病例基准上实现了 0.658/0.882/0.912/0.929 的 Recall@1/3/5/10，优于基于 Exomiser 导出的前 20 个候选变异的独立 Exomiser、DeepRare 和提示 LLM 重排序基线。消融和重叠分析表明，规则证据、机制背景和专家细化提供了互补信号。这些发现支持了一种有根据的代理工作流，该工作流将遗传性出生缺陷回顾性变异优先排序中的证据整合、基于工具的细化和 LLM 辅助的诊断审查分离开来。
AI.summary: DeepBD 是一种用于遗传性出生缺陷变异优先排序的代理工作流，通过整合 LLM 和多维生物学证据，实现了从变异筛选到诊断合成的自动化处理，在临床诊断准确性上优于现有主流模型。
AI.keywords: 遗传性出生缺陷, 变异优先排序, 大语言模型, 代理工作流, 临床诊断
AI.comments: DeepBD 通过将大语言模型（LLM）与领域专家模块相结合，构建了一个“有根据的（grounded）”代理工作流，有效解决了遗传性出生缺陷诊断中证据异构和表型不全的挑战。其创新之处在于将证据整合、工具辅助细化和临床诊断审查分层处理，显著提升了变异优先级排序的准确性。

title: Faster algorithm for achieving minimal-size quantum decision diagrams
summary: The decision diagram (DD) data structure enables fast linear-algebra calculations by bringing vectors into a normal form and subsequently merging equivalent ones, yielding a minimally-sized DD modulo the equivalence relation. A fruitful application area is quantum-circuit simulation, where the vectors represent quantum states. The Local Invertible Map Decision Diagram (LIMDD) type, merges LIM-equivalent (typically Pauli-gate equivalent) vectors, can efficiently simulate Clifford circuits as well as some high-T-count circuits, and has theoretically been proven exponentially faster for simulation than other well-developed data structures, including other common DD variants. However, these exponential advantages have not fully materialized yet in existing implementations, for which the normal-form procedure, which is a highly complex algorithm, is either absent or only partially implemented. We here present a novel normal-form algorithm for Pauli-LIMDDs, achieving a worst-case speedup from $O(n^3)$ to $O(n^2)$ for an $n$-qubit DD node with a single child node while keeping the $O(n^3)$ run time in case of two distinct children nodes. We implement the algorithm as part of QolDDer, our Pauli-LIMDD simulator for quantum circuits, written from scratch in C/C++. The implementation realizes the theoretically-proven advantages of Pauli-LIMDDs on Clifford circuits, is significantly faster than the existing LIMDD simulators on such circuits, and on a public quantum-circuit data set often outperforms them by an order of magnitude. In the future, we envision that our work will enable further application and development of LIMDD variants, not only for quantum design tasks, but also for analysis of linear-algebra-based systems in general.

AI.title_translation: 实现最小尺寸量子决策图的更快算法
AI.tldr: 本文通过优化Pauli-LIMDD的正规化算法，降低了计算复杂度，显著提升了量子电路仿真器的运行速度，并在实践中验证了其理论优势。
AI.motivation: 现有的LIMDD实现中，由于正规化过程过于复杂且实现不完整，导致其理论上的指数级性能优势在实际应用中未能充分发挥。
AI.method: 提出了一种针对Pauli-LIMDD的新型正规化算法，将单子节点情况下的最坏情况复杂度从O(n^3)降低至O(n^2)，并基于C/C++实现了名为QolDDer的模拟器。
AI.result: 在Clifford电路模拟中，新算法实现了理论预期的性能提升，在公共量子电路数据集上比现有模拟器快一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出了一种新型的Pauli-LIMDD正规化算法，通过降低计算复杂度，在实际模拟中显著提升了量子电路仿真速度，验证了LIMDD在处理Clifford电路时的理论优势。
AI.translation: 决策图（DD）数据结构通过将向量转换为正规形式并合并等价向量，能够实现快速线性代数计算，从而产生模等价关系的最小尺寸DD。一个富有成效的应用领域是量子电路模拟，其中向量代表量子态。局部可逆映射决策图（LIMDD）类型，通过合并LIM等价（通常为Pauli门等价）向量，可以高效地模拟Clifford电路以及一些高T门计数的电路，并且在理论上已被证明比其他成熟的数据结构（包括其他常见DD变体）在仿真速度上快指数级。然而，这些指数级的优势在现有实现中尚未完全体现，因为其正规化程序（一种高度复杂的算法）要么缺失，要么仅部分实现。我们在此提出了一种用于Pauli-LIMDD的新型正规化算法，在具有单个子节点的n量子位DD节点的情况下，实现了从O(n^3)到O(n^2)的最坏情况加速，同时在具有两个不同子节点的情况下保持了O(n^3)的运行时间。我们将该算法实现为QolDDer的一部分，这是我们用C/C++从头编写的Pauli-LIMDD量子电路模拟器。该实现实现了Pauli-LIMDD在Clifford电路上的理论证明优势，在这些电路上的速度明显快于现有的LIMDD模拟器，并且在公共量子电路数据集上通常比它们快一个数量级。未来，我们设想我们的工作将促进LIMDD变体的进一步应用和开发，不仅用于量子设计任务，还用于一般线性代数系统的分析。
AI.summary: 本文针对Pauli-LIMDD提出了一种优化后的正规化算法，有效降低了计算复杂度。通过在C/C++中实现该算法（QolDDer），作者成功在实践中验证了LIMDD在量子电路仿真中的理论性能优势，显著优于现有模拟器。
AI.keywords: 量子决策图, Pauli-LIMDD, 量子电路模拟, 正规化算法, Clifford电路
AI.comments: 该论文解决了量子决策图（LIMDD）在实际应用中因正规化算法复杂导致性能受限的问题。通过将核心算法的复杂度降低，成功实现了理论上的性能优势，对于量子电路模拟器的开发具有重要的工程参考价值。

title: Large-Language-Model Discovery of Quantum LDPC Codes through Structured Concept Evolution
summary: Quantum computers could outperform classical machines on important problems, but only if the errors that pervade quantum hardware can be corrected at scale. Quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes offer a promising route to this goal by combining sparse parity checks with finite encoding rate and growing distance, but their construction remains a challenging discrete design problem. Here we introduce structured concept evolution (SCE), a search framework that pairs a large language model with a structured algebraic mutation grammar to discover lifted-product code families, a class of CSS qLDPC codes. Instead of asking the LLM to design codes from first principles, SCE evolves structured concepts consisting of algebraic specifications paired with executable programs that realize them, using hierarchical mutations that modify the group algebra, protograph geometry, or base space. Running SCE, we discover a diverse set of competitive code families, ranging from abelian constructions to families over non-abelian groups beyond those underlying standard designs such as bivariate-bicycle codes, and characterize them under code-capacity depolarizing noise with BP+OSD decoding. These results are obtained with lightweight models (GPT-5.4-mini and GPT-5.4-nano).
