AI.title_translation: SLEEPING-DISCO 9M：一个用于生成式音乐建模的大规模预训练数据集
AI.tldr: Sleeping-DISCO 9M 提供了一个基于真实流行音乐的大规模数据集，旨在解决现有音乐生成模型因训练数据缺乏真实感而应用受限的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成式音乐数据集要么过于受限（如合成或重录音乐），要么虽然规模巨大但缺乏真实世界的音乐风味，导致其在生成式音乐社区的实际应用效果不佳。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含实际流行音乐和世界知名艺术家作品的大规模预训练数据集 Sleeping-DISCO 9M，旨在解决现有数据集缺乏真实感和音乐风味的问题。
AI.result: 成功构建并发布了 Sleeping-DISCO 9M 数据集，该数据集能够更好地反映真实世界的音乐特征，适用于文本生成音乐、音乐描述、歌声合成、旋律重构及跨模态检索等多种任务。
AI.conclusion: Sleeping-DISCO 9M 通过提供大规模、高质量的流行音乐数据，为生成式音乐建模领域提供了一个更具实用价值的基准，有望推动该领域模型在真实应用场景中的性能提升。
AI.translation: 我们提出了 Sleeping-DISCO 9M，这是一个用于音乐和歌曲的大规模预训练数据集。据我们所知，目前尚无开源的高质量数据集能够代表流行和知名歌曲，以支持文本生成音乐、音乐描述、歌声合成、旋律重构和跨模态检索等生成式音乐建模任务。过去的贡献主要集中在孤立和受限的因素上，其核心视角是创建合成或重录的音乐语料库（例如 GTSinger、M4Singer），而任意大规模音频数据集（例如 DISCO-10M 和 LAIONDISCO-12M）是社区关注的另一个重点。不幸的是，这些数据集在生成式音乐社区的采用率一直不高，因为它们未能反映真实世界的音乐及其风味。我们的数据集改变了这一现状，提供了一个使用实际流行音乐和世界知名艺术家作品构建的数据集。
AI.summary: Sleeping-DISCO 9M 是一个大规模的音乐预训练数据集，旨在弥补现有生成式音乐模型缺乏高质量、真实流行音乐数据的不足，从而提升模型在多种音乐生成与理解任务中的表现。
AI.keywords: 生成式音乐建模, 预训练数据集, 流行音乐, 音乐生成, 音频处理
AI.comments: 该论文填补了生成式音乐建模领域缺乏高质量、代表性流行音乐数据集的空白。其创新在于强调了数据集的“真实感”与“音乐性”，而非仅仅追求数据规模，这对于提升生成模型在现实场景中的表现具有重要意义。

title: Tuning without Peeking: Provable Generalization Bounds and Robust LLM Post-Training
summary: Gradient-based optimization is the workhorse of deep learning, offering efficient and scalable training via backpropagation. However, exposing gradients during training can leak sensitive information about the underlying data, raising privacy and security concerns such as susceptibility to data poisoning attacks. In contrast, black-box optimization methods, which treat the model as an opaque function, relying solely on function evaluations to guide optimization, offer a promising alternative in scenarios where data access is restricted, adversarial risks are high, or overfitting is a concern. This paper introduces BBoxER, an evolutionary black-box method for LLM post-training that induces an information bottleneck via implicit compression of the training data. Leveraging the tractability of information flow, we provide non-vacuous generalization bounds and strong theoretical guarantees for robustness to data poisoning attacks and extraction attacks, while ensuring privacy by design. In experiments with LLMs, we demonstrate empirically that black-box optimization methods-despite the scalability and computational challenges inherent to black-box approaches-are able to learn, showing how a few iterations of BBoxER improve performance, generalize well on a benchmark of reasoning datasets, and are robust to membership inference attacks. This positions BBoxER as an attractive add-on on top of gradient-based optimization, offering suitability for deployment in restricted environments while also providing non-vacuous generalization guarantees.

AI.title_translation: 无需窥探的微调：可证明的泛化界限与鲁棒的LLM后训练
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为BBoxER的黑盒LLM训练方法，通过信息瓶颈机制在无需梯度的情况下实现隐私保护、对抗鲁棒性和良好的泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 梯度下降训练过程中暴露梯度可能导致隐私泄露和数据投毒风险；现有黑盒优化方法在受限数据访问或高对抗风险场景下更具优势。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为BBoxER的进化黑盒优化方法，通过隐式压缩训练数据来引入信息瓶颈，无需使用梯度信息进行模型更新。
AI.result: 实验表明，BBoxER能在仅需少量迭代的情况下显著提升模型性能，在推理任务上表现出良好的泛化能力，并能有效抵御成员推理攻击。
AI.conclusion: BBoxER证明了黑盒优化在LLM后训练中的可行性，不仅提供了强大的理论安全保障和泛化界限，还作为梯度优化的一种有效补充，特别适用于对隐私和安全性要求极高的部署环境。
AI.translation: 基于梯度的优化是深度学习的核心，通过反向传播提供了高效且可扩展的训练。然而，训练过程中暴露梯度可能会泄露底层数据的敏感信息，引发隐私和安全问题，例如容易受到数据投毒攻击。相比之下，黑盒优化方法将模型视为一个不透明的函数，仅依赖函数评估来指导优化，在数据访问受限、对抗风险高或担心过拟合的场景中提供了一种有前景的替代方案。本文介绍了BBoxER，一种用于LLM后训练的进化黑盒方法，它通过对训练数据的隐式压缩引入了信息瓶颈。利用信息流的可追溯性，我们提供了非空泛化界限，并为抵御数据投毒攻击和提取攻击提供了强有力的理论保证，同时确保了设计上的隐私性。在LLM实验中，我们从经验上证明了黑盒优化方法——尽管黑盒方法存在固有的可扩展性和计算挑战——是能够学习的，展示了BBoxER的几次迭代如何提高性能、在推理数据集基准上良好泛化，并对成员推理攻击具有鲁棒性。这使BBoxER成为梯度优化之上的一种有吸引力的附加组件，使其适用于受限环境中的部署，同时也提供了非空的泛化保证。
AI.summary: 本文提出了BBoxER，一种用于LLM后训练的进化黑盒优化方法。该方法通过隐式数据压缩引入信息瓶颈，在无需梯度的情况下通过函数评估进行优化。研究不仅从理论上证明了其泛化界限及对数据投毒和提取攻击的鲁棒性，还通过实验验证了其在隐私保护和性能提升方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 黑盒优化, 大语言模型, 信息瓶颈, 隐私保护, 数据投毒防御
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种名为BBoxER的进化黑盒优化方法，通过引入信息瓶颈机制实现了LLM的后训练，同时解决了隐私保护、数据投毒和模型抽取攻击等安全挑战。其最大的亮点在于为黑盒优化提供了理论上的泛化界限，这在黑盒训练领域具有重要意义。局限性在于黑盒方法本身面临的计算开销和可扩展性挑战。

title: Stabilizing Black-Box Prompt Optimization with Textual Regularization and Signal Aggregation
summary: An increasing number of NLP applications interact with large language models (LLMs) through black-box APIs, making prompt engineering critical for controlling model behavior. Recent Automatic Prompt Optimization (APO) methods iteratively refine prompts using model-generated critiques (often called textual gradients), but they predominantly optimize from failures and underutilize information contained in correct predictions, leading to instability and semantic drift. We propose TRAS (Textual Regularization with Aggregated Signals), a feedback-centric framework that is plug-and-play with existing APO search backbones. It retains the standard textual gradient signal from prior work for error correction and introduces a complementary textual regularizer derived from successful predictions to preserve beneficial prompt components. Because both signals are stochastic and can be noisy, we further introduce Monte Carlo Signal Aggregation (MCSA), which samples multiple gradients or regularizers and aggregates them into a single actionable directive, emphasizing consistent, actionable advice while filtering out outliers. Motivated by rapid model churn, we also formalize Automatic Prompt Migration (APM), the practical problem of adapting an expert prompt across model versions or API providers without losing critical instructions. Across standard APO and APM scenarios, our approach consistently outperforms strong baselines, yielding higher accuracy, faster convergence, and lower query cost, while substantially reducing the degradation observed under naive prompt migration.

title: Balalaika: Data-Centric, Prosody-Aware Annotation Pipeline for Russian Speech
comments: The work is still in progress. Aceepted to Interspeech 2026
summary: We introduce Balalaika, an open-source, data-centric pipeline for processing audio and producing prosody-aware annotations. It combines semantic VAD for context-preserving segmentation, multi-ASR ensembling with ROVER consensus decoding, while retaining optional word-level timestamps, followed by automatic quality and speaker-purity filtering. The text is further enriched with punctuation restoration, lexical stress and "\textipa{e}/\textipa{He}" normalization, and IPA phonemes. Using Balalaika, we build a 5.1k-hour multi-source Russian corpus with rich annotations, and show consistent gains under equalized training budgets for both speech denoising and TTS; ablations confirm complementary benefits of stress and punctuation and improved synthesis with stricter MOS filtering. The datasets are publicly available at \href{https://huggingface.co/collections/lab260/balalaika-dataset}{\underline{\textbf{HuggingFace}}}

title: FISHER: A Foundation Model for Multi-Modal Industrial Signal Comprehensive Representation
comments: Accepted by IEEE TII. FISHER open-sourced on https://github.com/jianganbai/FISHER . RMIS open-sourced on https://jianganbai.github.io/RMIS
summary: Industrial signal analysis is hindered by severe data heterogeneity, which we characterize as the M5 problem. Existing solutions rely on specialized models that lack robustness and scalability, while large-scale pre-training has rarely been investigated in this area. In this work, we derive a prioritized roadmap for the M5 problem and propose FISHER, a Foundation model for multi-modal Industrial Signal compreHEnsive Representation. To address the foremost multi-sampling-rate problem, FISHER utilizes a novel sub-band modeling approach that treats sampling rate increments as concatenated sub-band information, enabling the adaptive usage of full signal bandwidth without resampling. FISHER is pre-trained by teacher-student self-distillation over external audio and music data. We also establish the RMIS benchmark, comprising 19 datasets across four modalities. In the experiment, FISHER outperforms 24 state-of-the-art series encoders (up to 2B) with much smaller sizes (up to 16x), showcasing groundbreaking diagnostic accuracy and remarkable versatility. We further demonstrate that 1) seamless adaptation to variable sampling rates is the key to generalization 2) audio and music data provide better temporal variability, which is essential for pre-training. Both FISHER and RMIS are open-sourced.

title: How Do Code Smells Affect Skill Growth in Scratch Novice Programmers?
summary: Context. Code smells, which are recurring anomalies in design or style, have been extensively researched in professional code. However, their significance in block-based projects created by novices is still largely unknown. Block-based environments such as Scratch offer a unique, data-rich setting to examine how emergent design problems intersect with the cultivation of computational-thinking (CT) skills. Objective. This research explores the connection between CT proficiency and design-level code smells--issues that may hinder software maintenance and evolution--in programs created by Scratch developers. We seek to identify which CT dimensions align most strongly with which code smells and whether task context moderates those associations. Method. A random sample of aprox. 2 million public Scratch projects is mined. Using open-source linters, we extract nine CT scores and 40 code smell indicators from these projects. After rigorous pre-processing, we apply descriptive analytics, robust correlation tests, stratified cross-validation, and exploratory machine-learning models; qualitative spot-checks contextualize quantitative patterns. Impact. The study will deliver the first large-scale, fine-grained map linking specific CT competencies to concrete design flaws and antipatterns. Results are poised to (i) inform evidence-based curricula and automated feedback systems, (ii) provide effect-size benchmarks for future educational interventions, and (iii) supply an open, pseudonymized dataset and reproducible analysis pipeline for the research community. By clarifying how programming habits influence early skill acquisition, the work advances both computing-education theory and practical tooling for sustainable software maintenance and evolution.

AI.title_translation: 代码异味如何影响Scratch初学者的技能成长？
AI.tldr: 通过对200万个Scratch项目的分析，研究揭示了代码异味与初学者计算思维能力之间的关联，为改进编程教育提供了数据驱动的洞察。
AI.motivation: 代码异味在专业编程中研究广泛，但其对Scratch初学者计算思维能力培养的影响尚不明确，需要通过大规模数据分析来探究二者的内在联系。
AI.method: 从约200万个公开Scratch项目中进行数据挖掘，利用开源linter提取9个计算思维评分和40个代码异味指标，并结合描述性分析、相关性检验、交叉验证及探索性机器学习模型进行研究。
AI.result: 研究建立了计算思维能力与具体设计缺陷之间的映射关系，明确了不同计算思维维度与代码异味的相关性，并提供了用于教育干预的基准数据及开源分析工具。
AI.conclusion: 研究旨在揭示代码异味与计算思维能力之间的关联，为优化计算教育课程设计和自动化反馈系统提供科学依据。
AI.translation: 背景：代码异味是设计或风格中反复出现的异常，在专业代码中已得到广泛研究。然而，它们在初学者创建的积木式项目中的重要性尚不明确。Scratch等积木式环境提供了一个独特且数据丰富的场景，用于考察涌现的设计问题如何与计算思维（CT）能力的培养相互作用。目标：本研究探讨了Scratch开发者所创程序中CT熟练度与设计层面的代码异味（可能阻碍软件维护和演进的问题）之间的联系。我们试图确定哪些CT维度与哪些代码异味联系最紧密，以及任务背景是否调节了这些关联。方法：挖掘了约200万个公开Scratch项目的随机样本。利用开源linter，从这些项目中提取了9个CT评分和40个代码异味指标。经过严格的预处理，我们应用了描述性分析、稳健相关性检验、分层交叉验证和探索性机器学习模型；定性抽查使定量模式得以语境化。影响：本研究将提供首个大规模、细粒度的图谱，将特定的CT能力与具体的设计缺陷和反模式联系起来。结果旨在（i）为基于证据的课程和自动化反馈系统提供信息，（ii）为未来的教育干预提供效应量基准，以及（iii）为研究界提供一个开放的、去标识化的数据集和可重复的分析流水线。通过阐明编程习惯如何影响早期技能习得，该工作推动了计算教育理论和可持续软件维护与演进的实用工具的发展。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了Scratch初学者项目中的代码异味与计算思维（CT）能力之间的关系。研究通过分析200万个项目，量化了编程中的设计缺陷对技能培养的影响，旨在为计算教育课程及自动化反馈工具提供实证支持。
AI.keywords: 代码异味, 计算思维, Scratch编程, 初学者, 教育数据挖掘
AI.comments: 该研究填补了Scratch新手编程中代码异味（Code Smells）与计算思维（CT）发展之间关系的空白。通过大规模数据挖掘，其创新之处在于将软件工程中的“代码异味”概念引入教育技术领域，为理解新手如何从编程实践中培养技能提供了实证依据。局限性在于其主要基于静态分析，可能无法完全捕捉编程过程中的思维动态。

title: From "Aha Moments" to Controllable Thinking: Toward Meta-Cognitive Reasoning in Large Reasoning Models via Decoupled Reasoning and Control
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) can exhibit step-by-step reasoning, reflection, and backtracking, but these behaviors are often unregulated, leading to overthinking. As a result, LRMs continue generating redundant reasoning even after reaching high-confidence conclusions. This increases inference cost and latency, limiting practical deployment. The root cause is the absence of an intrinsic mechanism to monitor the reasoning state and decide when to continue, backtrack, or stop. We propose MERA, a meta-cognitive reasoning framework that decouples reasoning from control to enable independent optimization of control strategies. MERA constructs high-quality reasoning-control supervision data via a takeover-based pipeline, and transforms long-horizon traces into structured reasoning-control alternating sequences for training. The model is trained with supervised fine-tuning to internalize the structured separation, and further optimized with Control-Segment Policy Optimization (CSPO), which combines segment-wise GRPO with control masking to focus learning on control segments. Experiments across reasoning benchmarks show that MERA improves both efficiency and accuracy.

AI.title_translation: 从“顿悟时刻”到可控思维：通过推理与控制解耦实现大推理模型的元认知推理
AI.tldr: MERA框架通过将推理过程与控制机制解耦，使大语言模型能够自主判断何时停止推理，从而在提升准确率的同时显著降低了推理延迟和成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的推理模型缺乏监控自身推理状态的机制，导致在得出高置信度结论后仍进行冗余推理，从而增加了推理成本和延迟。
AI.method: 提出MERA框架，通过“接管式”流水线构建高质量的推理-控制监督数据；将推理过程转化为结构化的推理-控制交替序列；并采用控制片段策略优化（CSPO）进行训练。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准测试中，MERA框架在提升推理准确性的同时，有效提高了推理效率。
AI.conclusion: MERA框架通过解耦推理和控制，成功实现了大模型推理过程的元认知管理，在提升推理准确性的同时显著改善了推理效率。
AI.translation: 大推理模型（LRMs）能够展现出逐步推理、反思和回溯的能力，但这些行为往往是不受监管的，导致了“过度思考”。因此，即使在得出高置信度结论后，LRMs仍会继续生成冗余的推理内容。这增加了推理成本和延迟，限制了其实际部署。其根本原因是缺乏一种内在机制来监控推理状态，并决定何时继续、回溯或停止。我们提出了MERA，一个元认知推理框架，它将推理与控制解耦，以实现控制策略的独立优化。MERA通过基于接管的流水线构建高质量的推理-控制监督数据，并将长程轨迹转化为结构化的推理-控制交替序列用于训练。模型通过监督微调来内化这种结构化分离，并进一步通过控制片段策略优化（CSPO）进行优化，该方法结合了分段GRPO与控制掩码，将学习重点聚焦于控制片段。在推理基准测试上的实验表明，MERA同时提高了效率和准确性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了MERA元认知推理框架，旨在解决大推理模型（LRMs）中存在的冗余推理问题。通过将推理过程与控制逻辑解耦，并引入专门的训练策略，该方法使模型能够自主监控推理状态，从而在保持高准确度的前提下显著降低了推理成本和延迟。
AI.keywords: 大推理模型, 元认知推理, 解耦推理与控制, 控制片段策略优化, 推理效率
AI.comments: 该研究通过将推理与控制解耦，解决了大模型推理中的“过度思考”问题，为实现更高效、可控的推理提供了一种创新的元认知框架。其创新点在于引入了控制片段策略优化（CSPO），不仅提高了准确率，还显著降低了推理成本。

title: Rule2Text: A Framework for Generating and Evaluating Natural Language Explanations of Knowledge Graph Rules
comments: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2507.23740
summary: Knowledge graphs (KGs) can be enhanced through rule mining; however, the resulting logical rules are often difficult for humans to interpret due to their inherent complexity and the idiosyncratic labeling conventions of individual KGs. This work presents Rule2Text, a comprehensive framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to generate natural language explanations for mined logical rules, thereby improving KG accessibility and usability. We conduct extensive experiments using multiple datasets, including Freebase variants (FB-CVT-REV, FB+CVT-REV, and FB15k-237) as well as the ogbl-biokg dataset, with rules mined using AMIE 3.5.1. We systematically evaluate several LLMs across a comprehensive range of prompting strategies, including zero-shot, few-shot, variable type incorporation, and Chain-of-Thought reasoning. To systematically assess models' performance, we conduct a human evaluation of generated explanations on correctness and clarity. To address evaluation scalability, we develop and validate an LLM-as-a-judge framework that demonstrates strong agreement with human evaluators. Leveraging the best-performing model (Gemini 2.0 Flash), LLM judge, and human-in-the-loop feedback, we construct high-quality ground truth datasets, which we use to fine-tune the open-source Zephyr model. Our results demonstrate significant improvements in explanation quality after fine-tuning, with particularly strong gains in the domain-specific dataset. Additionally, we integrate a type inference module to support KGs lacking explicit type information. All code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/idirlab/KGRule2NL.

title: FAIRVAR: Fair Federated Learning via Variance Regularization
summary: Federated learning (FL) allows collaborative training of machine learning models across multiple parties without sharing raw data. However, heterogeneous data can cause some clients to have disproportionate influence on the global model, leading to disparities in their performance. Fairness, understood as reducing these disparities, is therefore a crucial concern in FL and has been addressed in various ways. We studied performance equitable fairness in FL, where the goal is to minimize performance disparities across clients. We evaluated several existing fairness-aware methods and introduce here a new gradient-variance-regularized method, implemented in two variants: FairGrad (approximate) and FairGrad* (exact). We theoretically characterize the connections between these methods and, empirically, on heterogeneous benchmarks, show that FairGrad and FairGrad* consistently improve fairness by reducing variance in client accuracies, while maintaining competitive or improved mean performance compared to existing fairness-aware baselines.

AI.title_translation: FAIRVAR：通过方差正则化实现公平联邦学习
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为 FairGrad 的梯度方差正则化方法，通过平衡各客户端的贡献，有效缩小了联邦学习中客户端间的性能差异。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中异构数据导致客户端对全局模型的影响力不均，进而造成客户端间性能差异，需要一种有效的方法来最小化这些性能差距。
AI.method: 引入梯度方差正则化方法，具体实现为 FairGrad（近似版）和 FairGrad*（精确版），旨在通过优化梯度贡献来平衡客户端间的性能。
AI.result: 在异构基准测试中，FairGrad 和 FairGrad* 相比现有方法能更稳定地提高公平性，并保持或提升了整体的平均性能。
AI.conclusion: FairGrad 和 FairGrad* 有效地通过正则化手段降低了客户端准确率的方差，在实现性能公平的同时保持了良好的整体模型性能。
AI.translation: 联邦学习（FL）允许在不共享原始数据的情况下跨多个参与方协作训练机器学习模型。然而，异构数据可能导致某些客户端对全局模型产生不成比例的影响，从而导致其性能出现差异。因此，公平性（即减少这些差异）是联邦学习中的一个关键问题，并已通过各种方式得到解决。我们研究了联邦学习中的性能均衡公平性，其目标是最小化客户端之间的性能差异。我们评估了几种现有的公平感知方法，并在此介绍了一种新的梯度方差正则化方法，该方法有两种变体：FairGrad（近似）和 FairGrad*（精确）。我们从理论上描述了这些方法之间的联系，并在异构基准测试中通过经验证明，与现有的公平感知基线相比，FairGrad 和 FairGrad* 通过减少客户端准确率的方差，持续提高了公平性，同时保持了竞争性或更高的平均性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对联邦学习中因数据异构导致的客户端性能不公平问题，提出了一种基于梯度方差正则化的新方法 FairGrad 和 FairGrad*，通过理论分析和实验验证，证明了该方法在减少性能差异和提升平均性能方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, 公平性, 梯度方差正则化, 数据异构性
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的基于梯度方差正则化的公平联邦学习方法，通过直接调节客户端梯度贡献的方差来改善性能均衡，在处理异构数据带来的不公平性方面具有较好的理论支持和实验表现。

title: Hybrid Sequence Modeling and Reinforced Verification for Controllable Target-Conditioned Decision Making
summary: Target-conditioned sequence models provide a simple interface for controllable offline decision making, but the requested target return can be an unreliable control signal, especially when the target return lies in underrepresented regions of the dataset. This paper proposes Doctor, a hybrid sequence modeling and reinforced verification framework for controllable target-conditioned offline decision making. Doctor trains a shared masked trajectory Transformer with two complementary objectives: masked trajectory reconstruction for candidate generation and in-sample value learning for action-value verification. At inference time, the model samples multiple nearby target returns, generates candidate actions in parallel, and selects the action whose verified value is closest to the requested target return. We analyze this verifier-guided selection rule and show that its value-level alignment error is bounded by candidate-value coverage around the target return and verifier accuracy. Experiments on D4RL and EpiCare show that Doctor improves target-return alignment under reduced high-return coverage, remains competitive on standard offline return-maximization benchmarks, and enables a single policy to modulate between conservative and aggressive operating points in a simulated clinical decision-making task. These results suggest that reinforced verification can improve the controllability of target-conditioned policies.

AI.title_translation: 用于可控目标条件决策的混合序列建模与强化验证方法
AI.tldr: Doctor框架通过在生成动作的同时进行价值验证，解决了离线决策中目标回报信号不可靠的问题，大幅提升了策略的可控性。
AI.motivation: 目标条件序列模型中的目标回报往往是不可靠的控制信号，特别是在数据集覆盖不足的区域，导致模型难以准确实现预期的目标回报。
AI.method: 提出Doctor框架，采用共享掩码轨迹Transformer，包含掩码轨迹重建（候选生成）和样本内价值学习（动作验证）两个目标；推理时并行生成候选动作，利用验证器选择价值最接近目标回报的动作。
AI.result: 在D4RL和EpiCare数据集上表现优异，提升了在低高回报覆盖率下的目标回报对齐能力，在标准离线回报最大化基准上具有竞争力，并能实现保守到激进的策略调节。
AI.conclusion: Doctor框架通过强化验证机制显著提高了目标条件决策的鲁棒性和可控性，证明了在离线强化学习中引入价值验证是提升策略灵活性的有效途径。
AI.translation: 目标条件序列模型为可控离线决策提供了一种简单的接口，但所请求的目标回报可能是一个不可靠的控制信号，尤其是在目标回报位于数据集代表性不足的区域时。本文提出了Doctor，这是一个用于可控目标条件离线决策的混合序列建模和强化验证框架。Doctor使用两个互补的目标训练共享掩码轨迹Transformer：用于候选生成的掩码轨迹重建和用于动作价值验证的样本内价值学习。在推理时，模型采样多个邻近的目标回报，并行生成候选动作，并选择其验证价值最接近所请求目标回报的动作。我们分析了这种验证器引导的选择规则，并证明其价值级对齐误差受限于目标回报周围的候选价值覆盖范围和验证器准确性。在D4RL和EpiCare上的实验表明，Doctor在高回报覆盖率降低的情况下改善了目标回报对齐，在标准离线回报最大化基准上保持了竞争力，并使单一策略能够在模拟临床决策任务中在保守和激进的操作点之间进行调节。这些结果表明，强化验证可以提高目标条件策略的可控性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Doctor框架，通过结合掩码轨迹重建和价值验证，解决了目标条件离线决策中目标回报不可靠的问题，从而实现了更精准的策略可控性。
AI.keywords: 目标条件决策, 序列建模, 强化验证, 离线强化学习, 策略可控性
AI.comments: 该论文通过结合序列建模（生成）和强化验证（判别）机制，有效解决了目标条件决策中目标回报信号不可靠的问题。创新点在于将传统生成任务转化为带约束的验证选择问题，提升了策略的可控性，特别是在数据分布稀疏或极端情况下的表现。

title: Segmentation and Classification of Pap Smear Images for Cervical Cancer Detection Using Deep Learning
comments: Version 2: Added recent references, updated Figure 1, and improved manuscript presentation
summary: Cervical cancer remains a significant global health concern and a leading cause of cancer-related deaths among women. Early detection through Pap smear tests is essential to reduce mortality rates; however, the manual examination is time consuming and prone to human error. This study proposes a deep learning framework that integrates U-Net for segmentation and a classification model to enhance diagnostic performance. The Herlev Pap Smear Dataset, a publicly available cervical cell dataset, was utilized for training and evaluation. The impact of segmentation on classification performance was evaluated by comparing the model trained on segmented images and another trained on non-segmented images. Experimental results showed that the use of segmented images marginally improved the model performance on precision (about 0.41 percent higher) and F1-score (about 1.30 percent higher), which suggests a slightly more balanced classification performance. While segmentation helps in feature extraction, the results showed that its impact on classification performance appears to be limited. The proposed framework offers a supplemental tool for clinical applications, which may aid pathologists in early diagnosis.

AI.title_translation: 基于深度学习的宫颈涂片图像分割与分类及其在宫颈癌检测中的应用
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合U-Net分割的深度学习宫颈癌筛查框架，研究发现图像分割对分类性能的提升作用非常有限。
AI.motivation: 宫颈癌早期筛查中人工阅片耗时且易出错，旨在通过深度学习自动化技术提升诊断效率与准确性。
AI.method: 利用U-Net模型对宫颈涂片进行图像分割，并结合分类模型进行诊断；通过对比在分割与未分割图像上训练的模型性能来评估分割的影响。
AI.result: 实验表明，使用分割图像相比未分割图像，精确率（precision）提升约0.41%，F1-score提升约1.30%，显示分割对分类性能的提升作用较小。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习框架（U-Net分割+分类模型）可作为宫颈癌早期筛查的辅助工具，但实验表明，图像分割对分类性能的提升作用较为有限。
AI.translation: 宫颈癌仍然是一个重大的全球健康问题，也是导致女性癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一。通过宫颈涂片检查进行早期检测对于降低死亡率至关重要；然而，人工检查耗时且容易出现人为错误。本研究提出了一个深度学习框架，整合了用于分割的U-Net和用于增强诊断性能的分类模型。研究使用了公开的Herlev宫颈细胞数据集进行训练和评估。通过比较在分割图像和未分割图像上训练的模型，评估了分割对分类性能的影响。实验结果表明，使用分割图像在精确率（高约0.41%）和F1分数（高约1.30%）上对模型性能有小幅改善，这表明分类性能更加平衡。虽然分割有助于特征提取，但结果显示其对分类性能的影响似乎有限。所提出的框架为临床应用提供了一种补充工具，可能有助于病理学家进行早期诊断。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种结合U-Net分割与分类模型的深度学习框架，用于宫颈涂片图像的自动分析。通过在Herlev数据集上的对比实验，验证了分割预处理对分类性能的影响，结果显示其性能提升有限，但该框架仍可作为辅助病理学家进行早期筛查的有效工具。
AI.keywords: 宫颈癌, 深度学习, 图像分割, 宫颈涂片, 计算机辅助诊断
AI.comments: 该研究通过对比实验量化了图像分割对宫颈涂片分类任务的实际增益，指出分割虽然在理论上辅助特征提取，但在当前深度学习框架下对最终分类性能的提升效果有限，这一发现对后续相关领域的研究设计具有参考价值。

title: FALCON: Transforming Cyber Threat Intelligence into Deployable IDS Rules with Self-Reflection
summary: Signature-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) detect malicious activity by matching network or host events against predefined rules. Security analysts manually develop these rules from Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI). As threats evolve, this manual pipeline faces two bottlenecks. Before authoring a new rule, an analyst must reconcile the incoming CTI with the existing rule base and determine whether to create, update, or retire one. This process is challenging due to the representational differences between the CTI and Rule formats. This gap limits the effectiveness of keyword- and embedding-based search, making rule reconciliation cognitively demanding and, in turn, contributing to "rule bloat". Second, automated verification of a new rule is inherently difficult as zero-day threats lack ground truth from simulated testing. Hence, standard metrics cannot prove that a rule semantically adheres to the CTI, and the use of LLMs leads to non-deterministic behavior. To address these challenges, we introduce FALCON, an agentic framework for CTI-grounded rule retrieval, generation, and validation. At its core, a novel CTI-Rule semantic scorer, quantifies the functional alignment between a CTI and a rule; the same signal drives a retriever that surfaces relevant deployed rules and a ground-truth-free validator that scores generated ones. Around it, a generation pipeline produces deployable rules from CTI in real time and refines them through self-reflective syntactic, semantic, and performance validators. Across network (Snort) and host-based (YARA) platforms on a purpose-built CTI-Rule dataset, FALCON attains a mean relevance of 0.72 (approx), with 84% inter-rater agreement among cybersecurity analysts, underscoring the promise of real-time security automation.

AI.title_translation: FALCON：利用自反思将网络威胁情报转化为可部署的 IDS 规则
AI.tldr: FALCON 是一款自动化的 IDS 规则生成工具，通过自反思机制和语义评分技术，解决了威胁情报转化中的语义鸿沟与验证难题，提升了安全防御的自动化水平。
AI.motivation: 现有手动将网络威胁情报（CTI）转化为入侵检测（IDS）规则的流程存在两大瓶颈：一是 CTI 与规则格式的语义差异导致规则冗余；二是缺乏基准测试使得零日威胁的自动规则验证变得极其困难。
AI.method: 开发了 FALCON 代理框架，核心包括一个 CTI-Rule 语义评分器，用于量化 CTI 与规则的功能对齐；利用该评分器驱动检索器和无需基准测试的验证器；并通过包含语法、语义和性能检查的自反思管道生成并优化可部署规则。
AI.result: 在 Snort 和 YARA 平台上测试表明，FALCON 的平均相关性达到约 0.72，且网络安全分析师之间的一致性达到 84%，证明了其在实时安全自动化方面的潜力。
AI.conclusion: FALCON 通过代理框架实现了从 CTI 到 IDS 规则的自动化生成与验证，显著提升了安全响应效率，并有效缓解了规则冗余问题。
AI.translation: 基于签名的入侵检测系统（IDS）通过将网络或主机事件与预定义规则进行匹配来检测恶意活动。安全分析师通常手动根据网络威胁情报（CTI）开发这些规则。随着威胁的演变，这种手动流程面临两个瓶颈。在编写新规则之前，分析师必须协调传入的 CTI 与现有规则库，并决定是创建、更新还是废弃规则。由于 CTI 和规则格式之间的表示差异，此过程极具挑战性。这种差距限制了基于关键词和嵌入的搜索效果，使得规则协调在认知上要求很高，进而导致了“规则臃肿”。其次，新规则的自动验证本质上很困难，因为零日威胁缺乏模拟测试的基准事实。因此，标准指标无法证明规则在语义上符合 CTI，而使用大语言模型（LLM）会导致不确定的行为。为了解决这些挑战，我们引入了 FALCON，这是一个用于 CTI 驱动的规则检索、生成和验证的代理框架。其核心是一个新颖的 CTI-Rule 语义评分器，用于量化 CTI 与规则之间的功能对齐；相同的信号驱动了一个检索器，用于呈现相关的已部署规则，以及一个无需基准事实的验证器，用于对生成的规则进行评分。围绕此核心，生成管道实时从 CTI 产生可部署规则，并通过自反思的语法、语义和性能验证器对其进行完善。在构建的 CTI-Rule 数据集上，FALCON 在网络（Snort）和基于主机（YARA）的平台上平均相关性达到 0.72（约），网络安全分析师之间的一致性达到 84%，突显了实时安全自动化的前景。
AI.summary: FALCON 是一个旨在将网络威胁情报（CTI）自动转化为可部署 IDS 规则的代理框架。它通过创新的语义评分器和自反思验证机制，解决了规则维护中的语义鸿沟和缺乏基准验证的问题，实现了规则的实时生成与优化。
AI.keywords: 网络威胁情报, 入侵检测系统, 规则生成, 自反思, 安全自动化
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入“自反思”机制解决了自动化规则生成中的幻觉和语义偏差问题，创新性地提出了不依赖基准测试的验证方法。其局限性可能在于对复杂多变攻击模式的泛化能力，以及在实际生产环境中的实时性能表现。

title: On the Outage Probability of Multiuser Multiple Antenna Systems with Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access for Air-Ground Communications
comments: 16 pages, 10 figures; Revised version; under review in IEEE Transactions on Vehicular Technology
summary: This paper explores multiuser multiple antenna systems as a means to enhance the spectral efficiency of aeronautical communications systems. To this end, the outage regime for a multiuser multiple antenna system is studied within a realistic geometry-based stochastic air-ground (AG) channel model. In this application, users (aircraft) transmit air traffic management data to the ground station at a predefined target rate. Due to the nature of the AG propagation, we argue that the relevant performance metric in this context is the information outage probability. We consider the outage probability of individual aircraft under three decoding approaches. The first is based on successive interference cancellation (SIC). The second extends the first approach by considering joint group decoding. The third is a version of the second that limits the size of the jointly decoded user groups in order to lower the decoding complexity. The results show that joint group decoding, even in groups of only two, can significantly increase the spectral efficiency in the AG channel by allowing a large number of aircraft to transmit over a non-orthogonal channel with very low outage probabilities.

title: On a class of twisted elliptic curve codes
summary: Motivated by the studies of twisted generalized Reed-Solomon (TGRS) codes, we initiate the study of twisted elliptic curve codes (TECCs) in this paper. In particular, we study a class of TECCs with one twist. The parity-check matrices of the TECCs are explicitly given by computing the Weil differentials. Then the sufficient and necessary conditions of self-duality are presented. The minimum distances of the TECCs are also determined. Moreover, examples of MDS, AMDS, self-dual and MDS self-dual TECCs are given. Finally, we calculate the dimensions of the Schur squares of TECCs and show the non-equivalence between TECCs and ECCs/GRS codes.

AI.title_translation: 关于一类扭曲椭圆曲线码的研究
AI.tldr: 本文提出了扭曲椭圆曲线码（TECCs），通过Weil微分给出了其构造，并分析了其自对偶性、最小距离及Schur平方等关键代数性质。
AI.motivation: 受扭曲通用Reed-Solomon（TGRS）码研究的启发，旨在将扭曲的概念引入椭圆曲线码，以探索新型纠错码的构造及其性质。
AI.method: 利用Weil微分推导TECCs的校验矩阵；通过代数几何方法分析自对偶条件、最小距离以及Schur平方的维度。
AI.result: 给出了TECCs的校验矩阵，确定了其自对偶的充要条件及最小距离，展示了MDS、AMDS及自对偶TECCs的实例，并证明了其与ECC/GRS码在非等价性上的区别。

AI.summary: 本文研究了一类单扭曲的扭曲椭圆曲线码（TECCs）。作者通过Weil微分构造了其校验矩阵，分析了自对偶条件和最小距离，并提供了相关码类的实例，同时探讨了其Schur平方维度及与现有码的非等价性。
AI.keywords: 扭曲椭圆曲线码, Weil微分, 自对偶, 最小距离, Schur平方
AI.comments: 该论文将扭曲通用Reed-Solomon码的概念推广到了椭圆曲线码，通过Weil微分显式构造校验矩阵并分析了其代数性质（如自对偶性和最小距离），这是对代数几何码领域的重要理论扩展。其局限性在于未探讨更广泛的纠错性能或实际应用场景。

title: Breaking the Mirror: Activation-Based Mitigation of Self-Preference in LLM Evaluators
comments: Presented at {Mechanistic Interpretability, Evaluations, Reliable-ML} Workshops, NeurIPS 2025
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve as automated evaluators, yet they suffer from "self-preference bias": a tendency to favor their own outputs over those of other models. This bias undermines fairness and reliability in evaluation pipelines, particularly for tasks like preference tuning and model routing. We investigate whether lightweight steering vectors can mitigate this problem at inference time without retraining. We introduce a curated dataset that distinguishes self-preference bias into justified examples of self-preference and unjustified examples of self-preference, and we construct steering vectors using two methods: Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) and an optimization-based approach. Our results show that steering vectors can reduce unjustified self-preference bias by up to 97\%, substantially outperforming prompting and direct preference optimization baselines. Yet steering vectors are unstable on legitimate self-preference and unbiased agreement, implying self-preference spans multiple or nonlinear directions. This underscores both their promise and limits as safeguards for LLM-as-judges and motivates more robust interventions.

AI.title_translation: 打破镜像：基于激活的LLM评估者自我偏好缓解策略
AI.tldr: 通过在推理时注入引导向量，可显著减少LLM作为评估者时的不合理自我偏好，但该方法在区分合法偏好时仍存在局限。
AI.motivation: 解决大语言模型作为评估者时存在的“自我偏好偏差”问题，即模型倾向于优先选择自己生成的输出，从而影响评估的公平性与可靠性。
AI.method: 构建包含合理与不合理自我偏好的数据集，通过对比激活添加（CAA）和基于优化的方法构建引导向量，在推理阶段进行干预。
AI.result: 研究表明，引导向量可将不合理的自我偏好偏差降低高达97%，性能优于提示工程和直接偏好优化（DPO）。但在面对合理的自我偏好或无偏见一致性时，引导向量表现出不稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 基于激活的干预手段能显著降低LLM评估中的不合理自我偏好，但由于自我偏好在模型内部表现为复杂或非线性的方向，该方法在处理合法偏好时存在不稳定性，仍需更稳健的干预技术。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）正日益成为自动评估者，但它们深受“自我偏好偏差”困扰：即倾向于偏爱自己的输出而非其他模型的输出。这种偏好削弱了评估流程的公平性和可靠性，特别是在偏好调整和模型路由等任务中。我们探讨了轻量级引导向量是否能在推理阶段无需重训练的情况下缓解这一问题。我们引入了一个精心策划的数据集，将自我偏好偏差区分为合理的自我偏好和不合理的自我偏好，并使用两种方法构建引导向量：对比激活添加（CAA）和一种基于优化的方法。结果表明，引导向量可将不合理的自我偏好偏差降低高达97%，显著优于提示工程和直接偏好优化基准。然而，引导向量在处理合理的自我偏好和无偏见一致性时表现不稳定，这意味着自我偏好跨越了多个或非线性的方向。这既强调了它们作为LLM评估者保障措施的前景与局限，也激发了对更稳健干预措施的需求。
AI.summary: 本文针对LLM评估者中的“自我偏好偏差”问题，探讨了无需重训练的轻量级引导向量方案。通过构建特殊数据集并利用对比激活添加等方法，研究验证了该方案在降低不合理偏好方面的巨大潜力，同时也揭示了其在处理复杂偏好场景时的局限性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 自我偏好偏差, 激活引导向量, 模型评估, 对比激活添加
AI.comments: 该研究通过激活空间干预（steering vectors）解决LLM评估中的自我偏好偏差，这是一个创新且高效的方向，无需重训练。尽管效果显著，但论文坦诚地指出在区分合理与不合理偏好时的不稳定性，为后续研究提供了明确的改进空间。

title: VoltanaLLM: Energy-Efficient and SLO-Aware Disaggregated LLM Serving via Adaptive Frequency Control and State-Space Routing
summary: The energy cost of Large Language Model (LLM) inference is rapidly becoming a barrier to sustainable and scalable deployment. Although modern serving architectures expose distinct prefill and decode behaviors, existing systems fail to exploit these phase differences for energy-efficient serving under strict latency SLOs. This paper introduces VoltanaLLM, the first system that explicitly targets and reduces the energy bloat in modern prefill-decode (P/D) disaggregated LLM serving. Guided by a control-theory perspective, VoltanaLLM separates two levers: per-instance operating-point selection (GPU frequency per iteration) and system-level state-space routing of requests. We empirically observe that LLM inference exhibits a U-shaped energy-frequency curve creating "sweet spots" that depend on phase behavior and load. VoltanaLLM exploits this by combining phase-specific, iteration-level frequency selection driven by a lightweight, online-adaptive latency predictor, with a decode state-space guided router that avoids architectural granularity-induced inefficiencies, all while meeting desired SLOs. We implement VoltanaLLM using SGLang and evaluate it across multiple models and real-world workloads. Our results show VoltanaLLM reduces end-to-end energy by up to 36.3% versus a static max-frequency baseline while maintaining high SLO attainment, and generalizes to newer GPUs. These results point to sustainable LLM serving via phase-aware, iteration-level frequency selection coupled with architecture-aware routing. Source code is available in https://github.com/Supercomputing-System-AI-Lab/VoltanaLLM.

AI.title_translation: VoltanaLLM：通过自适应频率控制和状态空间路由实现节能且符合SLO的解耦LLM服务
AI.tldr: VoltanaLLM通过动态调整GPU频率和智能路由请求，在满足延迟要求的前提下，将LLM推理能耗降低了最多36.3%。
AI.motivation: 现代LLM推理的能耗问题日益严重，现有的服务架构未能充分利用预填充与解码阶段的不同特性，在满足严格延迟SLO的同时实现能效最优。
AI.method: 1. 引入控制理论视角，实现基于相位（预填充/解码）的迭代级GPU频率动态调整；2. 开发轻量级在线自适应延迟预测器；3. 设计解码状态空间导向的路由机制，以规避架构粒度带来的效率损失。
AI.result: 在多个模型和真实负载测试中，相比静态最高频率基准，VoltanaLLM在保持高SLO达成率的同时，将端到端能耗降低了高达36.3%。
AI.conclusion: VoltanaLLM通过相位感知的频率控制和架构感知的路由机制，在满足严格SLO的前提下，显著降低了LLM推理的能耗，为可持续的AI服务部署提供了有效解决方案。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）推理的能源成本正迅速成为可持续和可扩展部署的障碍。尽管现代服务架构表现出明显的预填充（prefill）和解码（decode）行为差异，但现有系统未能利用这些阶段性差异在严格的延迟SLO下实现节能服务。本文介绍了VoltanaLLM，这是第一个明确针对并减少现代预填充-解码（P/D）解耦LLM服务中能源浪费的系统。在控制理论视角的指导下，VoltanaLLM分离了两个控制杠杆：单实例运行点选择（每次迭代的GPU频率）和系统级请求状态空间路由。我们凭经验观察到，LLM推理表现出U型的能量-频率曲线，产生了取决于阶段行为和负载的“甜点”。VoltanaLLM通过结合由轻量级在线自适应延迟预测器驱动的特定阶段、迭代级频率选择，以及避免架构粒度引起效率低下的解码状态空间引导路由，同时满足所需的SLO，从而利用了这一特性。我们使用SGLang实现了VoltanaLLM，并跨多个模型和真实世界负载进行了评估。我们的结果表明，与静态最大频率基准相比，VoltanaLLM在保持高SLO达成率的同时，将端到端能耗降低了高达36.3%，并可推广到更新的GPU。这些结果表明，通过相位感知、迭代级频率选择与架构感知路由相结合，可以实现可持续的LLM服务。源代码可在https://github.com/Supercomputing-System-AI-Lab/VoltanaLLM获取。
AI.summary: VoltanaLLM是一个针对LLM解耦服务架构设计的能效优化系统。它通过识别推理过程中预填充与解码阶段的能效差异，结合迭代级GPU频率控制与状态空间驱动的请求路由，在确保满足服务水平目标（SLO）的同时，显著降低了推理能耗。
AI.keywords: 大模型推理, 能效优化, GPU频率控制, 请求路由, 服务质量(SLO)
AI.comments: VoltanaLLM通过控制理论视角，将GPU频率控制与请求调度相结合，巧妙利用了LLM推理中预填充（Prefill）和解码（Decode）阶段的能效差异，为解决大模型推理能耗问题提供了一种系统级优化思路，具有很高的实用价值。

title: ORQ: Complex Analytics on Private Data with Strong Security Guarantees
comments: Extended version, appeared at SOSP 2025. Code available at https://github.com/CASP-Systems-BU/orq
summary:
We present ORQ, a system that enables collaborative analysis of large private datasets using cryptographically secure multi-party computation (MPC). ORQ protects data against semi-honest or malicious parties and can efficiently evaluate relational queries with multi-way joins and aggregations that have been considered notoriously expensive under MPC. To do so, ORQ eliminates the quadratic cost of secure joins by leveraging the fact that, in practice, the structure of many real queries allows us to join records and apply the aggregations "on the fly" while keeping the result size bounded. On the system side, ORQ contributes generic oblivious operators, a data-parallel vectorized query engine, a communication layer that amortizes MPC network costs, and a dataflow API for expressing relational analytics -- all built from the ground up.
  We evaluate ORQ in LAN and WAN deployments on a diverse set of workloads, including complex queries with multiple joins and custom aggregations. When compared to state-of-the-art solutions, ORQ significantly reduces MPC execution times and can process one order of magnitude larger datasets. For our most challenging workload, the full TPC-H benchmark, we report results entirely under MPC with Scale Factor 10 -- a scale that had previously been achieved only with information leakage or the use of trusted third parties.

title: "GenAI Defaults to Bias!" Gamify AI Literacy Through Reflections on Prompts
summary: As Generative AI (GenAI) becomes widespread, it is increasingly important for the public to understand the model's behaviors and biases. However, existing AI literacy efforts miss opportunities to engage the general public to reflect on enduring GenAI bias and behaviors (e.g., how GenAI defaults to its internal bias in response to ambiguous or challenging prompts). In this work, we introduce ImaginAItion, a multiplayer game to help adults better reflect on GenAI bias and understand GenAI behaviors. ImaginAItion is grounded in reflective play to surface GenAI limitations by encouraging players to manipulate prompt specificity (e.g., an underspecified prompt "CEO" defaults to a white man). From ten sessions (n=30), we find that the game significantly improved players' understanding of GenAI behaviors by 35% in accuracy. Qualitative analysis showed how game mechanisms supported player reflections, including on prompting strategies to mitigate GenAI bias. Our work demonstrates a viable pathway to scale GenAI literacy through playful, social interventions resilient to rapidly evolving technologies.

AI.title_translation: “生成式AI默认偏见！”通过提示词反思游戏化AI素养教育
AI.tldr: 通过一款名为ImaginAItion的多人游戏，引导用户通过反思提示词来识别并理解生成式AI的默认偏见，显著提升了公众的AI素养。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI的普及，公众迫切需要理解其行为和偏见，但现有的AI素养教育缺乏有效方式引导公众反思AI在面对模糊或挑战性提示词时表现出的默认偏见。
AI.method: 开发了一款名为“ImaginAItion”的多人游戏，通过让玩家操控提示词的详细程度（例如通过模糊提示词揭示AI的刻板印象），引导用户在反思性游戏中识别并理解生成式AI的局限性和默认偏见。
AI.result: 基于10场游戏测试（n=30），结果显示玩家对生成式AI行为的理解准确率显著提升了35%；定性分析表明游戏机制有效支持了玩家对减轻AI偏见的提示策略的反思。
AI.conclusion: 通过游戏化互动（ImaginAItion）是提升公众AI素养、促进对生成式AI偏见进行反思的有效途径，能够跨越技术快速更迭带来的教育滞后。
AI.translation: 随着生成式AI（GenAI）的普及，让公众理解模型行为和偏见变得日益重要。然而，现有的AI素养教育错失了引导公众对生成式AI长期存在的偏见和行为（例如，生成式AI在面对模糊或挑战性提示词时如何默认其内部偏见）进行反思的机会。在这项工作中，我们介绍了ImaginAItion，这是一款旨在帮助成年人更好地反思生成式AI偏见并理解其行为的多人游戏。ImaginAItion基于反思性游戏，通过鼓励玩家操纵提示词的详细程度来揭示生成式AI的局限性（例如，不具体的提示词“首席执行官”会默认生成白人男性形象）。通过十次测试（n=30），我们发现该游戏使玩家对生成式AI行为的理解准确率显著提高了35%。定性分析表明，游戏机制如何支持玩家进行反思，包括对减轻生成式AI偏见的提示策略的反思。我们的工作展示了一条通过有趣的社会化干预来扩展生成式AI素养的可行途径，这种方式能够适应技术的快速发展。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了ImaginAItion，这是一款旨在提升大众AI素养的多人游戏。通过让玩家在游戏中通过修改提示词来探索AI的局限性，该工具成功帮助用户反思生成式AI的默认偏见，并显著提高了用户对AI行为的理解。

title: MOCHA: Multi-modal Objects-aware Cross-arcHitecture Alignment
comments: 18 pages main paper, 10 pages supplementary material
summary: Personalized object detection aims to adapt a general-purpose detector to recognize user-specific instances from only a few examples. Lightweight models often struggle in this setting due to their weak semantic priors, while large vision-language models (VLMs) offer strong object-level understanding but are too computationally demanding for real-time or on-device applications. We introduce MOCHA (Multi-modal Objects-aware Cross-arcHitecture Alignment), a distillation framework that transfers multimodal region-level knowledge from a frozen VLM teacher into a lightweight vision-only detector. MOCHA extracts fused visual and textual teacher's embeddings and uses them to guide student training through a dual-objective loss that enforces accurate local alignment and global relational consistency across regions. This process enables efficient transfer of semantics without the need for teacher modifications or textual input at inference. MOCHA consistently outperforms prior baselines across four personalized detection benchmarks under strict few-shot regimes, yielding a +10.1 average improvement, with minimal inference cost.

title: Modeling User Redemption Behavior in Complex Incentive Digital Environment: An Empirical Study Using Large-Scale Transactional Data
summary: The digital economy implements complex incentive systems to retain users through point redemption. Understanding user behavior in such complex incentive structures presents a fundamental challenge, especially in estimating the value of these digital assets against traditional money. This study tackles this question by analyzing large-scale, real-world transaction data from a popular personal finance application that captures both monetary spending and point-based transactions. We find that point usage is linked to demographics. Our analysis using a natural experiment and a causal inference technique reveals that a large point grant stimulated an increase in point spending without a detectable effect on cash expenditure. We then find an association between consumers' shopping styles and their point redemption patterns. This study, on a massive real-world economic ecosystem, examines how consumers behave in multi-currency environments, with direct implications for modeling economic behavior and designing digital platforms.

AI.title_translation: 复杂激励数字环境下的用户兑换行为建模：基于大规模交易数据的实证研究
AI.tldr: 该研究利用大规模交易数据分析发现，积分发放能显著增加用户的积分使用，但不会影响其现金支出，且积分兑换行为与用户的购物风格及人口特征密切相关。
AI.motivation: 数字经济中复杂的激励系统（如积分兑换）对用户留存至关重要，但如何量化积分价值并理解用户在多货币环境下的消费行为仍是难题。
AI.method: 利用大规模真实交易数据，采用自然实验与因果推断技术进行实证分析。
AI.result: 积分使用与人口统计学特征相关；大规模积分发放增加了积分消费，但未对现金支出产生可检测的影响；消费者的购物风格影响其积分兑换模式。
AI.conclusion: 积分发放能有效刺激积分消费，但对现金支出无显著影响；消费者的购物风格与积分兑换模式存在关联，数字经济中存在多货币并行的特殊消费行为。
AI.translation: 数字经济通过积分兑换实施复杂的激励系统以留住用户。理解这种复杂激励结构下的用户行为是一个根本性的挑战，特别是在评估这些数字资产相对于传统货币的价值方面。本研究通过分析来自一个流行个人金融应用的大规模真实交易数据（涵盖了货币支出和基于积分的交易）来解决这一问题。我们发现积分使用与人口统计学特征相关。我们使用自然实验和因果推断技术进行的分析揭示，大规模的积分发放刺激了积分消费的增加，但对现金支出没有可检测到的影响。我们还发现消费者的购物风格与他们的积分兑换模式之间存在关联。这项研究在一个大规模的现实经济生态系统中，探讨了消费者如何在多货币环境中表现，对建模经济行为和设计数字平台具有直接意义。
AI.summary: 本文通过分析个人金融应用的大规模交易数据，研究了数字经济中复杂的积分激励系统如何影响用户消费行为，揭示了积分发放对消费的刺激作用及其与用户特征的关联。
AI.keywords: 数字经济, 积分兑换, 用户行为, 因果推断, 多货币环境
AI.comments: 该研究通过大规模真实交易数据分析数字经济中的积分兑换行为，具有很高的实证价值。其创新点在于将因果推断技术应用于多货币（现金与积分）环境下的用户行为建模，为数字平台的积分系统设计提供了科学依据。局限性在于结论可能受限于该特定金融应用的用户群体特征。

title: LoT-Pass: Long-term-robust Image Watermarking for Image to Video Generation
summary: The rapid progress of image-guided video generation (I2V) has raised concerns about its potential misuse in misinformation and fraud, underscoring the urgent need for effective digital watermarking. While existing watermarking methods demonstrate robustness within a single modality, they fail to trace source images in I2V settings. To address this gap, we introduce the concept of Robust Diffusion Distance, which measures the temporal persistence of watermark signals in generated videos. Building on this, we propose I2VWM, a cross-modal watermarking framework designed to enhance watermark robustness across time. I2VWM leverages a video-simulation noise layer during training and employs an optical-flow-based alignment module during inference. Experiments on both open-source and commercial I2V models demonstrate that I2VWM significantly improves robustness while maintaining imperceptibility, establishing a new paradigm for cross-modal watermarking in the era of generative video. \href{https://github.com/MrCrims/I2VWM-Robust-Watermarking-for-Image-to-Video-Generation}{Code Released.}

AI.title_translation: LoT-Pass：面向图像到视频生成的长期鲁棒图像水印技术
AI.tldr: 针对图像到视频生成任务，提出了一种名为 I2VWM 的跨模态水印框架，通过光流对齐和专门的训练策略，实现了视频生成过程中的高鲁棒性溯源。
AI.motivation: 现有水印方法主要针对单一模态，无法有效应对图像到视频生成（I2V）任务中跨模态转换带来的信息丢失，导致无法溯源，因此需要一种针对 I2V 的鲁棒水印方案。
AI.method: 提出“鲁棒扩散距离”来衡量视频中的水印持久性；构建 I2VWM 框架，在训练阶段引入视频模拟噪声层，在推理阶段使用基于光流的对齐模块。
AI.result: 在开源和商业 I2V 模型上的实验表明，I2VWM 在显著提高水印鲁棒性的同时，保持了良好的不可感知性。
AI.conclusion: I2VWM 框架成功实现了跨模态水印的鲁棒性提升，为解决图像到视频生成领域的滥用和版权问题提供了一种有效且隐蔽的解决方案。
AI.translation: 图像引导视频生成（I2V）的快速发展引发了人们对其在虚假信息和欺诈中潜在滥用的担忧，突显了对有效数字水印的迫切需求。虽然现有的水印方法在单一模态内表现出鲁棒性，但它们无法在 I2V 设置中追踪源图像。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了鲁棒扩散距离的概念，用于衡量生成视频中水印信号的时间持久性。在此基础上，我们提出了 I2VWM，这是一种旨在增强跨时间水印鲁棒性的跨模态水印框架。I2VWM 在训练过程中利用视频模拟噪声层，并在推理过程中采用基于光流的对齐模块。在开源和商业 I2V 模型上的实验表明，I2VWM 在保持不可感知性的同时显著提高了鲁棒性，为生成式视频时代建立了一种跨模态水印的新范式。
AI.summary: 本文针对图像到视频生成（I2V）中的溯源难题，提出了 I2VWM 跨模态水印框架。通过引入鲁棒扩散距离衡量水印持久性，并结合视频模拟噪声训练与光流对齐推理技术，有效提升了水印在视频生成过程中的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 图像到视频生成, 数字水印, 跨模态鲁棒性, 光流对齐, 生成式AI安全
AI.comments: 该论文针对图像到视频生成（I2V）这一新兴领域中的版权溯源问题，提出了创新的“鲁棒扩散距离”概念，并设计了跨模态水印框架。其创新点在于将视频的时间维度纳入鲁棒性考量，通过光流对齐有效应对视频生成过程中的动态变化，具有很高的实用价值和前瞻性。

title: Policy Gradient with Self-Attention for Model-Free Distributed Nonlinear Multi-Agent Games
comments: The paper has been accepted and will be presented at IEEE/RSJ IROS 2026
summary: Multi-agent games in dynamic nonlinear settings are challenging due to the time-varying interactions among the agents and the non-stationarity of the (potential) Nash equilibria. In this paper we consider model-free games, where agent transitions and costs are observed without knowledge of the transition and cost functions that generate them. We propose a novel distributed policy structure that follows the communication constraints in multi-team games, with multiple agents per team, and learned through policy gradients. Our formulation is inspired by the structure of distributed policies in linear quadratic games, which take the form of time-varying linear feedback gains. In the nonlinear case, we model the policies as nonlinear feedback gains, parameterized by self-attention layers to account for the time-varying multi-agent communication topology. We demonstrate that our approach achieves strong performance in several settings, including distributed linear and nonlinear regulation, and simulated and real multi-robot pursuit-and-evasion games.

title: Self-CriTeach: LLM Self-Teaching and Self-Critiquing for Improving Robotic Planning via Automated Domain Generation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown strong promise for robotic task planning, particularly through automatic planning domain generation. However, prior approaches largely treat generated planning domains as planning utilities, which are brittle under imperfect logical states and perception noise, overlooking their potential as scalable sources of reasoning supervision and structured reward signals. At the same time, reasoning LLMs depend on chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision that is expensive to collect for robotic tasks, and reinforcement learning (RL) faces challenges in reward engineering. We propose Self-CriTeach, an LLM self-teaching and self-critiquing framework in which an LLM autonomously generates symbolic planning domains that serve a dual role: (1) enabling large-scale generation of robotic planning problem-plan pairs, and (2) providing structured reward functions. First, the self-written domains enable large-scale generation of symbolic task plans, which are automatically transformed into extended CoT trajectories for supervised fine-tuning. Second, the self-written domains are reused as structured reward functions, providing dense feedback for reinforcement learning without manual reward engineering. This unified training pipeline yields a planning-enhanced LLM with higher planning success rates, stronger cross-task generalization, reduced inference cost, and resistance to imperfect logical states. GitHub Page: https://markli1hoshipu.github.io/Plan_LLM/

AI.title_translation: Self-CriTeach：用于改进机器人规划的LLM自我教学与自我批判框架（基于自动化领域生成）
AI.tldr: Self-CriTeach利用LLM自动生成规划领域作为监督和奖励信号，从而在无需大量人工标注的情况下提升了机器人任务规划的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM机器人规划方法在面对感知噪声和逻辑不完备时表现脆弱，且高质量的思维链（CoT）数据获取昂贵，人工设计的奖励函数也极具挑战性。
AI.method: 提出Self-CriTeach框架，利用LLM自主生成符号化规划领域，一方面用于生成大规模任务规划对以进行监督微调，另一方面作为结构化奖励函数辅助强化学习。
AI.result: 该方法显著提高了机器人的规划成功率，增强了跨任务的泛化能力，降低了推理成本，并提升了对不完美逻辑状态的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: Self-CriTeach框架通过自我生成和自我批判机制，成功将LLM转化为高效的机器人规划器，在提升任务成功率和泛化能力的同时，降低了对人工监督和奖励工程的依赖。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）最近在机器人任务规划方面展现出巨大潜力，特别是在自动生成规划领域方面。然而，以往的方法大多将生成的规划领域仅视为规划工具，在面对不完美的逻辑状态和感知噪声时显得脆弱，忽视了它们作为可扩展推理监督来源和结构化奖励信号的潜力。同时，推理型LLMs依赖于思维链（CoT）监督，但这种监督在机器人任务中采集成本高昂，且强化学习在奖励工程方面面临挑战。我们提出了Self-CriTeach，这是一个LLM自我教学和自我批判框架，其中LLM自主生成符号规划领域并承担双重角色：（1）实现大规模机器人规划问题-计划对的生成；（2）提供结构化奖励函数。首先，自编写的领域能够大规模生成符号任务计划，这些计划被自动转化为扩展的CoT轨迹用于监督微调。其次，自编写的领域被复用为结构化奖励函数，为强化学习提供密集反馈，无需手动进行奖励工程。这一统一的训练流程产生了一个规划能力增强的LLM，具有更高的规划成功率、更强的跨任务泛化能力、更低的推理成本以及对不完美逻辑状态的抵抗力。
AI.summary: Self-CriTeach是一个通过LLM自我生成和批判规划领域来优化机器人任务规划的框架，通过将生成的领域用于大规模数据合成和结构化奖励计算，实现了无需繁琐人工干预的高效模型训练。
AI.keywords: 机器人规划, 大语言模型, 自我批判, 强化学习, 自动领域生成
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将LLM生成的规划领域（Planning Domains）作为一种监督信号和奖励机制，有效解决了机器人任务规划中训练数据匮乏和奖励函数设计困难的问题，是LLM在机器人领域应用的一个重要进展。

title: HyMaTE: A Hybrid Mamba and Transformer Model for EHR Representation Learning
comments: Proceedings of the 16th ACM International Conference on Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, and Health Informatics (BCB), 2025
summary: Electronic health Records (EHRs) have become a cornerstone in modern-day healthcare. They are a crucial part for analyzing the progression of patient health; however, their complexity, characterized by long, multivariate sequences, sparsity, and missing values poses significant challenges in traditional deep learning modeling. While Transformer-based models have demonstrated success in modeling EHR data and predicting clinical outcomes, their quadratic computational complexity and limited context length hinder their efficiency and practical applications. On the other hand, State Space Models (SSMs) like Mamba present a promising alternative offering linear-time sequence modeling and improved efficiency for handling long sequences, but focus mostly on mixing sequence-level information rather than channel-level data. To overcome these challenges, we propose HyMaTE (A Hybrid Mamba and Transformer Model for EHR Representation Learning), a novel hybrid model tailored for representing longitudinal data, combining the strengths of SSMs with advanced attention mechanisms. By testing the model on predictive tasks on multiple clinical datasets, we demonstrate HyMaTE's ability to capture an effective, richer, and more nuanced unified representation of EHR data. Additionally, the interpretability of the outcomes achieved by self-attention illustrates the effectiveness of our model as a scalable and generalizable solution for real-world healthcare applications. Codes are available at: https://github.com/healthylaife/HyMaTE.

AI.title_translation: HyMaTE：用于电子健康记录表示学习的混合 Mamba 和 Transformer 模型
AI.tldr: HyMaTE 结合 Mamba 和 Transformer 的优势，解决了 EHR 长序列建模中的效率瓶颈，并提升了临床预测的准确性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于 Transformer 的 EHR 模型存在二次计算复杂度和上下文长度限制的问题，而现有的 SSM 模型虽具备线性复杂度但缺乏对 EHR 数据中通道级信息的深入处理。
AI.method: 提出 HyMaTE 模型，通过结合状态空间模型（SSM/Mamba）的线性序列建模能力与 Transformer 的注意力机制，旨在同时捕获 EHR 数据中的序列级和通道级信息。
AI.result: 在多个临床数据集上的实验表明，HyMaTE 能够捕获更丰富、更细致的统一 EHR 表示，在预测任务中表现优异，并具备良好的可扩展性和解释性。
AI.conclusion: HyMaTE 是一种高效、可扩展且具备解释性的 EHR 表示学习框架，能够有效处理复杂的临床长序列数据，优于单一的 Transformer 或 SSM 模型。
AI.translation: 电子健康记录（EHR）已成为现代医疗的基石，是分析患者健康状况进展的关键。然而，其复杂性（表现为长且多变量的序列、稀疏性和缺失值）给传统的深度学习建模带来了巨大挑战。尽管基于 Transformer 的模型在建模 EHR 数据和预测临床结果方面取得了成功，但其二次计算复杂度和有限的上下文长度限制了它们的效率和实际应用。另一方面，诸如 Mamba 之类的状态空间模型（SSMs）提供了一种有前途的替代方案，通过线性时间序列建模提高了处理长序列的效率，但它们主要集中于混合序列级信息而非通道级数据。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了 HyMaTE（一种用于 EHR 表示学习的混合 Mamba 和 Transformer 模型），这是一种专为表示纵向数据而量身定制的新型混合模型，结合了 SSM 的优势与先进的注意力机制。通过在多个临床数据集上的预测任务测试，我们证明了 HyMaTE 能够捕获有效、丰富且细致的 EHR 数据统一表示。此外，自注意力机制所取得结果的可解释性，证明了我们的模型作为一种可扩展且通用的解决方案在现实医疗应用中的有效性。代码已开源。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 HyMaTE 模型，旨在解决 EHR 数据中长序列建模的效率与精度平衡问题。该模型结合了 Mamba 的线性序列建模优势与 Transformer 的注意力机制，实现了对 EHR 数据的有效特征表示，并在临床预测任务中表现出优越性与可解释性。
AI.keywords: 电子健康记录 (EHR), Mamba, Transformer, 表示学习, 长序列建模
AI.comments: 该论文通过结合Mamba（线性复杂度）和Transformer（强大的特征提取能力）的优势，解决了电子健康记录（EHR）中长序列建模的计算瓶颈问题。其创新点在于巧妙地融合了序列级建模与通道级建模，不仅提升了模型性能，还通过自注意力机制保留了临床决策所需的解释性，具有很高的实用价值。

title: RTFF: Random-to-Target Fabric Flattening Policy using Dual-Arm Manipulator
summary: Robotic fabric manipulation remains challenging due to fabric deformability and occlusions from wrinkles and the manipulator. This paper defines Random-to-Target Fabric Flattening (RTFF) as the task of bringing a randomly wrinkled fabric to an arbitrary user-specified wrinkle-free target pose. RTFF requires simultaneous flattening and pose alignment, where the two objectives are inherently coupled since flattening the fabric displaces its pose, while realigning it tends to introduce wrinkles. To solve this task, this paper anchors both the current and target fabric states to the same template mesh, enabling direct vertex-level wrinkle and pose assessment without registration. Building on this representation, a hybrid Imitation Learning--Visual Servoing (IL--VS) RTFF policy is proposed. A novel Mesh Action Chunking Transformer (MACT) leverages structured mesh observations to achieve goal-conditioned coarse alignment from a compact demonstration set, after which VS ensures precise convergence to the target. The policy is validated on a real dual-arm teleoperation system, demonstrating precise alignment to unseen target poses, fabric types, and scales. Code and videos: https://kaitang98.github.io/RTFF_Policy/

title: Removing Noise, not Finding Gold: Quality Filtering for Large-Scale Pretraining
comments: 21 pages, 22 figures, 2 tables, accepted at ICML 2026
summary: Large-scale models are pretrained on massive web-crawled datasets containing documents of mixed quality, making data filtering essential. A popular method is Classifier-based Quality Filtering (CQF), which trains a binary classifier to distinguish between pretraining data and a small, high-quality set. It assigns each pretraining document a quality score defined as the classifier's score and retains only the top-scoring ones. We provide an in-depth analysis of CQF. We show that while CQF improves downstream task performance, it does not necessarily enhance language modeling on the high-quality dataset. We explain this paradox by the fact that CQF implicitly filters the high-quality dataset as well. We further compare the behavior of models trained with CQF to those trained on synthetic data of increasing quality, obtained via random token permutations, and find starkly different trends. Our results challenge the view that CQF captures a meaningful notion of data quality.

title: A global log for medical AI
summary: Modern computer systems rely on syslog, a universal protocol that records critical events across heterogeneous infrastructure. Medicine's rapidly growing AI stack has no equivalent. As medicine deploys AI tools at scale, there is no standard way to record how, when, by whom, and for whom these models are used. Without such records, it is difficult to measure real-world performance and outcomes, detect adverse events, or identify bias and dataset drift. Here we introduce MedLog, a protocol for event-level logging of medical AI. Each time an AI model interacts with a human, another algorithm, or an automated workflow, MedLog creates a record. Each record contains nine core fields: header, model, user, target, inputs, artifacts, outputs, outcomes, and feedback. We apply MedLog across four deployments in the US, Switzerland, and Vietnam: ICU deterioration prediction, tetanus progression monitoring from wearable signals, automated sepsis quality reporting, and patient attendance prediction. MedLog records capture model behavior, workflow interactions, and downstream outcomes, including AI performance degradation during severe weather events in patient attendance prediction and increased laboratory testing after ICU deterioration alerts. MedLog limits the data footprint through risk-based sampling, lifecycle-aware retention policies, and write-behind caching, enabling deployment in low-resource settings. It also supports detailed traces for complex, agentic, or multi-stage workflows, creating a foundation for continuous monitoring, auditing, and improvement of medical AI.

AI.title_translation: 医疗AI的全球日志系统
AI.tldr: MedLog是一个为医疗AI设计的标准化日志协议，通过记录AI在临床工作流中的交互，实现了对模型性能、安全性和临床影响的实时监控与审计。
AI.motivation: 随着医疗AI的规模化部署，缺乏统一的记录机制导致难以评估真实世界性能、检测不良事件以及识别模型偏差和数据漂移。
AI.method: 提出一种名为MedLog的事件级日志记录协议，包含九个核心字段，并结合风险采样、生命周期保留策略和写后缓存机制，在四个不同国家的临床场景中进行了实证部署。
AI.result: 在四个临床场景的实证中，MedLog成功捕捉到了模型行为、工作流交互及下游结果，包括性能下降和实验室检查变化等关键指标，且在低资源环境下展现了良好的适用性。
AI.conclusion: MedLog为医疗AI提供了一个标准化的、可扩展的事件级日志记录协议，有助于实现对AI模型在真实临床环境中的全生命周期监控、审计和优化。
AI.translation: 现代计算机系统依赖于syslog，这是一种记录异构基础设施中关键事件的通用协议。而医学领域快速增长的AI技术栈尚无等效方案。随着医疗机构大规模部署AI工具，目前缺乏记录这些模型的使用方式、时间、使用者及服务对象等信息的标准方法。没有这些记录，就难以衡量真实世界的性能和结果，也难以检测不良事件或识别偏差与数据漂移。本文介绍了MedLog，一种用于医疗AI事件级日志记录的协议。每当AI模型与人类、其他算法或自动化工作流交互时，MedLog都会创建一个记录。每条记录包含九个核心字段：头部信息、模型、用户、目标、输入、工件、输出、结果和反馈。我们在美国、瑞士和越南的四个部署场景中应用了MedLog：ICU恶化预测、基于可穿戴信号的破伤风进展监测、自动化脓毒症质量报告以及患者就诊预测。MedLog记录捕获了模型行为、工作流交互和下游结果，包括患者就诊预测中恶劣天气期间AI性能的下降，以及ICU恶化警报后实验室检查的增加。MedLog通过基于风险的采样、感知生命周期的保留策略和写后缓存来限制数据占用，使其能够在低资源环境中部署。它还支持对复杂、智能体或多阶段工作流的详细追踪，为医疗AI的持续监控、审计和改进奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了MedLog，这是一个针对医疗AI的统一事件级日志记录协议。该协议通过标准化的九个核心字段记录AI模型的交互过程，旨在解决目前医疗AI缺乏统一监控机制的问题，从而支持对模型性能、偏见和临床结果的持续审计与改进。

title: ParallelBench: Understanding the Trade-offs of Parallel Decoding in Diffusion LLMs
comments: Accepted at ICLR 2026. Project Page: https://parallelbench.github.io
summary: While most autoregressive LLMs are constrained to one-by-one decoding, diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) have attracted growing interest for their potential to dramatically accelerate inference through parallel decoding. Despite this promise, the conditional independence assumption in dLLMs causes parallel decoding to ignore token dependencies, inevitably degrading generation quality when these dependencies are strong. However, existing works largely overlook these inherent challenges, and evaluations on standard benchmarks (e.g., math and coding) are not sufficient to capture the quality degradation caused by parallel decoding. To address this gap, we first provide an information-theoretic analysis of parallel decoding. We then conduct case studies on analytically tractable synthetic list operations from both data distribution and decoding strategy perspectives, offering quantitative insights that highlight the fundamental limitations of parallel decoding. Building on these insights, we propose ParallelBench, the first benchmark specifically designed for dLLMs, featuring realistic tasks that are trivial for humans and autoregressive LLMs yet exceptionally challenging for dLLMs under parallel decoding. Using ParallelBench, we systematically analyze both dLLMs and autoregressive LLMs, revealing that: (i) dLLMs under parallel decoding can suffer dramatic quality degradation in real-world scenarios, and (ii) current parallel decoding strategies struggle to adapt their degree of parallelism based on task difficulty, thus failing to achieve meaningful speedup without compromising quality. Our findings underscore the pressing need for innovative decoding methods that can overcome the current speed-quality trade-off. We release our benchmark to help accelerate the development of truly efficient dLLMs.
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026. Project Page: https://parallelbench.github.io

AI.title_translation: ParallelBench：理解扩散大模型中并行解码的权衡
AI.tldr: 本文提出了ParallelBench基准测试，揭示了扩散大模型在并行解码时存在严重的生成质量下降问题，并指出当前解码策略缺乏任务难度自适应能力，难以在速度和质量之间取得良好平衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散大模型（dLLMs）虽然具备并行解码以加速推理的潜力，但其条件独立性假设导致在处理强依赖任务时生成质量下降，且现有基准测试不足以评估这种质量损失。
AI.method: 1. 采用信息论方法对并行解码进行理论分析；2. 对合成列表操作进行案例研究以获取量化洞察；3. 构建并发布ParallelBench基准测试，包含一系列对并行解码具有挑战性的任务。
AI.result: 1. dLLMs在并行解码模式下，在现实场景中会经历严重的质量下降；2. 现有的并行解码策略无法根据任务难度自适应调整并行度，难以在不牺牲质量的前提下实现有效的速度提升。
AI.conclusion: 扩散大模型在并行解码时面临显著的性能与质量权衡问题，当前的并行策略缺乏根据任务难度动态调整的能力，亟需开发更具自适应性的创新解码方法。
AI.translation: 虽然大多数自回归大语言模型（LLMs）局限于逐个解码，但扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）因其通过并行解码大幅加速推理的潜力而受到广泛关注。尽管有此前景，dLLMs中的条件独立性假设导致并行解码忽略了Token依赖关系，在这些依赖关系较强时，不可避免地会降低生成质量。然而，现有研究在很大程度上忽视了这些内在挑战，且在标准基准（如数学和编码）上的评估不足以捕捉并行解码导致的质量下降。为了弥补这一空白，我们首先对并行解码进行了信息论分析。随后，我们从数据分布和解码策略的角度对可解析的合成列表操作进行了案例研究，提供了突出并行解码基本局限性的定量见解。基于这些见解，我们提出了ParallelBench，这是第一个专门为dLLMs设计的基准测试，其特点是包含人类和自回归LLMs可以轻松完成，但对并行解码下的dLLMs极具挑战性的现实任务。利用ParallelBench，我们系统地分析了dLLMs和自回归LLMs，结果表明：（i）dLLMs在并行解码下在现实场景中可能会遭受巨大的质量下降，以及（ii）当前的并行解码策略难以根据任务难度调整其并行度，因此无法在不牺牲质量的情况下实现有意义的加速。我们的研究结果强调了开发能够克服当前速度-质量权衡的创新解码方法的迫切需要。我们发布了我们的基准测试，以帮助加速真正高效的dLLMs的开发。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了扩散大模型（dLLMs）并行解码的局限性。研究指出，并行解码忽视了Token间的依赖性，导致生成质量下降。作者引入了ParallelBench基准测试，通过系统评估揭示了dLLMs在现实任务中的质量瓶颈及现有解码策略在动态适应性上的不足。
AI.keywords: 扩散大模型, 并行解码, 推理加速, 生成质量, 基准测试
AI.comments: 该研究通过信息论视角揭示了扩散大模型（dLLMs）在并行解码时的内在局限性，其创新之处在于提出了针对这一问题的专项基准测试集。该工作对当前盲目追求并行加速的趋势提出了警示，为未来平衡推理速度与生成质量的研究提供了关键参考。

title: Constraint-Level Design of zkEVMs: Architectures, Trade-offs, and Evolution
summary: Zero-Knowledge Ethereum Virtual Machines (zkEVMs) must reconcile an inherent tension. The Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) was designed for transparent step-by-step execution with dynamic control flow. Proving such execution in zero-knowledge, however, requires transforming it into algebraic circuit representations that encode computation as mathematical constraints. Existing surveys address zkEVMs at the level of implementations, cryptographic primitives, or Layer 2 deployment, leaving the constraint-system design that governs their cost largely unexamined. This survey provides the first constraint-level analysis of how five production zkEVM systems and three universal Zero-Knowledge Virtual Machines (zkVMs) resolve this tension through constraint engineering. We show that the degree of EVM compatibility, captured by the Type 1-4 spectrum, is the defining architectural decision that shapes all subsequent technical choices. We classify the design space along four architectural dimensions, namely arithmetization frameworks, dispatch strategies, semantic rewrites, and recursion approaches. Examining the mechanisms within each dimension, we identify the technical factors and trade-offs that drive each choice. The analysis reveals that all five surveyed production zkEVMs adopt PLONKish arithmetization. The zkVMs instead rely on the Algebraic Intermediate Representation (AIR), which suits uniform state machines. A single trade-off between EVM compatibility and constraint cost underlies these choices. The most Ethereum-equivalent systems accept higher constraint counts to preserve full bytecode fidelity, while systems that relax that fidelity attain substantially lower constraint counts. We close with the critical open problems and future research directions that this constraint-level view brings into focus.

title: On the Flexibility Potential of a Swiss Distribution Grid: Opportunities and Limitations
summary: The growing integration of distributed renewable generation and the electrification of heating and transportation are rapidly increasing the number of flexible devices within modern distribution grids. Leveraging the aggregated flexibility of these small-scale distributed resources is essential to maintaining future grid-wide stability. This work uses the Swiss distribution grid of Walenstadt as a case study to provide insights into the aggregated flexibility potential of distribution grids. It demonstrates that incorporating devices such as heat pumps and photovoltaic systems significantly enhances distribution grid flexibility. It investigates the time-varying nature of aggregated flexibility and highlights how it can vary seasonally. Furthermore, simulations of future scenarios reveal that aggregated flexibility does not increase linearly or monotonically with higher levels of flexible device penetration. This is primarily due to the overloading of individual feeders, which underscores the impact of grid topology and network constraints on the aggregated flexibility potential.

title: Channel Estimation under Large Doppler Shifts and Channel Aging in NOMA-Based Air-Ground Communications
comments: 7 pages, 3 Figures; Accepted to the 2026 IEEE 104th Vehicular Technology Conference (VTC2026-Fall), Boston, MA, USA, September 2026
summary: This paper investigates a multiple antenna system with non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) for the exchange of air traffic management data between commercial aircraft pilots and ground-based air traffic controllers. While NOMA techniques enhance spectral efficiency, their application to aircraft communications is challenged by the high speed of the aircraft (up to 214 m/s) and the long communication ranges (up to 250 km), resulting in significant Doppler shifts and low signal-to-noise ratios, respectively. To accurately assess these challenges, we employ a realistic geometry-based stochastic air-ground channel model, derived from dedicated flight measurement campaigns. In this paper, multiple aircraft simultaneously transmit data to the ground station. We focus on the channel estimation problem at the ground station under high carrier frequency offsets and the effects of channel aging due to channel's time-varying nature. For the channel estimation problem, we compare the Zadoff-Chu sequences with time-division approach under varying carrier frequency offset pre-compensation accuracies at the aircraft transmitter. For the channel aging problem and performance evaluation of channel estimators, we compute the outage probability for both the zero-forcing detector and the minimum mean squared error detector with successive interference cancellation. The results show that the favorable channel estimator-detector combinations differ between the takeoff & landing phase and the enroute cruise phase of the flight, due to the distinct channel propagation characteristics of each phase.

AI.title_translation: 基于NOMA的空地通信中大Doppler频移与信道老化下的信道估计
AI.tldr: 本文研究了NOMA在航空通信中的应用，指出飞行高度和速度带来的Doppler频移及信道老化问题，并发现不同飞行阶段的最优检测策略各异。
AI.motivation: 商业航空中高机动性（高速度）和长距离导致了严重的 Doppler 频移和低信噪比，这给基于 NOMA 的航空通信系统的信道估计和性能带来了严峻挑战。
AI.method: 采用基于实测数据的几何随机模型，对比了Zadoff-Chu序列与时分复用方法，并评估了迫零（ZF）检测器和带有串行干扰消除（SIC）的最小均方误差（MMSE）检测器的中断概率。
AI.result: 在存在高载波频率偏移和信道老化的情况下，不同飞行阶段对应的最优信道估计器与检测器组合存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论表明，在NOMA航空通信系统中，最优的信道估计器与检测器组合取决于飞行的阶段，因为起降阶段和巡航阶段具有截然不同的信道传播特性。
AI.translation: 本文研究了一个用于商业飞行员与地面空中交通管制员之间交换空中交通管理数据的多天线非正交多址（NOMA）系统。虽然 NOMA 技术提高了频谱效率，但其在航空通信中的应用受到飞机高速度（高达 214 m/s）和长通信距离（高达 250 km）的挑战，分别导致了显著的 Doppler 频移和低信噪比。为了准确评估这些挑战，我们采用了从专用飞行测量活动中导出的真实几何随机空地信道模型。在本文中，多架飞机同时向地面站传输数据。我们重点研究了高载波频率偏移下的地面站信道估计问题，以及由于信道时变特性引起的信道老化影响。对于信道估计问题，我们比较了在飞机发射机具有不同载波频率偏移预补偿精度下的 Zadoff-Chu 序列与时分复用方法。对于信道老化问题和信道估计器的性能评估，我们计算了迫零检测器和带有串行干扰消除的最小均方误差检测器的中断概率。结果表明，由于起降阶段和航路巡航阶段具有不同的信道传播特性，最优的信道估计器-检测器组合在这两个阶段之间存在差异。
AI.summary: 本文针对航空通信中的 NOMA 系统，研究了高多普勒频移和信道老化带来的挑战。通过使用基于实测的几何随机信道模型，论文对比了不同的信道估计方案，并评估了 ZF 和 MMSE-SIC 检测器在不同飞行阶段下的中断概率，揭示了飞行环境对系统性能的深远影响。
AI.keywords: NOMA, 航空通信, 多普勒频移, 信道老化, 信道估计
AI.comments: 该研究通过基于实测数据的几何随机模型，深入探讨了航空通信中NOMA技术的实际应用挑战，特别是针对高多普勒频移和信道老化问题，为航空通信系统的性能评估提供了重要的理论依据。其创新之处在于将理论模型与特定飞行阶段（起降与巡航）的实测特性相结合。

title: MSPL: Multi-Step Pseudo-Labeling for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
comments: This paper has been accepted by ECCV 2026
summary: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) aims to recognize and localize object categories beyond the training set. Recent approaches leverage vision-language models to generate pseudo-labels using image-text alignment, allowing detectors to generalize to unseen classes without explicit supervision. However, these methods depend heavily on single-step image-text matching, neglecting the intermediate reasoning steps crucial for interpreting semantically complex visual contexts, such as crowding or occlusion. In this paper, we introduce MSPL, a framework that incorporates multi-step visual reasoning into the pseudo-labeling process for OVD. It decomposes complex scene understanding into three interpretable steps-object localization, category recognition, and background grounding-where these intermediate reasoning states serve as rich supervision sources. Extensive experiments on standard OVD evaluation protocols demonstrate that MSPL achieves state-of-the-art performance with superior pseudo-labeling efficiency, outperforming the strong baseline by 9.4 AP50 for novel classes on OV-COCO and improving box and mask APr by 3.2 and 2.2, respectively, on OV-LVIS. Code and models are available at https://github.com/hchoi256/mspl.

title: MERGE: Minimal Expression-Replacement GEneralization Test for Natural Language Inference
summary: As many benchmarks have become saturated, it has become increasingly important to create new datasets that evaluate the generalization capacity of current state-of-the-art models in reasoning. However, designing high-quality reasoning datasets is challenging, as their manual construction is costly, and their automatic generation is unreliable, often leading to synthetic data with limited scope. In this paper, we propose the Minimal Expression-Replacement GEneralization (MERGE) test that evaluates the robustness of reasoning models against non-adversarial variants of existing evaluation datasets. We automatically obtain high-quality variants from the original instances with Minimal Expression REplacement (MERE) generation, which uses Masked Language Models (MLMs) and safeguarding filters. We apply the MERGE test to Natural Language Inference (NLI), a popular task of reasoning. We generate new NLI datasets from two widely used existing ones with the MERE generation and use them to evaluate multiple strong NLI models. The results indicate that both LLMs and fine-tuned NLI models generalize poorly: they struggle to consistently and correctly classify variants minimally different in form and reasoning from the original ones. Further, we also analyze how certain aspects in variant generation, such as the word class and the source MLMs, affect model performance.

title: Simple and Combination Parametric Resonances of an Electromagnetically Suspended Vehicle subject to Base Excitation
summary: This paper investigates the dynamic stability of an electromagnetically suspended vehicle, encountered in Hyperloop and Maglev systems, subject to periodic excitations caused by surface irregularities or vibration of the support induced by external noise. The narrow clearance between the vehicle and the support can make it highly sensitive to small oscillations, since the admissible amplitudes of the vehicle oscillations can be comparable to external excitation amplitude. The vehicle is modelled as a three-degree-of-freedom model where the vehicle is suspended via two identical electromagnetic actuators from a rigid support that oscillates. The governing equations are derived using force and torque balances, incorporating nonlinear electromagnetic forces, and Kirchhoffs law for the electromagnets with PD control strategy on the airgap. The equations of motion are linearized around the steady state induced by the surface oscillation, yielding a system with time-periodic coefficients. We analytically explore both principal and combination parametric resonances using an extended Hills method, and Floquet theory is used for numerical validation. The stability boundaries are obtained as ellipses in control gain parameter space, and the influence of system parameters on these boundaries is characterized. For the principal parametric resonance, the ratio of the sizes of the two obtained ellipses is three to one, whereas for the combination parametric resonance, the ratio is fourteen to one. When all ellipses are simultaneously present, one of the ellipses associated with the combination parametric resonance is the largest.

title: Debate2Create: Robot Co-design via Multi-Agent LLM Debate
summary: We introduce Debate2Create (D2C), a multi-agent LLM framework that formulates robot co-design as structured, iterative debate grounded in physics-based evaluation. A design agent and control agent engage in a thesis-antithesis-synthesis loop, while criterion-specific LLM judges provide multi-objective feedback to steer exploration. Across five MuJoCo locomotion benchmarks, D2C achieves the highest default-normalized score among the evaluated LLM-based and black-box baselines, with gains up to 3.2x on Ant and nearly 9x on Swimmer. Iterative debate yields 18-35% gains over compute-matched zero-shot generation, and D2C-generated rewards transfer to default morphologies in 4/5 tasks. These results suggest that structured, simulator-grounded multi-agent interaction is a useful mechanism for joint morphology-reward optimization under a fixed-topology, per-candidate-RL protocol. Project page: debate2create.github.io.

AI.motivation: 旨在解决机器人协同设计中形态与控制策略优化的复杂性，利用LLM的生成能力并引入物理仿真反馈以克服单一模型在设计任务中的局限性。
AI.method: 提出Debate2Create (D2C) 框架，包含设计智能体、控制智能体和基于物理评估的LLM裁判；通过“正题-反题-合题”的迭代辩论循环进行多目标优化。
AI.result: 在五个MuJoCo基准测试中表现最优，在Ant任务上提升达3.2倍，Swimmer任务上提升近9倍；迭代辩论相比零样本生成提升了18-35%的性能。
AI.conclusion: Debate2Create框架证明了基于物理仿真反馈的多智能体辩论是优化机器人形态与奖励函数的有效机制。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了Debate2Create (D2C)，这是一个多智能体LLM框架，它将机器人协同设计形式化为基于物理评估的结构化、迭代式辩论。设计智能体和控制智能体参与“正题-反题-合题”循环，同时特定标准的LLM裁判提供多目标反馈以引导探索。在五个MuJoCo运动基准测试中，D2C在评估的基于LLM和黑盒基准中获得了最高的默认归一化分数，其中Ant任务提升达3.2倍，Swimmer任务提升近9倍。迭代辩论比计算量相当的零样本生成带来了18-35%的收益，且D2C生成的奖励在4/5的任务中可迁移至默认形态。这些结果表明，结构化的、基于模拟器的多智能体交互是进行固定拓扑、候选者强化学习协议下形态-奖励联合优化的有用机制。
AI.summary: Debate2Create (D2C) 是一个利用多智能体大语言模型进行机器人协同设计的框架。它通过设计与控制智能体之间的迭代辩论，并结合物理仿真评估和多目标反馈，实现了机器人形态与控制策略的高效联合优化。
AI.keywords: 机器人协同设计, 多智能体大语言模型, 辩论机制, 物理仿真, 强化学习
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入多智能体辩论机制，成功将LLM的创造力与物理仿真反馈相结合，为机器人协同设计提供了一种高效、结构化的新范式，显著优于传统的单智能体或零样本生成方法。

title: An Explanation-oriented Inquiry Dialogue Game for Expert Collaborative Recommendations
summary: This work presents a requirement analysis for collaborative dialogues among medical experts and an inquiry dialogue game based on this analysis for incorporating explainability into multiagent system design. The game allows experts with different knowledge bases to collaboratively make recommendations while generating rich traces of the reasoning process through combining explanation-based illocutionary forces in an inquiry dialogue. The dialogue game was implemented as a prototype web-application and evaluated against the specification through a formative user study. The user study confirms that the dialogue game meets the needs for collaboration among medical experts. It also provides insights on the real-life value of dialogue-based communication tools for the medical community.

AI.title_translation: 一种面向解释的医疗专家协作推荐探究对话游戏
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种旨在提升医疗专家协作推荐可解释性的对话游戏，通过原型验证了其在记录推理过程和支持专业协作方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决医疗专家在协作推荐过程中对解释性及知识共享的需求，并探索如何将可解释性融入多智能体系统设计中。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于需求分析的探究对话游戏框架，该框架结合了基于解释的言语行为，并开发了原型Web应用程序进行形成性用户研究。
AI.result: 形成性用户研究确认该对话游戏满足了医疗专家协作的需求，并验证了其在生成推理过程记录方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了基于解释的探究对话游戏能够有效支持医疗专家间的协作推荐，并为开发医疗领域的对话式沟通工具提供了实践价值。
AI.translation: 本研究对医疗专家之间的协作对话进行了需求分析，并基于此分析提出了一种探究对话游戏，用于将可解释性纳入多智能体系统设计。该游戏允许拥有不同知识库的专家在协作进行推荐的同时，通过结合探究对话中基于解释的言语行为，生成丰富的推理过程记录。该对话游戏被实现为一个原型Web应用程序，并通过形成性用户研究根据规范进行了评估。用户研究证实，该对话游戏满足了医疗专家之间协作的需求，并为对话式沟通工具在医疗界的现实价值提供了见解。
AI.summary: 本文针对医疗专家协作需求，设计了一种支持可解释性的探究对话游戏。该游戏通过整合基于解释的言语行为，使具备不同知识背景的专家能够协作进行推荐，并自动生成推理轨迹。原型系统评估显示其在满足协作需求及提供临床沟通价值方面表现良好。
AI.keywords: 医疗专家协作, 探究对话游戏, 可解释性, 多智能体系统, 协作推荐
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将解释性引入多智能体系统的协作对话中，特别是针对医疗领域专家协作的特殊需求。其局限性在于目前仅为原型系统，且仅进行了形成性用户研究，未来需在更大规模、更复杂的临床场景中验证其有效性。

title: Thinking While Speaking: Inference-Time Knowledge Transfer for Responsive and Intelligent Conversational Voice Agents
summary: Voice agents face a fundamental tension: the reasoning, retrieval, and tool use that make foundation models capable are iterative and slow, while conversational interaction demands responses on a millisecond timescale. Smaller, real-time models meet the latency bar but cannot match foundation models on complex tasks, leaving current voice agents to trade away either responsiveness or capability. We introduce conversational infill, where a small talker model both immediately generates contextually grounded responses to hide the latency of an external reasoner model and fluently integrates streamed reasoner knowledge into its responses during inference. We curate a 290,571-example synthetic dataset spanning six domains and demonstrate that this task is learnable across seven widely used small language models ranging from 135M to 1.7B parameters. Our system implementation, ConvFill, sustains millisecond-level time-to-first-response while closing the accuracy gap to within 6.3% of the corresponding frontier reasoner performance. In a live user study (n=18) with talker deployments running on an Apple M2 SoC, participants rank ConvFill on par with frontier models overall, prefer it for retrieval-heavy tasks, and rate it significantly more responsive. These results show that conversational infill unlocks a new point on the latency-capability Pareto frontier, offering a practical path toward voice agents that are both responsive and highly capable. Code, models, and datasets are available at https://github.com/vysri/conversational-infill.

title: FuseSampleAgg: One-Pass Neighborhood Estimation for Budgeted Knowledge-Graph Refresh and Validation
comments: 11 pages. Code and reproducibility scripts: https://github.com/SV25-22/FuseSampleAgg
summary: Operational knowledge-graph (KG) pipelines in networking and cybersecurity increasingly need to refresh embeddings under strict time, memory, and audit budgets, especially as curated feeds and LLM-assisted extraction accelerate KG updates. A recurring per-step cost in mini-batch KG learning is neighborhood-context estimation: uniform neighbor sampling without replacement followed by mean aggregation. Common frameworks implement this estimator through sampled-subgraph materialization and intermediate feature gathers, adding kernel launches, allocator pressure, and transient memory spikes. We present One-Pass Neighborhood Estimation, a fused PyTorch CUDA operator that samples neighbors and directly emits the sampled-neighborhood mean, avoiding explicit block construction while preserving GraphSAGE-mean semantics for the same sampled neighbor IDs. It supports seed-controlled sampling and optional saved-index replay for reproducible validation and regression testing. Across large-graph mini-batch workloads, it improves FP32 end-to-end step latency by 2.24x-3.48x over tuned DGL baselines and reduces transient GPU memory by up to 160x in our measurements. On OGB KG completion benchmarks such as WikiKG2 and BioKG, it reduces step time and peak VRAM while matching ranking quality within seed variability, improving time-to-quality for budgeted KG refresh.

title: Selective Rotary Position Embedding
summary: Position information is essential for language modeling. In softmax transformers, Rotary Position Embeddings (\textit{RoPE}) encode positions through \textit{fixed-angle} rotations, while in linear transformers, order is handled via input-dependent (selective) gating that decays past key-value associations. Selectivity has generally been shown to improve language-related tasks. Inspired by this, we introduce \textit{Selective RoPE}, an \textit{input-dependent} rotary embedding mechanism, that generalizes \textit{RoPE}, and enables rotation in \textit{arbitrary angles} for both linear and softmax transformers. We show that softmax attention already performs a hidden form of these rotations on query-key pairs, uncovering an implicit positional structure. We further show that in state-space models and gated linear transformers, the real part manages forgetting while the imaginary part encodes positions through rotations. We validate our method by equipping gated transformers with \textit{Selective RoPE}, demonstrating that its input-dependent rotations improve performance in language modeling and on difficult sequence tasks like copying, state tracking, and retrieval.
