title: Hybrid Event Frame Sensors: Modeling, Calibration, and Simulation
summary: Hybrid event-frame sensors integrate an Event Vision Sensor (EVS) and an Active Pixel Sensor (APS) within a single chip, combining the high dynamic range and low latency of the EVS with the rich spatial intensity information from the APS. While this tight integration offers compact and temporally precise imaging, the complex circuit architecture introduces nontrivial noise patterns that remain poorly understood and unmodeled. In this work, we present the first unified statistics-based imaging noise model that jointly describes the noise behavior of APS and EVS pixels. Our formulation explicitly incorporates photon shot noise, dark current noise, fixed-pattern noise, and quantization noise, and links EVS noise to illumination level and dark current. Based on this formulation, we further develop a calibration pipeline to estimate noise parameters from real data and provide a detailed analysis of both APS and EVS noise behaviors. Finally, we propose H-ESIM, a statistically grounded simulator that generates RAW frames and events under realistic jointly calibrated noise statistics. Experiments on two hybrid sensors validate our model across multiple imaging tasks, including video frame interpolation and deblurring, demonstrating strong transfer from simulation to real data.

AI.title_translation: 混合事件-帧传感器：建模、校准与仿真
AI.tldr: 本文为混合事件-帧传感器开发了首个联合噪声模型及仿真器（H-ESIM），通过校准真实噪声参数，实现了高质量的合成数据生成，有效支持了各类视觉任务的算法训练与迁移。
AI.motivation: 混合事件-帧传感器（EVS+APS）虽然结合了高动态范围、低延迟和丰富空间信息的优势，但其复杂的电路架构带来了难以建模的噪声问题，限制了该类传感器在算法开发和仿真中的应用。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于统计学的统一成像噪声模型，涵盖光子散粒噪声、暗电流噪声、固定模式噪声和量化噪声；开发了从真实数据估计噪声参数的校准管道；设计了H-ESIM仿真器以生成真实的RAW帧和事件数据。
AI.result: 实验证明所提模型能准确描述APS和EVS的噪声行为；H-ESIM仿真器生成的合成数据在视频插帧和去模糊任务中表现出极强的真实场景迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的统一噪声模型和H-ESIM仿真器成功模拟了混合传感器的复杂噪声特性，并通过实验验证了其在实际任务中的有效性和迁移性能。
AI.translation: 混合事件-帧传感器将事件视觉传感器（EVS）和有源像素传感器（APS）集成在同一芯片上，结合了EVS的高动态范围和低延迟特性以及APS丰富的空间强度信息。尽管这种紧密集成提供了紧凑且时间精确的成像，但复杂的电路架构引入了非平凡的噪声模式，这些模式目前仍未被很好地理解和建模。在这项工作中，我们提出了第一个基于统计学的统一成像噪声模型，该模型联合描述了APS和EVS像素的噪声行为。我们的公式明确纳入了光子散粒噪声、暗电流噪声、固定模式噪声和量化噪声，并将EVS噪声与照明水平和暗电流联系起来。基于该公式，我们进一步开发了一个校准流程，用于从真实数据中估计噪声参数，并对APS和EVS的噪声行为进行了详细分析。最后，我们提出了H-ESIM，一个基于统计学基础的仿真器，它在真实联合校准的噪声统计数据下生成RAW帧和事件。在两个混合传感器上的实验验证了我们的模型在多种成像任务（包括视频帧插值和去模糊）中的有效性，展示了从仿真到真实数据的强大迁移能力。
AI.summary: 本文针对混合事件-帧传感器，提出了首个联合APS与EVS的统计噪声模型，并开发了相应的校准流程与H-ESIM仿真器，有效解决了该类传感器因复杂架构导致的噪声建模难题，提升了仿真数据的真实性。
AI.keywords: 混合事件-帧传感器, 噪声建模, 传感器校准, 图像仿真, 事件视觉传感器
AI.comments: 该论文填补了混合事件-帧传感器噪声建模的空白。其创新之处在于提出了首个联合描述APS和EVS像素噪声的统计模型，并配套开发了校准流程和高保真仿真器（H-ESIM）。这对于弥合仿真数据与真实传感器数据之间的鸿沟至关重要，显著提升了基于模拟数据训练的算法在真实硬件上的迁移能力。

title: Data-driven model order reduction for wave propagation in materials with damage and nonlinearities
summary: In this work, we consider wave propagation in materials characterized by nonlinear properties or damage. To accelerate the simulations of the resulting high-dimensional problems, we apply model order reduction methods. Depending on the knowledge of the underlying equations and the availability of their discrete operators, intrusive methods (here projection-based approaches based on proper orthogonal decomposition (POD)) or non-instrusive methods (here data-driven approaches including dynamic mode decomposition (DMD) and operator inference (OpInf)) can be used. We recall the theoretical foundations of the methods and apply them to the problem of wave propagation. In three different numerical examples, we evaluate the performance of the reduction techniques.

title: Representation Interventions Enable Lifelong Knowledge Memory Control in LLMs
comments: In Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026, Oral Presentation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often produce incorrect or outdated content after being employed. Efficient and accurate knowledge updates without costly retraining are a major challenge. This problem is particularly challenging in lifelong settings, where complex, unstructured knowledge must coexist without interference. We introduce RILKE (Representation Intervention for Lifelong KnowledgE Control), a robust and scalable method that treats knowledge control as interventions within the model's representation space. Leveraging representation-space expressiveness, we identify two key properties enabling RILKE to achieve fine-grained control over complex, unstructured knowledge while maintaining general utility with frozen base weights. During training, RILKE learns paraphrase-robust and edit-localized modules that limit each update to a low-dimensional subspace to minimize cross-edit interference. At inference, a query-adaptive router selects the appropriate module to guide the model's generation. Across LLaMA and Qwen models, RILKE scales effectively to large-scale benchmarks, demonstrating high edit success and strong paraphrase generalization while preserving general utility with modest memory overhead. These results show RILKE is an effective and scalable solution for lifelong knowledge control in LLMs.

title: FlowerDance: MeanFlow for Efficient and Refined 3D Dance Generation
summary: Music-to-dance generation aims to translate auditory signals into expressive human motion, with broad applications in virtual reality, choreography, and digital entertainment. Despite promising progress, the limited generation efficiency of existing methods leaves insufficient computational headroom for high-fidelity 3D rendering, thereby constraining the expressiveness of 3D characters during real-world applications. Thus, we propose FlowerDance, which not only generates refined motion with physical plausibility and artistic expressiveness, but also achieves significant generation efficiency on inference speed and memory utilization. Specifically, FlowerDance combines MeanFlow with Physical Consistency Constraints, which enables high-quality motion generation with only a few sampling steps. Moreover, FlowerDance leverages a simple but efficient model architecture with BiMamba-based backbone and Channel-Level Cross-Modal Fusion, which generates dance with efficient non-autoregressive manner. Meanwhile, FlowerDance supports motion editing, enabling users to interactively refine dance sequences. Extensive experiments on AIST++ and FineDance show that FlowerDance achieves state-of-the-art results in both motion quality and generation efficiency. Code will be released upon acceptance.

title: Bilevel Data Curation for LLM Fine-tuning: Offline Selection and Online Self-Refining Generation
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) datasets are critical to the downstream performance of large language models, yet they often contain low-quality or harmful question-response pairs. To improve SFT data quality, we develop a unified bilevel framework that combines offline data selection with the online self-refining generation. In the offline setting, bilevel data selection (BDS) selects question-response pairs from the offline SFT dataset to maximize the validation performance. We theoretically show that the optimal model given by BDS outperforms direct data mixing approach in useful data coverage. Moreover, we provide a global convergence analysis for gradient-based BDS approach for one-layer Transformer, showing that the epsilon-global optimum of offline BDS is achievable in finite time. Although efficient, offline BDS discards potentially harmful questions together with responses, thereby reducing question diversity. We address this limitation by refining the responses to selected questions using online self-refining generation framework. However, BDS is inefficient to update the response weights when responses are regenerated online. To address this issue, we introduce bilevel multi-objective optimization (BMO) for response-level weighting. We show that BMO recovers the same validation-aligned solution as BDS, but admits a closed-form importance-ratio weight that adapts to regenerated responses. Experiments on LLM quality enhancement and safety-aware fine-tuning demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently improves both data quality and downstream fine-tuning performance.

title: GENA3D: Generative Amodal 3D Modeling by Bridging 2D Priors and 3D Coherence
comments: Paper accepted by ECCV 2026. Project page: https://colezwhy.github.io/gena3d/
summary: Generating complete 3D objects under partial occlusions (i.e., amodal scenarios) is a practically important yet challenging problem, as large portions of object geometry are unobserved in real-world scenarios. Existing approaches either operate directly in 3D, which ensures geometric consistency but often lacks generative expressiveness, or rely on 2D amodal completion, which provides strong appearance priors but does not guarantee reliable 3D structure. This raises a key question: how can we achieve both generative plausibility and geometric coherence in amodal 3D modeling? To answer this question, we introduce GENA3D (GENarative Amodal 3D), a framework that integrates learned 2D generative priors with explicit 3D geometric reasoning within a conditional 3D generation paradigm. The 2D priors enable the model to plausibly infer diverse occluded content, while the 3D representation enforces multi-view consistency and spatial validity. Our design incorporates a novel View-Wise Cross-Attention for multi-view alignment and a Stereo-Conditioned Cross-Attention to anchor generative predictions in 3D relationships. By combining generative imagination with structural constraints, GENA3D generates complete and coherent 3D objects from limited observations without sacrificing geometric fidelity. Experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both synthetic and real-world amodal scenarios, highlighting the effectiveness of bridging 2D priors and 3D coherence in generating plausible and geometrically consistent 3D structures in complex environments.

title: MILE: A Mechanically Isomorphic Hand Exoskeleton and Visuotactile Robotic Hand for Data Collection in Dexterous Manipulation
comments: 18 pages including supplementary material. Main manuscript and supplementary material included in this version
summary: Dexterous robotic hands are expected to perform complex, contact-rich object manipulation, but learning such skills remains challenging because high-dimensional hands require high-fidelity demonstrations. Imitation learning provides a practical route for acquiring dexterous manipulation skills from human demonstrations, yet collecting synchronized multimodal demonstrations with accurate hand actions and tactile observations remains a key bottleneck. We present MILE, a teleoperation-based data-collection system comprising the human-first MILE exoskeleton and the mechanically corresponding MILE-Tac robotic hand. The system integrates custom-designed and fabricated modular joint encoders and compact MILE fingertip visuotactile sensor modules. The exoskeleton is informed by human-hand anatomy and ergonomic constraints, while the robotic hand is co-designed to preserve the selected four-finger kinematic topology. This correspondence enables joint-space command transfer and reduces reliance on task-space IK-based retargeting. The system synchronously records task-specific visual observations, four fingertip visuotactile streams, robot-hand proprioception, and exoskeleton-derived action commands. We evaluate MILE through a four-task teleoperation benchmark against representative glove-based and vision-based interfaces, and through imitation-learning experiments that compare policies trained with and without fingertip tactile input. The project page is available at https://sites.google.com/view/mile-system.

title: ATHENA: Agentic Team for Hierarchical Evolutionary Numerical Algorithms
summary: Progress in computational science depends on complex numerical workflows that must faithfully encode physical laws, yet translating conceptual insight into reliable code remains a major bottleneck. Although large language models can generate isolated code fragments, they lack the structured reasoning required to design, verify, and iteratively refine complete scientific pipelines. Here we introduce ATHENA, an agentic framework explicitly designed to emulate scientific research modeled as a knowledge-driven contextual bandit process. Its core loop separates conceptual policy from numerical realization through expert-derived conceptual scaffolding, enabling principled diagnosis, reformulation, and repair of computational strategies. Across scientific computing and scientific machine learning tasks, ATHENA autonomously derives and correctly applies exact analytical solutions, constructs stable numerical solvers, diagnoses ill-posed formulations, and orchestrates hybrid symbolic-numeric workflows. Quantitatively, ATHENA matches and frequently surpasses the accuracy of expert-authored reference solutions reported in the literature on canonical benchmarks. By reframing computation as an object of agentic reasoning, our framework enables autonomous orchestration of heterogeneous algorithms across scientific domains.

title: Solving Semi-Supervised Few-Shot Learning from an Auto-Annotation Perspective
comments: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Website and code: https://tian1327.github.io/SWIFT
summary: Semi-supervised few-shot learning (SSFSL) resembles real-world applications such as auto-annotation, as it aims to learn a model from a few labeled and abundant unlabeled task-specific examples to annotate the unlabeled ones. Despite the availability of powerful open-source Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and open-world data, existing SSFSL literature largely neglects these resources. In contrast, the related area few-shot learning (FSL) has already exploited them to boost performance. Arguably, to solve real-world auto-annotation, SSFSL should leverage such open resources. To bridge this gap, we explore established SSL methods to finetune a VLM. Unexpectedly, they significantly underperform FSL baselines that do not use unlabeled data. Our in-depth analysis reveals the root cause of failure: VLMs produce flat distributions of softmax probabilities, resulting in zero utilization of unlabeled data and weak supervision signals. To address this challenge, we propose an embarrassingly simple solution that uses temperatures to sharpen the softmax output, which not only increases the confidence scores of pseudo-labels to improve the utilization of unlabeled data, but also strengthens training supervision for effective finetuning. Furthermore, we exploit task-relevant open data, e.g., those retrieved from VLMs' publicly available pretraining set. To mitigate the imbalance and domain gaps in retrieved data, we employ a stage-wise training strategy. Building on the successful finetuning of VLMs and the exploitation of open data, we present a simple yet effective SSFSL method, Stage-Wise Finetuning with Temperatures (SWIFT). Across five benchmarks, SWIFT outperforms recent FSL and SSL methods by $\sim$5 accuracy points. SWIFT even rivals supervised learning, which finetunes a VLM assuming unlabeled data having ground-truth labels!

title: Computing Evolutionarily Stable Strategies in Imperfect-Information Games
summary: We present an algorithm for computing evolutionarily stable strategies (ESSs) in symmetric perfect-recall extensive-form games of imperfect information. Our main algorithm is for two-player games, and we describe how it can be extended to multiplayer games. The algorithm is sound and computes all ESSs in nondegenerate games and a subset of them in degenerate games which contain an infinite continuum of symmetric Nash equilibria. The algorithm is anytime and can be stopped early to find one or more ESSs. We experiment on an imperfect-information cancer signaling game as well as random games to demonstrate scalability.

title: Generative Manifold Distillation: Aligning Restoration Trajectories with Natural Image Prior
summary: Pre-trained image restoration models often fail on out-of-distribution (OOD) real-world degradations. Adapting to these domains is challenging as real-world data lacks paired ground truth, and unsupervised methods often require unstable architectural changes. We propose Generative Manifold Distillation (GMD), which reframes domain adaptation as geometric manifold alignment. GMD operates in a strictly unpaired setting, requiring only low-quality (LQ) target observations. By leveraging the flow-matching dynamics of a frozen text-to-image foundation model, GMD projects off-manifold restorations onto the natural image manifold to generate high-quality pseudo-targets. To ensure stability, a quality-gated manifold filter rejects off-manifold samples, while source-anchored trajectory regularization prevents error accumulation. Ultimately, GMD distills a powerful generative prior into an efficient restoration network. Experiments demonstrate that GMD seamlessly adapts to new distributions using only LQ inputs, drastically improving perceptual quality with zero architectural modifications or added inference latency.

title: A Multi-Worker Assembly Line Rebalancing with Spatial and Ergonomic Considerations
summary: This work addresses the Assembly Line Rebalancing Problem driven by cycle-time changes in manual assembly systems where multiple workers operate in parallel within the same station. A multi-objective optimization model is proposed that incorporates task reassignment, worker allocation, ergonomic evaluation, and explicit spatial feasibility through work-area constraints. The formulation minimizes deviations from the current configuration while promoting balanced workload and ergonomic conditions among workers. The main contribution is the extension of assembly line rebalancing to multi-worker settings with explicit spatial constraints. Computational experiments on synthetic instances demonstrate that the model consistently generates feasible reconfigurations, highlighting its potential as a decision-support tool for industrial rebalancing in flexible production environments.

title: Beyond a Single Light: A Large-Scale Aerial Dataset for Urban Scene Reconstruction Under Varying Illumination
summary: Recent advances in Neural Radiance Fields and 3D Gaussian Splatting have demonstrated strong potential for large-scale UAV-based 3D reconstruction tasks by fitting the appearance of images. However, real-world large-scale captures are often based on multi-temporal data capture, where illumination inconsistencies across different times of day can significantly lead to color artifacts, geometric inaccuracies, and inconsistent appearance. Due to the lack of UAV datasets that systematically capture the same areas under varying illumination conditions, this challenge remains largely underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduceSkyLume, a large-scale, real-world UAV dataset specifically designed for studying illumination robust 3D reconstruction in urban scene modeling: (1) We collect data from 10 urban regions data comprising more than 100k high resolution UAV images (four oblique views and nadir), where each region is captured at three periods of the day to systematically isolate illumination changes. (2) To support precise evaluation of geometry and appearance, we provide per-scene LiDAR scans and accurate 3D ground-truth for assessing depth, surface normals, and reconstruction quality under varying illumination. (3) For the inverse rendering task, we introduce the Temporal Consistency Coefficient (TCC), a metric that measuress cross-time albedo stability and directly evaluates the robustness of the disentanglement of light and material. We aim for this resource to serve as a foundation that advances research and real-world evaluation in large-scale inverse rendering, geometry reconstruction, and novel view synthesis.

AI.title_translation: 超越单一光照：用于多变光照下城市场景重建的大规模航空数据集
AI.tldr: 本文推出了SkyLume数据集，这是一个包含10个城市区域、超10万张多时段无人机图像及LiDAR真值的大规模航空数据集，旨在解决多变光照下的城市三维重建与逆渲染挑战。
AI.motivation: 在现实世界的大规模无人机三维重建中，数据往往是在不同时间段采集的，光照的不一致性会导致颜色伪影、几何不准确和外观不一致。然而，目前缺乏系统性采集同一区域在不同光照下变化的大规模无人机数据集，限制了光照鲁棒性重建技术的发展。
AI.method:
1. 引入SkyLume数据集：覆盖10个城市区域，包含超10万张高分辨率无人机图像（4个倾斜视角和1个正射视角），每个区域在一天中的3个不同时段进行采集；
2. 提供高精度真值：针对每个场景提供LiDAR扫描和精确的3D地面真值（包括深度、表面法线等）；
3. 提出新指标：引入时间一致性系数（TCC），用于测量跨时间反射率（albedo）的稳定性，从而直接评估光照与材质解耦的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 成功构建并推出了大规模真实航空数据集SkyLume，提供了丰富的多时段图像和高精度LiDAR真值，并设计了用于评估逆渲染任务中光照与材质解耦性能的TCC指标。
AI.conclusion: SkyLume数据集和TCC指标为解决多变光照下的城市三维重建、逆渲染和新视角合成提供了重要的数据基础和评估标准，有望推动该领域的实际应用与学术研究。

AI.summary: 本文推出了一个名为SkyLume的大规模真实世界无人机航空数据集，旨在解决城市场景三维重建中因多时段光照不一致带来的挑战。该数据集包含10个城市区域在三个不同时段采集的超10万张高分辨率图像，并配备了LiDAR三维真值。同时，本文还提出了时间一致性系数（TCC）指标，用于评估光照与材质解耦的鲁棒性。

title: EMFusion: Uncertainty-Aware Conditional Diffusion Model for Multivariate Narrow-band Exposure Forecasting
comments: Accepted in IEEE Transactions on Network Science and Engineering
summary: The rapid growth in wireless infrastructure has increased the need to accurately estimate and forecast electromagnetic field (EMF) levels to ensure ongoing compliance, assess potential health impacts, and support efficient network planning. While existing studies rely on univariate forecasting of wideband aggregate EMF data, multivariate narrow-band EMF forecasting is needed to capture the inter-operator and inter-frequency variations essential for proactive network planning. To this end, this paper introduces EMFusion, a conditional diffusion-based EMF forecasting framework that integrates diverse contextual factors, such as time of day, season, and holidays, while providing uncertainty-aware probabilistic forecasts. The proposed architecture features a residual U-Net backbone enhanced by a cross-attention mechanism that dynamically integrates external conditions to guide the generation process. Furthermore, EMFusion integrates an imputation-based sampling strategy that treats forecasting as a structural inpainting task, ensuring temporal coherence even with irregular measurements. Unlike standard point forecasters, EMFusion generates empirical probabilistic prediction intervals from the learned conditional distribution, providing uncertainty-aware probabilistic forecasting rather than simple point estimation. Numerical experiments conducted on the multivariate narrow-band EMF datasets demonstrate that EMFusion with the contextual information of working hours outperforms the baseline models with or without conditions. The proposed EMFusion outperforms the best baseline by 23.85% in continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) and 13.93% in normalized root mean square error.

AI.title_translation: EMFusion：多变量窄带暴露预测的不确定性感知条件扩散模型
AI.tldr: EMFusion是一个基于条件扩散模型，用于多变量窄带电磁场预测，它能整合上下文信息并提供不确定性感知的概率预测。
AI.motivation: 随着无线基础设施的快速增长，准确估计和预测电磁场（EMF）水平的需求日益增加，以确保合规性、评估潜在健康影响并支持高效网络规划。现有研究主要侧重于宽带聚合EMF数据的单变量预测，但多变量窄带EMF预测对于捕捉运营商间和频率间的变化至关重要，这对于主动网络规划是必需的。
AI.method: 本文提出了EMFusion，一个基于条件扩散的EMF预测框架。它整合了多种上下文因素（如一天中的时间、季节、节假日），并提供不确定性感知的概率预测。该架构的核心是一个由交叉注意力机制增强的残差U-Net骨干网络，能动态整合外部条件以指导生成过程。此外，EMFusion集成了一种基于插补的采样策略，将预测视为结构化修复任务，即使测量不规则也能确保时间连贯性。与标准点预测器不同，EMFusion从学习到的条件分布中生成经验概率预测区间，提供不确定性感知的概率预测而非简单的点估计。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，包含工作时间上下文信息的EMFusion在多变量窄带EMF数据集上优于有或无条件的基线模型。EMFusion在连续排序概率评分（CRPS）上比最佳基线模型表现提高23.85%，在归一化均方根误差（NRMSE）上提高13.93%。
AI.conclusion: EMFusion通过整合上下文信息和提供不确定性感知预测，显著提高了多变量窄带EMF预测的准确性和实用性，优于现有基线模型。

title: Attention in Motion: Secure Platooning via Transformer-based Misbehavior Detection
comments: Author's version; Accepted for publication at the IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems (T-ITs)
summary: Vehicular platooning promises transformative improvements in transportation efficiency and safety through the coordination of multi-vehicle formations enabled by Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication. However, the distributed nature of platoon coordination creates security vulnerabilities, allowing authenticated vehicles to inject falsified kinematic data, compromise operational stability, and pose a threat to passenger safety. Traditional misbehaviour detection approaches, which rely on plausibility checks and statistical methods, suffer from high False Positive (FP) rates and cannot capture the complex temporal dependencies inherent in multi-vehicle coordination dynamics. We present Attention In Motion (AIMformer), a transformer-based framework specifically tailored for real-time misbehaviour detection in vehicular platoons with edge deployment capabilities. AIMformer leverages multi-head self-attention mechanisms to capture intra-vehicle temporal dynamics, with a spatio-temporal variant that further models inter-vehicle spatial correlations. It incorporates global positional encoding with vehicle-specific temporal offsets to handle join/exit maneuvers. We propose a Precision-Focused Binary Cross-Entropy (PFBCE) loss function that penalizes FPs to meet the requirements of safety-critical vehicular systems. Extensive evaluation across 4 platoon controllers, multiple attack vectors, and diverse mobility scenarios demonstrates superior performance ($\geq$ 0.93) compared to state-of-the-art baseline architectures. A comprehensive deployment analysis utilizing TensorFlow Lite (TFLite), Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX), and TensorRT achieves sub-millisecond inference latency, making it suitable for real-time operation on resource-constrained edge platforms. Hence, validating AIMformer is viable for both in-vehicle and roadside deployment.

AI.title_translation: 运动中的注意力：基于Transformer的异常行为检测实现安全车队行驶
AI.tldr: 本文提出AIMformer，一个基于Transformer的框架，用于实时检测车辆编队中的异常行为，具有高精度和低延迟，适用于边缘部署。
AI.motivation: 车辆编队通过V2X通信实现多车编队协调，有望显著提高交通效率和安全性。然而，编队协调的分布式特性带来了安全漏洞，认证车辆可能注入伪造的运动数据，从而损害操作稳定性并威胁乘客安全。传统的异常行为检测方法依赖于合理性检查和统计方法，但存在高误报率，并且无法捕获多车协调动态中固有的复杂时间依赖性。
AI.method: 本文提出了Attention In Motion (AIMformer)，一个专门为车载编队实时异常行为检测量身定制的基于Transformer的框架，具有边缘部署能力。AIMformer利用多头自注意力机制捕获车内时间动态，并通过时空变体进一步建模车间空间相关性。它结合了带有车辆特定时间偏移的全局位置编码来处理加入/退出机动。此外，本文提出了一种精确聚焦二元交叉熵（PFBCE）损失函数，以惩罚误报，从而满足安全关键型车载系统的要求。
AI.result: 在4种编队控制器、多种攻击向量和多样化移动场景下进行的广泛评估表明，AIMformer的性能（≥ 0.93）优于最先进的基线架构。利用TensorFlow Lite (TFLite)、Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) 和 TensorRT 进行的全面部署分析实现了亚毫秒级的推理延迟，使其适用于资源受限边缘平台上的实时操作。
AI.conclusion: 因此，验证了AIMformer在车载和路边部署中都是可行的。

title: Wireless Copilot: An AI-Powered Partner for Navigating Next-Generation Wireless Complexity
summary: The sixth-generation (6G) of wireless networks introduces a level of operational complexity that exceeds the limits of traditional automation and manual oversight. This paper introduces the "Wireless Copilot," an AI-powered technical assistant designed to function as a collaborative partner for human network designers, engineers, and operators. We posit that by integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) with a robust cognitive framework. It will interact with wireless devices, transmitting the user's intentions into the actual network execution process. Then, Wireless Copilot can translate high-level human intent into precise, optimized, and verifiable network actions. This framework bridges the gap between human expertise and machine-scale complexity, enabling more efficient, intelligent, and trustworthy management of 6G systems. Wireless Copilot will be a novel layer between the wireless infrastructure and the network operators. Moreover, we explore \emph{Wireless Copilot}'s methodology and analyze its application in Low-Altitude Wireless Networks (LAWNets) assisting 6G, including network design, configuration, evaluation, and optimization. Additionally, we present a case study on intent-based LAWNets resource allocation, demonstrating its superior adaptability compared to others. Finally, we outline future directions toward creating a comprehensive human-AI collaborative ecosystem for the 6G.

title: Holoscope: Open and Lightweight Telescope & Honeypot Platform
comments: Accepted for publication in IEEE Communications Magazine
summary: The complexity and scale of Internet attacks call for distributed, cooperative observatories capable of monitoring malicious traffic across diverse networks. Holoscope is an open, lightweight, and cloud-native platform designed to simplify the deployment and management of telescope (passive) and honeypot (active) sensors. Built upon K3s and WireGuard, Holoscope offers secure connectivity, automated sensor onboarding, and resilient operation even in resource-constrained environments. Through modular design and Infrastructure-as-Code principles, it supports dynamic sensor orchestration, automated recovery, and data processing. We build, deploy, and operate Holoscope across multiple institutions and cloud networks in Europe and Brazil, enabling unified visibility into large-scale attack phenomena while maintaining ease of integration and security compliance.

title: Asymptotic Stability of Conservative Convex-Combination Dynamics on Multilayer Graphs
summary:
We study discrete-time consensus dynamics on multilayer networks in which each layer evolves via a time-varying doubly stochastic interaction matrix, and inter-layer coupling is introduced through two mechanisms: (i) distribute-then-average and (ii) average-then-distribute. These define conservative redistribution processes that preserve total mass across all layers and can be viewed as stochastic averaging driven by products of time-inhomogeneous stochastic matrices with structured coupling.
  For both mechanisms, we construct quadratic Lyapunov functionals that form nonnegative supermartingales, yielding almost sure convergence. The analysis combines martingale arguments with dissipation identities and connectivity properties of induced interaction graphs. Under recurrent connectivity conditions on subgraphs of the time-varying interaction structure, we prove asymptotic consensus to the global average determined by the initial total mass.
  This provides a unified framework for multilayer averaging dynamics, extending classical consensus results for products of stochastic matrices to settings with explicit inter-layer coupling. As corollaries, we specialize the general framework to the multilayer garbage disposal dynamics, thereby establishing convergence guarantees under natural connectivity conditions on the underlying graphs.

AI.title_translation: 多层图上保守凸组合动力学的渐近稳定性
AI.tldr: 本文研究了多层网络上离散时间共识动力学的渐近稳定性，通过构建二次Lyapunov泛函和结合鞅论证，证明了在循环连通性条件下，系统能够几乎必然收敛并渐近达成全局平均共识，从而为多层平均动力学提供了一个统一的框架。
AI.motivation: 本研究的动机是为多层平均动力学提供一个统一的框架，并将经典的随机矩阵乘积共识结果扩展到具有显式层间耦合的环境中。
AI.method: 研究方法是研究多层网络上的离散时间共识动力学，其中每层通过时变双随机交互矩阵演化，并通过两种机制（先分布后平均和先平均后分布）引入层间耦合。通过构建形成非负上鞅的二次Lyapunov泛函，并结合鞅论证、耗散恒等式和诱导交互图的连通性属性进行分析。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，对于这两种机制，系统能够几乎必然收敛。在时变交互结构的子图上满足循环连通性条件时，证明了系统能够渐近达成由初始总质量决定的全局平均共识。
AI.conclusion: 本文为多层平均动力学提供了一个统一的框架，并将经典的随机矩阵乘积共识结果扩展到具有显式层间耦合的环境中。作为推论，该通用框架被专门应用于多层垃圾处理动力学，在底层图的自然连通性条件下建立了收敛性保证。
AI.translation: 我们研究了多层网络上的离散时间共识动力学，其中每一层都通过一个时变双随机交互矩阵演化，并通过两种机制引入了层间耦合：(i) 先分布后平均和 (ii) 先平均后分布。这些定义了保守的再分配过程，它们在所有层中保持总质量不变，可以被视为由具有结构化耦合的时变非齐次随机矩阵乘积驱动的随机平均。对于这两种机制，我们构建了形成非负上鞅的二次Lyapunov泛函，从而产生了几乎必然的收敛性。分析结合了鞅论证、耗散恒等式和诱导交互图的连通性属性。在时变交互结构的子图上的循环连通性条件下，我们证明了渐近共识收敛到由初始总质量决定的全局平均值。这为多层平均动力学提供了一个统一的框架，将经典的随机矩阵乘积共识结果扩展到具有显式层间耦合的环境。作为推论，我们将通用框架专门应用于多层垃圾处理动力学，从而在底层图的自然连通性条件下建立了收敛性保证。

title: Collaborative Lossless LLM Inference Serving with Offloading-based Pipeline Parallelism on Edge Devices
summary: Providing lossless inference services of LLMs on edge devices remains challenging, especially given the extremely tight memory budgets. The existing offloading techniques inevitably introduce numerous loading bubbles, which further inflate the end-to-end latency of the entire inference pipeline. Meanwhile, dynamically fluctuating network bandwidth and diverse user request patterns pose additional obstacles to efficient lossless inference on edge devices. To address this, we propose LOIP, a collaborative lossless LLM inference system that employs an offloading-based interleaved pipeline parallelism to better overlap model offloading with computing and communicating. Specifically, LOIP first constructs an offloading-aware cost model to characterize inference latency and memory overhead under heterogeneous device capabilities and limited bandwidth. Based on this cost model, LOIP develops a fine-grained allocation scheduler that determines latency-efficient layer partitions across devices while explicitly accounting for offloading overhead, along with a unified memory architecture (UMA)-aware loading optimization using customized CUDA operators to reduce runtime loading overhead. LOIP further designs an online memory adaptation strategy to handle the increasing KV cache pressure and dynamic bandwidth fluctuations during inference. We implement LOIP with 2500+ lines of Python and 500+ lines of C++/CUDA code, and deploy it on five heterogeneous NVIDIA Jetson edge devices for lossless collaborative inference of LLaMA3.3-70B-Instruct. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LOIP achieves 8.8$\times$$\sim$20.3$\times$ speedups over the SOTA baselines under different bandwidth conditions and request patterns without compromising model accuracy.

AI.title_translation: 基于边缘设备卸载式流水线并行的大模型协作无损推理服务
AI.tldr: LOIP 系统通过协同卸载和流水线并行优化，在边缘设备上实现了大模型的无损高效推理，速度提升高达 20 倍。
AI.motivation: 在边缘设备上进行无损大模型推理面临内存紧缺挑战，现有卸载技术会产生大量加载气泡，导致延迟高，且难以应对波动的网络带宽和多变的用户请求。
AI.method: 提出 LOIP 系统，包含：1. 构建感知卸载的成本模型；2. 开发精细化分配调度器以优化层级划分；3. 使用统一内存架构（UMA）感知的自定义 CUDA 算子减少加载开销；4. 设计在线内存自适应策略以应对 KV 缓存压力和网络波动。
AI.result: 在五台异构 NVIDIA Jetson 设备上部署 LLaMA3.3-70B-Instruct 模型，相较于现有最先进（SOTA）基线，实现了 8.8 倍至 20.3 倍的加速，且未损失模型精度。
AI.conclusion: LOIP 系统通过协同卸载和流水线并行技术，成功在边缘设备上实现了大规模语言模型（如 LLaMA3.3-70B）的高效、无损推理，显著降低了延迟。
AI.translation: 在边缘设备上提供大模型（LLM）的无损推理服务仍然具有挑战性，特别是考虑到极其紧张的内存预算。现有的卸载技术不可避免地引入了大量的加载气泡，这进一步增加了整个推理流水线的端到端延迟。同时，动态波动的网络带宽和多样的用户请求模式为边缘设备上的高效无损推理带来了额外的障碍。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 LOIP，这是一个协作式无损 LLM 推理系统，它采用了基于卸载的交错流水线并行，以更好地重叠模型卸载、计算和通信。具体来说，LOIP 首先构建了一个感知卸载的成本模型，以表征在异构设备能力和有限带宽下的推理延迟和内存开销。基于此成本模型，LOIP 开发了一种细粒度的分配调度器，在明确考虑卸载开销的同时确定跨设备的延迟高效层分区，并使用自定义 CUDA 算子进行统一内存架构（UMA）感知的加载优化，以减少运行时加载开销。LOIP 进一步设计了一种在线内存自适应策略，以处理推理过程中日益增加的 KV 缓存压力和动态带宽波动。我们用 2500 多行 Python 代码和 500 多行 C++/CUDA 代码实现了 LOIP，并将其部署在五台异构 NVIDIA Jetson 边缘设备上，用于 LLaMA3.3-70B-Instruct 的无损协同推理。大量实验表明，在不同的带宽条件和请求模式下，LOIP 在不影响模型精度的情况下，比最先进的基线实现了 8.8 倍至 20.3 倍的加速。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 LOIP 系统，通过采用基于卸载的交错流水线并行技术，旨在解决边缘设备上大模型无损推理的延迟问题。该系统通过构建成本模型进行精细化任务调度，并利用自定义 CUDA 算子和动态内存适应策略，有效重叠了模型卸载、计算与通信过程。实验证明，LOIP 在异构边缘环境下能显著提升推理性能。
AI.keywords: 大模型推理, 边缘计算, 流水线并行, 模型卸载, 负载调度
AI.comments: 该论文针对边缘设备资源受限的痛点，提出了通过协同推理和流水线并行来优化大模型服务的方法。其创新之处在于通过成本模型对卸载和计算进行精细化调度，并结合CUDA算子优化，有效解决了传统卸载技术中常见的“加载气泡”问题，在保证模型无损的前提下实现了显著的性能提升。

title: A New Family of Binary Sequences via Elliptic Function Fields over Finite Fields of Odd Characteristics
comments: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2407.18570 by other authors
summary: Motivated by the constructions of binary sequences by utilizing the cyclic elliptic function fields over the finite field $\mathbb{F}_{2^{n}}$ by Jin \textit{et al.} in [IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory 71(8), 2025], we extend the construction to the cyclic elliptic function fields with odd characteristic by using the quadratic residue map $η$ instead of the trace map used therein. For any cyclic elliptic function field with $q+1+t$ rational points and any positive integer $d$ with $\gcd(d, q+1+t)=1$, we construct a new family of binary sequences of length $q+1+t$, size $q^{d-1}-1$, balance upper bounded by $(d+1)\cdot\lfloor2\sqrt{q}\rfloor+|t|+d,$ the correlation upper bounded by $(2d+1)\cdot\lfloor2\sqrt{q}\rfloor+|t|+2d$ and the linear complexity lower bounded by $\frac{q+1+2t-d-(d+1)\cdot\lfloor2\sqrt{q}\rfloor}{d+d\cdot\lfloor2\sqrt{q}\rfloor}$ where $\lfloor x\rfloor$ stands for the integer part of $x\in\mathbb{R}$.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在奇特征有限域上使用二次剩余映射，扩展了现有二元序列的构造方法，并构建了一个具有良好密码学性质的新型二元序列家族。
AI.motivation: 受Jin等人利用有限域$\mathbb{F}_{2^{n}}$上的循环椭圆函数域构造二元序列的启发，本文旨在将该构造扩展到奇特征的循环椭圆函数域。
AI.method: 通过使用二次剩余映射$η$代替现有方法中的迹映射，将二元序列的构造扩展到奇特征的循环椭圆函数域。对于具有$q+1+t$个有理点和满足$\gcd(d, q+1+t)=1$的正整数$d$的任意循环椭圆函数域，构建了一个新的二元序列家族。
AI.result: 构建的二元序列具有以下性质：长度为$q+1+t$，大小为$q^{d-1}-1$，平衡性上限为$(d+1)\cdot\lfloor2\sqrt{q}\rfloor+|t|+d$，相关性上限为$(2d+1)\cdot\lfloor2\sqrt{q}\rfloor+|t|+2d$，线性复杂度下限为$\frac{q+1+2t-d-(d+1)\cdot\lfloor2\sqrt{q}\rfloor}{d+d\cdot\lfloor2\sqrt{q}\rfloor}$。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功地在奇特征有限域上构建了一个新的二元序列家族，并通过二次剩余映射替代了迹映射，该家族的序列在长度、大小、平衡性、相关性和线性复杂度方面表现出良好的密码学特性。
AI.translation: 受Jin等人（IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory 71(8), 2025）利用有限域$\mathbb{F}_{2^{n}}$上的循环椭圆函数域构造二元序列的启发，我们将构造扩展到奇特征的循环椭圆函数域，通过使用二次剩余映射$η$代替其中使用的迹映射。对于任何具有$q+1+t$个有理点和满足$\gcd(d, q+1+t)=1$的正整数$d$的循环椭圆函数域，我们构造了一个新的二元序列家族，其长度为$q+1+t$，大小为$q^{d-1}-1$，平衡性上限为$(d+1)\cdot\lfloor2\sqrt{q}\rfloor+|t|+d$，相关性上限为$(2d+1)\cdot\lfloor2\sqrt{q}\rfloor+|t|+2d$，线性复杂度下限为$\frac{q+1+2t-d-(d+1)\cdot\lfloor2\sqrt{q}\rfloor}{d+d\cdot\lfloor2\sqrt{q}\rfloor}$，其中$\lfloor x\rfloor$表示$x\in\mathbb{R}$的整数部分。
AI.summary: 本文基于Jin等人的工作，将二元序列的构造方法扩展到奇特征有限域上的循环椭圆函数域。通过引入二次剩余映射代替迹映射，作者成功构建了一个新的二元序列家族。该序列家族的长度、大小、平衡性、相关性和线性复杂度均得到了明确的界定，显示出良好的密码学性能。
AI.keywords: 二元序列, 椭圆函数域, 有限域, 奇特征, 二次剩余映射
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将二元序列的构造从偶特征有限域扩展到奇特征有限域，并通过引入二次剩余映射实现了这一扩展。这为密码学中安全序列的设计提供了新的思路和工具，所提出的序列具有可量化的良好密码学特性，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: EchoFoley: Event-Centric Hierarchical Control for Video Grounded Creative Sound Generation
summary: Sound effects build an essential layer of multimodal storytelling, shaping the emotional atmosphere and the narrative semantics of videos. Despite recent advancement in video-text-to-audio (VT2A), the current formulation faces three key limitations: First, an imbalance between visual and textual conditioning that leads to visual dominance; Second, the absence of a concrete definition for fine-grained controllable generation; Third, weak instruction understanding and following, as existing datasets rely on brief categorical tags. To address these limitations, we introduce EchoFoley, a new task designed for video-grounded sound generation with both event level local control and hierarchical semantic control. Our symbolic representation for sounding events specifies when, what, and how each sound is produced within a video or instruction, enabling fine-grained controls like sound generation, insertion, and editing. To support this task, we construct EchoFoley-6k, a large-scale, expert-curated benchmark containing over 6,000 video-instruction-annotation triplets. Building upon this foundation, we propose EchoVidia a sounding-event-centric agentic generation framework with slow-fast thinking strategy. Experiments show that EchoVidia surpasses recent VT2A models by 40.7% in controllability and 12.5% in perceptual quality.

AI.title_translation: EchoFoley：面向视频接地创意声音生成的事件中心分层控制
AI.tldr: EchoFoley通过引入事件级局部控制和分层语义控制来解决现有视频-文本-到-音频（VT2A）模型的局限性，并发布了EchoFoley-6k数据集和EchoVidia框架，显著提高了可控性和感知质量。
AI.motivation: 现有VT2A模型存在视觉和文本条件不平衡、缺乏细粒度可控生成定义以及指令理解和遵循能力弱的问题。
AI.method: 提出EchoFoley任务，使用符号化表示来指定声音事件的发生时间、内容和方式，实现声音生成、插入和编辑等细粒度控制。构建了EchoFoley-6k数据集。提出EchoVidia框架，采用慢快思考策略。
AI.result: EchoVidia在可控性方面比现有VT2A模型提高了40.7%，在感知质量方面提高了12.5%。
AI.conclusion: EchoFoley任务和EchoVidia框架能够有效地进行视频接地创意声音生成，并在可控性和感知质量方面取得显著提升。
AI.translation: 声音效果是多模态叙事的重要组成部分，能够塑造视频的情感氛围和叙事语义。尽管最近在视频-文本-到音频（VT2A）方面取得了进展，但目前的模型存在三个主要局限性：首先，视觉和文本条件之间存在不平衡，导致视觉主导；其次，缺乏细粒度可控生成的具体定义；第三，指令理解和遵循能力较弱，因为现有数据集依赖于简短的分类标签。为了解决这些局限性，我们引入了EchoFoley，一项专为视频接地声音生成设计的新任务，具有事件级的局部控制和分层语义控制。我们为发声事件设计的符号化表示指定了每个声音在视频或指令中何时、何种以及如何产生，从而实现了声音生成、插入和编辑等细粒度控制。为了支持这项任务，我们构建了EchoFoley-6k，一个包含超过6000个视频-指令-标注三元组的大规模、专家策展基准。在此基础上，我们提出了EchoVidia，一个以发声事件为中心的代理生成框架，并采用了慢快思考策略。实验表明，EchoVidia在可控性方面比最近的VT2A模型提高了40.7%，在感知质量方面提高了12.5%。
AI.summary: EchoFoley提出了一种新的视频接地声音生成任务，旨在解决现有VT2A模型的局限性。该任务通过事件级局部控制和分层语义控制，允许对声音的生成、插入和编辑进行细粒度操作。为此，研究者构建了EchoFoley-6k数据集，并提出了EchoVidia框架，该框架采用了慢快思考策略，实验结果表明其在可控性和感知质量方面均优于现有模型。
AI.keywords: 视频声音生成, 事件中心控制, 分层语义控制, EchoFoley, EchoVidia
AI.comments: 该研究在视频声音生成领域取得了重要进展，通过引入事件中心和分层控制的概念，以及相应的数据集和框架，有效解决了现有模型的痛点。特别之处在于其细粒度的控制能力和慢快思考策略，为未来视频内容创作和多模态AI研究提供了新的方向。然而，对于EchoFoley-6k数据集的规模和多样性，以及EchoVidia框架在更广泛场景下的泛化能力，还需要进一步的验证。

title: Bridging Mechanistic Interpretability and Prompt Engineering with Gradient Ascent for Interpretable Persona Control
summary: Controlling emergent behavioral personas (e.g., sycophancy, hallucination) in Large Language Models (LLMs) is critical for AI safety, yet remains a persistent challenge. Existing solutions face a dilemma: manual prompt engineering is intuitive but unscalable and imprecise, while automatic optimization methods are effective but operate as "black boxes" with no interpretable connection to model internals. We propose a novel framework that adapts gradient ascent to LLMs, enabling targeted prompt discovery. In specific, we propose two methods, RESGA and SAEGA, that both optimize randomly initialized prompts to achieve better aligned representation with an identified persona direction. We introduce fluent gradient ascent to control the fluency of discovered persona steering prompts. We demonstrate RESGA and SAEGA's effectiveness across Llama 3.1, Qwen 2.5, and Gemma 3 for steering three different personas, sycophancy, hallucination, and myopic reward. Crucially, on sycophancy, our automatically discovered prompts achieve significant improvement (49.90% compared with 79.24%). By grounding prompt discovery in mechanistically meaningful features, our method offers a new paradigm for controllable and interpretable behavior modification. We release our scripts for RESGA and SAEGA in this github repo: https://github.com/HarshSaini10/RESGA_SAEGA.

AI.title_translation: 使用梯度上升连接机制可解释性和提示工程以实现可解释的个性控制
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新颖的框架，通过梯度上升技术来自动发现和优化用于控制大型语言模型（LLMs）行为的提示，解决了手动提示工程不精确和现有自动优化方法缺乏可解释性的问题。该框架通过RESGA和SAEGA两种方法，在多种模型和多种行为（如谄媚、幻觉、近视奖励）上进行了有效性验证，显著提高了对特定行为的控制能力，并为可控和可解释的行为修改提供了新途径。
AI.motivation: 现有的大型语言模型（LLMs）在控制其涌现行为（如谄媚、幻觉）方面存在挑战：手动提示工程不精确且难以扩展，而自动优化方法缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的框架，采用梯度上升技术来自动优化随机初始化的提示，使其与识别出的特定行为方向（persona direction）对齐，并引入了流畅梯度上升（fluent gradient ascent）来控制生成提示的流畅性。具体方法包括RESGA和SAEGA。
AI.result: RESGA和SAEGA在Llama 3.1、Qwen 2.5和Gemma 3模型上成功地引导了谄媚、幻觉和近视奖励三种行为。尤其在控制谄媚行为方面，自动发现的提示相比基线方法（79.24% vs 49.90%）有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的方法通过将提示发现与机制上具有意义的特征相结合，为实现可控且可解释的行为修改提供了一种新范式，解决了现有方法的局限性。
AI.translation: 控制大型语言模型（LLMs）中涌现的行为个性（例如，谄媚、幻觉）对于AI安全至关重要，但仍然是一个持续的挑战。现有解决方案面临一个困境：手动提示工程直观但不可扩展且不精确，而自动优化方法虽然有效但却像“黑箱”一样运作，与模型内部机制没有可解释的联系。我们提出了一种新颖的框架，将梯度上升应用于LLMs，从而实现有针对性的提示发现。具体来说，我们提出了RESGA和SAEGA两种方法，它们都优化了随机初始化的提示，以实现与已识别的个性方向更优的对齐。我们引入了流畅梯度上升来控制发现的个性引导提示的流畅性。我们在Llama 3.1、Qwen 2.5和Gemma 3上演示了RESGA和SAEGA在引导三种不同个性——谄媚、幻觉和近视奖励——方面的有效性。至关重要的是，在谄媚方面，我们自动发现的提示取得了显著的改进（与79.24%相比为49.90%）。通过将提示发现建立在机制上具有意义的特征之上，我们的方法为可控和可解释的行为修改提供了一种新范式。我们在该GitHub仓库中发布了RESGA和SAEGA的脚本：https://github.com/HarshSaini10/RESGA_SAEGA。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的框架，结合了机制可解释性和提示工程，利用梯度上升技术自动发现和优化用于控制大型语言模型（LLMs）中特定行为（如谄媚、幻觉）的提示。该方法通过RESGA和SAEGA两种具体实现，解决了手动提示工程的局限性和现有自动优化方法的“黑箱”问题，实现了对模型行为的可解释控制，并在多种模型和行为上取得了显著效果。
AI.keywords: 机制可解释性, 提示工程, 梯度上升, LLMs行为控制, 个性化引导
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地将机制可解释性与提示工程相结合，利用梯度上升来自动优化提示，解决了LLMs行为控制中的一个关键难题。RESGA和SAEGA方法的提出，以及在多种模型和行为上的有效性验证，为AI安全和可控性研究提供了有价值的工具和思路。其最大的亮点在于，它不仅提高了控制的有效性，还增加了可解释性，这在当前AI领域尤为重要。未来可以进一步探索该方法在更复杂行为控制和模型上的应用。

title: Evolving Programmatic Skill Networks
summary: We study continual skill acquisition in open-ended embodied environments where an agent must construct, refine, and reuse an expanding library of executable skills. We introduce the Programmatic Skill Network (PSN), a framework in which skills are executable symbolic programs forming a compositional network that evolves through experience. PSN defines three core mechanisms instantiated via large language models: (1)~\opreflect for structured fault localization over skill compositions, (2)~progressive optimization with maturity-aware update gating that stabilizes reliable skills while maintaining plasticity for uncertain ones, and (3)~canonical structural refactoring under rollback validation that maintains network compactness. We further show that PSN's learning dynamics exhibit structural parallels to neural network training. Experiments on MineDojo and Crafter demonstrate robust skill reuse, rapid adaptation, and strong generalization across open-ended task distributions.

AI.title_translation: 演化程序化技能网络
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为程序化技能网络（PSN）的框架，用于在开放式具身环境中实现持续的技能获取。PSN利用大型语言模型来构建、优化和重构可执行的符号程序技能网络，以实现技能的组合、复用和演化。实验表明，PSN在MineDojo和Crafter等环境中表现出强大的技能复用、快速适应和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 在开放式具身环境中，智能体需要持续构建、优化和复用不断扩展的可执行技能库，以应对复杂任务。
AI.method: 提出程序化技能网络（PSN）框架，该框架包含三个核心机制：1. 使用opreflect进行结构化故障定位；2. 采用具有成熟度感知更新门控的渐进式优化，以稳定可靠技能并保持不确定技能的可塑性；3. 在回滚验证下进行规范结构重构，以保持网络紧凑性。这些机制均通过大型语言模型实现。
AI.result: 在MineDojo和Crafter实验中，PSN展现了强大的技能复用、快速适应以及在开放式任务分布下的强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: PSN框架通过其创新的机制，有效解决了开放式具身环境中持续技能获取的挑战，并在实验中证明了其优越的性能。
AI.translation: 我们研究开放式具身环境中持续的技能获取，其中智能体必须构建、优化和复用不断扩展的可执行技能库。我们引入了程序化技能网络（PSN），一个技能是可执行的符号程序，形成一个通过经验演化的组合网络。PSN定义了三个核心机制，通过大型语言模型实现：(1) opreflect 用于技能组合的结构化故障定位，(2) 具有成熟度感知更新门控的渐进式优化，稳定可靠的技能，同时保持不确定技能的可塑性，以及 (3) 在回滚验证下进行规范结构重构，保持网络紧凑性。我们进一步表明，PSN的学习动态表现出与神经网络训练的结构相似性。在MineDojo和Crafter上的实验证明了其在开放式任务分布上的鲁棒技能复用、快速适应和强泛化能力。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了程序化技能网络（PSN）框架，利用大型语言模型来处理开放式具身环境中的持续技能获取问题。PSN通过结构化故障定位、成熟度感知优化和规范结构重构等机制，构建了一个可演化的、组合式的技能网络。实验结果表明，PSN在技能复用、适应性和泛化能力方面表现出色。
AI.keywords: 程序化技能网络, 持续学习, 具身环境, 大型语言模型, 技能组合
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的框架PSN，利用LLM在开放式环境中进行持续技能获取，解决了技能的组合、优化和重构问题。其核心机制和学习动态具有理论和实践意义，但对于LLM在其中扮演的具体角色和计算成本仍需进一步探讨。

title: Disentangling Aleatoric and Epistemic Uncertainty in Physics-Informed Neural Networks. Application to Insulation Material Degradation Prognostics
summary: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) provide a framework for integrating physical laws with data. However, their application to Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) remains constrained by the limited uncertainty quantification (UQ) capabilities. Most existing PINN-based prognostics approaches are deterministic or account only for epistemic uncertainty, limiting their suitability for risk-aware decision-making. This work introduces a heteroscedastic Bayesian Physics-Informed Neural Network (B-PINN) framework that jointly models epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty, yielding full predictive posteriors for spatiotemporal insulation material ageing estimation. The approach integrates Bayesian Neural Networks (BNNs) with physics-based residual enforcement and prior distributions, enabling probabilistic inference within a physics-informed learning architecture. The framework is evaluated on transformer insulation ageing application, validated with a finite-element thermal model and field measurements from a solar power plant, and benchmarked against deterministic PINNs, dropout-based PINNs (d-PINNs), and alternative B-PINN variants. Results show that the proposed B-PINN provides improved predictive accuracy and better-calibrated uncertainty estimates than competing approaches. A systematic sensitivity study further analyzes the impact of boundary-condition, initial-condition, and residual sampling strategies on accuracy, calibration, and generalization, and the influence of measurement noise on aleatoric uncertainty. Overall, the findings highlight the capability of Bayesian physics-informed learning to support uncertainty-aware prognostics and informed decision-making in transformer asset management by tracking aleatoric and epistemic sources of uncertainty.

AI.title_translation: 物理信息神经网络中偶然不确定性和认知不确定性的解耦。在绝缘材料退化预测中的应用
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种异方差贝叶斯物理信息神经网络（B-PINN）框架，用于联合建模偶然不确定性和认知不确定性，以提高绝缘材料老化的预测精度和不确定性量化能力，支持风险感知决策。
AI.motivation: 现有的物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在预测与健康管理（PHM）中的应用受到有限的不确定性量化（UQ）能力的限制，大多数方法是确定性的或仅考虑认知不确定性，不适用于风险感知决策。
AI.method: 本文引入了一个异方差贝叶斯物理信息神经网络（B-PINN）框架，该框架联合建模认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）和偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty），通过整合贝叶斯神经网络（BNNs）与基于物理的残差强制和先验分布，在物理信息学习架构中实现概率推断。该方法应用于变压器绝缘老化估计。
AI.result: 提出的B-PINN比现有方法（确定性PINNs、基于Dropout的PINNs和替代B-PINN变体）提供了更高的预测精度和更好校准的不确定性估计。系统敏感性研究分析了边界条件、初始条件和残差采样策略对精度、校准和泛化的影响，以及测量噪声对偶然不确定性的影响。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯物理信息学习能够通过跟踪偶然不确定性和认知不确定性来源，支持变压器资产管理中不确定性感知的预测和知情决策。
AI.translation: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）提供了一个整合物理定律与数据的框架。然而，它们在预测与健康管理（PHM）中的应用受到有限不确定性量化（UQ）能力的限制。大多数现有的基于PINN的预测方法是确定性的或仅考虑认知不确定性，这限制了它们在风险感知决策中的适用性。这项工作引入了一种异方差贝叶斯物理信息神经网络（B-PINN）框架，该框架联合建模认知不确定性和偶然不确定性，为时空绝缘材料老化估计提供完整的预测后验。该方法将贝叶斯神经网络（BNNs）与基于物理的残差强制和先验分布相结合，从而在物理信息学习架构中实现概率推断。该框架在变压器绝缘老化应用中进行了评估，通过有限元热模型和太阳能电厂的现场测量进行了验证，并与确定性PINNs、基于Dropout的PINNs（d-PINNs）和替代B-PINN变体进行了基准测试。结果表明，所提出的B-PINN比竞争方法提供了更高的预测精度和更好校准的不确定性估计。一项系统的敏感性研究进一步分析了边界条件、初始条件和残差采样策略对精度、校准和泛化的影响，以及测量噪声对偶然不确定性的影响。总的来说，研究结果强调了贝叶斯物理信息学习通过跟踪偶然不确定性来源和认知不确定性来源，支持变压器资产管理中不确定性感知的预测和知情决策的能力。
AI.summary: 本文针对物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在预测与健康管理（PHM）中不确定性量化能力不足的问题，提出了一种异方差贝叶斯物理信息神经网络（B-PINN）框架。该框架能够联合建模偶然不确定性（Aleatoric Uncertainty）和认知不确定性（Epistemic Uncertainty），从而为绝缘材料老化估计提供全面的预测后验分布。通过将贝叶斯神经网络（BNNs）与物理残差和先验分布相结合，实现了在物理信息学习架构中的概率推断。实验结果表明，该B-PINN在预测精度和不确定性校准方面优于现有方法，并能有效支持风险感知的决策。
AI.keywords: 物理信息神经网络, 贝叶斯神经网络, 不确定性量化, 绝缘材料退化, 预测与健康管理
AI.comments: 这项工作通过引入异方差贝叶斯物理信息神经网络，有效地解决了传统PINNs在不确定性量化方面的局限性，特别是在区分偶然不确定性和认知不确定性方面取得了重要进展。这对于需要风险感知决策的预测与健康管理领域具有重要意义。该方法通过整合贝叶斯方法和物理信息，提高了模型的鲁棒性和解释性。

title: Lightweight Test-Time Adaptation for EMG-Based Gesture Recognition
summary:
Reliable long-term decoding of gestures from surface electromyography (EMG) is hindered by signal drift caused by electrode displacement, muscle fatigue, and/or posture changes. Although modern models achieve high intra-session accuracy, their performance often degrades substantially across recording sessions. Existing approaches to mitigate this problem typically rely on large training datasets or computationally intensive pipelines that are unsuitable for energy-efficient wearable devices.
  We propose a lightweight test-time adaptation framework for EMG decoding. The framework includes three complementary adaptation strategies: (i) causal adaptive batch normalization for online statistical alignment, (ii) Gaussian Mixture Model alignment with experience replay to mitigate forgetting, and (iii) meta-learning for rapid few-shot calibration. We evaluate these methods on the multi-session NinaPro DB6 dataset. All approaches substantially improve inter-session robustness relative to a non-adaptive baseline while maintaining low computational overhead. Replay-regularized statistical alignment provides the most stable adaptation under limited data, while meta-learning achieves the highest accuracy when sparse calibration labels are available.
  Overall, our self-supervised test-time adaptation methods reach up to 82% inter-session accuracy, significantly improving upon prior approaches while maintaining resource-efficient operation. These results demonstrate that lightweight test-time adaptation can enable robust, long-term EMG decoding for wearable or prosthetic applications.

AI.title_translation: 轻量级测试时自适应用于基于肌电图的手势识别
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级测试时自适应框架，通过三种互补策略显著提高了肌电图手势识别的跨会话鲁棒性，特别适用于资源受限的可穿戴设备。
AI.motivation: 基于表面肌电图的手势识别因信号漂移（电极位移、肌肉疲劳、姿势变化）导致长期解码不可靠，现有方法计算密集，不适用于节能可穿戴设备。
AI.method: 提出了一种轻量级测试时自适应框架，包含三种策略：(i) 因果自适应批归一化用于在线统计对齐，(ii) 带有经验回放的高斯混合模型对齐以减轻遗忘，以及 (iii) 元学习用于快速小样本校准。
AI.result: 所有方法均显著提高了跨会话鲁棒性，同时保持低计算开销。经验回放正则化的统计对齐在数据有限时最稳定，元学习在稀疏校准标签可用时精度最高。自监督测试时自适应方法达到高达82%的跨会话准确率，显著优于现有方法并保持资源高效。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级测试时自适应可以为可穿戴或假肢应用实现稳健、长期的肌电图解码。
AI.translation:
肌电图（EMG）信号漂移由电极位移、肌肉疲劳和/或姿势变化引起，阻碍了基于表面肌电图手势的可靠长期解码。尽管现代模型在会话内准确率很高，但它们的性能在不同记录会话之间通常会大幅下降。现有的缓解此问题的方法通常依赖于大型训练数据集或计算密集型管道，这不适用于节能可穿戴设备。
我们提出了一种用于肌电图解码的轻量级测试时自适应框架。该框架包括三种互补的自适应策略：(i) 用于在线统计对齐的因果自适应批归一化，(ii) 带有经验回放的高斯混合模型对齐以减轻遗忘，以及 (iii) 用于快速小样本校准的元学习。我们在多会话NinaPro DB6数据集上评估了这些方法。与非自适应基线相比，所有方法都显著提高了会话间鲁棒性，同时保持了较低的计算开销。经验回放正则化的统计对齐在数据有限的情况下提供了最稳定的自适应，而元学习在稀疏校准标签可用时实现了最高的准确率。
总体而言，我们的自监督测试时自适应方法达到了高达82%的会话间准确率，显著优于现有方法，同时保持了资源高效的操作。这些结果表明，轻量级测试时自适应可以为可穿戴或假肢应用实现稳健、长期的肌电图解码。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个轻量级测试时自适应框架，旨在解决基于肌电图手势识别中因信号漂移导致的跨会话性能下降问题。该框架整合了因果自适应批归一化、经验回放高斯混合模型对齐和元学习三种策略。实验结果表明，这些方法在保持低计算开销的同时，显著提升了跨会话鲁棒性，最高可达82%的准确率，为可穿戴设备提供了长期、稳健的肌电图解码能力。
AI.keywords: 肌电图, 手势识别, 测试时自适应, 信号漂移, 可穿戴设备
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个整合多种策略的轻量级测试时自适应框架，有效地解决了肌电图信号漂移导致的跨会话性能下降问题，且特别关注了计算效率，使其适用于资源受限的可穿戴设备。这对于实现长期可靠的肌电图手势识别具有重要意义。

title: BioPIE: A Biomedical Protocol Information Extraction Dataset for Experiment Understanding
summary: Understanding biomedical experiments provides a foundation for downstream tasks, e.g., laboratory automation, and facilitates effective cross-disciplinary communication. Two challenges, High Information Density (HID) and Multi-Step Reasoning (MSR), pose unique difficulties for precise experimental understanding. Extracting structured knowledge, e.g., Knowledge Graphs (KGs), is an effective approach to address the HID and MSR. However, existing biomedical datasets for structured knowledge information extraction are limited to a general or coarse-grained level, hindering fine-grained experimental understanding. To address this gap, we introduce Biomedical Protocol Information Extraction Dataset (BioPIE), a dataset providing procedure-centric KGs that capture entities, actions, and relations at a scale sufficient for reasoning across biomedical protocols. We evaluate information extraction methods on BioPIE and implement a question answering system leveraging the dataset for validation, demonstrating improved understanding performance on test sets as well as on the HID and MSR question sets.

AI.title_translation: BioPIE：一个用于实验理解的生物医学协议信息提取数据集
AI.tldr: BioPIE是一个新的生物医学协议信息提取数据集，它通过提供以程序为中心的知识图谱，解决了现有数据集在细粒度实验理解方面的不足，并提高了信息提取和问答系统的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有用于结构化知识信息提取的生物医学数据集仅限于一般或粗粒度级别，阻碍了细粒度的实验理解。生物医学实验存在高信息密度（HID）和多步骤推理（MSR）的挑战。
AI.method: 引入BioPIE数据集，该数据集提供以程序为中心的知识图谱，以足以在生物医学协议中进行推理的规模捕获实体、动作和关系。在BioPIE上评估信息提取方法，并实现一个利用该数据集进行验证的问答系统。
AI.result: 在测试集以及高信息密度（HID）和多步骤推理（MSR）问题集上，理解性能得到了提高。
AI.conclusion: BioPIE数据集能够有效解决生物医学实验理解中的高信息密度和多步骤推理挑战，并显著提高信息提取和问答系统的性能。
AI.translation: 理解生物医学实验为下游任务（例如实验室自动化）提供了基础，并促进有效的跨学科交流。高信息密度（HID）和多步骤推理（MSR）这两个挑战为精确的实验理解带来了独特的困难。提取结构化知识（例如知识图谱（KGs））是解决HID和MSR的有效方法。然而，现有的用于结构化知识信息提取的生物医学数据集仅限于一般或粗粒度级别，阻碍了细粒度的实验理解。为了解决这一差距，我们引入了生物医学协议信息提取数据集（BioPIE），该数据集提供了以程序为中心的知识图谱，以足以在生物医学协议中进行推理的规模捕获实体、动作和关系。我们评估了BioPIE上的信息提取方法，并实现了一个利用该数据集进行验证的问答系统，证明了在测试集以及HID和MSR问题集上理解性能的提高。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了BioPIE，一个新颖的生物医学协议信息提取数据集，旨在克服现有通用或粗粒度数据集的局限性。BioPIE提供以程序为中心的知识图谱，捕获对理解复杂生物医学实验至关重要的细粒度实体、动作和关系，这些实验通常具有高信息密度和多步骤推理的特点。作者在BioPIE上评估了信息提取方法和问答系统，证明了实验理解性能的提高。
AI.keywords: BioPIE, 生物医学协议, 信息提取, 知识图谱, 实验理解
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于创建了一个用于生物医学协议的细粒度、以程序为中心的知识图谱数据集（BioPIE），解决了高信息密度和多步骤推理等关键挑战，这些挑战阻碍了精确的实验理解。这个数据集对于推动实验室自动化和跨学科交流具有重要意义。

title: LGTD: Local-Global Trend Decomposition for Season-Length-Free Time Series Analysis
comments: Second draft: The code and dataset is at https://github.com/chotanansub/LGTD
summary:
Time series decomposition into trend, seasonal, and residual components is a fundamental primitive in data mining and analytics pipelines, underpinning anomaly detection, change-point analysis, and forecasting. Most existing methods require a user-specified or estimated season length and assume stable periodic structure. In large, heterogeneous collections, where recurring patterns drift, appear intermittently, or operate at multiple nonstationary scales, period selection becomes brittle and per-series tuning does not scale.
  We propose LGTD (Local-Global Trend Decomposition), a season-length-free decomposition framework that requires no period specification and operates with a single fixed default configuration across datasets. LGTD represents a series as the sum of (i) a smooth global trend capturing long-term evolution, (ii) adaptive local trends inferred by an error-driven local linear segmentation procedure, and (iii) a residual component. Rather than modeling seasonality through an explicit periodic basis, LGTD treats it as an emergent property arising from the recurrence of local trend regimes, decoupling decomposition quality from any estimated season length.
  We prove that the local trend inference procedure terminates in a bounded number of iterations and runs in linear time in the series length, independent of any seasonal parameter, and confirm this empirically: LGTD scales linearly in runtime and memory and is the fastest method across all tested lengths, while several baselines degrade super-linearly. On synthetic benchmarks LGTD achieves balanced accuracy across fixed, transitive, and variable season-length regimes, particularly where period-based methods degrade, and on real-world data it yields interpretable components and low-structure residuals. Source code and datasets are available at https://github.com/chotanansub/LGTD.
