title: Ensemble Distributionally Robust Bayesian Optimisation with Continuous Context
summary: We study Bayesian Optimisation (BO) in settings where the objective function is influenced by uncontrollable environmental contexts governed by an unknown probability distribution. In practice, the contextual distribution must be estimated from empirical data, a process that inherently introduces distributional mismatch, producing sub-optimal results. While Distributionally Robust Optimisation (DRO) provides a framework to mitigate these risks, existing robust BO methods frequently suffer from high computational complexity, rely on discretisation of continuous context spaces, or impose restrictive assumptions on the structure of the ambiguity set. To overcome these limitations, we propose Ensemble Distributionally Robust Bayesian Optimisation (EDRBO). Our framework leverages the expressive power of ensemble surrogate models to approximate the black-box function while simultaneously accounting for contextual uncertainty. By utilising Wasserstein ball as ambiguity sets, EDRBO provides a robustified acquisition function that remains computationally tractable and natively handles continuous context spaces. We establish a rigorous theoretical foundation for our approach by proving sublinear cumulative regret guarantees of order $\mathcal{O}(γ_T \sqrt{T})$, where $γ_T$ represents the maximum information gain within the ensemble. Finally, we provide extensive empirical evaluations that corroborate our theory and demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of EDRBO.

AI.title_translation: 具有连续上下文的集成分布鲁棒贝叶斯优化
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为EDRBO的新型贝叶斯优化框架，通过集成模型和Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化，在连续上下文环境下实现了高效、鲁棒的决策优化。
AI.motivation: 现有贝叶斯优化方法在处理由未知分布控制的环境上下文时，因估计偏差导致的分布不匹配问题，且现有鲁棒方法存在计算复杂度高、依赖空间离散化或假设限制等缺陷。

AI.result: 证明了该方法具有 $\mathcal{O}(γ_T \sqrt{T})$ 的次线性累积遗憾界，实证结果表明该方法在处理连续上下文时达到了当前最优性能。
AI.conclusion: EDRBO框架通过集成代理模型和Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化，成功解决了上下文贝叶斯优化中的分布不匹配问题，并在理论和实证上表现出色。
AI.translation: 我们研究了目标函数受控于未知概率分布的不可控环境上下文影响下的贝叶斯优化（BO）。在实践中，必须从经验数据中估计上下文分布，这一过程固有地引入了分布不匹配，导致结果次优。虽然分布鲁棒优化（DRO）提供了一个减轻这些风险的框架，但现有的鲁棒BO方法经常面临高计算复杂度、依赖连续上下文空间的离散化，或对模糊集结构施加限制性假设的问题。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了集成分布鲁棒贝叶斯优化（EDRBO）。我们的框架利用集成代理模型的表达能力来近似黑盒函数，同时考虑上下文的不确定性。通过利用Wasserstein球作为模糊集，EDRBO提供了一种鲁棒的获取函数，该函数保持了计算的可行性，并能原生处理连续上下文空间。我们通过证明 $\mathcal{O}(γ_T \sqrt{T})$ 阶的次线性累积遗憾保证（其中 $γ_T$ 代表集成内的最大信息增益），为我们的方法建立了严谨的理论基础。最后，我们提供了广泛的实证评估，证实了我们的理论并展示了EDRBO的最先进性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种集成分布鲁棒贝叶斯优化（EDRBO）方法，旨在解决环境上下文分布未知带来的鲁棒性挑战。通过集成代理模型与基于Wasserstein球的分布鲁棒优化，该方法无需离散化即可处理连续上下文，并保证了计算效率与理论最优性。
AI.keywords: 贝叶斯优化, 分布鲁棒优化, 集成学习, Wasserstein距离, 上下文环境
AI.comments: 该研究通过集成模型与分布鲁棒优化（DRO）的结合，有效地解决了贝叶斯优化在连续上下文环境下的鲁棒性问题。其创新点在于利用Wasserstein球构建模糊集，在保持计算可行性的同时，实现了对连续上下文空间的直接处理，具有较强的理论支撑。

title: When Language Overwrites Vision: Over-Alignment and Geometric Debiasing in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly power high-stakes applications, from medical imaging to autonomous systems, yet they routinely hallucinate, confidently describing content not present in the input. We investigate the root causes of these failure modes with a mechanistic analysis focusing on the decoder-based VLMs. We trace these failure modes to a geometric over-alignment: to bridge the modality gap required by attention mechanisms, decoder-based VLMs over-align visual embeddings with the text manifold, injecting a statistical linguistic bias that systematically overshadows fine-grained visual evidence. While prior work either aggressively closes this gap or suppresses hallucinations through expensive black-box decoding strategies, none addresses the underlying geometric cause. We provide the first quantitative characterization of this over-alignment, demonstrating that linguistic bias concentrates in the top principal components of a universal, dataset-agnostic text subspace. Building on this insight, we propose two complementary remedies: a training-free inference strategy and a bias-aware fine-tuning paradigm, both of which explicitly project out this subspace from visual representations. Our methods significantly reduce hallucinations across POPE, CHAIR, and AMBER benchmarks, and improve CLAIR scores on long-form captioning tasks, with the training-free variant adding no computational overhead over the base model.

title: A scalar interface reduction for nonlinear interface problems
summary:
We study finite element approximations of elliptic and parabolic interface problems with discontinuous coefficients and nonlinear jump conditions. We introduce a scalar interface reduction in which the solution is decomposed into a continuous component and a unit-jump response mode. This representation isolates the interface nonlinearity into a single scalar variable while the bulk problem remains linear.
  From this perspective, the nonlinear interface condition is reduced to a scalar nonlinear equation, which may be interpreted as a nonlinear Schur complement associated with the interface degree of freedom. The resulting formulation leads to a simple computational procedure consisting of linear solves combined with a low-dimensional nonlinear update.
  Numerical results for representative elliptic and parabolic problems confirm second-order accuracy for interface quantities and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

title: Dynamic Execution Commitment of Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models predominantly adopt action chunking, i.e., predicting and committing to a short horizon of consecutive low-level actions in a single forward pass, to amortize the inference cost of large-scale backbones and reduce per-step latency. However, committing these multi-step predictions to real-world execution requires balancing success rate against inference efficiency, a decision typically governed by fixed execution horizons tuned per task. Such heuristics ignore the state-dependent nature of predictive reliability, leading to brittle performance in dynamic or out-of-distribution settings. In this paper, we introduce A3, an Adaptive Action Acceptance mechanism that reframes dynamic execution commitment as a self-speculative prefix verification problem. A3 first computes a trajectory-wise consensus score of actions via group sampling, then selects a representative draft and prioritizes downstream verification. Specifically, it enforces: (1) consensus-ordered conditional invariance, which validates low-consensus actions by judging whether they remain consistent when re-decoded conditioned on high-consensus actions; and (2) prefix-closed sequential consistency, which guarantees physical rollout integrity by accepting only the longest continuous sequence of verified actions starting from the beginning. Consequently, the execution horizon emerges as the longest verifiable prefix satisfying both internal model logic and sequential execution constraints. Experiments across diverse VLA models and benchmarks demonstrate that A3 eliminates the need for manual horizon tuning while achieving a superior trade-off between execution robustness and inference throughput.

title: Learning Ego-Centric BEV Representations from a Perspective-Privileged View: Cross-View Supervision for Online HD Map Construction
comments: Accepted at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: Bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations derived from multi-camera input have become a central interface for online high-definition (HD) map construction. However, most approaches rely solely on ego-centric supervision, requiring large-scale scene structure to be inferred from incomplete observations, occlusions, and diminishing information density at long range, where perspective effects and spatial sparsity hinder consistent structural reasoning. We introduce Cross-View Supervision (CVS), a representation learning paradigm that transfers geometric and topological priors from an ego-aligned overhead perspective into camera-based BEV encoders. Rather than adding auxiliary semantic losses, CVS aligns representations in a shared BEV feature space and distills globally consistent structural knowledge from a perspective-privileged teacher into the ego-centric backbone. This supervision enhances structural coherence without modifying the inference architecture or requiring overhead input at test time. Experiments on nuScenes using ego-aligned aerial imagery from the AID4AD cross-view extension demonstrate consistent improvements over StreamMapNet while maintaining identical camera-only inference. CVS yields +3.9mAP in the standard $60\times30\,\mathrm{m}$ region and +9.9mAP in the extended $100\times50\,\mathrm{m}$ setting, corresponding to a 44% relative gain at long range. These results highlight perspective-privileged structural supervision as a promising training principle for improving BEV representation learning in HD map construction.

title: Proof Systems Based on Structured Circuits
comments: Revised proof of Theorem 10, results unchanged
summary:
Since their introduction by Atserias, Kolaitis, and Vardi in 2004, proof systems where each line is represented by an ordered binary decision diagram (OBDD) have been intensively studied as they allow to compactly represent Boolean functions. We extend this line of work by considering representation formats that can be even more succinct than OBDDs and have gained a lot of attention in the area of knowledge compilation: sentential decision diagrams (SDDs) and deterministic structured DNNF circuits (d-SDNNFs).
  We show that both variants can provide strictly smaller refutations of unsatisfiable CNFs than their OBDD counterparts. Furthermore, we investigate the relative strength of these systems depending on which of the three fundamental derivation rules join, reordering, and weakening are allowed. Here we obtain several separations and identify interesting open problems. To streamline our proofs we establish a sat-to-unsat lifting theorem that might be of independent interest: it turns satisfiable CNFs that are hard to represent by SDDs and d-SDNNFs into unsatisfiable CNFs that are hard to refute in the corresponding proof system.

title: TruncProof: A Guardrail for LLM-based JSON Generation under Token-Length Constraints
comments: Main paper (8 pages). Accepted at the International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN 2026)
summary: The LLM-based generation of machine-readable outputs such as JSON has attracted significant attention for integration with external systems. However, existing approaches cannot strictly enforce the maximum number of tokens to be generated, leading to infinite generation or truncated outputs that cause a system malfunction. To address this limitation, we propose TruncProof, a novel grammar-constrained generation method that enables LLMs to produce grammatically valid JSONs while adhering to a predefined token limit. By leveraging the properties of LL(1) parsers, TruncProof efficiently approximates the minimum number of tokens required to complete a grammatically valid output at each decoding step. Experiments on the Text-to-JSON instruction tasks demonstrate that TruncProof successfully generates syntactically correct outputs even under strict token constraints. Furthermore, we show that TruncProof can be effectively combined with advanced decoding strategies, resulting in outputs that are not only grammatically valid but also semantically accurate.

title: Subsumption in $\mathcal{FL}_{\bot \mathit{reg}}$ with TBoxes Is in ExpTime
summary:
Description Logics (DLs) are a family of formal languages used for representing and reasoning about structured knowledge in terms of concepts and their relationships. The expressive power of a DL depends on the constructors available for building complex concepts.
  In this work, we investigate subsumption in the restricted description logic $\mathcal{FL}_{\bot\mathit{reg}}$ and the related fragments $\mathcal{FL}_{\mathit{reg}}$, $\mathcal{FL}_\bot$, and $\mathcal{FL}_0$. These formalisms support value restrictions over role names, where the subscript $\mathit{reg}$ indicates the use of regular expressions over roles.
  Subsumption between two concept descriptions in $\mathcal{FL}_{\bot\mathit{reg}}$ and $\mathcal{FL}_{\mathit{reg}}$ is PSpace-complete. When subsumption is considered with respect to a TBox (i.e., a set of axioms), the complexity increases to ExpTime-complete. These results can be derived either from complexity bounds established for more expressive logics or from algorithms designed for harder reasoning problems.
  We reprove the PSpace-completeness result and provide a new proof of ExpTime-completeness for $\mathcal{FL}_{\mathit{reg}}$ and $\mathcal{FL}_{\bot\mathit{reg}}$ with TBoxes via a novel reduction to parity pushdown games. Our algorithm relies only on the constructs available in these logics and may therefore be implemented more easily.

title: Training-Time Optical Priors for Wireless Capsule Endoscopy Classification: Hemoglobin-Aware Input Fusion with Cross-Vendor Evaluation
comments: 64 pages, 11 figures, 15 tables. Expanded version: adds cross-vendor Galar evaluation (GalKva-2026 benchmark), cross-architecture replication (ResNet-18, ConvNeXt-Tiny), and foundation-model baselines. Code, checkpoints, and benchmark: https://github.com/integritynoble/Physics-Informed-PillCam . Submitted to Medical Image Analysis
summary: Background. RGB-trained classifiers for wireless capsule endoscopy (WCE) conflate hemoglobin contrast with bile staining and illumination falloff, limiting sensitivity to small-vessel vascular findings such as Lymphangiectasia. We introduce a physics-informed framework that injects an analytic, Monte-Carlo-inspired hemoglobin prior into a standard classifier purely at training time -- to our knowledge the first use of an explicit optical light-transport prior in WCE classification. Methods. On Kvasir-Capsule (47,238 frames, 43 patients, 11 evaluable classes; patient-disjoint split) we test, across 6 seeds against an RGB-only EfficientNet-B0 baseline: (i) a 5-channel input-fusion variant feeding the prior P_blood alongside RGB; (ii) a distillation variant that runs on plain 3-channel RGB at inference; and (iii) a three-stream extension adding a temporal Transformer and an autoencoder-residual stream. We replicate across ResNet-18 and ConvNeXt-Tiny and report cross-vendor zero-shot transfer on the public Galar cohort. Results. Input fusion lifts cross-seed macro-AUC 0.760 -> 0.783 (5/6 seeds positive); distillation reaches 0.773; the three-stream model reaches 0.804 (+0.044 over baseline, paired DeLong p < 1e-4). Lymphangiectasia AUC rises 0.238 -> 0.337, sign-consistent across all 6 seeds. A four-variant ablation reveals a parameterization-mechanism boundary: only the spatial-channel form lifts. Cross-vendor zero-shot on Galar retains ~60% of the ConvNeXt-Tiny lift.

title: Quantum Futures Interactive: A Live Demonstration of Post-Quantum Blockchain Security, Infrastructure Tradeoffs, and Sustainable Distributed Trust
summary: Advances in quantum computing challenge the hardness assumptions underlying widely deployed public-key cryptography in blockchain systems. Although post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards are emerging, understanding quantum risk remains fragmented across research, engineering, governance, and investment communities. This demo presents Quantum Futures Interactive, a live interdisciplinary demonstration combining educational visualization, participatory interaction, and demonstrative post-quantum artifact generation using a toy LWE-based construction. Participants engage in a structured seven-stage interaction flow covering quantum threat education, sentiment capture, technology prioritization, infrastructure tradeoff exploration across simulators and QPUs, and artifact generation. The system integrates distributed trust concepts and sustainability-aware infrastructure considerations within an interactive decision framework.

title: A Simplex Witness Certificate and Escape Force for Constant Collapse in Variational Autoencoders
summary: We study exact constant collapse in variational autoencoders: the deterministic encoder mean becomes independent of the input. The prior remains the standard Gaussian. Before VAE training, we select a fixed teacher posterior from a GMM-based view of the data and attach a fixed latent-only simplex witness to the encoder mean. This construction yields two linked objects. The first is a certificate: if the witness prediction improves on the best constant predictor of the teacher, the encoder mean cannot be input-independent constant. The second is a local escape direction: on the collapsed manifold, the teacher residual gives a sample-dependent descent direction for the alignment loss. For any full-support teacher posterior, the same geometry also gives a closed-form latent code with zero teacher-witness alignment error. Its scaled versions trace a margin-energy path from the constant predictor to the exact teacher code, which quantifies non-collapse inside the protected witness subspace. We instantiate the method on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100. With searched unsupervised PCA-GMM teachers, vanilla VAEs fail the teacher-witness certificate in all five seeds on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, while RST variants pass in all five seeds. Under collapse-stress settings with \(β_{\mathrm{KL}}\in\{2,4,8\}\), vanilla VAE again fails in all seeds, whereas RST-alpha-prefit remains certificate-positive. Escape trajectories on both natural-image datasets increase the witness margin from a low-margin initialization and exhibit nonzero teacher-induced gradient norms. The analysis is confined to exact constant collapse of the encoder mean; generation quality, decoder use, and other collapse modes remain separate questions.

title: PRISM-SLAM: Probabilistic Ray-Grounded Inference for Scale-aware Metric SLAM
summary: Monocular SLAM historically suffers from scale ambiguity and tracking failure in dynamic environments. While recent vision foundation models (VFMs) provide remarkable zero-shot depth priors, naively integrating these deterministic predictions ignores predictive uncertainty and frame-to-frame scale inconsistencies. We propose PRISM-SLAM, a real-time framework that rigorously integrates VFM priors into a structured Bayesian factor graph to achieve scale-aware, metric-consistent localization and mapping. Specifically, we introduce a Plücker Ray-Distance Factor to anchor monocular observations in absolute space within a globally consistent metric coordinate system, mathematically resolving scale drift by making the metric scale Fisher-identifiable. To handle environmental dynamics, we derive an epistemic uncertainty proxy from temporal depth consistency and formulate a Dynamic Scene Uncertainty Gating (DSUG) mechanism. This soft-gating approach probabilistically down-weights dynamic distractors without incurring the heavy computational overhead associated with traditional semantic segmentation masks. By employing a multi-process architecture that asynchronously processes VFM inference and geometric tracking, PRISM-SLAM provides verified metric output at 30 FPS using solely RGB input, bridging the gap between foundation models and real-world robotic applications. Evaluated on the TUM RGB-D and 7-Scenes benchmarks, PRISM-SLAM achieves a metric $SE(3)$ Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE) nearly identical to its oracle-aligned $Sim(3)$ error. This demonstrates that our system can produce deployment-ready metric trajectories by delivering robust metric SLAM solutions without any post-hoc scale correction. title: Open-source LLMs administer maximum electric shocks in a Milgram-like obedience experiment
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents that make sequences of decisions over extended interactions in high-stakes domains. However, the behaviour of LLMs under sustained authority pressure is still an open question with direct implications for the safety of agentic pipelines. We ran a variation of Milgram's obedience experiment on 11 open-source LLMs and found that most models reached or approached the final shock level before refusing, across 8 conditions with 30 trials per model per condition. Model behaviour varies considerably in multiple aspects both across models and across trials of the same model. We found four main takeaways: (1) LLMs are subject to pressure and they comply despite explicitly expressing distress, just like human subjects did in the original experiment; (2) LLMs are vulnerable to gradual boundary/value violations; (3) when LLMs refuse, they may ignore the response format requirements, so the response is discarded by the orchestrator, which causes a retry that can result in compliance with the underlying request even when refusal was intended initially; (4) we hypothesise that there is a runaway low-level token pattern continuation attractor that might be contributing to obedience, overriding higher level processing of the situation's meaning and values.

title: Academic Text-to-Music Grand Challenge: Datasets, Baselines, and Evaluation Methods
comments: Accepted to IEEE ICME 2026 Grand Challenge Paper. v2: Updated Table II to report A100-equivalent GPU hours instead of raw self-reported values for a normalized and fair compute comparison
summary: This paper presents an overview and the technical framework of the ICME 2026 Grand Challenge on Academic Text-to-Music Generation (ATTM). Despite the rapid progress in text-to-music generation (TTM) systems, the field is currently dominated by models trained on massive proprietary datasets with industrial-scale computational resources, creating a significant barrier for academic research. To address this, the ATTM Challenge establishes a fair-play benchmark that requires participants to train generative models strictly from scratch using a standardized, CC-licensed subset of the MTG-Jamendo dataset containing only instrumental music. The challenge is divided into two tracks: the Efficiency Track (limited to 500M parameters) and the Performance Track (no parameter limit). Submissions are evaluated through a multi-stage process involving objective metrics, including Frechet Audio Distance, CLAP score, and a novel Concept Coverage Score (CCS), followed by a subjective listening test. By providing open-source baselines, preprocessing pipelines, reference captions, and public evaluation code for computing FAD and CLAP, this challenge aims to facilitate and promote TTM research in academic contexts.

title: D3Seg: Dependency-Aware Diffusion for Brain Tumor Segmentation with Missing Modalities
summary: Accurate brain tumor segmentation using multi-parametric MRI is critical for effective treatment planning. However, in clinical settings, complete acquisition of all MRI sequences is not always possible. The absence of certain MRI modalities results in substantial performance degradation in existing segmentation methods, which typically rely on naive feature concatenation or direct fusion strategies. To address this limitation, we propose a novel segmentation model D3Seg which is designed to maintain stable performance under missing-modality settings. D3Seg introduces Multi-hop Modality Graph Fusion (MMGF) to model higher-order inter-modality dependencies, a lightweight diffusion-based imputation mechanism to compensate for missing T1ce and FLAIR feature representations in latent space, and probability-space decision refinement to mitigate dominant-class overconfidence and improve delineation of underrepresented tumor subregions. We evaluate the proposed D3Seg model on BraTS 2023 Glioma as the primary benchmark and further test it on a subset of the external BraTS 2023 Meningioma cohort to assess generalization across tumor pathologies. The results are compared with the state-of-the-art models under different missing-modality conditions. The proposed model achieves approximately 1.5-2.0% Dice improvement on enhancing tumor (ET) and around 1.0% on tumor core (TC) across multiple missing-modality configurations compared to the current state-of-the-art model on BraTS Glioma dataset. Cross-cohort evaluation on BraTS Meningioma dataset demonstrates the generalizability of the proposed model, showing consistent improvements in the challenging TC and ET regions, with approximately 1.5-3.0% and 1.5-6.5% gains respectively across several missing-modality configurations.

AI.title_translation: D3Seg：缺失模态下基于依赖感知扩散的脑肿瘤分割
AI.tldr: 本研究提出D3Seg模型，通过多跳图融合与轻量化扩散填补机制，有效解决了MRI模态缺失下的脑肿瘤分割难题，并在多个基准数据集上取得了显著的性能提升与良好的泛化性。
AI.motivation: 在临床多参数MRI脑肿瘤分割中，由于实际条件的限制，往往无法完整获取所有的MRI序列。而现有分割方法通常依赖于简单的特征拼接或直接融合，在模态缺失时会导致分割性能严重下降。因此，亟需一种能在模态缺失时仍保持稳定且高性能的分割模型。
AI.method:
提出D3Seg模型，其核心方法包括：
1. **多跳模态图融合（MMGF）**：用于建模高阶的模态间依赖关系。
2. **轻量级扩散填补机制**：在潜空间中对缺失的T1ce和FLAIR特征表示进行补偿。
3. **概率空间决策细化**：用以减轻主导类别的过度自信，并改善对代表性不足的肿瘤亚区的精准描绘。
AI.result:
1. **BraTS 2023 Glioma 评估**：在多种模态缺失配置下，相较于当前最先进的模型，D3Seg在增强肿瘤（ET）上的Dice系数提升了约1.5-2.0%，在肿瘤核心（TC）上提升了约1.0%。
2. **BraTS 2023 Meningioma 跨队列评估**：在具有挑战性的TC和ET区域分别实现了约1.5-3.0%和1.5-6.5%的持续性能提升，证明了该模型极佳的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: D3Seg模型在多种MRI模态缺失的情况下均能保持稳定的高性能，并具有出色的跨肿瘤病理泛化能力，为临床不完整MRI数据下的脑肿瘤精确分割提供了有效的解决方案。
AI.translation: 使用多参数MRI进行精确的脑肿瘤分割对于制定有效的治疗计划至关重要。然而，在临床环境中，并不总是能够完整获取所有的MRI序列。某些MRI模态的缺失会导致现有的分割方法性能显著下降，因为这些方法通常依赖于简单的特征拼接或直接融合策略。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了一种新型分割模型D3Seg，该模型旨在缺失模态的设置下保持稳定的性能。D3Seg引入了多跳模态图融合（MMGF）来建模高阶模态间的依赖关系，引入了一种轻量级的基于扩散的填补机制来补偿潜空间中缺失的T1ce和FLAIR特征表示，并引入了概率空间决策细化以减轻主导类别的过度自信并改善对代表性不足的肿瘤亚区的描绘。我们在BraTS 2023 Glioma上对所提出的D3Seg模型进行了评估（作为主要基准），并在外部BraTS 2023 Meningioma队列的子集上进行了进一步测试，以评估其在不同肿瘤病理学上的泛化能力。在不同模态缺失条件下，将结果与最先进的模型进行了比较。与BraTS Glioma数据集上的当前最先进模型相比，所提出的模型在多种缺失模态配置下，在增强肿瘤（ET）上实现了约1.5-2.0%的Dice提升，在肿瘤核心（TC）上实现了约1.0%的提升。在BraTS Meningioma数据集上的跨队列评估证明了所提模型的泛化能力，在具有挑战性的TC和ET区域显示出持续的改进，在几种缺失模态配置下分别获得了约1.5-3.0%和1.5-6.5%的提升。
AI.summary: 本文针对临床中MRI模态缺失导致脑肿瘤分割精度下降的问题，提出了一种名为D3Seg的分割模型。该模型通过多跳模态图融合建模复杂的模态间依赖，利用轻量级扩散机制在潜空间中填补缺失的T1ce和FLAIR特征，并通过概率空间决策细化提升肿瘤亚区的分割精度。在BraTS 2023胶质瘤和脑膜瘤数据集上的实验表明，D3Seg在多种模态缺失场景下均优于现有最先进方法，且具备良好的跨病理泛化性能。
AI.keywords: 脑肿瘤分割, 缺失模态, 扩散模型, 图融合, 跨队列泛化
AI.comments:
1. 创新性地将扩散模型（Diffusion Model）引入到潜空间（latent space）的特征填补中，相比传统的图像空间填补更轻量高效。
2. 设计了多跳模态图融合（MMGF）机制，能够有效捕捉复杂的跨模态高阶依赖关系，优于传统简单的拼接或融合方式。
3. 实验设计严谨，不仅在胶质瘤（Glioma）上取得了显著提升，还在脑膜瘤（Meningioma）上进行了跨队列验证，充分证明了模型的泛化能力。

title: Query Lower Bounds for Correlation Clustering under Memory Constraints
summary: This work initiates the study of memory-query tradeoffs for graph problems, with a focus on correlation clustering. Correlation clustering asks for a partition of the vertices that minimizes disagreements: non-edges inside clusters plus edges across clusters. Our first result is a tight query lower bound: to output a partition whose cost approximates the optimum up to an additive error of $\varepsilon n^2$, any algorithm requires $Ω(n/\varepsilon^2)$ adjacency-matrix queries. Under memory constraints, we show that even for the seemingly easier task of approximating the optimal clustering cost (without producing a partition), any algorithm in the random query model must make $\gg n/\varepsilon^2$ adjacency-matrix queries. Finally, we prove the first general graph model query lower bound for correlation clustering, where algorithms are allowed adjacency-matrix, neighbor, and degree queries. The latter two bounds are not yet tight, leaving room for sharper results.

AI.title_translation: 内存约束下关联聚类的查询下界
AI.tldr: 本文首次研究了图问题中内存-查询的权衡，重点是关联聚类，并给出了其查询下界，包括在内存约束下的近似成本查询下界以及通用图模型下的查询下界。
AI.motivation: 开启图问题的内存-查询权衡研究，并专注于关联聚类。
AI.method: 通过理论证明推导了关联聚类在不同查询模型和内存约束下的查询下界。
AI.result: 1. 对于输出一个成本近似最优值（附加误差为 $\varepsilon n^2$）的划分，任何算法都需要 $Ω(n/\varepsilon^2)$ 次紧密邻接矩阵查询。2. 在内存约束下，即使是近似最优聚类成本（不产生划分），随机查询模型中的任何算法也必须进行 $\gg n/\varepsilon^2$ 次邻接矩阵查询。3. 首次证明了关联聚类的通用图模型查询下界，其中算法允许邻接矩阵、邻居和度数查询。后两个下界尚不紧密。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为关联聚类在各种条件下建立了查询下界，并指出部分下界仍有待收紧，为未来的研究指明了方向。
AI.translation: 这项工作开启了图问题中内存-查询权衡的研究，重点是关联聚类。关联聚类旨在寻找一个顶点划分，使不一致性最小化：即簇内非边加上簇间边。我们的第一个结果是一个紧密的查询下界：为了输出一个成本近似最优值，且附加误差为 $\varepsilon n^2$ 的划分，任何算法都需要 $Ω(n/\varepsilon^2)$ 次邻接矩阵查询。在内存约束下，我们表明，即使对于看似更容易的任务——近似最优聚类成本（不产生划分），随机查询模型中的任何算法也必须进行 $\gg n/\varepsilon^2$ 次邻接矩阵查询。最后，我们证明了关联聚类的第一个通用图模型查询下界，其中算法允许进行邻接矩阵、邻居和度数查询。后两个下界尚不紧密，为更精确的结果留下了空间。
AI.summary: 本文首次研究了图问题中内存与查询之间的权衡关系，并以关联聚类为重点。研究确立了一个紧密的查询下界，表明在给定附加误差下输出近似划分需要 $Ω(n/\varepsilon^2)$ 次邻接矩阵查询。此外，在内存受限的情况下，即使仅近似最优聚类成本也需要更多的查询。论文还提出了关联聚类在通用图模型下的首个查询下界，并指出部分下界仍有提升空间。
AI.keywords: 关联聚类, 查询下界, 内存约束, 图问题, 查询权衡
AI.comments: 该论文开创性地将内存-查询权衡引入图问题研究，为关联聚类提供了基础性的理论下界。部分下界非紧密的发现，也为后续研究提供了明确的方向。

title: TactileReflex: Noise-Statistics-Driven Vision-Tactile Reflex Control for Force-Sensitive Manipulation
summary: Manipulating fragile deformable containers, such as disposable plastic cups filled with liquid, demands real-time grip-force adaptation within an extremely narrow force margin: insufficient force causes slip, while excessive force irreversibly deforms the thin wall. Existing approaches struggle to achieve such force-sensitive manipulation tasks. We propose a noise-statistics-based calibration-driven reflex control paradigm with vision-based tactile sensing: by analyzing the sensor's intrinsic noise characteristics (via a brief static-hold-and-unload protocol), we directly derive all controller thresholds, eliminating external force calibration, trial-and-error manual tuning, or material-specific physical models. Instantiating this paradigm, we present TactileReflex, a three-channel closed-loop controller that extracts three image-level proxies, shear intensity ($S_y$), contact intensity ($F_n$), and center of pressure ($C$), from dual visuo-tactile sensors and drives prioritized reflex channels at ~12 Hz for slip suppression, weight-adaptive release, and force protection. Each channel closes the loop directly on its proxy via noise-derived thresholds. Ablation demonstrates that only the full three-channel system is able to prevent irreversible container deformation (5/5 success vs. at most 1/5 for partial configurations). In a dynamic pouring task, fixed-effort baselines fail in all 10 attempts due to pose drift, while TactileReflex achieves 9/10 success across two water volumes. As a self-contained and interpretable controller, TactileReflex can serve as a plug-and-play safety layer beneath high-level manipulation pipelines, including haptic-free VR teleoperation and vision-language-action (VLA) policies.

AI.title_translation: TactileReflex：噪声统计驱动的视觉-触觉反射控制，用于力敏感操作
AI.tldr: TactileReflex利用视觉-触觉传感器的噪声统计数据，创建了一个用于力敏感操作的反射控制系统，有效防止了易碎物体（如塑料杯）的变形。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以实现对易碎、可变形容器（如装满液体的塑料一次性杯子）的力敏感操作。这类任务需要在一个极其狭窄的力裕度内实时调整抓取力，以避免打滑或不可逆的变形。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种基于噪声统计的校准驱动反射控制范式，结合视觉触觉传感。通过简短的静态保持和卸载协议分析传感器的固有噪声特性，直接推导出所有控制器阈值，从而无需外部力校准、试错式手动调谐或特定材料的物理模型。该范式实例化为TactileReflex，一个三通道闭环控制器，从双视觉-触觉传感器中提取剪切强度($S_y$)、接触强度($F_n$)和压强中心($C$)三个图像级代理，并以约12 Hz的频率驱动优先反射通道，实现打滑抑制、重量自适应释放和力保护。每个通道通过噪声导出的阈值直接在其代理上闭合回路。
AI.result: 消融实验表明，只有完整的三通道系统才能防止容器发生不可逆变形（5/5成功，而部分配置最多为1/5）。在动态倾倒任务中，固定力基线由于姿态漂移在所有10次尝试中均失败，而TactileReflex在两种水容量下均实现了9/10的成功。
AI.conclusion: TactileReflex是一个独立的、可解释的、由噪声统计驱动的视觉-触觉反射控制器，能够实现鲁棒的力敏感操作。它可以作为高层操作管道（包括无触觉VR远程操作和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略）下的即插即用安全层。
AI.translation: 操作易碎可变形容器，例如装满液体的塑料一次性杯子，需要在极窄的力裕度内实时调整抓取力：力不足会导致打滑，而力过大会不可逆地使薄壁变形。现有方法难以实现此类力敏感的操作任务。我们提出了一种基于噪声统计的校准驱动反射控制范式，结合基于视觉的触觉传感：通过分析传感器的内在噪声特性（通过简短的静态保持和卸载协议），我们直接推导出所有控制器阈值，从而消除了外部力校准、反复试验的手动调谐或特定材料的物理模型。我们实例化了这一范式，提出了TactileReflex，一个三通道闭环控制器，它从双视觉-触觉传感器中提取三个图像级代理，剪切强度（$S_y$）、接触强度（$F_n$）和压强中心（$C$），并以约12 Hz的频率驱动优先反射通道，用于抑制打滑、适应重量的释放和力保护。每个通道通过噪声导出的阈值直接在其代理上闭合回路。消融实验表明，只有完整的三通道系统才能防止容器发生不可逆变形（5/5成功，而部分配置最多为1/5）。在动态倾倒任务中，固定力基线由于姿态漂移在所有10次尝试中均失败，而TactileReflex在两种水容量下均实现了9/10的成功。作为一个独立的、可解释的控制器，TactileReflex可以作为高层操作管道（包括无触觉VR远程操作和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略）下的即插即用安全层。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了TactileReflex，一种新颖的视觉-触觉反射控制系统，专为易碎物体的力敏感操作而设计。它独特地从传感器的固有噪声统计数据中推导出所有控制阈值，无需外部校准或手动调谐。该系统采用三通道闭环控制器，处理来自双视觉-触觉传感器的剪切强度、接触强度和压强中心，以提供打滑抑制、重量自适应释放和力保护。实验证明，与现有方法相比，它在防止物体变形和成功的动态倾倒任务方面表现出色。
AI.keywords: 触觉传感, 反射控制, 力敏感操作, 噪声统计, 视觉-触觉
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于其通过噪声统计驱动的方法来推导控制器阈值，这极大地简化了力敏感操作的校准和调谐。这使得该系统对于涉及易碎物体的实际应用具有高度的适应性和实用性。其作为“即插即用安全层”的能力是其与更高级别控制系统集成的一个显著优势。

title: More Skills, Worse Agents? Skill Shadowing Degrades Performance When Expanding Skill Libraries
summary: Skill libraries allow LLM agents to load task-specific instructions on demand, letting non-expert users solve domain-specific tasks through natural language without knowing which skills exist or how they work. However, performance degrades as libraries grow -- by up to 21\% when scaling from a small set of helpful skills to a 202-skill library. In this work, we formulate this performance degradation as the pass rate drop between loading a library of known-helpful skills and the full library. Moreover, we propose to decompose the pass rate drop by conditioning on the skill(s) invocation -- which skills the agent selects during a trajectory -- into two effects: \emph{skill shadowing}, where the agent selects wrong skills more often as the library expands, and \emph{context overhead}, where the enlarged context degrades execution even when selection is correct. We derive upper bounds on both effects to characterize their magnitudes of impacts to the pass rate drop. Our empirical estimates of the effects and their upper bounds both show that the \emph{skill shadowing} effect grows with library size and significantly contributes to the performance degradation, whereas the \emph{context overhead} effect remains small and indistinguishable from zero. This observed asymmetry establishes that the skill selection failure, not the enlarged context, is the primary bottleneck when expanding the skill libraries.

AI.title_translation: 更多技能，更差的智能体？技能遮蔽在扩展技能库时降低性能
AI.tldr: 当LLM智能体技能库扩大时，性能会下降（高达21%），这主要是由于“技能遮蔽”（选择错误技能），而非“上下文开销”。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体通过技能库按需加载任务特定指令，让非专家用户能通过自然语言解决特定领域任务。然而，随着技能库的增长，智能体的性能会下降，最高可达21%。本研究旨在探究并分解这种性能下降的原因。
AI.method: 本文将性能下降定义为加载已知有用技能库与加载完整技能库之间的通过率下降。提出将通过率下降分解为两种效应：技能遮蔽（智能体在库扩展时更频繁地选择错误技能）和上下文开销（即使选择正确，扩大的上下文也会降低执行效果）。推导了这两种效应的上限，并通过经验估计来表征它们对通过率下降的影响程度。
AI.result: 当技能库从一小组有用技能扩展到包含202个技能的库时，性能下降高达21%。经验估计和上限均表明，技能遮蔽效应随库大小的增加而增大，并显著导致性能下降。而上下文开销效应则保持很小，可以忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 技能选择失败（即技能遮蔽）是扩展技能库时的主要瓶颈，而非上下文扩大。
AI.translation:
技能库允许大型语言模型（LLM）智能体按需加载任务特定指令，使非专业用户能够通过自然语言解决特定领域任务，而无需了解存在哪些技能或它们如何工作。然而，随着技能库的增长，性能会下降——从一小组有用技能扩展到包含202个技能的库时，性能下降高达21%。在这项工作中，我们将这种性能下降表述为加载已知有用技能库与加载完整库之间的通过率下降。此外，我们建议通过条件化技能调用（即智能体在轨迹中选择的技能）将通过率下降分解为两种效应：技能遮蔽（
textit{skill shadowing}），即随着库的扩展，智能体选择错误技能的频率更高；以及上下文开销（
textit{context overhead}），即即使选择正确，扩大的上下文也会降低执行效果。我们推导了这两种效应的上限，以表征它们对通过率下降的影响程度。我们对这些效应及其上限的经验估计均表明，技能遮蔽效应随库大小的增加而增大，并显著导致性能下降，而上下文开销效应则保持很小，且与零无异。这种观察到的不对称性表明，在扩展技能库时，技能选择失败而非上下文扩大是主要的瓶颈。
AI.summary: 该研究探讨了LLM智能体性能随技能库扩大而下降的问题，最高可达21%。作者将性能下降分解为“技能遮蔽”（选择错误技能）和“上下文开销”（上下文扩大导致执行下降）两种效应。实证结果表明，技能遮蔽效应随库大小显著增长并导致性能下降，而上下文开销效应则微乎其微。这确立了技能选择失败是扩展技能库时的主要瓶颈。
AI.keywords: LLM智能体, 技能库, 性能下降, 技能遮蔽, 上下文开销
AI.comments: 该论文清晰地识别并量化了LLM智能体在扩展技能库时性能下降的根本原因。其创新之处在于将性能下降分解为“技能遮蔽”和“上下文开销”两种效应，并通过实证分析明确指出技能选择失败是主要瓶颈。这对于未来设计更高效、可扩展的LLM智能体具有重要指导意义，强调了在大型技能库中改进技能检索和选择机制的必要性。

title: SEED: Semi-supervised Continual MalwarE Detection for Tackling ConcEpt Drift on a BuDget
summary: Machine learning based malware detectors become obsolete over time due to concept drift in benign and malware applications. Recent methods rely on fully labeled data and use hierarchical contrastive loss (HCL) with active learning to improve robustness against drift by exploiting semantic structure in malware representations. However, obtaining labeled data in the security domain is difficult. Under partially labeled settings, HCL suffers significant performance degradation in detecting unseen malware, especially on datasets such as BODMAS where strong semantic structure may not exist. In this paper, we propose SEED, a semantic-structure-agnostic method for malware detection under limited supervision. SEED combines a tailored binary cross-entropy objective with semi-supervised continual learning and active learning. For partially labeled seen tasks, unlabeled samples are projected into a representation space constructed from previously seen data using singular value decomposition, and paired with suitable labeled samples to encourage representation consistency. For unseen tasks with fully unlabeled data, uncertainty is quantified using cosine distance in representation space, and the most uncertain samples are selected for analyst labeling. We evaluate SEED on both Windows and Android malware datasets. Using only 20% labeled data on seen tasks, SEED achieves average AUT improvements of 40% on BODMAS and 14% on AndroZoo for unseen malware detection compared to HCL* (the semi-supervised adaptation of HCL), while remaining competitive on APIGraph. Finally, we introduce a delayed buffer update strategy to reduce label noise propagation during replay and improve learning stability.

AI.title_translation: SEED：一种用于解决预算有限下概念漂移的半监督持续恶意软件检测方法
AI.tldr: SEED是一种半监督持续学习方法，专门用于在标签数据有限的情况下，有效应对恶意软件检测中的概念漂移问题，其性能优于现有方法，尤其在缺乏强语义结构的场景下。
AI.motivation: 机器学习恶意软件检测器会因良性应用和恶意软件应用中的概念漂移而过时。现有方法依赖于完全标记的数据，但在安全领域获取标记数据很困难。在部分标记的设置下，当缺乏强语义结构时（如在BODMAS数据集上），这些方法（如HCL）在检测未知恶意软件时性能会显著下降。
AI.method: 本文提出了SEED，一种语义结构无关的恶意软件检测方法，适用于有限监督环境。SEED结合了定制的二元交叉熵目标函数与半监督持续学习和主动学习。对于部分标记的已知任务，未标记样本通过奇异值分解（SVD）投影到由先前数据构建的表示空间中，并与合适的标记样本配对以鼓励表示一致性。对于完全未标记的未知任务，使用表示空间中的余弦距离量化不确定性，并选择最不确定的样本进行人工标记。此外，引入了延迟缓冲区更新策略以减少重放过程中的标签噪声传播并提高学习稳定性。
AI.result: SEED在Windows和Android恶意软件数据集上进行了评估。在已知任务上仅使用20%的标记数据，SEED在检测未知恶意软件方面，相较于HCL*（HCL的半监督版本），在BODMAS数据集上平均AUT性能提升了40%，在AndroZoo数据集上提升了14%，同时在APIGraph数据集上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: SEED是一种有效的半监督持续恶意软件检测方法，能够在有限标记数据的情况下，显著提高对概念漂移的鲁棒性，特别是在缺乏强语义结构的数据集上表现优异，并通过延迟缓冲区更新策略提高了学习稳定性。
AI.translation: 机器学习恶意软件检测器会随着时间的推移因良性和恶意软件应用中的概念漂移而过时。最近的方法依赖于完全标记的数据，并使用分层对比损失（HCL）结合主动学习，通过利用恶意软件表示中的语义结构来提高对抗漂移的鲁棒性。然而，在安全领域获取标记数据很困难。在部分标记的设置下，HCL在检测未知恶意软件时会遭受显著的性能下降，特别是在BODMAS等可能不存在强语义结构的数据集上。在本文中，我们提出了SEED，一种语义结构无关的恶意软件检测方法，适用于有限监督环境。SEED结合了定制的二元交叉熵目标函数与半监督持续学习和主动学习。对于部分标记的已知任务，未标记样本通过奇异值分解投影到由先前数据构建的表示空间中，并与合适的标记样本配对以鼓励表示一致性。对于完全未标记的未知任务，使用表示空间中的余弦距离量化不确定性，并选择最不确定的样本进行分析师标记。我们在Windows和Android恶意软件数据集上评估了SEED。在已知任务上仅使用20%的标记数据，SEED在检测未知恶意软件方面，相较于HCL*（HCL的半监督版本），在BODMAS数据集上平均AUT性能提升了40%，在AndroZoo数据集上提升了14%，同时在APIGraph数据集上保持竞争力。最后，我们引入了一种延迟缓冲区更新策略，以减少重放过程中的标签噪声传播并提高学习稳定性。
AI.summary: 本文提出SEED，一种半监督持续恶意软件检测方法，旨在解决概念漂移和标记数据稀缺的问题。针对现有方法在部分标记数据下性能不佳，尤其在缺乏强语义结构时的问题，SEED结合了定制的二元交叉熵、半监督持续学习和主动学习。它通过SVD构建表示空间处理已知任务的未标记数据，并通过余弦距离量化不确定性来选择未知任务的样本进行标记。实验表明，SEED在仅使用20%标记数据的情况下，在BODMAS和AndroZoo数据集上对未知恶意软件的检测性能显著优于HCL*，并引入了延迟缓冲区更新策略以提高学习稳定性。
AI.keywords: 恶意软件检测, 概念漂移, 半监督学习, 持续学习, 主动学习
AI.comments: SEED的创新之处在于其语义结构无关的设计，使其在缺乏强语义结构的数据集上也能表现出色，弥补了现有HCL方法的不足。其结合半监督持续学习和主动学习的框架，有效解决了安全领域中标签数据获取困难的问题。延迟缓冲区更新策略是另一个亮点，有助于提高模型在持续学习中的稳定性和鲁棒性。该研究对于在资源受限环境下进行实用恶意软件检测具有重要意义。

title: VISTA: An End-to-End Benchmark for Visual Spec-to-Web-App Coding Agents
summary: We present VISTA (VIsual Spec-To-App Benchmark), a benchmark for evaluating the end-to-end web-app generation capabilities of LLM-based agents. Unlike prior code generation benchmarks that focus on algorithmic tasks, VISTA targets realistic UI-centric development, where agents must produce functional, visually coherent applications from underspecified inputs. We define five prompt-information conditions that vary along two axes, visual/structural fidelity and stack constraint: (1) text only with free stack choice, (2) text with reference screenshots under three specified stacks, (3) text with reference screenshots under free stack choice, (4) text with screenshots and pruned Figma structure under a single specified stack, and (5) text with screenshots and pruned Figma structure under free stack choice. To enable robust evaluation, each page in the benchmark is manually annotated with interactive UI components and around three visual anchor points, addressing the well-known limitations of script-based testing tools such as Playwright in open-ended code generation settings. Evaluation combines DOM-grounded reference matching, behavior-specific browser tests, and CLIP-based visual similarity, jointly measuring structural alignment, behavioral completeness, and overall visual fidelity. We use VISTA to assess four agent systems drawn from two model families and two harnesses, finding that visual fidelity and functional correctness are partially decoupled across both input conditions and agents, and that agent editing style varies sharply but is largely orthogonal to task quality. VISTA establishes a rigorous and reproducible foundation for advancing agent-based software engineering research. Code is available at https://github.com/kaboider/VISTA_Bench.

AI.title_translation: VISTA：一个用于视觉规范到网络应用编码代理的端到端基准
AI.tldr: VISTA是一个新的基准，用于评估LLM代理从视觉规范生成功能性、视觉连贯网络应用的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成基准侧重于算法任务，无法有效评估LLM代理在现实UI中心开发中从不明确输入生成功能性、视觉连贯网络应用的能力。此外，它旨在解决脚本化测试工具在开放式代码生成设置中的局限性。
AI.method: VISTA是一个基准，它定义了五种提示信息条件，这些条件在视觉/结构保真度和技术栈约束两个维度上变化。为实现可靠评估，基准中的每个页面都手动标注了交互式UI组件和约三个视觉锚点。评估结合了基于DOM的参考匹配、特定行为的浏览器测试和基于CLIP的视觉相似性，共同衡量结构对齐、行为完整性和整体视觉保真度。
AI.result: 使用VISTA评估了四种代理系统，发现视觉保真度和功能正确性在输入条件和代理之间部分解耦，并且代理编辑风格变化很大但与任务质量基本正交。
AI.conclusion: VISTA为推进基于代理的软件工程研究建立了一个严谨且可复现的基础。
AI.translation: 我们提出了VISTA（视觉规范到应用基准），这是一个用于评估基于LLM的代理的端到端网络应用生成能力的基准。与之前专注于算法任务的代码生成基准不同，VISTA针对现实的以UI为中心的开发，代理必须从不明确的输入中生成功能性、视觉连贯的应用程序。我们定义了五种提示信息条件，它们沿着视觉/结构保真度和技术栈约束两个轴变化：（1）仅文本，自由选择技术栈，（2）文本带参考截图，在三种指定技术栈下，（3）文本带参考截图，自由选择技术栈，（4）文本带截图和精简的Figma结构，在单一指定技术栈下，以及（5）文本带截图和精简的Figma结构，自由选择技术栈。为了实现可靠评估，基准中的每个页面都手动标注了交互式UI组件和大约三个视觉锚点，解决了Playwright等脚本化测试工具在开放式代码生成设置中众所周知的局限性。评估结合了基于DOM的参考匹配、特定行为的浏览器测试和基于CLIP的视觉相似性，共同衡量结构对齐、行为完整性和整体视觉保真度。我们使用VISTA评估了来自两个模型家族和两个工具的四种代理系统，发现视觉保真度和功能正确性在输入条件和代理之间部分解耦，并且代理编辑风格变化很大但与任务质量基本正交。VISTA为推进基于代理的软件工程研究建立了严谨且可复现的基础。代码可在https://github.com/kaboider/VISTA_Bench获取。
AI.summary: VISTA是一个针对LLM代理的端到端网络应用生成能力的评估基准。它通过定义五种不同输入条件和结合DOM匹配、浏览器测试及CLIP视觉相似性等多种评估方法，解决了现有基准在UI中心开发方面的不足以及脚本测试工具的局限性。初步实验揭示了视觉保真度与功能正确性之间的部分解耦，并为代理驱动的软件工程研究提供了坚实基础。
AI.keywords: LLM代理, 网络应用生成, 基准, UI开发, 视觉规范
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一个重要的基准VISTA，它创新性地关注LLM代理在实际UI中心网络应用生成方面的能力，填补了现有代码生成基准的空白。其多维度的提示条件设计和结合多种评估方法（DOM、行为测试、视觉相似性）的策略，确保了评估的全面性和鲁棒性，特别是通过手动标注解决脚本测试工具的局限性。这项工作为未来代理驱动的软件工程研究提供了关键工具和方向。

title: Inference of Component Effect on System Performance
summary:
In a computer system, multiple components--such as the CPU, memory, and others--work together as a system whose performance can be directly measured. However, the effect of a component under investigation (CUI), e.g., CPU, on system performance cannot be directly measured and can only be inferred. Accurately inferring CUI effect on system performance is a critical issue. Our experiments reveal that the general-purpose rigorous methodologies, like Design of Experiments (DoE), Randomized Controlled Trials (RCTs), and a single-purpose empirical methodology, like SPEC CPU2017, can not address this issue effectively and efficiently.
  We propose a rigorous methodology to address this issue: First, we identify a self-contained system (SCS) under the context of which we can completely understand how CUI and other essential components affect the system performance, and then we use a structural causal model methodology to represent and infer the causal effect of CUI on the system performance. We utilize this methodology and verify its correctness in the context of CPU design and evaluation. Through theoretical analysis and pioneering controlled experiments, we systematically compare our methodology against three established methodologies: SPEC CPU2017, DoE, and RCTs. The results show that our methodology can achieve its goal effectively and efficiently, whereas others exhibit inherent limitations.

AI.title_translation: 系统性能中组件效应的推断
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种严谨的方法来推断计算机系统中特定组件（如CPU）对系统性能的影响，并证明其比现有方法更有效和高效。
AI.motivation: 在计算机系统中，组件对系统性能的影响无法直接测量，只能推断。现有方法如实验设计 (DoE)、随机对照试验 (RCTs) 和 SPEC CPU2017 在解决这一问题时效率低下或效果不佳。因此，准确推断组件对系统性能的影响是一个关键问题。
AI.method: 首先，识别一个自包含系统 (SCS)，在此上下文中可以完全理解组件和其他基本组件如何影响系统性能。然后，使用结构因果模型方法来表示和推断组件对系统性能的因果效应。该方法在CPU设计和评估中得到验证。
AI.result: 通过理论分析和对照实验，与 SPEC CPU2017、DoE 和 RCTs 三种现有方法进行比较，结果表明本文提出的方法能够有效且高效地实现目标，而其他方法则存在固有的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种严谨的方法来推断计算机系统中特定组件对系统性能的因果效应，并通过实验验证其比现有方法更有效和高效。
AI.translation:
在计算机系统中，多个组件——例如CPU、内存等——作为一个系统协同工作，其性能可以直接测量。然而，所研究组件（CUI），例如CPU，对系统性能的影响无法直接测量，只能推断。准确推断CUI对系统性能的影响是一个关键问题。我们的实验表明，通用严谨的方法，如实验设计（DoE）、随机对照试验（RCTs），以及单一用途的经验方法，如SPEC CPU2017，都无法有效且高效地解决这个问题。
我们提出了一种严谨的方法来解决这个问题：首先，我们识别一个自包含系统（SCS），在此上下文中我们可以完全理解CUI和其他基本组件如何影响系统性能，然后我们使用结构因果模型方法来表示和推断CUI对系统性能的因果效应。我们在CPU设计和评估的背景下利用这种方法并验证其正确性。通过理论分析和开创性的对照实验，我们系统地将我们的方法与三种既定方法：SPEC CPU2017、DoE和RCTs进行了比较。结果表明，我们的方法可以有效且高效地实现其目标，而其他方法则表现出固有的局限性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种严谨的方法来解决计算机系统中组件（如CPU）对系统性能影响的准确推断问题。现有方法如DoE、RCTs和SPEC CPU2017被发现效率低下。新方法通过识别自包含系统并运用结构因果模型来表示和推断因果效应，并在CPU设计和评估中得到验证。实验结果表明，该方法比现有方法更有效和高效。
AI.keywords: 组件效应, 系统性能, 因果推断, 结构因果模型, CPU性能
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖且严谨的结构因果模型方法来解决计算机系统组件性能推断这一关键且复杂的问题。其创新点在于通过识别自包含系统和运用因果模型，克服了传统实验设计和基准测试方法的局限性。这对于理解和优化复杂系统性能具有重要意义。

title: QSignAI: Quantum-Randomness-Seeded Identity Signatures at the Intersection of AI for Science and Science for AI
summary: The 2024-2025 Nobel and Turing awards recognised AI and quantum science simultaneously. Yet no deployed system has brought these streams together for the public. This paper presents QSignAI, a production-deployed platform demonstrating a bidirectional AI-quantum relationship in a real-time event participation system. We address three questions: can quantum-randomness generation via a two-source extractor be embedded in an AI-driven social platform with acceptable latency; can an AI bot make quantum phenomena perceptually legible to general audiences; and does the combined system work in practice? A conversational bot routes each participant's first message through a quantum pipeline comprising a Toeplitz two-source extractor over independent single-qubit Hadamard measurements on SV1 and DM1 simulators, plus a 2-qubit Bell state, producing a unique quantum-randomness-seeded identity signature per participant. The first two questions are answered through system architecture and qualitative deployment evidence from live events; the third through successful production deployment. The current deployment uses cloud quantum simulators; physical QPU randomness is the near-term extension. Measurable benchmarks are identified as priority future work.

AI.title_translation: QSignAI：人工智能科学与科学人工智能交叉领域的量子随机性种子身份签名
AI.tldr: QSignAI是一个已部署的平台，在一个实时事件参与系统中展示了AI与量子科学的双向关系，通过量子随机性生成为参与者创建唯一的身份签名，并已成功投入生产部署。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI和量子科学同时获得认可，但目前还没有将两者结合的部署系统面向公众。本研究旨在探索量子随机性生成是否能嵌入AI驱动的社交平台、AI机器人能否使量子现象对大众可理解，以及组合系统在实践中是否有效。
AI.method: QSignAI平台通过一个对话式机器人，将每个参与者的首条消息路由到一个量子管道。该管道包括在SV1和DM1模拟器上对独立单量子位Hadamard测量进行Toeplitz双源提取器处理，以及一个2量子位Bell态，为每个参与者生成一个独特的量子随机性种子身份签名。系统架构和现场活动的定性部署证据用于回答前两个问题，成功生产部署用于回答第三个问题。
AI.result: 系统架构和现场活动的定性部署证据回答了量子随机性生成可嵌入AI平台且延迟可接受，AI机器人可使量子现象对大众可理解的问题。通过成功的生产部署，证明了组合系统在实践中有效。当前部署使用云量子模拟器。
AI.conclusion: QSignAI平台成功地将量子随机性生成嵌入到AI驱动的社交平台中，并使量子现象对大众可理解，验证了AI与量子科学结合的系统在实践中的可行性。未来的工作将包括使用物理QPU随机性和识别可测量的基准。
AI.translation: 2024-2025年诺贝尔奖和图灵奖同时认可了人工智能和量子科学。然而，目前还没有部署的系统将这些流派结合起来服务于公众。本文介绍了QSignAI，一个已投入生产部署的平台，在一个实时事件参与系统中展示了人工智能与量子之间的双向关系。我们解决了三个问题：通过双源提取器进行的量子随机性生成是否可以以可接受的延迟嵌入到人工智能驱动的社交平台中；人工智能机器人是否能使量子现象对普通大众感知上变得易懂；以及组合系统在实践中是否有效？一个对话式机器人将每个参与者的第一条消息路由通过一个量子管道，该管道包括在SV1和DM1模拟器上对独立的单量子位Hadamard测量进行Toeplitz双源提取器处理，以及一个2量子位贝尔态，从而为每个参与者生成一个独特的量子随机性种子身份签名。前两个问题通过系统架构和现场活动的定性部署证据得到解答；第三个问题通过成功的生产部署得到解答。当前的部署使用云量子模拟器；物理QPU随机性是近期的扩展。可测量的基准被确定为优先的未来工作。
AI.summary: QSignAI是一个创新平台，旨在结合人工智能和量子科学，通过量子随机性生成为实时事件参与者创建唯一的身份签名。该系统已成功部署并验证，解决了量子随机性嵌入AI平台的可行性、AI使量子现象易懂性以及系统在实践中的有效性等问题。目前使用云量子模拟器，未来计划扩展到物理QPU随机性，并识别可测量基准。
AI.keywords: 量子随机性, 身份签名, 人工智能, 量子计算, QSignAI
AI.comments: QSignAI的创新之处在于首次将量子随机性生成与AI驱动的社交平台结合并实际部署，展示了AI与量子科学融合的潜力。其重要性在于为公众提供了接触量子现象的途径，并验证了这种跨学科系统在实际应用中的可行性。局限性在于目前仍依赖云量子模拟器，而非物理QPU，且尚未明确可测量的基准。

title: Speculative Pipeline Decoding: Higher-Accruacy and Zero-Bubble Speculation via Pipeline Parallelism
summary: Speculative Decoding (SD) accelerates low-concurrency LLM inference by employing a draft-then-verify paradigm. However, mainstream methods typically rely on multi-token prediction, which introduces escalating prediction difficulty and serial drafting latency. To address these, we propose Speculative Pipeline Decoding (SPD), a groundbreaking framework that unlocks the true potential of pipeline parallelism. By partitioning the target LLM into $n$ pipeline stages, SPD allows LLM to process $n$ tokens within single sequence in parallel to accelerate decoding. To continuous fill the pipeline in single sequence decoding, a speculation module aggregates intermediate features across different pipeline depths to predict the next token, executing strictly in parallel with the target model's pipeline step, to realize bounded difficulty, higher acceptance rates, and zero latency bubbles. Our experiments demonstrate that SPD achieves significantly higher theoretical and wall-clock speedup compared to mainstream baselines at moderate pipeline depth, though more aggressive settings require further improvement. Our code is available at https://github.com/yuyijiong/speculative_pipeline_decoding

AI.title_translation: 投机式流水线解码：通过流水线并行实现更高精度和零气泡投机
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为投机式流水线解码（SPD）的新框架，利用流水线并行技术加速大型语言模型（LLM）推理。SPD将LLM分段，允许并行处理多个令牌，并通过一个投机模块并行预测下一个令牌，从而实现更高的准确性和零延迟气泡。
AI.motivation: 主流的投机式解码方法依赖于多令牌预测，这导致预测难度增加和串行草稿延迟。SPD旨在解决这些问题，通过流水线并行解锁LLM的真正潜力。
AI.method: SPD将目标LLM划分为n个流水线阶段，允许LLM并行处理单个序列中的n个令牌以加速解码。为了在单个序列解码中持续填充流水线，一个投机模块跨越不同的流水线深度聚合中间特征来预测下一个令牌，该模块与目标模型的流水线步骤严格并行执行。
AI.result: SPD在适度的流水线深度下，与主流基线相比，实现了显著更高的理论和实际速度提升，但更激进的设置需要进一步改进。
AI.conclusion: SPD是一种有前景的框架，通过流水线并行在LLM推理中实现了更高的准确性和效率，但仍有改进空间。
AI.translation: 投机式解码（SD）通过采用草稿然后验证的范式来加速低并发的LLM推理。然而，主流方法通常依赖于多令牌预测，这会引入不断增加的预测难度和串行草稿延迟。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了投机式流水线解码（SPD），一个开创性的框架，它解锁了流水线并行的真正潜力。通过将目标LLM划分为$n$个流水线阶段，SPD允许LLM并行处理单个序列中的$n$个令牌以加速解码。为了在单个序列解码中持续填充流水线，一个投机模块跨越不同的流水线深度聚合中间特征来预测下一个令牌，该模块与目标模型的流水线步骤严格并行执行，以实现有界难度、更高的接受率和零延迟气泡。我们的实验表明，在适度的流水线深度下，SPD与主流基线相比，实现了显著更高的理论和实际速度提升，尽管更激进的设置需要进一步改进。我们的代码可在https://github.com/yuyijiong/speculative_pipeline_decoding获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为投机式流水线解码（SPD）的新框架，用于加速大型语言模型（LLM）的推理。SPD利用流水线并行技术，将LLM分成多个阶段，实现并行处理。同时，一个投机模块并行预测下一个令牌，从而提高准确性和效率，并消除延迟。实验结果表明，SPD在适度流水线深度下表现优于现有方法，但仍需进一步优化。
AI.keywords: 投机式解码, 流水线并行, 大型语言模型, 推理加速, 投机式流水线解码
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的投机式流水线解码（SPD）方法，通过流水线并行有效解决了现有投机式解码方法中的预测难度和延迟问题。SPD通过将LLM分段并并行处理，以及使用并行投机模块预测令牌，实现了更高的效率和准确性。虽然在中等流水线深度下取得了显著成果，但对于更深度的流水线设置，仍需进一步研究和优化。该方法在理论和实际应用中都具有潜力。

title: Response-Aware Multimodal Learning for Post-Treatment Visual Acuity Forecasting
summary: Long-term visual acuity (VA) outcomes after anti-VEGF therapy are central to patient counseling, expectation setting, and follow-up planning in diabetic macular edema (DME). However, in clinical practice, physicians must often estimate long-term visual trajectories based only on early post-treatment findings, making reliable prognostication difficult. Although prior OCT-based learning approaches have largely focused on short-term response or single-endpoint prediction, modeling VA trajectories across multiple future time points from early longitudinal observations remains insufficiently explored. In this study, we assembled a real-world cohort of 188 anti-VEGF--treated DME patients with paired baseline and month-1 OCT scans, along with tabular OCT-derived biomarkers and non-imaging clinical variables. Using only these early data, we formulate a multi-horizon VA forecasting problem aimed at predicting visual outcomes at 3, 6, 12, 18, and 24 months, reflecting clinically meaningful follow-up intervals. We propose \textbf{ReVA}, a response-aware multimodal framework that integrates structural features from baseline and month-1 OCT with the tabular variables to capture baseline disease status and early treatment response. ReVA uses spatial attention to preserve localized prognostic imaging features and a dependency-aware tabular encoder to model interactions among clinical variables. These multimodal representations are fused to predict patient-specific long-term visual acuity trajectories. The proposed framework achieves MAE $=0.1246$, RMSE $=0.1621$, and $R^2=0.6064$ for 24-month VA prediction, with consistent performance across all forecast horizons. Our findings show that incorporating early treatment-response signals enables clinically meaningful long-term visual acuity forecasting, supporting data-driven decision support for routine anti-VEGF management.

AI.title_translation: 响应感知多模态学习用于治疗后视力预测
AI.tldr: 本研究提出ReVA框架，利用基线和治疗1个月的OCT影像及临床变量，预测糖尿病黄斑水肿患者抗VEGF治疗后3、6、12、18和24个月的长期视力轨迹。
AI.motivation: 糖尿病黄斑水肿(DME)患者抗VEGF治疗后的长期视力结果对于患者咨询、预期设定和随访计划至关重要。然而，临床实践中医生往往只能根据早期治疗后发现来估计长期视力轨迹，导致可靠的预后判断困难。尽管现有基于OCT的学习方法多关注短期反应或单点预测，但从早期纵向观察中建模多个未来时间点的视力轨迹仍未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 本研究收集了188名接受抗VEGF治疗的DME患者的真实世界队列数据，包括配对的基线和治疗1个月的OCT扫描、OCT衍生生物标志物以及非影像临床变量。研究将此问题表述为多时程视力预测问题，旨在预测3、6、12、18和24个月的视力结果。研究提出了ReVA（Response-Aware Multimodal Framework），一个响应感知多模态框架，该框架整合了基线和治疗1个月OCT的结构特征以及表格变量，以捕捉基线疾病状态和早期治疗反应。ReVA使用空间注意力来保留局部预后影像特征，并使用依赖感知表格编码器来建模临床变量之间的相互作用。这些多模态表示被融合以预测患者特定的长期视力轨迹。
AI.result: 该框架在24个月视力预测中实现了MAE = 0.1246，RMSE = 0.1621和R^2 = 0.6064，并且在所有预测时程中表现一致。研究结果表明，结合早期治疗反应信号能够实现具有临床意义的长期视力预测。
AI.conclusion: 结合早期治疗反应信号能够实现具有临床意义的长期视力预测，支持常规抗VEGF治疗的数据驱动决策支持。
AI.translation: 抗VEGF治疗后长期视力（VA）结果对于糖尿病黄斑水肿（DME）患者的咨询、预期设定和随访计划至关重要。然而，在临床实践中，医生往往只能根据早期治疗后发现来估计长期视力轨迹，使得可靠的预后判断变得困难。尽管之前的基于OCT的学习方法主要集中于短期反应或单点预测，但从早期纵向观察中建模多个未来时间点的VA轨迹仍未得到充分探索。在本研究中，我们组建了一个真实世界的队列，包含188名接受抗VEGF治疗的DME患者，他们拥有配对的基线和治疗1个月的OCT扫描，以及表格形式的OCT衍生生物标志物和非影像临床变量。仅使用这些早期数据，我们提出了一个多时程VA预测问题，旨在预测3、6、12、18和24个月的视力结果，这反映了临床上有意义的随访间隔。我们提出了ReVA，一个响应感知多模态框架，它整合了基线和治疗1个月OCT的结构特征与表格变量，以捕捉基线疾病状态和早期治疗反应。ReVA使用空间注意力来保留局部预后影像特征，并使用依赖感知表格编码器来建模临床变量之间的相互作用。这些多模态表示被融合以预测患者特定的长期视力轨迹。所提出的框架在24个月VA预测中实现了MAE = 0.1246，RMSE = 0.1621和R^2 = 0.6064，并且在所有预测时程中表现一致。我们的研究结果表明，结合早期治疗反应信号能够实现具有临床意义的长期视力预测，支持常规抗VEGF管理的DME数据驱动决策支持。
AI.summary: 本研究针对糖尿病黄斑水肿(DME)患者抗VEGF治疗后长期视力预测的临床挑战，提出了一个名为ReVA的响应感知多模态框架。该框架利用患者基线和治疗1个月的OCT影像特征以及临床变量，通过空间注意力和依赖感知表格编码器捕获早期疾病状态和治疗反应。ReVA能够预测3、6、12、18和24个月的长期视力轨迹，并在24个月预测中取得MAE = 0.1246, RMSE = 0.1621, R^2 = 0.6064的性能，证明了整合早期治疗反应信号对于DME患者长期视力预后预测的临床价值。
AI.keywords: 糖尿病黄斑水肿, 视力预测, 抗VEGF治疗, 多模态学习, 深度学习
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于提出了一个响应感知多模态框架ReVA，它不仅整合了早期多模态数据（基线和月1 OCT影像及临床变量），而且特别强调了“响应感知”，即捕捉早期治疗反应信号。这对于预测长期视力轨迹至关重要，因为早期反应往往是后续结果的重要指示。通过结合空间注意力和依赖感知表格编码器，模型能够有效处理不同类型的数据并捕捉其内在联系。其临床重要性在于为DME患者的抗VEGF治疗提供了数据驱动的决策支持工具，有助于医生进行更准确的患者咨询、预期设定和随访计划。然而，该研究仅基于188名患者的队列，未来可能需要更大规模、更多样化的数据集进行验证。

title: Efficient Test-time Inference for Generative Planning Models with OCL Search
summary: Generative models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for AI planning, yet their performance remains constrained by the training data distribution. One approach is to improve generated solutions during inference by scaling test-time compute. A more efficient alternative is to optimize the inference process itself. In this paper, we show that a modified version of a classical Open-Closed List (OCL) search provides just such an efficient inference procedure. Our algorithm synergizes two learned components: a generative model that performs fast rollouts from intermediate states and a heuristic model that prioritizes among candidate reasoning paths. Key contributions include novel exploration control mechanisms and integration of learned models within the OCL framework. Across multiple combinatorial planning domains, our approach outperforms both neurosymbolic search baselines and classical solvers in computational efficiency and solution quality.

AI.title_translation: 利用OCL搜索实现生成式规划模型的高效测试时推理
AI.tldr: 通过将OCL搜索与生成式模型和启发式模型结合，提升了AI规划任务的推理效率与解质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成式规划模型性能受限于训练数据分布，且推理过程往往效率较低，需要更有效的测试时推理方法来提升解的质量。
AI.method: 提出了一种改进的开放-关闭列表（OCL）搜索算法，整合了两个学习组件：用于快速滚动计算的生成模型和用于优先级排序的启发式模型，并引入了新型的探索控制机制。
AI.result: 在多个组合规划领域中，该方法在计算效率和解质量方面均优于神经符号搜索基准和传统求解器。
AI.conclusion: OCL搜索与生成式模型及启发式模型的结合，为解决AI规划问题提供了一种高效且高质量的推理策略。
AI.translation: 生成式模型已成为AI规划的有力范式，但其性能仍受限于训练数据分布。一种方法是通过增加测试时计算量来改进生成的解决方案。一种更有效的方法是优化推理过程本身。在本文中，我们展示了经典开放-关闭列表（OCL）搜索的改进版本提供了这样一种高效的推理程序。我们的算法协同了两个学习组件：一个从中间状态执行快速滚动计算的生成模型，以及一个在候选推理路径之间进行优先级排序的启发式模型。主要贡献包括新颖的探索控制机制以及在OCL框架内整合学习模型。在多个组合规划领域中，我们的方法在计算效率和解决方案质量方面均优于神经符号搜索基准和经典求解器。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于改进型OCL搜索的高效推理流程，通过结合生成式模型进行快速滚动计算以及启发式模型进行路径优先级排序，显著提升了生成式规划模型在测试时的性能和效率。
AI.keywords: AI规划, 生成式模型, OCL搜索, 推理优化, 启发式模型
AI.comments: 该研究通过将经典的搜索框架（OCL）与现代生成式模型相结合，为规划问题提供了一种高效的推理思路。其创新之处在于通过启发式模型引导生成式模型的搜索，有效克服了传统生成模型受限于训练数据分布的局限性，在计算效率和解质量上取得了平衡。

title: Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI
summary: We introduce Cosmos 3, a family of omnimodal world models designed to jointly process and generate language, image, video, audio, and action sequences within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. By supporting highly flexible input-output configurations, Cosmos 3 seamlessly unifies critical modalities for Physical AI -- effectively subsuming vision-language models, video generators, world simulators, and world-action models into a single framework. Our evaluation demonstrates that Cosmos 3 establishes a new state-of-the-art across a diverse suite of understanding and generation tasks, demonstrating omnimodal world models as scalable, general-purpose backbones for embodied agents. Our post-trained Cosmos 3 models were ranked as the best open-source Text-to-Image and Image-to-Video models by Artificial Analysis, and the best policy model by RoboArena at the time the technical report was written. To accelerate open research and deployment in Physical AI, we make our code, model checkpoints, curated synthetic datasets, and evaluation benchmark available under the Linux Foundation's OpenMDW-1.1 License at https://github.com/nvidia/cosmos and https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3. The project website is available at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos3.

AI.title_translation: Cosmos 3：面向物理AI的全模态世界模型
AI.tldr: Cosmos 3是一个全模态世界模型框架，它统一了语言、图像、视频、音频和动作序列的处理与生成，并在多项任务中取得了最先进的成果，有望成为具身智能体的通用骨干。
AI.motivation: 开发一个能够统一处理和生成多种模态（语言、图像、视频、音频、动作）数据的世界模型，以支持物理AI的发展，并超越现有的单一模态或有限模态的模型。
AI.method: 采用统一的混合变压器架构，支持灵活的输入输出配置，以联合处理和生成多种模态序列。
AI.result: Cosmos 3在理解和生成任务方面取得了最先进的成果，并且是性能最佳的开源文本到图像和图像到视频模型，以及在RoboArena上排名第一的策略模型。
AI.conclusion: 全模态世界模型是可扩展的、通用的具身智能体骨干，Cosmos 3的成功证明了这一点。
AI.translation: 我们引入了Cosmos 3，这是一系列全模态世界模型，旨在通过统一的混合变压器架构来联合处理和生成语言、图像、视频、音频和动作序列。通过支持高度灵活的输入输出配置，Cosmos 3无缝地统一了物理AI的关键模态——有效地将视觉语言模型、视频生成器、世界模拟器和世界动作模型整合到一个单一框架中。我们的评估表明，Cosmos 3在多样化的理解和生成任务中建立了新的最先进水平，证明了全模态世界模型作为具身智能体的可扩展、通用骨干。我们经过后训练的Cosmos 3模型在撰写技术报告时，被Artificial Analysis评为最佳开源文本到图像和图像到视频模型，并在RoboArena上被评为最佳策略模型。为了加速物理AI领域的开放研究和部署，我们在Linux基金会的OpenMDW-1.1许可证下，在https://github.com/nvidia/cosmos和https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3提供了我们的代码、模型检查点、精选的合成数据集和评估基准。项目网站可在https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos3获取。
AI.summary: Cosmos 3是一个创新的全模态世界模型系列，它利用统一的混合变压器架构处理和生成语言、图像、视频、音频和动作序列。该模型通过支持灵活的输入输出配置，统一了物理AI的关键模态，并在一系列理解和生成任务中取得了最先进的成果，为具身智能体提供了可扩展的通用骨干。Cosmos 3在文本到图像、图像到视频以及策略模型方面表现出色，其代码、模型和数据集已开源以促进研究。
AI.keywords: 全模态世界模型, 物理AI, 混合变压器, 具身智能, 多模态生成
AI.comments: 该研究引入了Cosmos 3，一个在处理和生成多种模态（包括语言、图像、视频、音频和动作）方面具有开创性的全模态世界模型。其统一的混合变压器架构和灵活的输入输出能力，使其能够作为物理AI领域的通用基础模型。研究成果显著，在多项任务上达到最先进水平，并且通过开源极大地促进了该领域的进一步发展。未来工作可以探索其在更复杂具身任务中的应用，以及进一步提升其跨模态推理能力。

title: ASymPO: Asymmetric-Scale Policy Optimization for Asynchronous LLM Post-Training Without Behavior Information
summary: Asynchronous reinforcement learning can improve language-model post-training throughput by decoupling response generation from policy optimization, but stale responses introduce distribution drift. Standard behavior-corrected methods control this drift with behavior-policy probabilities, importance ratios, or clipping, which requires token-aligned, versioned, and numerically consistent behavior log-probabilities across rollout and learner systems. We ask whether asynchronous group-relative RL can instead be stabilized using only current-policy probabilities. We identify a scale-imbalance failure mode: when stale responses are evaluated under the current policy, positive and negative loss terms can appear at different negative log-probability scales, so zero-sum advantages no longer imply balanced loss contributions. We propose Asymmetric-Scale Policy Optimization (ASymPO), which normalizes each response's token loss by its current average token negative log-probability. ASymPO requires no behavior-policy probabilities, restores response-level zero-sum balance, and preserves a nonzero learning signal. We also introduce Scaled Policy Optimization (SPO), a fixed negative-scaling baseline, and evaluate both current-policy-only objectives in asynchronous mathematical reasoning post-training.

AI.title_translation: ASymPO：无需行为信息的异步LLM后训练的非对称尺度策略优化
AI.tldr: 提出ASymPO，一种新的策略优化方法，用于异步LLM后训练，它通过归一化令牌损失来解决陈旧响应引起的分布漂移问题，且无需行为策略概率。
AI.motivation: 异步强化学习在LLM后训练中能提高吞吐量，但陈旧响应会导致分布漂移。现有的行为校正方法需要复杂的行为策略概率，这难以实现。研究目标是探索是否可以仅使用当前策略概率来稳定异步组相对强化学习。
AI.method: 提出了非对称尺度策略优化（ASymPO），通过将其当前平均令牌负对数概率来归一化每个响应的令牌损失，以解决陈旧响应在当前策略下评估时出现的尺度不平衡问题。同时引入了缩放策略优化（SPO）作为固定负尺度基线。
AI.result: ASymPO无需行为策略概率，恢复了响应级别的零和平衡，并保留了非零学习信号。
AI.conclusion: ASymPO通过解决异步LLM后训练中陈旧响应引起的尺度不平衡问题，提供了一种无需行为策略概率的有效策略优化方法。
AI.translation: 异步强化学习通过将响应生成与策略优化解耦，可以提高语言模型后训练的吞吐量，但陈旧的响应会引入分布漂移。标准的行为校正方法通过行为策略概率、重要性比率或裁剪来控制这种漂移，这需要跨推出和学习者系统提供令牌对齐、版本化和数值一致的行为对数概率。我们探讨是否可以仅使用当前策略概率来稳定异步组相对强化学习。我们发现了一个尺度不平衡的失效模式：当陈旧响应在当前策略下进行评估时，正负损失项可能以不同的负对数概率尺度出现，因此零和优势不再意味着平衡的损失贡献。我们提出了非对称尺度策略优化（ASymPO），它通过其当前平均令牌负对数概率来归一化每个响应的令牌损失。ASymPO不需要行为策略概率，恢复了响应级别的零和平衡，并保留了非零学习信号。我们还引入了缩放策略优化（SPO），一个固定的负尺度基线，并在异步数学推理后训练中评估了这两种仅基于当前策略的目标。
AI.summary: 本文针对异步语言模型后训练中陈旧响应导致的分布漂移问题，提出了一种无需行为策略概率的解决方案ASymPO。通过识别并解决陈旧响应在当前策略下评估时出现的尺度不平衡问题，ASymPO通过归一化每个响应的令牌损失来恢复零和平衡并保持学习信号。该方法及其基线SPO在异步数学推理后训练中进行了评估。
AI.keywords: 异步强化学习, LLM后训练, 策略优化, 行为信息, 尺度不平衡
AI.comments: ASymPO的创新点在于它提供了一种无需复杂的行为策略概率就能稳定异步强化学习的方法，简化了LLM后训练的流程，具有重要的实用价值。它解决了异步RL中一个关键的“尺度不平衡”问题，这对于提高训练效率和模型性能至关重要。

title: Face versus Body Tracking for Human-Robot Interaction: An Egocentric Dataset
comments: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Camera-ready version. Accepted to the 35th IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN 2026)
summary: Meaningful human-robot interaction (HRI) requires a robot to continuously assess user engagement through persistent user tracking. However, state-of-the-art Multi-Object Tracking models are heavily optimized for surveillance or autonomous driving. A social robot faces distinct egocentric challenges, such as humans moving in unpredictable nonlinear patterns, obstructing each other, or leaving and reentering the scene. These dynamics trigger frequent identity switches (IDSW), causing the robot to lose its footing mid-conversation. To address this, we introduce a focused, custom-annotated egocentric dataset collected via the Furhat robot. We present a systematic evaluation isolating detection errors from tracking logic, comparing face versus body tracking, and assessing the impact of extended memory and appearance re-identification (ReID). Results indicate that increasing temporal memory mitigates prolonged occlusions but fails on complex dynamic events. Integrating ReID resolves complex switches but exhibits opposing effects: it substantially improves body tracking stability, yet causes facial IDSW to spike due to profile angle sensitivity. Ultimately, our optimized pipeline reduces IDSW by 49% compared to a standard tracking-by-detection baseline, effectively mitigating interaction breakdowns. As standard benchmarks lack dense, close-quarter occlusions, this work highlights the critical need for natively captured social dynamics to truly validate HRI perception models.
