AI.title_translation: 惊喜引导归并排序：基于自适应比较调度的高效人机协作排序方法
AI.tldr: 通过利用VLM评估比较的“惊喜度”，SGS框架仅将困难的比较交给人类，从而在保持高精度的同时大幅减少了人工标注需求。
AI.motivation: 传统的两两比较排序方法（如$O(n \log n)$）仍需大量昂贵的人工判断，为了降低标注成本并提高效率，需要一种能够识别哪些比较真正需要人工干预的智能调度机制。
AI.method: 提出了“惊喜引导归并排序（SGS）”框架，包含三个核心组件：1. 基于归并排序的调度器；2. 综合惊喜评分系统（结合VLM置信度、Elo差距和投票熵）；3. 自适应预算分配器，根据惊喜度决定由模型推理或人工标注。
AI.result: 在六个基准数据集（文本相似度和图像质量评估）上进行了验证，SGS最多可跳过每会话535次非必要比较，并在相同预算下将Kendall's τ指标提升了6到12个点。
AI.conclusion: SGS框架通过引入惊喜度评分和自适应预算分配，成功在保证排序精度的同时，显著降低了人工标注成本，证明了在大规模主观排序任务中，结合模型引导与算法排序是提升效率的有效途径。
AI.translation: 两两比较是主观排序任务的黄金标准；然而，详尽的标注需要大量的人工比较（$O(n^2)$）。虽然基于排序的方法已将此负担降低至$O(n \log n)$，但它们仍然需要为每一次比较进行昂贵的人工判断。为了进一步提高标注效率，我们建议利用视觉语言模型（VLM）作为“问题优先级排序器”，而不是直接替代标注者，以识别哪些比较真正需要人工判断。所提出的“惊喜引导归并排序（SGS）”框架通过三个集成组件实现这一点：（1）一种自底向上的归并排序调度器，用于构建比较并利用传递性；（2）一种复合惊喜评分器——结合了消除位置偏差的VLM置信度、Elo差距和投票熵——以量化比较的模糊性；（3）一种自适应预算分配器，将高惊喜对路由给人类，同时通过传递性推理自动处理低惊喜对。我们在跨越文本相似度（STS-B, BIOSSES, SICKR-STS）和图像质量评估（KonIQ-10k, TID2013, LIVE Challenge）的六个不同基准上进行了验证。SGS有效地识别并跳过了每个会话中多达535个非信息性比较。因此，在相同的总预算下，它实现了Kendall's τ×100比Active Elo提高6到12个点的成绩。这些结果表明，将VLM引导的惊喜度指标与算法排序相结合，可以在不同领域提供一致的精度-效率权衡。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“惊喜引导归并排序（SGS）”的框架，旨在通过视觉语言模型（VLM）作为问题优先级排序器，优化主观排序任务中的人工标注效率。该方法利用惊喜度评分机制识别模糊的比较对，并结合归并排序算法和自适应预算分配，将低惊喜度任务由模型自动处理，高惊喜度任务交给人工，从而在有限预算下实现更优的排序精度。
AI.keywords: 主观排序, 视觉语言模型, 惊喜度评分, 自适应预算分配, 人机协作
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地将大模型（VLM）从单纯的“标注者”角色转变为“决策辅助者”，通过引入“惊喜度（Surprise）”概念筛选出真正需要人工介入的比较，有效解决了传统排序方法中人工成本高昂的问题。这种人机协作范式在资源受限场景下具有很高的实用价值。

title: Differentiable Packing of Irregular 3D Objects with Adaptive Container Estimation
summary: Most existing approaches either fix the container in advance or optimize only a single container dimension through an outer search loop, leaving the remaining dimensions as a manual tuning problem. We present a differentiable packing framework that jointly optimizes all 6N object pose parameters and all three container side lengths inside a single gradient-based loop. The formulation combines six physics-inspired, differentiable loss terms computed directly on triangle meshes through axis-aligned bounding-box proxies. An adaptive squeezing mechanism periodically tightens the container whenever the overlap loss falls below a pair-count-scaled threshold, producing a large initial drop in container volume, followed by small refinements. All pairwise computations are written in tensor-broadcasting form, giving a 3.4 to 54 times speedup over a reference loop-based implementation. The pipeline is implemented in Python and PyTorch, with no physics engine, FFT library, or convex decomposition. On multiple object categories, the method produces containers that are 11 to 32 percent smaller than time-matched DBLF and simulated-annealing baselines at N =100, while running in under 4 minutes per instance on a single consumer GPU.

AI.title_translation: 具有自适应容器估计的不规则三维物体可微分装箱
AI.tldr: 一种全新的可微分装箱框架，通过联合优化物体姿态与容器尺寸，实现了比传统方法更小、更快的装箱结果。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常预设容器或仅能优化单一维度，导致容器尺寸难以达到最优且依赖人工调整。
AI.method: 提出一种可微分包装框架，通过计算六个基于物理的微分损失项，联合优化物体姿态和容器三维尺寸；引入自适应压缩机制动态缩小容器，并利用张量广播技术加速计算。
AI.result: 相比基准方法（DBLF和模拟退火），在N=100的情况下，容器体积缩小了11%到32%，且单实例运行时间在4分钟以内。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过可微分的包装框架和自适应压缩机制，实现了对不规则三维物体及其容器尺寸的高效、同时优化，在保持计算速度的同时，显著提升了空间利用率。
AI.translation: 现有的大多数方法要么预先固定容器，要么仅通过外部搜索循环优化单一容器维度，这使得其余维度成为人工调整的问题。我们提出了一种可微分的装箱框架，可以在单个基于梯度的循环内联合优化所有6N个物体姿态参数和所有三个容器边长。该公式结合了六个基于物理的、可微分的损失项，这些损失项直接通过轴对齐包围盒代理在三角网格上计算。一种自适应挤压机制会在重叠损失低于按对数缩放的阈值时定期收紧容器，从而产生容器体积的初始大幅下降，随后进行小幅优化。所有成对计算均以张量广播形式编写，比参考的基于循环的实现快3.4到54倍。该管线使用Python和PyTorch实现，无需物理引擎、FFT库或凸分解。在多个物体类别上，该方法生成的容器比N=100时时间匹配的DBLF和模拟退火基准小11%到32%，且在单个消费级GPU上每个实例的运行时间不到4分钟。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种可微分的三维不规则物体装箱框架，通过联合优化物体姿态与容器尺寸，配合自适应压缩机制，实现了高效且紧凑的装箱效果，显著优于现有基准方法。
AI.keywords: 可微分装箱, 三维物体, 容器优化, 梯度下降, 张量广播
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种完全可微分的装箱框架，能够同时优化物体姿态和容器尺寸，并引入了自适应压缩机制。其优势在于无需依赖物理引擎或复杂的凸分解，且计算效率极高，在处理大规模物体装箱时展现了优异的性能。

title: LectūraAgents: A Multi-Agent Framework for Adaptive Personalized AI-Assisted Learning and Embodied Teaching
summary: Effective personalized AI-assisted learning demands systems that can not only generate accurate learner-specific educational materials, but also dynamically adapt their instruction to diverse learners. However, existing educational agents have primarily focused on lecture content automation and simulations, which often fall short of modelling multimodal and embodied instructional methods tailored for the individual learner. To this end, we propose LectūraAgents - a multi-agent framework that enables personalized learning through end-to-end adaptive embodied teaching. At its core, LectūraAgents mirrors a professor-student relationship, in which a ProfessorAgent leads a collaborative team of specialized subordinate agents through research, planning, review, and embodied delivery of lecture contents that adapt to a learner's needs. The framework offers three main contributions: (1) a hierarchical multi-agent architecture for end-to-end personalized learning; (2) an adaptive embodied teaching mechanism, wherein the ProfessorAgent executes visible and pedagogically motivated teaching actions (e.g., handwrite, highlight, underline, etc.) over contents in a teaching environment; and (3) a Teaching Action-Speech Alignment (TASA) algorithm that employs salience-based heuristics and temporal semantic segmentation to generate coherent teaching action sequences aligned with learner profiles. We evaluate LectūraAgents on diverse courses at high school, undergraduate, and graduate levels using sample-specific rubric-based analysis; with generated lecture materials and teaching actions assessed and validated by expert educators. Experimental results show consistent gains in lecture content quality, embodied teaching quality, assessment, and personalization over existing approaches, positioning LectūraAgents as a pedagogically well-grounded framework for personalized learning at scale.

AI.title_translation: LectūraAgents：一种用于自适应个性化AI辅助学习与具身教学的多智能体框架
AI.tldr: LectūraAgents通过多智能体协作和具身教学机制，实现了能够模仿人类教师行为（如书写、标注）并根据学生需求动态调整的个性化AI教学系统。
AI.motivation: 现有的教育AI智能体多集中于内容自动化和模拟，缺乏针对个体学习者进行多模态和具身化教学建模的能力，无法满足深层次的个性化教学需求。
AI.method: 提出了LectūraAgents框架，包含一个层级化多智能体架构（由ProfessorAgent领导）、一种自适应具身教学机制（模拟书写、高亮等教学动作），以及TASA（教学动作-语音对齐）算法，通过显著性启发式方法和时间语义分割实现动作与语音的精准对齐。
AI.result: 在高中、本科及研究生多学科课程的专家评估中，LectūraAgents在内容质量、具身教学质量、评估和个性化方面均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: LectūraAgents 证明了通过多智能体协作和具身教学机制，可以显著提升AI辅助学习的个性化程度与教学质量，为规模化个性化教育提供了坚实的框架基础。
AI.translation: 有效的个性化AI辅助学习不仅需要生成准确的特定学习者教育材料，还需要根据不同学习者动态调整教学方式。然而，现有的教育智能体主要关注讲座内容的自动化和模拟，在针对个体学习者进行多模态和具身化教学建模方面往往存在不足。为此，我们提出了LectūraAgents，一个通过端到端自适应具身教学实现个性化学习的多智能体框架。其核心模仿了师生关系，由ProfessorAgent领导一个由专业子智能体组成的协作团队，负责研究、规划、审查和执行适应学习者需求的讲座内容。该框架主要有三个贡献：（1）用于端到端个性化学习的层级化多智能体架构；（2）自适应具身教学机制，ProfessorAgent在教学环境中对内容执行可见且具有教学动机的动作（如手写、高亮、下划线等）；以及（3）教学动作-语音对齐（TASA）算法，采用基于显著性的启发式方法和时间语义分割，生成与学习者画像对齐的连贯教学动作序列。我们在高中、本科和研究生水平的多种课程上，通过基于样本的评分标准分析对LectūraAgents进行了评估，生成的讲座材料和教学动作均经过专家教育工作者的评估和验证。实验结果显示，与现有方法相比，该框架在讲座内容质量、具身教学质量、评估和个性化方面均有显著提升，使LectūraAgents成为一个基于教学法、可规模化实施的个性化学习框架。
AI.summary: 本文提出了LectūraAgents，一个通过多智能体协作实现端到端自适应具身教学的框架。该框架利用教授智能体协调子智能体进行研究、规划与教学，通过TASA算法实现教学动作与语音的语义对齐，从而为不同水平的学习者提供高质量、个性化的教学体验。
AI.keywords: 个性化学习, 多智能体框架, 具身教学, 教育AI, 教学行为-语音对齐
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将多智能体架构与具身教学（Embodied Teaching）相结合，通过模拟师生关系和TASA算法，解决了现有教育AI在个性化教学和多模态交互方面的不足。其优势在于将教学行为（如书写、高亮）与语音语义对齐，显著提升了教学的交互性和个性化程度。局限性在于该框架的实际落地可能依赖于特定的教学硬件或环境支持。

title: AI+CAD Data Representation Architecture: From DeepCAD Solid Modeling to WHUCAD Industrial-Level Parametric Feature Modeling
summary: In July 2025, Study Times, sponsored by the Party School of the Central Committee of the CPC, pointed out that 95% of industrial software for R&D and design in China relies on imports, and that 90% of the high-end CAD/CAE/CAM software market is monopolized by European and American giants. This is a typical strategic bottleneck problem. Unlike the visually oriented goal of "visual plausibility" pursued by related sister disciplines such as CV and CG, CAD places greater emphasis on "industrial usability". In CAD, data representation architecture is more foundational than the optimization of network algorithms. This paper first starts from data representation in AI+CAD and reports a classification paradigm and research progress in AI+CAD. Then, using the open-source DeepCAD data representation as an example, it analyzes the pain points of representative AI+CAD work and the gap between such work and real industrial-level parametric feature modeling. Next, by comparison with the open-source WHUCAD data representation, it discusses how its three-level architecture provides fundamental support for industrial-grade parametric feature modeling. Finally, in view of the rapid iteration of the AI wave, large models, and agents, this paper offers an outlook on AI+industrial-grade CAD.

AI.title_translation: 人工智能+CAD数据表示架构：从DeepCAD实体建模到WHUCAD工业级参数化特征建模
AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了AI+CAD中的数据表示架构，分析了现有方法的痛点，并提出了WHUCAD的三级架构以支持工业级参数化特征建模，最后展望了AI+工业级CAD的未来。
AI.motivation: 中国工业软件在研发设计领域严重依赖进口，高端CAD/CAE/CAM市场被国外巨头垄断，这是典型的战略瓶颈问题。CAD领域的数据表示架构比网络算法优化更基础，需要关注“工业可用性”。
AI.method: 文章首先从AI+CAD的数据表示入手，介绍了其分类范式和研究进展。然后，以开源DeepCAD数据表示为例，分析了现有AI+CAD工作的痛点和与工业级参数化特征建模的差距。接着，通过与开源WHUCAD数据表示的对比，阐述了其三级架构如何为工业级参数化特征建模提供基础支持。最后，对AI+工业级CAD的未来进行了展望。
AI.result: 文章分析了DeepCAD的痛点，并提出WHUCAD的三级架构能够为工业级参数化特征建模提供基础支持。
AI.conclusion: WHUCAD的三级架构为工业级参数化特征建模提供了基础支持，并对AI+工业级CAD的未来发展进行了展望。
AI.translation: 2025年7月，中共中央党校主办的《学习时报》指出，我国研发设计领域的工业软件九成依赖进口，高端CAD/CAE/CAM软件市场则被欧美巨头垄断。这是典型的战略瓶颈问题。与计算机视觉（CV）和计算机图形学（CG）等相关姊妹学科追求的“视觉真实性”的视觉导向目标不同，CAD更注重“工业可用性”。在CAD领域，数据表示架构比网络算法的优化更为基础。本文首先从AI+CAD的数据表示入手，介绍了其分类范式和研究进展。然后，以开源DeepCAD数据表示为例，分析了代表性AI+CAD工作的痛点及其与真正工业级参数化特征建模的差距。接着，通过与开源WHUCAD数据表示的对比，讨论了其三级架构如何为工业级参数化特征建模提供基础支持。最后，鉴于AI浪潮、大模型和智能体（Agent）的快速迭代，本文对AI+工业级CAD进行了展望。
AI.summary: 本文聚焦于AI+CAD领域的数据表示架构，旨在解决中国工业软件的战略瓶颈问题。文章首先回顾了AI+CAD数据表示的研究进展，随后通过分析DeepCAD的局限性，指出了现有方法与工业级参数化特征建模之间的差距。在此基础上，文章重点介绍了WHUCAD的三级架构，并论证了其为实现工业级参数化特征建模提供的基础支撑。最后，文章对AI技术（如大模型和智能体）在未来工业级CAD中的应用前景进行了展望。
AI.keywords: AI+CAD,数据表示,参数化特征建模,DeepCAD,WHUCAD
AI.comments: 该论文关注了AI与CAD结合的关键问题——数据表示，并点明了中国在这一领域面临的挑战。通过对比DeepCAD和WHUCAD，文章清晰地阐述了从现有AI+CAD方法到满足工业级需求的差距，并提出了WHUCAD的三级架构作为解决方案。论文的价值在于其对工业可用性的强调，以及对未来AI技术在CAD领域发展的前瞻性思考。然而，文章可能需要提供更具体的WHUCAD架构细节和实验验证来进一步增强其说服力。

title: How Much Can We Trust LLM Search Agents? Measuring Endorsement Vulnerability to Web Content Manipulation
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based search agents synthesize open-web content into actionable recommendations on behalf of users, creating a risk that attacker-published pages are transformed into endorsed claims. We introduce SearchGEO, a controlled evaluation framework for measuring endorsement corruption in LLM-based web-search agents, combining a web-evidence manipulation pipeline, a five-mode attack taxonomy, and multiple output-level metrics. We evaluate 13 LLM backends on 308 cases each. Results show that vulnerability patterns vary across backends: overall attack success rate (ASR) ranges from 0.0% on Claude-Sonnet-4.6 to 31.4% on Gemini-3-Flash, the strongest attack mode differs by model family, and the same deployment scaffold could amplify or decrease ASR on different backends. An auxiliary agent-skill probe, where endorsement becomes an install command, exposes a sharp split among otherwise robust backends: Claude over-rejects while GPT over-trusts. These findings argue for treating recommendation reliability under adversarial search content as a first-class dimension of backend safety evaluation.

AI.title_translation: 我们能多信任LLM搜索代理？衡量对网页内容操纵的背书脆弱性
AI.tldr: 该论文通过SearchGEO框架揭示了LLM搜索代理容易被恶意网页内容误导，不同模型在应对攻击时表现出从“过度拒绝”到“过度信任”的巨大差异。
AI.motivation: LLM搜索代理将开放网络内容转化为用户建议，这引发了攻击者通过操纵网页内容诱导模型发布错误背书（Endorsement）的风险，亟需量化评估此类漏洞。
AI.method: 提出了SearchGEO评估框架，包含网页证据操纵流水线、五种攻击模式分类法以及多维度的输出评估指标。通过在13个大模型后端进行308个测试用例的对比实验，并引入了“代理技能探测”以评估模型在指令执行层面的信任倾向。
AI.result: 不同LLM后端的脆弱性差异巨大，攻击成功率（ASR）从0%到31.4%不等。研究发现最强攻击模式因模型系列而异，且部署方式会显著影响ASR。在安装命令探测中，Claude表现出过度拒绝，而GPT表现出过度信任。
AI.conclusion: LLM搜索代理在面对恶意操纵的网页内容时存在显著的背书风险，且不同模型在安全性与合规性之间表现出截然不同的权衡策略。建议将推荐可靠性纳入大模型安全评估体系。
AI.translation: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的搜索代理代表用户将开放网络内容合成为可操作的建议，这产生了一种风险，即攻击者发布的网页可能被转化为模型背书的声明。我们引入了SearchGEO，这是一个用于衡量LLM搜索代理中背书腐败情况的受控评估框架，结合了网页证据操纵流水线、五种攻击模式分类法以及多个输出层面的指标。我们评估了13个LLM后端，每个后端处理308个案例。结果表明，脆弱性模式在不同后端之间存在差异：总体攻击成功率（ASR）从Claude-Sonnet-4.6的0.0%到Gemini-3-Flash的31.4%不等，最强的攻击模式因模型系列而异，且相同的部署框架可能会增加或减少不同后端上的ASR。一项辅助的代理技能探测（将背书变为安装命令）揭示了原本稳健的后端之间存在明显分歧：Claude过度拒绝，而GPT过度信任。这些发现主张将对抗性搜索内容下的推荐可靠性视为后端安全评估的一流维度。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了用于衡量大模型搜索代理背书腐败情况的评估框架SearchGEO。研究通过对13个模型进行攻击实验，揭示了不同模型在对抗性网页内容下的脆弱性差异，并指出模型在处理恶意指令时的信任偏差，强调了提升搜索代理推荐可靠性的紧迫性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 搜索代理, 内容操纵, 安全评估, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了LLM搜索代理在面对恶意网页内容时的脆弱性，强调了将“推荐可靠性”作为安全评估核心指标的重要性。研究方法论严谨，通过SearchGEO框架量化了不同模型在不同攻击模式下的表现差异，特别是在“指令注入”等高风险场景下的行为分歧，对构建更安全的AI代理具有重要指导意义。

title: Robust Dual-Signal Fusion: Hybrid Neuro-Symbolic Gating with Compressed Chain-of-Thought Refinement for Irony Detection in Social Media Texts
summary: Small-scale Large Language Models (LLMs) natively default to literal semantic interpretations, making few-shot irony detection a persistent challenge in noisy, user-generated text. We introduce the Robust Dual-Signal (RDS) Fusion framework, a hybrid neuro-symbolic architecture that compresses Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning trajectories without Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). Evaluated on a strictly held-out TweetEval test set ($N=734$), RDS achieves $78.1\%$ accuracy and a Macro F1 of $0.777$, matching the absolute performance ceiling of a fine-tuned BERTweet. On the heavily imbalanced iSarcasm dataset, the frozen CoT pipeline filters $22.5\%$ of out-of-distribution hallucinations, yielding a few-shot Macro F1 of $0.6726$ and Ironic F1 of $0.4821$, outperforming multiple heavily supervised SemEval transformer ensembles. Statistical ablation confirms this structural synergy: while adding the symbolic prior to the neural baseline yields an insignificant gain, and the RDS fusion is statistically insignificant compared to the combined RoBERTa and symbolic prior ablation; the concurrent fusion achieves a statistically significant improvement over the standalone baseline ($p=0.005$).

AI.title_translation: 鲁棒双信号融合：结合压缩思维链精炼的混合神经符号门控用于社交媒体文本中的讽刺检测
AI.tldr: 本文提出RDS框架，通过混合神经符号架构与压缩思维链推理，在无需微调的情况下显著提升了小模型在社交媒体文本中的少样本讽刺检测能力。
AI.motivation: 小规模大语言模型（LLMs）天生倾向于字面语义解释，这使得在嘈杂、用户生成的社交媒体文本中进行少样本讽刺检测成为一个极具挑战性的难题。
AI.method: 提出了鲁棒双信号（RDS）融合框架。这是一种混合神经符号（neuro-symbolic）架构，它在无需监督微调（SFT）的情况下，对思维链（CoT）推理轨迹进行压缩和提炼。
AI.result: 在TweetEval测试集（N=734）上，RDS实现了78.1%的准确率和0.777的Macro F1值，达到了微调后BERTweet的性能上限。在高度不平衡的iSarcasm数据集上，该框架过滤了22.5%的分布外幻觉，取得了0.6726的少样本Macro F1和0.4821的Ironic F1，优于多个重度监督的SemEval Transformer集成模型。统计消融实验证实，并发融合相比于独立基线取得了显著的提升（p=0.005）。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒双信号（RDS）融合框架在无需监督微调的前提下，能够有效克服小规模大语言模型在字面语义理解上的局限，在社交媒体少样本讽刺检测任务中达到或超越了重度监督的基线模型，证明了神经符号协同设计的有效性。
AI.translation: 小规模大语言模型（LLMs）原生默认进行字面语义解释，这使得在嘈杂的用户生成文本中进行少样本讽刺检测成为一个持续的挑战。我们引入了鲁棒双信号（RDS）融合框架，这是一种混合神经符号架构，可在没有监督微调（SFT）的情况下压缩思维链（CoT）推理轨迹。在严格保留的TweetEval测试集（N=734）上进行评估，RDS实现了78.1%的准确率和0.777的Macro F1值，达到了微调后BERTweet的绝对性能上限。在高度不平衡的iSarcasm数据集上，冻结的CoT流水线过滤了22.5%的分布外幻觉，取得了0.6726的少样本Macro F1和0.4821的Ironic F1，超越了多个经过重度监督的SemEval Transformer集成模型。统计消融实验证实了这种结构协同效应：虽然在神经基线中加入符号先验带来的提升并不显著，且RDS融合与结合了RoBERTa及符号先验的消融相比在统计上也不显著，但并发融合相比于独立基线取得了显著的统计学提升（p=0.005）。
AI.summary: 本文针对小规模大语言模型在社交媒体文本中难以进行少样本讽刺检测的问题，提出了一种名为RDS（Robust Dual-Signal）的混合神经符号融合框架。该框架在无需监督微调的情况下，通过压缩思维链推理轨迹，在TweetEval和iSarcasm数据集上均取得了优异的性能，不仅能够过滤分布外幻觉，还能在性能上媲美或超越重度监督的传统模型，消融实验也证实了其双信号并发融合结构的统计学显著性。
AI.keywords: 讽刺检测, 神经符号架构, 思维链压缩, 社交媒体文本, 少样本学习
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种混合神经符号（Neuro-Symbolic）架构，在无需监督微调（SFT）的情况下，通过压缩思维链（CoT）推理轨迹，显著提升了小规模大语言模型在社交媒体文本少样本讽刺检测上的表现。其局限性在于，消融实验表明某些单一模块的叠加（如仅在神经基线上加入符号先验）带来的提升并不显著，这暗示其性能高度依赖于双信号的特定并发融合结构设计。

title: Geometric Action Model for Robot Policy Learning
summary: Generalist robot policies must follow user instructions while reasoning about how objects, cameras, and robot actions interact in the 3D physical world. Recent vision-language-action models (VLAs) and video world-action models (WAMs) inherit strong semantic or temporal priors from large-scale foundation models, but they still operate primarily on 2D image frames or 2D-derived latent spaces, leaving implicit the 3D geometry required for contact-rich manipulation. We propose the Geometric Action Model (GAM), a language-conditioned manipulation policy that directly repurposes a pretrained geometric foundation model (GFM) as a shared substrate for perception, temporal prediction, and action decoding. GAM splits the GFM at an intermediate layer: the shallow layers serve as an observation encoder, and a causal future predictor inserted at the split layer forecasts future latent tokens conditioned on language, proprioception, and action history. The predicted future tokens are then routed through the remaining GFM blocks for feature propagation and decoding, allowing a single backbone to produce both future geometry and actions. This design equips the GFM with language-conditioned temporal world modeling through minimal architectural modification while preserving its rich geometric priors. Across a broad suite of simulation and real-robot manipulation benchmarks, GAM is more accurate, more robust, faster, and lighter than current foundation-model-scale baselines.

AI.title_translation: 用于机器人策略学习的几何动作模型
AI.tldr: GAM通过在几何基础模型中集成未来预测能力，实现了对3D物理世界更好的理解，从而在机器人操控任务中表现出比传统2D模型更优的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作模型主要基于2D图像，缺乏对3D物理世界的几何理解，难以处理需要精确接触的复杂操作任务。
AI.method: 提出几何动作模型（GAM），将预训练的几何基础模型（GFM）拆分为两部分：浅层作为观察编码器，中间层插入因果未来预测器，用于生成语言条件下的未来潜空间特征，最后通过剩余的GFM块进行特征传播和动作解码。
AI.result: 在多个仿真和真实机器人操作基准测试中，GAM在准确性、鲁棒性、推理速度和模型轻量化方面均优于当前的基础模型规模基线。
AI.conclusion: GAM通过将几何基础模型作为核心，成功实现了高效、高精度的机器人操作策略，证明了将几何先验与时间预测相结合在复杂机器人任务中的有效性。
AI.translation: 通用机器人策略必须在遵循用户指令的同时，推理物体、相机和机器人动作在3D物理世界中的交互。近期的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和视频世界-动作模型（WAM）虽然继承了大规模基础模型的强大语义或时间先验，但它们主要在2D图像帧或2D衍生的潜空间上运行，忽略了复杂接触操作所需的3D几何信息。我们提出了几何动作模型（GAM），这是一种语言条件下的操作策略，它直接将预训练的几何基础模型（GFM）重新利用为感知、时间预测和动作解码的共享基础。GAM在中间层拆分了GFM：浅层作为观察编码器，并在拆分层插入一个因果未来预测器，根据语言、本体感受和动作历史预测未来的潜空间标记。预测出的未来标记随后通过剩余的GFM块进行特征传播和解码，使得单一骨干网络能够同时生成未来的几何形状和动作。这种设计通过极小的架构修改，为GFM配备了语言条件下的时间世界建模能力，同时保留了其丰富的几何先验。在一系列广泛的仿真和真实机器人操作基准测试中，GAM比当前基础模型规模的基线更准确、更稳健、更快且更轻量。
AI.summary: 本文提出了几何动作模型（GAM），这是一种将几何基础模型（GFM）改造为机器人操作策略的方法。通过在GFM中间层插入未来预测器，模型能够结合语言指令和物理几何先验进行时间建模与动作生成，从而在保持轻量化的同时显著提升了机器人复杂操作的性能。
AI.keywords: 机器人策略, 几何基础模型, 3D几何, 动作解码, 时间建模
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将预训练的几何基础模型（GFM）转化为具备时间预测和动作解码能力的机器人策略模型，填补了现有视觉-语言-动作模型在3D几何理解上的不足。其优势在于无需大幅修改架构即可利用现有的几何先验，在效率和性能上均优于现有的基线模型。

title: Loss Landscape Poisoning: Targeted Extraction of Unseen Training Data from LLMs
comments: Updated author order. No technical changes
summary: Large Language Models are increasingly trained on proprietary or sensitive data, from private healthcare and financial records to user conversations containing secrets. Ensuring the privacy of such data against extraction attacks has become a central concern. In this paper, we ask whether an attacker who can poison a portion of the training data can facilitate the leakage of a separate target record they have no access to. We answer in the affirmative and show that such leakage can be induced by a poisoning mechanism that reshapes the model's local loss landscape around the target completion. Our key insight is that poisoning to create a sharp loss minimum at the target, surrounded by elevated loss on nearby alternatives, forces the model to memorize the target as the unique low-loss solution in its neighborhood. The attack requires no architectural changes, and generalizes across centralized and federated learning settings. We demonstrate that the attack amplifies privacy leakage across language (up to 100% successful extraction), and vision-language models (up 90% successful extraction). We show that the attack is thwarted when the model is trained to be differentially private. However, we introduce a new attack that directly probes the loss landscape bypassing even differential privacy defenses.
comment: Updated author order. No technical changes

AI.title_translation: 损失地形毒化：从大语言模型中针对性提取未见训练数据
AI.tldr: 通过毒化训练数据重塑模型损失地形，即使没有访问权限也能诱导大模型精准泄露敏感训练数据，且能绕过差分隐私保护。
AI.motivation: 随着大模型训练数据的敏感性日益增加，研究者旨在探讨攻击者是否可以通过毒化部分训练数据，诱导模型泄露其原本无法访问的特定敏感记录。
AI.method: 提出了一种损失地形毒化机制，通过在目标数据周围构建尖锐的损失极小值（Sharp Loss Minimum），并提高邻近替代方案的损失，从而迫使模型在该特定邻域内记忆目标记录；此外，引入了一种直接探测损失地形的新型攻击以绕过差分隐私防御。
AI.result: 在语言模型和视觉-语言模型上实现了高达100%和90%的提取成功率；证明了该攻击在集中式和联邦学习中均有效，且能绕过传统的差分隐私防御。
AI.conclusion: 攻击者可以通过毒化训练数据重塑模型损失地形，迫使模型记忆特定的目标记录，从而实现对敏感数据的有效提取；即使是差分隐私保护也可能被新型探测攻击绕过。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型越来越多地基于私有或敏感数据进行训练，从私人医疗和财务记录到包含机密的对话。确保此类数据免受提取攻击已成为核心关注点。在本文中，我们探讨了如果攻击者可以毒化部分训练数据，是否能促进其无法访问的独立目标记录的泄露。我们给出了肯定的回答，并证明这种泄露可以通过一种重塑目标补全周围模型局部损失地形的毒化机制来诱导。我们的核心见解是，通过毒化在目标处创建一个尖锐的损失最小值，并使附近的替代方案损失升高，从而迫使模型将目标记忆为该邻域内唯一的低损失解。该攻击无需改变架构，并可推广到集中式和联邦学习设置中。我们证明该攻击放大了跨语言（高达100%的成功提取）和视觉-语言模型（高达90%的成功提取）的隐私泄露。我们表明，当模型经过差分隐私训练时，该攻击会被挫败。然而，我们引入了一种直接探测损失地形的新型攻击，甚至绕过了差分隐私防御。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了针对大型语言模型的“损失地形毒化”攻击，证明攻击者通过恶意操纵部分训练数据，可以重塑模型损失地形，诱导模型记忆并泄露其无法直接访问的敏感目标记录，且该方法在多种模型架构下均表现出极高的成功率。
AI.keywords: 损失地形毒化, 数据隐私, 隐私提取攻击, 大型语言模型, 差分隐私
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了模型训练过程中的一种新型安全威胁，通过操纵损失函数地形（Loss Landscape）来实现对未见训练数据的精准提取。其核心创新在于将“记忆”问题转化为“优化”问题，且该攻击具有跨模型（语言/视觉-语言）和跨架构的通用性。尽管差分隐私能缓解基础攻击，但作者提出的针对性探测方法进一步凸显了当前隐私保护机制的脆弱性，为未来鲁棒模型训练提供了重要警示。

title: OTRO: Oblivious Tokenization Path with Square-Root ORAM
summary:
The CPU-side large language model (LLM) tokenizer is a critical security gap in LLM serving through a confidential computing stack with CPU and GPU trusted execution environments (TEEs). Tokenizers converts the prompts through table-driven lookups, and the resulting memory access patterns are a powerful source of side-channel leakage. Recent work demonstrates end-to-end recovery of user prompts from tokenizer access pattern on production Intel TDX. However, a drop-in use of the popular tree-based Oblivious RAMs (e.g., PathORAM) to prevent access-pattern leakage introduces $\sim$13$\times$ tokenizer slowdown, resulting in 10-58% higher time-to-first-token (TTFT).
  In this paper, we present OTRO, an efficient, oblivious tokenization path tailored to latency-critical LLM serving. OTRO relies on square-root ORAM for fast single-access lookups, but avoids its prohibitive $O(N\log^2N$) rebuild cost every $\sqrt{N}$ accesses through three key innovations. First, OTRO provides a pool of replicated square-root ORAM instances that utilize the read-only nature of tokenizer table. Second, an epoch-based rotation policy decouples accesses from rebuilds and pads each epoch with dummy accesses to its boundaries, minimizing observable information. Lastly, chunked KV-cache-aware tokenization further overlaps rebuilds with GPU prefill and minimizes the instance count. Implemented as modules in HuggingFace Tokenizers and nano-vLLM, running within a TDX-enabled CVM with an NVIDIA H100 GPU, OTRO limits TTFT overhead to at most 4.5%, keeps tokenizer-induced latency under 10\% of total TTFT, and adds less than 0.5 GB of memory overhead while reducing the tokenizer's observable leakage across various model families and sizes.

AI.title_translation: OTRO：具有平方根ORAM的遗忘分词路径
AI.tldr: OTRO通过改进的平方根ORAM技术，在保护LLM分词过程免受侧信道攻击的同时，将性能开销控制在极低水平，解决了安全与速度难以兼顾的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM分词器在机密计算环境中存在内存访问模式泄露，导致用户提示词被还原；而直接使用传统的树状ORAM会导致严重的性能下降，无法满足延迟敏感的LLM服务需求。
AI.method: 提出了OTRO框架，利用副本平方根ORAM实例池、基于纪元的轮换策略以及KV缓存感知的块化分词技术，将重建开销与GPU预填充阶段重叠，从而绕过传统ORAM的性能瓶颈。
AI.result: 在TDX环境下，OTRO将首词生成时间（TTFT）的开销限制在4.5%以内，分词器引起的延迟低于总TTFT的10%，内存增加小于0.5GB，并有效降低了侧信道泄露风险。
AI.conclusion: OTRO成功地将OBRAM应用于LLM分词器，在显著降低侧信道信息泄露的同时，将TTFT性能开销限制在4.5%以内，证明了其在实际生产环境中的可行性。
AI.translation: CPU端的大语言模型（LLM）分词器是利用CPU和GPU可信执行环境（TEE）进行LLM服务时的一个关键安全漏洞。分词器通过查表方式转换提示词，由此产生的内存访问模式是侧信道泄露的重要来源。近期研究表明，在生产环境的Intel TDX上，可以通过分词器的访问模式端到端恢复用户提示词。然而，直接使用流行的树状遗忘RAM（如PathORAM）来防止访问模式泄露，会导致分词器速度下降约13倍，使首词生成时间（TTFT）增加10-58%。在本文中，我们提出了OTRO，这是一个为延迟敏感型LLM服务量身定制的高效遗忘分词路径。OTRO利用平方根ORAM进行快速的单次访问查找，并通过三项关键创新避免了每$\sqrt{N}$次访问后高达$O(N\log^2N)$的重建成本。首先，OTRO利用分词表只读的特性，提供了一组副本平方根ORAM实例池。其次，基于纪元的轮换策略将访问与重建解耦，并通过在每个纪元边界填充虚拟访问，最大限度地减少了可观察信息。最后，分块的KV缓存感知分词进一步将重建与GPU预填充阶段重叠，并最大限度地减少了实例数量。OTRO在HuggingFace Tokenizers和nano-vLLM中实现，运行在启用了TDX的CVM和NVIDIA H100 GPU上，将TTFT开销限制在4.5%以内，分词引起的延迟保持在总TTFT的10%以下，内存开销小于0.5 GB，同时减少了各种模型系列和规模下分词器的可观察泄露。
AI.summary: 本文提出了OTRO，一种针对LLM分词器设计的遗忘路径方案。通过优化平方根ORAM的使用，结合实例池、纪元轮换及KV缓存感知技术，OTRO在保护分词过程免受侧信道攻击的同时，极大地降低了性能损耗。
AI.keywords: 机密计算, LLM分词器, 侧信道防御, 平方根ORAM, 安全推断
AI.comments: OTRO通过针对性设计解决了传统OBRAM在延迟敏感场景下的性能瓶颈，其利用分块、实例池和流水线技术在安全与性能间取得了出色平衡，为机密计算环境下的LLM部署提供了重要参考。

title: EComAgentBench: Benchmarking Shopping Agents on Long-Horizon Tasks with Distributed Hidden Intent
summary: As LLM-based shopping agents enter production, existing benchmarks fail to capture how a shopper's requirements arrive: stated implicitly in the query, recorded in a profile, or revealed only when the right question is asked. Benchmarks that expose full intent upfront and grade only the final choice can neither pose this long-horizon challenge nor explain which requirement an agent missed. To address this gap, we introduce EComAgentBench, a benchmark of 662 tasks grounded in real Amazon products and reviews. Each task scatters these requirements across a visible query, a tool-gated profile, and scripted clarification; an agent must uncover hidden intent, verify candidates against attributes and review evidence, and commit to a single product within 100 tool calls. Moreover, typed, source-tagged rubrics grade every task, attributing each failure to a requirement and its source. Construction is automated yet reliable, with every answer fixed in code before any text is generated and every sample validated. Our evaluation of seven models reveals that even the strongest attains only 57.1% overall accuracy, and rubric satisfaction degrades from visible to hidden sources. Overall, we believe EComAgentBench will serve as a reproducible foundation for moving shopping agents from single-query search toward dependable assistance over long horizons.

AI.title_translation: EComAgentBench：在分布式隐性意图下对长期购物代理进行基准测试
AI.tldr: EComAgentBench 是一个新型购物代理基准，通过模拟真实世界中分散的购物需求，揭示了当前大模型在发现隐性意图和长期任务规划方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试无法模拟真实购物场景中需求分散（显性、隐性、隐藏）的特点，且仅关注最终结果而忽略了长期交互过程中的意图发现能力。
AI.method: 构建了包含 662 个基于真实亚马逊产品和评论的任务基准；设计了分布式意图获取机制（查询、资料、澄清）；实现了基于类型化、来源标记的自动评分系统，用于诊断代理失败的具体原因。
AI.result: 对七个主流模型进行了评估，结果显示最强模型准确率仅为 57.1%，且模型在处理隐藏来源信息时的性能显著下降，证明了现有模型在复杂购物任务中的局限性。
AI.conclusion: EComAgentBench 为评估购物代理在复杂、多步骤交互中的表现提供了一个可靠的基准，揭示了当前大模型在处理隐性需求和长期规划方面的显著不足。
AI.translation: 随着基于大语言模型的购物代理进入生产环境，现有的基准测试无法捕捉购物者需求到达的方式：在查询中隐式陈述、记录在个人资料中，或仅在被问及正确问题时才显露。那些预先暴露全部意图并仅对最终选择进行评分的基准，既无法提出这种长期挑战，也无法解释代理错过了哪个需求。为了填补这一空白，我们引入了 EComAgentBench，这是一个包含 662 个任务的基准，基于真实的亚马逊产品和评论。每个任务将需求分散在可见查询、工具限制的个人资料和脚本化澄清中；代理必须在 100 次工具调用内揭示隐藏意图、根据属性和评论证据验证候选者，并确定单一产品。此外，类型化、源标记的准则对每个任务进行评分，将每次失败归因于特定需求及其来源。构建过程自动化且可靠，每个答案在生成任何文本之前都在代码中固定，并且每个样本都经过验证。我们对七个模型的评估显示，即使是最强的模型也仅达到 57.1% 的整体准确率，并且准则满足度从可见来源到隐藏来源呈现下降趋势。总的来说，我们相信 EComAgentBench 将成为推动购物代理从单次查询搜索转向长期可靠协助的可重复基础。
AI.summary: EComAgentBench 是一个新型购物代理基准测试，包含 662 个真实场景任务。它通过在查询、用户资料和交互澄清中分散意图，强制代理进行长期规划与探索，并利用细粒度的评分机制诊断代理在处理不同来源需求时的具体失败原因。
AI.keywords: 购物代理, 大语言模型, 隐性意图, 基准测试, 长期任务
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于构建了一个不仅关注结果，更关注“发现隐性意图”过程的评估框架。通过引入“分布式隐性意图”概念和自动化的细粒度评分机制，解决了现有购物代理基准测试过于简单、缺乏解释性的局限，对于提升购物代理的实际可用性具有重要意义。

title: Optimal placement and tuning of pointwise dampers for vibrating strings via a Lyapunov framework
summary:
We study the optimal placement and tuning of a small number of pointwise viscous dampers for a vibrating string. Starting from a finite element discretization of the damped wave equation, the system is transformed into a first-order phase-space formulation, which enables a unified Lyapunov trace framework.
  Three optimization criteria are considered: average total energy, average total displacement, and energy for a fixed initial state. For all criteria, explicit gradient formulas with respect to damper positions and viscosities are derived, requiring only one primal and one dual Lyapunov solve.
  Due to the strong non-convexity of the problem, a simple heuristic based on an explicit single-damper formula is proposed to generate effective initial guesses. Numerical examples illustrate the influence of spectral selection and discretization on the optimal damping configuration.

title: KANLib -- A Modular, Extensible and Fast Kolmogorov-Arnold Network Implementation
summary: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to traditional multilayer perceptrons by replacing linear weights with learnable univariate functions. Despite their theoretical advantages in interpretability and expressiveness, practical research of KANs remains difficult due to high computational costs and inconsistent feature support across existing frameworks. This paper introduces KANLib, a modular, extensible, and computationally efficient framework for developing and evaluating KAN architectures. KANLib unifies core concepts from existing implementations, including PyKAN, EfficientKAN, and FastKAN, within a consistent software architecture that emphasizes flexibility, feature parity, and high performance. The framework supports two basis function types, adaptive grid rescaling, grid extension, and fine-grained architectural customization while maintaining compatibility with standard PyTorch workflows. Experimental evaluation on the California Housing benchmark demonstrates that KANLib reproduces the predictive behavior of established reference KAN implementations while achieving competitive computational efficiency. Furthermore, the framework enables the exploration of architectural variations beyond standard KAN formulations with only minor impacts on predictive performance. Overall, KANLib provides a robust foundation for future research on scalable and extensible KAN architectures.

title: PAIWorld: A 3D-Consistent World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation
summary: World foundation models (WFMs) are powerful simulators, yet they predominantly operate in a single-view setting and lack the multi-view 3D consistency required for robotic manipulation. While robotic systems rely on multiple cameras (egocentric, eye-to-hand, and wrist-mounted) for policy learning, current multi-view world models simply concatenate view tokens without explicit geometric reasoning. This causes cross-view object drift, depth inconsistency, and texture misalignment. We trace these failures to two deficiencies: the absence of an explicit inter-view communication mechanism and the lack of a 3D geometric prior. We argue that resolving both simultaneously is necessary and sufficient. To address this, we present PAIWorld, a framework that augments diffusion-transformer world models via three core components: (1) Geometry-Aware Cross-View Attention blocks that establish an explicit pathway across views, (2) Geometric Rotary Position Embedding that encodes camera ray directions and extrinsic poses into the attention mechanism, and (3) Latent 3D-REPA, which distills 3D-aware features from frozen 3D foundation models to ensure 3D consistency. Built upon a DiT-based world foundation model, PAIWorld achieves state-of-the-art multi-view 3D consistency on robotic manipulation benchmarks, ranking 1st on the WorldArena leaderboard and 2nd on the AgiBot-Challenge2026 leaderboard, while enabling downstream applications such as model-based planning, world action models, and multi-view policy post-training.

AI.title_translation: PAIWorld：面向机器人操作的3D一致性世界基础模型
AI.tldr: PAIWorld 通过在世界模型中显式引入3D几何推理，解决了机器人多视角操作中的视图一致性难题，实现了顶尖的性能表现。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型缺乏多视角3D一致性，导致机器人操作中出现跨视角物体漂移、深度不一致和纹理错位问题。
AI.method: 提出 PAIWorld 框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 几何感知跨视角注意力模块；(2) 编码相机射线方向和外参的几何旋转位置嵌入；(3) 蒸馏3D特征以确保一致性的 Latent 3D-REPA。
AI.result: 在机器人操作基准测试中达到最先进的多视角3D一致性水平，位列 WorldArena 榜首及 AgiBot-Challenge2026 第二名，并支持模型预测规划等下游应用。
AI.conclusion: PAIWorld 通过集成几何感知注意力、几何旋转位置编码和3D特征蒸馏，成功解决了多视角世界模型中的一致性问题，提升了机器人操作任务的性能。
AI.translation: 世界基础模型（WFMs）是强大的模拟器，但它们主要在单视角环境下运行，缺乏机器人操作所需的多视角3D一致性。虽然机器人系统依赖多摄像头（自我中心、手眼及腕部安装）进行策略学习，但现有的多视角世界模型仅仅是简单地拼接视角令牌，而缺乏显式的几何推理。这导致了跨视角的物体漂移、深度不一致和纹理错位。我们将这些失败归因于两个缺陷：缺乏显式的视角间通信机制和缺乏3D几何先验。我们认为同时解决这两者是必要且充分的。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 PAIWorld，这是一个通过三个核心组件增强扩散Transformer世界模型的框架：(1) 几何感知跨视角注意力模块，建立了跨视角的显式路径；(2) 几何旋转位置嵌入，将相机射线方向和外参姿态编码到注意力机制中；(3) Latent 3D-REPA，从冻结的3D基础模型中蒸馏出3D感知特征以确保3D一致性。基于 DiT 的世界基础模型，PAIWorld 在机器人操作基准测试中实现了最先进的多视角3D一致性，在 WorldArena 排行榜上排名第一，在 AgiBot-Challenge2026 排行榜上排名第二，同时支持模型预测规划、世界动作模型和多视角策略后训练等下游应用。
AI.summary: PAIWorld 是一款旨在解决机器人多视角操作中3D一致性问题的世界基础模型。它通过引入几何感知的跨视角注意力机制、几何旋转位置嵌入以及3D特征蒸馏，克服了传统模型缺乏几何推理导致的视角间不一致缺陷。
AI.keywords: 世界基础模型, 3D一致性, 机器人操作, 多视角学习, 几何推理
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将显式几何推理引入世界模型，解决了多视角机器人操作中的一致性难题，为构建更具空间感知能力的具身智能体提供了重要范式。其局限性可能在于对预训练3D基础模型的依赖。

title: Data-Forcing Distillation: Restoring Diversity and Fidelity in Few-Step Video Generation
summary: Recent progress has shown promise in distilling multi-step video diffusion models into efficient few-step students. Among them, Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) and its successor DMD2 achieved strong generation quality and fast convergence. However, due to the nature of the reverse Kullback--Leibler (KL) objective, these methods exhibit two persistent failure modes: a substantial drop in sample diversity, and visibly over-saturated outputs that deviate from real-video appearance. In this work, we propose Data-Forcing Distillation (DFD), a simple post-training framework that restores diversity and fidelity in DMD with only a single-line of code change. At its core is the teacher score discrepancy to guide the student toward the real-data distribution, pulling it to missing modes (mitigating mode collapse) and away from problematic modes absent in real data (avoiding over-saturation). We provide an in-depth theoretical analysis of our framework and validate our approach on text-to-video, image-to-video, and autoregressive video generation. With only 100--300 steps of finetuning, DFD effectively restores diversity and fidelity on both Wan2.1-1.3B and Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B model, resolving the over-saturation artifacts with significantly better video dynamics and appearance, and even outperforms the teacher model.

AI.title_translation: 数据驱动蒸馏：恢复少步视频生成的多样性与保真度
AI.tldr: 通过引入教师分数差异引导，DFD仅需单行代码修改即可解决视频蒸馏中的模式崩溃与过饱和问题，提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有视频扩散模型蒸馏方法（如DMD/DMD2）受限于反向KL散度目标，导致生成样本多样性下降以及输出画面过饱和，严重影响视频质量。
AI.method: 提出数据驱动蒸馏（Data-Forcing Distillation, DFD）框架，通过引入教师分数差异（teacher score discrepancy）作为引导，强制学生模型向真实数据分布对齐，从而修正模式崩溃并抑制过饱和现象。
AI.result: DFD在Wan2.1和Cosmos等模型上实现了有效的多样性与保真度恢复，仅需100-300步微调即可显著改善视频动态与外观，甚至在性能上超越了教师模型。
AI.conclusion: DFD通过引入教师分数差异引导学生模型，成功解决了视频扩散模型少步蒸馏中的多样性缺失与过饱和问题，为高效视频生成提供了稳健的解决方案。
AI.translation: 最近的研究表明，将多步视频扩散模型蒸馏为高效的少步学生模型前景广阔。其中，分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）及其后续版本DMD2在生成质量和收敛速度上表现优异。然而，由于反向Kullback-Leibler（KL）目标的特性，这些方法存在两个持续的失败模式：样本多样性大幅下降，以及明显偏离真实视频外观的过饱和输出。在本文中，我们提出了数据驱动蒸馏（DFD），这是一个简单的后训练框架，仅需修改一行代码即可恢复DMD中的多样性和保真度。其核心在于利用教师分数差异来引导学生模型趋向真实数据分布，将其拉向缺失的模式（缓解模式崩溃），并远离真实数据中不存在的问题模式（避免过饱和）。我们对该框架进行了深入的理论分析，并在文本到视频、图像到视频以及自回归视频生成任务上验证了我们的方法。仅需100-300步的微调，DFD即可有效恢复Wan2.1-1.3B和Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B模型的多样性和保真度，解决了过饱和伪影，实现了更好的视频动态和外观，甚至超越了教师模型。
AI.summary: 本文针对视频扩散模型少步蒸馏中的多样性丧失和过饱和问题，提出了数据驱动蒸馏（DFD）框架。通过利用教师分数差异引导学生模型，该方法不仅修复了生成缺陷，还显著提升了视频的动态效果和视觉保真度。
AI.keywords: 视频生成, 知识蒸馏, 模型多样性, 扩散模型, 数据驱动蒸馏
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种极简的后训练框架，仅需单行代码即可修正现有蒸馏方法（如DMD/DMD2）中存在的模式崩溃和过饱和问题。其创新点在于引入了教师分数差异（teacher score discrepancy）作为引导，不仅提升了生成质量，甚至在某些指标上超越了教师模型，具有很高的实用价值。

title: SC3-Eval: Evaluating Robot Foundation Models via Self-Consistent Video Generation
summary: Evaluating generalist robot manipulation policies in the real world is expensive, slow, and difficult to scale. Action-conditioned video world models offer a scalable alternative by simulating policy rollouts. Autoregressive rollouts accumulate compounding errors, observations across multiple camera views must remain mutually consistent, and the evaluator must generalize to policies whose behaviors lie outside the training distribution. We address these challenges with SC3-Eval, a self-consistent video generation recipe that adapts a pre-trained video foundation model into an accurate policy evaluator by enforcing three complementary forms of consistency. First, forward-inverse dynamics consistency jointly trains the model to predict frames from actions and to recover actions from frames, anchoring generated rollouts to a physically plausible action manifold and counteracting the drift a forward-only model cannot penalize. Second, cross-view consistency trains the model to inpaint each camera view from the other, keeping the multi-camera observation coherent over long rollouts without any explicit memory mechanism. Third, test-time consistency reuses the inverse dynamics mode at inference as a per-action-chunk uncertainty signal that terminates rollouts whose generated frames drift away from the requested actions. We also demonstrate SC3-Eval rollouts reproduce the failure modes that policies exhibit in real-world rollouts, supporting fine-grained diagnostic comparison rather than aggregate ranking alone. Across seven real-world vision-language-action policies, SC3-Eval attains a closed-loop Pearson correlation of $0.929$ and MMRV of $0.119$, outperforming three strong prior video-model-based baselines, and generalizes to new tasks.

title: PACT: Preserving Anchored Cores in Task-vectors for Model Merging
summary: Model merging has emerged as a training-free alternative to multi-task learning, aiming to combine multiple task-specific fine-tuned models into a single multi-task model. Most existing model merging approaches follow the Task Arithmetic paradigm, which decomposes fine-tuned weights into pre-trained parameters and task vectors, and performs merging exclusively in the task-vector space. The effectiveness of this paradigm implicitly relies on the assumption that task-specific knowledge is encoded solely within task vectors. We argue that this assumption generally does not hold due to the intrinsic task preferences of pre-trained models. Specifically, we identify \textbf{Load-Bearing Wall (LBW) dimensions}, namely some task-critical knowledge that remains embedded in the pre-trained weights rather than being fully transferred into task vectors. We characterize LBW dimensions from both scalar-weight and subspace perspectives, thereby covering the major paradigms of existing model merging methods. Our analysis reveals that, by ignoring LBW dimensions, task-vector-based approaches fail to fully resolve task conflicts and may inadvertently damage task-specific knowledge encoded in the pre-trained model, leading to degradation. To address this issue, we propose PACT, which preserves the anchored task-specific cores (i.e., LBW dimensions) within task vectors by aligning their orthogonal complements with the subspace of the pre-trained weights. These aligned subspace components are then removed from the task vectors before applying existing model merging algorithms. Furthermore, we develop an efficient variant based on randomized SVD to improve scalability. PACT can be seamlessly integrated with existing methods. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that PACT consistently enhances mainstream model merging approaches and establishes new state-of-the-art performance.

title: Bridging Single Distortion Artifacts and Multifactorial Clinical Quality: Few-shot Biparametric MRI Quality Assessment via Distortion-trained Prototypical Networks
summary: Clinical prostate multi-parametric MRI relies heavily on high-quality diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI), yet reading DWI is frequently compromised by geometric distortion, often caused by rectal air. Assessing quality via the PI-QUAL scoring system is an emerging clinical standard, but it is subjective, time-consuming and suffers from a class imbalance where low-quality cases are diverse and relatively scarce. Using the PRIME clinical trial as an example, there are $6\%$ images with PI-QUAL scores lower than 4, $87\%$ of DWI issues are due to distortion. Many of the other clinical quality issues are under-represented. To address this common dual-scarcity of annotated clinical data, we propose a few-shot biparametric prototypical network for automated image quality assessment (IQA). Our framework utilizes a dual-branch 3D ResNet to fuse T2-weighted and DWI features, providing anatomical context to distinguish true morphology from distortion. To handle real-world heterogeneity, we introduce feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM) and a gradient reversal layer (GRL) to align feature distributions conditioned on varying b-values while suppressing acquisition-related biases. We demonstrate that a model meta-trained solely on comparatively objective, readily obtainable distortion labels can effectively adapt to predicting complex, multi-factorial clinical quality scores such as PI-QUAL using only five representative samples. Experimental results on two datasets show that our method significantly outperforms few-shot learning baselines for this challenging IQA task, offering a practically feasible and data-efficient solution for standardizing prostate MRI quality control in clinical workflows.

AI.title_translation: 弥合单一畸变伪影与多因素临床质量：通过畸变训练的原型网络实现少样本双参数MRI质量评估
AI.tldr: 利用易获取的几何畸变数据进行元训练，通过原型网络实现少样本学习，从而解决了前列腺MRI临床质量评估中数据稀缺和标注困难的问题。
AI.motivation: 前列腺MRI的临床质量评估（如PI-QUAL）极其依赖高质量的DWI影像，但受直肠气体引起的几何畸变影响严重。且临床标注数据稀缺、类别严重失衡，导致现有的深度学习方法难以直接应用。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于双分支3D ResNet的少样本双参数原型网络，结合特征级线性调制（FiLM）和梯度反转层（GRL）来对齐不同b值的特征分布，并利用畸变标签进行元训练，随后通过五样本学习迁移至PI-QUAL质量评分任务。
AI.result: 在两个数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法在少样本质量评估任务中显著优于现有基准模型，仅需5个样本即可实现对复杂PI-QUAL评分的准确预测。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过少样本学习有效解决了前列腺MRI临床质量评估中的数据稀缺和类别不平衡问题，为临床工作流中的质量控制提供了一种高效、自动化的方案。
AI.translation: 临床前列腺多参数MRI严重依赖高质量的弥散加权成像（DWI），但DWI的判读常受直肠气体引起的几何畸变影响。通过PI-QUAL评分系统评估质量已成为新兴的临床标准，但其主观性强、耗时且存在类别不平衡问题（低质量病例多样且稀缺）。以PRIME临床试验为例，仅6%的图像PI-QUAL评分低于4分，且87%的DWI问题源于畸变。针对这种临床标注数据的双重稀缺性，我们提出了一种用于自动图像质量评估（IQA）的少样本双参数原型网络。我们的框架利用双分支3D ResNet融合T2加权和DWI特征，提供解剖学背景以区分真实形态与畸变。为处理现实世界的异质性，我们引入了特征级线性调制（FiLM）和梯度反转层（GRL），以在不同b值条件下对齐特征分布，并抑制采集相关的偏差。我们证明，仅在相对客观、易获取的畸变标签上进行元训练的模型，能够有效地仅使用5个代表性样本，适应预测PI-QUAL等复杂的多因素临床质量评分。在两个数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的方法在该挑战性IQA任务中显著优于少样本学习基准，为临床工作流中的前列腺MRI质量控制提供了一种实用且数据高效的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对前列腺多参数MRI的少样本质量评估框架。通过利用容易获得的几何畸变标签进行元训练，并结合双分支3D ResNet、FiLM和GRL技术，该模型能够有效融合T2加权和DWI特征，仅需少量标注样本即可实现对复杂临床质量评分（PI-QUAL）的准确预测，解决了数据稀缺和标注不平衡的难题。
AI.keywords: 前列腺MRI, 图像质量评估, 少样本学习, 几何畸变, 临床质量标准
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将单一的几何畸变标签作为预训练目标，利用原型网络（Prototypical Networks）的少样本学习能力，成功跨越到更复杂、标注稀缺的临床质量评估（PI-QUAL）。这种“以易获数据辅助难获数据”的思路在医学影像领域具有很高的实用价值。

title: ESBMC-GraphPLC: Formal Verification of Graphical PLCopen XML Ladder Diagram Programs Using SMT-Based Model Checking
summary: PLCopen XML defines two encoding formats for IEC 61131-3 Ladder Diagram programs: a textual encoding using <rung> elements, and a graphical encoding that represents rung logic as a directed graph of localId/refLocalId connections. ESBMC-PLC supported the textual format but parsed graphical exports from CONTROLLINO, Beremiz, and OpenPLC Editor into an empty GOTO intermediate representation, causing vacuous verification success. This paper presents ESBMC-GraphPLC, which closes this gap with a DFS-based graphical LD resolver. The resolver traverses the connection graph from leftPowerRail to each coil, extracts rung paths as Boolean contact conjunctions, and applies a three-tier I/O inference scheme. Ordering coils by rightPowerRail connectionPointIn sequence ensures SET coils process before RESET coils, matching IEC scan-cycle semantics. The graphical-to-IR conversion leaves the ESBMC backend unchanged. Validation on 3 graphical LD programs from CONTROLLINO/OpenPLC Editor shows all produce full GOTO IR with nondeterministic inputs and rung logic, versus the empty IR previously. All 3 verify SAFE at k=2 under 70ms. The 11 textual LD benchmarks are fully preserved, with no regression. Two Beremiz examples with no LD content or unsupported timer semantics are reported as discovered limitations. Artifact at Zenodo (DantasCordeiro2026graphical, doi:10.5281/zenodo.20699856).

AI.title_translation: ESBMC-GraphPLC：使用基于SMT的模型检测对图形化PLCopen XML梯形图程序进行形式化验证
AI.tldr: ESBMC-GraphPLC通过引入图形解析器，使ESBMC能够正确解析并验证图形化PLCopen XML梯形图程序，解决了此前无法处理图形化逻辑的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有的ESBMC-PLC工具无法解析图形化PLCopen XML格式（导致空中间表示和虚假的验证成功），迫切需要一种方法来支持图形化梯形图的形式化验证。
AI.method: 开发了一个基于DFS（深度优先搜索）的图形解析器，通过遍历从左电源轨到线圈的连接图，提取梯形图路径，并应用三层I/O推理方案，最后根据IEC扫描周期语义对线圈进行排序。
AI.result: 在测试集上成功将图形化LD程序转换为完整的GOTO中间表示，验证时间小于70ms，且对原有的文本格式基准测试无性能回归。
AI.conclusion: ESBMC-GraphPLC成功实现了从图形化梯形图到GOTO中间表示的转换，在保持原有文本格式验证能力的同时，扩展了对图形化程序的形式化验证能力，且验证效率高。
AI.translation: PLCopen XML定义了两种IEC 61131-3梯形图程序的编码格式：使用<rung>元素的文本编码，以及将梯级逻辑表示为localId/refLocalId连接有向图的图形编码。ESBMC-PLC支持文本格式，但在解析来自CONTROLLINO、Beremiz和OpenPLC Editor的图形导出文件时，会产生空的GOTO中间表示，导致虚假的验证成功。本文提出了ESBMC-GraphPLC，通过基于DFS的图形LD解析器填补了这一空白。该解析器从左电源轨遍历连接图到每个线圈，提取梯级路径作为布尔触点合取，并应用三层I/O推理方案。通过按右电源轨connectionPointIn顺序对线圈进行排序，确保置位（SET）线圈在复位（RESET）线圈之前处理，符合IEC扫描周期语义。图形到IR的转换保持了ESBMC后端的完整性。在3个来自CONTROLLINO/OpenPLC Editor的图形化LD程序上的验证表明，所有程序都能产生完整的GOTO IR，包含非确定性输入和梯级逻辑，而此前则为空。所有3个程序在k=2且70ms内验证为SAFE。11个文本LD基准测试被完全保留，没有回归。报告了两个关于Beremiz示例的局限性，即无LD内容或不支持定时器语义。工件已在Zenodo发布。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ESBMC-GraphPLC，这是一种针对PLCopen XML图形化梯形图的解析器。它通过DFS遍历连接图并应用I/O推理，将图形化逻辑转换为SMT求解器可识别的中间表示，从而解决了以往图形化程序无法被正确验证的问题。
AI.keywords: PLCopen XML, 梯形图, 形式化验证, SMT模型检测, ESBMC
AI.comments: 该研究有效填补了ESBMC在处理图形化PLCopen XML梯形图方面的空白，通过引入基于DFS的图形解析器，使得形式化验证工具能够支持实际工业场景中的图形化逻辑，具有很高的实用价值。局限性在于对特定定时器语义的支持尚显不足。

title: Essential Subspace Merging for Multi-Task Learning
summary: Model merging aims to enable multi-task learning by integrating the capabilities of multiple models fine-tuned from the same pre-trained checkpoint into a single model. Its core challenge is inter-task interference among task-specific parameter updates. In this paper, we analyze the output shifts induced by task updates and observe that their energy is concentrated in a small number of principal directions. We call the subspace spanned by these directions the essential subspace. In contrast, most remaining directions carry little task-relevant energy, but their accumulation across multiple task updates can cause severe interference during merging. Motivated by this observation, we propose Essential Subspace Decomposition (ESD), which decomposes each task update according to the principal components of its activation shift. Based on ESD, we introduce Essential Subspace Merging (ESM), a training-free static merging method that orthogonalizes and fuses essential components into one compact multi-task model. We further extend ESM to ESM++, a training-free dynamic merging method that decomposes task-specific residuals into low-rank experts and selects the most relevant expert through prototype-based routing during forward inference. Extensive experiments across multiple task sets and model scales demonstrate that ESM and ESM++ effectively preserves task knowledge while reducing inter-task interference. Code is available at https://github.com/kiddo127/ESM.

AI.title_translation: 用于多任务学习的本质子空间合并
AI.tldr: 通过识别并正交化模型更新中的“本质子空间”，该论文提出了一种无需训练即可高效合并多个任务模型的方法，有效解决了任务间的干扰问题。
AI.motivation: 解决多模型合并过程中任务间参数更新产生的严重干扰问题，旨在将多个微调模型的能力高效融合为单一模型。
AI.method: 提出本质子空间分解 (ESD) 技术，识别任务更新中的主成分；基于此开发了 ESM（静态合并）和 ESM++（动态专家路由）两种无需训练的合并方法。
AI.result: 实验证明 ESM 和 ESM++ 在多个任务集和不同模型规模上，均能有效保持任务知识并显著降低任务间的干扰。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出的ESM和ESM++方法通过分解任务更新的本质子空间，成功实现了高效、低干扰的多任务模型合并，为模型集成提供了一种新颖且有效的范式。
AI.translation: 模型合并旨在通过将从同一预训练检查点微调的多个模型的能力整合到一个模型中，来实现多任务学习。其核心挑战在于任务特定参数更新之间的相互干扰。在本文中，我们分析了任务更新引起的输出偏移，并观察到其能量集中在少数几个主方向上。我们将由这些方向组成的子空间称为本质子空间。相比之下，其余大多数方向承载的任务相关能量很少，但它们在多个任务更新中的积累会导致合并过程中严重的干扰。基于这一观察，我们提出了本质子空间分解（ESD），根据激活偏移的主成分对每个任务更新进行分解。基于 ESD，我们引入了本质子空间合并（ESM），这是一种无需训练的静态合并方法，它将本质组件正交化并融合为一个紧凑的多任务模型。我们进一步将 ESM 扩展为 ESM++，这是一种无需训练的动态合并方法，它将任务特定的残差分解为低秩专家，并通过前向推理期间基于原型的路由选择最相关的专家。在多个任务集和模型规模上的广泛实验表明，ESM 和 ESM++ 在保留任务知识的同时有效地减少了任务间的干扰。代码可在 https://github.com/kiddo127/ESM 获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对模型合并中的任务干扰问题，提出了一种基于本质子空间分解（ESD）的方法。通过识别和正交化任务更新中的关键方向，作者开发了静态合并方法 ESM 和动态路由方法 ESM++，实现了在无需额外训练的情况下高效融合多任务模型。
AI.keywords: 模型合并, 多任务学习, 本质子空间分解, 参数干扰, 权重融合
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地将模型合并问题转化为对“本质子空间”的分析，通过识别并正交化任务更新中的关键方向，有效解决了多任务干扰问题。其无需训练的特性使其在计算资源受限的情况下具有很高的实用价值。

title: MortarBench: Evaluating Mortgage Loan Origination Agents
summary: Loan origination is the process by which a lender creates a new loan, from application and underwriting through approval and funding. This process serves a critical role in evaluating the eligibility and level of risk posed by an applicant. Recently, firms have begun using mortgage loan agents to augment human loan officers, despite a lack of any public benchmark. To fill this gap, we present MortarBench, a loan origination agent benchmark. MortarBench uses a financial data synthesis and mutation pipeline to generate examples with broad edge case coverage that match real-world distributions and questions. We find that state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) perform poorly, with closed-source models achieving at most 77.1\% exact match accuracy. We also discover systematic biases in LLM perception of foreignness related to non-English names. Noting these weaknesses, we introduce CRIT, a confidence calibration framework. Our method increases accuracy to 80.5\% while improving risk management steering and reducing bias.

title: SEAGAN: domain-Specific and Edge-Aware Graph Attention Network for Dynamic Plant Processes
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) offer a flexible framework for learning from scientific data with physical, biological, or functional associations. One promising domain is plant physiology, where observed responses result from several interacting processes that are difficult to isolate, even with human intervention. A key example is the A-Ci curve, which relates the net CO2 assimilation rate (Anet) to leaf intercellular CO2 concentration (Ci) and is also used to estimate photosynthetic parameters in biophysical models. However, accurate estimation requires accurate identification of the active biochemical limiting state at each curve point, which is a major source of uncertainty. Here, we express the limitation-state identification in A-Ci curves as a graph-based node classification problem. A graph representation of the A-Ci curve is created using distance-based k-nearest-neighbor (kNN) and auxiliary-signal-guided (ASG) connectivity. The methodology was evaluated against the conventional machine learning baselines, graph-based architectures, and an automated fitting-based benchmark. Results on a large synthetic dataset with known ground-truth limitation states show that graph-based models improve classification, especially near biochemical transition areas. The top-performing configuration, SEAGAN (domain-Specific and Edge-Aware Graph Attention Network for Dynamic Plant Processes), integrates process-aware node features, edge attributes, kNN connectivity, and graph attention with a weighted cross-entropy loss, obtaining an F1-score of 0.857 and accuracy of 0.882. The results suggest that using A-Ci curves as graphs enables better identification of the biochemical limiting condition and reduces the uncertainty associated with both human and automated methods.

title: Light-weight Pronunciation Assessment via Discrete Speech Token Surprisal
summary: Training automated pronunciation assessment often relies on labeled learner errors or non-native corpora that are costly to collect. We propose a lightweight framework trained only on native speech resources, operating unsupervised or lightly calibrated with a small set of scored utterances. At inference, learner speech is discretized with an SSL encoder and a K-means codebook. A token language model trained on native sequences computes surprisal where higher surprisal indicates phonotactic deviation. We add a transcript-guided Text2DUnit--DTW module that predicts native token sequences from reference text and aligns them to acoustic tokens to derive error-sensitive features. Surprisal and alignment features are fused via simple regression. On SpeechOcean762, PCC improves from 0.60 to 0.66 with transcript guidance, near supervised baselines. Cross-dataset evaluation on L2-ARCTIC shows consistent gains.

AI.title_translation: 基于离散语音Token惊奇度的轻量级发音评估
AI.tldr: 提出了一种仅需原生语音训练的轻量级发音评估方法，通过离散语音Token的惊奇度与文本对齐特征，实现了高效的非母语发音质量检测。
AI.motivation: 自动发音评估通常依赖昂贵的标注错误数据或非母语语料库，本文旨在开发一种仅需原生语音资源、无需或仅需少量标注即可训练的轻量级评估框架。
AI.method: 1. 使用SSL编码器和K-means码本将语音离散化；2. 训练原生语音Token语言模型计算惊奇度以识别语音偏差；3. 引入Text2DUnit-DTW模块，将参考文本转化为原生Token序列并与声学Token对齐；4. 将惊奇度特征与对齐特征通过简单回归模型融合。
AI.result: 在SpeechOcean762数据集上，PCC（皮尔逊相关系数）从0.60提升至0.66，接近监督学习基准；在L2-ARCTIC数据集上的交叉评估也显示了稳定的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种轻量级、无需大量标注数据的发音评估框架。实验证明，利用原生语音训练的惊奇度与文本引导的对齐特征相结合，能有效检测非母语发音错误，并在多个数据集上表现出优于现有基准的性能。
AI.translation: 自动发音评估的训练通常依赖于昂贵的标注学习者错误数据或非母语语料库。我们提出了一种仅在原生语音资源上训练的轻量级框架，该框架可无监督运行或通过少量打分话语进行轻度校准。在推理阶段，学习者的语音通过SSL编码器和K-means码本进行离散化。在原生序列上训练的Token语言模型计算惊奇度，其中较高的惊奇度表示音位偏差。我们添加了一个转录引导的Text2DUnit-DTW模块，从参考文本预测原生Token序列，并将其与声学Token对齐以导出错误敏感特征。惊奇度特征和对齐特征通过简单回归融合。在SpeechOcean762上，引入转录引导后，PCC从0.60提高到0.66，接近监督学习基准。在L2-ARCTIC上的跨数据集评估显示了持续的性能提升。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于离散语音Token惊奇度的轻量级发音评估框架。该方法仅需原生语音训练，通过计算语音序列的惊奇度并结合文本引导的对齐特征，能够有效评估发音质量，在减少标注需求的同时实现了与监督学习方法相当的评估表现。
AI.keywords: 发音评估, 自监督学习, 离散语音Token, 惊奇度, 无监督学习
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于利用自监督学习（SSL）生成的离散语音Token及其惊奇度（surprisal）来评估发音，摆脱了对大规模标注语音数据的依赖。这种方法在资源受限场景下极具实用价值，通过将文本引导的对齐特征与惊奇度结合，在保持轻量化的同时达到了接近监督学习基准的效果。

title: BIM-Edit: Benchmarking Large Language Models for IFC-Based Building Information Modeling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to computer-aided design (CAD) to generate design artifacts from textual instructions. In engineering practice, this requires more than creating new geometry, models must also understand existing scenes, edit them correctly, and preserve semantics and relations. However, many CAD benchmarks focus on creating new models rather than editing existing ones, and mostly evaluate geometric correctness. We introduce BIM-Edit, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on natural-language editing of Building Information Models (BIM) represented in the Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) format. BIM provides a challenging testbed because building models encode geometry together with semantic and relational structure. BIM-Edit contains 324 editing tasks spanning 11 realistic building models and 36 synthetic scenes. Tasks are expressed using three instruction categories - direct, spatial, and topological - covering both explicit and scene-grounded edits. We evaluate outputs along three dimensions: geometric accuracy, semantic validity, and topological consistency. Across evaluated LLMs, the best-performing model achieves only 49.5% average score across the three metrics, and no model fully solves more than 3.4% of tasks. These results demonstrate a substantial gap between current LLM capabilities and the requirements of structured engineering design workflows.

title: HilDA: Hierarchical Distillation with Diffusion for Advancing Self-Supervised LiDAR Pre-training
comments: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Maciej and Jesper contributed equally
summary: Leveraging Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) for camera-to-LiDAR knowledge distillation offers a promising solution to the scarcity of annotated data needed to represent the immense geometric and kinematic diversity of real-world autonomous driving (AD). However, current approaches typically treat VFMs as black-box teachers, relying exclusively on frame-wise feature similarity. Consequently, they do not fully exploit the teacher's layer-wise semantic structure and global context, as well as the rich spatiotemporal information inherent in LiDAR sequences. We propose HilDA, a self-supervised pretraining framework for LiDAR backbones that better captures the semantic what and geometric where needed for driving tasks. HilDA combines hierarchical distillation comprising multi-layer distillation for progressive semantic alignment and global context distillation for scene-level semantics, with a temporal occupancy diffusion objective promoting spatiotemporal consistency. Models pre-trained with HilDA achieve state-of-the-art results on cross-modal distillation benchmarks and outperform models trained via prior distillation approaches on 3D object detection, scene flow, and semantic occupancy prediction. Code available at: https://maxiuw.github.io/hilda.

title: Repeated Shared Access Enables Grokking, but Edit Propagation Depends on an Addressable Memory
summary: We study factual edit propagation in a controlled synthetic knowledge-graph QA setting using a 2x2 grid that crosses loop recurrence with shared-memory access: a dense transformer (Dense), a looped transformer (Loop), a dense backbone with shared memory (Dense+Mem), and a looped backbone with shared memory (loop-memory coupling, LMC). The two factors dissociate. For learning, both routes to repeated shared access -- looped recomputation and repeated memory rereading -- cross the out-of-distribution (OOD) grokking barrier that Dense fails, so repeated shared access is the behavioral regularity, not a specific architecture. For editing, the substrates split along a different axis: applying a single localized factual edit (conditioned on direct success) and measuring 2-hop propagation on a shared pre-edit-correct set, the edit propagates strongly in both memory-bearing cells (LMC 0.78-0.92, Dense+Mem 0.71-0.96) and only weakly in the memory-free ones (Loop 0.04-0.30, Dense 0.00-0.03). The split is along the memory axis, not the loop axis: every memory-bearing seed exceeds every memory-free seed, with no detectable difference between the two memory cells. Crucially Dense+Mem has no recurrence, so the propagating ingredient is an addressable site that an edit can write to and later computation rereads, not loop recomputation; Loop is at best a partial intermediate. The affordance survives coarsening the store (N=128 to N=13): propagation attenuates but the memory/no-memory split persists, so fine granularity buys precision rather than the affordance itself. These results dissociate learning competence from editing affordance -- repeated shared access suffices to grok, but edit propagation depends on whether the substrate exposes an addressable memory that the forward computation can write to and later reread, an affordance that loop recurrence provides only partially.

AI.title_translation: 重复共享访问实现Grokking，但编辑传播依赖于可寻址内存
AI.tldr: Grokking只需要重复的共享访问（循环或记忆），但高效的知识编辑必须依赖于可寻址的内存存储。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究模型实现Grokking（从泛化到过拟合的跨越）与实现高效事实编辑（Edit Propagation）在架构机制上的差异与联系。
AI.method: 构建了一个受控的合成知识图谱问答环境，通过对比四种架构（Dense, Loop, Dense+Mem, LMC），分析循环递归与共享内存对模型Grokking和事实编辑传播的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现重复的共享访问（无论是通过循环重计算还是重复读取内存）是实现Grokking的关键；而事实编辑的传播则完全依赖于可寻址的存储器，与循环递归无直接关系。即使在内存粒度降低的情况下，内存与非内存架构之间的差异依然显著。
AI.conclusion: 学习能力主要依赖于重复的共享访问（无论是循环还是记忆），而知识编辑的有效传播则必须依赖于可寻址的存储器，与循环递归无关。
AI.translation: 我们通过一个受控的合成知识图谱问答环境研究了事实编辑的传播，该环境通过循环递归与共享内存访问的2x2组合进行了实验：密集Transformer（Dense）、循环Transformer（Loop）、带共享内存的密集骨干（Dense+Mem）以及带共享内存的循环骨干（LMC）。这两个因素是解耦的。在学习方面，实现重复共享访问的两种路径——循环重计算和重复内存重读——都跨越了Dense模型无法跨越的分布外（OOD）Grokking障碍，因此重复共享访问是行为规律，而非特定架构的属性。在编辑方面，基质沿着不同的轴分裂：应用单一局部事实编辑并测量2跳传播时，编辑在两个带内存的单元中传播强烈，而在无内存单元中传播微弱。这种分裂是沿着内存轴而非循环轴进行的。关键在于，Dense+Mem没有递归，因此传播的关键因素是可寻址站点，而不是循环重计算。即使在降低存储粒度后，内存/无内存的分裂依然存在。这些结果将学习能力与编辑能力分离开来：重复共享访问足以实现Grokking，但编辑传播取决于基质是否暴露了可寻址内存。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了模型在知识图谱问答任务中实现Grokking与知识编辑的架构需求。研究表明，虽然循环递归和共享内存都能促进Grokking，但只有具备可寻址内存的架构才能有效传播事实编辑，循环本身并非编辑传播的核心驱动力。
AI.keywords: Grokking, 知识编辑, 共享内存, Transformer, 递归
AI.comments: 该研究通过受控实验清晰地分离了模型“学习（Grokking）”与“知识编辑（Edit Propagation）”所需的机制，指出了模型理解与模型可修改性之间的架构差异，对理解大语言模型的内部机制具有重要的理论指导意义。

title: Stochastic Signed Distance Processes
summary: Multi-view surface reconstruction is a core problem in computer vision. One prominent line of work represents the surface implicitly as a signed distance field (SDF), optimizing it based on the photometric loss between rendered and observed pixel colors. These approaches typically employ SDF-based volume rendering to obtain a differentiable relaxation of discontinuous visibility along rays, thereby reducing reliance on silhouette supervision. In this paper, we reformulate SDF-based volume rendering as probabilistic surface rendering, where each pixel color is modeled as a mixture distribution induced by the random first ray-surface intersection. To this end, we introduce Stochastic Signed Distance Processes (SSDP), which model the SDF along each ray as a stochastic process, inducing a first-passage-time distribution for each ray. We then derive the first-passage probability for each sampling interval based on Bayesian filtering, together with its practical approximation for parallel rendering. We further show that NeuS, an existing SDF-based volume rendering method, arises as a special case of our formulation. Experiments on the DTU and MobileBrick datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms baselines in both surface reconstruction and uncertainty quantification, supporting the effectiveness of our first-passage formulation. Our code is available at https://github.com/skmhrk1209/SSDP.

AI.title_translation: 随机符号距离过程
AI.tldr: 通过将SDF建模为随机过程，提出了一种更具统计严谨性的多视图表面重构框架，并在重构精度和不确定性量化上取得了优异表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于SDF的体渲染方法虽然有效，但缺乏严谨的概率建模，且对射线与表面相交的建模存在局限性，特别是在处理不确定性和复杂几何场景时。
AI.method: 提出随机符号距离过程（SSDP），将射线上的SDF建模为随机过程，利用首通时间（first-passage-time）分布描述射线与表面的相交，并结合贝叶斯滤波推导采样区间的相交概率。
AI.result: 在DTU和MobileBrick数据集上的实验表明，SSDP在表面重构精度和不确定性量化方面均优于现有基线方法，且证明了NeuS是该方法的一个特例。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的SSDP框架通过引入随机过程和首通时间分布，为多视图表面重构提供了一个更严谨的概率建模框架，并在基准测试中证明了其在重构质量和不确定性预测方面的优越性。
AI.translation: 多视图表面重构是计算机视觉中的一个核心问题。一种突出的研究方向是将表面隐式表示为符号距离场 (SDF)，并根据渲染像素颜色与观测像素颜色之间的光度损失进行优化。这些方法通常采用基于SDF的体渲染来获得沿射线的不连续可见性的可微松弛，从而减少对轮廓监督的依赖。在本文中，我们将基于SDF的体渲染重新表述为概率表面渲染，其中每个像素颜色被建模为由随机的首条射线-表面交点引起的混合分布。为此，我们引入了随机符号距离过程 (SSDP)，它将每条射线上的SDF建模为随机过程，为每条射线诱导出一个首通时间分布。然后，我们基于贝叶斯滤波推导了每个采样区间的首通概率，并给出了其在并行渲染中的实用近似。我们进一步证明了现有的基于SDF的体渲染方法 NeuS 是我们公式的一个特例。在 DTU 和 MobileBrick 数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法在表面重构和不确定性量化方面均优于基线方法，支持了我们首通公式的有效性。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/skmhrk1209/SSDP 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为随机符号距离过程（SSDP）的新方法，通过将SDF建模为随机过程来重新定义多视图表面重构中的体渲染过程。该方法利用首通时间分布和贝叶斯滤波来计算像素颜色，不仅在理论上涵盖了NeuS等现有方法，还在实验中展现了更优的重构效果和不确定性估计能力。
AI.keywords: 多视图表面重构, 符号距离场 (SDF), 随机过程, 体渲染, 贝叶斯滤波
AI.comments: 该论文通过概率论视角重新审视了SDF体渲染，将确定性的渲染过程转化为随机过程，不仅在理论上统一了现有的NeuS方法，还通过引入贝叶斯滤波实现了更稳健的表面重构和不确定性量化。这是一个在隐式表面建模领域具有深厚数学基础的创新。

title: Grouped Query Experts: Mixture-of-Experts on GQA Self-Attention
summary: Self-attention is central to Transformer performance and is often the most expensive part of the Transformer at long context lengths because its pairwise token interactions scale quadratically with sequence length. Standard dense attention also applies the same set of attention heads to every token regardless of token difficulty or information content. This uniform activation can waste compute, especially as sequences grow longer and attention cost increases rapidly. We propose Grouped Query Experts (GQE), a mixture-of-experts layer on top of grouped-query attention (GQA). Within each GQA group, a router selects k query-head experts per token while all key-value (KV) heads remain dense and unchanged. Thus, GQE keeps the KV cache benefits of GQA and reduces only the active query-head computation. On a fixed 30B token budget at the 250M parameter scale, GQE matches the all-active GQA baseline in downstream accuracy while activating half the query heads per token.

title: OxyMake: A Formally-Specified, Content-Addressable Workflow Engine
comments: 38 pages, 3 figures. Source code: https://github.com/noogram/oxymake. Documentation: https://oxymake.noogram.dev
summary: Make-lineage workflow runners decide whether a job must re-run from file-modification time (mtime, a timestamp) -- a broken proxy for the question that matters: did the content change? A git checkout, a tree copy, or a backup restore rewrites mtimes without touching content, forcing spurious re-execution; and in the reverse case -- when an output looks newer than its inputs but its content is stale -- the stale output is silently reused. (Snakemake 7's per-output provenance survives this churn, as local bookkeeping; GNU Make and pure-mtime fast paths are where it bites.) OxyMake, a single-binary Rust workflow engine, replaces the proxy with a content-addressed cache key: a BLAKE3 hash of rule source, input content, parameters, environment, and platform. Because the key is a pure function of these declared inputs, the caching decision survives mtime churn and travels across same-platform machines and shared caches. Phantom re-runs vanish for declared inputs (no sandbox: an undeclared input is invisible to the key). The spec stays declarative and statically parseable, keeping the Make rule model so Snakemake pipelines port directly. DAG resolution is an order of magnitude faster than Snakemake's on large graphs, but a cold end-to-end run is slower -- the price of content-addressed bookkeeping -- repaid several-fold on the warm re-run that caching exists to serve (exact figures, hardware, and a bundled reproducer are in the evaluation). Execution is daemon-free via a cooperative claim/reclaim protocol (sessions claim jobs, reclaiming stalled ones); today two sessions duplicate work safely rather than coordinate, and wiring the protocol as a hard execution gate is staged, not yet done. Cross-session safety is specified in TLA+ and model-checked over all interleavings for 2-3 sessions, assuming atomic state commits. A plan-of-record lockfile and NDJSON event stream record exactly what ran.

AI.title_translation: OxyMake：一种经过形式化说明的内容寻址工作流引擎
AI.tldr: OxyMake 通过基于内容的哈希校验取代了脆弱的时间戳判断，彻底解决了工作流中不必要的任务重运行问题，并利用形式化方法确保了并发执行的安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有工作流引擎（如GNU Make、Snakemake）依赖文件修改时间（mtime）作为判断任务是否需要重运行的代理指标，但这会导致由于mtime变更引起的虚假重运行，或因内容更新未反映在mtime上导致的错误缓存。
AI.method: 使用BLAKE3哈希对规则源码、输入内容、参数、环境和平台进行内容寻址缓存键生成；采用Rust语言编写单二进制程序；利用TLA+对跨会话安全性进行建模和模型检测；通过合作式声明/回收协议处理并发执行。
AI.result: OxyMake 消除了基于mtime的虚假重运行；在大规模图处理中，DAG解析速度比Snakemake快一个数量级；通过内容寻址实现了高效的缓存复用，且通过TLA+验证确保了多会话执行的安全性。
AI.conclusion: OxyMake 成功利用内容寻址机制替代了传统的时间戳判断，在保证工作流执行正确性的同时，显著减少了虚假重运行，并通过形式化验证确保了多会话执行的安全性。
AI.translation: 基于 Make 的工作流运行器通常根据文件修改时间（mtime，即时间戳）来决定作业是否需要重新运行——但这对于真正关心的问题（内容是否改变？）来说是一个糟糕的代理。Git 检出、树拷贝或备份恢复会重写 mtime 而不改变内容，从而导致虚假的重新执行；而在相反的情况下——当输出看起来比输入更新，但其内容已经过时时——过时的输出会被静默重用。（Snakemake 7 的逐个输出溯源作为本地簿记避免了这种混乱，但 GNU Make 和纯 mtime 的快速路径却深受其害。）OxyMake 是一款单二进制的 Rust 工作流引擎，它用内容寻址的缓存键替换了上述代理：即规则源码、输入内容、参数、环境和平台的 BLAKE3 哈希。由于该键是这些已声明输入的纯函数，缓存决策可以抵御 mtime 的变动，并能在相同平台的机器和共享缓存之间迁移。对于已声明的输入，幻影重运行消失了（无沙箱：未声明的输入对键不可见）。其规范保持声明式且可静态解析，保留了 Make 规则模型，以便 Snakemake 管道可以直接移植。在大规模图上，DAG 解析速度比 Snakemake 快一个数量级，但冷启动的全流程运行速度较慢——这是内容寻址簿记的代价——但在缓存旨在服务的热重运行中，这一代价得到了数倍的回报（确切数据、硬件和捆绑的复现器在评估部分中提供）。执行过程通过合作式的声明/回收协议实现，无需守护进程（会话声明作业，回收停滞的作业）；目前两个会话安全地重复工作而不是协调，将该协议作为硬执行门控的方案已在计划中，尚未完成。跨会话安全性已在 TLA+ 中进行说明，并假设原子状态提交，对 2-3 个会话的所有交织情况进行了模型检查。一个计划记录锁文件和 NDJSON 事件流记录了运行的每一个细节。
AI.summary: OxyMake 是一款基于 Rust 开发的、具备形式化说明的内容寻址工作流引擎。它通过使用基于输入内容和环境参数的加密哈希（BLAKE3）替代传统的修改时间戳，解决了工作流执行中的虚假重运行问题，并支持跨机器的缓存共享。该系统通过 TLA+ 验证了并发执行的安全性，并在大规模工作流中表现出更优的执行效率。
AI.keywords: 工作流引擎, 内容寻址, 缓存机制, 形式化验证, Rust
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将基于内容寻址的缓存机制引入工作流引擎，有效解决了传统基于时间戳（mtime）判断导致的不必要重运行或错误缓存问题。其采用Rust实现并结合TLA+进行形式化验证，展现了在工程实践中平衡性能与正确性的严谨态度。

title: Sakana Fugu Technical Report
summary: The capabilities of frontier Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to advance, with different providers increasingly specializing in distinct domains. This raises a natural next objective: how to combine the individual specializations of various LLMs into a collectively intelligent system. To this end, we report the development of Sakana Fugu, a family of orchestrator models that harness and amplify the capabilities of an LLM agent team. Fugu models are themselves language models trained to understand user queries and dynamically devise agentic scaffolds to solve them. Through these adaptive scaffolds, Fugu accesses performance beyond any individual LLM agent, achieving state-of-the-art results compared to other publicly accessible models across a range of challenging tasks, including SWE-Bench Pro, Terminal Bench, LiveCodeBench, GPQA-Diamond, Humanity's Last Exam, and CharXiv Reasoning. We release two models: Fugu, which balances performance with latency for everyday use, and Fugu-Ultra, which prioritizes answer quality on the hardest problems. We describe our training paradigm, which encompasses large-scale fine-tuning, evolutionary algorithms, and reinforcement learning approaches, along with the infrastructure and core design principles that turn these methods into a production system. We hope this report encourages further research into multi-agent systems and dynamic, query-adaptive agentic scaffolds as a path toward the next frontier of AI capabilities, accessed through collective intelligence.

AI.title_translation: Sakana Fugu 技术报告
AI.tldr: Sakana Fugu 是一种能够动态协调多个大模型协同工作的编排系统，通过智能体框架实现集体智能，在多项复杂任务中表现卓越。
AI.motivation: 随着不同大模型在不同领域展现出专门化能力，如何将这些独立的模型优势整合为一个具备集体智能的系统成为当前的研究核心目标。
AI.method: 开发了一系列名为 Sakana Fugu 的编排模型，通过大规模微调、进化算法和强化学习进行训练，使其能够理解用户查询并动态设计智能体框架，从而协调不同的 LLM 完成任务。
AI.result: Fugu 和 Fugu-Ultra 模型在 SWE-Bench Pro、Terminal Bench、GPQA-Diamond 等多个极具挑战性的基准测试中达到了行业领先水平，实现了超越单一 LLM 智能体的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: Sakana Fugu 展示了一种通过动态、查询自适应的智能体框架整合不同大模型能力的高效途径，为实现更高级的集体智能提供了新的研究范式。
AI.translation: 前沿大语言模型（LLM）的能力持续提升，且不同提供商在特定领域日益专业化。这引出了一个自然的后续目标：如何将各个 LLM 的个人专长组合成一个集体智能系统。为此，我们报告了 Sakana Fugu 的开发，这是一系列能够利用并放大 LLM 智能体团队能力的编排模型。Fugu 模型本身是经过训练的语言模型，能够理解用户查询并动态设计智能体框架来解决问题。通过这些自适应框架，Fugu 实现了超越任何单一 LLM 智能体的性能，在包括 SWE-Bench Pro、Terminal Bench、LiveCodeBench、GPQA-Diamond、Humanity's Last Exam 和 CharXiv Reasoning 在内的一系列挑战性任务中，相比其他公开模型取得了最先进的结果。我们发布了两个模型：Fugu（平衡了性能与延迟，适合日常使用）和 Fugu-Ultra（优先考虑最困难问题的答案质量）。我们描述了我们的训练范式，其中包括大规模微调、进化算法和强化学习方法，以及将这些方法转化为生产系统的基础设施和核心设计原则。我们希望这份报告能鼓励对多智能体系统和动态、查询自适应智能体框架的进一步研究，将其作为通往 AI 能力新前沿的路径，通过集体智能来实现。
AI.summary: Sakana Fugu 是一系列旨在整合多个 LLM 专长的编排模型。该系统通过动态生成任务自适应的智能体框架，实现了比单一模型更强大的性能，并在多项复杂基准测试中表现出色，为多智能体系统的协作提供了新的技术路径。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 多智能体系统, 集体智能, 动态智能体框架, 编排模型
AI.comments: 该论文提出了利用“编排模型”（orchestrator models）来动态构建智能体框架的创新思路，将多个大模型的专长整合以实现集体智能。这种方法在处理复杂任务时表现出极强的适应性，是多智能体协作领域的重要进展。局限性在于未详细说明在极端资源受限环境下的具体部署开销。

title: Topological Neural Dynamics: A Neuron-wise Framework for Sequence Modeling
comments: The experiments have some errors regarding model accuracy and need to be updated
summary: Existing sequence models, including RNNs, LSTMs, continuous-time networks, and Transformers, share a common structural principle: layer-wise dynamics, where all neurons in the same layer co-evolve through a shared parameterized operator, leaving individual neurons no freedom to evolve independently. Yet in many complex dynamical systems, rich global behavior emerges precisely from locally evolving units interacting through structured connectivity. Inspired by this principle, we introduce Topological Neural Dynamics (TND), a sequence modeling framework that shifts computation from layer-wise to neuron-wise dynamics. TND represents a neural system as a directed neuron graph, an interaction operator, and a local dynamics function, where each neuron evolves independently and collective computation emerges from interactions through the explicit graph topology. We instantiate TND as a discrete-time graph-coupled dynamical system and evaluate it as a case study on a behavior cloning task in single-player Pong. Compared with Vanilla RNN, Sparse RNN, LSTM, Closed-form continuous-time neural network (CfC), and Transformer baselines, TND achieves the best catch rate and a mean of 17.47 consecutive catches per round, more than three times that of the strongest baseline. These results suggest that shifting from layer-wise to neuron-wise dynamics provides an effective inductive bias for sequence modeling.

AI.title_translation: 拓扑神经动力学：一种用于序列建模的神经元级框架
AI.tldr: TND框架通过将神经网络建模为神经元图，实现了神经元的独立演化与交互，在序列建模任务中显著优于传统层级化模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的序列模型（如RNN、Transformer等）均采用“层级动态”，限制了单个神经元独立演化的自由度，无法有效模拟复杂系统中局部单元交互产生的涌现行为。
AI.method: 提出了拓扑神经动力学（TND）框架，将神经网络建模为由有向神经元图、交互算子和局部动力学函数组成的系统，通过神经元间的显式图拓扑交互实现集体计算。
AI.result: 在单人Pong游戏的行为克隆任务中，TND的表现大幅超越了RNN、LSTM、CfC和Transformer等基准模型，平均连续接球次数达到17.47次，是性能最强基准的三倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 将序列建模从层级动态转向神经元级动态，能够显著提升模型在复杂行为控制任务中的表现，证明了该范式在捕捉复杂系统动力学方面的优势。
AI.translation: 现有的序列模型，包括RNN、LSTM、连续时间网络和Transformer，共享一个共同的结构原则：层级动态，即同一层的所有神经元通过共享的参数化算子共同演化，使得单个神经元没有独立演化的自由。然而，在许多复杂的动力系统中，丰富的全局行为正是源于局部演化的单元通过结构化连接进行交互而产生的。受此原则启发，我们引入了拓扑神经动力学（TND），这是一个将计算从层级动态转移到神经元级动态的序列建模框架。TND将神经系统表示为有向神经元图、交互算子和局部动力学函数，其中每个神经元独立演化，集体计算通过显式的图拓扑交互产生。我们将TND实例化为离散时间图耦合动力系统，并将其作为单人Pong游戏行为克隆任务的案例研究进行了评估。与Vanilla RNN、Sparse RNN、LSTM、闭式连续时间神经网络（CfC）和Transformer基准相比，TND实现了最佳的接球率，每轮平均连续接球17.47次，是性能最强基准的三倍以上。这些结果表明，从层级动态转向神经元级动态为序列建模提供了有效的归纳偏置。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为拓扑神经动力学（TND）的序列建模框架，通过将计算模式从层级演化转变为神经元级独立演化，并引入显式的图拓扑结构进行交互，有效增强了模型对复杂动力系统的建模能力。实验表明，TND在行为克隆任务中表现优异。
AI.keywords: 序列建模, 神经元级动态, 拓扑神经网络, 行为克隆, 归纳偏置
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于打破了传统深度学习架构中“层级动态”的束缚，提出了“神经元级动态”的新范式。这种借鉴复杂动力系统理论的方法，通过显式的图拓扑结构实现了更强的建模灵活性，为解决序列建模问题提供了一种全新的归纳偏置。

title: LLM-assisted Generation of Pseudo-C2 Servers for IoT Malware Dynamic Analysis
summary: Most IoT malware operates as botnets dependent on Command and Control (C2) servers, but the short-lived nature of attack infrastructure often leaves samples dormant without C2 communication, hindering dynamic analysis. This paper proposes a system that combines Ghidra with a Large Language Model (LLM) to extract communication specifications from a malware binary and automatically generate a pseudo-C2 server. Experiments using Mirai demonstrate that the proposed system semantically interprets binary control structures and extracts all 20 core protocol elements in agreement with the ground truth (100\% specification extraction accuracy). The generated pseudo-C2 server fully reproduces seven of ten DDoS attack vectors with attack behavior consistent with the original C2. When applied to a customized variant created by modifying the publicly available Mirai source code, the method succeeds end-to-end -- from specification extraction through pseudo-C2 generation to attack reproduction -- demonstrating that the LLM infers specifications from binary structures without relying on pre-trained knowledge. This approach extends the applicability of LLMs from analysis assistance to the automated construction of dynamic analysis environments.

AI.title_translation: 基于LLM辅助的IoT恶意软件动态分析伪C2服务器生成技术
AI.tldr: 利用LLM解析IoT恶意软件二进制文件并自动构建伪C2服务器，成功解决了因缺乏C2环境导致的动态分析难题。
AI.motivation: 大多数IoT恶意软件依赖C2服务器运行，但攻击基础设施往往生命周期较短，导致样本在缺乏C2通信时处于休眠状态，严重阻碍了研究人员对其进行有效的动态分析。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合Ghidra二进制分析工具与大语言模型（LLM）的系统，通过LLM对恶意软件二进制文件中的控制结构进行语义解析，提取通信协议规范，并据此自动生成伪C2服务器以模拟攻击行为。
AI.result: 实验表明，该系统对Mirai恶意软件的协议规范提取准确率达到100%，生成的伪C2服务器成功复现了70%的DDoS攻击向量，且对自定义变体实现了从规范提取到攻击复现的端到端自动化。
AI.conclusion: 该系统成功证明了利用LLM进行二进制语义分析并自动构建动态分析环境的可行性，有效解决了IoT恶意软件分析中的基础设施依赖问题。
AI.translation: 大多数物联网（IoT）恶意软件作为依赖命令与控制（C2）服务器的僵尸网络运行，但攻击基础设施的短效性常导致样本在没有C2通信的情况下处于休眠状态，从而阻碍了动态分析。本文提出了一种将Ghidra与大语言模型（LLM）相结合的系统，用于从恶意软件二进制文件中提取通信规范，并自动生成伪C2服务器。以Mirai进行的实验表明，该系统能够语义化地解释二进制控制结构，并提取出与基准事实完全一致（100%规范提取准确率）的所有20个核心协议元素。生成的伪C2服务器完全复现了十种DDoS攻击向量中的七种，且攻击行为与原始C2一致。当应用于通过修改公开Mirai源代码创建的自定义变体时，该方法成功实现了端到端的流程——从规范提取到伪C2生成再到攻击复现，证明了LLM无需依赖预训练知识即可从二进制结构中推断出规范。该方法将LLM的应用范围从分析辅助扩展到了动态分析环境的自动化构建。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于LLM和Ghidra的自动化系统，旨在通过从IoT恶意软件二进制文件中提取通信协议规范，自动构建伪C2服务器，从而解决因缺乏真实C2环境而导致的恶意软件动态分析困难问题。
AI.keywords: 物联网恶意软件, 命令与控制服务器, 大语言模型, 动态分析, 二进制逆向工程
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将大语言模型（LLM）与二进制分析工具（Ghidra）结合，解决了物联网恶意软件动态分析中因C2服务器缺失而无法触发攻击行为的难题。其核心价值在于自动化地从二进制文件中提取协议规范并构建模拟环境，显著提升了恶意软件分析的效率。局限性在于目前主要针对Mirai等结构相对固定的恶意软件进行验证，对高度混淆或复杂协议的恶意软件的通用性仍需进一步研究。

title: Beyond Classification Accuracy: An Exploration-Range Evaluation of Adaptive Crawling for Fake Shopping Sites
summary: In recent years, fake shopping sites targeting Japanese users have appeared in the top results of search engines through SEO poisoning, causing increasing damage. Conventional collection methods rely on fixed keywords and cannot keep up with evolving attack campaigns, delaying the discovery of new sites. We propose a closed-loop crawler that incorporates the page-level outputs of a fake-site classifier (fastText+LightGBM) into the search queries of the next cycle. Search queries are generated by a seed-compound strategy that combines characteristic words extracted from positive pages with seed words from the fake-shopping context (e.g., ``deep discount,'' ``official''). To complement evaluations that tend to focus on classifier accuracy, we also introduce per-cycle new-host counts and cumulative unique-host counts as exploration-range metrics. In a comparative experiment ($n=3$ for the proposed method, $n=2$ for the baseline), the fixed-keyword baseline yielded zero new-host acquisition from cycle 2 onward, indicating complete stagnation, whereas the proposed method continued to discover new hosts and, at cycle 3, achieved a cumulative unique-host count approximately 7.6 times that of the baseline on average.

title: Does Mixture-of-Experts Actually Help Inference on Consumer and Edge Hardware? An Empirical Study
comments: 18 pages, 7 tables, 4 figures. Submitted to FAIEMA 2026. Code available at https://github.com/Analytics-Everywhere-Lab/edge-moe
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models are often described as ideal for resource-constrained inference. Each token activates only a small subset of experts, so the per-token compute cost, in floating-point operations (FLOPs), resembles that of a much smaller dense model. Whether that FLOP advantage survives in practice is far less clear. We ask whether MoE models actually run faster and cheaper than comparable dense models on consumer-grade and edge hardware. We benchmark OLMoE-1B-7B (1.3 B active of 6.9 B total) against three dense baselines on an Apple M2 Pro and an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 8 GB through \texttt{llama.cpp}, measuring throughput, memory, and on-device energy. The answer is device-dependent: OLMoE's active-parameter advantage is only partly realised on the laptop (~10% behind the same-active Llama-3.2-1B) and erodes on the edge device (~31% behind, at 2.1$\times$ the energy per token, with peak memory at the 8 GB ceiling). Patching \texttt{llama.cpp} to time the decode graph node-by-node shows routing accounts for under 9% of MoE-block compute on the cleaner edge backend, so the gap reflects total-parameter memory footprint, expert dispatch, and KV-cache pressure rather than routing. The implication is that on bandwidth-bound edge hardware, inference cost tracks total parameters, not active ones, and sparse activation does not buy back what the device is constrained on. These findings are bounded to one MoE model at this parameter scale and two devices, and we release the full measurement harness and per-run data.
