AI.result: DAE能够有效重建未受污染的光谱并保留关键分子特征；在反演测试中，该方法显著降低了丰度参数的偏差，且计算成本比传统同时拟合方法低一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 去噪自动编码器（DAE）在处理系外行星透射光谱的恒星污染和噪声方面，表现出比传统方法更高的计算效率和相当的准确性，非常适合集成到未来的大气表征流程中。
AI.translation: 背景：詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）的红外灵敏度实现了前所未有的高精度透射光谱观测，彻底改变了系外行星大气的表征。然而，恒星异质性（如黑子和光斑）仍然是主要的污染源，如果校正不当，会使大气反演产生偏差。目的：我们提出了一种利用神经网络（特别是去噪自动编码器，DAE）降低系外行星透射光谱中恒星污染和特定仪器噪声的方法。我们的目标是实现快速、准确的校正，以提高大气参数反演的可靠性，并推广无监督算法在数据处理中的应用。方法：我们设计并训练了DAE架构，使用了类地行星（TRAPPIST-1e类似物）和亚海王星（K2-18b类似物）的大型合成数据集。随后，我们在受污染的光谱上进行了大气反演实验，以比较我们的深度学习方法与传统校正方法在准确性和计算成本方面的差异。结果：我们的自动编码器成功地重建了未受污染的光谱，即使在低信噪比（S/N）环境下也能保留关键的分子特征。在反演测试中，与未校正的观测结果相比，DAE预处理减少了反演丰度参数的偏差。值得注意的是，我们的方法在保持与同时拟合恒星污染方法相当的准确性的同时，计算成本大幅降低，通常小一个数量级。结论：这些结果表明，DAE在计算效率上优于传统校正方法，同时保持了高精度，为将其整合到未来岩石行星和巨行星的大气表征流水线中铺平了道路。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用去噪自动编码器（DAE）去除系外行星透射光谱中恒星污染和噪声的方法。通过在合成数据集上的训练与测试，证明了该方法在保持高精度反演的同时，具备比传统模型更优越的计算效率。
AI.keywords: 系外行星, 透射光谱, 神经网络, 恒星污染, 去噪自动编码器
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将深度学习（去噪自动编码器）应用于系外行星光谱处理，成功在保持高精度的前提下显著降低了计算成本，为处理大规模JWST数据提供了高效的新路径。

title: Event-Grounded Question Answering over Long Audio via Structured Retrieval
summary: Answering natural-language questions over multi-hour audio requires both event recognition and temporal grounding. Current large audio-language models perform well on short clips, but are limited by context length, query-time cost, and weak temporal localization. We present LA-RAG (Long Audio-Retrieval Augmented Generation), a structured framework that converts continuous audio into timestamped event records using an open-vocabulary Audio Grounding Model (AGM), stores them in a SQL event database, and answers queries through intent-aware retrieval followed by LLM-based generation. LA-RAG supports offline grounding mode, where long recordings are pre-indexed for low-latency QA, and inference-time grounding mode, where query-conditioned grounding is performed for shorter open-ended clips. We create 24-hour Home-IoT and Industrial-IoT audio benchmarks and augment CASTELLA, a real-world audio moment retrieval dataset with QA pairs. In offline grounding mode, LA-RAG achieves 76.88% overall accuracy on Home-IoT and 71.10% on Industrial-IoT, with average query latencies below 0.6 seconds. In inference-time grounding mode, state-of-the-art LALMs achieve competitive event-detection accuracy on CASTELLA-QA but low temporal detection F1. We further show that LALMs augmented with our structured retrieval metadata achieve consistent temporal detection improvements, with F1 gains of 11-17% across baseline models with improved latency. These results show that explicit timestamped grounding and structured retrieval provide a practical complement to generative audio-language models for deployment-oriented long-audio QA.

AI.title_translation: 基于结构化检索的长音频事件定位问答
AI.tldr: LA-RAG将长音频转化为结构化SQL事件数据库，通过检索增强生成实现高效、精准的长音频问答。
AI.motivation: 现有的音频语言模型在处理数小时的长音频时，受限于上下文长度、查询延迟高以及时间定位能力较弱等问题，难以直接应用于实际场景。
AI.method: 提出LA-RAG框架：1. 使用开放词汇音频定位模型（AGM）将音频转化为带时间戳的事件记录；2. 将事件存储在SQL数据库中；3. 通过意图感知检索和LLM生成进行问答。支持离线预索引和推理时动态定位两种模式。
AI.result: 在Home-IoT和Industrial-IoT基准测试中，离线模式下分别达到76.88%和71.10%的准确率，延迟低于0.6秒。在CASTELLA-QA任务中，通过结构化检索元数据增强，模型的时间定位F1值提升了11-17%。
AI.conclusion: LA-RAG通过显式的带时间戳的事件定位和结构化检索，为长音频问答提供了一个高效、低延迟且性能优越的部署方案，有效弥补了现有大音频语言模型的不足。
AI.translation: 在多小时的音频上进行自然语言问答需要同时具备事件识别和时间定位能力。当前的大型音频语言模型在短片段上表现良好，但受限于上下文长度、查询耗时和较弱的时间定位能力。我们提出了LA-RAG（长音频检索增强生成），这是一个结构化框架，它利用开放词汇音频定位模型（AGM）将连续音频转换为带时间戳的事件记录，并将其存储在SQL事件数据库中，通过意图感知检索和基于LLM的生成来回答查询。LA-RAG支持离线定位模式（对长录音进行预索引以实现低延迟问答）和推理时定位模式（对较短的开放式片段进行查询条件下的定位）。我们创建了24小时的Home-IoT和Industrial-IoT音频基准，并扩充了CASTELLA（一个现实世界的音频片段检索数据集）的问答对。在离线定位模式下，LA-RAG在Home-IoT上的总体准确率为76.88%，在Industrial-IoT上为71.10%，平均查询延迟低于0.6秒。在推理时定位模式下，最先进的LALM在CASTELLA-QA上实现了具有竞争力的事件检测准确率，但时间检测F1值较低。我们进一步证明，使用我们的结构化检索元数据增强的LALM实现了持续的时间检测改进，在基线模型上F1值提高了11-17%，并改善了延迟。这些结果表明，显式的带时间戳定位和结构化检索为面向部署的长音频问答提供了对生成式音频语言模型的实用补充。
AI.summary: 本文提出了LA-RAG框架，旨在解决长音频问答中的长上下文和定位难题。该方法将音频解析为带时间戳的结构化事件存入SQL数据库，利用检索增强生成技术提高问答效率与准确性，并在多个基准测试中验证了其在低延迟和高定位精度方面的优势。
AI.keywords: 长音频问答, 检索增强生成, 音频事件定位, 结构化检索, 大音频语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的方法，通过将非结构化的长音频转换为结构化的SQL数据库，有效解决了大音频语言模型（LALMs）在长音频处理中上下文受限、定位能力弱和推理成本高的问题。其重要意义在于将检索增强生成（RAG）范式成功应用于音频领域，并提供了实用的部署方案。局限性在于对音频事件识别模型的依赖程度较高，且需要预先构建索引。

title: Separating Oblivious and Adaptive Models of Variable Selection
comments: 40 pages, Extended abstract accepted for presentation at COLT 2026
summary: Sparse recovery is among the most well-studied problems in learning theory and high-dimensional statistics. In this work, we investigate the statistical and computational landscapes of sparse recovery with $\ell_\infty$ error guarantees. This variant of the problem is motivated by \emph{variable selection} tasks, where the goal is to estimate the support of a $k$-sparse signal in $\mathbb{R}^d$. Our main contribution is a provable separation between the \emph{oblivious} (``for each'') and \emph{adaptive} (``for all'') models of $\ell_\infty$ sparse recovery. We show that under an oblivious model, the optimal $\ell_\infty$ error is attainable in near-linear time with $\approx k\log d$ samples, whereas in an adaptive model, $\gtrsim k^2$ samples are necessary for any algorithm to achieve this bound. This establishes a surprising contrast with the standard $\ell_2$ setting, where $\approx k \log d$ samples suffice even for adaptive sparse recovery. We conclude with a preliminary examination of a \emph{partially-adaptive} model, where we show nontrivial variable selection guarantees are possible with $\approx k\log d$ measurements.
comment: 40 pages, Extended abstract accepted for presentation at COLT 2026

AI.title_translation: 分离变量选择的遗忘模型与自适应模型
AI.tldr: 该论文证明了在$\ell_\infty$稀疏恢复中，自适应模型比遗忘模型需要多得多的样本（从$k \log d$增加到$k^2$），纠正了人们从$\ell_2$设置中得出的误区。
AI.motivation: 为了探究稀疏恢复在$\ell_\infty$误差保证下的统计和计算特性，特别是在变量选择任务中，区分遗忘模型与自适应模型在性能表现上的差异。
AI.method: 通过理论分析和计算复杂性研究，对比了在$\ell_\infty$误差保证下，遗忘模型（需要$\approx k \log d$样本）与自适应模型（需要$\gtrsim k^2$样本）的性能差异，并探讨了部分自适应模型。
AI.result: 在遗忘模型下，最优$\ell_\infty$误差可在近线性时间内通过$\approx k \log d$个样本达到；而在自适应模型下，则至少需要$\gtrsim k^2$个样本。这与$\ell_2$设置下两者均只需$\approx k \log d$样本的情况形成鲜明对比。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了在$\ell_\infty$范数稀疏恢复中，遗忘模型与自适应模型存在本质的样本复杂度差距，并为部分自适应模型的可行性提供了初步证据。
AI.translation: 稀疏恢复是学习理论和高维统计中研究最深入的问题之一。在这项工作中，我们研究了具有$\ell_\infty$误差保证的稀疏恢复的统计和计算前景。该问题的变体受到变量选择任务的启发，其目标是估计$\mathbb{R}^d$中$k$-稀疏信号的支撑集。我们的主要贡献是证明了$\ell_\infty$稀疏恢复的遗忘模型（“逐个”）和自适应模型（“全部”）之间的分离。我们证明，在遗忘模型下，最优$\ell_\infty$误差可以在近线性时间内以$\approx k \log d$个样本达到，而在自适应模型中，任何算法要达到此界限都需要$\gtrsim k^2$个样本。这与标准的$\ell_2$设置形成了惊人的对比，在$\ell_2$设置中，即使对于自适应稀疏恢复，$\approx k \log d$个样本也足够了。最后，我们初步考察了部分自适应模型，并证明了在$\approx k \log d$测量下，非平凡的变量选择保证是可能的。
AI.summary: 本文研究了稀疏恢复中$\ell_\infty$误差保证的统计与计算复杂性。作者证明了在变量选择任务中，遗忘模型与自适应模型存在显著的样本复杂度差异：遗忘模型仅需$\approx k \log d$样本，而自适应模型需要$\gtrsim k^2$样本。此外，文章还探讨了部分自适应模型的有效性。
AI.keywords: 稀疏恢复, 变量选择, 遗忘模型, 自适应模型, 样本复杂度
AI.comments: 该论文在稀疏恢复领域具有重要意义，通过揭示$\ell_\infty$误差保证下遗忘模型与自适应模型之间的样本复杂度差异，挑战了传统$\ell_2$设置下的认知。其创新点在于从理论上证明了在特定误差范数下，自适应性会带来显著的样本惩罚。

title: An Approach to Simultaneous Acquisition of Real-Time MRI Video, EEG, and Surface EMG for Articulatory, Brain, and Muscle Activity During Speech Production
summary: Speech production is a complex process spanning neural planning, motor control, muscle activation, and articulatory kinematics. While the acoustic speech signal is the most accessible product of the speech production act, it does not directly reveal its causal neurophysiological substrates. We present the first simultaneous acquisition of real-time (dynamic) MRI, EEG, and surface EMG, capturing several key aspects of the speech production chain: brain signals, muscle activations, and articulatory movements. This multimodal acquisition paradigm presents substantial technical challenges, including MRI-induced electromagnetic interference and myogenic artifacts. To mitigate these, we introduce an artifact suppression pipeline tailored to this tri-modal setting. Once fully developed, this framework is poised to offer an unprecedented window into speech neuroscience and insights leading to brain-computer interface advances. The source code and data are available.

AI.title_translation: 一种语音产生过程中实时MRI、EEG和表面肌电图同步采集的研究方法
AI.tldr: 首次实现了语音产生过程中实时MRI、EEG和表面肌电图的三模态同步采集，并开发了配套的伪影抑制方案。
AI.motivation: 现有的语音研究多依赖声学信号，难以直接揭示语音产生背后的神经生理机制，因此需要一种能同时捕捉大脑活动、肌肉激活和发音运动的综合方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种三模态同步采集范式，并开发了一套专门针对该设置的伪影抑制流水线，用以处理MRI引起的电磁干扰和肌源性伪影。
AI.result: 成功实现了实时MRI、EEG和表面肌电图的同步采集，并验证了通过伪影抑制流水线处理数据的有效性，为语音神经科学研究提供了新的实验平台。
AI.conclusion: 研究成功建立了三模态同步采集平台，为深入理解语音产生的神经生理过程提供了全新的技术手段和数据支持。
AI.translation: 语音产生是一个跨越神经规划、运动控制、肌肉激活和发音运动学的复杂过程。虽然声学语音信号是语音产生过程中最容易获取的产物，但它并不能直接揭示其因果神经生理基础。我们首次实现了实时（动态）MRI、EEG和表面肌电图的同步采集，捕捉到了语音产生链中的几个关键环节：大脑信号、肌肉激活和发音运动。这种多模态采集范式带来了巨大的技术挑战，包括MRI引起的电磁干扰和肌源性伪影。为了缓解这些问题，我们引入了一种专门针对这种三模态设置的伪影抑制流水线。一旦完全开发，该框架将为语音神经科学提供一个前所未有的窗口，并为脑机接口的进步提供见解。源代码和数据现已公开。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种首次结合实时MRI、EEG和表面肌电图的同步采集技术，旨在全面捕捉语音产生过程中的大脑活动、肌肉激活及发音运动。针对多模态采集中的电磁干扰和伪影问题，研究设计了专门的抑制流程，为语音神经科学研究及脑机接口开发提供了强有力的工具。
AI.keywords: 实时MRI, EEG, 表面肌电图, 语音产生, 多模态采集
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于首次实现了实时MRI、EEG和表面肌电图（sEMG）的三模态同步采集，为研究语音产生的神经生理机制提供了极其宝贵的综合数据集。其局限性在于处理MRI引起的电磁干扰和肌源性伪影面临巨大的技术挑战，虽然提出了伪影抑制流程，但其通用性和鲁棒性仍需进一步验证。该研究对语音神经科学和脑机接口领域具有重要意义。

title: Posterior Sampling Reinforcement Learning with Gaussian Processes for Continuous Control: Sublinear Regret Bounds for Unbounded State Spaces
summary: We analyze the Bayesian regret of the Gaussian process posterior sampling reinforcement learning (GP-PSRL) algorithm. Posterior sampling is a heuristic for decision-making under uncertainty that has been used to develop successful algorithms for a variety of continuous control problems. However, theoretical work on GP-PSRL is limited. All known regret bounds either have a sub-optimal growth rate, require strong smoothness assumptions, or fail to properly account for the fact that the set of possible system states is unbounded. Through a recursive application of the Borell-Tsirelson-Ibragimov-Sudakov inequality, we show that, with high probability, the states actually visited by the algorithm are contained within a ball of near-constant radius. We then use the chaining method to control the regret suffered by GP-PSRL under weak smoothness conditions. Our main result is a Bayesian regret bound of the order $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(H\sqrt{γ_TT})$, where $H$ is the horizon, $T$ is the number of time steps and $γ_T$ is the expected information gain. With this result, we resolve the limitations with prior theoretical work on PSRL, and provide the theoretical foundation and tools for analyzing PSRL in complex settings.

title: Conditional channel entropy sets fundamental limits on thermodynamic quantum information processing
comments: Fixed bugs, added some more observations, 33+20 pages, 1 table, 3 figures
summary: The thermodynamic resourcefulness of quantum channels primarily depends on their underlying causal structure and their ability to generate quantum correlations. We quantify this interplay within the resource theory of athermality for bipartite quantum channels in the presence of a side channel acting as memory, referred to as the resource theory of conditional athermality. For channels with trivial output Hamiltonians, we characterize the optimal one-shot rates for distilling the identity gate from a given channel, as well as the cost of simulating the channel using the identity gate, under conditional Gibbs-preserving superchannels. We show that these rates have a direct trade-off relation with the conditional channel entropies, attributing operational significance to signaling in quantum processes. Furthermore, we establish an asymptotic equipartition property for the conditional channel min-entropy for classes of channels that are either tele-covariant or no-signaling from the non-conditioning input to the conditioning output. As a consequence, we demonstrate asymptotic reversibility of the resource theory for these channels. The asymptotic conditional athermality capacity of a tele-covariant channel is half the superdense coding capacity of its Choi state. Our work establishes the conditional channel entropy as a primitive information-theoretic concept for quantum processes, elucidating its potential for wider applications in quantum information science.

AI.title_translation: 条件通道熵设定了热力学量子信息处理的基本极限
AI.tldr: 本文提出条件通道熵是衡量量子通道热力学资源的核心指标，并证明了其在特定条件下具有渐近可逆性，从而揭示了量子信号传递与热力学资源之间的基本权衡。
AI.motivation: 旨在量化量子通道的热力学资源（非热力学性），探讨其因果结构与产生量子关联的能力，并理解这些特性如何受侧信道（作为记忆）的影响。
AI.method: 在条件非热力学资源理论框架下，研究二分量子通道，利用条件吉布斯保持超通道，刻画蒸馏恒等门与模拟通道的单次速率，并结合渐近等分性质分析特定通道类的可逆性。
AI.result: 发现蒸馏与模拟速率与条件通道熵存在直接的权衡关系；证明了对于特定通道（如遥变协变或无信号通道），该资源理论具有渐近可逆性；指出遥变协变通道的渐近条件非热力学容量为其Choi态超密编码容量的一半。
AI.conclusion: 条件通道熵是量化量子通道热力学资源的关键信息论原始量，它不仅决定了通道的蒸馏与模拟速率，还揭示了量子过程中信号传递与热力学资源之间的深刻联系。
AI.translation: 量子通道的热力学资源性主要取决于其底层的因果结构及其产生量子关联的能力。我们在存在作为记忆的侧信道的情况下，于二分量子通道的非热力学资源理论中量化了这种相互作用，并将其称为条件非热力学资源理论。对于具有平凡输出哈密顿量的通道，我们在条件吉布斯保持超通道下，刻画了从给定通道蒸馏恒等门的最优单次速率，以及使用恒等门模拟该通道的代价。我们证明了这些速率与条件通道熵之间存在直接的权衡关系，从而赋予了量子过程中信号传递操作上的意义。此外，我们针对遥变协变或从非条件输入到条件输出无信号的通道类，建立了条件通道最小熵的渐近等分性质。结果表明，这些通道的资源理论具有渐近可逆性。遥变协变通道的渐近条件非热力学容量为其Choi态超密编码容量的一半。我们的工作确立了条件通道熵作为量子过程的基本信息论概念，阐明了其在量子信息科学中更广泛的应用潜力。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了量子通道在热力学资源理论中的表现，引入了“条件非热力学”框架，研究了在存在侧信道的情况下，量子通道蒸馏与模拟的速率。研究表明，条件通道熵是决定这些热力学资源转换极限的核心量，并证明了特定通道类在渐近极限下的可逆性。
AI.keywords: 条件通道熵, 热力学资源理论, 量子通道, 渐近可逆性, 非热力学性
AI.comments: 该研究将条件通道熵引入热力学资源理论，不仅深化了对量子通道热力学特性的理解，还通过建立渐近可逆性为量化量子过程的资源价值提供了统一的框架。其创新点在于将信息论中的条件熵概念成功推广至热力学资源理论，并为量子通信与热力学的交叉领域提供了重要的理论支撑。

title: Robust and Fast Training via Per-Sample Clipping
summary: We propose a robust gradient estimator based on per-sample gradient clipping and analyze its properties both theoretically and empirically. We show that the resulting method, per-sample clipped SGD (PS-Clip-SGD), achieves optimal in-expectation convergence rates for non-convex optimization problems under heavy-tailed gradient noise. Moreover, we establish high-probability convergence guarantees that match the in-expectation rates up to polylogarithmic factors in the failure probability. We complement our theoretical results with multiple numerical experiments. In particular, we demonstrate that PS-Clip-SGD outperforms both vanilla SGD with momentum and standard gradient clipping when training AlexNet on the CIFAR-100 dataset, even after accounting for the additional computational time caused by per-sample clipping. We also empirically show that, in the presence of gradient accumulation, applying clipping at the mini-batch level can improve training performance while incurring virtually no additional computational cost. This finding is particularly interesting, as it contradicts the common practice of applying clipping only after all accumulation steps have been completed.

AI.title_translation: 通过单样本裁剪实现鲁棒且快速的训练
AI.tldr: 提出了一种PS-Clip-SGD算法，通过单样本梯度裁剪有效应对重尾噪声，在提高训练鲁棒性的同时，优化了梯度累积过程的性能。
AI.motivation: 为了解决传统梯度下降在处理重尾梯度噪声时收敛性不佳的问题，并提升训练过程的鲁棒性和效率。
AI.method: 提出并分析了单样本梯度裁剪梯度下降法（PS-Clip-SGD），并在理论上证明了其在非凸优化问题及重尾梯度噪声下的收敛性；实证研究了该方法在AlexNet训练及梯度累积场景下的表现。
AI.result: PS-Clip-SGD在重尾噪声环境下实现了最优的期望收敛速率；在CIFAR-100数据集训练AlexNet的任务中，其表现优于普通SGD及标准梯度裁剪；此外，发现在梯度累积过程中逐样本裁剪优于累积后裁剪。
AI.conclusion: 单样本裁剪梯度下降法（PS-Clip-SGD）不仅在理论上对重尾噪声具有鲁棒性，在实际深度学习任务（如AlexNet训练）中也优于传统方法，且在梯度累积场景下具有极高的应用价值。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种基于单样本梯度裁剪的鲁棒梯度估计器，并从理论和实证两方面分析了其属性。我们证明了所提出的方法——单样本裁剪梯度下降法（PS-Clip-SGD），在重尾梯度噪声下的非凸优化问题中实现了最优的期望收敛速率。此外，我们建立了高概率收敛保证，其与期望收敛速率在失败概率的对数因子范围内保持一致。我们通过多项数值实验补充了理论结果。特别地，我们证明了在CIFAR-100数据集上训练AlexNet时，即使考虑了单样本裁剪带来的额外计算时间，PS-Clip-SGD的表现依然优于传统的动量SGD和标准梯度裁剪。我们还通过实证表明，在存在梯度累积的情况下，在小批量级别应用裁剪可以提高训练性能，且几乎不产生额外的计算成本。这一发现特别有趣，因为它反驳了在所有累积步骤完成后才进行裁剪的常见做法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于单样本梯度裁剪的鲁棒梯度估计器（PS-Clip-SGD），证明了其在处理重尾梯度噪声时的最优收敛性，并通过实验验证了其在深度学习训练中的优越性及在梯度累积策略上的改进空间。
AI.keywords: 单样本梯度裁剪, SGD, 重尾噪声, 鲁棒优化, 梯度累积
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种通过单样本梯度裁剪来增强SGD鲁棒性的方法。创新点在于理论上证明了其在重尾噪声下的最优收敛性，并实证发现梯度累积过程中进行单样本裁剪优于传统的累积后裁剪，这对优化深度学习训练流程具有重要的启发意义。

title: Neural Posterior Estimation of Terrain Parameters from Radar Sounder Data
comments: 5 pages, 3 figures; accepted at IGARSS 2026, 9 - 14 August 2026, Washington D.C., USA
summary: Radar sounders are electromagnetic instruments that can probe deep into the subsurface of Earth and other planetary bodies by processing the echo of transmitted radar waves. Conventional approaches for analyzing such data rely on approximate assumptions and often produce point estimates that ignore parameter correlations as well as galactic and measurement noise. We propose a simulation-based inference approach to terrain parameter inversion from radar sounder data, where synthetic observations from a GPU-based simulator are used to train a neural network-based density estimator for neural posterior estimation (NPE). By explicitly conditioning on reference surface assumptions, the proposed framework allows systematic evaluation of posterior robustness to reference surface variability. We demonstrate that our NPE model is well calibrated on simulated data and transferable to real Mars radar profiles, where we analyze terrain parameters using literature-informed reference values.

title: Activation Functions, Statistics and Learning of Higher-Order Interactions in Restricted Boltzmann Machines
comments: Accepted for publication in Physica A: Statistical Mechanics and its Applications, Special Issue on Statistical Mechanics for Learning. 36 pages, 27 figures
summary: The great success of neural networks primarily arises from the presence of the large number of weight parameters combined with nonlinearities in the input-output relationship of single neurons. In this work, we study the relationship between the statistical properties of the weights and the nonlinearity of the hidden unit in Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs) on the one side, and the distribution induced on binary visible units. We do this for four commonly used activation functions: Linear, Step, ReLU, and Exponential, and make qualitative predictions about the ability of these models to learn distributions with strong higher order interactions over the visible nodes. We show that in general, in an ensemble of RBMs with Gaussian weights, these distributions are rare and hard to learn, except when the hidden unit activation function is an Exponential.

AI.title_translation: 受限玻尔兹曼机中的激活函数、统计特性与高阶交互学习
AI.tldr: 研究发现，相比线性、阶梯和ReLU激活函数，使用指数激活函数的受限玻尔兹曼机在学习数据中高阶交互特征方面表现出显著优势。
AI.motivation: 神经网络的成功依赖于权重参数与非线性激活函数的结合，但目前对于不同激活函数如何影响模型学习高阶交互能力缺乏深入的统计学理解。
AI.method: 通过理论推导研究受限玻尔兹曼机中隐藏单元激活函数（线性、阶梯、ReLU、指数）与权重统计特性之间的关系，并分析其对可见单元分布的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现，在具有高斯权重的RBM集合中，学习强高阶交互分布通常很困难且罕见，唯有使用指数激活函数时能够有效改善这一状况。
AI.conclusion: 在受限玻尔兹曼机中，使用指数激活函数能显著提升模型学习具有强高阶交互特征的数据分布的能力，而其他常见激活函数则表现较差。
AI.translation: 神经网络的巨大成功主要归功于大量权重参数与单个神经元输入输出关系中非线性的结合。在这项工作中，我们研究了受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）中权重的统计特性和隐藏单元非线性，以及它们在二值可见单元上诱导出的分布之间的关系。我们针对四种常用的激活函数（线性、阶梯、ReLU和指数）进行了研究，并对这些模型学习可见节点上具有强高阶交互分布的能力做出了定性预测。我们证明，在具有高斯权重的RBM集合中，除了隐藏单元激活函数为指数函数的情况外，这些分布通常是罕见的且难以学习的。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）中不同激活函数（线性、阶梯、ReLU、指数）与权重统计特性对模型学习高阶交互能力的影响，揭示了指数激活函数在捕捉复杂分布方面的优越性。
AI.keywords: 受限玻尔兹曼机, 激活函数, 高阶交互, 权重统计, 生成模型
AI.comments: 该研究通过理论分析揭示了激活函数选择对受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）学习复杂数据分布能力的决定性影响。其创新点在于从统计物理的角度探讨了权重分布与非线性激活函数之间的相互作用，特别是指出了指数激活函数在捕捉高阶交互方面的独特优势，这对理解生成模型的表达能力具有重要意义。

title: Precision Physical Activity Prescription via Reinforcement Learning for Functional Actions
summary: Physical activity (PA) plays an important role in maintaining and improving health. Daily steps have been a key PA measure that is easily accessible with common wearable devices. However, methods are lacking to recommend a personalized optimal distribution of daily steps over a period of time for the best of certain health biomarkers. In this paper, we fill this void based on the data from the All of Us Research Program which includes months of step counts as well as repeated measurements of key health biomarkers. We develop a new offline reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm to learn personalized and optimal PA distributions associated with cardiometabolic risk, where the action is a function representing the daily step distribution over a period of time. Simulation studies demonstrate the advantage of the proposed approach over existing continuous-action RL methods. The learned optimal policy from the All of Us data generally suggests people take more daily steps and also follow a more consistent pattern of PA over time while offering tailored recommendations for subgroups in blood glucose level, body mass index, blood pressure, age, and sex.

AI.title_translation: 通过强化学习实现功能性动作的精准身体活动处方
AI.tldr: 利用离线强化学习分析长期步数数据，为个体提供定制化的每日步数建议，以改善心血管代谢健康。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏一种有效的方法来为个人推荐最优的每日步数分布，以改善特定的健康生物标志物。
AI.method: 开发了一种新的离线强化学习（RL）算法，将每日步数分布作为动作函数，利用“All of Us”研究项目中的长期步数数据和重复健康生物标志物测量进行训练。
AI.result: 模拟实验证明该方法优于现有的连续动作RL算法。基于真实数据得出的最优策略建议人们增加步数并保持一致的运动模式，同时能针对不同血糖、BMI、血压、年龄和性别的人群提供量身定制的建议。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，基于离线强化学习的个性化身体活动处方优于现有方法，能够根据个人的健康指标提供更一致且有效的步数建议，从而改善心血管代谢健康。
AI.translation: 身体活动（PA）在维持和改善健康方面发挥着重要作用。每日步数是一项关键的PA指标，可以通过常见的可穿戴设备轻松获取。然而，目前缺乏一种方法来推荐一段时间内每日步数的个性化最优分布，以达到特定健康生物标志物的最佳状态。在本文中，我们基于“All of Us”研究项目的数据填补了这一空白，该项目包括数月的步数统计以及关键健康生物标志物的重复测量。我们开发了一种新的离线强化学习（RL）算法，用于学习与心血管代谢风险相关的个性化且最优的PA分布，其中动作是一个表示一段时间内每日步数分布的函数。模拟研究证明了所提方法优于现有的连续动作RL方法。从“All of Us”数据中学到的最优策略通常建议人们采取更多的每日步数，并随着时间的推移遵循更一致的PA模式，同时为血糖水平、体重指数、血压、年龄和性别等亚组提供量身定制的建议。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于离线强化学习的新型框架，旨在根据个人的心血管代谢健康指标，为其制定个性化的最优每日步数分布方案。研究利用大规模真实世界数据，验证了该方法在提供精准运动建议方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 身体活动处方, 离线强化学习, 可穿戴设备, 心血管代谢风险, 个性化健康
AI.comments: 该研究填补了根据个人健康生物标志物动态调整每日步数分布的空白，通过离线强化学习处理复杂的长时序数据，具有很高的临床应用潜力。其局限性在于离线强化学习对数据质量和覆盖范围的依赖性较高。

title: Quantum Entanglement Halves the Oblivious Update Bandwidth
summary: We consider $(n,k)$ MDS-coded distributed storage over $\mathbb{F}_q$ with per-node storage $α$ symbols. For the oblivious update problem, where a single message symbol changes and neither helpers nor the stale node know which, the classical lower bound is $αk \log_2 q$ bits. We prove that when the $k$ contacted helpers share prior quantum entanglement, the update bandwidth is $\lceil α/2 \rceil \cdot k \log_2 q$ bits-equivalent, a factor approaching 2 reduction. For $α= 2$, a $[[k, k-2]]_q$ CSS code achieves bandwidth $k \log_2 q$ with one qudit per helper. For general $α$, a $[[\lceil α/2 \rceil k, \lceil α/2 \rceil k - α]]_q$ CSS code achieves the bound with $\lceil α/2 \rceil$ qudits per helper. The matching converse uses the superdense coding bound: the stale node holds all transmitted qudits and hence the entangled partners, so each helper's channel supports at most $D^2$ distinguishable signals for dimension $D$. The result holds for all $(n,k)$ pairs with sufficiently large prime $q$.

AI.title_translation: 量子纠缠使遗忘更新带宽减半
AI.tldr: 通过引入量子纠缠和超密编码，研究证明分布式存储系统在进行遗忘更新时的通信带宽可以减少至经典情况的一半。
AI.motivation: 传统分布式存储在遗忘更新问题上存在经典带宽下界，研究者旨在探索量子纠缠资源是否能打破这一限制，从而降低通信带宽。
AI.method: 利用量子超密编码原理，通过构建 $[[\lceil \alpha/2 \rceil k, \lceil \alpha/2 \rceil k - \alpha]]_q$ CSS量子纠错码，实现分布式存储中的遗忘更新，并利用超密编码界限证明了该带宽下界。
AI.result: 在分布式存储的遗忘更新中，当辅助节点共享量子纠缠时，更新带宽可降至经典的二分之一，即 $\lceil \alpha/2 \rceil \cdot k \log_2 q$ 比特等效值。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了利用量子纠缠可以使分布式存储的遗忘更新带宽减半，并通过构建特定的CSS码验证了该理论的实现路径。
AI.translation: 我们考虑了 $\mathbb{F}_q$ 域上每节点存储 $\alpha$ 个符号的 $(n,k)$ MDS编码分布式存储系统。对于遗忘更新问题（即单个消息符号发生变化，但辅助节点和过期节点均不知道是哪一个符号改变），其经典下界为 $\alpha k \log_2 q$ 比特。我们证明了当 $k$ 个被联系的辅助节点共享预先存在的量子纠缠时，更新带宽可以达到 $\lceil \alpha/2 \rceil \cdot k \log_2 q$ 比特等效值，即带宽减少了近 2 倍。对于 $\alpha = 2$，一个 $[[k, k-2]]_q$ CSS码可以在每个辅助节点使用一个量子比特的情况下实现该带宽。对于一般情况 $\alpha$，一个 $[[\lceil \alpha/2 \rceil k, \lceil \alpha/2 \rceil k - \alpha]]_q$ CSS码可以在每个辅助节点使用 $\lceil \alpha/2 \rceil$ 个量子比特的情况下实现该界限。匹配的逆定理使用了超密编码界限：过期节点持有所有传输的量子比特及其纠缠伙伴，因此对于维度为 $D$ 的情况，每个辅助节点的信道最多支持 $D^2$ 个可区分信号。该结果适用于所有具有足够大素数 $q$ 的 $(n,k)$ 对。
AI.summary: 本文研究了分布式存储系统中的遗忘更新问题，证明了利用量子纠缠资源可以有效地将更新带宽需求降低至经典下界的一半。通过构造特定的CSS量子码，实现了这一带宽优化，并利用超密编码理论证明了该方案的边界。
AI.keywords: 量子纠缠, 分布式存储, 遗忘更新, 带宽优化, CSS码
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地将量子信息理论（特别是超密编码）应用于分布式存储系统的更新带宽优化问题，证明了量子纠缠可以突破经典通信的带宽限制，在特定场景下实现了带宽减半。这是一个理论创新，展示了量子资源在提升传统存储系统效率方面的潜力。

title: Sensing Intelligence as a Trainable Metamaterial Property
summary: In biological systems, sensing is not performed by the brain alone: the body deforms, vibrates, and filters external stimuli before they are transduced into neural signals. In engineered systems, this processing burden is placed largely on electronics and computation, while the mechanical body is usually designed only for strength and stability. Here, we present sensing intelligence as a trainable property of the body. We show that the geometry of a metamaterial can be optimized to reshape external stimuli into internal signals that are easier for a neural network to interpret. Rather than hand-designing this physical preprocessing, we let the neural network train its own body for sensing by backpropagating the sensing loss to the body's design parameters through differentiable simulation. Across numerical and experimental sensing scenarios, the optimized body improves sensing accuracy by up to fivefold or reduces the number of required electronic sensors by nearly an order of magnitude.

AI.title_translation: 作为可训练元材料属性的感知智能
AI.tldr: 该研究通过可微仿真优化元材料的物理结构，使其具备“感知智能”，从而在不依赖复杂电子计算的情况下，大幅提升感知精度或降低硬件成本。
AI.motivation: 传统工程系统过度依赖电子计算，而忽视了物理身体在感知过程中的处理潜力。作者旨在通过赋予材料“感知智能”，减轻后端计算负担，模仿生物系统利用身体结构进行信息过滤和处理的机制。
AI.method: 提出一种将元材料几何参数作为可训练变量的方法，利用可微仿真技术，通过反向传播感知损失函数来自动优化物理结构，使其作为预处理器将外部刺激转化为更易于被神经网络解释的信号。
AI.result: 在数值和实验场景中，优化后的物理结构将感知准确率提升了高达5倍，或者将所需电子传感器的数量减少了近一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 通过可微仿真实现元材料结构的端到端优化，可以显著提升感知系统的准确性并降低硬件需求，验证了物理结构作为“计算资源”的潜力。
AI.translation: 在生物系统中，感知并非仅由大脑完成：身体在刺激被转化为神经信号之前，会对其进行变形、振动和过滤。在工程系统中，这种处理负担主要由电子设备和计算承担，而机械结构通常仅为强度和稳定性而设计。本文提出将感知智能作为身体的一种可训练属性。我们展示了元材料的几何结构可以通过优化，将外部刺激重塑为更容易被神经网络解释的内部信号。我们没有进行物理预处理的手动设计，而是通过可微仿真将感知损失反向传播到身体的设计参数，让神经网络为感知任务“训练”其自身的身体。在数值和实验感知场景中，优化后的身体将感知准确率提高了五倍，或将所需的电子传感器数量减少了近一个数量级。
AI.summary: 本文提出将元材料的几何结构作为可训练的感知组件。通过可微仿真，研究人员能够自动优化物理结构，使其预处理外部刺激，从而显著提升感知系统的效率和精度，实现了感知任务中计算负担从电子端向物理端的有效转移。
AI.keywords: 元材料, 感知智能, 具身智能, 可微仿真, 物理预处理
AI.comments: 该研究通过将“感知智能”赋予物理结构，打破了传统感知系统中传感器与计算分离的范式，体现了具身智能（Embodied Intelligence）的深刻见解。其创新性在于将物理结构设计纳入端到端的可微学习框架，为低功耗、高效能感知系统的设计提供了新思路。

title: Statistical and Numerical Convergence in Stochastic Equilibrium
summary: This paper sets out the most general computational and econometric implications of the rigorous stochastic equilibrium theory from SELCKE (Staines (2024a)) arXiv:2312.16214. The analytical backbone is the discovery that the system converges geometrically to long-run equilibrium, at a rate given by the greater of the eigenvalue or inverse eigenvalue (from outside) closest to the unit circle and the maximum shock persistence. High-order shocks converge faster. I develop a simulation procedure to test, with asymptotic power, whether stochastic equilibrium exists for a particular model. The fundamental approximation result asserts that, whatever the order of expansion or loss function, the stochastic steady state delivers the most accurate perturbation solution. I also show that super-consistent parameter estimators $O(1/T)$ arise whenever second-order terms vanish. Besides Calvo, I study stochastic equilibrium in two alternative pricing models. Dynamics simplify considerably. I bound the time the impulse response peaks, by the maximum lag in the errors. This lends empirical support to Taylor contracts, although there are issues surrounding unit roots and the strong cost-channel. For menu costs, I demonstrate that the initial price distribution decays away super-exponentially, producing a system equivalent to Calvo with an endogenous reset probability. The impact of idiosyncratic disturbances appears as an additional wedge between actual and efficient output. Blow-up of the objective function at the boundary is proven, with the help of new distributional arguments, so the model meets existing eigenvalue existence conditions for the recursive equilibrium. Along the way, new light is shone on existing theoretical models and statistical procedures.

title: Acquisition state behaves as a structured, measurable variable governing lung-nodule AI: kernel-driven measurement instability and noise-driven detection fragility, invisible to DICOM metadata
summary: AI governance for medical imaging is formalizing: the 2026 ACR-SIIM Practice Parameter recommends local acceptance testing and ongoing drift monitoring, and the ACR Assess-AI registry monitors AI outputs using DICOM metadata for context. We argue that a necessary, currently unmonitored layer sits beneath output metrics: whether incoming studies remain within the acquisition envelope a model was validated on. Using a LUNA16-trained MONAI RetinaNet lung-nodule detector, we test whether acquisition state behaves as a structured, measurable variable. On real paired CT differing only in reconstruction kernel (NLST B30f vs B80f), kernel alone shifted AI-measured diameter and flipped a Fleischner size category in 5.2% (8 of 155) of nodules at fixed patient and acquisition, while detection confidence was unchanged (Wilcoxon p=0.22). Under controlled LIDC-IDRI perturbations the effects dissociated by axis: the noise axis degraded detection confidence (p=5.9e-32, concentrated in nodules under 6 mm) but not measurement, while the frequency/kernel axis corrupted measurement (p=8.6e-13) but not detection. A 4-feature pixel fingerprint recovered reconstruction identity (patient-level AUC about 0.95 on real CT, 0.995 on a QIBA phantom) where the ConvolutionKernel DICOM tag was uninformative (identical labels across reconstructions). The kernel axis transported across four manufacturers (leave-one-vendor-out AUC 0.94-0.98, matching the within-vendor ceiling). Acquisition state thus maps to distinct AI failure modes, frequency content to measurement reliability and noise to detection sensitivity, and is not recoverable from metadata. Acquisition-aware, input-side validation is the missing layer for the acceptance-testing and drift-monitoring requirements now entering imaging-AI accreditation.

AI.title_translation: 获取状态作为一种结构化、可测量的变量支配着肺结节AI：核函数驱动的测量不稳定性与噪声驱动的检测脆弱性，且在DICOM元数据中不可见
AI.tldr: 医学影像AI的性能受图像获取状态（如核函数和噪声）影响，这些因素无法从DICOM标签中获知，但会导致AI测量偏差或检测失效，因此必须建立基于输入端的AI验证机制。
AI.motivation: 现有的医学AI监管（如ACR-SIIM）主要关注输出指标和DICOM元数据，但忽略了输入数据是否处于模型验证时的“获取包络（acquisition envelope）”内，导致AI在实际临床中存在未被发现的失效模式。
AI.method: 使用在LUNA16数据集上训练的MONAI RetinaNet肺结节检测器；在真实CT数据（NLST B30f vs B80f核函数对比）和LIDC-IDRI控制扰动下进行测试；使用4特征像素指纹识别重建算法，并对比DICOM标签的有效性；通过留一厂商验证法评估泛化性。
AI.result: 重建核函数（Kernel）改变会导致AI测量直径偏移，甚至改变临床分类；噪声主要导致检测置信度下降，特别是对小于6mm的结节。4特征像素指纹能高精度识别重建算法，而DICOM标签无效。获取状态与特定的AI失效模式直接相关，且具有跨厂商泛化性。
AI.conclusion: “获取状态”是影响AI性能的关键隐变量，无法从DICOM元数据中恢复。重建核函数影响测量可靠性，而噪声影响检测灵敏度。未来的AI监管必须引入基于输入图像的自动化验证机制。
AI.translation: 医学影像AI治理正趋于规范化：2026年ACR-SIIM实践参数建议进行本地验收测试和持续的漂移监测，ACR Assess-AI注册中心则利用DICOM元数据监测AI输出。我们认为，在输出指标之下存在一个必要且目前未被监测的层面：输入研究是否仍在模型验证时的获取包络内。使用在LUNA16上训练的MONAI RetinaNet肺结节检测器，我们测试了获取状态是否表现为一种结构化的、可测量的变量。在仅重建核函数（NLST B30f vs B80f）不同的真实配对CT上，仅核函数的改变就导致5.2%（8/155）的结节在固定患者和获取条件下，AI测量直径发生偏移并改变了Fleischner大小分类，而检测置信度未变（Wilcoxon p=0.22）。在受控的LIDC-IDRI扰动下，效应按维度分离：噪声轴降低了检测置信度（p=5.9e-32，集中在6mm以下结节），但不影响测量；而频率/核函数轴破坏了测量（p=8.6e-13），但不影响检测。一个4特征像素指纹恢复了重建身份（真实CT上患者级AUC约为0.95，QIBA体模上为0.995），而ConvolutionKernel DICOM标签无效（不同重建间标签相同）。核函数轴在四个制造商间具有跨越性（留一厂商验证AUC 0.94-0.98，符合厂商内上限）。因此，获取状态映射到不同的AI失效模式，频率内容对应测量可靠性，噪声对应检测灵敏度，且无法从元数据中恢复。获取感知、输入端的验证是目前进入影像AI认证所需的验收测试和漂移监测要求中缺失的一环。
AI.summary: 本文提出“获取状态”是影响医学影像AI性能的关键变量，却往往被现有的DICOM元数据忽略。研究发现，重建核函数和图像噪声分别独立干扰AI的测量准确性和检测灵敏度。作者通过像素指纹技术证明了这些状态可被测量，并建议将基于输入端的验证纳入医学AI的质量控制流程。
AI.keywords: 医学影像AI, 肺结节检测, DICOM元数据, 获取状态, 质量控制
AI.comments: 本文创新性地揭示了医学影像AI在DICOM元数据之外存在的“获取状态”隐变量问题。通过实验证明了重建核函数（kernel）和图像噪声分别独立影响AI的测量准确性和检测灵敏度，且这些信息无法通过现有的DICOM标签获取。这对AI的临床部署、质量控制及监管标准（如ACR-SIIM）具有重要的指导意义，强调了输入端验证的必要性。

title: Foundations of Practical Quantum Advantage in Quantum-Informed Machine Learning for Predicting Chaos
summary: We develop theoretical foundations for a practical quantum-advantage mechanism in quantum-informed machine learning for chaotic dynamical systems. A family of $k$-indexed higher-order quantum statistical priors (Q-Priors) hosts the $k$-point marginal of the invariant measure on $n_q = kq$ qubits, extending the single-site construction of prior work. We prove a two-stage advantage. In the representation stage, superposition and entanglement compactly store non-factorisable spatial correlations of the invariant measure on $n_q$ qubits. In the extraction stage, joint Bell measurements on two copies estimate any post hoc Pauli functional with a copy-pair count independent of $n_q$, whereas any adaptive single-copy protocol for the corresponding full-Pauli read-out requires $Ω(2^{n_q})$ copies; this is a provable quantum-classical separation in copy-measurement complexity. The two-copy read-out is realised in simulation and on IQM superconducting processors. Two case studies instantiate the mechanism in workflows of independent scientific value: a turbulent channel-flow study in which the two-copy read-out yields a named non-diagonal correlator of the invariant measure, and a medium-range weather forecasting workflow on the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts ERA5 reanalysis in which the diagonal $k \leq 2$ Q-Prior steers a Koopman rollout, improves anomaly-correlation skill by 10 to 39\% across 48 to 240\,h lead times and stabilises long-horizon rollouts against collapse onto a static mean field. Together, the mechanism and these workflow instantiations satisfy our practical-advantage definition, identifying a candidate route to practical quantum advantage before fault-tolerant hardware.

AI.title_translation: 混沌预测中量子启发机器学习实用量子优势的基础研究
AI.tldr: 研究提出了一种利用量子纠缠和两拷贝测量实现混沌系统预测的方法，在气象预报任务中证明了其优于传统方法的实用量子优势。
AI.motivation: 探索在当前非容错量子硬件条件下，如何通过量子信息技术在混沌动力系统预测任务中获得实际的量子计算优势。
AI.method: 提出一种k索引的高阶量子统计先验（Q-Priors）来存储混沌系统不变测度的空间相关性；利用叠加和纠缠进行紧凑表示，并通过两拷贝联合贝尔测量实现高效的Pauli泛函提取，从而在拷贝测量复杂度上实现量子-经典分离。
AI.result: 在理论上证明了拷贝测量复杂度的量子-经典分离；在模拟和IQM超导处理器上实现了两拷贝读出；在湍流通道流和ERA5气象预测任务中表现优异，显著提升了预测技能并稳定了长期演化。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过理论证明和实验验证，确立了一种利用量子统计先验在混沌系统预测中实现实用量子优势的机制，为近期量子硬件的应用提供了有力支持。
AI.translation: 我们为混沌动力系统量子启发机器学习中的实用量子优势机制建立了理论基础。一族k索引的高阶量子统计先验（Q-Priors）在n_q = kq个量子比特上承载了不变测度的k点边缘分布，扩展了早期工作的单点构造。我们证明了两个阶段的优势。在表示阶段，叠加和纠缠紧凑地存储了n_q个量子比特上不变测度的非因子化空间相关性。在提取阶段，两个拷贝上的联合贝尔测量估计任意事后Pauli泛函所需的拷贝对数量与n_q无关，而对应的全Pauli读出的任何自适应单拷贝协议需要Ω(2^{n_q})个拷贝；这是一种可证明的量子-经典拷贝测量复杂度分离。双拷贝读出在模拟和IQM超导处理器上实现。两个案例研究在具有独立科学价值的工作流中实例化了该机制：一个湍流通道流研究，其中双拷贝读出产生了不变测度的命名非对角相关器；以及一个基于欧洲中期天气预报中心ERA5再分析的中期天气预报工作流，其中对角k≤2 Q-Prior引导了Koopman展开，在48至240小时的预报时效内将异常相关技能提高了10%至39%，并稳定了长期展开以防止坍缩到静态平均场。总之，该机制及其工作流实例化满足了我们对实用优势的定义，确定了在容错硬件出现之前实现实用量子优势的潜在途径。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了量子机器学习在混沌系统预测中的应用，提出了一种基于量子统计先验（Q-Priors）的机制，通过高效存储空间相关性和两拷贝测量协议，实现了在拷贝测量复杂度上的量子优势，并在气象预测等实际任务中验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 量子机器学习, 混沌动力学, 量子统计先验, 量子优势, 气象预测
AI.comments: 该研究在量子机器学习领域具有重要意义，通过引入量子统计先验（Q-Priors）和两阶段优势机制，为在非容错量子硬件上实现实用量子优势提供了可行的路径。其创新点在于将量子纠缠与混沌动力学预测相结合，并通过实际气象预测任务证明了其应用潜力。限制在于目前主要依赖于两拷贝测量方案，且在更复杂系统中的扩展性仍需进一步验证。

title: AgentRivet: an automated system for producing Rivet routines from journal publications
summary: Particle physics collider experiments provide Rivet routines as part of the analysis preservation strategy for model-independent measurements. Rivet is a C++ toolkit that allow new theoretical models to be compared to the measurements, thus aiding the development and tuning of Monte Carlo event generators as well as searches for physics beyond the Standard Model. However, analysis coverage is known to be incomplete, with only 39% of measurements having documented and publicly available Rivet routines. In this article, we design and implement an automated workflow based on Large Language Models with the goal of providing the missing routines. This multi-step workflow, referred to as AgentRivet, extracts the physics analysis information from published papers and writes the missing Rivet routines, with intermediate code- and physics- reviews as part of an autonomous quality control. We report the results obtained using commercial Large Language Models, provided by OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, for two recent measurements from the ATLAS and CMS experiments. We find that AgentRivet produces competent Rivet routines with few syntax errors. The physics fidelity of the routines is reasonable and follows the explanations given in the relevant publications. Nevertheless, physics-implementation issues do arise and are investigated using the artefacts produced by AgentRivet. The majority of physics implementation issues arise from subtle-but-ambiguous definitions in the given publication, although some models struggle to implement complex observables even when clear definitions are given.

title: Quantum Cinema: An Interactive Cinematic Exploration of Quantum Computing Hardware via Generative World Models
summary: Quantum computing promises transformative advances across science and industry, yet the physical hardware that enables these computations remains invisible to the public: quantum processors operate inside sealed dilution refrigerators at temperatures near absolute zero, making direct observation impossible. This "imagination gap" between quantum computing's growing societal impact and the public's ability to visualize it represents a significant barrier to quantum literacy and workforce development. We present Quantum Cinema, an open-source, browser-based interactive application that closes this gap by transforming invisible quantum hardware into explorable, cinematic experiences using generative world models. Quantum Cinema guides users through a four-act narrative -- from the foundational Nobel Prize-winning science of quantum entanglement, through curated video introductions to three major quantum computing architectures (trapped-ion, neutral-atom, and superconducting systems), into immersive three-dimensional generative worlds that make invisible quantum phenomena observable, and finally to interactive radar-chart comparisons grounded in real quantum device specifications. All three-dimensional environments are generated using WorldLabs' generative world model platform and are scientifically grounded in curated metrics from Amazon Web Services (AWS) Braket quantum hardware. Quantum Cinema requires no installation, no specialized hardware, and no quantum computing background. It is designed to serve two distinct communities: scholars and developers seeking to replicate or extend the platform, and educators, researchers, and science communicators seeking an intuitive tool for explaining quantum hardware to diverse audiences. This paper describes the system architecture, the generative world model pipeline, use cases for both communities, and directions for future work.

title: Statistical Foundations of LLM-based A/B Testing: A Surrogacy Framework for Human Causal Inference
summary: Organizations and researchers show increasing interest in using large language models (LLMs) in place of human participants in A/B tests, in the hope of experimenting faster and at lower cost. We study when a treatment effect estimated on LLM outcomes can recover the effect for the human population of interest. Distributional equivalence between LLM and human outcomes would make any standard estimator valid but is unrealistic. We therefore develop a statistical framework that adapts surrogate endpoint theory to LLMs, showing that calibrating LLM outcomes to human outcomes identifies the average treatment effect under surrogacy and comparability conditions that are jointly weaker than distributional equivalence. We present a falsification test for surrogacy and a bound on the worst-case bias from limited overlap between the LLM and human samples. We further show that the stochasticity inherent to LLMs can weaken surrogacy for identification while also introducing bias and variance during estimation, but that using an average over multiple LLM draws per unit as the surrogate mitigates these issues. Simulations validate the results, and an empirical application to the Upworthy Research Archive dataset shows that raw LLM outputs recover only 39% of the human treatment effect while nonparametric calibration closes the gap. A central takeaway is that A/B testing on LLM responses is correct only by assumption, whereas A/B testing on humans is correct by design, and that the required assumptions are hardest to justify precisely where LLMs promise the greatest benefit. We discuss the choice of LLM, prompting, and temperature as design variables, the compounded challenge posed by long-term outcomes, and how to size human pilot studies for validation.

title: Tensor-based second-order causal discovery
comments: 27 pages, 7 figures. Code available at https://github.com/QWE123665/Tensor-based-Second-order-Causal-Discovery Replacement: Corrected typo in author's name
summary: Causal discovery seeks to uncover the causal dependencies among variables. For this purpose, we propose an algorithm called Tensor-based Second-order Causal Discovery (TSCD). Its input is a tensor obtained from the covariance matrices of observational and interventional data. Assuming the causal dependencies follow a linear structural equation model on a directed acyclic graph (DAG), TSCD outputs the DAG and the functions on its edges, requiring only that the noise variables are uncorrelated. We also implement a version of the approach for nonlinear models. Our focus on second-order statistics (via the covariance matrices) is motivated by their statistical and computational efficiency relative to higher-order moments, their identifiability relative to first-order statistics, and that they work regardless of whether the variables are Gaussian. We show that TSCD has identifiable causal order and parameters from a number of interventions that is logarithmic in the number of variables. Experiments show that TSCD is robust to noise, competitive with existing methods, and scales to hundreds of variables.

AI.title_translation: 基于张量的二阶因果发现
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用协方差矩阵（二阶统计量）进行因果发现的算法，在保证计算高效的同时，实现了对大规模因果结构的高精度识别。
AI.motivation: 现有的因果发现方法在处理高阶矩时计算复杂，且一阶统计量难以保证可识别性。作者旨在利用二阶统计量（协方差矩阵）实现统计与计算上的高效，同时克服对数据分布（如高斯分布）的限制。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于张量的二阶因果发现（TSCD）算法。该算法利用观测数据和干预数据的协方差矩阵构建张量，基于线性结构方程模型（DAG）进行因果结构及边函数的识别，并扩展至非线性模型。
AI.result: 实验表明，TSCD 算法在处理百级变量时表现出良好的扩展性，对噪声具有鲁棒性，且在所需的干预次数上达到对数级复杂度，性能优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: TSCD 算法通过二阶统计量有效实现了因果发现，证明了在对数级干预数量下即可识别因果顺序和参数，且具有良好的扩展性和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 因果发现旨在揭示变量间的因果依赖关系。为此，我们提出了一种称为基于张量的二阶因果发现（TSCD）的算法。该算法的输入是由观测数据和干预数据的协方差矩阵构成的张量。假设因果依赖遵循有向无环图（DAG）上的线性结构方程模型，TSCD 输出 DAG 及其边上的函数，仅要求噪声变量是不相关的。我们还实现了该方法的非线性模型版本。我们专注于二阶统计量（通过协方差矩阵）是受其相对于高阶矩在统计和计算效率上的优势、相对于一阶统计量在可识别性上的优势，以及它们无论变量是否为高斯分布均可工作的特性所驱动。我们证明了 TSCD 可以从与变量数量成对数关系的干预次数中识别出因果顺序和参数。实验表明，TSCD 对噪声具有鲁棒性，与现有方法相比具有竞争力，并可扩展到数百个变量。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于张量的二阶因果发现算法（TSCD）。该方法通过整合观测数据和干预数据的协方差矩阵，在不需要高阶矩的情况下，高效识别线性结构方程模型下的因果图及其边函数，并具备处理非线性模型的能力。
AI.keywords: 因果发现, 张量, 二阶统计量, 线性结构方程模型, 协方差矩阵
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于利用二阶统计量（协方差矩阵）构建张量，从而在保持计算效率的同时实现了因果结构的识别。相比于依赖非高斯性或高阶矩的方法，该方法在处理大规模变量时表现出更好的可扩展性和鲁棒性。

title: TimeLAVA: Learning-Agnostic Data Valuation for Time Series
summary: Data valuation quantifies the intrinsic quality of individual samples to enable principled data curation, quality control, and robust learning. For time series in critical domains such as healthcare, finance, and industrial monitoring, effective valuation methods are essential yet fundamentally lacking. Existing approaches are either model-dependent, limiting their generalizability, or designed for i.i.d. data and thus fail to capture temporal dependencies, multi-scale patterns, and non-stationary dynamics inherent to sequential data. We introduce TimeLAVA, a learning-agnostic framework that values temporal segments by their marginal contribution to minimizing distributional discrepancy between evaluated and reference data. At its core is a novel Selective Wavelet-based Wasserstein discrepancy combining multi-scale wavelet transforms for temporal localization with unbalanced optimal transport for robustness to distributional shifts. Segment values are efficiently computed via sensitivity analysis without requiring model training and aggregated into point-wise scores. We provide theoretical guarantees linking valuation to model-agnostic generalization and prove bounded sensitivity to outlier contamination. Extensive experiments across anomaly detection, data pruning, and label noise detection demonstrate that TimeLAVA produces significantly more informative value scores than existing methods on diverse real-world datasets.

AI.title_translation: TimeLAVA：面向时间序列的学习无关型数据评估方法
AI.tldr: TimeLAVA 是一种无需训练模型即可评估时间序列数据质量的新框架，通过小波分析和最优传输技术，有效解决了时序数据中复杂的分布与动态依赖问题。
AI.motivation: 现有数据评估方法大多依赖于特定的模型，且主要针对独立同分布（i.i.d.）数据设计，无法有效处理时间序列数据中的时间依赖性、多尺度模式及非平稳动态特征。
AI.method: 提出 TimeLAVA 框架，采用基于选择性小波的 Wasserstein 差异（Selective Wavelet-based Wasserstein discrepancy），结合多尺度小波变换进行时域定位，利用非平衡最优传输处理分布偏移，并通过敏感性分析计算数据片段的贡献度。
AI.result: 在异常检测、数据剪枝和标签噪声检测等任务的实验中，TimeLAVA 表现出比现有方法更优的评估效果，并提供了关于模型无关泛化和对异常值敏感性的理论保证。
AI.conclusion: TimeLAVA 提供了一种高效、鲁棒且具有理论支撑的时间序列数据评估方法，能够有效应用于数据清洗、异常检测等任务，优于现有的模型依赖型方法。
AI.translation: 数据评估通过量化单个样本的内在质量，从而实现原则性的数据管理、质量控制和稳健学习。对于医疗、金融和工业监控等关键领域的时间序列而言，有效的评估方法至关重要，但目前在本质上仍然缺失。现有的方法要么依赖于模型，限制了其泛化能力；要么是为独立同分布（i.i.d.）数据设计的，因此无法捕获序列数据固有的时间依赖性、多尺度模式和非平稳动态。我们引入了 TimeLAVA，这是一个学习无关的框架，通过评估片段对最小化评估数据与参考数据之间分布差异的边际贡献来对其进行价值评估。其核心是一种新型的基于选择性小波的 Wasserstein 差异，它结合了用于时域定位的多尺度小波变换和用于处理分布偏移鲁棒性的非平衡最优传输。片段价值通过敏感性分析高效计算，无需模型训练，并聚合成点级分数。我们提供了将评估与模型无关泛化联系起来的理论保证，并证明了其对离群值污染的敏感性是有界的。在异常检测、数据剪枝和标签噪声检测方面的广泛实验表明，在多样化的现实数据集上，TimeLAVA 产生的价值分数比现有方法更具信息量。
AI.summary: TimeLAVA 是一种针对时间序列数据的学习无关型评估框架。它通过计算数据片段对最小化分布差异的边际贡献来评估其价值，利用小波变换和最优传输理论捕获时序数据的复杂动态特征，实现了高效且鲁棒的评估。
AI.keywords: 时间序列, 数据评估, 小波变换, 最优传输, 学习无关法
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个不依赖于特定学习模型的评估框架（Learning-Agnostic），通过结合小波变换与最优传输理论来处理时间序列特有的多尺度和非平稳性。这弥补了现有方法在处理时序数据依赖性及泛化能力上的不足，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Cross-Dataset, Age, and Gender Generalization: A Comprehensive Analysis of Fine-Tuning Strategies for Low-Resource Children's ASR
summary: The challenge associated with recognizing dysarthric speech primarily arises from pronounced acoustic variability attributed to impaired articulatory precision. Past research has demonstrated improved recognition through the use of hybrid DNN/HMM sequence discriminative training. This paper presents a comprehensive investigation of various combinations of acoustic features tailored to different Acoustic Models, offering suitable feature selections for each. The incorporation of Pitch features notably improved recognition performance, especially for sentence recognition tasks involving dysarthric speech. Through a systematic examination of the TORGO database, we have demonstrated the potential to enhance the performance of the state-of-the-art Factorized Time Delay Neural Network (F-TDNN) model for recognizing dysarthric speech. Our methods, implemented with the F-TDNN model, resulted in a 4.65\% relative improvement in isolated word recognition and a 4.63\% relative improvement in sentence recognition for dysarthric speech, compared to previous research. This improvement effectively compensates for speech variability, attributable to our deliberate selection of the number of overlapping frames between consecutive training example chunks.

title: Quantum ring all-reduce: communication and privacy advantages for distributed learning
comments: 23 pages, 1 figure / v2: Minor expository corrections; results unchanged
summary: Machine learning models have scaled to unprecedented sizes, making training across distributed devices the de facto standard in the field. In this work, we explore how quantum communications can make distributed training both more communication-efficient and information-theoretically private, for both classical and quantum learning models. Ring all-reduce is the foundational communication primitive for large-scale distributed training. We present a quantum version that reduces per-link online communication by a provably optimal factor of two using pre-shared entanglement and superdense coding, without requiring the learning model or gradient computation to change. Beyond bandwidth, the primitive enables privacy guarantees that are information-theoretically impossible for any classical protocol, achieving composable ε-secure aggregation, via verified entanglement, at a 2x overhead in GHZ copies. Our hybrid quantum-classical communication architecture yields simultaneous communication and security advantages for large scale distributed training, regardless of whether the learning itself is quantum or classical. Finally, we characterise quantum advantages in gradient conflict detection for server-to-client communication under bandwidth constraints, a setting that arises after ring all-reduce is completed, when full gradient broadcast to external clients is infeasible. Two variants of the problem admit different separations. For margin-based alignment testing (\textsc{GapIP}_τ), the quantum advantage is quadratic in the margin parameter: \widetilde{O}(τ^{-1}\log P) qubits versus \widetilde{O}(\min(\τ^{-2},P)) bits. For sign-consistency auditing against a private parameter matching (\textsc{TieAudit}_ε), the advantage represents an exponential separation in communication complexity: Ω(\sqrt{P}) bits whereas O(ε^{-2}\log P) qubits suffice.

title: Sexualised synthetic personas encode and amplify gendered power asymmetries through voice
summary: This work examines sexualised AI-generated English-speaking voices offered by a popular commercial platform. New technologies may enable sexual empowerment and greater diversity in gender expression, yet toxic masculinity, heteronormativity, and the abuse of women and LGBTQ+ people remain pervasive online. Drawing on a Feminist HCI perspective, we examine how commercial voice AI systems reproduce and circulate particular performances of gender. We conducted a listening experiment with a diverse group of listeners, combining quantitative adjective selection, qualitative free-text responses, and acoustic analysis. Participants evaluated male- and female-coded voices presented with either sexualised scripts or neutral text. Results reveal a narrow range of gender expression, largely binary and heteronormative. Female-coded voices are more frequently described using sexualised and submissive terms, while male-coded voices are more often associated with dominance and positive traits.

AI.title_translation: 性别化的合成人设通过语音编码并放大了性别权力不对称
AI.tldr: 研究表明，商业AI语音系统通过将女性化声音与顺从/性化标签绑定，将男性化声音与支配地位绑定，加剧了现实社会中的性别权力不平等。
AI.motivation: 探讨商业AI语音平台中是否存在性别权力不对称，以及这些系统如何通过性化表达再现和传播社会中的性别偏见与有毒文化。
AI.method: 采用女权主义人机交互视角，通过听觉实验（包括定量形容词选择、定性自由文本响应）以及声学分析，对比评估了不同性别编码（男女）在性化脚本与中性文本下的表现。
AI.result: 研究发现AI语音的性别表达范围狭窄，呈现出明显的二元论和异性恋规范。女性化语音被更多地描述为“性化”和“顺从”，而男性化语音则更多与“支配”和“积极特质”相关联。
AI.conclusion: 商业AI语音系统通过受限且刻板的性别化表达，强化了异性恋规范和性别权力不对称。女性化语音更易被赋予顺从和性化标签，而男性化语音则与支配地位相关联。
AI.translation: 本研究考察了一个流行商业平台所提供的性化AI生成英语语音。新技术可能有助于实现性赋权和性别表达的多样化，但有毒的男性气概、异性恋规范以及对女性和LGBTQ+群体的虐待在网络上依然普遍。借鉴女权主义人机交互（Feminist HCI）的视角，我们研究了商业语音AI系统如何再现和传播特定的性别表现。我们与一组多元化的听众进行了听觉实验，结合了定量形容词选择、定性自由文本响应和声学分析。参与者评估了呈现性化脚本或中性文本的男性和女性编码声音。结果揭示了性别表达范围的狭窄，在很大程度上是二元和异性恋规范的。女性编码的声音更频繁地使用性化和顺从的术语来描述，而男性编码的声音则更多地与支配和积极特质联系在一起。
AI.summary: 本研究调查了商业AI语音平台中的性别化表现，利用听觉实验和声学分析揭示了这些系统如何通过性化脚本强化性别刻板印象。研究发现，AI语音不仅未能促进多元表达，反而固化了女性顺从、男性支配的权力不对称结构。
AI.keywords: 人工智能语音, 性别权力不对称, 女权主义人机交互, 性别化脚本, 刻板印象
AI.comments: 该研究通过女权主义人机交互（Feminist HCI）视角，揭示了商业AI语音平台在设计中存在的性别偏见，指出技术并非中立，而是社会权力结构在数字产品中的延伸。其创新之处在于结合了听觉实验与声学分析，量化了AI语音中潜藏的性别不平等。

title: Anticipating the Optimism Gap: Predicting Distribution-Shift Degradation of RF-Impairment Detectors from In-Distribution Statistics
summary: Detectors for GNSS radio-frequency impairments (jamming, spoofing, multipath) are usually reported with a single AUC measured on the distribution they were tuned on. That number falls once conditions move, and the size of the drop is rarely known in advance because labelled field data is scarce. We ask whether this optimism can be predicted before any out-of-distribution data is seen. On an open, parameter-grounded synthetic testbed with a tunable severity shift, we evaluate thirteen detectors (five physics baselines, full-feature logistic regression and multilayer perceptrons, and single-feature learned controls) across four impairment classes. The optimism gap, the difference between in-distribution and shifted AUC, grows monotonically as the shift deepens (mean Spearman correlation 0.50). It is driven by how many observables a detector uses rather than by whether it is learned, and it varies systematically by class. Centrally, a ridge model built only from in-distribution score statistics predicts the gap for a detector it has never seen (R^2 = 0.47) and for an impairment class it has never seen (R^2 = 0.46); both are significant against a 2000-fold permutation null (p < 0.001) and survive removing the feature that is, by construction, part of the target. The headline findings are synthetic. We then run the pre-registered protocol on three open field corpora: on Jammertest 2024 the cross-detector prediction holds (R^2 = 0.11, p = 0.009), and on SatGrid, whose spoofer power sweep gives a calibrated severity axis, in-distribution AUC overstates higher-severity AUC by up to 0.22 and to the point of sign inversion, with in-distribution AUC and realised gap perfectly rank-correlated (Spearman rho = 1.0). The mechanism survives contact with real data, at smaller magnitude than in simulation. We release the testbed, a software-receiver front end, the ingest adapters and the protocol.

title: Theorist Toolbox: Tools for Agent Based LLM-assisted economic theory Research
summary: Empirical economists often start their projects with a toolbox. Shared packages, replication archives, and circulated guides shorten the time between and idea and a rough initial draft. Theorists, on the other-hand, largely start from a blank page. By 2026, large language models can a produce and check nontrivial mathematics. The can also hallucinate and write wrong claims very convincingly. The current bottleneck on machine-assisted theory is no longer production but trust: a model will claim to prove a false theorem as readily as a true one. Building on recent attempts in mathematics, I present 3 methods for doing economic theory with a language model. These methods differ on how the work is verified: a single disciplined pass, an adversarial prover-verifier pair (Claude Opus~4.8 proposing, OpenAI Codex refuting), and a structured multi-agent project with a reviewer gate (inspired by the Google co-mathematician architecture). I demonstrate these protocols on one open worked example: designing a Groves/Pigouvian incentive mechanism for the Gans--Kominers eigengrade model of grade inflation. None of the three runs produced a strict direct-revelation VCG/Clarke mechanism (as requested, perhaps due to the non-existence of such mechanism). Three phenomena recur. First, convergent discovery: two runs derive the same effective-resistance externality kernel on opposite margins. Second, adversarial verification is load-bearing: the pair caught three of its own false claims and the gate rejected a sub-goal. Third, polish is not rigor: the most finished-looking output was the least verified. The methodological takeaway is that external verification, not model capability, is the design variable.

title: ZeroGVC: Zero-Shot Generative Video Compression with Autoregressive Diffusion Priors
summary: Recent generative video compression methods leverage powerful generative priors to achieve perceptually pleasing reconstructions. However, most existing approaches require additional training to adapt generative models to produce realistic reconstructions from compact representations. In this paper, we propose ZeroGVC, a zero-shot generative video compression framework that leverages pretrained autoregressive diffusion priors for low-delay video reconstruction. ZeroGVC encodes the first frame of each group of pictures (GOP) with an image codec and represents subsequent P-frames through Codebook-Guided Autoregressive Latent Compression. This design is motivated by our observation that the compression scheme of denoising diffusion codebook models is effective in few-step consistency sampling. By selecting compact combinations of reproducible codebook noise vectors, ZeroGVC steers the latent denoising trajectory toward the target P-frame while allowing the decoder to reproduce the same trajectory in only a few denoising steps. In addition, we design an optional bidirectional reference mode that mitigates error propagation by leveraging the next I-frame context without introducing any additional bitrate overhead. Extensive experiments on standard video compression benchmarks demonstrate that ZeroGVC achieves superior perceptual reconstruction quality at ultra-low bitrates without any additional training.

AI.title_translation: ZeroGVC：基于自回归扩散先验的零样本生成式视频压缩
AI.tldr: ZeroGVC 是一种无需额外训练的零样本视频压缩方法，它利用预训练的扩散模型先验，通过高效的代码本引导潜空间压缩实现超低码率下的高质量视频重建。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成式视频压缩方法通常需要针对性训练来适应紧凑表示，这限制了其灵活性和应用范围。因此，研究旨在开发一种无需额外训练的零样本方法，利用预训练的生成先验来实现高效的视频重建。
AI.method: 提出 ZeroGVC 框架，利用图像编码器处理每组图片（GOP）的首帧，并引入“代码本引导的自回归潜空间压缩”来处理后续 P 帧；通过选择可复现的代码本噪声向量组合来引导潜空间去噪轨迹，并设计可选的双向参考模式以减少误差传播。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，ZeroGVC 在标准视频压缩基准测试中，在超低码率下实现了卓越的感知重建质量，且无需任何额外的训练过程。
AI.conclusion: ZeroGVC 证明了在零样本条件下，利用预训练的扩散模型先验能够实现高质量、低延迟的视频压缩，为生成式压缩领域提供了高效的新范式。
AI.translation: 近期的生成式视频压缩方法利用强大的生成先验来实现感知上令人满意的重建。然而，大多数现有方法需要额外的训练来调整生成模型，以便从紧凑的表示中生成逼真的重建结果。在本文中，我们提出了 ZeroGVC，这是一种零样本生成式视频压缩框架，利用预训练的自回归扩散先验进行低延迟视频重建。ZeroGVC 使用图像编解码器对每组图片（GOP）的第一帧进行编码，并通过“代码本引导的自回归潜空间压缩”来表示后续的 P 帧。这一设计的动机源于我们观察到去噪扩散代码本模型的压缩方案在少步一致性采样中非常有效。通过选择可复现代码本噪声向量的紧凑组合，ZeroGVC 将潜空间去噪轨迹引导至目标 P 帧，同时允许解码器仅通过少量去噪步骤就能复现相同的轨迹。此外，我们设计了一种可选的双向参考模式，通过利用下一个 I 帧的上下文来减轻误差传播，且不会引入任何额外的码率开销。在标准视频压缩基准上的大量实验表明，ZeroGVC 在无需任何额外训练的情况下，在超低码率下实现了卓越的感知重建质量。
AI.summary: ZeroGVC 是一种零样本生成式视频压缩框架，它利用预训练的自回归扩散模型先验，通过代码本引导的潜空间压缩技术实现低延迟视频重建。该方法通过优化噪声向量组合引导去噪轨迹，并结合双向参考模式，在无需额外训练的情况下，在超低码率下展现出优异的感知重建效果。
AI.keywords: 零样本生成式视频压缩, 自回归扩散先验, 低延迟, 代码本引导, 码率控制
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于无需额外训练即可实现零样本视频压缩，通过利用预训练的自回归扩散先验，巧妙地解决了生成式视频压缩中训练成本高的问题，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Target-Aware Linear Regression Under Distribution Shift
summary: Distribution shift between training and deployment is a pervasive challenge for modern AI systems. In many cases, the target marginals of covariates and response are known or specified through population-level observations, boundary conditions, properties of simulator configurations, or alignment-time distributional constraints. Such knowledge may provide valuable side information for regression estimation. We study this problem in the multivariate linear regression setting with a stable conditional mean $E[Y\mid X]$ across source and target, and identify the hybrid-loss estimator, which jointly incorporates both target marginals, as a benchmark target-aware estimator. Its direct computation, however, requires solving a coupled nonlinear optimization that is expensive at scale. Our main contribution is to develop and evaluate two computationally tractable alternatives: a constrained moment-matching estimator and a two-stage estimator that augments ordinary least squares with a calibration step. For all three estimators, we derive and compare closed-form asymptotic mean squared errors, yielding conditions under which the tractable alternatives match or closely approximate the hybrid benchmark, and regimes in which they do not. Monte Carlo experiments across three controlled shift regimes validate the theoretical results, investigate the accuracy-runtime tradeoffs among the three estimators, and translate into guidance on estimator choice. In particular, the two-stage estimator nearly matches the hybrid benchmark in the high signal-to-noise regime at essentially no additional cost, providing theoretical grounding for empirical observations in nonlinear settings.

AI.title_translation: 分布偏移下的目标感知线性回归
AI.tldr: 本文通过利用目标域的已知信息，提出了两种计算高效的线性回归估计方法，在处理分布偏移问题时能以极低的成本接近最优性能。
AI.motivation: 在训练与部署环境存在分布偏移时，利用已知的目标域边际信息来改进回归估计，但直接计算最优的混合损失估计量在大规模场景下计算成本过高，需要寻求计算上可行的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出了三种目标感知回归估计量：1. 混合损失估计量（基准）；2. 约束矩匹配估计量；3. 两阶段校准估计量（增强普通最小二乘法）。通过推导渐近均方误差进行比较，并辅以蒙特卡洛实验验证。
AI.result: 推导了三种估计量的闭式渐近均方误差，明确了替代方案逼近基准的条件。实验表明，两阶段估计量在高信噪比环境下几乎能达到基准性能，且计算成本极低。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出结论，在目标域信息已知的情况下，通过约束矩匹配或两阶段校准方法可以有效地近似计算昂贵的混合损失估计量，特别是在高信噪比环境下，两阶段估计量表现出极高的性价比。
AI.translation: 训练与部署之间的分布偏移是现代人工智能系统面临的普遍挑战。在许多情况下，协变量和响应的目标边际分布可以通过总体观察、边界条件、模拟器配置属性或对齐时间的分布约束来获取。这些知识可能为回归估计提供有价值的辅助信息。我们研究了在源域和目标域之间具有稳定条件均值 E[Y|X] 的多元线性回归问题，并将结合了两种目标边际分布的混合损失估计量确定为基准目标感知估计量。然而，其直接计算需要解决在大规模下昂贵的耦合非线性优化问题。我们的主要贡献是开发并评估了两种计算上可行的替代方案：约束矩匹配估计量和通过校准步骤增强普通最小二乘法的两阶段估计量。对于所有三种估计量，我们推导并比较了闭式渐近均方误差，得出了可行的替代方案匹配或近似混合基准的条件，以及它们不匹配的情况。在三种受控偏移机制下的蒙特卡洛实验验证了理论结果，研究了三种估计量之间的精度-运行时间权衡，并转化为对估计量选择的指导。特别是，两阶段估计量在高信噪比环境下几乎匹配了混合基准，且几乎没有额外成本，为非线性设置中的经验观察提供了理论依据。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在训练与部署数据存在分布偏移且目标域边际分布已知的情况下的多元线性回归问题。作者评估了三种目标感知回归估计量，重点解决了直接计算最优混合损失估计量计算开销大的问题，并提出了两种高效的替代方案：约束矩匹配和两阶段校准估计量，通过理论分析与实验证明了其有效性及适用场景。
AI.keywords: 分布偏移, 线性回归, 目标感知, 矩匹配, 两阶段估计
AI.comments: 该研究通过利用目标域的边际分布信息来解决回归分析中的分布偏移问题，其创新点在于从计算复杂度和理论性能两个维度评估了三种不同的目标感知回归估计量，为实际应用中选择合适的估计策略提供了明确的理论指导。

title: Scalable Physics-Inspired Transformers for Spin Glasses
summary: Efficient sampling of the Boltzmann distribution in frustrated spin glasses is central to statistical mechanics and combinatorial optimization. Despite advances in machine-learning-based approaches, two issues persist: limited understanding of why variational models fail to benefit from increased scale, unlike the monotonic scaling law of large language models; and high computational cost on large systems that negates advantages over classical sampling methods. Here, we develop a physics-inspired transformer with interpretable sparse attention and spin-tailored positional embeddings to address these challenges. By further leveraging FlashAttention for parallel ancestral sampling, it achieves up to two orders of magnitude speedup over vanilla variational autoregressive networks, enabling neural-network simulations of spin-glass systems to unprecedented sizes on a single GPU. It can resolve full probability distributions, free energies, and overlap statistics across temperatures, for Sherrington-Kirkpatrick and 2D or 3D Edwards-Anderson models, where existing machine-learning methods encounter limitations at certain temperatures. This framework thus establishes a scalable paradigm for frustrated spin-glass systems.

title: FEM-Based Dispersion and Mode Analysis of Rectangular, Circular, and Ridge Waveguide Geometries
summary: This paper presents a two-dimensional finite element method (FEM) solver for computing modal field distributions and dispersion characteristics of hollow metallic waveguides. To solve the waveguide problem, the source-free frequency-domain Maxwell equations are reduced to scalar Helmholtz eigenvalue formulations evaluated over the waveguide's transverse cross section. The computational method determines both transverse electric (TE) and transverse magnetic (TM) mode families by enforcing perfectly electrically conducting (PEC) boundary conditions. The framework is initially validated against analytical benchmarks using empty rectangular and circular waveguides, demonstrating high accuracy in computing cutoff wavenumbers, dispersion curves, and field maps for the first three unique modes. After validation, the solver is applied to analyze single-ridged and double-ridged waveguides. The numerical results demonstrate that introducing metallic ridges successfully redistributes the modal fields and significantly lowers the cutoff frequency of the dominant mode relative to empty rectangular guides. Ultimately, this work confirms that the generalized eigenvalue FEM formulation is a robust and adaptable tool for analyzing complex waveguide geometries where exact analytical solutions are unavailable.

AI.title_translation: 基于有限元法的矩形、圆形及脊形波导几何结构的色散与模式分析
AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种基于有限元法的波导分析工具，通过将麦克斯韦方程转化为特征值问题，实现了对矩形、圆形及脊形波导模式与色散特性的高精度模拟。
AI.motivation: 针对复杂波导几何结构（如脊形波导）缺乏解析解的问题，开发一种能够准确计算模式分布和色散特性的通用数值求解工具。
AI.method: 采用二维有限元法（FEM），将无源频域麦克斯韦方程降维为波导横截面上的标量亥姆霍兹特征值公式，并施加理想电导体（PEC）边界条件进行求解。
AI.result: 通过对矩形和圆形波导的验证，该求解器在计算截止波数、色散曲线和场分布方面表现出高精度；同时发现金属脊的引入能有效重分布模场并显著降低主模的截止频率。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功开发并验证了一个基于FEM的波导分析工具，证实了其在计算各种波导结构（尤其是脊形波导）模式分布和色散特性方面的准确性与高效性，为复杂电磁结构的工程设计提供了可靠的数值方法。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种二维有限元法（FEM）求解器，用于计算空心金属波导的模场分布和色散特性。为了解决波导问题，将无源频域麦克斯韦方程简化为在波导横截面上评估的标量亥姆霍兹特征值公式。该计算方法通过强制执行理想电导体（PEC）边界条件，确定横向电（TE）和横向磁（TM）模族。该框架首先使用空矩形和圆形波导进行解析基准验证，证明了其在计算前三个独特模式的截止波数、色散曲线和场图方面具有高精度。验证后，该求解器被应用于分析单脊和双脊波导。数值结果表明，引入金属脊成功地重新分布了模场，并相对于空矩形波导显著降低了主模的截止频率。最终，这项工作证实了广义特征值FEM公式是分析缺乏精确解析解的复杂波导几何结构的稳健且适应性强的工具。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于二维有限元法的波导求解器，用于分析空心金属波导的模式分布与色散特性。通过将麦克斯韦方程转化为标量亥姆霍兹方程，该方法能够精确计算TE和TM模式。在通过矩形与圆形波导验证后，该方法被应用于脊形波导分析，结果表明脊结构能有效调整模场并降低截止频率，证明了该方法在处理复杂波导几何结构时的稳健性和灵活性。
AI.keywords: 有限元法 (FEM), 波导, 色散特性, 模式分析, 脊形波导
AI.comments: 该论文提供了一种通用的基于有限元法（FEM）的波导分析框架，通过将麦克斯韦方程转化为标量亥姆霍兹特征值问题，实现了对复杂波导几何结构的精确模拟。其创新点在于方法的通用性与稳健性，通过对矩形、圆形及脊形波导的分析，验证了该工具在处理无解析解结构时的有效性，对微波工程设计具有重要的参考价值。

title: RadioRange: An Open-Source Digital Twin-based Ranging Simulator for UWB, Wi-Fi, and 5G
summary: Accurate RF-based ranging is critical for location-aware wireless systems, yet no open platform exists for fair, reproducible comparison across protocols under realistic hardware impairments. Existing simulators target communication-layer metrics and lack ranging algorithms, impairment models, and positioning-specific evaluation. We present RadioRange, an open-source, positioning-first digital twin that unifies UWB, Wi-Fi, and 5G NR on identical ray-traced physical channels. The platform models eleven independently toggleable hardware impairments across three injection stages, spanning antenna-level offsets, RF circuit non-idealities, and post-compensation CSI residuals, each with documented physical models and protocol-specific defaults. Five first-path ranging detectors and three multipath identification algorithms are provided within a protocol-specific evaluation framework, enabling controlled Monte Carlo benchmarking and systematic ablation studies. The simulator is validated against real-world UWB and Wi-Fi measurements, demonstrating that the channel model captures geometry-dependent multipath bias. RadioRange-Sim is publicly available at https://github.com/Togure/RadioRange.

AI.title_translation: RadioRange：一个面向 UWB、Wi-Fi 和 5G 的开源数字孪生测距仿真器
AI.tldr: RadioRange 是一个开源的数字孪生平台，旨在为 UWB、Wi-Fi 和 5G 提供公平、可复现的射频测距仿真与基准测试环境。
AI.motivation: 现有的无线仿真平台主要关注通信层指标，缺乏针对测距算法、硬件损伤模型及定位性能评估的统一开源工具，难以进行公平、可复现的跨协议对比。
AI.method: 基于射线追踪技术的物理通道建模，集成了11种可配置的硬件损伤模型（涵盖天线、射频电路及CSI残差），并内置了多种首径检测和多径识别算法，支持蒙特卡洛基准测试。
AI.result: 通过与真实世界中 UWB 和 Wi-Fi 的测量数据对比验证，证明了其通道模型能准确捕捉几何相关的多径偏差，并提供了一套完整的协议评估框架。
AI.conclusion: RadioRange 是一个功能全面、开源的测距仿真平台，能够有效模拟多种无线协议在复杂环境下的测距表现，为定位技术的研究与评估提供了标准化的基准。
AI.translation: 基于射频的精确测距对于位置感知无线系统至关重要，但目前尚无开源平台能够针对各种协议在现实硬件损伤下进行公平、可复现的对比。现有的仿真器主要针对通信层指标，缺乏测距算法、损伤模型和定位相关的评估功能。我们提出了 RadioRange，这是一个开源的、以定位为中心的数字孪生平台，在相同的射线追踪物理信道上统一了 UWB、Wi-Fi 和 5G NR。该平台对三个注入阶段的十一种可独立切换的硬件损伤进行了建模，涵盖了天线级偏移、射频电路非理想特性以及补偿后的 CSI 残差，每种损伤都具备已记录的物理模型和协议特定的默认值。平台提供五种首径检测器和三种多径识别算法，支持受控的蒙特卡洛基准测试和系统的消融研究。该仿真器通过真实的 UWB 和 Wi-Fi 测量数据进行了验证，证明了其信道模型能够捕获几何相关的多径偏差。RadioRange-Sim 已在 https://github.com/Togure/RadioRange 公开发布。
AI.summary: RadioRange 是一个开源的、以定位为中心的数字孪生仿真平台，统一了 UWB、Wi-Fi 和 5G NR 的测距仿真。它通过精细化的硬件损伤建模和通用的评价框架，解决了当前无线测距研究中缺乏公平、可复现对比环境的问题。
AI.keywords: 射频测距, 数字孪生, UWB, Wi-Fi, 5G NR
AI.comments: RadioRange 填补了无线定位领域缺乏统一、可复现基准测试平台的空白。其创新之处在于将数字孪生技术引入射频测距，不仅统一了多种协议（UWB、Wi-Fi、5G），还细致地建模了硬件损伤，为定位算法的深入研究提供了强有力的工具。

title: Optical Ground Stations for Space Communications:Systems Engineering, Availability, and Service Economics Through 2030
summary: Optical ground stations (OGSs) are becoming networked infrastructure for high-rate space-to-Earth communications, but their adoption is governed by service availability and utilization as much as by optical line rate. This paper develops a systems-engineering and service-economics assessment of the OGS sector as of June~2026. The analysis combines public flight demonstrations and operational records with scalar link-budget, availability, and cost-normalization models. Public benchmarks span 25 Mbps from interplanetary range, 260 Mbps-class lunar links, 1.2 Gbps-class ISS relay, 1.8 Gbps operational GEO relay, 120 Gbps-class direct-to-ground demonstrations in China, and 200 Gbps from LEO in NASA's TBIRD mission. The resulting conclusion is that the bottleneck has shifted from peak line rate to repeatable service under weather, acquisition, scheduling, and operations constraints. Under one explicit planning normalization -- a 10 Gbps near-Earth station, annualized cost of $2 million/year, scheduled pre-weather optical contact time of 0.5 h/day, and weather-inclusive combined efficiency $η=0.7$ -- the fixed-cost component is of order $3\times10^{3}$--$4\times10^{3}$ USD/TB. This number is a sensitivity anchor, not a tariff forecast; the controlling variables are duty factor, effective weather diversity, shared-network loading, and service-level allocation. The public industrial evidence is best interpreted as a stratified value chain, not as a single vendor ranking. The defensible 2030 baseline is hybrid optical+radio-frequency (RF): optical for throughput, relay, and spectrum relief; RF for continuity, contingency, and assured command paths.

AI.title_translation: 空间通信的光学地面站：截至2030年的系统工程、可用性与服务经济学分析
AI.tldr: 光学地面站的发展瓶颈已不再是传输速度，而是如何在各种约束下保证持续的服务可用性；未来主流方案是光与射频结合的混合系统。
AI.motivation: 光学地面站作为空间通信的基础设施，其广泛采用不仅取决于传输速率，更受限于服务可用性和利用率。因此需要对当前的OGS行业进行系统工程和服务经济学的综合评估。
AI.method: 结合公开的飞行演示数据、运行记录，以及标量链路预算、可用性评估和成本标准化模型进行系统工程与服务经济学分析。
AI.result: 定义了每TB数据的固定成本基准（约3000-4000美元），并指出影响成本的关键变量为占空比、天气多样性、网络负载及服务水平分配。证实了未来混合光/射频通信系统的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 光学地面站的发展瓶颈已从峰值速率转移到天气、调度和运营约束下的服务可用性。2030年的基准架构应为光学与射频的混合系统，以兼顾高吞吐量与高可靠性。
AI.translation: 光学地面站（OGS）正逐渐成为高速空间对地通信的网络化基础设施，但其采用程度不仅取决于光学链路速率，更受服务可用性和利用率的制约。本文针对截至2026年6月的OGS行业进行了系统工程和服务经济学评估。该分析结合了公开的飞行演示和运行记录，以及标量链路预算、可用性评估和成本标准化模型。公开基准涵盖了从行星际范围的25 Mbps、月球链路的260 Mbps级、国际空间站中继的1.2 Gbps级、地球静止轨道（GEO）中继的1.8 Gbps、中国的120 Gbps级直接对地演示，以及NASA TBIRD任务中低地球轨道（LEO）的200 Gbps传输。研究结论表明，瓶颈已从峰值链路速率转移到天气、采集、调度和运营约束下的可重复服务。在明确的规划标准化下（10 Gbps近地站，年化成本200万美元/年，预定光学接触时间0.5小时/天，包含天气的综合效率η=0.7），固定成本约为3000-4000美元/TB。该数据作为敏感性锚点而非关税预测；控制变量为占空比、有效天气多样性、共享网络负载和服务水平分配。公开的工业证据最好被解释为分层的价值链，而非单一的供应商排名。2030年的可辩护基准是混合光学+射频（RF）：光学用于吞吐量、中继和频谱缓解；RF用于连续性、应急和保障指令路径。
AI.summary: 本文针对2026年光学地面站（OGS）行业进行了系统工程与经济学评估。研究发现，OGS的技术瓶颈已转向服务可用性而非传输速率。通过标准化模型分析，文章量化了成本敏感性因素，并得出结论：2030年的空间通信应采用光与射频互补的混合架构，以实现吞吐量与可靠性的平衡。
AI.keywords: 光学地面站, 空间通信, 系统工程, 服务经济学, 混合通信架构
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将系统工程与服务经济学相结合，从运营成本和可用性角度审视光学地面站（OGS），而非仅仅关注技术指标（如传输速率）。其局限在于部分成本模型基于标准化假设，实际应用中可能受地理位置和具体网络架构影响较大。该研究明确了未来卫星通信的发展路径为“光+射频”混合架构。

title: Unifying Adaptive Fourier and Möbius-Based Models for Efficient and Interpretable Biomedical Signal Decomposition
summary: Oscillatory biomedical signals such as electrocardiograms (ECG) and electroencephalograms (EEG) call for decompositions that are both computationally efficient and interpretable. This paper establishes a formal connection between two finite-order frameworks that have largely evolved independently: Adaptive Fourier Decomposition (AFD), based on orthonormal Takenaka-Malmquist expansions, and the Frequency-Modulated Mobius (FMM) model, a parametric decomposition built on Mobius transforms with morphologically meaningful parameters. We prove that finite-order AFD and FMM decompositions are mathematically equivalent. Under mild regularity assumptions, we further show that their associated estimation procedures solve the same underlying optimization problem when FMM is formulated with independent Gaussian noise. The results are extended to multi-channel signals, which are central in multilead bioelectric recordings. Practically, the equivalence clarifies how fast AFD approximations, including FFT-based implementations, relate to FMM-style parametrization and component interpretability. We illustrate these implications with an EEG example evaluating approximation behavior as the number of components increases, and with an ECG use case comparing five-component decompositions on representative beats, contrasting unlabeled AFD components with physiologically identified FMM components. Overall, the proposed equivalence provides a principled basis to leverage the computational advantages of AFD alongside the interpretability of FMM in biomedical signal analysis.
